notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance - September 25th
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5kjj54nt/250415_maintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]September 25th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]3 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h2][b]-Time-[/b][/h2]
[b]Thursday, September 25th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 10:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 12:00 AM (September 26th) - 3:00 AM (September 26th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update][/url][/*][*]The [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29875/metropolitan-high-school-box][b]Metropolitan High School Box[/b][/url] is ending. Grab your uniform before it's gone![/*][*]The 3rd Season of the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/31139/erinn-adventure-pass-season-3][b]Erinn Adventure Pass[/b][/url] is starting and is sure to be [i]electrifying[/i] with rewards![/*][*]Go live and have your Milletian streaming with the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/31135/livestream-star-box][b]Livestream Star Box[/b][/url]! [/*][/list]
[b]The following bugs will be fixed:[/b]
[list][*]Minor typo fixes. Thank you for the continued reports![/*][*]The in-game reporting function has been fixed and will no longer give an "e-2" error.[/*][*]We've renamed the following hotkey setting to be clearer:[list][*]Messenger Window --> Friends List[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Erinn Adventure Pass - Season 3
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/axzckya3/v2_250924-wgc-2466-erinnpassevent-940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]We've leveled up the Erinn Pass this time around with some electrifying rewards! Complete different tasks to update the Pass and gain rewards each time the Pass levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can purchase a Special Erinn Pass Expansion ticket to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Season Dates: Thursday, September 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Erinn Adventure Pass[/b][/h2][table noborder=true][tr][td][list][*]Upon logging in during Erinn Adventure Pass Season 3, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Chronicling an Adventure[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Eavan [/b]in [b]Dunbarton[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only participate with one character, and this [b]CANNOT[/b] be changed.[/*][*]To open the [b]Erinn Adventure Pass,[/b] on the main task bar click on Character → Erinn Adventure Pass.[list][*]You can also set a hotkey shortcut for it in Options → Game → Control → Hotkey Settings.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1694/ui-bubble.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tqyh0bfc/eap-ui-v2.png[/img]
[list][*]With the Pass, you will receive a wide list of Daily missions for you to choose from, including but certainly not limited to:[list][*]Completing Part Time Jobs[/*][*]Playing Musical Instruments[/*][*]Completing a Uladh Dungeon[/*][*]Clearing Glenn Bearna[/*][*]**[b]New[/b]** Defeat 1 Boss of Brí Leith[/*][*]And many, many more![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Daily missions [/b]reset every day at [b]7:00 AM Server Time.[/b][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Adventure Level[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=true][tr][td][list][*]Each time you complete a task, the mission will automatically complete and you will receive [b]Adventure EXP[/b].[/*][list][*]Collect Adventure EXP to raise the [b]Pass Grade[/b].[/*][/list][*]There are [b]50[/b] grades in total. [/*][*]A maximum of 280 Adventure EXP can be earned per day.[/*][list][*]The limit is reset every day at [b]7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][*]You can earn 1.5x more total Adventure EXP during the weekends (starting and ending at 7:00 AM Server Time).[/*][*]You can also use additional [b]Erinn Pass EXP Tickets[/b] to increase your Adventure EXP.[list][*]The Adventure EXP gained from using an Erinn Pass EXP Ticket is not subject to the daily Adventure EXP limit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Erinn Pass EXP Tickets can be purchased from the Item Shop.[list][*]The Erinn Pass EXP Ticket has a [b]weekly [/b]limit of [b]5 [/b]and resets on [b]Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][table noborder=false][tr][th]Erinn Pass EXP Ticket[/th][/tr][tr][td width=25%][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1653/grade-up.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Price: 2,100[/b] [b]NX[/b]
[b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/detail/cash/153447]BUY NOW[/url][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[table noborder=true][tr][td][h2][b]Special Erinn Pass Expansion[/b][/h2][list][*]In addition to the normal rewards, there are also [b][url=#special]Special Rewards[/url][/b].[/*][*]Special Rewards can only be obtained after being unlocked via the Special Erinn Pass.[/*][*]The [b]Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket[/b] can be purchased from the Item Shop.[/*][*]Purchasing a Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket will not reset your progress and will allow you to collect the special rewards of the levels you've unlocked instantly.[/*][/list][/td][td width=25%][table noborder=false][tr][th]Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket[/th][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/detail/cash/153448][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1652/special-pass.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Price: 21,700 NX[/b]
[b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/detail/cash/153448]BUY NOW[/url][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Season 3 of the Erinn Adventure Pass contains various items such as AP Potions, Erg Unlock Assist Potions, Lightning-themed Chairs and Titles, and more![/*][*][b]Normal Rewards[/b] can be claimed any time you reach a new level.[/*][*][b]Special Rewards[/b] can be unlocked using a [b]Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket[/b].[list][*]For each normal grade unlocked, you will unlock up to the same special grade reward.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note[/b]: You can only Claim Rewards while the Erinn Adventure Pass season is active. Unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character’s Point Inventory after the season ends.[/*][/list]
[b]Normal Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Normal Rewards can be claimed any time you reach a new level.[/*][*]If you complete all Pass Levels, you’ll receive the [b]Erinn Adventure Pass Season 3 Conqueror 2nd Title[/b]![/*][*]All items from the Normal Rewards track are [b]not tradeable[/b].[/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 18th
notes.content:
[b]Maintenance has concluded as of 9:17 AM and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]September 18th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]5:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]5 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h2][b]-Time-[/b][/h2]
[b]Thursday, September 18th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 3:00 AM (September 19th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update][/url][/*][*]Windows Update.[/*][*]Cash Shop Update.[/*][*]Adding 3 more new channels: Channel 14, 15, and 16. [list][*]Channels 14 and 16 will not be raid channels.[/*][*]Channel population of the other channels will not be adjusted.[/*][/list][/*][*]The winners of the[b] [/b]first[b] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfkv3LE9Go6PXqa5Outnxz8DHZ-VRLyyrSiJqGD4kNASQWmcA/viewanalytics]Community Pet Poll[/url][/b] have been selected with over 1,700 Milletians having voted! These pets will be brought back to the cash shop for the next 3 months. Be sure to [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1415203221525500046]give us your thoughts[/url] on what other pets you'd like to see go on sale or brought back![list][*][b]1st Place[/b] - [b]Thunderbird [/b](30% off)[/*][*][b]2nd Place[/b] - [b]Golden Pig [/b](20% off)[/*][*][b]3rd Place[/b] - [b]Shark Robe Seal[/b] (10% off)[/*][/list][/*][*]Test your Summer Festival training results in the challenging [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27083][b]Malign Hellgate Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Wind down after the Summer Festival and relax with other Milletians in [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29009][b]A Campfire for All Event[/b][/url]![/*][/list]
[b]The following bugs will be fixed:[/b]
[list][*][strike]The in-game reporting function has been fixed and will no longer give an "e-2" error.[/strike][/*][list][*] After further testing, this issue will require additional time to fix.[/*][/list][*]We've cleaned up the few Pet Medals on the Auction House that were still untranslated.[/*][*]Spiders had filled in the entire back of the Cobweb Wings giving them a solid color. We've dusted those off so they'll display correctly just in time for Samhain season.[/*][*]We've renamed the following settings to be more clearer:[list][*]Open/Close Interface --> Show/Hide User Interface (UI)[/*][*]Open/Close Character Name --> Show/Hide Character Name[/*][/list][/*][*]The Tiger Cub Whistle was refusing to accept its true colors earlier, but is now called the Yellow Tiger Cub Whistle.[/*][*]Lightning and Thunder Dragons pets? Too confusing. We've condensed the naming to all be just "Thunder" Dragons.[/*][*]We've cleaned up the naming convention of Stat Stones that were obtainable through past Samhain events to be more clearer.[list][*]Additional Stat Stone (Regular) --> Additional Stat Stone (Primary)[/*][*]Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) --> Additional Stat Stone (Unique)[/*][/list][*]Mandrakes are important for potion making! HP, MP, and Stamina 300 Potion RE now correctly lists Mandrakes as one of it's vital ingredients.[/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Malign Hellgate Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/0elpt3lo/250915-wgc-2449-mb-malignhellgateevent-1400x300-v2.png[/img]
[i]Tech Duinn beckons for Milletians to band together and uncover a new portal allowing for even greater dungeon challenges. Prizes and glory await... Can you handle what this new mode has to offer or will you succumb to the depths of Hellgate?[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Table of Contents[/b][/h2]
[list][*][url=#event-details]Event Details[/url][/*][*][url=#entering-hellgate]Entering Hellgate[/url][/*][*][url=#hellgate-missions]Hellgate Missions and Quests[/url][/*][*][url=#hellgate-rewards]Hellgate Rewards[/url][list][*][url=#hellgate-rings]Hellforged Adventure Rings[/url][/*][*][url=#second-titles]Second Titles[/url][/*][*][url=#hellgate-remnants]Hellgate Remnants[/url][/*][/list][url=#hellgate-remnants] [/url][/*][/list]
[url=#hellgate-remnants] [/url][hr][/hr]
[h2=event-details][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, September 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 13th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in to receive the quest [b][Guide] Hellgate Investigation Participation[/b].[/*][list][*][i]No rewards are given for completing the Guide Quest.[/i][/*][/list][*]Find the [b]Hellgate Researcher[/b] in the Tech Duinn Lobby to learn more about the increased dangers that occurred due to the newly spawned portal.[list][*]Unlike other events in the Summer Festival, you will [b]not[/b] be able to teleport directly to the NPC.[/*][/list][/*][*]You’ll be asked to [b]register a Main Character[/b] to partake in the event.[list][*]It’s recommended to register with your most powerful character on your account for this event.[/*][*]Your registered character will need to have [b]completed Generation 22[/b] and access to the Tech Duinn Lobby.[/*][/list][/*][*]Hellgate Mode will take after the 4 regular Tech Duinn Missions with a [b]significant [/b]difficulty increase.
[list][*]Entering this mode will [b]not[/b] count towards your Tech Duinn weekly limit.[/*][*]You will not receive regular Tech Duinn rewards in this mode.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dtphq2gm/hellgate-entrance.png[/img]

[h2=entering-hellgate][b]Entering Hellgate[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Entering Hellgate [b]requires[/b] Milletians to be in a [b]party of 4[/b] to proceed.
[list][*]The created party cannot be a squad, concert, or mini-game party.[/*][*]All members of the party will need to be the registered character on their account.[/*][/list][/*][*]The party leader will need to talk to the Hellgate Researcher to open the Hellgate UI Menu, allowing you to customize the difficulty modifier.[/*][*]The Hellgate UI Menu has 5 slots available to adjust the difficulty, ranging from Level 1 to Level 25. 
[list][*][b]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones[/b] are required to increase the difficulty level.[/*][*]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones range from Level 1 to Level 5, empowering the modifier it is slotted into.
[list][*]You can acquire these stones as an end reward in each Hellgate mission.
[list][*]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones received at the end reward will be determined by the Hellgate Level mission in the table below.[/*][/list][/*][*]Alternatively, Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones can be acquired through Sealed Hellgate Level # Proving Stone Boxes from the Hellgate Researcher’s shop for 1,000,000 gold each.
[list][*][b]Note:[/b] While you are allowed to purchase any level box from the shop, the highest level of your investigations from the week prior will determine the level of Proving Stone Boxes that can be opened.
[list][*]Example: Completing only Level 13 as the highest level will only allow you to open up to Sealed Hellgate Level 3 Proving Stone Boxes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th]Hellgate Level[/th][th]Stone Level Earned (Reward) / Purchased from Store (Box)[/th][/tr][tr][td]0 - 4[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 1) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 1 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]5 - 9[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 2) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 2 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]10 - 14[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 3) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 3 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]15 - 19[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 4) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 4 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]20 - 25[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 5) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 5 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][/table][list][*][list][*]Depending on the indentation the Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone is slotted into, the mission will provide different effects:
[list][*][b]HP Increase:[/b]
[list][*]Increases the health of the boss. The higher the level of the stone, the more HP the boss has.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Defense Decrease:[/b]
[list][*]Decreases the defense and protection of players. The higher the level of the stone, the lower the characters’ defense and protection are.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Blighting Orb:[/b]
[list][*]An orb will appear around the battlefield, rapidly losing health. Overhealing it will provide a buff to those within range. Failure to heal will cause a debuff to those within range.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Burning Earth:[/b] 
[list][*]The player furthest from the boss will be targeted. After a set amount of time, the ground beneath will begin to burn, dealing damage to any players still inside.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Withering Doom:[/b]
[list][*]Continuous mark that will appear over the player closest to the boss, dealing damage that continuously stacks.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Any party member can slot a Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone into the indentation on the UI.[/*][*]Players will start immediately at the boss of that level when entering.
[list][*][b]Note:[/b] The Researcher is unable to learn everything about what's inside, thus turning to you. Milletians will need to work together to learn what's different about these bosses…[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/2j0pf4si/hellgate-ui.png[/img]

[h2=hellgate-missions][b]Hellgate Missions and Quests[/b][/h2]
The Investigation is focusing on specific missions each week. As such, entry into other missions are closed until the appropriate week:[list][*]The dates of when Hellgate Missions open are as follows:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Mission[/th][th]Investigation Begin Date[/th][/tr][tr][td][b]Revived Illusion[/b][/td][td]September 18th, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Feth Fiada[/b][/td][td]October 2nd, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Awakened Abyssal Lord[/b][/td][td]October 16th, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seven Nightmares[/b][/td][td]October 30th, 2025[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Investigations into each mission will [b]reset weekly[/b] (Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time), in which you’ll be rewarded [b]up to 20x Hellgate Remnants[/b] depending on how many challenge levels you and your party completed the week prior.[/*][*]In addition, the Hellgate Researcher will provide the player with 3 investigation quests with unique rewards.[/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zulddkbo/hellgate-quests-v3.png[/img]
[h2=hellgate-rewards][b]Hellgate Rewards[/b][/h2]
[h3=hellgate-rings][b]Hellforged Adventure Rings[/b][/h3]
After completing the quest [b]Hellgate Investigation (Intermediate)[/b], you’ll be given an exclusive [b]Hellforged Adventurer Ring Selection Box[/b]. Be sure to open it to choose between boxes, each containing a powerful ring allowing you to empower yourself with physical or magical enchantments of Hellgate. Be sure to open this box before the end of the event however… Hellgate will reclaim it otherwise.

[table][tr][th]Hellforged Adventurer Ring
(Max Damage) Box[/th][th]Hellforged Adventurer Ring
(Magic Attack) Box[/th][/tr][tr][td]Open to receive a Hellforged Adventure Ring with the Creepy and Haunted enchants on it.[/td][td]Open to receive a Hellforged Adventure Ring with the Eerie and Spooky enchants on it.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Stats:[/b][list][*]Defense: 6[/*][*]Protection: 6[/*][*]Max Damage: 6[/*][*]Piercing Level: 1[/*][/list][/td][td][b]Stats:[/b][list][*]Defense: 6[/*][*]Protection: 6[/*][*]Piercing Level: 1[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan=2]Expires in 90 days once acquired
[b]Note:[/b] These rings cannot have their enchants extracted through Enchanter's Burn.
[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3=second-titles][b]Second Titles[/b][/h3]

After completing each objective in the quest [b]Hellgate Investigation (Advanced)[/b], you’ll be given unique second titles with visual effects for your character.
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/04iepzm3/moon1.gif[/img][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/gz0ktkar/moon2.gif[/img][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vpgi2vpj/moon3.gif[/img][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rn3cjzqb/moon4.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[i]From Left to Right[/i]
[list][*]Black Moon's Omen 2nd Title Coupon[/*][*]Black Moon's Shadow 2nd Title Coupon[/*][*]Black Moon's Rising 2nd Title Coupon[/*][*]Black Moon's Advent 2nd Title Coupon[/*][/list]
[h3=hellgate-remnants][b]Hellgate Remnants[/b][/h3]

[i]Curious to know what you can receive from the remnants of Hellgate? [/i]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*][b]Basic Rewards:[/b][list][*]Basic Erg Unlock 1st Slot Material[/*][*]Basic Erg Unlock 2nd Slot Material[/*][*]Basic Erg Unlock 3rd Slot Material[/*][*]Intermediate Erg Unlock 1st Slot Material[/*][*]Intermediate Erg Unlock 2nd Slot Material[/*][*]Intermediate Erg Unlock 3rd Slot Material[/*][*]Advanced Erg Unlock 1st Slot Material[/*][*]Advanced Erg Unlock 2nd Slot Material[/*][*]Advanced Erg Unlock 3rd Slot Material[/*][/list][/*]
[*][b]Grand Rewards (Very Low Probability):[/b][list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Longing[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Desirous[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Wishing[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Sunken[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Vanished[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Covered[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Fleeing[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Onlooking[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Rotating[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Imprisoning[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=50%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/xusnno3b/levont_cameo_steam.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Immovable[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Frostbitten[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Abominable Rabbit[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Gwyllion[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Gwyllgi[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Trail[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Trajectory[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Trace[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Folach Catt[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Snuggly Sneachta[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Frostwork Soul[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Birch Tree[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Tide[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll - Mirror[/*][*][b]**NEW** [/b]Void Robe Selection Box
[list][*][i]Open to select either a Void Robe (M) or Void Robe (F)[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]Irusan’s Bell (Event)[/*][*]Destructive Robe (Event) Selection Box
[list][*][i]Open to select either a Destructive Robe (M) or Destructive Robe (F)[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]Fleur’s Grass Tiara (Event)[/*][*]Unfinished Reverie’s Diadem Halo (Event)[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Note: [/b][i]Exclusive Enchant Scrolls have a 1-trade limit.
All other items from Hellgate Remnants are untradeable.[/i]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 11th
notes.content:
[b]Maintenance has completed as of 10:00 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]September 11th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]6:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]4 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h2][b]-Time-[/b][/h2]
[b]Thursday, September 11th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 10:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 11:00 PM - 3:00 AM (September 12th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529856925490218609]September's Quality of Life Update[/url] is arriving! Play mini-games with friends and guildmates, browse Shamala's new pet shop, and enjoy a variety of other fantasy life changes in Erinn.[/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529856925490218630]Pan's Check-in Attendance Event: Season 8[/url] is starting! Be sure to log in and collect those stamps to obtain Rowan's outfit.[/*][*]The new [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/30126/sylvan-strider-box]Sylvan Strider Box[/url] is arriving! These new looks are sure to help any nature lover blend in with the surroundings.[/*][*]Numerous events and sales will be ending. [i]Last chance to spend your event currency, collect rewards, or make any final purchases![/i][list][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529848048073836621]Luis's Piñata Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529848048073836529]Letters to a Milletian Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529848048073836387]Guild-ed Gala Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529848048073836619]Mystical Rental Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529850584204840818]Flying High Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529850584204841297]Summer Master Plan Event[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28087/taillteann-townspeople-doll-bag-box]Taillteann Townspeople Doll Bag Box[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28134/summer-soiree-pet-box]Summer Soiree Pet Box[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29034/blanc-patisserie-box]Blanc Patisserie Box[/url][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Pan's Check-in Event Season 8
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]Rowan fans and admirers, your time has arrived! Check in each day to earn various support items, and collect pieces from Rowan's stylish attire. Once you complete the calendar, you can add the next art easel to your homestead in your quest to collect all the Arcanas![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, September 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 18th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] The Collected Collector’s Request.[/b][list][*]Find [b]The Collected Collector[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue in Dunbarton.[/*][*]You’ll receive a [b]Stamp Employee Contract[/b]. Use it to register your [b]account[/b] for the event, allowing you to participate [b]on all characters[/b].[/*][*]Completing [Guide] The Collected Collector’s Request will award you with the following items:[list][*][b]5,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Pan's Support Selection Box x7[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1][tr][td][*]Once registered, a calendar icon will appear on your screen.[list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars with 28 days each, for a total of 84 days.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive your daily stamp, or how far along you are![/*][/list][/*][/td][td width=15%][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1653/calendar-icon.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][*]An Event Clock Timer is also available so you can check your Daily Stamp progress at a glance without opening the Event Menu.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Attendance Stamps[/b][/h2][list][*]You now have even more ways to earn a stamp each day![list][*]Complete any of the following to earn a stamp:[list][*]Daily Taillteann Shadow Mission[/*][*]Daily Tara Shadow Mission[/*][*]Baltane Mission[list][*][i]Excluding Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table missions.[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]Lord Mission[/*][*]Mag Mell Mission[/*][*]Tech Duinn Mission[/*][*]Theatre Mission[/*][*]Clear Crom Bas[/*][*]Clear Glenn Bearna[/*][*]Clear 1 Floor of Fahmes Ruin[/*][*]3 Part-Time Jobs perfectly[/*][/list][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour to earn a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect the stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your Event Clock timer and it is already [b]7:00 AM PT[/b], the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive [b]1 stamp per day[/b].[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[list][*]The rewards will be available for 3 weeks after the event ends from [b]December 18th, After Maintenance ~ January 8th, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/uuifynpf/ui-calendar.png[/img]
[h2][b]Attendance Pass[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase up to 2 Attendance Pass [b]per week [/b]for [b]500,000 Gold[/b] each.[list][*]Additional passes needed per week can be purchased for [b]29 Pon[/b].
[/*][/list][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. [/*][/list][/td][td width=35%][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1795/attendance-pass.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b] Stamp Rewards[/b][/h2]
[b]Note:[/b] All cosmetic items are [u][b]not[/b][/u] tradable. However, Selection Boxes can be [b]traded once[/b].

[list][*]Unused Pet Character Cards can still be used as normal from the Character Selection Screen.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are no changes made to Partners.[/*][/list]
[h3=shamala][b]Shamala's Pet Shop:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Shamala will be opening her own shop for Milletians to purchase old pets that have been sold in the past.[/*][*]All pets sold will be in the form of a Pet Whistle and purchasable with Pon.[list][*]Pon is available for purchase through the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/shop/webshop/detail/cash/138486]Web Shop[/url].[/*][/list][/*][*]The following pets and their prices are as follows:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Pet[/th][th]Price (Pon)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Adelie Penguin[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino King Snake[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Beyaya[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bluebird[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cow[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Desert Cobra[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Golden Retriever[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Goldfinch[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gray Wolf[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Green Gecko[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Himalayan[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Kangaroo Rat[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pitta[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Reindeer[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Hedgehog[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Jindo[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bengal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blue Elephant[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bombay[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bull[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Crow[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Falcon[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ghost Crab[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Laghodessa[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lime Sprite[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Silver Fox[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tiger Cub[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Seal[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Albino Tiger[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Brown Ostrich[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cheetah[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Griffin[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lesser Panda[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Carpet[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mini Skeleton[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Monkey[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rainbow Sprite[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Shire[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2=fantasy-life][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Unvisited Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates will be semi-transparent until visited for the first time.[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrajw0az/mana-tunnel-map-merged.png[/img]
[*]Right-clicking an item will now list options to search and list the item on the Auction House.[/*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zqoas4m3/right-click-menu.png[/img]
[*]When searching the Auction House: Pet Adoption Medals, Blacksmith Manuals, and Sewing Patterns will contain the full name.[/*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/g0pf5luw/auction-house-improvement.png[/img]
[*]Preset Character Models have been refreshed for new accounts and premium character cards during character creation.[/*][*]The pop-up box will no longer appear when attempting to enter a dungeon room where a battle is active.[/*][*]When changing channels, you can now double-click the channel name in the list to move.[/*][*]Two new functions have been added to items when the Inventory Magnifying Glass window is open:
[list][*]You can preview weapons, clothing/armor, and chairs.
You can search items directly that are listable on the Auction House.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Auction House has added security measures to assist with your daily trading and shopping:
[list][*]The warning message has been enhanced to give more notice when attempting to purchase or sell an item 90+% higher or lower than the average price.[/*][*]Warning messages have been added when attempting to purchase non-repairable items that have 20% or less durability/use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Options for Hair Styles, Eye Shapes, Faces, and Mouths have been revised in the Dressing Room so the most recent additions will appear at the top.[/*][*]Sick of having to go outdoors to warp? We are too… so we’ve addressed that! You can now warp indoors when using the following warp functions:
[list][*]The Arcana Room via your Character UI Menu.[/*][*]Festia via your Character UI Menu.[/*][*]Doki Doki Island via the Soulmate UI Menu.[/*][*]The Star Citadel via skill use.[/*][*]Guild Hall via the Guild Hall UI Menu.[/*][*]Event NPCs through the Event UI Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1317970922715742268]Feedback heard![/url] We’ve updated the Astral Reave Dan Tests to be slightly less difficult. You will now receive 35 points instead of 30 when attacking an enemy with Astral Reave.[/*][*]Additional search fields have had their case sensitivity removed:[list][*]Guild UI Menu[/*][*]Point Inventory[/*][*]Party Board[/*][*]Production Crafting Lists[/*][*]Bard Bulletin[/*][/list][/*][*]When picking up equipment from the ground, the logic has been modified so it will no longer be equipped to the character’s style tab automatically.
[list][*]The equipment can still be automatically slotted into the character’s equipment tab as normal if the equipment tab slot is empty.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following appearance scrolls have been renamed to indicate that they are applied onto two-handed axes, not scythes, despite visually being scythes:
[list][*]Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][*]Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][*]Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)[/*][/list][/*][*]Following the Magic Attack Changes in July, adjustments to ease the difficulty have been made to most RP missions where the Magic Talent is a focus.[/*][*][Element] Alchemy skills have been properly unified in name, matching the format of the current Earth Alchemy Mastery skill: 
[list][*]Fire Alchemy -> Fire Alchemy Mastery[/*][*]Wind Alchemy -> Wind Alchemy Mastery[/*][*]Water Alchemy -> Water Alchemy Mastery[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2=bug-fixes][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[i]We’ve been continuing to address G27 via several fixes throughout the month. Thanks for all the reports - we very much appreciate these, and we hope that you’re enjoying the story![/i]
[list][*]Zap-happy Dark Diviners with Thunderblight and specific timing could accidentally destroy the enemies during one of the G27 cutscenes, creating a time paradox where nothing further would happen! ...Until you left and tried again, that is. The enemies have been adjusted to no longer be defeated during the cutscene. [/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the game to close when previewing one of the following chairs: 
[list][*]Kanna Tanning Chair[/*][*]Eirlys Tanning Chair[/*][*]Elsie Tanning Chair[/*][*]Dai Tanning Chair[/*][*]Kaour Tanning Chair[/*][*]Logan Tanning Chair[/*][*]Shuan Tanning Chair[/*][*]Christmas Dessert Table[/*][*]Elegant Afternoon Tea Table[/*][/list][/*][*]Through your reports, we found and fixed a few more Sewing Patterns where the pattern had gone mysteriously blank.
[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the August 28th Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Addressed the channel lag by adding new channels and redistributing channel population capacities. See the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/30036/completed-scheduled-maintenance-and-hotfix-patch-august-28th#channel-increase]August 28th Maintenance Patch Notes[/url] for the full details! [/*][*]More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel![/*][*]As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.[/*][*]In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. Robes that were crafted in this incorrect way have been corrected automatically. [/*][*]The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:[list][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F][/*][*]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:
[list][*][Dual Guns]
[list][*]Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers
[Control Bars][/*][/list][/*][*]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer Tricksters
[list][*]Perseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars
[Knuckles][/*][/list][/*][*]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer Vagabonds
[list][*]Perseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented Knuckles[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type (ie. Nightbringer Warlord Greatsword).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the August 21st Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some Generation 27 typos as reported by our Milletians.[/*][/list][h2=known-bugs][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h2][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]An e-2 error is occasionally causing in-game Player Reports to fail to send. In the meanwhile, if you need to submit a report we ask that you use our [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.com/hc/en-us]Player Support website[/url].[/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5kjj54nt/250415_maintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg[/img]
[b]Maintenance has concluded as of 10:30 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]August 28th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance will begin at [b]5:00 AM PDT[/b] and is expected to last up to [b]6 hours[/b]. In addition to the below, [i]please see the [url=#patch-notes]Patch Notes[/url] section for more information[/i].
[list][*]Windows Update[/*][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Did you find all the GMs in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29688/summer-gm-event-2025][b]GM Hide & Seek Event[/b][/url]? The following server buffs may be active starting tomorrow:[list][*]Erg Success Rate Boost[/*][*]+2 Dungeon Guide Coins[/*][*]2x Erinn Spirit Drop Rate[/*][/list][/*][*]It's back to school in Erinn. Pick up your new uniforms in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29875/metropolitan-high-school-box][b]Metropolitan High School Box[/b][/url]![/*][*]Last chance to acquire the looks from the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28770/celestial-eminence-box][b]Celestial Eminence Box[/b]![/url][/*][/list]
Note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h2][b]-Time-[/b][/h2]
[b]Thursday, August 28th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 11:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 8:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 4:00 AM (August 29th)[/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.
[hr][/hr]
[h3=patch-notes][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/acuhclbs/patch-notes-1400x300.jpg[/img][/h3]
Hello Milletians!

We'll be having a mid-cycle patch with a few upcoming changes.

[b]Table of Contents:[/b]
[list][*][url=#OTR]Return of the Over the Rainbow Event[/url][/*][*][url=#channel-increase]Channel Increase and Reduction[/url][/*][*][url=#bug-fix]Bug Fixes[/url][/*][/list]
[h3=OTR][b]Return of the Over the Rainbow Event[/b][/h3]
In our [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/29819/notice-regarding-the-over-the-rainbow-event-august-19-2025]previous announcement[/url], we shared about the various issues that were discovered and needed to be addressed to ensure the gameplay was fair for all Milletians. The biggest issue was the efficiency in which Milletians could acquire rewards through Leprechauns, particularly Dapper. To prevent high-valued rewards from being flooded into the game's economy and ensure that the rewards still have value after the event, the following adjustments have been made:
[list][*]A weekly [b]Leprechaun Encounter Limit [/b]will be added to Uladh Hard Mode Advanced, Tech Duinn, and Crom Bás Dungeons.[list][*]Crom Bás: 10 Encounters[/*][*]Tech Duinn: 15 Encounters[/*][*]Uladh Hard Mode Advanced: 15 Encounters[/*][*]This limit functions separately from the dungeon reward limit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The weekly encounter limit will reset on [b]Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT[/b].[/*][*]With the addition of this limit, the encounter rate for higher-grade Leprechauns has been slightly increased for both Tech Duinn and Crom Bás.[/*][*]Leprechauns will no longer spawn in the Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares mission. Initially, a Leprechaun would spawn when Cethlenn would reach 20% health, but would cause the Leprechaun to despawn if Cethlenn was defeated.[list][*]Due to the nature of this bug and to ensure a timely return of the event, this particular Tech Duinn mission has been excluded.[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1][tr][td][*]The [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27082]Over the Rainbow Event[/url] will resume [b]this Thursday after maintenance[/b] and will be [b]extended for 2 weeks[/b] after its original end date, with the [b]new end date[/b] being October 30th (Before Maintenance).[/*][/td][td width=40%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/doto52nn/otr-ticket.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/list]
We greatly apologize for the inconvenience that the temporary suspension and adjustment of the event has caused. As compensation, the following rewards will be provided via a Hotday Event for all accounts from [b]August 28th to September 11th[/b]:
[list][*][b]Service Error Compensation Box[/b] (Expires in 30 Days)[list][*]5x Unlimited Dungeon Pass Boxes (Expires in 7 Days)[list][*]Each Box contains 3x Unlimited Dungeon Passes (Expires in 7 Days)[/*][/list][/*][*]3x Holy Water of Murias (No Expiration)[list][*]Applying this item to equipment can grant a powerful random effect.[/*][*]Once applied, the equipment will be untradeable and cannot be stored in the Dressing Room unless removed.[/*][*]Please refer to our [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update#bri-leith-rewards]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace Update Notes[/url] for more details and information.[/*][/list][/*][*]1x Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 Days) (No Expiration)[/*][/list][/*][*]All items received are untradeable and can only be claimed once per account.[/*][/list]
[h3=channel-increase][b]Channel Increase and Reduction[/b][/h3]
With the Summer Festival in full swing, we have noticed a significant increase in Milletians both joining for the first time and returning to Erinn! [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28948/generation-27-the-garden-of-solace-update#known-bugs]As mentioned previously[/url], we are aware that these growing pains are not without issues, particularly lag amongst all channels. 

In this upcoming maintenance, our first update aimed at addressing the recent performance will be taking place:
[list][*]3 new channels will be added to the server, for a total of 13 channels.[list][*]Channel 11[/*][*]Channel 12[/*][*]Channel 13[/*][/list][/*][*]Adjusting the channel population to be uniform for all channels.[/*][/list]
While these adjustments are just an initial step, we will continue to share about the changes made to the game. In the weeks following we will be monitoring these changes and these new channels for stability and overall improvements. Following changes to be made include improvements to the server hardware, the inclusion of more channels as needed, and more as our changes uncover other issues or point us towards areas of greater focus. 

Thank you for your patience as we continue to make further adjustments as necessary to bring you the best Mabinogi.

[h3=bug-fix][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel![/*][*]As accidentally [i](we swear!)[/i] showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. notes.title: [Notice] Regarding the Over the Rainbow Event - August 19, 2025
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/edhgjhai/announcement-1400x300.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Dear Milletians, 

In short, the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27082]Over the Rainbow Event[/url] will be temporarily disabled as we make a few corrections to the Leprechauns. There has been a very positive reception to this event, and we want to make sure to return it as quickly as we can while maintaining the good vibes. 

To share further details, several issues were occurring in various areas of the event relating to the rarities of the Leprechauns, the interactions with weekly limits and keys, and rarer circumstances that could cause no Leprechauns to spawn or no rewards to drop. Additionally and most notably for the purposes of this disabling, our intention was to provide better chances to encounter Leprechauns with higher rarity in more difficult dungeons so that players would challenge these dungeons, but we found that Uladh Dungeons had better efficiency, resulting in players focusing on Uladh Dungeons rather than other dungeons.  

When the event returns, the following changes will be made and we will also be addressing other existing bugs related to the event. Rather than decreasing rates for Uladh Hard Mode Dungeons, we will be adding a set number of Leprechaun encounter chances per week for each dungeon type. Instead, to make it more rewarding for you to tackle more difficult dungeons, we will be raising the rates for rarer grade Leprechauns for Tech Duinn and Crom Bás. While we are happy that players are spending a lot of time with the event, we hope that the limits are a compromise to allow for higher rates while freeing players up to try out other new updates and events that our summer patches have to offer, such as the new Generation storyline, attempting Brí Leith with your friends and guildmates, or even participating in the several Milletian-ran events that are occurring this month!

This will take some time to confirm the stability of these changes and the event overall, but we will try to implement these changes and resume the event as soon as possible. We thank you for your patience and understanding during this time. We will also be extending the event window to ensure that you have as much time as possible for slaying the Leprechauns, and we will update you with more information on the webpost as we have more details to share.

Thank you, 

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Test Your Metal Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lg0ic3wa/250805_wgc-2282_testyourmetalevent_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png[/img]
[i]Ferghus is looking to give you a free weapon! We promise it's not a scam. Earn yourself a weapon on par with the Perseus weapons through his own craft and all he asks is to spread his good name throughout Erinn in return! Check out all the details below![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, August 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 16th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2]Event Details[/h2]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Log in to receive the quest [b][Guide] You’re Un-Fergh-ettable![/b][/*][*]Meet with Ferghus in Tir Chonaill to learn more about the new set of weapons he’s created.
[list][*]You can also warp to him directly by clicking the “[b][u]To NPC[/u][/b]” button in the Summer Festival UI.[/*][*]You may add/remove this event to/from your Event Icon List by clicking the “[b][u]On/Off[/u][/b]” buttons in the Summer Festival UI.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=10%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wltc3pqv/tym-ui-icon.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ckubiwfw/summer-festival-ui-help.png[/img]
[list][*]You’ll be asked to [b]register a Main Character[/b] to partake in the event.[/*][*]Select the weapon you wish to acquire. This weapon will be on par with its Perseus Weapon counterpart.[/*][*]After confirming the weapon choice, Ferghus will provide the option to choose what kind of quests you’d like to complete to acquire enhancements for your new weapon. Your decision will determine what type of objectives you’ll need to complete to upgrade your new weapon.
[list][*][b]Thrilling battles![/b] - all objectives given will be combat-related, clearing dungeons, and dungeon-related storylines.[/*][*][b]Calming crafting and gathering[/b] - all objectives given will be life-related, ranging from commerce, gathering, and quests related to stardust.[/*][*][b]A little bit of everything[/b] - you will be given a mix of both combat and life-focused objectives.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sjun1zdr/test-your-metal-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]Regardless of which objective path you choose, you’ll have 12 different tasks assigned to unlock all the rewards specifically designed for your new Fergseus weapon.[/*][*]Six of those tasks will be available the first week, with 2 additional tasks opening each week after on [b]Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][*]Check out all the exclusive enhancements you can earn to upgrade your weapon:[/*][/list]
[table]
   [tr]
      [th width=8%]Week[/th]
      [th]Item[/th]
      [th]Additional Information[/th]
   [/tr]
   [tr]
      [th rowspan=6]1[/th][td][b]Special Fergseus Upgrade Hammer[/b][/td][td]This unique hammer will automatically apply all of a weapon’s normal and gem upgrades in one go.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Fergseus Reforging Hammer[/b][/td][td]This special reforging hammer will apply an optimized reforge, ensuring a helpful bonus.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Fergseus Prefix Enchant Box[/b][/td][td]Will provide you with a custom-made Prefix Enchant Scroll to complement your weapon[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Fergseus Suffix Enchant Box[/b][/td][td]Will provide you with a custom-made Suffix Enchant Scroll to complement your weapon[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/b][/td][td rowspan=5]Allows you to choose between a Lucky Blue Upgrade Stone or Lucky Red Upgrade Stone.

Lucky Upgrade Stones allow you to perform a special upgrade on your weapon at 100% rate up to Level 5.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]2[/th][td][b]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]3[/th][td][b]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Exceptional Special Upgrade Increase Scroll[/b][/td][td rowspan=2]Boosts the Special Upgrade of your Fergseus weapon by +1, up to Level 7.[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]4[/th][td][b]Exceptional Special Upgrade Increase Scroll[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Blossoming Hope Gem[/b][/td][td]
Upgrades the number of attribute slots on your reforged weapon to 3.

Note: Using this item first and then the Reforging Hammer will remove the extra attribute slots.
[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]All upgrade items can only be used on the Fergseus Weapon you currently own.[/*][*]All upgrade items are untradeable and expire within 60 days if not used.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Weapon Swapping[/b][/h2]
[i]Did your hand slip and you selected the wrong weapon?[/i]
[list][*]Ferghus will allow you to trade the weapon in for a different one [b]once per day[/b] (resets [b]daily at 7:00 AM PDT[/b]) with the following restrictions:[list][*]You must still own the current Fergseus weapon you obtained.[/*][*]Any enhancements applied to the weapon acquired from the event can be reapplied.[list][*]Objectives will need to be completed again to acquire the prizes.[/*][/list][/*][*][b][u]Any enhancements applied to the weapon not earned from the event will be lost.[/u][/b][/*][*]If the weapon has been turned into a Spirit Weapon or been imbued with Erg, it cannot be traded in.[list][*]Please transfer the Erg or Spirit prior to trading in your weapon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2=generation-27][b]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace[/b][/h2]
Word travels across the land as Divine Beasts begin to appear once again. This time, however, rumors spread of a mysterious warrior who claims they can solve any problem that the famous Milletian can…
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace has been added.[list][*]Players who have completed Generation 26 will automatically receive the quest [b]The Sign of the Comet[/b].[/*][*]Players who have not completed Generation 26, but have reached at least Cumulative Level 5,000, will receive a window notification that the storyline is available for them to start if they so choose. [list][*]You may start the storyline by clicking the “Start G27 The Garden of Solace” button in the Storyline Menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Korean voiceover has been added to all characters in the story. [list][*]You can adjust the volume of the voices through the Options menu by going to the following: [list][*]Options → System →Sound → Voice Volume[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=30%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yhxcpaox/g27-story-message-ui.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Completing Generation 27 Part 1 will reward the player with the following:[list][*]Sister's Flower Crown[/*][/list][/*][*]Completing Generation 27 Part 2 will grant the player with the following:: [list][*]Brí Leith Dungeon unlocked[/*][*]who Recalls the Unfading Garden title[/*][*]Solace Prefix Enchant[/*][/list][list][*]Acquire the Garden of Solace Collection Book to further enhance your MabiNovels by talking to Declan at the East Wind Camp in Port Ceann.[/*][*]Invite a G27 NPC to the Campfire Spirit.[/*][*]Revisit Generation 27 cutscenes by watching them anytime through the Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library.[/*][/list][/*][*]9 BGMs related to the G27: The Garden of Solace campaign have been added to the Jukeboxes for your Homestead and Moonlight Island.[list][*]These songs can be unlocked through the C1-C7 Replay Reward Boxes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2=bri-leith-dungeon][b]Brí Leith Dungeon[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Entry Details[/b] [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/554fnkwr/bri-leith-dungeon-pass.png[/img][/h3]
[list][*]Entry will be available through the Gate of Murias located at the Longa Desert Oasis in Connous.[/*][*]Dungeon Entry Conditions:[list][*]Generation 27 completed.[/*][*]Cumulative Level 20,000 or higher.[/*][*]Arcana Total Level 200 or higher.[/*][/list][/*][*]A minimum of 1 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeon.[/*][*]Each party member must have a [b]Bri Leith Dungeon Pass[/b] to enter.[/*][*]You may purchase passes from the NPC outside the dungeon Entrance Portal.
[list][*]The price of purchasing a pass will increase depending on the number of passes you purchase during the week.[list][*]These prices are applied [b]account-wide[/b].[/*][*]Purchased Dungeon Passes are good for 7 days.[/*][/list][/*][*]Dungeon Pass prices will reset every [b]Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][table center=1][tr][th]Number of Passes Purchased[/th][th]Price (in Gold)[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]100,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]200,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]400,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]700,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]1,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]2,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]3,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]5,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]7,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]10[/td][td]10,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]11+[/td][td]50,000,000[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Retry & Checkpoints[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Retry[/b][list][*]During battle, the party has the option to restart the current battle from the beginning by pressing the [RETRY] button at the top right of the screen.[/*][*]All players in the party must press the button to restart.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Checkpoint[/b][list][*]Allows the party to continue where they left off in the dungeon.[/*][*]After defeating a boss, a checkpoint save menu will appear, allowing you to save your status in the dungeon and re-enter at a later time.[list][*]The checkpoint save will last until you’ve completed the next boss/cleared the dungeon, or canceled it outside at the gate.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new Dungeon Pass is required when exiting and re-entering the dungeon where you left off.[/*][*]When entering the dungeon through a checkpoint, ALL party members must be at the same checkpoint.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Revival Restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Party members can be revived [b]once[/b] per battle stage.[list][*]Harmonic Saint’s Steadfast Soul ability can bypass this limit, allowing for a second revival for themselves.[/*][*]The limit is reset upon retrying or winning the battle.[/*][*]If all party members are incapacitated, the battle will automatically restart, regardless of the number of revivals the party has remaining.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Time Limit[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each stage of the dungeon has a set time limit.[/*][*]Should the fight exceed the time limit, the current battle will end and automatically be retried.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Reward Distribution[/b][/h3]
[list][*]After defeating each stage of the dungeon, the party will be rewarded with [b]one[/b] treasure chest.[list][*]See [url=#bri-leith-rewards][b]Brí Leith Dungeon Reward Details[/b][/url] section for more details on the rewards themselves.[/*][/list][/*][*]At first, the treasure chest can only be opened by the party leader.[list][*]If the party leader does not open it after 30 seconds, anyone in the party can open the treasure chest.[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon opening the treasure chest, a special reward distribution UI will appear listing all the rewards that can be distributed to all party members currently in the dungeon.[list][*]If a party member happens to re-enter the dungeon after the chest has been opened, they will be ineligible for reward distribution.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each eligible party member will roll the dice (1 to 100) for each item. The party member with the highest roll will win that item.[list][*]If two or more winning party members rolled the same number on an item, a second tie-breaker roll will be initiated to break the tie.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you move to another location or exit the dungeon during the reward distribution, all items except for the ones you’ve already won will be automatically “passed over”.[/*][*]If a solo party opens the treasure chest, a reward choice UI will appear, allowing the player to select which items they’d like to discard/keep rather than the party reward distribution UI.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Other[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A cooldown period of 30 seconds is applied when consuming a potion in the dungeon.[/*][*]Party members can only re-enter the dungeon when the party is not currently fighting a boss.[/*][/list]
[h2=bri-leith-rewards][b]Brí Leith Rewards[/b][/h2]
[i]Many new rewards have been added, allowing you to further empower your gear, Arcanas, and craft the most powerful weapons ever seen in Erinn - Soul Liberator weapons.[/i]
[list][*]Rewards can be obtained after defeating each boss in the dungeon.[list][*]With each boss defeated, each party member is guaranteed the following rewards:[list][*]Trace of Memory[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias (Not Tradeable)[/*][/list][/*][*]Further rewards are distributed through the reward distribution UI.[/*][*]Neither EXP nor Gold are awarded in the dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1][tr][td][*]Defeating each of the 3 dungeon bosses will reward you with a Journal Achievement[list][*]Bri Leith - Defeat Vertrag of the Deep Roots (10 points)[/*][*]Bri Leith - Defeat Bronntanas (20 points)[/*][*]Bri Leith - Defeat [Final Boss] (30 points)[/*][/list][/*][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/cpvmeowq/bri-leith-journal-achievements.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][*]Multiple titles are available to earn throughout the dungeon:[list][*]who Broke the Comet’s Orbit[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]who Trampled the Trampler[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]the Ender of Euphoria[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]the Agony and the Ecstasy[list][*]Max Damage +33[/*][*]Magic Attack +55[/*][*]Defense +30[/*][*]Magic Defense +30[/*][*]Protection +15[/*][*]Magic Protection +15[/*][*]Movement Speed +2%[/*][/list][/*][*]whose Memories Shall Never Fade[list][*]Max Damage +33[/*][*]Magic Attack +55[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3=holy-water][b]Holy Water of Murias[/b][/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]The following items have been added:[list][*]Bri Leith Cascading Water[/*][*]Elixir of Reality[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias Cleansing Scroll[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ccphbqqn/holy-water-murias.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Similar to Holy Flame, applying Holy Water of Murias will grant new effects towards equipment.[/*][*]Items that have had Holy Water of Murias applied will become untradeable.[/*][*]The Holy Water of Murias’ effect and untradeable status can be removed through the use of a Holy Water of Murias Cleansing Scroll.[/*][*]Holy Water of Murias can be either obtained by defeating a Bri Leith dungeon boss or through Handicrafting.[list][*]The items required for crafting can be obtained through the Bri Leith Dungeon NPC Shop and through Bri Leith’s reward distribution.[/*][/list][/*][*]The potential list of effects on equipment blessed by Holy Water of Murias can be [h3=murias-relics][b]Murias Relics[/b][/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]You can acquire new Murias Relics (Ideal) from the City of the Gods as a possible reward for defeating the final boss of Bri Leith Dungeon.[list][*]Murias Relics (Ideal) expire within 7 days unless restored.[/*][*]A Murias Relic (Ideal) can be restored and repaired by the NPC next to the Entrance Portal to Bri Leith.[list][*]The cost of restoration is 3,000,000 Gold and the effect is random.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you wear multiple Murias Relics with the same effect, only the highest value will be active.[/*][/list][/*][*]Murias Relics share the same Divine Treasure Slots as Falias Relics.[/*][*]Similar to Falias Relics that enhance the power of Demigod, Murias Relics enhance the power of the Arcanas! See what type of powers you can unlock below:[/*][/list][/td][td width=30%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ad2nddot/murias-relics-v2.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr][th]Elemental Knight[/th][td][list][*]Increased Blazing Assault Slash Damage (Max 500%)[/*][*]Increased Shattering Windmill Damage (Max 600%)[/*][*]Increased Dynavolt Smash Damage (Max 800%)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]Harmonic Saint[/th][td][list][*]Increased Echoes of Salvation Recovery (Max 500)[/*][*]Increased Pulse of Purification Duration (Max 5 seconds)[/*][*]Increased Pall of Ruination Duration (Max 5 seconds)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]Alchemic Sharpshooter[/th][td][list][*]Increased Ignis Plume Damage (Max 300%)[/*][*]Increased Aqua Volley Damage (Max 600%)[/*][*]Increased Tri-Assault Finisher Damage (Max 1000%)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]Dark Diviner[/th][td][list][*]Reduced Shadow Flare Cooldown (Max 2 seconds[/*][*]Reduced Thunderblight Cooldown (Max 4 seconds)[/*][*]Increased Polar Vortex Duration (Max 5 seconds)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]Sacred Guardian[/th][td][list][*]Increased Divine Retribution Martyr’s Burden Deduction Rate (Max 10%)[/*][*]Increased Deliver Judgement Damage (Up to 600%)[/*][*]Increased Martyr’s Consecration Damage Interval (Max 2 seconds)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]Explosive Vanguard[/th][td][list][*]Increased Arc Impact Damage (Max 500%)[/*][*]Increased Dreadnought Burst Explosion Attack (Max 700%)[/*][*]Increased Blaze of Glory Explosion Mana Pressure Coefficient (Max 3)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3=npc-shop][b]NPC Shop[/b][/h3]
[list][*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vruberox/bri-leith-obol.png[/img] Bri Leith Obols earned from rolling can be used in the Dungeon NPC Shop right outside the Portal to Murias.[list][*]Gold is also accepted for specific items as well.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Cost (Obols)[/th][th]Additional Info[/th][/tr][tr][td]Bri Leith Core[/td][td]100[/td][td rowspan=9]Not Tradeable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bri Leith Essence[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Green Memory Fragment[/td][td]25[/td][/tr][tr][td]Orange Memory Fragment[/td][td]25[/td][/tr][tr][td]Golden Memory Fragment[/td][td]25[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bri Leith Empowered Crest[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dull Blade Fragment[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Malleable Metal Shard[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Faded Embroidery Thread[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Enchanted Melding Agent[/td][td]500,000 (Gold)[/td][td] [/td][/tr][tr][td]Elixir of Reality[/td][td]800,000 (Gold)[/td][td]

[list][*]The following enchants can be found from Bri Leith Dungeon:[list][*]All Enchants listed below have the following applications:[list][*][Enchanted equipment made exclusive.][/*][*][Repair Fee +200%][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th colspan=2 width=50%]Prefix Enchants[/th][th colspan=2]Suffix Enchants[/th][/tr][tr][td width=15%][b]Animated[/b][/td][td width=35%]

With the many new Milletians entering Erinn, we love to see Mabinogi growing and flourishing, though we recognize this hasn’t been without issues. In the future, we will send a letter about our plans to address and improve the network latency. We apologize again for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determine the causes.[/i]

notes.title: Box Full of Memories Event
notes.content:
[img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/lirl40vy/250708-wgc-2139-mb-mainstreamstoryskipsale-1400x300-v2.png[/img]
[i]Lorna and Pan found a new item that’s sure to help any Milletian in saving Erinn! They found so many that they’re willing to let you sample this new item out! If you want more though, it’s gonna cost ya… check out all the details below![/i]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, August 14th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event to receive the guide quest [b][Guide] An Unopenable Box.[/b][/*][*]Talk to Lorna and Pan in Dunbarton next to the Unicorn Statue to learn more about the new item.[list][*]Register a main character to complete the quest and receive the following rewards:[table noborder=1][tr][td width=75%][list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*][b]**NEW** Memory of a Story Selection Box[/b][list][*]This unique item will allow your character to [b]instantly complete[/b] a Generation Storyline of your choosing (up to Generation 25).[/*][*]You will need to have started the storyline before it can be skipped.[/*][*]The item does not expire.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/42wf5i32/webicon_mainstreamskip.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][/*][*]After registering a main character and completing the guide quest, you’ll be given the option to earn up to 4 additional Memory of a Story Selection Boxes![/*][*]You’ll be given [b][Quest] Box Full of Memories[/b].[list][*]Talk to Lorna and Pan to learn what missions you’ll need to complete.[/*][*]You’ll be given one mission per week.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th]Quest[/th][th]Task[/th][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 1st Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 10th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Complete 5 Part-Time Jobs.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 2nd Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 17th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Clear a Shadow Mission or Uladh Dungeon 3 times.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 3rd Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 24th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Engage in Commerce 3 times.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 4th Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 31st, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Harvest Homestead Crops 5 times.[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Completing all 4 weekly quests will also reward you with the best reward of all… [i]Pan’s admiration and respect[/i]. Oh, and the following bonus rewards:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]*NEW* Goddess Feather 2nd Title Coupon[/b] [img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/ai3nboyy/goddess-feather-title-icon.png[/img][/*][*][b]*NEW* Immersed in Memory 2nd Title Coupon[/b] [img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/3h1n5jtl/memory-2nd-title.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][table noborder=1][tr][td][img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/favngtvl/goddess-2nd-title-animation-v2.gif[/img][/td][td][img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/pzwjvsea/memory-2nd-title-animation-v2.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*]This offer by Lorna and Pan is only available until [b]August 14th[/b], so be sure to grab these before they’re gone![/*][/list]
[h2][b]Memory of a Story Sale[/b][/h2]
[i]Need to stock up on additional Memories of a Story? While Lorna and Pan have given a few away, they’re selling additional copies in the cash shop! This limited time sale is only available until August 14th, so be sure to pick up a copy or two today![/i]

[table noborder=1][tr][td][table][tr][th]Memory of a Story Selection Box[/th][/tr][tr][td][img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/42wf5i32/webicon_mainstreamskip.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Price: 9,200 NX
[b][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/shop/webshop/detail/cash/154402]BUY NOW[/url][/b][/td][/tr][/table][/td][td][list][*]Allows you to instantly complete a Generation Story![list][*]When using the item, you will receive all relevant titles, rewards, and reward boxes that come with completing the story.[/*][*]Can only be used for Generations 1-3 and 8-25.[list][*]Generation 7 can be skipped by talking to Kousai in Cor.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will need to have started the storyline before it can be skipped.[/*][/list][/*][*]The selection box has a 1-time trade usage when purchased in the cash shop. The books themselves cannot be traded, dropped, or stored in the bank/pet.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Flying High Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2fbyh11/250626_flyinghighevent-newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg[/img]
[i]Dash, Leap, and Fly your way to new heights as you acquire goods that will help every Milletian with their Master Plan training! From acquiring your first (or second) Arcana to dashing to Level 40,000, the benefits of this event are sure to have you dashing, leaping, and eventually, flying high![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Log in to receive the quest [b][Guide] Flying High Guide Quest[/b].[/*][*]Visit the Flying Boy next to Ferghus in Tir Chonaill to register a main character.[list][*]When registering a main character [b]with an account that has not unlocked an Arcana[/b], the event will start with [b]Step 1: Dash[/b].[list][*]You will receive numerous items to help progress your character to acquire your first Arcana throughout clearing Step 1: Dash.[/*][/list][/*][*]When registering a main character [b]with an account that has unlocked an Arcana[/b], the event will proceed to [b]Step 2: Leap[/b] and [b]Step 3: Fly[/b].[list][*]The following items will be provided upon registration:[list][*][b]**NEW** Alban Knights Condensed Divine Fruit x1[/b][list][*]Increases your Crusader Level to 100.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]**NEW** Stardust Memory Scroll (Rank 10) x1[/b][list][*]Using this powerful scroll will rank your character's Stardust to Rank 10.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]**NEW** Spirit Memory Scroll (Level 100) x1[/b][list][*]Using this powerful scroll will automatically level a Spirit Weapon to Level 100.[/*][*]Does not affect Spirit Bond bonus, allowing for maximum Ego Points.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]**NEW** Max Renown Seal Box x1[/b][list][*]Opening this box will reward you with [b]all 6 types[/b] of Renown Seals with the required amount to rank to Level 50.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Warrior Corgi Whistle (Medal Storage Unavailable) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Wizard Corgi Whistle (Medal Storage Unavailable) x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]If the account has an Arcana level of at least 50, additional items are provided upon registration.[/*][/list][/*][*]Regardless of whether an account has unlocked an Arcana or not, registered characters will receive the following items:[list][*][b]**NEW** High-Flying Nao Bag Coupon[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4otazhmx/nao-gift-box-personal-shop-cropped.png[/img][/b][list][*]Contains a 10x10 Personal Shop Bag with a small Nao Figure to help you sell your goods.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Upon speaking with the Flying Boy, the character will be placed in either Dash, Leap, and/or Fly depending on both the character and account progress of an Arcana.[list][*]The Flying Boy will let you know where your character will be placed before finalizing your character's registration, in case you wish to register on a different character.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
