notes.title: Producer’s Letter: Summer Festival Continues! Timeline & More~
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/niyjn1dt/250609-producers-letter-newsarticleheader_1400x300.jpg"][/img]Dearest Milletians, 

It is with a happy heart and no small amount of excitement that I can share new stories, updates, and reflections from the world of Mabinogi with you. While it has been a while since our last correspondence, I hope you’ve seen for yourselves what we have been cooking up. I'd like to extend my thanks to all of our Milletians who have been playing Mabinogi, following our update news, watching our livestreams, and engaging with everything else we have shared with you lately! There has been no doubt that Erinn brings connections to one another, and it has been delightful to welcome both new faces and community members from past and present eras of Mabinogi. We are sincerely grateful to have welcomed so many new Milletians and love to see them experiencing Mabinogi with fresh perspectives! 

The Summer Festival has only just begun, surely made more fun with confetti and many piñatas for celebrating! We're excited to reveal a multitude of events planned for this summer, with many already underway and more to come each month. These events will offer numerous beneficial items and opportunities to enjoy the many facets of life in Erinn, from fashion to combat to character growth. It’s the best time to return to Mabinogi, and we hope you'll join us in the months ahead! 

[i]Check out all of the details of the [url="https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27012/summer-festival-event"]Summer Festival[/url]. If you ask me, I’d recommend opening Nao’s gift, Package to a Milletian![/i]

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kwkjlstq/producer-letter-summer-2025-q3-4-infographic.jpg"][/img]Coming very soon in July, the highly anticipated [b]Sacred Guardian [/b]and [b]Explosive Vanguard [/b]Arcana talents will make their debut! In addition to these exciting new talents, we’ll be introducing a variety of balance adjustments aimed at enhancing the overall combat experience. These updates will improve skill usability and strengthen synergy with existing Arcana talents. Additional adjustments to other Arcana skills are also on the way to ensure a more refined and engaging playstyle. 

In particular, we focused on increasing the DPS of primary damage-dealing Arcana Talents, the Elemental Knight, Dark Diviner, and Alchemic Sharpshooter. We also worked to reduce many limitations and hurdles that Elemental Knights and Alchemic Sharpshooters faced, and as a part of it, we added two new skills for the Elemental Knight: Instill Elements and Flashing Steel. As for Harmonic Saint, our previous updates focused on increasing the effects of the healing ability, and this time the Music Buff link effect will be adjusted. We’ll also be making changes to how debuffs are applied in combat, creating more meaningful tactical opportunities. Finally, we are implementing fundamental updates to the Magic Attack damage calculation. Magic-based talents will now scale more consistently and intuitively, bringing their damage output more in line with the existing minimum and maximum attack power scaling used for physical attacks. Keep an eye out for specific details on these upcoming adjustments in our Update Notes! 

In August, the Chapter 8: G27 storyline will be unveiled, introducing the Bri Leith Dungeon once the story is complete! We're excited to see where the Winds of Fate take us as our tale continues~ Milletians looking for the next challenge in the Bri Leith Dungeon may enter upon completion of G27 and reaching Arcana Comprehensive Level 200 or higher. The new retry system gives flexibility during battle allowing you to save your progress and retry the boss fight you’ve saved. A new reward system has also been added. Each time a boss is defeated, your party will be granted rewards that party members can roll on, with the highest dice roll winning the prize. Bri Leith Obles you obtain from clearing the dungeon can be exchanged for rewards in an exclusive dungeon shop. A new powerful weapon series, the Soul Liberator and its associated crafting materials and recipes will be available, along with new Enchant Scrolls to empower your gear.

These exciting additions are just the beginning of fundamental improvements to the game experience!

Many more upcoming contents for Mabinogi have been announced during the “New Rise” Fantasy Party event: [url="https://www.youtube.com/live/VWC5XukVAUY?si=QpfbkyzUu0r3OPup&t=1815"]\[Mabinogi Korea] 21st Anniversary Fantasy Party 'Summer Showcase NEW RISE'[/url] . While these updates are currently in the pipeline for Mabinogi Korea, we can broadly expect many of these exciting changes to come to our North American Mabinogi service as well. Our team had the opportunity to watch the livestream together with you in “Starlet’s Stage” in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/mabinogi"]Official Mabinogi Discord[/url]. Thanks to the Milletians who joined the party! In case you missed the broadcast, we recommend checking it out!

(You can adjust options on the broadcast for closed captions and auto-translation, though we can’t promise that they will make perfect sense. Rest assured, all content that will be revealed and implemented for our service will be properly addressed in future correspondences!) 

[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zwqNii2IOmQ&ab_channel=마비노기"]Eternity gameplay[/url] has also been showcased, and we will add more videos to the Eternity page later. Please stay tuned for that and more! We take your feedback constructively and appreciate your dedication to Erinn. 

For now, [url="https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/micro-site/eternity/news/28256"]let’s enjoy the campfire together…[/url]

As we enter our soon to be 18th year for Mabinogi in North America, we want to thank all of our dedicated Milletians for your patience as we’ve worked on many updates to build a more stable and rewarding gameplay experience. As we move forward together, your continued support means the world to us, and we can’t wait for you to dive into all the exciting changes coming soon. The improved Mabinogi experience will be well worth it.

We are going to have more to share soon!

[b]~ GM Mewlynne, [/b][i]a Milletian who is excited for the summer festivities! ₍^. .^₎⟆[/i][b]
Mabinogi Producer
[u]& The Mabinogi Team[/u][/b]

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/cnhpttxe/mewlynne_signature_july2025_crop1.png"][/img][i]Mewlynne (studiously studying) of the Quality Association[/i]
[/p]

notes.title: Summer Festival Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aixdqfur/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png[/img]
[i]This summer is certain to be an unforgettable one! Join in several events throughout the next few months with fun for all Milletians. Whether you're participating in activities with friends and guildmates, trying a new look, or simply becoming stronger, there's an event for everyone![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Summer Festival Events[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Log in anytime during the Summer Festival to participate in the various events planned over the next several months![/*][*]A dedicated Event Icon will appear in your Event Tab, allowing visibility of all active and upcoming events during the Summer Festival![/*][/list][/td][td width=15%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sljhv0np/event-book-ui.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Click to open the Summer Festival UI, showcasing all the events taking place this summer![list][*]Each event will display its dates, summary, relevant quests, and the main rewards related to that event![/*][*]Certain events will have extra features such as:
[list][*]Event Icon - allows you to show or hide the shortcut icon, located on your Event Tab.[/*][*]Details - will provide some extra information for the event, such as attendance UI.[/*][*]To NPC - allows you to teleport directly to the corresponding NPC of the event.[/*][*]Link - opens the in-game browser window to the web post of the event, providing additional information about the event.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wejhkxjm/summer-festival-ui-v2.png[/img]

[i]Not currently in Erinn, but want to know more about each event? While we're providing a small synopsis of each event here -- clicking any of the banners below will take you to that event's dedicated web post! This web post will be updated each month with which events are available, which ones have ended, and which are yet to come as the festival progresses, so be sure to keep this page bookmarked![/i]
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h2][b]New Events[/b][/h2]

[b]Summer Master Plan Event[/b]
[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27079][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vjhjxwwa/250626-wgc-2143-mb-masterplanevent-1400x300.png[/img][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Ready to pick up the pace this summer season? It's getting hot in here with these fiery rewards... including FREE Combination VIP Service. Check out all the details in the dedicated webpost above![/i]

[b]Flying High Event[/b]
[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27080][i][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2fbyh11/250626_flyinghighevent-newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg[/img][/i][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Dash, Leap, and Fly your way to new heights as you acquire goods that will help every Milletian with their Master Plan training! From acquiring your first (or second) Arcana to dashing to Level 40,000, the benefits of this event are sure to have you dashing, leaping, and eventually, flying high![/i]

[b]Box Full of Memories Event[/b]
[url=http://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/28228][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/p3hhwght/250703-wgc-2139-mb-mainstreamstoryskipsale-1400x300.png[/img][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, August 14th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Lorna and Pan found a new item that’s sure to help any Milletian in saving Erinn! They found so many that they’re willing to let you sample this new item out! If you want more though, it’s gonna cost ya… check out all the details in the dedicated webpost above![/i]
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][h2][b]Ongoing Events[/b][/h2]

[b]Luis's Pinata Prep Event[/b]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/27029][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/1euh5vde/luispinataprep-1400x300-1.jpg[/img][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Luis is looking to bring a little extra cheer, but his colored paper blew away. They've formed into giant piñatas just outside of Dunbarton. Grab several of your friends, a good stick, and an appetite for sweets as you bash away for some delicious candy and colored paper! Turn that paper in to Luis for some delicious rewards![/i]

[b]Letters to a Milletian Event[/b]
[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/27078][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lwlnlsh3/letter-to-milletian-1400x300.jpg[/img][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]In celebration of Milletians, several NPCs have each penned a letter, expressing thanks and gratitude... and a daily buff! It's all packaged in a neat 'Nao-box' alongside LOTS of goodies! Be sure to open it on a character you treasure most.[/i]

[b]Guild-ed Gala Event[/b]
[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/27077][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/bl3jtdav/guild-ed-gala-event-1400x300.jpg[/img][/url][i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Celebrate the Guild Renewal with some rewards, buffs, and your very own Guild Title! Create or join a guild, make some new friends (and guildmates!), and get a head start this summer![/i]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/27076][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wl3abudy/mystical-rental-event-1400x300.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click to visit event page)[/i]

[b]Event Dates: [i]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/i][/b]
[i]Can't wait for the rental services from the Master Plan? Neither can Sasha! She started her own Rental Service and improved it! Whether you're looking for a new cool ride to travel in, a powerful weapon to tackle Glenn Bearna, or showing up other Fashionogists with your new look, this event has you covered.[/i]

[i]We have even more events planned for Milletians later this summer! Here's what's still in store for the remaining months![/i]

notes.title: Guild Renewal Update
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aonb2vws/250526-wgc-2054-mb-guildrenewal-1400x300.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Active Events/Sales/Promotions[/b][/h2]
[table][tr][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27012/summer-festival-event][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yc5jvkgv/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27101/south-sea-sailor-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/grwk4o3n/250530_southseasailorbox_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/23897/pan-s-check-in-attendance-season-7][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27349/shopkeeper-s-sale-shopping-bags-and-summer-package][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kdwjfugb/250523-wgc-2063-mb-outfitpakagesale-940x290.png[/img][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25363/erinn-adventure-pass-season-2][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25363/erinn-adventure-pass-season-2][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/26986/ravenscall-box][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tamjcquk/250519_mb_ravenscallbox_wgc-2006_940x290-1.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ylxh1ugg/260529_mb_glennbearnaevent_wgc-2057.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table]
[i](Click the banners to go to that event/sales/promotion webpage)[/i]
[h2][b]Guild Renewal[/b][/h2]
[i]Guilds have been a cornerstone of Erinn since Mabinogi first released! While the strengths and bonds between Guild Members is unique for each guild, the system to help foster those bonds had been severely neglected. We hope that this massive renewal of the Guild System will continue fostering new bonds between Guildmates that cannot be found anywhere else.[/i]
[list][*]A new Guild Home UI has been created and added to the game to house most guild-related things.[list][*]A new Guild Menu button has been added to the bottom of the screen to open the Guild Home.[/*][*]The Guild Home and Guild List buttons at the bottom of the friends messenger window have been removed.[/*][*][b]All Guild Stones will be removed with the update. [/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The following features have been added to the Guild Home UI:[list][*][b]Guild Search[/b]
[list][*]You will be able to search by Guild Name and/or Guild Master.[/*][*]Tag Filtering is now possible to find the guild that suits your playstyle best.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Recommendation[/b]
[list][*]When not in a guild, opening the Guild Menu will open the “Recommended Guilds” tab.[/*][*]Guilds that have a healthy activity record will have priority in the displayed list.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Member Play Rankings[/b]
[list][*]Guild Members will be able to compete against other members of their guild to be displayed on a Leaderboard for certain activities.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Portrait[/b]
[list][*]Guild Portraits allow Guild Members to be displayed on the Guild Home screen.[/*][*]Spend Guild Points or Gold to unlock new locations, the number of members that can be displayed, and more.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Guide[/b]
[list][*]Will guide you to the official web [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds]Guild Guide[/url][/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A new NPC, [b]Siobhan[/b], has been added to take over the duties of Eavan and Sinead.[list][*]Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the first quest.[/*][*]Siobhan is normally located inside the Guild Hall.[/*][*]Three (3) new Guide Quests titled [b][Guild] A Guild-ed Opportunity[/b] have been added to introduce the changes to the Guild System.[list][*]Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the 1st quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]After completing A Guild-ed Opportunity (1), Siobhan will open the Guild Shop for Guild Members, and be in charge of handling changes made to the Guild Banner, Guild Robe, and when available, Guild Title.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Leveling[/b] and [b]perks [/b]have been added.[list][*]Guilds can now level up, earning perks with each level.[/*][*]The types of Perks a guild has unlocked or yet to unlock can be viewed through the “Perks” tab in the Guild Menu.[/*][*]Leveling will require a set amount of Guild Points (GP) and Guild Gold (GG), contributed by members of the guild.[/*][*]Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.[list][*][b]All Guild Points prior to the update will be reset. [/b][/*][*]The maximum amount of GP a Guild Member can now hold is 2,000.[/*][*]The maximum amount of GP a guild can now have is equal to the amount required for leveling up.[list][*]Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Donations of GP will reward the donor with Guild Coins.[/*][*]Guild Coins are a new currency, allowing Guild Members to purchase items from the new Guild Shop through the Guild Assistant Siobhan.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guild Missions[/b] have been added.[list][*]Two different types of Guild Missions have been added:[list][*][b]Guild Field Missions[/b] - band with your Guildmates to defeat a Field Boss and earn GP.[/*][*][b]Guild Life Mission [/b]- deliver materials per the NPC's request to earn GP based on your score.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Guild Member can earn GP from both Field and Life Missions up to 3 times per week.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]A Guild Shop[/b] has been added.[list][*]The new Guild Shop is available for all Guild Members starting at Guild Level 1 through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.[/*][*]The Guild Shop only accepts Guild Coin (GC) and all items are subject to a weekly purchase limit per character.[/*][*]A guild can level up the shop by reaching Guild Level to access the “Guild Shop Level 2” tab containing more powerful items.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Guilds can now create [b]Guild Banners[/b].[list][*]The ability to create Guild Banners is unlocked when a guild reaches Level 6.[/*][*]Creation of a Guild Banner will cost the guild 25,000 Guild Points and 10,000,000 Gold.[/*][*]Guild Banners can be crafted through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.[/*][*]A Guild Banner will apply the same emblem, embroidery, and border used in the Guild Robe.[/*][*]Guild Banners can only be wielded by the Guild Master.[/*][*]Guild Banners can be planted when a guild Reaches Level 9.[list][*]Planting a banner will create an interactable banner, and will remain for 10 minutes or until the Guild Master leaves the map.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=30%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ex4hsiej/guild-banners.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Additional Guild Changes:[list][*][b]All web functionality of guilds has been removed.[/b][list][*]The "Guilds" tab will be removed from the Mabinogi Website.[/*][/list][/*][*]Member requirement for creating a guild has been reduced from 5 players to 2.[/*][*]The Guild Hall is now available immediately upon creation of a guild.[/*][*]Guild Leaders can now assign up to 3 Guild Officers.[/*][*]Functionality of duties between Guild Leader, Guild Officers, and Members/Senior Members has been updated.[/*][*]Guild Leaders can now withdraw up to 100 million gold per day from the Guild Treasury.[/*][*]The requirements of disbanding a guild have been updated to require only the Guild Leader to remain in the guild.[/*][*]The cooldown time for leaving and joining another guild has been reduced from 1 week to 24 hours after joining the previous guild.[/*][*]An “Immediate Join” option has been added, allowing players to instantly join a guild without waiting for approval, if the guild allows it.[/*][*]Guild Quests sold by Eavan have been removed.[/*][*]The method for obtaining Guild Points have changed:
[list][*]Before: 1 GP per 10 minutes; 5 GP per level up.[/*][*]After: 1 GP per minute; available through Guild Missions.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Guild Points requirement for the Guardian Guild Tournaments has been reduced from 15,000 GP to 1,000 GP.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Read more in-depth about guilds and all the new changes in the dedicated [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds]Guild Guide[/url][/b]!
[url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds][i][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5uifjiey/guildguide-1400x300.jpg[/img][/i][/url]
[h2][b]Tutorial Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h3]Arcana Achievement Missions[/h3]
[list][*][b]Arcana Achievement Missions [/b]have been added for Milletians that have yet to acquire an Arcana on any character of their account.[/*][list][*]Accounts that have an Arcana unlocked on any of their characters are not eligible for this questline.[/*][*]Only one character can progress through the questline.[/*][/list][*]Upon completing the Third Memoir of Blannid’s Brave Boost questline, you’ll receive a Guide Quest to talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register for the questline.[/*][*]You can confirm the progress of the questline by going to [b]Guides [/b]→ [b]Arcana Achievement Mission [/b]in your bottom menu bar.[/*][list][*]Alternatively, you can select “View Arcana Achievement Mission” by opening your Quest Log.[/*][/list][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2cnfvgd/arcana-achievement-missions.png[/img][/b][list][*]The Arcana Achievement Mission UI will provide you with information on what your next Cumulative Point Rewards are, what the next step in your current quest is, and additional details for better understanding.[/*][list][*]Only one quest is given each real life day (17 quests in total)[/*][*]The next quest after completing one will be delivered at [b]7:00 AM Server Time[/b] the next day.[/*][*]When completing objectives, you will receive Arcana Achievement Mission Points as a reward.[/*][*]Upon accumulating enough Arcana Achievement Mission Points, you’ll receive the current Cumulative Point Rewards listed.[/*][/list][/list][h3]Tutorial Improvements ft. Blaanid[/h3]
The introductory tutorial quests have been improved.
[list][*]The quests [Tutorial] Battle in Erinn, [Tutorial] Basics of Battle, and [Tutorial] To The Outside World have been removed.[list][*]Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.[/*][*]The removed quest rewards can be obtained from previous quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]When creating a new character, some guidance messages have been added to the upper right corner of the screen.[/*][*]When entering the Soul Stream in certain situations, the following UI will now be hidden:[list][*]Skill slots[/*][*]Chat[/*][*]Notifications[/*][*]Event windows[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of the specifications of the tutorial zone have been changed.[list][*]Some chats and notifications in the UI will be hidden in the tutorial zone.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of Nao’s dialogue has been adjusted to account for the various tutorial changes.[/*][*][Tutorial] Item Equipping and Usage will no longer provide Lorna's Stadium Horn.[/*][*]After completing the revamped Tutorial, Milletians will receive the books “Traveler’s Guide Life Edition” and “Traveler’s Guide Combat Edition”.[list][*]These books can also be purchased from Aeira in Dunbarton.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of the contents of the "Traveler's Guide" book when creating a new character has been changed to improve readability.[/*][*]"Practical Course - Talent Experience" has been added to the courses that can be ordered on the Beginner's Combat Course bulletin board.[list][*]By taking this course, you can experience various talent skills.[/*][/list][/*][*]When a beginner rebirths, they can obtain the beginner title of the Talent they selected, and the beginner title will not be removed.[list][*]In addition, some of the title descriptions have been changed due to the specification change.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Blannid’s Memory Book[/h3]
The introductory quests have been improved.
[list][*]The tutorial quest [Tutorial] Rebirth and Talent has been removed.[list][*]As a result, a Milletian's first guided Rebirth will be led by Blaanid.[/*][*]Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Chain Slash questline has been removed from Blaanid’s Memoir quests.[/*][*]Throughout Blaanid’s quests, various visual glowing indicators have been placed at objectives to help Milletians find their way.[/*][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4uwafqib/blaanid-ooooh-shinyyyyy.png[/img][/b][list][*]When Blaanid’s Memory Book is in progress, a button will appear at the bottom of the quest window.[/*][*]If you have not purchased any items upon Rebirthing, the purchase confirmation pop-up window will not appear.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qkhgsmve/blaanid-brave-boost-quest-mark.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Other Fantasy Life Changes[/h3][list][*]The [b]Auto-Pathing[/b] function has been improved.[list][*]Teleport fees are waived if your cumulative level is below 10,000 or if you have an active Basic VIP Membership.[/*][*]If you are on the same continent and not in a restricted area, you also have the option to Go on Foot without spending any Gold.[/*][*]When viewing Quest Info, you can now teleport to the nearest Moon Gate.[/*][/list][/*][/list][b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ovgoivyj/auto-pathing-june-update.gif[/img][/b][list][*]Stack Sizes for certain items have been increased.[list][*]We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to [b]100[/b]![list][*]Rebirth Potion[/*][*]Forgetful Potion[/*][*]Tendering Potion[/*][*]Special Tendering Potion (S, SS, and SSS)[/*][*]Likability Potion[/*][*]Chat Color Change Potion[/*][*]Name/Chat Color Change Potion[/*][*]Enchant Protection Potion[/*][*]Enchant Extraction Protection Potion[/*][*]Trade Unlock Potion[/*][*]Height Potion[/*][*]Age Potion - Age 9 ~ 19[/*][*]Partner Age Potion - 9 ~ 19[/*][*]Partner Age Potion - Max Age[/*][*]Pet Age Potion - Age 1 ~ 5[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Ladeca Combat 4x EXP Potion[/*][*]Pet EXP Potion[/*][*]Life Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Combat Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Magic Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Alchemy Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Martial Arts Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Music Skill 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Puppetry 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Dual Gun 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Ninja 2x EXP Potion[/*][*]Speed Walk Potion (30%)[/*][*]Speed Walk Potion (40%)[/*][*]Complete Skill EXP Potion[/*][*]Royal Complete EXP Potion[/*][*]Monster Drop Booster Potion[/*][*]Fishing Booster Potion[/*][*]Dragon Knight’s Potion[/*][*]Magic Power Potion[/*][*]Magic Speed Potion[/*][*]Physical Power Potion[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Training Potions[/*][*]E.g. Fury of Connous Training Potion[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Production Boost Potions[/*][*]All [Skill Name] Quality Increase Potions[/*][*]All Restorative Potions (HP, MP, Stamina, Wound), including:
[list][*]SE[/*][*]RE[/*][*]Liquids[/*][*]Crystals[/*][*]Beginner[/*][*]Buff[/*][*]Comprehensive[/*][*]Full Recovery[/*][/list][/*][*]Base Potion[/*][*]Childlike Green Perfume[/*][*]Childlike Yellow Perfume[/*][*]Childlike Pink Perfume[/*][*]Youthful Black Perfume[/*][*]Mature Red Perfume[/*][*]Holy Water of Lymilark[/*][*]Massive Holy Water of Lymilark[/*][*]Diet Potion U[/*][*]Diet Potion L[/*][*]Diet Potion F[/*][*]Flint[/*][/list][/*][*]We’ve also increased the following item stack limits to [b]200[/b]!
[list][*]Light Magic Power Potion[/*][*]Light Magic Speed Potion[/*][*]Light Physical Power Potion[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]*Note:[/b] The stack improvements will also apply for various items with suffix tags, such as (Event), (Untradable), (Can be Traded Once), (30 min), (1 Day), etc.
[list][*]The following Phoenix pets have been renamed:
[list][*]White Phoenix -> Mistborn Phoenix[/*][*]Blue Phoenix -> Cerulean Phoenix[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been renamed:
[list][*]Special Eluned Classic Maid Dress (M) -> Eluned Special Classic Maid Dress (M)[/*][*]Special Eluned Classic Butler Outfit (F) -> Eluned Special Classic Butler Outfit (F)[/*][*]Baseball Bat -> Baseball Bat (M)[/*][*]Pom Poms -> Pom Poms (F)[/*][*]Water Spirit Ankle Straps -> Water Spirit Ankle Straps (F)[/*][*]Water Spirit Sandals -> Water Spirit Sandals (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]The training method for Rain Casting requiring one to "Produce something under a cloud" has been expanded to make the action more clear- "Successfully perform the finishing steps of production under a cloud".[list][*]The required method itself has not changed, only the description.[/*][/list][/*][*]We have truncated the text tags on Commerce Mounts within the Commerce Trading menu, to allow more of the name to be visible.
[list][*][Partner] -> [P][/*][*][Guild] -> [G][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1[/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*][b]Seasonal Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1[/b] will begin at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b] on [b]July 3rd 2025 [/b]and run until [b]November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST[/b].[list][*][Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.[/*][*]Alban Heruin Season 1 will conclude on [b]November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The following items have been added to the Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box.[list][*]Cone Hat Balloon Pony Whistle[/*][*]Festival Troublemaker Alo Whistle[/*][/list][/*][*]The Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]**NEW**[/b] Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger 2nd Title[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Mistborn Phoenix Whistle
[/b][/*][*]20x Precise Reforging Tools (Expire after 30 Days)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td width=40%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/twwi1xt1/alban-heruin-season-1-challenger-2nd-title.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[i]A few fixes in this auspicious update, with some typical typo fixes alongside them. We like telling you that we're still fixing these typos, and hearing your wonderful reports, we just don't always feel these smaller items are worth highlighting individually as they're typically uninteresting![/i]
[list][*]The icon for the status effect Support Shot was missing and has been added.[/*][*]A few otherwise fine folk in Erinn were sporting an overly bald look, appearing as if they had no hair or skull! Spooky! We asked them to don their hair proper, and they will be showing correctly moving forward.[/*][*]A fix for the recent issue causing audio to behave unexpectedly, such as overlapping BGM, has been added and the issues should be quelled.[/*][*]Small modeling fixes have been made to improve the display of the Shadow Reaper (F) set.[/*][*]The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls were displaying the incorrect name when applied, and will now show their correct name:
[list][*]Ravenscall Hunter's Shotgun Crossbow[/*][*]Ravenscall Shotgun Crossbow[/*][*]Morpho Dreamwood Long Bow[/*][*]Morpho Dreamwood Two-Handed Sword[/*][/list][/*][*]The description for Clairvoyant Wings Orb was updated to properly indicate that it grants Placid Shining Forest Wings instead of Placid Folded Shining Forest Wings.[/*][*]Slight corrections to the following Enchants, to better reflect the actual skill names:
[list][*]Alchemist's[/*][*]Dazed[/*][*]Galactic[/*][*]Tilted[/*][*]Witch[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h2]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Guild-ed Gala Event
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate the Guild Renewal with some rewards, buffs, and your very own Guild Title! Create or join a guild, make some new friends (and guildmates!), and get a head start this summer![/i]
[hr][/hr][b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Attendance Event Details[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]During theevent period, log in to receive an [b]Attendance Book Summons[/b].[list][*]Use the Attendance Book Summons to [b]register a Main Character[/b].[/*][/list][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/c5cpuwwl/summons-scroll.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]You can only use the Attendance Book Summons to register your character during the Event Period.[/*][*]Once registered, an Event Icon will appear, allowing you to check the status of your attendance.[/*][*]The Attendance Check has a total of 10 rewards.[/*][*]Stay logged in for a full Erinn Day to receive your daily prize.[/*][*]The next day will start at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]When the event period ends, the Event Icon will disappear and you will be unable to claim any unclaimed rewards. Please claim all rewards before the end of the event period.[/*][*][b]As a bonus, during the event period, all Guild Missions will award 1.5x the amount of Guild Points.[/b][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Guild Title Event Details[/b][/h2]
[table noborder=1][td][list][*]During the event period, Guild Leaders can set a [b]Custom Guild Title[/b] for the Guild![/*][*]Talk to Siobhan in your Guild's Guild Hall and select "Guild Title" option.[/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/k3mhdqvc/guild-title.png[/img][/td][/table][list][*]Title Requirements:[list][*]Titles may contain 2 to 10 characters.[/*][*]The title may contain spaces.[/*][*]The title may not contain symbols or numbers.[/*][*]Titles that contains profanity or inappropriate words will be deleted without notice.[list][*][b]Once a title is deleted, it cannot be restored.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]During the event, the title may be changed as many times as you like. [/*][*]There is a 1-minute cooldown between changes. [/*][*]You may only change the title once you’ve met the requirements.[/*][*]To change the title, the Guild must accept 5 newly recruited members into the Guild.[/*][*]The title will automatically be acquired when the recruitment requirement is achieved.[/*][*]All Guild members will receive the title after the Guild Title is set, even if a member joins after the initial acquisition.[/*][*]The title will show up as the set custom title at the end of the regular title selection list.[/*][*]When the event period ends, the Guild Title that is acquired will be available for use by the Guild permanently.[/*][*][b]A custom Guild Title will grant the following stats:[/b][list][*]HP +10[/*][*]Strength +10[/*][*]Intelligence +10[/*][*]Luck +10[/*][*]Will +10[/*][*]MP +10[/*][*]Defense +1[/*][*]Protection +1[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Luis's Pinata Prep Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/1euh5vde/luispinataprep-1400x300-1.jpg[/img]
[i]Luis is looking to bring a little extra cheer, but his colored paper blew away. They've formed into giant piñatas just outside of Dunbarton. Grab several of your friends, a good stick, and an appetite for sweets as you bash away for some delicious candy and colored paper! Turn that paper in to Luis for some delicious rewards![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Upon logging in, you'll receive the quest [b][Guide] Help! Pinata Panic![/b][/*][*]Find Luis next to the Dunbarton Church to learn more and register a [b]Main Character[/b].[list][*]Doing so will complete the quest and earn the following:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Papier Mache Coin x20[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table noborder=1][tr][td width=60%][list][*]Giant colorful piñatas will appear in the surrounding maps near Dunbarton [b]every Erinn Day[/b] at specific times.[list][*][b]Pony Pinata[/b] - will appear in Gairech Hills at [b]9:00 AM Erinn Time[/b].[/*][*][b]Irusan Pinata[/b] - will appear in Osna Sail at [b]12:00 PM Erinn Time[/b].[/*][*][b]Scented Bear Pinata[/b] - will appear in Dugald Aisle at [b]3:00 PM Erinn Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]While only the registered characters can obtain the Quest Rewards, all characters can participate in the Field Bosses![/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4xgp0k4k/pinatas.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]When fighting the piñatas, attacking them will have a chance to earn a random buff as well as different types of candy! [list][*][b]Pony Pinata[/b] - chance to drop [b]Strawberry Candy (Max HP Buff)[/b][/*][*][b]Irusan Pinata[/b] - chance to drop [b]Grape Candy (Max MP Buff)[/b][/*][*][b]Scented Bear Pinata[/b] - chance to drop [b]Orange Candy (Max Stamina Buff)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The creatures are made from the finest colorful paper scraps Erinn has ever seen, so they'll be able to withstand several hits by Milletians. They're even immune to defense and protection reducing skills, so be sure to bring several of your friends... and your best piñata-whacking stick![/*][/list]
[h3][b]Daily Quest[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each day you'll receive the quest [b][Event] Scrapping for Scraps[/b].[list][*]You'll need to collect Colorful Paper Scraps from the colorful piñatas near Dunbarton.[/*][*]Deliver the Colorful Paper Scraps to Luis to earn your daily reward:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x Papier Mache Coin[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Achievement Quest[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Mystical Rental Event
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wl3abudy/mystical-rental-event-1400x300.jpg[/img]
[i]Can't wait for the rental services from the Master Plan? Neither can Sasha! She started her own Rental Service and improved it! Whether you're looking for a new cool ride to travel in, a powerful weapon to tackle Glenn Bearna, or showing up other Fashionogists with your new look, this event has you covered.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Upon logging in, you'll receive the quest [b][Guide] Rentals for Success[/b].[/*][*]Talk to Rental Agent Sasha next to the Part-Time Job Bulletin Board in Dunbarton to [b]Register a Main Character[/b].
[list][*]You'll receive the following upon completing the quest:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Sasha once more to learn more about all the types of rental programs she has available during the Summer Festival.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Pet Rental[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Talk to Rental Agent Sasha to learn more about the [b]Pet Rental Program[/b].[list][*]You can rent a [b]Level 200 Kart Pet[/b] of your choosing from the following:[/*][/list][table noborder=1][tr][td][list][list][*]Saber X[/*][*]Mart Kart[/*][*]Lodi Infernal[/*][*]White Knight X[/*][*]Dark Knight X[/*][*]Practice Kart[/*][/list][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/p2ojycta/kart-keys.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]You can only rent one Kart Pet per account.[/*][*]The rental pet does not have an inventory and expires once the event has ended after September 11th.[/*][*]The pet whistle will be removed at the end of the event if it has not been used.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Inventory Rental[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Talk to Rental Agent Sasha to learn more about the [b]Mystical Rental Event Inventory Rental Service[/b].[list][*]You will be able to use the [b]Mystical Rental Event Inventory[/b], which has a [b]20x15[/b] inventory size for the duration of the event.[/*][*]The Mystical Rental Event Inventory is accessible by clicking on the Mystical Rental Event Inventory bag icon in the top-right of your main inventory window.[/*][*]Once the event ends, the inventory space will be locked. No items can be put into the bag, but all items can be retrieved at your leisure.[/*][*]This inventory is [b]separate [/b]from the Master Plan Inventory of previous years. The Master Plan Inventory will be locked, but accessible for retrieving items.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lxobj0sw/mystical-rental-inventory-ui.png[/img]
[h3][b]Weapon Rental[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Talk to Rental Agent Sasha to learn more about the[b] Weapon Rental Program[/b].[list][*]You can rent a Celtic weapon of your preferred talent.[list][*]This weapon will be upgraded with the following:[list][*]Prefix and Suffix Enchants[/*][*]Fully Upgraded[/*][*]Lvl 5 Special Upgrade (Choice of R or S Upgrade)[/*][*]Reforged (Rank 1; 15/20 Roll)[/*][*]Erg Rank A (45/50)[/*][*]Max Spirit Level[/*][/list][/*][*]This weapon will not count towards your Spirit Weapon limit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The rental service is free; however, you can only rent [b]one[/b] weapon at a time.[/*][*]To rent a different weapon, destroy your current rental weapon, then talk to Sasha to request a different weapon to rent.[/*][*]Rental weapons can only be used during the event period and will be removed once the event ends.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th]Talent[/th][th]Weapon[/th][/tr][tr][td]Battle Astrology[/td][td]Celtic Triplicity Scythe (Rental)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Alchemy[/td][td]Celtic Tetra Cylinder (Rental)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Archery[/td][td]Celtic Ancient Bow (Rental)
Celtic Royal Crossbow (Rental)

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - June 4th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 12:00 PM and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]June 4th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]5:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]7 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
[h3][b]-Time-[/b][/h3]
[b]Wednesday, June 4th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 12:00 PM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEST, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 5:00 AM (June 5th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Website Domain Change from "mabinogi.nexon.net" to "www.nexon.com/mabinogi"[/*][*][url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27011/guild-renewal-update][b]Guild Renewal Update[/b][/url] has arrived! New features and perks! No better time to join a guild than today![list][*][b]Final reminder to spend any old Guild Points at your Guild Stone prior to maintenance![/b][/*][*]Check out the official [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/guide/advancedguide/general/25467/guilds][b]Guild Guide[/b][/url] for a more extensive look at what Guilds have to offer![/*][/list][/*][*]Celebrate in Erinn as the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27012/summer-festival-event][b]Summer Festival[/b][/url] gets underway![list][*]Join Luis with festival preparations in [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27029][b]Luis's Festival Prep Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Earn bonus (new) Guild Points and earn/update your Guild Title in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27077][b]Guild-ed Gala Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Try out new clothing, weapons, and pets in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27076][b]Mystical Rental Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Nao has a letter for you... check it out in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27078][b]Letter to a Milletian Event[/b][/url]![/*][/list][/*][*]Prepare the crew as the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27101/south-sea-sailor-box][b]South Sea Sailor Box[/b][/url] has docked for a limited time![/*][*]Fan of outfit bags? The [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/27349/shopkeeper-s-sale-shopping-bags-and-welcome-package][b]Shopkeeper's Sale: Outfit Bags and Welcome Package[/b][/url] is for you![/*][*]Were you able to get your dragon? Final chance as the [url=https://www.nexon.com/mabinogi/news/26760/updated-dragon-master-season-3][b]Dragon Master Event: Season 3[/b][/url] is ending.[/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Milletian-Ran Event Support
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/u3qns0kf/250425_mb_community_wgc-1975_1400x300-1.jpg[/img]

Hey Milletians!

Looking for some additional support to help host your next Community Event? Now's your chance! Submit information regarding your upcoming event via the application form below for a chance to have your event receive support from the Mabinogi team!
[h2][b]🎉What events are eligible?🎉[/b][/h2]
Events that are public and available for all players of the Mabinogi Community to participate in are eligible to receive additional support. Some example events are (but not limited to):
[list][*]Trivia/Quizzes[/*][*]Racing/Speedruns[/*][*]Scavenger Hunts[/*][*]Player vs. Player (PvP)[/*][*]Creative Competitions (Art, Music, etc.)[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
[h2][b]🎁What support is available?🎁[/b][/h2]
Depending on the type of event, expected attendance, prizes (if any), etc., different avenues of support are available by the Mabinogi team. Listed below are support options that may be available, depending on your event, availability by the team, and more.
[list][*][url=https://discord.com/invite/mabinogi][b]Official Discord Promotion[/b][/url] - This level of support is self-promotion within the Mabinogi Discord's [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/880251252292849745]#milletian-events channel[/url]. A special role is required to post in this channel, and is highly curated for all Milletians with visibility to the channel. You can even ping the [b]@Community Alarms Role[/b] for those following the channel, as well as publish to other servers following along![/*][/list]
After your first successful promotion through the Discord Channel, additional opportunities will be available.
[list][*][b]GM Attendance[/b] - Looking to have a GM assist by being a judge, hand out prizes, or more? Depending on the day and time, CM Arciellia or Elebon will schedule time to be in attendance![/*][*][b]Prize Support[/b] - Need a little bit of extra oomph to your prizes? The Mabinogi team can support additional prizes, relevant to the type of event being held! While we can't provide gold or high-valued items, we can provide prizes such as: [list][*]Transformation Medals[/*][*]Gachapon[/*][*]Homestead Items[/*][*]Chairs[/*][*]Food[/*][*]Fans[/*][*]Stickers
[b]Note:[/b] This type of support requires at least 4+ weeks of advanced notice and if approved, will require a post-mortem of how the event went, what went well, what could be improved, etc.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Other [/b]- Have an idea for us to help support that doesn't fit above? Reach out to Arciellia or Elebon and we'll discuss further on whether it's something the team can support![/*][/list]
[h2][b]📝What do I need to submit?📝[/b][/h2]
You'll need to fill out this provided Google Form with complete information about your upcoming event. The more information provided, the better we can gauge whether the Mabinogi team can accommodate any extra support!

[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/x4clnaqq/glyph_design.png[/img] [url=https://forms.gle/PUXoFMxto2LiYoZK9]Coordinator Submission Application[/url] [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/x4clnaqq/glyph_design.png[/img][/b]

We'll also have this link, and all of these details pinned in our Official Mabinogi Discord Server where you'll also be able to promote your event. Please make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/mabinogi]join our Discord[/url] if you're not already a part of it!

We look forward to seeing all the wonderful Milletian-ran events that come up!

[i]- The Mabinogi Team Community Managers[/i]

notes.content:

[hr][/hr]
Dear Milletians,

In anticipation of the upcoming Guild Renewal as mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/212200/announcements/detail/529841887223218444]2025 Summer Road Map[/url] earlier this year, we would like to bring a few changes to your attention prior to the update itself. Additionally, with the revamp, [b]all Guild Stones will be removed from the game[/b]. Please take this time to prepare - we plan to share more with you in our June Preview Stream on June 3rd!

[i]- The Mabinogi [strike]Team[/strike] Guild[/i]

notes.title: [UPDATED] Dragon Master Season 3
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/z2ddimbr/250502_dragonmastereventseason-3_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png[/img]
[i]Meiling is back once more and needs your help to craft the dragon! Brave Uladh's Dungeons and Shadow Missions to collect the items needed for the dragon. Or, log in in every day to make this majestic pet your own! Check out the details below.[/i]
[hr][[/hr]
[b]Update:[/b] Thank you to all the Milletians who have provided your feedback regarding the Dragon Master Event. During the 5/15 Maintenance, we have updated the rewards for the Dragon Master Event below. 

The Dragon Master Season 3 event rewards were far too spread out into the entirety of the duration of the event, making it more difficult than intended to receive all 9 Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch items to completely expand the Blue Dragon Bag. To alleviate some burden, we’ve reorganized the Attendance Scroll event rewards allowing you to obtain all of the Blue Dragon Bag Pouches with several days of leniency built in. We hope that this change will allow you to continue working towards becoming a Dragon Master!

[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, May 8th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, June 4th, 7:00 AM PDT[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] Return of the Dragon Clan.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Meiling[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[list][*]The character must be [b]above Level 1,000[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Attendance Scroll[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Crafting a Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a [b]Marshal Blue Dragon Whistle.[/b][/*][*]You can only craft one Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn during the event period.[/*][*]You can also obtain a Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn as a reward from the Attendance Scroll event.[/*][*][b]Note:[/b] The event items (Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Old Dragon, Blue Dragon's Hard Blue Leather, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, Incomplete Horn, and Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.[/*][*]You must gather one [b]Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon[/b], one [b]Blue Dragon's Hard Blue Leather[/b], one [b]Golden Yarn of the First Dawn[/b], and one [b]Strength Essence[/b] for Meiling to attempt to craft the [b]Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn.[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Known Bug: [/b]The description text on the Horn of the Ten Thousand-Year Dragon, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, and Incomplete Horn incorrectly refers to a Red/Fire Dragon instead of a Blue Dragon. This is a text error and will not impede making the Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn.
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yrpjusti/blue-dragon-pet.png[/img]
[list][*]You have a chance to collect the [b]Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon[/b] by [b]clearing an Uladh Dungeon[/b]:
[list][*]Alby Intermediate[/*][*]Alby Advanced[/*][*]Alby Advanced Hardmode[/*][*]Ciar Intermediate[/*][*]Ciar Advanced[/*][*]Ciar Advanced Hardmode[/*][*]Rabbie Basic[/*][*]Rabbie Advanced[/*][*]Fiodh Intermediate[/*][*]Fiodh Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Basic[/*][*]Rundal Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Advanced Hardmode[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Blue Dragon's Hard Blue Leathe[/b]r when you complete a [b]Tara or Tailteann Shadow Mission[/b]:[list][*]Basic[/*][*]Intermediate[/*][*]Advanced[/*][*]Hard[/*][*]Elite[/*][*]Lord[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Golden Yarn of the First Dawn[/b] when you [b]fish at Tir Chonaill Fishing Area[/b] with [b]Bait Tin[/b].[/*][*]You can receive the [b]Strength Essence[/b] when you reach current levels 50, 100, 150, and 200.[/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Eminent Alchemist’s Note[/b] when you complete Tech Duinn Missions.
[list][*]When the Eminent Alchemist’s Note is in your inventory, it increases the success rate of crafting the Incomplete Horn.[/*][/list][/*][*]The harder the dungeon or mission difficulty, the better the chance to collect the material.[/*][*]When the crafting succeeds, you will receive an [b]Incomplete Horn[/b]. Stay logged in for 1 hour to convert it to a [b]Marshal Blue Dragon’s Horn[/b]...and the Dragon might have something special for you! [list][*]If you change channels or log out before the hour has finished, the timer will reset. You will need to stay logged in for the full hour to convert it to a Marshal Blue Dragon’s Horn.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the crafting fails, you could keep all three materials or could lose one or more materials. You will also receive a consolation item.[/*][/list][h2][b]How to Feed Your Dragon Event[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, May 29th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, June 4th, 7:00 AM PDT[/b]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]After logging in during Week 4 of the event, you will received the event quest, [b][Event] Foods that Dragons Enjoy.[/b][/*][*]Talk to Meiling to start the quest and help her feed her Dragon by delivering food.[/*][*]Each day, for 5 days, deliver the requested dish that the Dragon likes.[/*][*]You can deliver the next dish after 7 AM PDT the next day.[/*][*]After delivering all 5 dishes, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]*NEW* Blue Dragon's Cintamani 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Max Damage +25*[/*][*]Magic Attack +40*[/*][*]Alchemic Elemental Damage +15*[/*][/list][/*][*][i]*Stats on the title expire after 14 days.[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/g2pfashm/blue-cinta-title.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]Attendance Scroll Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, May 8th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, June 4th, 7:00 AM PDT[/b]
[list][*]Every day, spend at least 36 minutes logged in to Mabinogi on your main character to receive a reward.[/*][*]To receive your reward, you must use the Attendance Scroll and click 'Receive Gift.'[/*][*]There is a maximum of 28 rewards to collect during the event period.[/*][*][b]Known Bug: [/b]The "Period" date in the UI will be listed as 30 days from when you first registered your main character instead of the official event end date of June 4th.[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b].[*]You can collect the following rewards:[list][*][b]Day 1:[/b] [b]*NEW* Blue Dragon Bag Coupon (Not tradeable)[/b][table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Redeem this voucher for a Blue Dragon Bag. Its default size is 9x4, offering a total of 36 slots.[*]When you apply a Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch to it, you can later expand its capacity to up to 9x13.[/*][*]The bag takes up a 2x3 space in your Basic Inventory. You can only have one such bag.[/*][/list][/td][td width=15%][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ab1blff1/blue-dragon-bag.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/*][*][b]Day 2:[/b] Rusty Hammer of Proficiency[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 3:[/b] AP 30 Potion (Event)[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 4:[/b] [b]*NEW* Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradeable)[/b][list][*]A special Royal Pouch that can be applied to the Blue Dragon Bag. Use it on the Blue Dragon Bag to add 1 extra row at the bottom.[/*][*]Up to 9 Royal Pouches can be applied to one Blue Dragon Bag.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Day 5:[/b] Direct Dye Ampoule[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 6:[/b] Golden Experience Fruit (300%) x5[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 7:[/b] [b]Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Day 8:[/b] Full Recovery Potion x5[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 9:[/b] AP 50 Potion (Event)[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 10:[/b] [b]Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Day 11:[/b] Rebirth Potion (Event)[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 12: Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Day 13:[/b] Any Pass Selection Box[b]**[/b][/*][*][b]Day 14: Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Day 15: [/b][b]Bun-ches of Fun Wig Gift Box[/b][table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Open this box to receive both a [b]*NEW*[/b] [b]Twin Bun Clips[/b] and [b]Single Bun Clip.[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/jwzng5fd/buns.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[list][*]Before: 690%[/*][*]After: 1035%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 14m to 15m at Dan 3.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been shortened from 4 seconds to 2 seconds at Dan 3.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ig3hrz1d/kunai-storm.png[/img] Kunai Storm[/b]
[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.[list][*]For Dan 3:
[list][*]Before: 560%[/*][*]After: 1288%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 15m at Dan 3.[/*][/list]
