[list][*]Damage has been increased for all Ranks.
[list][*]For Rank 1:
[list][*]Before: 300%[/*][*]After: 420%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 20m for Rank 1.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been shortened from 4 seconds to 2 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]When the skill is cast, the distance between each kunai will adjust to be farther apart the farther the skill is from your character.[/*][*]The Explosive Trigger Range of the kunai has been increased from 1m to 2m for Rank 1.[/*][*]Changed so that the hit targets are no longer pushed out of position.[/*][*]The cooldown time has been reduced from 11 seconds to 6 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]The Enemy Stun Duration has been reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][*]The delay after using the skill has been reduced.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5dkhuvd4/smokescreen.png[/img] Smokescreen[/b]
[list][*]The range has been increased from 10m to 15m at Rank 1.[/*][*]The delay upon using the skill has been reduced.[/*][/list]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zsbfg1fw/sakura-abyss.png[/img] Sakura Abyss[/b]
[list][*]The cooldown time has been reduced from 300 seconds to 60 seconds at Rank 1.[/*][/list]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Partners[/b][/h3]
Several changes to Partners have been made.
[list][*]Partner Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.[list][*]Using the card from the inventory will create a Partner Card on the character creation menu.[/*][*]Partner Cards are tradeable with other players.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Partners and their Mounts are now permanent items on the Cash Shop:[list][*]Maid[/*][*]Butler[/*][*]Commerce[/*][*]Partner’s Magical Broom[/*][*]Partner’s Noble Carriage[/*][*]Partner’s Long Boat[/*][*]Partner Mount Package[/*][/list][/*][*]Equipment items equipped by Partners are no longer bound and can be retrieved by the player without the use of a Partner Trade Unlock Potion.
[list][*]All remaining Partner Trade Unlock Potions have been removed as a result.[list][*]Partner Trade Unlock Potions that have been purchased from the Cash Shop since April 1st, 2024 and unused will be refunded the amount purchased in NX.[/*][*]Partner Trade Unlock Potions sold on the Auction House, but the funds are still unclaimed, will be claimed with the gold being delivered via mailbox.[/*][/list][/*][*]A Style Tab has been added for Partners.
[list][*]Tail and Facewear Slots have been added.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Newly created Laighlinne Partners will now have 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in their inventory.
[list][*]Players who previously had a Laighlinne Partner created before the update will receive 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in the mailbox on their highest-leveled character.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Gift function has been improved.
[list][*]The maximum number of daily gifts you can give to your Partner has been increased.
[list][*]Before: 5[/*][*]After: 10[/*][/list][/*][*]A Partner’s favorability now increases further when gifting an item.
[list][*]Before: 2[/*][*]After: 5[/*][/list][/*][*]Partners will now only accept a certain type of gift.
[list][*]Maid: Herbs[/*][*]Butler: Fish[/*][*]Laighlinne: Instruments[/*][*]Commerce/William/Rem/Ram: Gems[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Partners have been given a “Partner Exclusive” tab in their shop containing Partner Age Potions and Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Boxes.
[list][*]Partner Age Potions do not reset on Saturdays.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now change most Partners' body type and height.
[list][*]A Partner’s weight, upper body, and lower body can be modified similar to a player’s body through the use of Hot Springs and feeding them food.[/*][*]A Partner’s height can be modified through the use of Partner Age Potions.[/*][*]William and Commerce Partners cannot have their body type or height modified.[/*][/list][/*][*]Multi-person chairs can now be used with Partners.
[list][*]A Partner can only be seated on a multi-person chair placed by the Milletian who summoned them.[/*][*]After sitting on the multi-person chair, you can change the seat that your summoned Partner occupies through right-clicking your Partner and selecting “Sit Together”.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some Partners' dialogue and lines have been updated.[/*][*]A “Disable Basic Interaction” button has been added in the menu options when right-clicking a Partner.
[list][*]Toggling this option will hide all speech bubbles and dialogue, as well as motions by the Partner.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Party System[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Party Creation Menu UI has been updated.
[list][*]Regular Parties and Dungeon Parties have been merged.
[list][*]The ability to restrict parties by Skill Level has been removed as of a result.[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum length of a party name has been increased to 50 characters.[/*][*]Leaving a party name blank will auto-populate with "[Character Name]’s Party."[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/muzdwpk2/before-after-party-creation-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The Party Menu UI has been updated.
[list][*]The “Wanted” button has been renamed to “Recruit Locally”.
[list][*]The Recruitment Notice above your character will no longer expire.[/*][*]The [Wanted] party recruitment messages will no longer appear in the party chat.[/*][/list][/*][*]The width of the UI has been expanded for better visibility of text.[/*][*]Added new functionality buttons:
[list][*][u]Recruit on Party Board[/u] - adds/removes your party from the Party Bulletin Board.[/*][*][u]Move to Destination[/u] - teleports you to the pre-determined location.[/*][*][u]Recruit via Bugle[/u] - allows you to send a bugle with the party information.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Party Bulletin Board UI has been updated.
[list][*]All parties, regardless of objective, will be displayed as a default view.[/*][*]You can now search via party name directly (case-sensitive).[/*][/list][/*][*]The ability to move parties to a preset destination has been added.
[list][*]When creating a Normal Party, the following locations have been added as destinations to teleport to:
[list][*]Glenn Bearna[/*][*]Crom Bás[/*][*]Tech Duinn[/*][*]Mag Mell[/*][*]Avalon Purification[/*][*]Sidhe Finnachaid[/*][*]Alban Knights[/*][*]Taillteann Shadow Mission[/*][*]Tara Shadow Mission[/*][*]Hard Mode Alby Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm[/*][*]Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Hard Mode Rundal Advanced Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]A 30-second cooldown has also been added to prevent teleport spamming.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now right click → Invite to Join Party.[list][*]If not in a party, this will create the party and send an invite to the player.[/*][*]This option is available through the Player, Friends List, and Guild List.[/*][*]This can be done across channels / maps.[/*][/list][/*][*]Added a Bugle Recruitment Feature.
[list][*]When a destination is determined in a party, the “Recruit via Bugle” option will be available in the Party Menu UI.[/*][*]A ‘Horn Bugle - World’ item is required and consumed when used.
[list][*]The Horn Bugle - World with the shortest expiration timer will be consumed first.[/*][/list][/*][*]Using the feature will display a clickable message with the party information in the message log, allowing other players to join with ease.
[list][*]The bugle message will begin with a # symbol and have an outline around the message.[/*][*]Players joining the party via clicking the bugle message will be prompted to change channels (if necessary) and move to the destination.[/*][/list][/*][*]The bugle link is valid for up to 3 minutes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/d0bps5lr/bugle-party-message.png[/img]
[h3][b]Emblems[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A new UI has been added for synthesizing Alban Knight and Commander emblems.[list][*]Right-click an Alban Knight or Commander emblem and select "Synthesize" to open the synthesis UI.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to combine emblems through the "drag and drop" method.[/*][/list][/*][*]A "Training Camp" tab has been added to Shaun's shop in the Alban Knights Training Camp with the following items:[list][*]Unadorned Alban Knights Emblem[/*][*]Rune of Body[/*][*]Rune of Mind[/*][*]Rune of Sharpness[/*][*]Rune of Ingenuity[/*][*]Rune of Mana[/*][*][b]*New*[/b] Alban Knights Rune Box[list][*]This box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A "Commander" tab has been added to the Royal Quartermaster's shop in the Tech Duinn Lobby with the following items:[list][*]Unadorned Commander's Emblem[/*][*]Rune of Command: Phantasmal Sight[/*][*]Rune of Command: Fateweaver[/*][*]Rune of Command: Tenacious Taunt[/*][*]Rune of Command: Zone of Renewal[/*][*]Rune of Command: Unified Might[/*][*][b]*New*[/b] Rune of Command Box[list][*]This box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Auction House[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now preview Hair Dyes and Chairs through the Auction House.[/*][*]An “All” category has been added to the top of the Category list.
Categories can now be expanded/collapsed with a single click rather than double click.[/*][*]The following items can now be sold/purchased via the Auction House: 
[list][*]Clothing/Outfits:[list][*]Aladdin Shoes[/*][*]Badoura Costume[/*][*]Cat Armor[/*][*]Cat Armor (Giant)[/*][*]Cheerleader Boots[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Headdress (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Headdress (M)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Outfit (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Outfit (M)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Ring    [/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Shoes (F)[/*][*]China 7th Anniversary Shoes (M)[/*][*]Clover Pig Costume (F)[/*][*]Clover Pig Costume (M)[/*][*]Dorren's Robe[/*][*]Goggle Shades[/*][*]Great Goggle Shades[/*][*]Heart Eyepatch[/*][*]Lollipop Heart Eyepatch[/*][*]Mabinogi School Shoes[/*][*]Ornamented Crown[/*][*]Pop Star Bracelet[/*][*]Pop Star Dress[/*][*]Pop Star Earrings[/*][*]Pop Star Shoes[/*][*]Style Sunglasses[/*][*]Taoist Bracelet[/*][*]Taoist Costume[/*][*]Taoist Headdress[/*][*]Taoist Shoes[/*][/list][/*][*]Weapons:[list][*]Carpinus Healing Wand[/*][*]Chef's Passion  [/*][*]Metal Ice Wand[/*][*]Metal Lightning Wand[/*][*]Panacea Healing Wand[/*][*]Pop Star Conductor Baton[/*][*]Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan[/*][*]Scythe that Reaps Darkness[/*][/list][/*][*]Chairs:[list][*]Double Sunbed[/*][*]Single Sunbed[/*][/list][/*][*]Misc. Items:[list][*]Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group)[/*][*]Ruined Bonita Twin Tail Ribbons[/*][*]Bonita Twin Tail Ribbons Repair Kit[/*][*]Broken Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan[/*][*]Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan Repair Kit  [/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Mirror World Pass[/*][*]Receiver of Nao's Blessing Title Coupon[/*][*]Totem Reset Coupon[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Keyword Highlights have been added to the Chat Menu Options.[list][*]When an added word/phrase is said in chat, it will be highlighted to draw your attention.[/*][*]You may add up top 10 words/phrases, with a maximum of 20 characters per entry.[/*][*]Management of this system is located in [u]Options [/u]→ [u]Social [/u]→ [u]Chat [/u]→ [u]Manage Highlighted Keywords[/u] [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/k2ufgwht/image-22.png[/img]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dhanq0x4/image-23.png[/img]
[list][*]Your chat log history will not reset upon changing channels.[list][*]It will still reset upon logging in/out of the game however.[/*][/list][/*][*] Clicking a player's name on the Message Log will now bring up the Report User window. [/*][*]The in-game Cash Shop has received an update:[list][*]The window will now load directly in your Mabinogi client, rather than as an external window.[/*][*]The specifications and security have been updated.[/*][/list][/*][*]The calculations performed when production crafting have been modified to capture the state when starting the craft. This will prevent situations where the display showed 100%, but it was still possible to fail, even when successfully clearing the crafting mini-game.[/*][*]The setting to hide the visibility of your Support Puppet will now be saved when swapping to different Extra Equipment Slots.[/*][*]Shadow Missions that previously required you to be in a party to progress, such as The Secret of Scathach Caverns, will now allow those not in a party to progress when speaking with the NPCs.[list][*][i]It's dangerous to go alone, but you got this![/i][/*][/list][/*][*]You no longer need to meet the requirements to teleport to the entrance of Sidhe Finnachaid when using the Dungeon Guide.[/*][*]Expanding/Collapsing a Group in your friends list now only requires a single-click instead of double-click.[/*][*]In line with our rename change to Fragarach, we have also renamed the G25 sword from Luminous Cross-hilt Sword to The Answerer.[/*][*]Combo Card Slot Change Coupons have been modified to allow them to be destroyed via the Trash Can.[/*][*]Character Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.[list][*]Using the card from the inventory will create a Character Card on the character creation menu.[/*][*]Character Cards are tradeable with other players.[/*][*]With this change, Hero and Elite Character cards have been removed from the Cash Shop.[/*][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Smaller text fixes this month for some of the Shop related dialogue with NPCs, some C7 NPC text polish, more changes to the Party and Partner related texts, and unification of some of the Lance item descriptions to better convey the gameplay. Thank you for your eyes with each update. We're glad we can continue to make this game clean.[/*][*]Improvements have been made to the newly added Pet Parade action that allow it to perform better under higher latencies.[/*][*]The (old) Doki Doki Island quest Natural Dye Event has been cleared from all accounts. Apologies for the confusion![/*][*]Doll Bag Storage Chests will once again show the contents that are stored within the chest.[/*][*]Shopkeeping Milletians of Dunbarton and elsewhere (though mostly Dunbarton…) - you will once again be able to check the set price of your wares when reviewing your merchandise.
[list][*][i]Belvast Merchants where ya be? [/i]😭[/*][/list][/*][*]The range of Smokescreen was increased to 15m with the Battle Astrologer update. The associated skill text has been updated to reflect this change.[/*][*]With the update to the in-game Cash Shop browser, the zoom level has been corrected and the page will now display as expected when opening.[/*][*]The button redirects for opening specific Cash Shop pages have been updated to better direct you towards the relevant item(s).[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the status effect from a Carpentry Quality Increase Potion was not properly removing itself when failing a crafting attempt.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Changes during the March 20th Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]As mentioned in our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25214/renovation-season-6-update]April Update[/url], the following mythological sword and accompanying technique have been renamed, and all accompanying text (such as from the storyline) has been replaced:[list][*]Pragarah -> Fragarach[/*][*]Seal: Pragarah -> Seal: Fragarach[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Localization Note 】
[i]The Localization Team has wanted to correct "Pragarah" for several years now, re-localizing it to its proper mythological name "Fragarach" (which, in Gaelic, translates to "The Answerer"). After all, just as one would never expect to see "Excalibur" rendered otherwise in a game based on Arthurian legend, Fragarach ought to hold a similar status when one discusses the tales of Ireland. With the recent updates to the Seal: Fragarach skill, we finally had the opportunity to make the change to this odd artifact of legacy localization. The Mabinogi Team hopes that this small yet meaningful change will help foster a deeper connection with the Celtic lore that serves as the inspiration for so many characters, places, and events within the world of Erinn.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes during the March 20th Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]An issue was causing the Def/MDef/Prot/MProt reduced via Brionac and Seal: Fragarach to be lower than expected. This has been fixed, and both should be reducing the values in the same way to the appropriate amounts.[/*][*]The description of this year's Lovely Doki Doki Commemorative Box has been updated to reflect the proper outfit.[/*][*]The Life Exploration Tools now correctly line break in the Item Attribute field.[/*][*]DJ Romantic will be coming back from his "judging competition" on April 17th instead of April 24th. He wrote the wrong date in his calendar, it seems.[/*][*]Reserve Attack settings will now save upon logging out/changing channels.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where an untranslated message was showing when a Trade Unlock Letter of Guarantee when applied on an item.[/*][*]The family name of Zeder was retranslated from Shiarpe to Scharp.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Known Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]
[url=#top][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1575/back-to-the-top-button.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/MabiDiscord][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: [Community Event] 20,000 Discord Member Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/htyma0qr/250425_20k_membersbanners_1400x300psd.jpg[/img]

[b]🎉 20,000 Members and Counting – Let’s Celebrate with a Giveaway! 🎉[/b]

The [b][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi]Official Mabinogi Discord Server[/url][/b] has reached an incredible milestone—[b]over 20,000 Milletians[/b] have joined our growing community as of this past month! 🥳

To celebrate this momentous occasion, the [b]Mabinogi Team[/b] is hosting a special [b]Discord-exclusive giveaway[/b] with a variety of fun prizes! Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning or just found your way to Erinn, this is our way of saying thank you for making this community so vibrant and welcoming.

[b]Giveaway Dates: Tuesday, May 6th, After Stream (~3:00 PM PDT) - Wednesday, May 7th, 3:00 PM PDT[/b]
[h3]🎁 [b]Giveaway Details[/b][/h3]
The Mabinogi Team is celebrating [b]20,000 Discord members[/b] by giving away several exciting items to randomly selected participants! Community Managers @[b]Arciellia[/b] and @[b]Elebon[/b] will host the event, using [url=https://wheelofnames.com/]Wheel of Names[/url] to determine each winner's prize—[b]live on the Mabinogi Discord Server[/b]!
[h3]✅ [b]How to Enter:[/b][/h3][olist][*][b]Join the Giveaway[/b]
During the designated entry period, click the 🎉 button on the giveaway post (posted via [b]Caravan Joe[/b], our Discord bot)![olist][*]The giveaway will last [b]24 hours [/b]until [b]Wednesday, May 7th ~3:00 PM PDT[/b], so make sure to enter within that time![/*][/olist][/*][*][b]Random Winner Selection[/b]
After 24 hours, 20 randomly selected winners will be entered into a live prize drawing using [url=https://wheelofnames.com/][b]Wheel of Names[/b][/url], hosted by CMs Arciellia and Elebon in a livestream in the Discord server (#starlet-stage).[/*][*][b]Watch the Spins![/b]
Winners are not required to be present during the livestream, but we’d love for you to join the fun![/*][*][b]Results Announcement[/b]
Final prize results will be shared in the [b]#announcements[/b] channel in Discord after the event.[/*][/olist][h3]📜 [b]Giveaway Rules:[/b][/h3][list][*]You [b]must be a member[/b] of the Mabinogi Discord Server [b]prior to the start of the giveaway (May 6th, After Stream)[/b].[/*][*][b]New Discord accounts[/b] created after the announcement will [b]not[/b] be eligible.[/*][*]Winners can [b]only be selected once[/b].[/*][*]Winners must [b]not have any active bans or sanctions[/b] on the Mabinogi Discord Server.[/*][/list][h3][b]🎁 Giveaway Prize List 🎁[/b][/h3]
Here’s what lucky Milletians could win on the Wheel of Names:
[list][*][b]Flashy Dead Bee x1[/b][/*][*][b]Choice of Pet from Below x1[/b][list][*](Golden Retriever, Straw Magic Broom, Afghan Hound, Rainbow Sprite, Guardian Spider, Baby Pig, Mini Thunderbird)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Elysees Manor Box x11[/b][/*][*][b]Arcana 2x EXP Potion x1[/b] (Listed twice)[/*][*][b]Bank Limit Expansion Coupon (10 million) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Ethereal Ballet Box x11[/b][/*][*][b]DIY Dye Mold Selection Box x5[/b][/*][*][b]Pon (100)[/b][/*][*][b]Irusan's Letter of Guarantee x5[/b][/*][*][b]Nao Coin x1[/b][/*][*][b]Special Gold Box Coupon x2[/b][/*][*][b]Title Voucher: Who Can't Find a Needle in a Stack of Needles[/b]
(Or vanity title of your choice – e.g., "Bling Bling", "Ferghus's Senpai")[/*][*][b]Rebirth Potion x3[/b][/*][*][b]Lucky Blue or Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x3[/b][/*][*][b]GM's Dungeon or Shadow Mission Key Card x3[/b][/*][*][b]Spirit Appearance Slot Expansion Coupon x1[/b][/*][*][b]Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 days)[/b] (Listed twice)[/*][*][b]🎉 FREE PICK – Choose any prize on the wheel![/b][/*][/list]
[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/26915]Legal Rules[/url]
We’re incredibly grateful for the 20,000+ Milletians who make our Discord server such a fun, helpful, and friendly place. This celebration is all about you—our amazing community!

👉 Haven’t joined the Discord yet? We'd love to have you! [b][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi]https://discord.gg/mabinogi[/url][/b]

We hope to run more giveaways like this in the future! Let’s keep the memories going, together in Erinn. 💖 

[i]– The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] 2025 Mabinogi Survey
notes.content:
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zf2f1pqe/250514-wgc-1847-mb-cem-surveybanner-1400x300-a.png[/img]
[i]The survey period has concluded! We received a generous amount of responses and feedback from this survey. Thank you for your participation, Milletians!
---
Help shape the future of Mabinogi by taking our upcoming player survey! We’re looking for your feedback to improve the game, and as a thank-you, you’ll receive a small gift just for participating. Your voice matters — let’s build a better Mabinogi together![/i]

[b]Survey Dates: Thursday, May 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 15th, 11:59 PM PDT[/b]

Hey Milletians!

Your adventures across Erinn are important to us — and so is your voice. That’s why we’re launching a brand new [b]2025 Mabinogi Survey[/b] to gather your feedback on your Mabinogi experience!

Whether you're a long-time veteran or a fresh face in Uladh, your input helps shape the future of Mabinogi. We want to know what you love, what could be better, and how we can make your journey even more magical.

[h3][b]📜[url=https://www.research.net/r/MABI25]Check out the Survey Here![/url]📜[/b][/h3]

[i]All responses are confidential and will remain anonymous. [url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/legal/privacy/]Nexon Privacy Policy[/url].[/i]
[h3]🎁 What’s in it for you?[/h3]
As a thank-you for your time and thoughts, you’ll receive a guaranteed reward after completing the survey:
[list][*]1x Rebirth Potion[/*][*]20x Pon[/*][/list]
Rewards will be sent to the highest level character on the account you use to take the survey. 
These items will be sent at a later date, after the conclusion of the survey.

Let’s build a better Mabinogi — together. See you in Erinn! 🌟

[i]— The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch
notes.content:
[img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/mu5dciyt/1100x225-maplestory-worlds-official-launch.jpg[/img]

MapleStory Worlds has now officially launched! Enjoy MapleStory in entirely new ways, with countless worlds and games with unique gameplay, all created by other MapleStory fans! [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]Join the fun at the MapleStory Worlds website[/url][/b], and try out the creation tools to craft your own MapleStory experience!

[h2]What is MapleStory Worlds?[/h2]
MapleStory Worlds is a UGC platform where players can build, explore, and monetize their unique games. With intuitive tools and access to 30M+ assets, creators of all levels can bring ideas to life. Players can explore a delightful range of Worlds catering to all play styles. There is a perfect World waiting just for you! Explore. Discover. Play!

[h2]What Can You Play in MapleStory Worlds?[/h2]
There's tons of games to play on MapleStory Worlds, with more coming out all the time. Check out the three games below for a taste of what you can enjoy and create!
[h2][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e92c6726261c4c1795c369b5e66f1efa/][b]Maple Duel[/b][/url][/h2]
[url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e92c6726261c4c1795c369b5e66f1efa/][/url][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e92c6726261c4c1795c369b5e66f1efa/][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/eq4j3qvv/mapleduel_1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

Experience MapleStory in a whole new way with this card battle adventure! Collect cards for the Warrior, Magician, Bowman, and Thief jobs and build a deck to battle in friendly games or competitive ranked matches against other Maple Duel players! [b][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e92c6726261c4c1795c369b5e66f1efa/]Play Maple Duel on the MapleStory Worlds website[/url][/b]!
[h2][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/dcd9c5fee74142c9b0d7fbb4d1bccb1e/][b]Maple Slash[/b][/url][/h2]
[url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/dcd9c5fee74142c9b0d7fbb4d1bccb1e/][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vrjbcpcu/mapleslash_1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

Hack and slash through MapleStory's classic combat with a roguelite twist! Upgrade randomly selected skill cards as you level up, creating a unique build every round, and use them to battle through an endless battalion of monster! [b][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/dcd9c5fee74142c9b0d7fbb4d1bccb1e/]Play Maple Slash on the MapleStory Worlds website[/url][/b]!
[h2][b][url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e967c59f15f3418a843256894801df29/]Durango: The Lost Island[/url]
[/b][/h2]
[url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e967c59f15f3418a843256894801df29/][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/odljzxud/durango_1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

Explore, gather, hunt, research, build, and craft to survive in the wildlands of Durango! Tangle with some adorable monsters and endure the lost island in this survival game with a MapleStory flavor! [url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play/e967c59f15f3418a843256894801df29/][b]Play Durango: The Lost Island on the MapleStory Worlds website[/b][/url]!

[b]Unleash Your Creativity[/b]

Discover how our creators are turning their ideas into reality. From puzzle games to battle arenas, this thriving community is shaping the future of MapleStory Worlds. [b][url=https://maplestoryworlds-creators.nexon.com/en]Learn more in the Creator Center[/url][/b]!

[b]Join the Creator Circle[/b]

We developed this ongoing monthly program to amplify the work of promising creators like yourself. Whether you’re just starting out or an experienced creator, the Creator Circle provides mentorship, promotion, and financial support ($3,500 USD monthly stipend) to help you build the next great world. [b][url=https://maplestoryworlds-creators.nexon.com/en/community/5479/5485/2665788]Learn more in the Creator Circle post[/url][/b]!

[b]Available Regions and Platforms[/b]

MapleStory Worlds has officially launched globally, allowing players from all corners of the globe to play. Players can play and create on Windows PC, Mac (Beta), Apple, and Android mobile devices. Get ready to explore new realms and unleash your creativity in MapleStory Worlds!

[i]The Erinn Adventure Pass is back! Complete different tasks to update the Pass and gain rewards each time the Pass levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can purchase a Special Erinn Pass Expansion ticket to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.[/i]

notes.title: End-of-Sale Notice: Partner Trade Unlock Potion
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Hello Milletians,

In the May Update, several Fantasy Life Changes related to the Partner system are abound! We are announcing the end of sale of the Partner Trade Unlock Potion in the Cash Shop, effective immediately during the April 10th, 2025 maintenance.

With the update, the tradeability and equipment tab of Partners will be made accessible without locking the item exclusively to your Partner character. The Partner Trade Unlock Potion item no longer has an effective use.

Existing Partner Trade Unlock Potions will be retrieved from all characters with the May update patch. 

For players who purchased the Partner Trade Unlock Potion item directly and still had the item in their account, they will be refunded the original value spent on the item in NX. If a player purchased the item and used it, they will not be refunded. This will be distributed with the May 8th, 2025 maintenance. 

Those eligible for the reimbursement must meet the following criteria defined below:
[list][*]An account who had purchased the Partner Trade Unlock Potion item within the last 1 year (April 1st, 2024 ~ April 10th, 2025)[/*][*]The account still had the item:[list][*]Item was not claimed from the Cash Shop Inventory
OR[/*][*]Item is in the inventory of the character on the account[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Thank you,
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - April 10th
notes.content:
[b]Maintenance has concluded as of 9:25 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on [b]April 10th[/b]. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]6:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]4 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[h3][b]-Time-[/b][/h3]
[b]Thursday, April 10th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 10:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEDT, UTC +10): 11:00 PM - 3:00 AM (April 11th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Try your hand with the improved Alchemy and Puppetry talents, or enjoy the numerous Fantasy Life Changes in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/212200/announcements/detail/529842339955343539][b]Renovation Season 6 Update[/b][/url]![/*][*]Looking to relax at the most romantic place in Erinn? Find Love, make dyes, and enjoy the scenery with the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25310/doki-doki-island-2025][b]Doki Doki Island Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Take the stage and stun the audience with your fashion from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25313/ethereal-ballet-box][b]Ethereal Ballet Box[/b][/url]![/*][*]Last chance to acquire the the full outfit and chair to impress all your Mage-focused friends from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/25077/phantasmal-mage-outfit-box][b]Phantasmal Mage Outfit Box[/b][/url]![/*][/list]

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[list][*]Damage has been increased and modified at all ranks to allow for major damage on the first hit, with additional smaller damage on subsequent hits.[list][*]For Rank 1:[list][*]Before: 860%[/*][*]After: 2580% (Initial Hit) + 100% (Subsequent Hits)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Enemies in the path of the skill will now be pushed towards the attack’s direction rather than to the side.[/*][*]Marionettes now charge at a faster speed during the skill.[/*][*]The length of the attack range has been increased from 4m to 5m.[/*][*]The knockback distance on enemies has been increased from 4m to 5m.[/*][*]A cooldown penalty will no longer occur when cancelling the skill.[/*][/list][h2]Simplenogi: Part 2[/h2]
Simplenogi: Part 2 Update has arrived! 🎉
[list][*][b]Item tooltips[/b] have been improved, and the way text displayed has changed.[list][*]When applying simplified mode, you can see only the key information such as level or effect name in an abbreviated form.[/*][*]When applying detailed mode, you can see more detailed information than before.[/*][/list][/*][list][*]Similar information has been colour coded for quick and easy viewing.[/*][*]Added list icons and indentation to make information more recognizable.[/*][*]You can switch between simplified mode and detailed mode by pressing the ALT key while the equipment item tooltip is displayed.[/*][*]Item tooltips are no longer obscured by announcements.[/*][/list][/list][list][*]The [b]item selection window[/b] has been improved.[/*][list][*]Changed to a vertical scroll type that can expand up and down.[/*][*]Modified to a 2-column list format.[/*][*]Item search and sorting functions are added.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfM85YBfAhQ46Ru73GD64RjIoGjjLw74G9Ephbq1BiC_rhvGyrwbGevb06MXi_Mw1RVPdwXXRx6ztN7CcxGN1-F9IZWKV6DS5deSP6IJX4FBSDleFLTKSXmU0UikdPHtT1UVsT2?key=ljPczGE-uKM7uK96Y5t6IzWl[/img]
[list][*]The [b]item preview window[/b] has been improved.[list][*]Auction House Preview[/*][*]NPC Shop Preview[/*][*]Preview of the dye window[/*][*]Preview the title selection window effect[/*][*]Preview of the facilities to be installed on Moonlight Island[/*][*]Preview of Glyphwrighting[/*][*]Preview Beauty Coupons and Storage Coupons[/*][list][*]Preview actions may be restricted in the Transformations, Nascent Divinity, Demigod states.[/*][/list][/list][/*][list][*]The size of the view area is expanded.[/*][*]You can freely adjust the background color brightness.[/*][*]You can move the camera position by right-clicking in any preview view.[/*][*]Improved preview window applies to the views below.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/joxos2yl/title-preview-improvements.gif[/img]
[list][*]The [b]right-click menu[/b] for items has been improved.[/*][list][*]Only the list of functional buttons is displayed.[/*][*]The 'Item Description' section, where the same information as the item tooltip was displayed repeatedly, has been omitted.[/*][*]Right-clicking on an object will highlight it with brackets and a blue background.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/q3hdbbok/item-right-click-ui.png[/img]

[list][*]Some features of the item inventory have been improved.[list][*]With the item inventory window open, click on your inventory or bag and then press ESC to close the inventory window all at once.[/*][/list][list][*]If there is a new item in your item inventory, it will be highlighted with a yellow background and an "N".[/*][/list][/*][list][*]Improved[b] [/b]item inventory closing functionality.[/*][*]Improved visibility when acquiring new items in your item inventory.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zsbf1i0s/new-item-ui.png[/img]

[list][*]The status effect of [b]Mana Shield[/b] has been modified to visibly show your total Mana in Blue over the Health Bar above your character.[/*][list][*]When a Harmonic Saint's Veil of Life has been applied, the bar will be green with the Veil of Life Health instead.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/addlwzvt/mana-shield-health-bar.png[/img]
[list][*]You now have the option to choose which [b]Music Buffs[/b] you wish to share and receive.[list][*]A "Sharing Settings" button has been added to the bottom of the Music Tab in your Skill UI.[list][*]An option to set a shortcut to access the Share Settings Menu has also been added.[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Party Music Buff Sharing" option has been moved from the Options Menu to the Music Buff Sharing Settings menu.[/*][*]You can choose whether to give or receive the following Musical Buffs to/from your party members:[list][*]Battlefield Overture[/*][*]Enduring Melody[/*][*]Vivace[/*][*]March Song[/*][*]Harvest Song[/*][/list][/*][*]You will only be able to share and receive buffs from the skills you've learned. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/os1coifi/music-buff-sharing.png[/img]
[list][*]An option to immediately use specific skills after loading has been added.[list][*]The option to enable/disable is located on the Skill Info Window for each skill.[/*][/list][/*][*]The flash when landing a Critical Hit will no longer obscure your UI or hide the items in your inventory.[/*][*]The [b]Status List[/b] has been improved, allowing one to edit the status effects shown on themselves. 
[list][*]By Favoriting, you can set a status to always show, even when inactive. Inactive effects will be greyed out.[/*][*]By Hiding, you can set a status to never show, regardless of if it is active or inactive.[/*][*]A Status history will also be visible for statuses your character receives during your play session. These inactive statuses can be added to the Hidden or Favorites list.[/*][*]If the status icons are under the character name instead of the Status List Window during editing, the changes will not be saved.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/uxsni4ey/status-list-changes-v3.png[/img]
[list][*]Feedback Noted! We’ve restored the “[b]Reserve Attack[/b]” functionality and is available in the Gameplay [b]→ [/b]Control area of the Options Menu.[/*][/list]
[img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeXKK2xbswJjSB48ponETfqza1EmBX2bMmTB8pbQ0FiduehIDPUxwxymE1ipVGIJKuywu3zwj4mvXZ4925GxmXWlu0e0gJs7vxtFOG9KASeNiL8n03RSYIXMZ7t7bdyCa_xfr_DoQ?key=ljPczGE-uKM7uK96Y5t6IzWl[/img]
[h2]Debuff Changes[/h2]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rijlnqnu/pragarah.png[/img] Brionac and Seal: Pragarah[/b]
[list][*]The shredding effects of Brionac and Seal: Pragarah have been unified:[list][*]Awakened Brionac (by use of Awakening of Light or Shock) will now also reduce Magic Defense and Magic Protection on hit, according to the level of your Seal: Pragarah technique.[/*][*]Seal: Pragarah, when activated, will now also reduce Protection.[/*][/list][/*][*]The shredding effects of Brionac and Seal: Pragarah have been strengthened:[list][*]Protection:[list][*]Before: 3 per hit[/*][*]After: 6 per hit[/*][/list][/*][*]Magic Defense and Magic Protection[list][*]Before: 3 at technique level 10[/*][*]After: 6 at technique level 10[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Status Effect icons have been added to the enemy to indicate when they are at maximum Protection shred, or maximum Magic Defense/Magic Protection shred, from these sources.[list][*][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ncmindce/physical-debuff.png[/img] [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tzbjuwc5/magical-debuff.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】
Use of Brionac and Seal: Pragarah to reduce enemy Defense/Protection/Magic Defense/Magic Protection is an important part of Mabinogi combat. We felt that the process to use both sources to apply the two effects separately was an uncomfortable play pattern. In order to make this smoother, we have unified the effects of Brionac and Seal: Pragarah so that instead players pick which application source to use depending on the situation. Additionally, we increased the shred per hit so that less hits are required to reach the cap, and added a status effect icon so you can quickly check if the enemy has reached the cap or not.[/td][/tr][tr][td]【 Mabinogi Team Note 】
Additionally, we intend to rename Pragarah and Seal: Pragarah in a future update to Fragarach and Seal: Fragarach. This change is intended to correct the name of this mythological weapon. While we sympathize that changing terms players have become accustomed to can have challenges, we do want to represent the source material in an accurate, educational, and entertaining manner.
- The Mabinogi Team[/td][/tr][/table]
[b][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lrxhearc/hydra-transformation.png[/img] Hydra Transmutation[/b]
[list][*]The Battle Alchemy talent skill Hydra Transmutation has been adjusted.[b]
[/b][list][*]An indicator has been added to display the attack range of your Hydra.[/*][*]The time the Magic Defense and Magic Protection reduction is applied has been increased.[list][*]30 seconds at Rank 1[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]
【 Developer Comments 】
Hydra Transmutation is a considerable skill for Magic Attack based talents. However, due to the fixed location of the Hydra, it can be difficult to apply the Magic Defense / Magic Protection shred. We have decided to improve the skill to allow for more effective application of this debuff by making it last for a longer duration after an enemy enters its area of effect.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Pet Friend Summon Improvements[/b]
[list][*][b]Pet Parade[/b], a new action, has been added.[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/o15ahmhy/pet-parade.png[/img][list][*]This action can be learned by adding an extra Friend Summon slot to a pet by using Fynn Sync, or by summoning a pet that has an extra Friend Summon slot already unlocked.[/*][*]When used with a summoned pet with Friend Summon slots set, Pet Parade will activate the pet’s 1~5 Friend Summon slots that are ready to be summoned in sequential order.[/*][*]Friend Summons can still be individually summoned like before.[/*][/list][/*][*]Friend Summon slots can now be updated once every five minutes per slot, changed from once every Erinn day.[/*][*]Increased the duration of the Magic Defense and Magic Protection shreds provided by the summon skill for Ceraunus-type pets, Lightning Wave.[list][*]Before: 30 seconds[/*][*]After: 5 minutes[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Boss Health Bars
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/suufnqvm/boss-health-bar.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]The duration for debuffs will now show on the health bars for certain bosses. The list is as follows:[list][*]Succubus Queen[/*][*]Skelemancer[/*][*]Illusion of Balor[/*][*]Cethlenn[/*][*]Fleur[/*][*]Kerune[/*][*]Mag Mell Guard​ Captain[/*][*]Mag Mell Magic Spirit[/*][*]Sreng[/*][*]Irusan[/*][*]Completed Glas Ghaibhleann[/*][*]Giga Glas Ghaibhleann[/*][*]Cailleach[/*][*]Unfinished Reverie[/*][*]Cnoc Oighir[/*][*]The Winter Tyrant[/*][/list][/*][*]Debuffs with a timer will display the remaining time directly below the icon.[/*][/list]
[b]Other Debuff Changes[/b]

The following debuffs have had Status Effect icons added:
[list][*]Combo: Spinning Uppercut [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sd4nkxpm/spinning-uppercut-debuff.png[/img][/*][*]Smokescreen [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/cblbctob/smokescreen-debuff.png[/img][/*][*]Death Mark [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/v0jlv1xy/death-mark-debuff.png[/img][/*][*]Water Balloon [img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/npnjk4lm/water-balloon-debuff.png[/img][/*][/list][h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b]
[list][*]We have updated our Recommended Hardware Specifications from Windows 7 to Windows 10.[/*][*]Adjusted the following search fields to no longer be Case Sensitive[list][*]Inventory Search[/*][*]NPC Shop[/*][*]Dressing Room[/*][/list][/*][*]Face Accessory slot renamed to Facewear.[list][*]All item names that previously stated (Face Accessory Slot Only) have been shortened to (Facewear).[/*][*]The Dressing Room category has been renamed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Blaanid and Growth Guide have been updated to improve the flow for new players.[list][*]The Header text for these quests has been changed to [Guide].[/*][*]The messages seen when attempting to open the Memoir Book or Growth Guide before unlocking have been updated to better indicate how to unlock them.[/*][*]A step has been added to the unlock quests to require you to open the respective UI once.[/*][*]Once per day, resetting at 7am (Server Time), you may speak with Blaanid to restore a missing Blossoming Memories weapon, if far enough in the questline.[/*][/list][/*][*]Adjustments have been made to several Storyline Missions to improve places where players may get stuck.
[list][*]G7 - Ruwai’s Exploration Journal has been improved to allow players to progress quicker, and immediately teleport to the ruins entrance by speaking with Ruwai.[/*][*]During G7 - Lost Memory of the Ancients, Kousai's Lipai Tea can be reacquired by speaking with Kousai if the original tea is lost.[/*][*]The descriptions in the 'List of Missing People' during G22 - Overlapping Trails has been improved.[/*][*]The objective text to find Ruairi during G8 - Legatus' Advice has been made more clear.[/*][*]The required Synthesis materials will be regranted if necessary upon entering G10 - Goddess Memorial mission.[/*][*]During G17 - Mysterious Clue, completing the first objective will regrant the Mysterious Lingerie if the item is not in your inventory.[/*][*]During G3 - Deliver the Spirit Potion, the Spirit Potion can be regranted by speaking with Duncan if the item is lost.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you could not enter the Barri Dungeon with a Brown Fomor Pass in the G1 - Paradise quest if you had a Fomor Medal.[/*][*]The quest description for several quests has been updated to indicate that you can reobtain the necessary quest item by speaking with a certain NPC.[/*][/list][/*][*]Auto-pathing has been improved further.[list][*]The option to move to a specific NPC via the NPC Search or by Quest has been added.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Chronicle Mission, The First Battle of Mag Tuireadh, has been updated.[list][*]The experience for clearing the mission has been increased.[/*][*]When picking your role as The One in the Spotlight, fewer cutscenes will show to increase the speed of repeat performances.[/*][*]The effects of the Sealed Letters hidden within the battlefield have been strengthened.[/*][*]A light ray has been added to Sealed Letters that have been found on previous runs, making it easier to find in subsequent performances.[/*][*]The guide quest, Encore for an Empty Theater, has been improved.[/*][*]The cost to craft a Chronicle Celtic Weapon has been reduced from 5 Celtic Artifact Shards to 3 Celtic Artifact Shards.[/*][*]Several enemies have been adjusted to be easier.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements to emptying bags have been made. [list][*]The items from the emptied bag will automatically be organized into the free space of other bags.[/*][*]The items will be sorted based on bag order and bag tag settings.[/*][*]Items will no longer be moved into the Temporary Inventory or drop onto the floor.[list][*]If you do not have enough free space, you will not be able to empty the bag.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Quite a few smaller fixes this update, thank you all for your finds and patience when issues do arise. The usual text polish has continued this month, this time a few fixes for G24 and G25, miscellaneous quests, the descriptions for Mysterious Spirit Stones, and realigning a few UI text boxes.[/*][*]After the March Title menu update, custom Guild titles on your title list were defaulting to "an Erinn Expeditionary Force Member". This has been fixed to once again show as your custom guild title on this UI.[/*][*]An issue occurred when Constellation Casting caused constellations to be placed only on the right side, and occasionally hiding stars beneath the UI. The stars were brightest overhead with the launch of Astrologer, but now it's time for star fishers to truly test their mettle.[/*][*]Outfit Motions that contained additional props (such as a cat, or a kettle) would flicker upon starting your running animation. This has been corrected.[/*][*]The display issue causing ducats to appear incorrectly when at values over 4.3 billion has been fixed. To those who sallied forth to attempt to replicate this issue before it was fixed- we hope you all made your goal in time![/*][*]The Auction House entries for expiring Tail coupons have been removed to clean up items that cannot be obtained.[/*][*]A rarely occurring dark umbral shroud causing reduced vision and spooky vibes upon renewed entry into one of the many dungeons of Uladh has been dispelled.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the 3/20 Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]An issue was fixed where the Warm and Conceited Maid Partner Shops would appear as empty. Some say this was the impact of the Clumsy Maid, but surely none would hear such slander.[/*][*]Glewyas, tired from politely correcting nobles in the proper way to say his name, was accidentally taking Gold in lieu of Food Court Seals. He has been ordered to get a good night's rest.[/*][*]Pan is still learning the ropes after taking over the Check-In Attendance from Irusan. He made a small mistake with the date on the stamps, causing them to appear as if he had done this months in the past! He's fixed his mistakes, and hopes you wool forgive him.[/*][/list]
[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]Doll Bag Storage Chests are currently missing its "Doll Info" on its Item Attributes Section.[/*][*]The Brionac and Seal: Pragarah are currently operating at half-power by not reducing an enemy's Magic Defense and Magic Protection.[/*][*]There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.[/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2025 Spring and Summer Content Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/udebsqu0/1st-halfroadmapinfographics_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Dear Milletians,

Here we are in March, and it has already been a fantastic year for Mabinogi. Firstly, I must wish us all a happy 17th Anniversary! All of us have made strides this year in our own ways, making Mabinogi a comfortable home together. As we welcome the spring season, I want to take a moment to look back at some of our highlights from the past several months and share a few of my thoughts on what we can expect in the upcoming summer months, too!

We’ve been delighted to release many different content updates and events over the past year in Erinn. Fantasy Life Updates have encouraged Milletians to seek greater achievements in combat, fashion, and life. What are your proud achievements this year? [i]Did you craft your best weapon? Dye your favorite outfit? Tend to your Homestead or Moonlight Island?[/i] 

In my IRL Homestead garden, I've been learning a lot while sowing and planting. As I was planting radishes, tomatoes, and marigolds alongside each other, I couldn’t help but giggle while thinking of Ruairi, Tarlach, and Mari. Mabinogi is always on my mind, and I am grateful for it. It has given me the strength and courage to try new things, express myself, and be proud and hopeful for those around me, too. In Erinn, the Astrologer updates, the recent crossover event, and the Library of Secrets have all been met with such creativity and love. I hope these stories have made lasting memories for you, as they have for me. Fate Astrologer touched my heart deeply, and both using Astral Imaging and collecting cards have been a lot of fun—especially getting to share them with friends and the GMs! Meanwhile, the charming stories surrounding the Argontel Caravan reminded me of my early days in Mabinogi – spending time with friends, delving into dungeons, and exploring the world. 

In the next half of 2025, updates focused on skill balancing and QoL for combat content will be introduced. Meanwhile, we will also be improving accessibility for various systems, including Partner pets, Party and Chat, and improving the experience of Guilds. [i]Do you have a goal you are working towards next, Milletian?[/i] As we grow and improve our talents, it is always important to remember that each new skill or interest is fostered by learning and strength, bolstering you to overcome challenges through trial and error.

With the launch of G26, we began Chapter 8: Winds of Fate and met Aine, Delga, and other new faces. This coming summer, we plan to release the second installment of Chapter 8, Generation 27! This update will introduce a challenging new dungeon, Bri Leith, which offers a new tier of weapons to empower the game's many talents. And speaking of, we have two new hybrid talents on the way: the Sacred Guardian and Explosive Vanguard Arcana, introducing new styles of play to Mabinogi by allowing players to specialize their role as the party's dutiful protector, or take to the spear with explosive finishers.

Doki Doki Island is a longtime favorite for Milletians and the Mabinogi Team. The island received a major revamp last year, with the scent of cotton candy trees in the Plaza of Blessing making for a vivid gathering place for meetings with friends both old and new. The stories from the event offer new perspectives and bring us closer to the world of Tuatha de Danann and to each other. We hope that by adjusting and improving this and other classic content, we can refresh the Milletian experience and continue to inspire self-expression. In the Summer, there will be even more events than usual, so I expect that there will be something for everyone to enjoy. 

And last but certainly not least, the long-awaited Guild Renewal is coming! While past technical challenges have caused a delay in bringing Guild updates to Mabinogi, we've been working hard behind the scenes to get everything ready and will be implementing several changes to the Guild system all at once. We're hoping these improvements will provide an immediate difference in how you manage and interact with your Guild, fostering connections with friends and guildmates to make Mabinogi a more social experience. 

[url=https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/t2qpfz34/1st-halfroadmapinfographics_v3.png][img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/t2qpfz34/1st-halfroadmapinfographics_v3.png[/img][/url]

It’s always exciting to present all of these content updates to you, and I can’t wait to see what the rest of the year brings for Mabinogi and our community. Thank you for your continued support and dedication.

See you soon!

[b]~ GM Mewlynne, [/b][i]a 1st Year Milletian who will be carefully capturing caterpillars[/i] 🐛[b]
Mabinogi Producer[/b]
[img]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/3g3lvunf/mewsiggy2025narrow-1.png[/img]

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding the Soul Streamers Program - March 7, 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Dear Milletians, and our sincerest gratitude for our Soul Streamers,

We have evaluated the current operational needs and requirements of the Soul Streamer Influencer program and must announce that we need to sunset the program. To explain this decision on behalf of the dedicated team members of Mabinogi NA Marketing, due to a shift in strategic priorities, the program unfortunately can no longer be maintained. 

This by no means minimizes the achievements and dedication that our Soul Streamers and affiliated community members have shown. While there is no fault of the influencers’ work, the program and ongoing operations related to this program will conclude. Therefore, information detailing the program on our official website and social platforms has been archived.

[table][tr][td]To our Soul Streamers – 

We hope that you retain your love and appreciation for Mabinogi, and we will continue to support you and other community members in new and different ways in the future. We cannot express our thanks enough for the events you created, and we have fond memories of the many streams, videos, and messages from the community revealed through your works. Through many successful community-based efforts and events, collaborations and promotions with VTubers, celebrations of new content through videos and livestreams, and more, your dedication for Mabinogi shines.[/td][/tr][/table]

The Soul Streamers program was an effort amongst many different team members at Nexon, including the Mabinogi Development Team! We are thankful to each and every Soul Streamer, all 25 dedicated members over the course of the program, and we extend our gratitude for the trust in the project which grew and evolved over time. We are honored to have hosted many talented content creators through this program, and encourage all Milletians to create to their heart’s content, and to continue sharing your adventures. 

We hope to implement new and different methods for our Milletians to share and engage with each other’s content. We ask for your patience and understanding as these new projects may become available slowly. After all, there are many new contents to be revealed in the coming year that will require your support!

Please look forward to news about Mabinogi and our community on our official website and social platforms. Thank you once again.  

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]
[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
Special thanks to our Soul Streamer roster, as it stood on March 7, 2025. We encourage you to visit the creative pages of our community members below.

[i]For a full list of our Soul Streamer roster at the time of this post, please visit our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/96042/notice-regarding-the-soul-streamers-program-march-7-2025]official webpost[/url].[/i]

notes.title: 17th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1570/17thanni-news-940x290.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][h2]Simplenogi[/h2]
[b]Options Menu[/b]
[list][*][b] [/b]The Options Menu has been overhauled and updated to better assist Milletians with their settings.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1686/options-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[list][*]Tabs/Categories in the Options have been re-labeled and reorganized.[/*][*]All customizable options have been rearranged to fit the updated tab/category.[/*][*]Many options now have hover text to further explain their functionality.[/*][*]The following customization options have been [b]removed[/b] and are permanently activated:
[list][*]Dithering[/*][*]Sky Rendering[/*][*]Rendering Specular[/*][*]Shadow Blurring[/*][*]Enable Hotkeys[/*][*]Quick Equip[/*][*]Highlight New Items[/*][*]Giant / Nascent Divinity Camera Height Adj.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following customization options have been removed and will be permanently disabled:[list][*]Reserve Attack[list][*]Auto-Attack is [b]not[/b] being removed and has been relocated to the Gameplay tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list][*]The following customization options were [b]removed[/b] due to the option not working as intended:[list][*]Use NPC Theme Music[/*][*]Using 3D Sound[/*][/list][/*][*]New customizable settings have been [b]added[/b] to the Options Menu:[list][*]Horn Bugle - World Prem.[list][*]Located under Gameplay → System → View Announcements.[/*][*]Unchecking this box will prevent all text from [b]World Premium Bugles[/b] from appearing. Regular Bugles will still appear as normal in the Horn Channel.[/*][/list][/*][*]Video Volume[list][*]Located under Sound → Video.[/*][*]You can now adjust the volume of video cutscenes.
[/*][/list][*]Allow Astral Imaging[list][*]Located under Gameplay → Social → Community.[/*][*]Toggle this option for All players, Party members, or Guildmates only.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The following customization options have been [b]added[/b] to the Gameplay → Display → Show/Hide section to help increase visibility of the world of Erinn.[list][*]Talent Title and Icon[/*][*]2nd Title Icon[/*][*]Monster Fynni Gem Icon[/*][*]Guild Name (Self)[/*][*]Guild Name (Others)[/*][*]Doll Bags[/*][*]Pet/Partner Names[/*][*]Monster Names (Non-Boss)[/*][*]Damage Skin (Others)[/*][*]Erg Effects (Self)[/*][*]Erg Effects (Others)[/*][*]Special Upgrade (Self)[/*][*]Special Upgrade (Others)[/*][*]Pet Fynn Sync Effect
[/*][/list][/*][*]For all above customization options, unchecking the box will [b]remove[/b] the display of said effects.[list][*]All options are checked by default.
[/*][/list][/*][*]When entering Dunbarton square, the Simplified Display Options pop-up window will appear.[list][*]Clicking “Apply” will apply the recommended “Simplenogi” settings.[/*][*]You can still fine-tune your preferences through the Options menu.[/*][*]Clicking “Do not show again” will prevent the pop-up from appearing again.
[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]NPC Shop Menu[/b]
[list][*]The UI of NPC Shops has been changed to a “list” format, allowing for better visibility on items, such as cost, inventory size, and more.[list][*]You can alternate between the two styles by clicking on “Switch to Bag” / “View as List” in the top right corner of the Shop Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]A search function has been added.[list][*]The shop search function is case sensitive.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now sell up to 14 items at once when selling to an NPC.[/*][*]The repurchase limit from an NPC shop has been increased from 10 to 30.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1687/shop-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[b]Title Menu[/b]
[list][*]Title Menu UI has been revamped.[/*][*]Improved search functionality to now include effects from titles.[list][*]i.e. searching “Speed” will bring up “the Busy” title.[/*][*]The title search function is not case sensitive.[/*][/list][/*][*]Expanded the window for easier viewing of all titles.[/*][*]Added a “Favorites” button to have your favorite titles be automatically listed at the top.[list][*]You can still right-click a title to add/remove from the favorites’ list.[/*][/list][/*][*]A “Preview Effects” window has been added, allowing for visibility of 2nd Title Visual Effects.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1688/title-menu-before-after.png[/img]
[b]Other Simplenogi Changes:[/b]
[list][*]Talent Title icons and 2nd Title icons will now be vertically centered based on all tags displayed in the name area (Guild, Talent, Name, etc.)[/*][*]Spirit Transformation Liqueur (Invisible) is now available in Berched’s shop in Taillteann.[list][*]When applied, all visual effects from the Spirit Weapon will be invisible.[/*][/list][/*][*]When defeating (most) non-boss monsters, the name will now be hidden and its body will turn transparent before disappearing.[/*][*]The Combat Log will no longer list when you’ve made a critical hit on an enemy.[/*][/list][h2]Auto-pathing[/h2][list][*]Auto-pathing has now been added to the game as an improvement to the auto-navigation system for Milletians and their Pets.[/*][*]When clicking a location on the mini-map, a set route will automatically appear, allowing your character to run or ride all the way to its destination without making a 2nd marker.[/*][*]Auto-pathing is only available in the overworld and is not available in some areas or conditions such as:[list][*]Commercing[/*][*]Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Stellar Citadel[/*][*]Any Doki Doki Flight[/*][/list][/*][*]Auto-pathing will remember your pathing when on a mount and alternating between ground and sky.[list][*]The auto-pathing must be set before taking flight.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b]
[list][*]The Library of Secrets has been added as a Deluxe Background for Astral Imprinting.[/*][*]The name for the visual-only halo for Blaanid's Blessing has been renamed from Blessing Effect to Halo Effect. As this drop-down selection was always visual-only, not the strength of Blaanid's Blessing received, we hope that this better communicates as such.[/*][*]The death-defying technique and Cwn Annwn skill, Defiance and Veil of Mystique, have had their priorities altered. When the conditions are met, Defiance will now activate before Veil of Mystique.[/*][*]All non-gold currency will no longer be able to be stored in your bank.[list][*][b]Note: Any non-gold currency currently stored in your bank account will be automatically moved to the character based on the tab the currency is stored in.[/b][/*][*]These include currency such as:[list][*]Dungeon Vouchers (1st Voucher, 2nd Voucher, etc.)[/*][*]Adventure Seals[/*][*]Gold-Leaf Pine Cones[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Thank you all for your continued reports! A lot of smaller text fixes here and there with this patch, notably updating the descriptions for Upgrade Stones to better indicate their use, polishing up text for Fate Astrologer, shortening some of the lengthier buff-related ticker messages, and correcting the necessary book for rank 3 Rest's upgrade. Also, a new description for Cilantro's favorite food![/*][*]While we were updating the UIs, several text boxes have been updated to better fit the text inside the field.[/*][*]An issue has been fixed that was causing the Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scrolls and Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scrolls to not work on the following items:[list][*]Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scroll[list][*]Perseus Brutal War Hammer[/*][*]Nightbringer Enforcer[/*][/list][/*][*]Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scroll[list][*]Perseus Steeled Sword[/*][*]Perseus Brutal War Hammer[/*][*]Perseus Vigilant Shield[/*][*]Nightbringer Assault[/*][*]Nightbringer Enforcer[/*][*]Nightbringer Vanguard[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Bow-wielding Humans of Erinn, your time has come. The issue causing Arrow Revolver to lock characters in place when the burst fire was cast in extreme rapid succession with other attacks has been fixed. Nock your arrows, fire them well![/*][*]Under rare circumstances, players could find themselves with two Homestead Houses. The issue has been fixed, allowing players to remove the faulty house.[list][*]Despite this sounding affluent, this would lock them out from doing most things relating to the House.[/*][/list][/*][*]Effie found a few boxes of clothes in the back of her shop- these items have returned back for purchase in her Shop.[/*][*]Although he's a star, the Treasure Hunter Ace Talent was unintentionally giving 2x Skill Training to Fate Astrologer skills. This has been corrected.[/*][*]Corrected the listed Collection Categories on the Black Moon Commanders Compact Doll Bag Box. The Bag is unchanged.[/*][/list]
[b]2/13 Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]The issue causing Astral Frames to display incorrectly (missing subjects/stickers/etc) has been fixed. The issue has occurred one last time with this week's maintenance as we corrected the root of the issue; Astral Frames will stop resetting starting next week. Frames that are currently displaying incorrectly cannot be automatically fixed, and we apologize for the inconvenience.[/*][/list]
[b]2/27 Maintenance[/b] 
[list][*]The Black Rose Wig (F) from Tolly's Fashion event was not properly removed- we snatched your wig in this maintenance.[/*][/list]
[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]For those truly dedicated to Commerce and keeping Erinn stocked up- when reaching over 4.3 billion ducats, the inventory window will incorrectly return the value to 0.[list][*]This is a display only issue- if you obtained another 1 billion ducats after this, the display would show 1b but you would correctly have 5.3b.[/*][/list][/*][*]The props used for Special Idle Motions are currently showing incorrectly at the start of animation cycles.
