notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - March 6th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:01 AM PST and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.
[hr][/hr]Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on March 6th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]6:00 AM PST[/b] and last approximately [b]4 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[h3][b]-Time-[/b][/h3]
[b]Thursday, March 6th[/b]
[list][*]Pacific (PST, UTC -8): 6:00 AM - 10:00 AM[/*][*]Eastern (EST, UTC -5): 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM[/*][*]Paris (CET, UTC +1): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/*][*]Sydney (AEDT, UTC +11): 1:00 AM (Feb 7th) - 5:00 AM (Feb 7th)[/*][/list]
[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]UI changes, updated auto-pathing, and more in Mabinogi's [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95799/17th-anniversary-update][b]17th Anniversary Update[/b][/url]![/*][*]It's time to celebrate Mabinogi's 17th Anniversary this month! Join the celebration with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/519706073503891634][b]Library of Secrets Event[/b][/url]![/*][*]Acquire unique goods such as Cowenna's outfit in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212200/view/529839807839339930][b]Pan's Attendance Check Season 7[/b][/url]![/*][*]Tell other Milletians "You've Got Mail!" in style with the all new [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95941/erinn-courier-box][b]Erinn Courier Box[/b][/url]![/*][*]Frieren and her party are ready to depart. Thank you for joining them and compleing their story! [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253]Life in Erinn with Frieren[/url][/b] is ending. [/*][*]It's the last chance to grab Frieren and her party's looks! It's also the last chance to have your very own Frieren-themed Doll Bags![list][*]The [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95188/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-adventure-box]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Adventure Box[/url][/b] Sale is ending.[/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95189/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-demon-king-s-army-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Demon King's Army Box[/b][/url] Sale is ending.[/*][*]The [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95251/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-doll-bag-box]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Doll Bag Box[/url][/b] Sale is ending.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url][/b] will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PST time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Library of Secrets Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1597/250227_libraryofsecretsevent_newsarticleheader_940x290-2.jpg[/img]
[i]Milletian… we cordially invite you as a guest to one of Erinn’s most secretive corridors that only a select few are welcome. We ask that you enjoy your time, enjoy the celebration… and maybe read a book or two while you’re here.[/i][hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, March 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 3rd, Before Maintenance[/b]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Upon logging in, you’ll receive the quest [b][Guide] 17th Anniversary: An Invitation to Mystery[/b] as well as [b]Leath’s Letter[/b].[list][*]Read the letter to both select difficulty and register a main character.[list][*]You will also receive an [b]Orange Wings of a Goddess[/b] to whisk you to a location most Milletians are allergic to.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards for completing the quest:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][*]While only the main character will be able to participate in the story, mini-games, and earn rewards, [b]all characters[/b] on your account will be allowed to visit the new location once you’ve discovered it.[list][*]While you’re there, Leath loves to hear about your adventures, receive presents, and more! Try equipping various generational and dungeon-related titles to get a fun reaction from him! [i](Preferably not dog food...)[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1625/leath-2.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]That’s not all! Check out what else is happening around Erinn during this time of celebration:[list][*]When issuing a check from any bank in Erinn, all characters will receive a 17th Anniversary Check design.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]17th Anniversary Hot Time[/b][/h2][list][*]Log in during the event period to receive special items prepared by Nao herself to celebrate 17 years of Milletians’ in Erinn![/*][*]Claim the items from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose Claim Later if you wish to receive the reward on another character.[/*][*]You can only claim the item from the Hotday menu once during the event period.[/*][*]These items will not expire once acquired.[/*][/list]
[b]Item Details[/b]
[list][*][b]Letter from Nao[/b][list][*]A letter personally written by Nao to you. Using the item will allow you to read the message and receive a special buff leaving you [b]Refreshed[/b] for the next [b]10 minutes[/b]:[list][*]HP / MP / Stamina +100[/*][*]Defense / Magic Defense +5[/*][*]Protection / Magic Protection +5[/*][*]Strength / Intelligence / Dexterity / Will / Luck +20[/*][*]Max Attack +30[/*][*]Critical +5%[/*][*]Combat EXP Bonus +150%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]17th Anniversary Cake[/b][list][*]A delicious cake baked by Nao. Consuming this cake will provide you with a temporary boost of the following stats:[list][*]+20 Strength[/*][*]+20 Intelligence[/*][*]+20 Dexterity[/*][*]+20 Will[/*][*]+20 Luck[/*][/list][/*][*]As this cake is one of a kind, it cannot be used as a Catering Ingredient.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]17th Anniversary Fantasy Star 2nd Title Coupon [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1613/17th-anniversary-title-icon.png[/img][/b][list][*]Stats:[list][*]Max Damage +17[/*][*]Magic Attack +17[/*][*]Alchemy Elemental Damage +11[/*][*]Strength / Intelligence / Dexterity / Will / Luck +17[/*][*]Movement Speed +1%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Library of Secrets Quests[/b][/h2]
Upon completion of the guide quest, you’ll receive the following quest, allowing you to learn more about the secret area and the purpose it serves:
[list][*][b][Event] 17th Anniversary: Be Our Guest[/b][list][*]Follow Leath’s instructions to locate the secret area.[/*][*]Completing all tasks will award you with the following rewards:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*][b]10x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img][/b][/*][*][b]Developer’s 17th Anniversary Thank-You Notebook[/b][/*][*][b]2x 17th Anniversary Week # Instant Prize Tickets[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][list][*]A UI Icon will appear for your main character to provide information regarding the event overall, allowing you to teleport to the event area, and allowing you to enter the Instant Prize Drawing remotely.[/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1652/event-ui-icon.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
While you’re exploring the area, you’ll notice another Milletian that reminds you of the early years in Erinn. Join her to go down memory lane together, learn about what mini-games are available, and more! Each week, you’ll receive a new quest that reveals more about this strange Milletian and the Library of Secrets…what secrets await?
[table][tr][th]Week[/th][th]Quest[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][th]1[/th][td][b]17th Anniversary: A Song of Serenity[/b][/td][td][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img]
[/b][/*][*][b]**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td][b]17th Anniversary: The Flame of Memory[/b][/td][td][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img]
[/b][/*][*][b]**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td][b]17th Anniversary: May Happiness Be With You Always[/b][/td][td][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img]
[/b][/*][*][b]**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td][b]17th Anniversary: Going on Seventeen[/b][/td][td][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img]
[/b][/*][*][b]**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
[*][i]Each quest will unlock on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PST/PDT (or after Maintenance)[*]Week 1: March 6th, Week 2: March 13th, etc.[/i]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1618/caibres-bugle.png[/img][b]Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b] - similar to other Cairbre’s bugles, this special bugle can only be used after having acquired Melody Step from Music Jam. Upon using, your Melody Step will be upgraded in both power and time, becoming [b]Exalted Melody Step[/b]. This new buff lasts for [b]3 hours[/b] and gives you a [b]+5 Musical Buff[/b]! Now run and spread the celebration all across Erinn!
[h2][b]Daily & Achievement Quests[/b][/h2]
It’s a month of celebration, with rewards to earn [b]every day[/b] with the Daily Quest - [b][Event] 17th Anniversary: Treat Thyself![/b]
[table][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td][list][*]Experience one of the enchanted tales in the Library of Secrets (Play a mini-game once)[/*][/list][/td][td][list][*][b]20x 17 Anniversary Story Snippets [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png[/img][/b][/*][*][b]1x 17th Anniversary Week # Instant Prize Ticket[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
Looking to experience it all? You’ll earn a hefty amount of Story Snippets in return by completing objectives in the Achievement Quest - [b][Event] 17th Anniversary: The Mabinogi, Our Never-Ending Story[/b].
[table][tr][td][table][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td][list][*]Complete the [b]17th Anniversary: Going On Seventeen[/b] quest. (Available March 27th)[list][*]Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the [b]17th Anniversary: Treat Thyself[/b] quest 20 times.[list][*]Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets[/*][/list][/*][*]Speak with Duncan in Tir Chonaill with the Undelivered Letter in your possession.[list][*]Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][list][*]171717 EXP[/*][*]10,000 Gold[/*][*][b]200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets[/b][/*][*][b]1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/b][/*][*][b]**NEW** Branches of the Mabinogi Set Selection Box 
[/b](Click Right Image for Outfit Animation)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1651/mabinogi-celtic-branch-outfit-mplusf.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Celebration of Mini-games[/b][/h2]
What’s an anniversary celebration without mini-games? The Booksprites around the library have set up many different types of mini-games to test your skills, knowledge, and reflexes. You’ll earn unique prizes from each mini-game, so be sure to check them all out!
[list][*]Attempting any of the mini-games will net you a [b]17th Anniversary Story Snippet[/b].[/*][*]You can only earn 5 Story Snippets per day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT) across all mini-games. Don’t try to fool the Booksprites, they know and see all![/*][/list]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][h3][b]Who's that Whirling Sprite?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Speak to [b]Yoyo[/b] towards the back of the library to start this mini-game![/*][*]You’ll watch several Booksprites whirling around with one being different from the rest. You’ll need to guess what that unique Booksprite looked like, but be quick! They won’t be on screen for too long![/*][*]There are 5 rounds in total, each round will be tougher than the last, so sharpen those observation skills Milletians![/*][*]Depending on how many you get correct, you can earn up to [b]30,000 Exploration EXP[/b].[/*][*]Getting at least 3 correct will net you a [b]Library of Secrets Transformation Medal Fragment[/b].[list][*]Combine 3 fragments to acquire a [b]Shamala’s Transformation Medal[/b].[/*][*]You are limited to obtaining 3 fragments per real life day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT).[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1661/whirling-sprite-minigame.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][h3][b]Sprite of Order[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Talk to [b]Nono[/b] in the top-right corner (near the giant book and scrolls) to get started![/*][*]You're given 60 seconds to sort as many dyes as possible.[list][*]Each successful sort will net you 3 points.[/*][*]Each incorrect sort will cost you 2 points.[/*][/list][/*][*]After the mini-game, you can turn your points into [b]Combat EXP[/b] or [b]Exploration EXP[/b].[list][*]If selecting Combat EXP, the amount earned is based upon your Final Score x 1,000.[/*][*]If selecting Exploration EXP, the amount earned is based upon your Final Score x 100.[/*][/list][/*][*]Score over [b]350 points[/b] to earn a random [b]Fixed Color Dye Ampoule[/b]![list][*]You can only earn 1 dye per day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT).[/*][*]Dye expires in 7 days.[/*][*]Potential Colors available are:[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1659/dye-sorting-minigame.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]#F1EBC6[/td][td]#73824B[/td][td]#684329[/td][td]#E1DDCD[/td][/tr][tr][td]#F8E610[/td][td]#2F4A2F[/td][td]#B3B3C4[/td][td]#EFE8E5[/td][/tr][tr][td]#927A5C[/td][td]#51423C[/td][td]#8D3131[/td][td]#191616[/td][/tr][tr][td]#767272[/td][td]#100F0F[/td][td]#373F57[/td][td]#6F5F4C[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Stage of Trials[/b][/h3]
Looking to showcase your achievements and scale the toughest boss rush Erinn has to offer? The Stage of Trials is for you then! The trials have two modes: Basic and Veteran. Talk to [b]Fofo[/b] who is next to Nono in the Library or read below on what to expect:
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][list][*]Every Day, you’re given 3 attempts to make it to the end of the trials.[/*][*]The Stage of Trials is a 1-room dungeon with 15 bosses.[/*][*]The following restrictions apply in the dungeon:[list][*]Cannot summon pets[/*][*]Cannot revive[/*][*]Cannot enter with a party[/*][*]Cannot use a Rag Doll[/*][*]Cannot use a Marshal Weapon[/*][*]Cannot use a Remote Bank Coupon[/*][*]Cannot have accepted a Shadow Mission
[b]Note: [/b]The above items cannot be in your inventory - be sure to check your point inventory as well![/*][/list][/*][*]The following additional restrictions apply when attempting Veteran mode:[list][*]Cannot use potions.[/*][*]Cannot use the following skills:[list][*]Anchor Rush[/*][*]Tumble[/*][*]Wings of Eclipse[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1660/stage-of-trials.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]In Basic, you’ll be given a rest point after every 3 rounds.[list][*]Additionally, the stage manager will apply one of the following buffs of your choosing:[list][*]Power[/*][*]Defense[/*][*]Speed[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]In Veteran, you’ll attempt to clear it without any rest period or extra buffs.[/*][/list]
Of course, we wouldn’t leave our most courageous Milletians without goodies!
[list][*]Completing at least the first stage of the trials each day will count towards the Daily and Achievement Quests of the Event.[list][*]Limit once per real life day; resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT.[/*][/list][/*][*]For each attempt, you can choose your type of reward EXP:[list][*]Combat EXP[/*][*]Exploration EXP[/*][*]Music Renown EXP[/*][*]Life Renown EXP[/*][/list][/*][*]Finally, the Booksprites are providing titles for those who reach the following accomplishments:
[/*][/list]
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Title[/th][th]Stats[/th][th]Requirements[/th][/tr][tr][td]who Took the First Step to the Stage (1st Title)[b]**[/b][/td][td]Luck +19[/td][td]Clear at least 1 round in the Stage of Trials (Basic or Veteran)[/td][/tr][tr][td]who Upstaged the Stage of Trials (2nd Title)[/td][td]Max Attack +17
Magic Attack +17[/td][td]Clear the Stage of Trials
(Basic or Veteran)[/td][/tr][tr][td]who Bested the Stage of Trials (1st Title)[/td][td]Max Damage +30[b]*[/b]
Magic Attack +45[b]*[/b][/td][td]Clear the Stage of Trials (Veteran)[/td][/tr][/table][list][*][i][b]*[/b] Stats Expire after 30 days once awarded.[*][b]**[/b] If you already acquired the “who Took the First Step to the Stage” title from the 16th Anniversary Event, you will not receive another.[/i][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Dungeons that Drag-on[/b][/h3]
Do you enjoy dungeons? Do you enjoy roleplaying?, then this mini-game’s for you! Talk to the [b]Elder Booksprite[/b] to get started!
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]This mini-game will have you roleplay one of three famous characters as you clear a Uladh Dungeon.[list][*]Legendary Warrior - Reno[/*][*]Legendary Mage - Vay[/*][*]Legendary Archer - Tion[/*][/list][/*][*]You’ll work with the other two legendary characters to complete the dungeon.[list][*]Completing each room will allow your character to grow stronger, tackling stronger enemies with each room until you reach the boss.[/*][*]Despite the dungeon consisting of the legendary trio, this mini-game is [b]solo-only[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Completing the dungeon will earn you the following rewards:[list][*]+10 Levels for your character.[list][*]If you are Level 190 or higher, you will only gain levels up to the Level cap of 200.[/*][/list][/*][*]1x Aggressor’s Will[/*][*]1x Defender’s Will[list][*]You can earn up to 3 Aggressor’s and Defender’s Will per day.[/*][*]Both the Aggressor’s and Defender’s Will will expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1658/dungeons-drag-on.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Developer Thank You Notes[/b][/h2]
Throughout the celebration, enemies throughout Erinn will drop [b]Thank-You Note Fragments[/b]. As you received the Developer’s Notebook in [b][Event] 17th Anniversary: Be Our Guest[/b], be sure to collect all [b]27[/b] fragments to complete the book, composed of thank you notes, heartfelt messages, and even custom artwork from the Mabinogi Team!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1602/thank-you-notes.png[/img]
[h2][b]Instant Prize Capsule Machine[/b][/h2]
[i]Tucked away in a small corner of the Library of Secrets, you notice a little prize machine filled with goodies. It reminds you of the one in Festia in prior years. What potential prizes are up for grabs this year?[/i]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]Click on the [b]Capsule Machine[/b] in the Southwest corner of the library to open the Instant Prize Window. If you’re too busy to stop by the Library, you can also enter remotely through the [b]Event UI Button[/b]![/*][*]You can use [b]20,000 Gold[/b] or [b]1x Instant Prize Ticket[/b] to draw from the Capsule Machine.[/*][*]The capsule can only hold so much gold, so to be fair to all participating Milletians, only [b]20 gold entries per real-life day[/b] will be accepted.[list][*]Instant Prize Tickets do not have a limit, but you will only be able to use the [b]current week’s tickets[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Gold entries reset [b]every real life day[/b] at [b]8:00 PM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][*]Higher-end prizes are in limited stock and are [b]for the entire server[/b].[list][*]The Prize Window will display how many prizes are left for the server.[/*][/list][/*][*]All prizes will be re-stocked [b]every Thursday[/b] at [b]7:00 AM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1664/instant-prize-machine.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Weekly Prize List[/b][/h2]
Curious what you can earn from the Instant Prize Machine? Check below for the weekly jackpot (1st Prize) and other runner-up prizes below!

notes.title: Pan's Check-In Attendance Season 7
notes.content:
[i]Step aside, Irusan! Pan's coming through to take over the Check-In Attendance Season 7 Event! 
Check in each day to earn various support items, and collect pieces from Cowenna's closet on your way. Once you complete the calendar, feature her beautiful portrait in your Homestead where you can admire her always![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, March 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 12th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] Kid In Need’s Request[/b][list][*]Either find the [b]Kid in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue in Dunbarton or [b]read the letter[/b] provided to you in your inventory.[/*][*]You’ll receive a [b]Stamp Employee Contract[/b]. Use it to register your [b]account[/b] for the event, allowing you to participate [b]on all characters[/b].[/*][*]Completing [Guide] Kid In Need’s Request will award you with the following items:[list][*][b]1,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Pan's Support Selection Box x7[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once registered, a calendar icon will appear on your screen[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1653/calendar-icon.png[/img].[list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars with 28 days each, for a total of 84 days.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive your daily stamp, or how far along you are![/*][/list][/*][*]An Event Clock Timer is also available so you can check your Daily Stamp progress at a glance without opening the Event Menu.[/*][/list][h2][b]Attendance Stamps[/b][/h2][list][*]You now have even more ways to earn a stamp each day![list][*]Complete any of the following to earn a stamp:[list][*]Daily Taillteann Shadow Mission[/*][*]Daily Tara Shadow Mission[/*][*]Baltane Mission[list][*]Excluding Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table missions.[/*][/list][/*][*]Lord Mission[/*][*]Mag Mell Mission[/*][*]Tech Duinn Mission[/*][*]Clear Crom Bas[/*][*]Clear Glenn Bearna[/*][*]Clear 1 Floor of Fahmes Ruin[/*][*]3 Part-Time Jobs perfectly[/*][/list][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour to earn a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect the stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your Event Clock timer and it is already [b]7:00 AM PT[/b], the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive [b]1 stamp per day[/b].[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[list][*]The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from [b]June 12th, After Maintenance ~ June 19th, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1655/pan-calendar.png[/img]
[h2][b]Attendance Pass[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1795/attendance-pass.png[/img]
[list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase up to 2 Attendance Pass [b]per week [/b]for [b]500,000 Gold[/b] each.[list][*]Additional passes needed per week can be purchased for [b]29 Pon[/b].
[/*][/list][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. [/*][/list]

notes.title: [Community Event] Astral Imaging - Valentine's Edition Contest
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1511/250211_valentinesdayastralimagingcontest_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]You might not be able to capture your sweetheart's love, but you sure can capture them in an Astral Imaging card forever! Capture your Erinn Valentine this romantic season, and immortalize your affection for them behind a frame~![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3]
[b]Submission Dates: Thursday, February 13th, 12:00 PM PST - Friday, February 28th at 12:00 PM PST [/b]

[b]How to Enter:[/b]

All Milletians must submit the following information and files to the Official [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/mabinogi]Mabinogi Discord[/url][/b] Server [b][url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1229485400196911196]#contest-submissions [/url][/b]Channel:
[olist][*]Your [b]In-Game Name[/b][/*][*]Your [b]Valentine (Player Name, NPC Name, etc.)[/b][/*][*][b]1x Photo[/b] of your Decorated and Finished Astral Imaging Tarot Card[/*][*]The [b]Category[/b] you've chosen to submit your entry into:
[list][*]Romantic, Creepy, or Unconventional[/*][*]Note: You may only submit to one category.[/*][/list][/*][/olist]
Decorate your Astral Imaging shots with carefully curated backgrounds, and creative stickers! You can use Screenshot Mode to also finesse your perspective by pressing the Arrow Keys. Try out different methods to get good captures!

**Submissions cannot be edited, but can be cropped.
Please do not submit collages of any kind.

[b]General Rules[/b]:

notes.title: Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Patch Notes - February 6th, 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, including the Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End crossover![/i]
[hr][/hr][h3][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren][b]Life in Erinn with Frieren Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95317/community-event-mabinogi-x-frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-screenshot-contest][b]Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Screenshot Contest[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Wednesday, March 5th, 11:59PM PST[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95251/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-doll-bag-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Doll Bag Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95188/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-adventure-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Adventure Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95189/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-demon-king-s-army-box][b]Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Demon King's Army Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, [b]February 20th[/b], After Maintenance ~ Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance

[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95619/tolly-s-valentine-s-glow-up-event][b]Tolly's Valentine's Glow-up Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 30th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95303/updated-astraea-stella-box][b]Astraea Stella Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 23rd, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94826/master-plan-brilliantly-shining-star][b]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95243/milletian-events-fate-astrologer-update-event][b]Fate Astrologer Update Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, January 16th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94923/milletian-events-battle-astrologer-update-event][b]Battle Astrologer Update Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94579/otherworldly-guardians-pet-box][b]Otherworldly Guardians Pet Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 5th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/b][/url]: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance ~ Until Further Notice[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The highly anticipated crossover has arrived! See our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/frieren][b]microsite[/b] [/url]for more information![list][*]Join Frieren and her party as [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren#event-details]they search for unique magic[/url] in the world of Erinn.[/*][*]Earn exclusive rewards ranging from Homestead Items, gestures, and even your very own [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95253/life-in-erinn-with-frieren#achievement-quests]Mimic chair[/url]![/*][*]Dress up like your favorite characters from both the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95188/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-adventure-box]Frieren's Adventure Box [/url]and [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95189/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-demon-king-s-army-box]Demon King's Army Box[/url].[/*][*]Have a miniature Frieren, Fern, Stark, and others follow you on your adventure with [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95251/frieren-beyond-journey-s-end-doll-bag-box]Doll Bags[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Additional following changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]

[b]Commerce Baltane Season 3[/b]
[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Baltane Season 3 will begin at 7:00 AM PST on March 6th, 2025 and run until June 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PDT.
[list][*]Baltane Season 2 will conclude on March 6th, 6:59 AM PST.[/*][*]Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.
[list][*][Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The following items will be available in Sayiv’s Limited (Seasonally) shop tab, and have been added to the [b]Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box[/b].[list][*]Sturdy Angler's Creel Coupon - 1,000,000 Seasonal Ducats[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Erinn Flower Merchant's Knapsack - 10,000,000 Seasonal Ducats[/*][/list][/*][table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][*]The Baltane Season 3 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Baltane Season 3 Challenger 2nd Title: [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1087/baltane-s2-title.png[/img]
(See right for visual effect)
[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]20x Precise Reforging Tools[/*][/list][/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/75214/seasonal-commerce-system-guide]Seasonal Commerce Guide[/url] will be updated with Baltane Season 3, and Baltane Season 2 information will be archived.[/*][*]The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.[/*][*]Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.[/*][*]Additional updates to Commerce are as follows:[list][*]Added two [Mercantile] quests available after reaching Commerce Rank Silver 5 as a guide quest for the Barter Trading system.[/*][/list][/*][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1396/anaphora-v2.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*]Updated the skill description of Fate Foretold to indicate that its damage scales off unique cards drawn, rather than counting any card drawn (example: 5x Wheel of Fortune cards drawn would only count as 1x). This is a text only change.[/*][*]Although technically correct, the best kind of correct, to better differentiate them as well as represent more asterisms we have renamed the seven star version of Ursa Major that appears when Constellation Casting to Big Dipper. [i]We did think about naming it "Ursa Mid" though.[/i][/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following bugs have been fixed:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Some text was appearing incorrectly in the Metal Conversion and Fragmentation UIs. The text enjoyed its brief sojourn, and is now back in its proper place.[/*][*]Alchemic Sharpshooter's Arcana Link Level 6 was previously not displaying Archery Talent Weapon Max Damage +100 in the Arcana menu. This was a text only error, and it has been corrected.[/*][*]The "Open with Inventory" option for the Inventory Search window will once again properly save between channel changes and relogs.[/*][*]Corrected an issue where the Grade 20 Chariot Card on was giving less movement speed than expected.[/*][*]The following Title Coupons have been renamed to correct a mismatch. Note that the 2nd Titles themselves are unchanged, and are only listed here to help convey which title you would receive when using the renamed coupon.[list][*]Beautiful Starlight (Yellow effect)[list][*]Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title Coupon[/*][/list][/*][*]Mysterious Starlight (Purple effect)[list][*]Beautiful Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Mysterious Starlight 2nd Title Coupon[/*][/list][/*][*]Enchanting Starlight (Blue effect)[list][*]Energetic Starlight 2nd Title Coupon > Enchanting Starlight 2nd Title Coupon
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The following item has been renamed to properly reflect the skill name.[list][*]Bullet Storm Mastery Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower) > Bullet Storm Effect Change Card (Dazzling Shower)[/*][/list][/*][*]The Christmas Tree in Dunbarton has been finally taken down. [list][*]The resident who was previously responsible for seeing to its removal, whose identity will be kept hidden for her own sake, was previously heard saying "We can just keep it up for another 10 months and it will be correct again. Look, I have books to sell!".[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where gold may disappear when unregistering items from the Auction House.[/*][*]Quest Markers will now appear correctly when riding an Antique Mimic Pet. No need to ask random Milletians for directions![/*][*]Corrected an issue where the trade limit was reset when using an exchange coupon when in possession of specific bags.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following bugs have been fixed during the January 23rd Maintenance:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Items dropped on the ground will now properly clear from the ground when picked up.[/*][*]Production Boost Potions can no longer be used in Fragmentation.[/*][*][i]Hey, wait, come back![/i] Fixed an issue where the Raft would escape without you during the G17 Raft Escape quest.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.[/*][*]Astral Frames are not saving properly following weekly maintenance, leading to Milletian and other Cards to not appear as expected.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Life in Erinn with Frieren Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1097/241202_frieren-beyondjourneysendevent-1_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]Frieren and her party have heard rumors of Erinn’s magic and have come to visit. Milletian, who happened to meet Frieren and her party, decides to accompany them for a while. What kind of magic will they encounter?[/i]
[hr][/hr][h1][b]Main Event Details[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Part 1[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h3][b]Part 2[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, February 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]During the event, you'll receive the quest,[b] [Guide] Argontel Merchant Caravan.[/b][/*][*]Register your main character with Arganthel Merchants Guild Manager who is located at the Argantel Caravan located at the Southern end of Tara.[/*][list][*]You can quickly travel to the NPC by teleporting from your Traveler’s Guide to “Moon Gate: Tara - Tara South” from the list.[/*][*]Additionally, you can travel by talking to the NPC “Argontel Merchants Guild Advertising Officer” who will be appearing in Tir Chonaill and Dunbarton during the event period.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][/list][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1161/argontel-caravan-npc.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]You’ll receive the following after completing [Guide] Argontel Merchant Caravan:[list][*]5x Argontel Caravan Coins [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1110/argontel-caravan-coin.png[/img][/*][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][Guide] Browse the Argontel Merchant Caravan[/*][/list][/*][*]The reset time for all commission and event quests is at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]All event quests and event items will be removed when the event ends.[/*][*]While the caravan is in town, you'll notice that several NPCs from past events have also made a return to celebrate the occasion! Be sure to stop by and visit them all around Tara and see what they have to say! [i]Some might even appreciate you if you wear the appropriate title.[/i][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1228/argontel-caravan-camp.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hotday Event Details[/b][/h1]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, February 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 6th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the items prepared for the [b]Mabinogi x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Hotday Event[/b]![/*][*]Claim the items from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose Claim Later if you wish to receive the reward on another character.[/*][*]You can only claim the item from the Hotday menu once during the event period.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Item Details[/b][/h3]

During the story quest [b][Event] A Magical Scene[/b], you’ll be given an item to see which villagers in Erinn need assistance for the day. Using the item will pull up various quests, allowing you to earn [b]Dice Points[/b] which can be used for the [b]Erinn-Go-Round[/b] board. You’ll be able to choose from the following at the beginning of the story:
[list][*]Commission: Procure Materials[list][*]Provide 5 Iron Ore and 5 Copper Ore to Ferghus.[/*][/list][/*][*]Commission: To Overcome Pain[list][*]Deliver 10 Bloody Herbs, 10 Mana Herbs, and 10 Base Herbs to Dilys.[/*][/list][/*][*]Commission: Clear Alby Dungeon

As you progress through the story, you’ll unlock more available quests, up to 10 in all. You can accept up to 3 commission quests per day and can repeat commissions if you so wish. Completing all available commissions will award you with a total of [b]4,000 Dice Points per day[/b]. Commission quests will [b]reset daily at 7:00 AM PST[/b].

The higher the number, the more dice points it will cost.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Dice Points reset each day at 7:00 AM PST.[/b][/list][*]When you land on normal squares of the Erinn-Go-Round, you will receive the following boxes.[list][*][b]Erinn-Go-Round Reward Box[/b][/*][*][b]Erinn-Go-Round General Gift Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]You can also receive the following box when you land on a corner square.[list][*][b]Erinn-Go-Round Special Gift Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Completing a lap will award you [b]one of each box[/b].[/*][*]While Dice Points reset each day, the space you land on will [b]not[/b] reset.[/*][*]Each event day will start at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]After the event ends, you will be unable to claim any rewards and the related event quests and coins will be removed.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Tolly’s Valentines Glow-up Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1385/250123-wgc-1746-mb-tollysvalentinesdayevent-940x290-v2.png[/img]
[i]Strut your Fashionogi knowledge as you help two love birds who are just terrible with fashion by crafting and dyeing new outfits for their wardrobes! Do you have what it takes to save their date? Tolly has new rewards for you if you do! Check below for details![/i]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, January 30th After Maintenance - Thursday, February 20th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Tolly-Free Call[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with Tolly near Dunbarton Square.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A Tolly-Free Call:[list][*]15,000 EXP[/*][*]Daily Event Quests and Achievement Quest unlocked.[/*][*]A delectable candy icon for Tolly’s Event will appear under your Event tab.[list][*]You can check the event details and move to Tolly using this menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1376/ui-icon.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Tolly's Craft Services[/b][/h2]
[h3]Craft Event-Exclusive Outfits[/h3][list][*]You can craft a new outfit set once per day (in Real-Time), resets at 7:00 AM Server Time. [/*][*]Tolly’s Fashion outfit pieces will be available for your character to try on! [/*][*]Each Thursday 7:00 AM Server Time, all Tolly’s Fashion outfit pieces will be cut up for scraps to make new beautiful outfits! [/*][*]Each week, 5 different outfit sets will be available. [/*][*]Tolly’s Fashion outfit pieces can be destroyed through Tolly or manually through the item tooltip ‘Destroy’ option.[/*][/list][table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][b]Cutting[/b]
[list][*]After choosing your selected outfit pieces, ask Tolly for scissors. [/*][*]Carefully cut out the pattern to your best ability by playing the Restoration minigame. Try not to damage the pattern, or you’ll start to see red![/*][/list]
[b]Sewing[/b]
[list][*]After cutting your pattern, ask Tolly to borrow a needle to sew it together! [/*][*]Carefully sew the clothing to your best ability by playing the Tailoring minigame.[/*][/list][/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1378/mini-games.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][h3]Craft Dye Ampoules[/h3]
[list][*]Receive a Fixed Color Dye Ampoule of your choice by inputting the RGB colors for the dye color you wish to create.[/*][/list]
[b]Today’s Regular Dye Ampoule[/b]
[list][*]Can be crafted once per day (in Real-Time), resets at 7:00 AM Server Time. [/*][*]Fixed Color Dye Ampoule (Event) will expire in 7 days.[/*][/list]
[b]Tolly Style Dye Ampoule[/b]
[list][*]Can be crafted using 1,000 Gold.[/*][*]You can ask Tolly to craft dyes in multiples of 1, 5, or 10 at a time to create a specified color Fixed Color Dye Ampoule (Tolly’s Fashion) and Fixed Metal Dye Ampoule (Tolly’s Fashion).[/*][*]Fixed Color Dye Ampoule (Tolly’s Fashion) and Fixed Metal Dye Ampoule (Tolly’s Fashion) will expire in 15 hours. [/*][*]Fixed Color Dye Ampoules (Tolly’s Fashion) can only be used on (Tolly’s Fashion) items.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Daily Quest[/b][/h2]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td][b][Event] Fashion to Dye for[/b]

Check in with Tolly each day to craft, cut, and sew! The event quest will reset daily at 7:00 AM Server Time.[/td]

Check in with Tolly, Daulet, and Roisina to see how you can lend a hand. Come back each day!

notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:20 AM PST and the servers are available once more. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Let's keep making Mabinogi as great as possible in 2025![/*][*]Dorren found and fixed an magic alchemy jam with the Dry Ovens causing issues when recalling Synthesis favorites and attempting to register materials. notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Europe and Mobile Soft Launch!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1165/msw-eu-launch_940x290_final.png[/img]

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]The MapleStory Worlds Soft Launch rolls on and is now available in Europe and on mobile devices[/url]! Introducing an exciting new way to play and create - MapleStory Worlds is here with powerful tools to design your own adventures and enjoy the creations of your fellow Maplers, and Maplers in Europe and on mobile devices can now join the fun!

[url=https://www.nexon.com/msw/landing]Learn more at the MapleStory Worlds website[/url]!

[previewyoutube=qT_cgEgHObw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What is MapleStory Worlds?[/b][/h2]
Immerse yourself in a whole new way to experience MapleStory! MapleStory Worlds is a dynamic platform where Players and Creators unite to explore custom-crafted Worlds and avatars. With robust worldbuilding tools and access to over 30 million MapleStory Assets, Creators can design immersive experiences that captivate players globally—and earn rewards for their unique creations.

[b]Unleash Your Creativity[/b]

Discover the stories of our Creators who have transformed their passions into playgrounds! Join this thriving community using the MapleStory Worlds platform to bring diverse visions to life. [url=https://maplestoryworlds-creators.nexon.com/en]Learn more in the Creator Center[/url]!

[b]Dive into a Vibrant Community[/b]

Experience the nostalgia of old-school MapleStory or dive into vibrant worlds crafted by our very own Creators. Each World available on the platform offers unique adventures and endless excitement! [url=https://maplestoryworlds.nexon.com/en/play]Learn more in the Play Worlds page[/url]!

[b]Join the Creator Circle[/b]

Apply for our exclusive Creator Circle! We developed this ongoing monthly program to amplify the work of promising Creators like yourself. Take your world to the next level with promotional and technical support, mentorship from the MapleStory Worlds team, and a $3,500 USD monthly stipend. [url=https://forum.nexon.com/maplestoryworlds-creators-en/board_view?board=5485&thread=2665788]Learn more in the Creator Circle post[/url]!

[b]Available Regions and Platforms[/b]

MapleStory Worlds is now soft-launching in Europe in addition to North and South America. Players in the available regions can also play and create on Windows PC, Mac (Beta), and Mobile platforms! We plan on expanding MapleStory Worlds to additional regions later this year.

notes.title: Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1024/250108_decemberastrologerpart-2_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Astrologer Part 1: Written in the Stars[/b]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94832/astrologer-part-1-written-in-the-stars-update][b]Read the full update details here.[/b][/url] The movements of the stars tell stories about our past, present, and even the future. Astrologers study star patterns and make predictions about what the future may hold. People with this special talent can see a multitude of possibilities hidden in the stars. Meet Neal and Delaney, witness the Stellar Citadel, and reach for the stars as you gain new talents and skills, wielding powerful weapons in the new Astrologer update!

[b]Astrologer Part 2: Stellar Reunion[/b]

Study your constellations and gain new life skills as the Astrologer update continues! Join Delaney and Neal in the rest of their story after the end of their long journey, and learn the ways of Fate Astrology. Master of many life skills, this type of Astrologer can view fates, catch stars, craft materials, and more!
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Fate Astrologer[/b][/h2][table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][list][*]A new Fate Astrologer Talent and 5 new Fate Astrologer skills have been added to the [Astrology] skill tab.[list][*]Fate Astrologer related items, titles, journal achievements and Grandmaster Quests have been introduced.[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional details for Fate Astrologer can be viewed on the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/astrologer/part2]dedicated microsite[/url].[/*][/list][/td][td]          [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1100/fate-astrology-talent.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Astrology Scenario Quests Part 2[/b]

Those seeking to [b]craft[/b] the stars themselves can begin their journey once they have completed the Astrologer Part 1 Scenario Quests, up to [b][Astrologer] The Workings of the Stellar Citadel[/b]. Begin viewing the possibilities of a Fate Astrologer with Delaney in the Stellar Citadel.[list][*][b]New Milletians[/b] who choose Fate Astrology for their first talent after rebirthing will be granted [i]‘the Aspiring Fate Astrologer’[/i] 1st title.[list][*]Title Effects:[list][*]Magic Attack +15[/*][*]MP +20[/*][*]HP +20[/*][/list][*]The title is available to you until you reach Level 10,000.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Upon visiting Delaney in the Star Citadel, you'll continue the questline with the following quests, rewards, and learned skills:
[list][*][b][Fate Astrology] Wand of Lesser Willpower[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Constellation Casting skill[/b], 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, a [b]Constellation Rod[/b] and [b]100x Constellation Bait[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Pentacle of Good Fortune[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the Stellar Handicraft skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and the [b]materials to craft Constellation Bait.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Cup of Overflowing Emotion[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Astral Imaging[/b] skill and [b]Astral Imprinting[/b] skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and 20x Astral Sticker Kits.[/*][/list][/*][*][b][Fate Astrology] Sword of Fate’s Resolve[/b][list][*]Complete the quest to unlock the [b]Cartomancy[/b] skill, 5,000 Gold, 50,000 EXP, and [b]10x Conjuration Crystals[/b].[/*][*]Neal and Delaney have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Spirit Campfire Invitation.[list][*]Neal: 5x Rigel Crystal[/*][*]Delaney: 1x Neal’s Corn Soup[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Fate Astrologer Skills[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]General Fate Astrologer Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*]AP Training cannot be used for skills of this talent.[/*][*]When using a skill, a certain amount of mana and stamina will be consumed.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1104/constellation-casting.png[/img] Constellation Casting[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When the time in Erinn is between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM, the reflections of the stars are the brightest, and [b]Constellation Casting[/b] will be available for use. [/*][*]This is a skill that allows you to obtain Star Reflection fragments, materials used for [b]Stellar Handicraft[/b].[list][*]Procyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair Fragments[/*][*]Procyon/Polaris/Arcturus/Hadar/Rigel/Canopus/Altair Crystals[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill can be used at existing fishing spots.[/*][*]A [b]Constellation Rod[/b] and [b]Constellation Bait Box[/b] is required to begin casting for the stars' reflection![list][*]The Constellation Rod cannot be reforged or upgraded.[/*][/list][/*][*]When fishing manually, you can play a minigame to find constellations. The number of stars you find will be scored, and you can earn Star Reflection fragments depending on the score.[list][*]After a certain amount of time has passed in the mini-game, stars that are not the correct answer will gradually disappear.[/*][*]If you succeed in matching the stars during the mini-game, a buff effect for the next Constellation Cast will activate an increased biting speed +10.[/*][/list][/*][*]Auto fishing is possible for those that wish to just enjoy the tranquility under the stars.[/*][*]Constellation Casting is [b]not[/b] affected by existing Fishing skill related effects.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1105/stellar-handicraft.png[/img] Stellar Handicraft[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can create various items used by Astrologers by harnessing the power of Star Reflections paired with the Fatespinner, located in the Stellar Citadel.[/*][*]You can touch the Fatespinner, or use the skill nearby to open the crafting menu.[/*][*][b]38 new recipes[/b] have been added for Stellar Handicraft, including the following items:
[list][*]Altair[/*][*]Altair Crystal[/*][*]Arcturus[/*][*]Arcturus Crystal[/*][*]Astral Sticker Kit[/*][*]Blank Astral Card[/*][*]Canopus[/*][*]Canopus Crystal[/*][*]Conjuration Crystal[/*][*]Constellation Bait[/*][*]Constellation Rod[/*][*]Cups Card[/*][*]Hadar[/*][*]Hadar Crystal[/*][*]Oracle's Pavilion[/*][*]Oracle's Tools[/*][*]Pentacles Card[/*][*]Polaris[/*][*]Polaris Crystal[/*][*]Procyon[/*][*]Procyon Crystal[/*][*]Rare Cups Card[/*][*]Rare Pentacles Card[/*][*]Rare Swords Card[/*][*]Rare Wands Card[/*][*]Rigel[/*][*]Rigel Crystal[/*][*]Starter Cups Card[/*][*]Starter Pentacles Card[/*][*]Starter Swords Card[/*][*]Starter Wands Card[/*][*]Stellar Powder[/*][*]Swords Card[/*][*]Wands Card[/*][/list][/*][*]Entries have been added for Stellar Handicraft in the Crafting Diary.[/*][*]Astrologer Tarot Cards now have Grades from Grade 0 to Grade 30 and can be crafted through Stellar Handicraft.[list][*]The higher the grade, the better the buff effect from the Tarot Card drawn in Fate Foretold. [/*][*]You can create a Card Pack with Stellar Handicraft.[/*][*]Starter Cards are the lowest grade, with Rare being of the highest grade.[/*][*]When opening a card pack, if a card of the same or lower grade appears, you will obtain an amount of Pollux instead, used to craft new Card Packs.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1101/astral-imagin.png[/img] Astral Imaging[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Astral Imaging is a skill that can take an image of a Subject, capturing a moment in time.[/*][*]No resources are consumed when using this skill.[/*][*]Capture a subject’s moment by clicking on them. You can capture Milletians (including yourself), NPCs, and monsters.
[list][*]Transformations, Spirit Weapon Awakenings, and Marionettes cannot be captured.[/*][*]Subjects eligible for Astral Imaging will have an HP gauge displayed above their head when hovering the subject. You cannot capture the subject if it does not have an HP gauge displayed.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can save up to 10 images at one time which will be present in the Astral Imprinting skill menu.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1102/astral-imprinting.png[/img] Astral Imprinting[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Astral Imprinting is a skill that allows you to decorate your own Tarot Cards using the Subjects captured via Astral Imaging, and various elements including stickers and border designs for your cards.[/*][*]When designing a card via Astral Imprinting, you can add decorations up to 100 points, a cost accumulated when adding elements to the card.
[list][*]Each decoration element applies the following cost.
[list][*]Subjects: 8[/*][*]Borders: 2[/*][*]Sticker Shop: 1[/*][*]Extracted Stickers: 2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Stickers in the Sticker Shop within the Stickers tab can be selected unlimitedly, each costing 1,000 Gold to place into the design.[list][*]The cost of the selected stickers will be shown before completing a card.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can create your own stickers by using an [b]Astral Sticker Kit[/b] to create stickers using the item icons of items in your inventory.[list][*][b]Astral Sticker Kits[/b] can be crafted with [b]Stellar Handicraft[/b].[/*][*]When using the kit, you will be able to select which item you would like to create an [b]Astral Sticker Pack[/b] for.[list][*]The kit will be consumed on use. The target item will not be lost.[/*][*]Using the [b]Astral Sticker Pack[/b] will add the sticker to your Extracted Stickers within the Stickers tab.[/*][*][b]Astral Sticker Packs[/b] can be traded with others, but cannot be sold on the Auction House.[/*][*]You may also use Astral Sticker Kits by clicking Extract Stickers from the Extracted Stickers menu. When done this way, the Extracted Sticker will be available for immediate use without creating a sticker pack.[/*][*]Using an Astral Sticker Kit on a weapon that has had a Weapon Appearance Scroll applied to it will create a sticker of the transformed weapon.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each extracted sticker may only be used once and will disappear from the Stickers tab after being finalized on a card.[/*][/list][/*][*]Decorative borders are unlocked based on the grade of the Tarot Cards you have acquired, and are unlocked permanently.[/*][*]A variety of card backgrounds are available.[/*][*]You can save the completed decorated cards in Blank Astral Cards, crafted via Stellar Handicraft, and these completed cards can be traded with others.[/*][*]The Astral Frame Homestead prop has been added which can display completed card designs. Astral Frames can be installed on Homesteads and Moonlight Islands using the Astral Frame Homestead item, or 75 Pon through the Construction List.[list][*]Looking for additional Constellation themed Homestead items? The following Constellations have also been added:[list][*]Monocerus Constellation (100 Pon)[/*][*]Vulpecula Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][*]Aries Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][*]Cetus Constellation (75 Pon)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Completed card designs can be applied as the appearance of a Tarot Card.[/*][/list][h3][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1103/cartomancy.png[/img] Cartomancy[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Cartomancy allows one to consult the cards to receive the guidance of fate, allowing you to either accept it for yourself or share your fate with other Milletians to gain access to the drawn card’s chosen destiny.[list][*]The guidance of fate will last up to 36 minutes at rank 1.[list][*]The destiny cannot be overwritten while it is still in effect.[/*][/list][/*][*]Accepting or Sharing will require Conjuration Crystals, an item made using Stellar Handicraft.[/*][*]Each of the 22 tarot cards will have a different effect, shown in the chart below.[/*][/list][/*][*]By [b]Accepting Fate[/b], you will immediately receive the guidance of fate of the drawn card.[list][*]This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal, and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.[/*][*]The fortune of the reader will be revealed.[/*][/list][/*][*]By [b]Sharing Fate[/b], you grant the guidance of fate to yourself and the allies you have shared the drawn card with.[list][*]You will be prompted to select how many Milletians to share with, up to 7 at rank 1.[/*][*]The drawn card will be held face down above your head, allowing Milletians to receive the fate alongside you. This will last up to 5 minutes at rank 1.[/*][*]Once all of the shared fates have been foretold, or the reader ends sharing, the drawn card will be received and all players will receive the guidance.[/*][*]This will consume 1x Conjuration Crystal for yourself plus an additional 1x Conjuration Crystal per share (up to 8 Crystals to share with 7 Milletians), and place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown.[/*][/list][/*][*]One may also choose to simply [b]Read Fortune[/b].[list][*]This will not consume any Conjuration Crystals, but will still place the ability on a 36 minute cooldown. The guidance of fate will not be granted.[/*][*]The fortune of the reader will be revealed. A daily single card reading can give direction to the unknown, or explore possibilities of the future.[/*][/list][/*][*]Oracle’s Tools and Oracle’s Pavilion have been added to allow you to provide readings for others.[list][*]By using one of these items, the reader will sit, allowing others to take the seat across from them to have their fortunes read.[/*][*]A three-card spread tells of the Past, Present, and Future of a subject.[/*][*]The upright and reversed cards will hold the answers, but we give them meaning.
[list][*](Cards drawn in this way will not place the ability on cooldown, and will have no gameplay effect.)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Cartomancy Tarot Buff List[/b]
[table][tr][th]Card[/th][th]Applied Fate Buff[/th][th]Increased Effect[/th][/tr][tr][td]The Fool[/td][td]Increased Exploration EXP[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Magician[/td][td]Increased Magic Attack damage[/td][td]+35[/td][/tr][tr][td]The High Priestess[/td][td]Increased Movement Speed during Commerce[/td][td]+20%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Empress[/td][td]Increased duration of Harvest Song[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Emperor[/td][td]Increased Critical damage[/td][td]+2%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hierophant[/td][td]Increased chance of receiving a Huge Lucky Bonus[/td][td]+10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Lovers[/td][td]Increased Music Buff effect[/td][td]+2[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Chariot[/td][td]Increased duration of Battlefield Overture[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]Strength[/td][td]Increased Maximum damage[/td][td]+35[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hermit[/td][td]Increased Defense/Magic Defense[/td][td]+20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wheel of Fortune[/td][td]Increased Production success rate[/td][td]+5%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Justice[/td][td]Increased Max HP[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Hanged Man[/td][td]Increased Combat EXP[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]Death[/td][td]Increased number of successful Part-Time Jobs[/td][td]2x[/td][/tr][tr][td]Temperance[/td][td]Increased Movement speed[/td][td]+40%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Devil[/td][td]Increases Max Critical Chance[/td][td]+1%[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Tower[/td][td]Increased Alchemy damage[/td][td]+15[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Star[/td][td]Increase Max MP[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Moon[/td][td]Increased Max Stamina[/td][td]+1000[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Sun[/td][td]Increased duration of Vivace[/td][td]+300 Seconds[/td][/tr][tr][td]Judgement[/td][td]Increased Gathering speed[/td][td]+20[/td][/tr][tr][td]The World[/td][td]Increased Piercing[/td][td]+1[/td][/tr][/table]

Be sure to check out the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/95086/astrologer-part-2-update-patch-notes-january-16th-2025]full Patch Notes[/url][/b][/i]!

notes.title: Holiday Snowball Fight Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1797/241213-wgc-1649-mb-snowballfightevent-940x290.png[/img]
[i]You've experienced the hottest PvP action around, now get ready for the coldest as you partake in a good ol' fashion Snowball Fight! Alongside prizes, your pride is on the line in this team-based control point style game. Take a break from the Masterplan and Astrologer training to enjoy a few rounds... and maybe make a few friends, enemies, and even frenemies.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, December 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 9th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the entire event period, log in to receive the quest [b][Event] Snowball Fight Event[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Holiday Joe[/b] near the Unicorn Statue in Dunbarton to learn more about the event and how to participate.[list][*]Completing the will earn you the following rewards:[list][*]5,000 EXP.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will also receive a daily quest [b][Event] I Wish I Was a Snowballer[/b].[list][*]Complete 5 rounds of the Snowball Event (win or lose) to receive the following rewards:[list][*]AP 5 Potion[/*][*][b]**NEW** Holiday Joe Gift of Gratitude[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Holiday Joe to solo queue for the event; make sure to stay outdoors in Dunbarton to keep your place in queue.[list][*]After [b]16[/b] players have registered, the event will start automatically.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once inside, you'll be divided into two teams of 8 for either Red or Blue Team.[list][*]If you have anything in your Fashion Tab, you'll wear what you currently have on. Otherwise, Holiday Joe will provide you with a snazzy robe suited for the occasion.[/*][/list][/*][*]The goal is to destroy the enemy team's snowman before they destroy yours.[/*][*]Defeating an enemy will earn you gold, which in-turn, spend on items to help turn the tide of battle.[/*][*]There are 2 control nodes located on the map to allow you to spawn closer to the action, as long as you control the node.[/*][*]Once a snowman has been destroyed, the match ends. Be sure to talk to Holiday Joe after to receive your prize![list][*]Members on the winning side will receive a [b]Holiday Joe Gift of Gratitude[/b].[/*][*]Members on the losing side will receive a [b]Holiday Joe Gift Piece[/b].[list][*]Collect 5 pieces to receive a Holiday Joe Gift of Gratitude.[/*][/list][/*][*]To save Milletians from frostbite, if neither team is able to destroy their opponent's snowman after 20 minutes, the team that has dealt the most damage to their opponent's snowman will be declared the winner.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
[i]Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, including our Astrologer - Written in the Stars Update![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94826/master-plan-brilliantly-shining-star][b]Master Plan: Brilliantly Shining Star[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94923/milletian-events-battle-astrologer-update-event][b]Battle Astrologer Update Event[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94811/erinn-beauty-box-2024][b]Erinn Beauty Box 2024[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 12th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, January 9th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94579/otherworldly-guardians-pet-box][b]Otherworldly Guardians Pet Box[/b][/url]: Thursday, December 5th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, February 13th, 2025, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94592/pre-astrologer-check-in-event][b]Pre-Astrologer Check-In Event[/b][/url]: Wednesday, November 27th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, December 26th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/93947/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-6][b]Irusan's Check-In Attendance - Season 6[/b][/url]: Thursday, September 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/b][/url]: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Astrologer Update:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The new Battle Astrologer Talent is here! See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/94832/astrologer-part-1-update][b]update post[/b][/url] for more information![list][*]An all new story! Join Delaney and Neal as they progress in their pilgrimage.[/*][*]New Weapons, Enchants, Upgrades, and more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Additional following changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The number of spirits you can contract has been increased by 2, allowing you to contract up to [b]8[/b] types of Spirit Weapons.[list][*]Eiry the Ancient Spirit is not included in the maximum contractable quantity.[/*][/list][/*][*]You are now able to search and sort your Point Inventory![list][*]You can select your point inventory to display your items in either alphabetical order or by date when you received the item.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1769/point-inventory-search.png[/img]
[list][*]The maximum number of additional equipment slots that can be expanded with Extra Equipment Slot Expansion Coupon will be increased from 12 -> 16.[list][*]Hotkeys for the additional Extra Equipment Slots have also been added under the Hotkey Settings menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1751/ees-expansion.png[/img]
[list][*]The Pet/Partner limit has been increased from 300 to 400.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A "Related Quest" description has been added to item tooltips.[list][*]These will display items that are relevant to Generational Storylines, Arcana Questline, etc.[/*][*]Quest Names are shaded depending on whether the quest has been completed, is in progress, or already completed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1756/quest-relation.png[/img]

How do you feel about them?[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now collect Flint near Pera Volcano through the use of Rain Casting.[/*][*]The following balance adjustments have been implemented:
[list][*][b]Smokescreen[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Rank 1, increased from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.[/*][*]When using Smokescreen on an enemy that is already under the effect, the condition timer will refresh.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Fateweaver[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Level 10, increased from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Death Mark[/b][list][*]The duration of the effect has been increased; for Rank 1 to Dan 3, increased from 15 seconds to 40 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The probability of a rank increase for Precise Reforging Tools, Exquisite Reforging Tools, and Dazzling Reforging Tools has been increased.[list][*]The probability of a rank increase for Precise Reforging Tools will be increased to the same probability as the Exquisite Reforging Tools.[/*][/list][/*][/list][quote][b]【 Developer Comments 】[/b]

Accordingly, in order to alleviate some of the burden of using Reforging Tools, the rank upgrade probability of paid Reforging Tools has been increased. In order to narrow the gap between paid and free reforges, Precise Reforging Tools have been adjusted to have the same probability of being used for rank upgrades as the upgraded Exquisite Reforging Tools.[/i][/quote]

From further unifying Rudolf to Rudolph on a few items, fixes to assorted quest texts, or more- we will always search high and low to improve the script quality for Mabinogi. Thank you, as always, for your reports![/*][*]The suite of Mysterious [Color] Bags have been renamed slightly in the following format:[list][*]Mysterious Horizontal Green Bag (10x17) -> Mysterious Green Bag (10x17) - Horizontal[/*][/list][*]After an unfortunate mix-up, Edern and Gleywas have demanded that the versatile Kraken Sucker be labeled appropriately. The following items have been renamed:[list][*]The Kraken Sucker for Blacksmithing purposes will be named Fierce Kraken Sucker.[/*][*]The Kraken Sucker for Cooking purposes will be named Fresh Kraken Sucker.[/*][/list][*]The following since-removed event items have had their slots removed from the Chair section of the Dressing Room.[list][*]Beginner's/Journeyman's/Professional's Mannequin (event) [/*][/list][*]The visibility of the Spellwalk glyph has been improved, allowing one to better see another's glyphs and the changed visuals from their Effect Change Cards.[/*][*][b]Milletians that have been trade-blocked due to their first Item Shop purchase will be able to drop Storyline items to enter dungeons unimpeded.[/b][/*][*]Fixed an issue causing Spirit of Tuan pets to miss their rhythm. Whisper of Tuan will properly increase Music skill duration every time.[/*][*]Condensed Strength Fragment: One-handed Blunt Weapon has been added to Gillach's Shop.[/*][*]Unusable items involving the removed Bonita Twin Ribbon (Handicraft) recipe will no longer drop.[list][*]Ruined Bonita Twin Ribbon[/*][*]Bonita Twin Ribbon Repair Kit[/*][/list][*]Slight adjustments to various UIs to better accommodate text. Most notably the chat text for Direct Messages and Altruism's Quest Chat Room will no longer be cut off by the window.[/*][*]The text for Grandmaster Mage Unique Effect now properly indicates that you need a Magic Weapon equipped.[/*][*]The male hairstyle Parted Long Hair has been renamed to Regal Parted Long Hair.[/*][*]A prankster in the Royal Court swapped the ink used for naming Tara Banquet Tables with an invisible brand, causing chaos as nobody knew where to sit! More fine ink has been imported, and tables will once again be able to be named.[/*][*]The skill description of the Ninja skill Smokescreen has been clarified to better describe its effect.[/*][h2][*][i]#fixedtailchasers[/i][/*][/h2]

[h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be purchased on the Web Shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][/list]
