notes.title: Producer's Letter: End of 2024 Upcoming Content
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]Dear Milletians,

Happy 20th Anniversary, Mabinogi! While only 16 years for us, Mabinogi itself has celebrated its 20 year anniversary just recently in June with the 2024 Fantasy Party. Community Manager Arciellia and I traveled to Korea to attend and celebrate this wondrous and momentous occasion! Today I want to talk about our trip with you, as well as share more details about some upcoming content we can expect to see soon.

At the Fantasy Party event, through rain, sweat, and tears– the feelings of excitement, love, and past memories bubbled to the surface. 16 Years of Mabinogi for me and you. There is such a level of nostalgia and happiness that comes from experiencing new content for the first time. A plethora of new adventures and memories to make together, and a moment of reflection on memories past. It is my greatest excitement to be preparing and working with the developers at this stage of Mabinogi. [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/eternity/]Mabinogi Eternity[/url] is a dream come true. The concept of a new Erinn, a fresh rebirth for our world, new moments to discover together. Hearing the crowd of rain-soaked Milletians cheering for each trailer touched my heart and brought such a glittering reverie to me about how far we’ve come and the future of Mabinogi.

With each new update, as dazzling as the [b]upcoming Astrologer talent[/b], and with every new Eternity blog, video, or screenshot, the dream becomes drawn more clearly. Adorable outfits, electrifying skill effects, smooth animations, rain, cute animals… these are only a few of the beautifully detailed elements that have been showcased lately, and I can’t wait to see even more come to fruition. My team and I are definitely still awaiting the happenings of Eternity – including, how will it go? [i]Maintenances, updates, events? So much to prepare, I’m sure…![/i]

While abroad, we also had the opportunity to visit the Nexon Korea office. Immediately I could feel a love for Mabinogi built by passions, challenges, and everything in between. The joy I felt walking sleek modern hallways, decorated with all the character cutouts for Mabinogi, figurines, wall prints, and the rows of office desks with Mabinogi peeking behind open documents on computer screens. As a long-time Milletian myself, it gave me surreal feelings that I will surely hold dear to my heart as a core memory!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1763/kr-trip-image.png[/img]
In our meetings with the Development Team, we discussed various game updates and intentions behind the changes. Discussing changes that we’d like to see based off of your suggestions, our organic discussions in-game and out, and through all of the shared comments we’ve read throughout the year was my main intention. We are continuously focusing on what our community would like to see and how we could represent the best vision of Mabinogi. While we adjust our strategy to explore Eternity, it is a chance to learn about how we can evolve our longstanding game through a modern lens while still keeping the charm we adore.

With an abundance of game updates already released this year, there have been many contents to play, but there are still many to look forward to! Realistically, game updates come with challenges we must endure: from the many bugfixes for both new and existing contents, lengthy text polishing and UI reorganization, to web integrations, these items take time and energy. The Mabinogi Team has encountered more than just sunshine and rainbows but I believe in my team wholeheartedly and they have proved that whether rain or shine, passion and excitement outshines those difficulties.

For the second half of 2024, we first focused on providing a new and improved combat experience through adjustments to our existing combat content. These improvements include a significant rebalance of the Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana talents, as well as a new Elite difficulty for Glenn Bearna. We also wanted to freshen up older content and make it accessible to a larger audience, which you'll have a chance to experience for yourself in both the revamped Fahmes Ruin dungeon and the upcoming release of the Royal Artisan system.

Lastly in winter, we want to provide a new talent, '[b]Astrologer[/b]' to you, Milletians, who are the shining stars of Mabinogi, who can become anything and express mastery of all talents. Of course, you cannot miss out on the various events you can expect as well!

We’ve prepared an exciting infographic to share all of the soon to be expected content updates. I hope you enjoy a glimpse of what’s to come.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1632/mb-2024-2025-q1-roadmap-infographic-v5.png[/img]
Additionally, I’d like to share the video we’ve put together to celebrate Mabinogi’s 20th Anniversary in Korea. ✨

[previewyoutube=7dz48Zcev5E;full][/previewyoutube]
MabiNerd also produced a creative documentary piece to share the experience. We love this video and it was such a joy and honor to have him join us on a truly Mabi-filled adventure. 💗

[previewyoutube=qI7CFpdpZRw;full][/previewyoutube]
I also want to give a shoutout to our Milletians who made it out to the Mabinogi Mag Mell Mixer event that we held in July this year. We’d love to organize more opportunities to meet in the future. Thank you for your support in person and in spirit! ☀️

[previewyoutube=7fpjtOUULQQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for continuing to give Mabinogi a place in your heart. Collectively, we have millions of moments that play on in our minds and many more awaiting us.

Until next time,
[b]~ GM Mewlynne, a Milletian who Wishes to see the Stars
Mabinogi Producer[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1768/mewprodletter.png[/img]

[i]Mewlynne gazes at the stars, visualizing new magics. Her speciality hones that of frost, [/i]
[i]Before her eyes, she sees the electric pulse of energy awaiting her next move.[/i]

notes.title: September Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1698/240829-wgc-1400-mb-septemberupdate-940x290.png[/img]
[h1][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.png[/img] Elemental Knight Skill Changes [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.png[/img][/h1][list][*]The Link Bonus effect has been improved.[/*][list][*]At [b]Link Level 10[/b], you can now use all 3 Elemental Instillments simultaneously.[/*][/list][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.png[/img][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.png[/img][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png[/img] [b]All Instillments[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Instillments will deactivate if either your Mana or Stamina are exhausted and will reactivate again when both are above 100.[/*][*]When multiple Elemental Instillments are activated, the consumption rate will increase based on how many Instillments are active.[/*][*]The Minimum and Maximum Damage effects now stack when multiple Elemental Instillments are activated.[/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.png[/img] [b]Instill Flame[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have [b]increased[/b] for most skill ranks.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on various ranks of the Skill:[list][*]Rank F: +1.1% (0.5% → 1.6%)[/*][*]Rank 2: +0.4% (2.5% → 2.9%)[/*][*]Rank 1: No Change (3% → 3%)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.png[/img] [b]Instill Frost[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have [b]decreased[/b] for each skill rank.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on various ranks of the Skill:[list][*]Rank F: -0.4% (1.0% → 0.6%)[/*][*]Rank 1: -3.0% (5% → 2%)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png[/img] [b]Instill Thunder[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have [b]changed[/b] for each skill rank.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on various ranks of the Skill:[list][*]Rank F: +2.6% (1% → 3.6%)[/*][*]Rank 1: -1.0% (6% → 5%)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1574/blazing-assault-slash.png[/img] Blazing Assault Slash[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1:[list][*]Instill Flame: 400% Additional Damage[/*][*]Instill Frost: Reduce’s target’s Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 20% for 5 seconds.[/*][*]Instill Thunder: Pulls all stricken enemies to the target’s location[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1590/shattering-windmill.png[/img] [b]Shattering Windmill[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Damage Calculations have been [b]changed[/b].
[list][*][b]Before:[/b] Windmill Rank Damage + Base Damage +  Additional Damage after Frozen Effect ends.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1:[list][*]Windmill Rank Damage + 300% of Base Damage + 1200% After Frozen Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After: Windmill Rank Damage + Increased Base Damage.[/b][list][*][b][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1:[/b][list][*][b]Windmill Rank Damage + 1500% of Base Damage.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1:[list][*]Instill Flame: 450% Additional Damage[/*][*]Instill Frost: Attack Radius +2 meters[/*][*]Instill Thunder: 500% Damage to Enemies every 2 seconds for 5 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 10 seconds.[/*][*][b]Increased the duration of frozen enemies at higher ranks.[/b][list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 5 to 1:[list][*]Ranks 5-2: 4 seconds[/*][*]Rank 1: 5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The duration of the Frozen Status effect now resets when Shattering Windmill is used again while the target is still frozen.[/*][/list]
[h3] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1578/dynavolt-smash.png[/img] Dynavolt Smash[/b] [/h3]
[list][*][b]Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.[/b][list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1:[list][*]Instill Flame: 600% Additional Damage[/*][*]Instill Frost: 1200% Additional Damage to Enemies frozen by Shattering Windmill[/*][*]Instill Thunder: Attack Width +2 meters; Attack Length +5 meters[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][quote=Developer]【 Developer Comments 】

To create a better play pattern and play experience, the development team decided to allow simultaneous use of [b]Instill Element[/b], granting Elemental Knights the benefits of all three Instillments (Flame, Frost, Thunder) at once. Additionally, the additional effects that each Instillment grants to the primary skills ([b]Blazing Assault Slash[/b], [b]Shattering Windmill[/b], [b]Dynavolt Smash[/b]) have been modified to increase the link between skills as well as to provide utility and benefits to individual skills, such as increased attack range and pulling enemies inward.

As we are increasing the power of [b]Instill Element[/b], the upkeep cost (Mana, Stamina) will increase when multiple Instillments are activated. Our intention is that players will consider their situation and increased upkeep cost, selecting which and how many Instillments to use accordingly, rather than having all three elements up at all times. Each additionally applied Instillment will grant further increased damage, so we have adjusted the damage increase granted by each element.[/quote]
[h1][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.png[/img] Harmonic Saint Skill Changes [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.png[/img][/h1][list][*]The Link Bonus effects have been improved at the following levels:[list][*][b]Link Level 6[/b][list][*][b]Warmth of Life[/b] is now granted to the caster when allies are standing in Pulse of Purification’s area of effect.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Link Level 8[/b][list][*]A new [b]Veil of Life[/b] effect is applied when healing an ally or self with [b]Hand of Restoration[/b] or [b]Echoes of Salvation[/b].[list][*]Veil of Life converts healing into a shield at the default healing amount when a player is at full health with no wounds.[/*][*]The Veil of Life condition lasts for 60 seconds or when the shield has been exhausted, whichever comes first.[/*][*]The Veil of Life will reduce incoming damage by 50%.[/*][*]Those under the effect of Veil of Life will be immune to most knockback and stun.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Link Level 9[/b][list][*]Pulse of Purification no longer recovers HP and Wounds for allies within range by 160 upon inflicting damage to enemies.[list][*]Now grants Warmth of Life at Link Level 6.[/*][/list][/*][*]Grants Music Buff +3[/*][*]Pulse of Purification Radius +3 meters[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1579/echos-of-salvation.png[/img] [b]Echoes of Salvation[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]Now heals wounds for each skill rank:[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on various ranks of the Skill:[list][*]Rank F: +100 Wound Recovery[/*][*]Rank 1: +250 Wound Recovery[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]MP and Stamina recovery are now instantaneous rather than increased recovery speed.[/*][*]Additional MP and Stamina recovery based on the Rank of Enduring Melody’s recovery speed.[/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1591/voice-of-vitality.png[/img] [b]Voice of Vitality[/b] [/h3]
[list][*][b]Voice of Vitality’s Effect will now remain even when incapacitated.[/b][/*][/list]
[h3] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1575/blessing-of-protection.png[/img] Blessing of Protection[/b] [/h3]
[list][*][b]If the health of an ally or self is below 10% or in Deadly status, casting Blessing of Protection will now restore health up to 10%.[/b][/*][/list]
[h3] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1589/pulse-of-purification.png[/img] [b]Pulse of Purification[/b][/b] [/h3]
[list][*]The usage method for the skill has been changed so that you can click the area that you wish to cast the skill.[/*][*]Numerous changes have been made for each rank.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1.[list][*]Deals 3,000 Magic Damage/second to enemies within the skill’s radius.[/*][*]Restores 200 HP, MP, and Stamina per second.[/*][*]Grants Stun and Knockdown Immunity to allies within the skill’s radius.[/*][*]Deals an additional 10,800 Magic Damage after the skill ends to any enemies remaining in the skill’s radius.[/*][/list][/*][*]Casting Time has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second.[/*][*]Cooldown has been drastically reduced from 360 seconds to 60 seconds.[/*][*]Now only consumes Mana upon use.[/*][*]The skill can now be canceled by using the skill again while activated.[/*][*]The skill’s Piercing Effect has been removed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Visibility of the Skill’s Effect has been enhanced.[/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1588/polyphonic-melody.png[/img] [b]Polyphonic Melody[/b] [/h3]
[list][*]A [b]new skill[/b] acquired upon reaching Level 3 of Harmonic Saint.[/*][*]Provides a chance for the next use of [b]Enduring Melody[/b], [b]March Song[/b], or [b]Harvest Song[/b] to stack with other Musical Buffs.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on various ranks of the Skill:[list][*]Rank F: 30% Strength of Buff[/*][*]Rank 9: 60% Strength of Buff[/*][*]Rank 5: 80% Strength of Buff[/*][*]Rank 1: 100% Strength of Buff[/*][/list][/*][*]Only 2 Musical Buffs can be active at the same time.[/*][*]You are unable to stack the same Musical Buff.[/*][/list][/*][/list][quote]【 Developer Comments 】

[b]Harmonic Saint[/b] has been modified to maintain its role as party support. Some of the less meaningful Arcana Link effects have been adjusted, and a brand new effect [b]Veil of Life[/b] has been added into Link Level 8. [b]Hand of Restoration[/b] and [b]Echoes of Salvation[/b] are powerful heals, but are limited to only healing missing health, so it can be difficult to respond immediately to every situation. With Link Level 8, [b]Veil of Life[/b] will activate when healing those with full health, and provide an additional shield proportional to the strength of the heal cast. This effect will allow Harmonic Saints to apply preemptive support.

When considering that higher difficulty dungeons require more active play, the development team decided to allow continuous party support even while using [b]Pulse of Purification[/b]. We felt this would allow for a more positive and synergistic experience. Additionally, by reducing the immediate damage output of the skill and supplementing it with a highly reduced cooldown and a party member support effect, Harmonic Saints will be able to leverage [b]Pulse of Purification[/b] more often in combat. We hope you enjoy it!

Lastly, a new skill, [b]Polyphonic Melody[/b], has been added to increase the Harmonic Saint's contribution to the party. However, we have found that with Share Music Buffs settings, the best possible buff combination would be different for various talents, and some talents may not be able to fully benefit from such situations or require different combinations from others, causing those talents to be less favored in parties. Thus, we decided to limit the songs that can be activated with the [b]Polyphonic Melody[/b] to [b]Enduring Melody[/b], [b]March Song[/b], and [b]Harvest Song[/b] to allow each member of the party to benefit from the buff effects while keeping the Harmonic Saint's party contribution ability intact.[/quote]
[h1]Non-Arcana Skill Changes[/h1]
[h3] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1595/smash.png[/img] Normal Attack/Smash[/b]
[list][*]Enemies who have Counterattack loaded and are not the intended target will not trigger its use nor be affected by the attack splash.[/*][/list][/h3]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1593/bash.png[/img] [b]Bash[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Stacks now decrease by 1 instead of all stacks when the retention timer ends.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the skill could not be used on enemies in Finish State.[/*][/list]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1594/rage-impact.png[/img] [b]Rage Impact[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Now accounts for sizes of enemies when measuring distance.[/*][*]Enemies hit by Rage Impact now have the debuff applied to them for the entire duration.[/*][*]Debuff duration decreased from 10 seconds to 7 seconds.[/*][*]Melee Attack Bonus Damage has been decreased at all ranks.[list][*]Example: Based on Rank 1:[list][*]Reduced from 50% to 15%.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Glyphs with the Rage Impact Skill augment have had the Melee Attack Bonus Damage reduced from 1% to 0.3% per level.[/*][*]Imperial Knight Gloves have[/*][/list][quote]【 Developer Comments 】

[b]Rage Impact[/b] previously would increase the strength of the next melee attack’s damage after it was applied onto a target. However, when factoring in party play, it was very likely that this effect would be consumed unintentionally, making it difficult to fully utilize this damage increase. 

To resolve this, we modified the effect from the skill. Targets affected by [b]Rage Impact[/b] will now take increased damage from all melee attacks during its duration. In order to keep this balanced, we have adjusted the duration and damage increase. 

We have also adjusted the [b]Rage Impact[/b] enhancement effects to match this change. Like Rage Impact, the damage multiplier for the enhancements have decreased, but will now apply for all melee damage applied during the duration. We expect this to increase synergistic use in combat.[/quote]
[h3] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1592/musical-knowledge.png[/img] [b]Musical Knowledge[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The chances of performing Excellent and Inspiring Performances have been increased at higher ranks.[/*][/list]
[h1]Fahmes Ruin[/h1]
After 4 months of renovation, Fahmes Ruin Dungeon is open to Milletians once more!
[list][*]Fahmes Ruin Dungeon has been added to the Dungeon Guide.[list][*]New UI has been added to allow you to teleport directly to the Dungeon Entrance.[/*][*]Clicking the Ruin Stone will open Fahmes page in the Dungeon Guide UI.[/*][/list][/*][*]The dungeon is restricted to Milletians level 5,000 or higher.[/*][*]The dungeon consists of 6 Stages with 5 Floors each for a total of 30 Floors.[list][*]Each floor consists of 3 waves of mobs that can be triggered at any time.[/*][*]You will be given the choice of one “Stage Buff” upon entering the stage.[list][*]Bonus Damage +15%[/*][*]Movement Speed +30% & Protection/Magic Protection +100%[/*][*]Auto-Revival x3[/*][*]Bachram Speed +500%[/*][/list][/*][*]The ranking system has been reworked for bragging rights only.[/*][*]Monthly Rewards have been updated.[list][*]The monthly rewards will be reset with the 1st Thursday of each month at 7:00 AM (Server Time).[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A star reward system has been implemented.[list][*]You can earn up to 3 stars per floor through the following conditions:[list][*]Complete the Floor.[/*][*]Complete the Floor in under 3 minutes.[/*][*]Complete the Floor in under 1 minute.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can earn new Journal Achievements and one-time rewards.[list][*]The Journal Achievements will be awarded to all characters on your account.[/*][*]The star rewards are once per account.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]**NEW**[/b] Rewards include:[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1752/fahmes-ruins-1.png[/img][list][*]Homestead Stamina Fahmes Ruin Figure[list][*]+100 Stamina[/*][/list][/*][*]Homestead MP Fahmes Ruin Figure[list][*]+100 MP[/*][/list][/*][*]Homestead HP Fahmes Ruin Figure[list][*]+100 HP[/*][/list][/*][*]Homestead Patience Fahmes Ruin Figure[list][*]+1 Defense[/*][*]+1 Protection[/*][*]+1 Magic Defense[/*][*]+1 Magic Protection[/*][/list][/*][*]Homestead Courage Fahmes Ruin Figure[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1754/fahmes-ruins-2-v2.png[/img][list][*]+2 Defense[/*][*]+2 Protection[/*][*]+2 Magic Defense[/*][*]+2 Magic Protection[/*][/list][/*][*]Homestead Rage Fahmes Ruin Figure[list][*]+3 Defense[/*][*]+3 Protection[/*][*]+3 Magic Defense[/*][*]+3 Magic Protection[/*][/list][/*][*]Fahmes Ruin Copper/Silver/Gold Coin[/*][*]Rest Skill Animation Card
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1736/mewlynne-rest.gif[/img][/*][*]Champion of Fahmes Ruin 2nd Title Coupon [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1737/fahmes-champion-2nd-title.png[/img][list][*]+12 Defense[/*][*]+11 Protection[/*][*]+14 Magic Defense[/*][*]+8 Magic Protection[/*][*]+3% Movement Speed[/*][/list][/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1741/fahmes-champion-title-effect.gif[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h1]Fantasy Life Changes[/h1]
[h3][b]Blacklisting[/b][/h3]
The Blacklist system has been updated.
[list][*]The Blacklist system is now separate from the friend list and has been moved to the Options.[list][*]Settings → Game → Chat → Blacklist Setting[/*][*]Blacklisted players in your Friends list will be moved to the Blacklist Settings list.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Blacklist capacity has been increased from 60 to 300.[/*][*]When a player has been Blacklisted:[list][*]Their character model will not be visible on screen.[/*][*]Direct Messages and Notes will not be received.[/*][*]Sound Effects are not heard.[/*][*]Their Demigod Form will not be visible.[/*][*]Props and Chairs set up will not be visible on screen.[/*][*]Their PvP requests will be automatically rejected/ignored.[list][*]It is still possible to be hit by a Blacklisted player in EvG/PvDK however.[/*][/list][/*][*]Their conversation and speech bubbles will not be visible.[/*][*]Marriage Proposals are automatically ignored.[/*][*]Couple Link Effects will not be visible. (i.e. Rose Couples Bracelet)[/*][*]The option to request becoming the player’s Soulmate will not be available (during Doki Doki Event).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3] [b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The reward selection panel has been updated.[list][*]You can now select the quantity.[/*][/list][/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1744/qol-change-1.png[/img][/*][/list]

notes.title: Developer's Note: Moonlight Island Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Milletians!

Greetings from the Mabinogi Development Team,

Last week saw the debut of the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/93161/g26-winds-of-fate-part-2-moonlight-island-update]Moonlight Island update[/url][/b], bringing a whole new dimension of fun to Milletians.

Moonlight Island is Mabinogi's newest life content, allowing players to create and customize their very own Island, invite visitors to become residents, and continue to grow and expand the Island by using their islanders' skills to good use.

The development team has analyzed ways in which we might make Moonlight Island more enjoyable and accessible for everyone. After much discussion, we have included the following updates:

[h3][b]Improving the Starter Guide[/b][/h3]
Moonlight Island is an expansive and multifaceted offering, especially considering that it adds a variety of resources and vectors for growth. We decided it would be beneficial to improve how the game better explains those systems to players and expand access to the materials needed to help one's Island grow in its early stages. By doing this, we hoped it would help players to not only understand everything Moonlight Island has to offer, but get them off to a good start in developing their Islands.

The best way to accomplish this was to enhance Moonlight Island's tutorial questline.

Reviewing our existing material, we've made revisions to help walk you through the different systems available on Moonlight Island. It is our hope that the addition of step-by-step Guide Quests, which award Moonlight Island materials, will provide a supportive foundation to help you become more familiar with Island growth.

Lastly, we've added Amelia, a brand-new NPC ready to greet you on Moonlight Island. Amelia has plenty of help to offer, running you through Moonlight Island's systems and offering a variety of items for use on the Island in her shop.

[h3][b]Reducing the Difficulty of Island Growth and Management[/b][/h3]
Our aim with Moonlight Island was to give players a fun experience as they settle on their Island, complete with residents, using the skill points earned from growth to customize the attributes of Island and Islanders alike.

To help Milletians enjoy the excitement of populating their Island sooner, we decided that we needed to ease up on the requirements for the initial stages of growth. We've reduced the EXP needed to level up the Island and the Islanders to accomplish that.

We understood that the time and the cost of managing Moonlight Island were somewhat high. As a result, we've made it easier for your Islander’s production activities by making adjustments to several elements that could be exhausting or costly.

[h3][b]Increasing the Accessibility of Island-styling Elements[/b][/h3]
One of the most engaging and captivating features of Moonlight Island is that you can expand the Island and reshape its terrain to your liking. Landscape Essences are required to make alterations to the terrain, and we've made them available not only through the guide quests I mentioned earlier, but in Amelia's Shop as well.

Also, since we expected players might initially find it challenging to obtain the Moonlight Island Special Production Materials necessary to expand their Islands, we lowered the requirements for the first stage of Island expansion, making it easier for more Milletians to reach that momentous milestone.

[h3][b]Celebrated the Update With a Boost Event[/b][/h3]
We held a two-week celebration boost event to celebrate the launch of the Moonlight Island update and helped every Milletian get their Island off to a great start.

During the event, Amelia's Shop sold some of the Moonlight Island Special Production items that bolstered your combat abilities, which allowed you to try them out until enough Milletians improved their Islands enough to start crafting them. In addition, to help ensure you had plenty of items to customize your Moonlight Island, Amelia's Shop sold Amelia's Homestead Boxes, which contained one of the many Homestead furnishings.

During the event period, EXP acquired from Moonlight Island Production increased for both the Island and Islanders alike, and you saw increased chances for visitors to drop by your Moonlight Island.

It's our hope that your beautifully decorated Moonlight Island will become a beloved place you can go to relax, and we'll continue listening to your feedback and making improvements as we go.

The detailed guide page below contains additional information about Moonlight Island and its features.

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/93118/moonlight-island-guide][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1266/240802-wgc-1291-mb-moonlight-island-guide-940x290-v2.png[/img][/url]

As always, we'll continue striving to create a more enjoyable environment for every player, working hard to make you proud to be a Milletian.

Thank you.

[i]- The Mabinogi Development Team –[/i]

notes.title: [Notice] Aug. 8 Account Sanctions
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

In our recent [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/93162/g26-winds-of-fate-part-2-moonlight-island-patch-notes-august-8th-2024][b]August patch[/b][/url], we noted that an exploit involving Treasure Chest Keys had been fixed and was under further investigation. During this investigation, we have found numerous accounts that have rampantly abused this method to gain an abnormal amount of rewards from Glenn Bearna, exploiting the issue multiple times. These accounts will be facing immediate bans, ranging from permanent to temporary, based on the severity that they abused this issue.
[list][*]63 players will be facing immediate bans of varying lengths based on the severity at which they've abused the exploit. Accounts that have had leniency placed upon them for prior offenses are subject to stronger punitive action[/*][/list]
While we cannot disclose specific details of the bans directly, if you have any questions regarding your account, please submit a ticket to [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us][b]Player Support[/b][/url]. As a reminder, use of and discussion of exploits are against Mabinogi's [url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/legal/tou][b]Terms of Service[/b][/url].

Thank you for your understanding.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: G26 Winds of Fate Part 2 + Moonlight Island Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1276/240729_augustupdate_socials_newsarticlefooter_940x290.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h1]Winds of Fate[/h1]
[i]Search for traces of Delga and the Divine Beasts on the continent of Iria. To plot your course, Aine and her companions turn to old, faded writings they've collected to guide them![/i]
[list][*][b]Generation 26 - Winds of Fate - Part 2[/b] has been added.[/*][*]Players who have completed Generation 26 Part 1 will automatically receive the quest [b]The Open Door[/b].[list][*]After completing Generation 26, you can talk to the Researcher next to the Poulnabrone in Dunbarton to receive a copy of the [b]Winds of Fate Collection Book[/b] for your Mabinovel.[/*][*]Completing Generation 26 will award the player with one of the following titles based on their choices during the story:[list][*]who Seeks to Bring Order[/*][*]who Strives for a Better Life[/*][*]who Dreams of a New World[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]G26 Winds of Fate Clear Reward Box[/b] has been added and is awarded after completion of Generation 26 - Part 2.
[list][*]Use the item to receive an invitation for Roisin to appear in your Moonlight Island.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/93118/moonlight-island-guide][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1266/240802-wgc-1291-mb-moonlight-island-guide-940x290-v2.png[/img][/b][/url]
[hr][/hr][h1]Moonlight Island[/h1]
[list][*][b]Moonlight Island has been added.[/b][list][*]Players who have a Homestead created will receive the quest [b][Guide] Moonlighting in Island Development[/b] upon log-in.[/*][/list][/*][*]The existing Homestead Hotkey (Default: “U”) has been updated to a new menu/UI.[list][*]Information and Activity regarding both the Milletian’s Moonlight Island and Homestead will be visible through the new menu.[/*][*]Players will be able to enter both their Homestead and Moonlight Island through the new menu.[/*][*]The [b]Weekly Island Spotlight[/b] will feature a highly active Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the week.[/*][*][b]Today’s Islander[/b] will randomly select a resident of a random Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the day.[/*][/list][/*][*]Islanders will visit your Moonlight Island![list][*]Each day, a new Visitor will visit your island.[list][*]Islanders can be invited to stay on your island through the use of a [b]Resident Invitation[/b], obtained after completing a Visitor's quest and tasks.[/*][/list][/*][*]Islanders can produce unique materials through various activities and facilities through Moonlight Island.[list][*]Doing such activities will spend a Islander’s endurance.[/*][*]An Islander’s endurance can be restored by gifting food, certain items, leveling up your Island, or naturally over time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Milletians can help their Residents grow by ranking their skills and abilities.[list][*]Certain abilities require Resident Journals, which can be obtained from spare Resident Invitations you acquire.[/*][/list][/*][*]Residents can also be removed from the island.[list][*]Any time, effort, and journals used to rank the resident’s abilities will not be refunded.[/*][/list][/*][*]Milletians may dress their Residents with outfits and weapons.[list][*]Effects from certain outfits will not trigger (e.g. Patron Wear).[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Certain Tuatha de Dannan will also visit your Moonlight Island.[list][*]These noticeable characters will assist you with your Island when visiting through special shops, gifts, or buffs.[/*][*]You will need to complete Generation 26 - Part 2 in order to have them visit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The ability to alter the landscape on Moonlight Island with Terrain Change Mode has been added.[/*][*]A new "Moonlight Island" Tab in Quests (Default: "Q") has been dedicated to all Moonlight Island quests.[/*][*][b]Read more about Moonlight Island in the dedicated [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/93118/moonlight-island-guide]Moonlight Island Guide[/url]![/b]
[i](Available after the update goes live!)[/i][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Bugles[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A cooldown of 30 seconds has been applied to all Bugles.
[list][*]When attempting to use a bugle within this cooldown, you will receive an error message.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[b]Curious to know what else was added? Be sure to check out the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/92712/g26-winds-of-fate-part-1-patch-notes-july-11th-2024]full Patch Notes[/url][/b]![/b]
[i](Available after the update goes live!)[/i]

notes.title: Connous Beach Vacation Event 2024
notes.content:
Catch some rays at the Connous Beach! Log in each day and get a mixed drink from Hafgan on the house. Now's your time to play some of the mini-games for Magical Pieces and other useful dye ampoules! Check out the details below.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1619/drinkies.png[/img]
[Update 2:15 PM Aug 8]: We're aware that purchasable items from Hafgan's Vacation Shop are not populating properly if you've previously purchased the product in past event periods. 
The team is looking into this and will share further information when the issue is resolved! Thank you for your patience.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, August 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 5th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Time To Chill[/b].[/*][*]Log in during the event period to receive the [b]Orange[/b] [b]Wings of the Goddess[/b] to travel to the [b]Connous Beach Metallurgy Site.[/b][/*][*][b]Event NPCs and props have been moved to the plaza in [b]Port Connous[/b].[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Hafgan[/b] located inside the[b] Tropical Orange Drink Stand.[/b][/*][*]Once you register your main character, you will receive a [b]cocktail[/b] and a [b]Vacation Box[/b].[/*][*]Once [Guide] A Time To Chill has been completed, you will receive the following rewards:[/*][list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][b]
[/b][/*][/list][*]Talk to Hafgan each day to receive a [b]cocktail[/b] and a [b]Vacation Box.[/b][/*][*]You will receive a different cocktail each day:[/*][list][*]Monday: [b]June Bug [/b](Instantly grants 500% of EXP needed)[/*][*]Tuesday: [b]Cosmopolitan x3[/b] (Recover full HP, MP, Stamina, and Wounds)[/*][*]Wednesday: [b]Mojito[/b] (Gain 50 AP)[/*][*]Thursday: [b]Martini[/b] (Increase EXP by 35% after Resting for 36 min. Lasts for 3 days)[/*][*]Friday: [b]Blue Hawaii [/b](Rewards from clearing a Shadow Mission will be increased by 360%)[/*][*]Saturday: [b]Pina Colada x3[/b] (Increase Movement Speed by 40%)[/*][*]Sunday: [b]Long Island Iced Tea[/b] (All Skill Training EXP x2)[/*][/list][*]These are event versions of existing consumables and will not stack with their non-event versions. For example, the Long Island Iced Tea item will not stack with a Complete Skill EXP Potion.[/*][/list]

[b]The G26 Winds of Fate Part 1 Update:[/b]
[list][*]Part 1 of the [b]Chapter 8: Generation 26 "Winds of Fate" Update[/b] is here! See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/92969/g26-winds-of-fate-part-1-update]G26 Winds of Fate Part 1[/url][/b][list][*]Brand-new Generation quests featuring new NPCs![/*][*]Improvements to the Auction House search function![/*][*]Addition of a durability indicator for your equipment's durability![/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]

Why would anyone want to destroy his picture diary containing adorable drawings and clumsy handwriting?[/*][*]Lovely Pan Bag will now properly display dye colors.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]

[list][*]Thunderbird[/*][*]Barbegazi[/*][*]Ifrit[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game throughout June:[/b]

Following this update, the correct amount of Max Attack will be granted.[/*][*]The following Springtime Clean Sweep Event items can now be listed on the Auction House:[list][*]Homestead Large Flowerpot Set[/*][*]Homestead Small Flowerpot Set[/*][/list][/*][*]News reaches Tir Chonaill a little slower than the rest of Erinn--Duncan and Trefor now know how Part-Time Jobs work post-update.[/*][*]Fixed a displacement issue with certain skill functions.[list][*]Following the update to Bash, it was possible to use a combination of skills to have Milletians move to unintended places. In order to prevent this, the movement on Fencing Attack 1 and 2 has been removed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Milletian Events: Black Combo Card Event
notes.content:
[i]Psst, you. Yes, you. Move 3 steps to the right and act natural. Secret Agent Joe as a special training mission for you. Can you handle it? He's willing to provide you with a Black Combo Card if you do. This message will self-destruct on August 15th. More info is below.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Black Combo Card Event[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, July 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 15th, Before Maintenance[/b]

[h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Black Combo Card[/b].[/*][*]Talk to a particularly inconspicuous [b]Special Agent Joe[/b] in the Dunbarton Town Square. [/*][*]Register a main character with Special Agent Joe.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Black Combo Card:[list][*][b]5,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Incomplete Black Combo Card[/b][/*][*][b]Black Combo Card Special Mission Pass[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b].[/*][*]When the event ends, all event quests and event items will be deleted (Incomplete Black Combo Card, Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission Pass, Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons).[list][*][b]Note[/b]: All Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons registered in the Auction House will be deleted. Please collect all proceeds from sales before the maintenance. Unreceived sales proceeds will not be recovered and instead donated to pay for Ferghus' blacksmithing classes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h3][b]Special Agent Joe's Special Training[/b][/h3][list][*]You will receive the daily quest, [b][Event] Black Combo Card Special Mission[/b].[list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Black Combo Card Special Mission Pass x2[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Use the Black Combo Card Special Mission Pass and complete the mission. To enter the mission, right-click "Use" on the pass.[list][*]You are able to choose the difficulty level for the mission.
[list][*][b]Beginner[/b] is about the same as the Hard Shadow Missions.
[/*][*][b]Normal [/b]is about the same as the Elite Shadow Missions.
[/*][*][b]Advanced [/b]is as hard as Tech Duinn Missions.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can earn a maximum of 90 Black Combo Card Points per day.[list][*]You will earn 30 Black Combo Card Points for clearing 1 mission, regardless of difficulty level.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can enter this mission 5 times a day.
[list][*]Entering the mission will count towards the limit, regardless if you succeed or fail the mission.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can complete this mission with a party of up to 4 people.[list][*]Our intel recommends entering with a full party of 4 to maximize your chance at success.[/*][/list][/*][*]When completing this mission, you will receive [b]EXP[/b], [b]Gold[/b], and a [b]Treasure Chest Key[/b] depending on the difficulty level.
[list][*]The treasure chest will grant a random potion, leather/silk/fabric, and [b]Skill Combo Card Fragment[/b] of a Talent.
[/*][*]The higher the difficulty of the mission, the more Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Combo Card Exchange Coupons you will receive.
[list][*]Combine 10 Skill Combo Card Fragments of the same Talent to receive a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon for that talent.
[/*][/list][/*][*]The mission consists of 5 waves of Caravan Joe and his cousins... we think. This intel we've been told is unconfirmed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h3][b]Special Agent Joe's Dispatch Commission[/b][/h3][list][*]After participating in Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission once for the day, the [b]Dispatch Commission[/b] option will become available.[/*][*]Exchange one Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission Pass and 300,000 Gold to receive the rewards from Advanced difficulty immediately, and 30 Combo Points (up to the limit of 90 points per day).[/*][*]The daily Event Mission entry count will be reduced by 1, and cannot exceed the daily mission limit of 5 missions per day.[/*][*]You will not receive EXP or Gold for completing with a Dispatch Commission.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Incomplete Black Combo Card[/b][/h3][list][*]By completing Special Agent Joe's Special Training Missions, you can receive [b]30 Combo points[/b], [b]up to 90 Combo points per day[/b].[/*][*]Combo points can be used to modify the [b]Incomplete Black Combo Card[/b].[/*][*]Right-click "Use" on the Incomplete Black Combo Card in your inventory, then click [b]Customize Combo Card[/b].
[list][*]Select a Slot Number of the Incomplete Black Combo Card and choose to change the skill, or unlock the slot.[/*][*][b]**NEW**[/b] You can use 90 Combo points and a [Talent] Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon to change one skill of the Incomplete Black Combo Card to a skill of your choice.[/*][*]You can use 60 Combo points to unlock a new skill on the selected Slot Number.
[list][*]Note: Slots must be unlocked in order from Slot Number 4 to Slot Number 6.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can click on [b]Bonus Reset[/b] for Slots 2 through 6, and reset the bonus value of the Slot using 30 Combo points.[list][*]The Bonus Reset Value is determined by different probabilities within the parameters of each slot:[list][*]Slot 2: 0~10%[/*][*]Slot 3: 0~12%[/*][*]Slot 4: 0~15%[/*][*]Slot 5: 0~20%[/*][*]Slot 6: 0~30%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]**NEW**[/b] Alternatively, clicking on [b]Fixed Bonus Change[/b] will apply a fixed value to your combo card slot with the payment of [b]90 Combo Points[/b] and a small sum of [b]1,000,000 Gold[/b].[list][*]The Fixed Bonus Value is based on the chosen slot:[list][*]Slot 2: +8%[/*][*]Slot 3: +10%[/*][*]Slot 4: +12%[/*][*]Slot 5: +16%[/*][*]Slot 6: +24%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When you are satisfied with the Black Combo Card, click on Complete Combo Card to receive the [b]Black Combo Card[/b] in your Combo Card menu.
[list][*][b]Do not complete the card until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.[/b][/*][*][b]Completing the Combo Card is NOT reversible. Even if you complete the card by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.[/b][/*][*][b]Only one Black Combo Card can be completed during the event period.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Black Combo Card will expire in 30 days, but can be extended or made permanent using the Permanent Combo Card Coupon item.[/*][*]Once you have completed the card, you can no longer edit it.[/*][*]Similar to normal Combo Cards, you can customize it using Advancement Badges.[/*][*]Here is a list of skills you can receive for the Black Combo Card:[/*][/list]

notes.title: Master Plan: Sizzling Summer Boot Camp
notes.content:
[i]There's a heat frenzy hitting Erinn and there's only one cure - the Summer Master Plan Event! Join in this year's summer Boot Camp that's sure to be sizzling! Enroll with the Mercenaries and train like never before. Curious to see what benefits this camp has to offer? Mercenary Liaison Cineraria has the details or check out more below![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, July 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 12th, Before Maintenance[/b]

[h2]Event Details[/h2][list][*]During the event period, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Calling All Mercenaries![/b][/*][*]Find [b]Mercenary Liaison Cineraria[/b] in Dunbarton near the Upgrade Anvil.[/*][*]Talk to Cineraria to learn more about the program and to complete the quest.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Calling All Mercenaries!:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*]Access to the Mercenary Training Guide.[list][*]View your play records during the event period, available benefits, and even move to the NPC Specialists.[/*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2312/even-icon-white.png[/img][/list][/*][*]You’ll receive the quest [b][Guide] Ready for Action[/b].[/*][*]Talk to Cineraria again to register a main character for the event.[list][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][/list][/*][*]The main character will have access to the following benefits:[list][*]Master Plan Inventory[/*][*]Pet Rental[/*][*]Weekly Quests[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Ready for Action:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*][b][b]Cineraria’s Brawn-ic Tonic

[hr][/hr][h2]Pet, Inventory, and Weapon Rental[/h2][list][*]After getting registered, you’ll receive the quest [b][Guide] Boot Camp Benefits[/b].[list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completion:[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton to learn more about the Pet Rental Program.[list][*]You can rent a Level 200 Ceraunus.[/*][*]You can only rent one Ceraunus per account.[/*][*]The rental pet does not have an inventory and expires once the event has ended after September 12th.[/*][*]The pet whistle will be removed at the end of the event if it has not been used.[/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton to learn more about the Master Plan Inventory Rental Service.[list][*]You will be able to use the [b]Master Plan Inventory[/b], which has a 15x10 inventory size for the duration of the event.[/*][*]The Master Plan Inventory is accessible by clicking on the Master Plan Inventory bag icon in the top-right of your main inventory window.[/*][*]Once the event ends, the inventory space will be locked. notes.title: G26 Winds of Fate Part 1 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2348/240627_julyupdate_socials_newsarticlefooter_940x290.png[/img]

[h2]Winds of Fate[/h2]
With multiple divine beasts appearing throughout Uladh, Etain and Eirawen make a secret pact to overcome the crisis by working together and recruiting the Milletian and four mercenaries to handle the new threat.
[list][*][b]Generation 26 - Winds of Fate - Part 1[/b] has been added.[list][*]Players who have completed Generation 25 will automatically receive the quest [b]When Fate Comes Knocking[/b].[/*][*]Players who have not completed Generation 25, but have reached at least Level 5,000 will receive a window notification that the storyline is available to start if they so choose.[list][*]You may start the storyline by clicking the “Start G26 Winds of Fate” button in the Storyline Menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Voice acting (Korean) has been added to all characters in the story.[/*][*]You can adjust the volume of the voices through the options menu by going to the following:[list][*]Options -> System -> Sound -> Voice Volume[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Fantasy Life Changes[/h2]
[b]Enchant Naming[/b]
[list][*]Enchant Scrolls will now display the name of the enchant in its name.[/*][*]The Auction House search function has been updated to allow you to search by the enchant name.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2425/enchant-search.png[/img][/*][/list]
[b]Case-Sensitive Closed[/b]
[list][*][b]Searches within the Auction House and Traveler's Guide are no longer case-sensitive![/b][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2424/dead-bee-case-sensitive.png[/img][/b][/*][/list]
[b]NPC Chat Log[/b]
[list][*]The Chat Log now has a dedicated tab for NPC Chat.[/*][*]All conversations that appear in the NPC Conversation window will appear in the chat log.[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2422/npc-chat-log.png[/img][/*][/list]
[b]Durability Indicator[/b]
[list][*][b]A new window will appear when the durability of your equipped item is close to breaking.[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2423/durability-indicator.png[/img][/b][list][*]Above 20%, the indicator will display normally.[/*][*]At under 20%, the indicator will display Yellow.[/*][*]At 0% durability, the indicator will display Red.[/*][/list][/*][*]The indicator will appear when you have any items equipped in your gear tab.[list][*][b]You can disable the indicator in the settings by going to:[/b][list][*][b]Options → Game → Etc. → Hide Durability Alert[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Forgetful Potions[/b]
[list][*]All Special Forgetful Potions will be renamed to “Forgetful Potion”.[/*][*]All Forgetful and Special Forgetful Potions now reset every day at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]The timer of any Forgetful and Special Forgetful potions currently on cooldown will reset with the upcoming maintenance to accommodate the change.[/*][/list]
[b]Inventory Identifier[/b]
[list][*]Improvements to the UI have been made so it can be easier to see which inventory space belongs to a bag.[list][*]Hovering over a bag will darken the inventory that the bag belongs to.[/*][*]Hovering over an item name in the "Inventory Magnifying Glass" will darken the inventory space that item is in.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Erinn Essence[/b]
[list][*]When using a title coupon obtained from Erinn Spirit that has already been collected, you will now receive Erinn Essence, which can be traded in with Eavan at Dunbarton for a title coupon you may not yet have. [b]Gold Limit Expansion[/b]
[list][*]The Gold Bank Limit has been increased to 30 Billion gold.[/*][list][*]First 10 Characters on the account will now increase the bank storage by 30 Million) gold.[/*][*]The 11th Character and onward will now increase the bank storage by 15 Million gold.[/*][*]An Active Life VIP or Combination VIP Membership will now increase the deposit limit by 600 Million gold.[/*][/list][*]The Auction House/Tara Auction Gold Limit has been increased to 30 Billion gold.[/*][*]The design of the Bank Checks have been improved to accommodate the new limits.[/*][*]The Check withdrawal amount from the Bank has been increased from 10 million to 30 Million gold for Milletians [b]without[/b] Life VIP or Combination VIP Service.[/*][*]The Check withdrawal amount from the Bank has been increased from 60 million to 100 Million gold for Milletians [b]with[/b] Life VIP and Combination VIP Service.[/*][*]The Remote Check-Issuing Ticket (100 Million), which can be obtained from the Erinn Merchants’ Guild Souvenir Box, has been increased to 300 Million.[/*][list][*]Both the title and description of the item have been updated to reflect this.[/*][/list][*]New Bank Limit Expansion Coupons have been added to the Cash Shop:[/*][list][*]Bank Limit Expansion Coupon (300 Million)[/*][*]Bank Limit Expansion Coupon (500 Million)[/*][/list][*]When hovering over the [Limits] field in the Bank Tab UI, a new tool tip will be displayed with detailed information on how to increase the limit of your bank’s gold limit.[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*]Additional UI has been added to help prevent trade items from being lost during commerce.[/*][*]Extra info has been added to the fossil mini-game to clarify how to do a better job at excavating those bones.[/*][*]Food will list whether they can be used as a Catering Ingredient or not once the character has learned Catering.[/*][/list]

Curious to know what else was added? Be sure to check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/92712/g26-winds-of-fate-part-1-patch-notes-july-11th-2024][b]full patch notes[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Gather with Fellow Milletians in LA! Registration Opens 6/11!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2047/fanmeetup-news-940x290.jpg[/img]

Greetings Milletians!

We are ecstatic to officially announce our upcoming event, the [b]Mabinogi Mag Mell Mixer[/b]! This event will be an in-person gathering to celebrate all the love and support we've received from you, Milletians! We'll have a photo wall for selfies, a cosplay contest, arts & crafts stations, and more, highlighting the relaxing and creative atmosphere that we all enjoy in Erinn as Real Life Milletians! Also, a special guest DJ will be there remixing all your favorite Mabinogi music!

Come join the Mabinogi Team and mingle with other Milletians in Downtown Los Angeles this July~

[h2]Event Details[/h2]
[b]Date & Time:[/b] July 5th from 4:00 PM~7:00 PM PDT
[b]Venue:[/b] La Casita at [url=https://www.hotelfigueroa.com/bars-restaurants/la-casita/]Hotel Figueroa[/url] (939 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015)

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2049/ricks_upperlevel-1024x683.jpg[/img]

Some of the fun you can expect at the event:
[list][*]Complimentary delightful bites and beverages (both alcoholic/non-alcoholic) will be served[list][*]Valid ID will be checked upon entry[/*][*]A vegetarian/vegan option will be available.[/*][/list][/*][*]Cosplay actors onsite for selfies[/*][*]Free [b]Thank-you swag[/b] gift bag to all attendees[/*][*]Cosplay contest[/*][*]Music by a special DJ[/*][*]And much more![/*][/list]
We encourage you to dress in your favorite Mabinogi outfit, cosplay, or even a comfortable cottagecore styled outfit to resemble your best Mag Mell fit as you relax and enjoy the event with other Milletians. All props will be inspected. Real, functional weapons are not permitted.

The event will be [b]FREE[/b]. However, space is very limited, so tickets will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. Tickets for the Mabinogi Mag Mell Mixer will be available on [b]Tuesday, June 11th at 12:00 PM PDT[/b] via Eventbrite.
[list][*]Webpost with ticket reservation links coming soon![/*][/list]
We hope to see you on July 5th!

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Renovation Season 5: Close Combat and Lance Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1994/renos5-news-940x290.jpg[/img]
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1967/grandmaster_close_combat_icon.png[/img] Close Combat[/h2]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1968/smash.png[/img] [b]Smash[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example[/b][b]: [/b]Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before:[/b] Humans and Elves: 620%, Giants: 720%[/*][*][b]After:[/b] Humans and Elves: 800%, Giants: 900%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The cooldown of Smash is reduced at higher ranks.[list][*][b]Before:[/b][list][*]3 seconds at all ranks.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]After:[/b][list][*]Rank F ~ Rank A: No Change[/*][*]Rank 9 ~ Rank 1: 2.5 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 1: 2.4 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 2: 2.2 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 3: 2 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1966/bash.png[/img] [b]Bash[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before:[/b] 380% / 400% / 420% / 440% / 460%[/*][*][b]After: 520% / 540% / 560% / 580% / 600% [/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The cooldown of Bash has been increased to 2 seconds.[/*][*]Bash's attack priority has been adjusted to be higher than normal attacks.[/*][*]When using Bash while dual-wielding, Bash stacks are gained twice as fast. [/*][*]Close Combat Talent Damage increases based on the number of Bash stacks.[list][*][b]Example[/b]: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: 2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%[/*][/list][/*][*]Close Combat Talent Damage increase is only applied while wielding a Close Combat Talent weapon.[/*][*]When Bash is at 5 stacks, Close Combat Talent and Elemental Knight Skills will ignore Auto-defense of Heavy Standers below a certain rank.[/*][*]The Bash stack retention time has been reduced to 20 seconds for all ranks.[/*][*]The Bash stacks will remain even when changing weapons.[/*][*]Bash will now automatically strike the enemy from a distance, depending on how close the character is to the enemy.[/*][*][b]Example[/b][b]:[/b] Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Distance up to 7m [/*][*]This function does not occur if the skill is used by a monster.[/*][*]The issue of intermittent normal attacks when using Bash continuously has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2005/counterattack.png[/img]Counterattack[/b]
[list][*]Counterattack has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack at higher ranks.[list][*][b]Before:[/b][list][*]3 seconds at all ranks.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]After:[/b][list][*]Rank F ~ Rank D: No Change[/*][*]Rank C ~ Rank A: 2.5 seconds[/*][*]Rank 9 ~ Rank 6: 2 seconds[/*][*]Rank 5 ~ Rank 1: 1.5 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 1: 1.4 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 2: 1.2 seconds[/*][*]Rank Dan 3: 1 second[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2006/assault_slash.png[/img]Assault Slash[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for all skill ranks have been increased.[list][*]Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 260%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 350%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Assault Slash has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack.[list][*][b]Example: [/b] Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]1.5 seconds[/*][*][b]After: [/b] 0.3 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][*]The cooldown of Assault Slash has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]7 seconds[/*][*][b]After: [/b] 5.5 seconds[/*][/list][*]An issue where the skill could not be used in certain situations on enemies who have been knocked down has been fixed.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】[i]In order to reduce the inconvenience of Automatic Defense and ensure that Close Combat talent skills can be used meaningfully in battle, we have updated the above skills and adjusted their values. Due to how Close Combat skills work there are often situations where you need to approach your target. Our expectation is that you’ll be able to zip around more in-battle with Bash’s new gap closer and Smash's lower cooldown. As Smash contains higher potential risk, the damage values have been increased so that the skill has a higher payoff when successful.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2012/grandmaster_lance_combat_icon.png[/img] Lance Combat[/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1993/lance-impact.png[/img] [b]NEW![/b] [b]Lance Impact[/b]
[list][*]New Lance-only skill![/*][*]Knock your target back with a heavy blow, and grants an effect that gives your next Lance Charge increased damage when unmounted![list][*]Knocks your opponent back in a straight line, up to 5m. [list][*]If your opponent cannot be knocked back, you will leap back 5m instead. [/*][/list][/*][*]Grants Lance Charge Mount Bonus (On Foot) upon use, empowering your next Lance Charge. [list][*]Your next Lance Charge will deal mounted Lance Charge damage.[/*][*]The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.  [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2037/lance-impact-eng.gif[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1991/lance-leap.png[/img] [b]NEW![/b] [b]Lance Leap[/b]
[list][*]New Lance-only skill![/*][*]Reposition backwards with deft grace, and empower your next Lance Charge’s unmounted movement speed![list][*]Leaps backwards upon use, distance increases with rank, up to 6m at Rank 1. [/*][*]Grants Lance Charge Speed Boost (On Foot) upon use, enhancing your next unmounted Lance Charge. [list][*]Your next Lance Charge will have increased movement speed while unmounted.[/*][*]The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2038/lance-leap-eng.gif[/img]

[b]Other Lance Weapon Changes[/b]
[list][*]Basic Attacks and Smash can now be used from a closer range. [list][*]The damage dealt will depend on the distance between you and the target, with the damage being reduced if targets are too close. [list][*]If the Spirit enhancement skill Ultimate Lance is present, this damage reduction does not apply. [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Defense skill can now be used when equipped with a Lance.[/*][*]Lance Counter can now be canceled out of and ignores stun.[/*][*]Corrected the behavior of Lance Charge that was causing it to occasionally fail when used at minimum range.[/*][*]When undertaking the Lance Charge Advancement Test, you can now use Lance Impact and Lance Leap.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】[i]As is, the Lance talent can be used most optimally when riding a pet, but as a talent it can be difficult when in positions where you cannot use a pet. When entering progressively higher leveled dungeons, it becomes more difficult to make use of your pet. To this we decided that a new skill would be needed to allow for greater use of the Lance Combat talent even in harder content. The development team wanted to add more fun to the player input of the talent while reducing the dependency that the talent has on pets- Lance Impact and Lance Leap were designed with this in mind.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]
[b]Human Movement Speed[/b]
[list][*]Human movement speed has been increased, and is now equal to Giants.[list][*]The movement speed bonus gained from Breath of Ladeca has been reduced due to this change. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2007/breath_of_ladeca.png[/img] Breath of Ladeca[/b]
[list][*]The amount of movement speed granted in the description is now a percentage, rather than a flat value. [/*][*]Altered from ~13% down to its new value of 10%. [/*][*]Removed the 10% bonus damage to Close Combat talent skills when Dual-Wielding.[list][*]Now adds 5% bonus damage to normal talent skills.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2011/spirit_of_order.png[/img] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2010/soul_of_chaos.png[/img]Transformation Skill [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2009/fury_of_connous.png[/img] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2008/daemon_of_physis.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]Your 1st and 2nd Titles are now maintained when using Paladin, Dark Knight, Beast, and Falcon transformations.[list][*]Transformation-specific Titles can still be used when transformed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Passive Defense Skills for the transformations, such as Paladin Heavy Stander, will now always be active. [/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2013/shield_mastery.png[/img] Shields[/b]
[list][*]The Shield Mastery skill had had the following changes made:[list][*]The damage reduction rates depending on the size of your shield have been changed.[/*][*]The damage reduction when using Defense increases depending on the size of your shield.[/*][*]The Elemental Knight skill Dauntless Defense accounts for the size of your shield as well as the new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Shields have had a new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect added: [list][*] [b]Frosted Borealis Shield[/b]: 14%[/*][*] [b]Divine Shield[/b]: 15%[/*][*] [b]Massive Despair Shield[/b]: 18%[/*][*] [b]Perseus Vigilant Shield[/b]: 20%[/*][*] [b]Nightbringer Vanguard[/b]: 30%[/*][/list][/*][*]Using the Defense skill will no longer reduce damage against a skill that cannot be blocked, and your skill will be canceled instead. [/*][/list][table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】[i]Previously when wearing a small, medium, or large shield, the damage reduction of the Defense skill could be applied regardless of if the attack was successfully blocked or not, allowing players to maintain the damage reduction at all times. The development team decided to adjust this behavior in order to create more interesting combat scenarios in future content where Defense must be used to block some skills, while other attacks must be avoided entirely as they cannot be blocked. Instead of having an effect based solely on the size of the shield itself, we’ve strengthened the options and tweaked the damage formula so that higher-tiered shields are stronger in the long run.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Fantasy Life Changes[/h2]
[b]Ducat Exchange Daily Limit[/b]
[list][*][b]Seasonal Ducat exchange for Ducat currency will no longer have a daily limit.[/b][list][*]Commerce merchant NPC dialogues have been updated to reflect this change.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]EXP-Granting Items[/b]
[list][*]Gaining experience by percentage is changed from current level to absolute level for the following values:[list][*]Item use (eg. Golden Fruit, Magical Piece (Grade n), Pet Golden Experience Fruit, etc.)[/*][*]Shop Sales Bonus (Equipment that has Shop Sales Bonus attribute which you then sell it)[/*][*]Fountain of Blessing in Uladh Dungeons[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The experience formula values for the following are subject to change:[/b][list][*]Battle experience (including pets)[/*][*]Exploration experience (eg. Special Artifact)[/*][*]Spirit experience (eg. Mysterious Spirit Stone)[/*][/list][/*][/list]

Be sure to check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/212200/announcements/detail/4176604868932294111][b]full patch notes[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Milletian Maestro Concert
notes.content:
[i]You've dueled it out in the arena, now it's time to take the stage... with music! The GMs are calling upon all musically-inclined Milletians to audition for a chance at the spotlight! Curious to know more? See below for full details![/i]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Audition Dates: Wednesday, May 22nd at 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT) - Wednesday, June 19th at 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT)[/b]
[olist][*]All performers aiming for the stage will submit an audition video of their song being performed through the link below:[list][*][url=https://forms.gle/ZSkP1s9yp6fdpJzY8][b]Audition Form[/b][/url][/*][/list][/*][*]The song [b]must[/b] be an [b]original composition[/b]! Copyrighted music will [b]not[/b] be counted this time around.[list][*]While we love the music that's already out there, we want to hear YOUR musical talent and creativity![/*][/list][/*][*]The audition piece should be no longer than [b]8[/b] minutes long.[/*][*]The audition can be either a Solo performance [b]or[/b] an Ensemble (up to a Quartet).[list][*]If you are auditioning as part of an ensemble, only 1 entry is needed for the group.[/*][*]Milletians can only be apart of 1 performance.[/*][*]All players In-Game Names must be visible in the audition video.[/*][*]Do not use Laighlinne partners.[/*][/list][/*][*]Judging will be done in 2 parts:[list][*]Judging will be done internally by Nexon staff to select the [b]Concert Finalists.[/b]
[list][*]The theme is [b]A New Chapter[/b].[/*][*]Criteria will be based on:[list][*]50% Originality[/*][*]50% Video Presentation[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Judging for the [b]Grand Performances[/b] will be done by the [b]Community[/b] after the concert.[/*][/list][/*][*]Those chosen to perform will be notified the day before the concert through their preferred method of contact.[/*][*]Performers will need to be available the evening of the Winner's Concert to receive a Grand Performance or Finalist Prize.[/*][*]All audition videos will be available for viewing after the concert in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1229485400196911196]Mabinogi Official Discord's Contest Submission Channel[/url].[/*][/olist]
[h2][b]Concert Details[/b][/h2][b]Concert Date: Wednesday, June 26th at 5:00 PM PDT (8:00 PM EDT)[/b][list][*][b]Location[/b]: Emain Macha Stage OR Arpeggio Concert Hall, Channel 2[/*][*]Thirteen Performers (Solo or Ensemble) will be selected as [b]Finalists[/b] to perform their audition piece live to all Milletians watching both in-game and/or through a Mabinogi Livestream, hosted by the Community Managers.[/*][*]After the concert, Milletians will get to vote on their favorite performance to determine the Grand Prize Winners.[list][*]Voting will take place in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1229485400196911196]Mabinogi Official Discord Contest Submission Channel[/url] and will last 1 week.[list][*]Top 3 highest voted will receive the [b]Grand Performance Prize[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Prizes[/b][/h2]
While the ultimate prize is hearing the beautiful melodies our Milletians create, we also have some wonderful prizes [b]for everyone[/b]! Regardless of solo or ensemble, all players of the performance will receive the same prize based on their performance overall.
[table][tr][th][b]Grand Performance Prize[/b][/th][th]Finalist Performance Prize[/th][th]Participation Prize[/th][/tr][tr][td][list][*][b]**NEW**

It was present on a few equipment names, but mostly a lot of potions. May we walk free of the invisible danger pretzel.[/*][*]The message that displays when attempting to study too close to another player has been translated. Just in time- what do you mean the exam was last week?[/*][*]Several Muffler style wings introduced in the Stellar Wing Box were temporarily inaccessible in the Dressing Room. They can now be reaccessed![/*][*]Visual fixes for the following items: [list][*](Special) Bejeweled Monarch Gown (F) [/*][*](Special) Winter Forest Wanderer Outfit (F), Gloves (F), and Boots (F) [/*][*]Winter Forest Campsite [/*][*](Ancient) [Water/Forest] Dragon [Lordling/Maiden] Plus Support Puppets [/*][*]Seraphic Cantabile Holy Censer [/*][*](Special) [Showy/Sweet] Circus Performer's Outfit (M), Gloves (M), and Boots (M) [/*][*]Guardian Boots (M)[/*][*]Digital Destiny Gloves (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Shooting Star minigame where the indicator would disappear under certain conditions. Get your game on, go play![/*][*]Corrected the Homestead Library Shelf's icon on the Building Information window. [/*][*]The post-game Time Remaining display for the Memory Match mini-game will now display the correct time. [/*][*]Fixed an issue in character creation where the Human’s race description would disappear if scrolled down.[/*][*]It is no longer possible to enter a Mafia match while you are in your Homestead as the game starts.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where in some situations Hans would refuse to draw a portrait.[/*][*]References to 'Four-Legged Animal Mark' have been corrected to 'Sheep Mark'. We believe this to be a conspiracy from Pan to lord over other quadrupeds.[/*][/list][h3][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.png[/img][/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][*]In some cases, it is not possible to transfer leadership to another player within the guild.[/*][/list]
