notes.title: May Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dungeon Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]General Tech Duinn Changes[/b]
[list][*]Instructions for some missions have been improved to provide clear indicators such as monster deaths (Example: Golems in Awakened Abyssal Lord) or item use requirements (Example: Lava Lump in Seven Nightmares).[/*][*]The Lava Decal spawned when defeating enemies in the Salamander family will now have a casting indicator to warn of the incoming danger. [/*][*]Fixed an issue causing Lava Decals (such as those from Salamanders) to stun Milletians through Iron Will.[/*][*]A timer gauge has been added to show the time remaining until Salamanders "self-destruct" after a certain period of time.[/*][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [/*][list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][*]Bosses will no longer resist the following skills: [/*][list][*]Final Hit[/*][*]Magnum Shot[/*][*]Firebolt[/*][*]Chain Impale[/*][/list][*]The following enemies will have a cooldown added to their Ice Spear spell: [/*][list][*]Cethlenn[/*][*]Tathlum [/*][*]Red Lizard Witch[/*][*]Black Moon Follower[/*][/list][*]The following rewards will now have a longer despawn timer when on the floor:[/*][list][*]Evil Eye Sealstone[/*][*]Function Geata Fragment[/*][*]Remnants of Illusion[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Revived Illusion Changes[/b]
[list][*]A timer to show when the next Salamander will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Red Lizard Witch enemy.[/*][*]The gimmick of Red Lizard Witch reflecting damage from being hit has been removed.
[/*][/list]
[b]Feth Fiada Changes[/b]
[list][*]The draw distance for Feth Fiada has been slightly increased. [/*][*]The frequency of how often the following enemies teleport in combat has been reduced: [/*][list][*]Fire Slime[/*][*]Ice Slime[/*][*]Lightning Slime[/*][/list][*]Lightning Slimes and Black Moon Followers will no longer become temporarily immune to all damage upon knockdown, and will instead gain a temporary boost to their Protection and Magic Protection.[/*][list][*]This change also applies to all Lightning Slimes outside of Feth Fiada.[/*][/list][*]Previously Illusion Zombies and Black Moon Followers would ignore damage below a certain threshold. This has been removed, and their HP values have been increased to compensate.[/*][*]During the Hallway Puzzle, Illusion Zombies will now spawn in the same fixed locations on both Easy and Hard modes.[/*][*]Tathlum's "Spin Dash" skill, which attacks while rolling, has been changed:[/*][list][*]Cast time of the skill before rolling has been increased.[/*][*]An attack range indicator is displayed during the casting time.[/*][*]The monster can be damaged while using the skill.[/*][*]The attack range has been reduced to a narrower range.[/*][*]The attack duration, which was slightly different between difficulties, has been adjusted to be the same in all difficulties.[/*][*]These changes also apply to the Frostwork Soul monsters in Glenn Bearna.[/*][/list][*]A timer gauge has been added to show the remaining time towards when Black Moon Followers will disappear.[/*][*]When the first Tech Duinn Geata is defeated, the particle indicator will be shown to point towards the location of the next orb.[/*][*]Tech Duinn Geatas will now always spawn in a fixed location on both Easy and Hard modes. [/*][*]The following attacks from Tech Duinn Geata will now display cast indicators, and have had their casting time increased to allow better reaction: [/*][list][*]Light of Annihilation[/*][*]Light of Destruction[/*][*]Windmill[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Seven Nightmare Changes[/b]
[list][*]During the Salamander puzzle,[list][*]The "Black Explosion" caused by the Evil Eye Monolith has been removed.[/*][*]Lava Lumps held inside the inventory will now automatically be used against the Evil Eye Monolith every 5 seconds. The Lava Lump can still be manually activated.[/*][/list][/*][*]During the Black Moon Follower Battle puzzle,[list][*]The radius of the Lava Decals has been decreased, and the amount that appears has been increased.[/*][*]A preview casting indicator has been added for decals that are about to appear. [/*][/list][/*][*]During Cethlenn’s boss fight,[list][*]Cethlenn's "Summon Reaper" skill indicator now has a higher resolution.[list][*]The skill indicator has also been changed to better match its range.[/*][/list][/*][*]Cethlenn’s Staff enemies have had the following changes made:[list][*]Staves will pass through targets, applying a bleed effect on hit.  [/*][*]Their attack speed has been increased.[/*][*]They will no longer cause knockback on hit.[/*][*]The enemy name and health bars will be hidden to reduce noise. [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Awakened Abyssal Lord Changes[/b]
[list][*]During the Golem Puzzle, the moving sacrifice circle has been removed and replaced with a large stationary one in the center.[/*][*]During the Barrier/Bastion Puzzle,[/*][list][*]A timer to show when the next Barrier Spirits will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Bastion enemy.[/*][*]The maximum number of summoned Barrier Spirits has been changed so that it does not exceed a certain number of summoned monsters.[/*][/list][*]During the Boss fight, the location of the name and health bars of the Soaring Leg enemy have been improved to be visible from the floor
[/*][/list]
[b]Crom Bás Changes[/b]
[list][*]Defense and Protection of regular Crom Bás monsters has been reduced.[list][*]When Dark Erg levels are between 71~100, the Protection of regular monsters has been reduced, but their HP has been increased. [/*][/list][/*][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][/*][*]The defense-increasing Divine Blessing effect from Frozen Cari and Dark Cari will no longer apply to Frozen Cari and Dark Cari. [/*][*]Stun Immunity has been removed from the following monsters:[list][*]Dark Ronaun[/*][*]Dark Cari[/*][*]Dark Llygadog[/*][*]Dark Gwallgof[/*][*]Dark Wyneb[/*][*]Dark Disciple[/*][/list][/*][*]The following monsters have cooldowns added to the listed skills, causing them to be used less:[list][*]Disciple and Dark Disciple: Shooting Rush[/*][*]Slime Wyneb and Dark Wyneb: Ice Spear and Thunder[/*][*]Un Llygadog and Dark Llygadog: Icebolt and Thunder[/*][*]Ronaun and Dark Ronaun: Puppet's Snare[/*][*]Frozen Cari and Dark Cari: Icebolt, Ice Spear, and Thunder[/*][*]Irusan: Ice Spear and Thunder[/*][/list][/*][*]Excluding specific phase mechanics, the damage caps for Irusan, Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann have been removed. [/*][*]The additional damage taken by Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann when dazed has been reduced from 230% to 200%.[/*][*]Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's "Erg Black Hole" will now be visible when the ‘Minimize VFX’ option is enabled. [/*][*]The Disciples that spawn during Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's gimmicks had their passive defenses removed, except for when they resist that damage type.[/*][*]The following changes have been made to the fight with Irusan:[list][*]The summoning rules for regular monsters have been changed, and new gimmicks have been added.[/*][*]Irusan now has an increased delay after using Sharpened Claw.[/*][*]The progression rules for Irusan's Sweet Tea Time (where the cauldron is activated) have been changed.[/*][*]Irusan's Deathly Brand has been changed so that it can be canceled using Hand of Restoration.[list][*]This status effect icon is also now visible to all party members.[/*][*]Some dialogue about this effect provided by Brielle has been changed.[/*][/list][/*][*]The interval of Dark Lure (Red exploding circles) has been changed:
[list][*]Dark Erg 0-30: 6~10 seconds[/*][*]Dark Erg 31~70: 5~8 seconds[/*][*]Dark Erg 71~100: 4~6 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The visibility of Warp Circles in Crom Bas has been improved.[table][tr][td]Green Magic Circle has not been changed.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1563/green-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Yellow Magic Circle now has an outline without a shade added.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1591/yellow-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Red Magic Circle now has an outline with a shade added.[/td][td][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1564/red-crom-bas-circle.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list]
[b]Glenn Bearna Changes[/b]
[list][*]Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: [/*][list][*]Heavy Stander[/*][*]Natural Shield[/*][*]Mana Deflector[/*][/list][*]Damage caps have been removed except for certain sections during boss fights.[/*][*]An issue where some monsters behave abnormally when hit by the Flame Burst skill has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Dungeon Changes[/b]
[list][*]G1 Fiodh - Lowered the HP value of the following creatures:[list][*]Small Golem[/*][*]Flying Sword[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Additional Fantasy Life Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Spring is in the air and there are flowers to be picked! To help with that, we’ve added 2 new items: [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1589/empty-flower-baskets.png[/img][list][*][b]Flower Basket[/b][list][*]This item can hold up to 200 Bundles of Flowers.[/*][*]Can be purchased from Del for 350,000 gold.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Sturdy Flower Basket[/b][list][*]*slaps top of basket* This bad boy can fit even more Bundles of Flowers - up to 500![/*][*]Can be purchased from any Commerce Trading Merchant Imp for 500,000 Ducats.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to [b]20[/b], including:[list][*]Bunches of Flowers[/*][*]Dye Ampoules[/*][*]Metal Dye Ampoules[/*][*]All Baltane Mission Elite Passes[/*][*]All Shadow Mission Elite Passes[/*][/list][/*][*]To better assist our merchants, the Auction House functionality has been enhanced.[list][*]The UI will no longer close after registering an item for sale.[/*][*]Erinn will now inform you that the item has been successfully listed in the chat log.[/*][*]Items that can be sold on the Auction House will now be highlighted in your inventory and gear slots.[/*][/list][/*][*]The “Claim Rewards” button in the Growth Guide has been renamed to “Completion Rewards” for better clarity.[/*][*]An outline will be added to the VFX which indicates the impact range of Moon Stones in the G24 [Fallen from the Sky] mission.[/*][/list]
[b]Quest Polishing[/b]
[list][*]Blaanid is now more concise with her dialogue when helping new Milletians on their path of learning about the world of Erinn. [/*][*]In the Pet Training Skill quest [A Blossoming Embrace], the number of required Bear Fynni Gems has been reduced.[/*][list][*]Additional text has been added to the Quest Scroll to clarify how to speak to Fynni Fynn.[/*][/list][*]You can no longer remove the Dark Knight Armor in your inventory prior to completing [Eliminating the Dark Knight Armor] Quest.[/*][*]In the G1 Mission [Paradise], you can now talk to Tarlach to receive another Brown Fomor Pass if you happen to lose it.[/*][*]In the final G1 Missions [Tir Na Nog], [Find the Black Orb], and [Final Dance], additional text has been included into the Quest Scroll on how to return to Tir Na Nog.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Froggy Foster Friend Event
notes.content:
[i]Have you ever wanted to raise your very own tadpole and watch it grow up big and strong, or maybe become rich and famous? Rafaela has many foster frogs that need tending to and she feels that you have the expertise to help these little ones grow... help prove her right (or wrong?) and you could even earn some ribbiting prizes out of it![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, May 9th, 2024, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, June 6th, 2024, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h3][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1355/tadpole1.gif[/img] [b]Event Details[/b] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1355/tadpole1.gif[/img][/h3][list][*]Log in to receive the quest [b][Guide] Seeking Eggs-perts[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Rafaela[/b] in [b]Dunbarton[/b] and register a main character.[list][*]Doing so will automatically complete the quest with the following rewards:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]10x Event Coin (Tadpenny)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Upon registering a main character, you’ll become the proud parent of a newly hatched tadpole![/*][*]A special tadpole icon will appear on your screen. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1352/ui-icon-v2.png[/img][list][*]Clicking on the icon will bring up a special hub that shows information about the tadpole including:[list][*][list][*]The mood of your tadpole.[/*][*]How many Event Coins you currently have as well as access to the Event Shop.[/*][*]Time remaining (in real-life minutes) to before the tadpole needs attention for the day.[/*][*]How many times you’ve fed, played, or exercised with the tadpole.[/*][*]Daily Log-in progress for bonus Event Coins.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will also be given two additional quests:
[list][*]Daily Quest - [b][Quest] Growing Just a Tad[/b][/*][*]Achievement Quest - [b][Quest] From Green to Grown[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1357/ui-screen-v3.png[/img][h3][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1356/tadpole2.gif[/img] [b]Daily Quest[/b] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1356/tadpole2.gif[/img][/h3]
In order to have your tadpole grow, you'll need to check in with the little fella (at least once every real-life day!). After a full Erinn Day, you'll be able to select an activity with your watery ward to grow to grow an everlasting bond that can only be shared between a Milletian and a frog. Oh, and you'll get a reward for doing so.
[table][tr][th][Quest] Growing Just a Tad[/th][th][/th][/tr][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td][list][*]Choose today's frog activity[list][*]Eating[/*][*]Exercising[/*][*]Playing[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td][list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]10x Event Coin (Tadpenny)[/b][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][h3][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1355/tadpole1.gif[/img] [b]Achievement Quest[/b] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1355/tadpole1.gif[/img][/h3]
Raising your tadpole takes work! You'll be rewarded like a prince if you do enough activities with your growing tadpole, as each milestone celebrates your accomplishments:

[/b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1396/frog-makeup-v2.gif[/img][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[list][*]The remaining duration of character Style Tabs on an account, rounded to the nearest whole day.[/*][*]Payment of 0.4 Pon/day, rounded to the nearest whole number.[/*][list][*]Examples:[/*][list][*]If a character has 3 days of Style Tab remaining, 2 Pon will be provided.[/*][*]If a character has 10 days and 20 hours of Style Tab remaining, 5 Pon will be provided by the calculation of 0.4 Pon x 11 days = 4.4 Pon -> 5 Pon.[/*][*]The duration provided by existing Premium/VIP service will not be included.[/*][/list][*]The duration of remaining Style Tab cannot exceed a total of 2500 days for the account. This means 1000 Pon will be the maximum amount of Pon one account can receive.[/*][/list][/list]

notes.title: [UPDATED] The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 5
notes.content:
[i]Ethel the Billionaire is here to invest in your growth! The scrappy young entrepreneur will be providing support to all Milletians by selling Recommendation Letters for additional rewards. Additionally, rare artifacts have been discovered in Musical Math Dungeon allowing you to have 10x the loot... for a cost. Rumor is Ethel is planning even more as the event rolls on. Check out the details below![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Overall Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - July 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3]
[list][*]During the event, you'll receive the quest [b][Guide] Investing in the Future[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Ethel[/b] in [b]Dunbarton[/b] to learn more of what he has to offer this time around.[list][*]When listening to his story, you'll need to select a Main Character.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]After talking to him, you'll automatically complete [Guide] Investing in the Future.[list][*]You will also earn the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Musical Math Dungeon[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - July 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, when completing Musical Math Dungeon, you will receive [b]Excavated Artifact (Music) x10[/b] from the dungeon end chest.[list][*]Each artifact can be sold as-is for [b]5,000 [/b][b]Exploration EXP[/b] or can be taken to Voight for restoration.[list][*]The Artifact Investigation Skill cannot be used on Excavated Artifact (Music).[/*][*]Voight will offer to restore the artifact for the low, low price of just [b]50,000 Gold [/b]per artifact![/*][/list][/*][*]Once an artifact is restored, it can be sold for [b]50,000 Exploration EXP[/b] or exchanged to Ethel for a [b]Music Dungeon Box[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Music Dungeon Box List:[/b]
When opening a Music Dungeon Box, you are guaranteed any of the following items below:
[list][*]Music Score Scroll (2000)[/*][*]Music Score Scroll (1000)[/*][*]HP 500 Potion RE[/*][*]HP 100 Potion RE[/*][*]MP 500 Potion RE[/*][*]MP 100 Potion RE[/*][*]Stamina 500 Potion RE[/*][*]Stamina 100 Potion RE[/*][/list]
Additionally, boxes may contain additional item(s) from the list below:
[list][*]Song Stardust[/*][*]Instrument Strings[/*][*]Harmonic Wood Board[/*][*]Melodic Metal Board[/*][*]Jabchiel's Music Score (10)[/*][*]Jabchiel's Music Score (5)[/*][*]Jabchiel's Music Score (3)[/*][*]Tuning Kit[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Purification Missions[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - May 16th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Ethel will provide players with [b]Sponsored Missions[/b].[list][*]These missions are for [b]up to 2 players[/b].[/*][*]Missions will require [b]Recommendation Letters[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]You can purchase up to [b]7[/b] Recommendation Letters for 777 Gold each [b]per week[/b] from Ethel.[list][*]Ethel will restock his recommendation letters every [b]Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional Recommendation Letters can be obtained by clearing existing Purification Missions each day, 3 times per day. (Resets at 7:00 AM Server Time)[list][*]One Recommendation Letter has a chance to drop during each Purification Mission, regardless of the number of party members.[/*][/list][/*][*]Innes will inform you how many reward attempts you have left based on the number of Recommendation Letters you have in your inventory.[/*][*]Sponsored Missions are the same as before, with adjusted monster health and stats. The rewards are 2 to 4 times higher.[list][*]Cleared solo: 4x increase for rewards[list][*]The monster has increased health, but lower defensive stats.[/*][/list][/*][*]Cleared by 2 players: 2x increase for rewards[list][*]The monster has increased health, and the same defensive stats as the existing mission.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Avalon Field Raids[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, May 16th, After Maintenance - June 13th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Ethel will provide players with Sponsored Missions: Avalon Raid.[/*][*]These missions can be completed [b]solo[/b] or in a [b]party with 2~8 players.[/b][list][*]Mokkurkalfi[/*][*]Sylvan Dragon[/*][/list][/*][*]Missions will require [b]Recommendation Letters[/b].[/*][*]You can purchase up to [b]7[/b] Recommendation Letters for 777 Gold [b]per week[/b] from Ethel.[list][*]Ethel will restock his recommendation letters every [b]Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Visit Innes in the Outskirts of Avalon to proceed with a Sponsored Avalon Raid.[/*][*]Innes will inform you how many reward attempts you have left based on the number of Recommendation Letters you have in your inventory.[/*][*]Sponsored Missions are the same as before, with adjusted monster health and stats based on the number of party members.[list][*]Mokkurkalfi[/*][*]Sylvan Dragon[/*][/list][/*][*]When successfully clearing the mission, you will receive [b]1x Billionaire’s Proof[/b]. These coins are stored in the Currency tab, and can be used to purchase items in Ethel’s Shop.[/*][*]Mission Difficulty will depend on the number of current Billionaire’s Proof you have, ranging from Difficult Lvl 1 to Difficulty Lvl 10. Innes will inform you of the current difficulty level at anytime by talking to her.[list][*]If partaking as a group, the difficulty is set based on the number of Billionaire’s Proof the party leader has.[/*][*]Spending Billionaire’s Proofs at [b]Ethel's Event Shop[/b] will reduce the difficulty level, but higher valued items are worth more Billionaire’s Proofs.[/*][/list][/*][*]Keep in mind that both solo and party challenges count towards the total number of rewards you can earn, up to 10 per week. [/*][*]Only the main character can enter the missions.[/*][*]If the mission fails before you are able to complete it, the Recommendation Letter will be granted back to you[/*][/list][h3][b]Ethel's Event Shop[/b][/h3][list][*]Use the Billionaire’s Proof items received from Avalon Field Raid Sponsored Missions to exchange for the Relic Boxes.[/*][*]Each Dragon Relic Box can be purchased once a day (resets [b]Daily at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b]).[/*][*]Each High-Quality Dragon Relic Box can be purchased once a week (resets [b]Weekly at Thursday 7:00 AM Server Time[/b]).[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Cost[/th][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x1[/td][td]1x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x2[/td][td]2x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x3[/td][td]3x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x4[/td][td]4x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x5[/td][td]5x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x1[/td][td]6x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x2[/td][td]7x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x3[/td][td]8x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x4[/td][td]9x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x5[/td][td]10x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Dragon Relic Box & High-Quality Dragon Relic Box List[/b]
When opening either a [b]Dragon Relic Box [/b]or [b]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box[/b], you can receive one of the following items below:
[list][*]Desecrated Charm Chunk[/*][*]Ancient Monster Core[/*][*]Black Dragon Blood[/*][*]White Dragon Blood[/*][*]Dragon Flesh Lump[/*][*]Dragon Flesh[/*][*]Dragon Scale[/*][*]Dragon Scale Fragment[/*][*]Dragon Bone[/*][*]Dragon Bone Fragment[/*][*]Billionaire's Recommendation Letter[/*][/list]
You will have a higher chance at receiving a monster part from the list when opening a High-Quality Dragon Relic Box.
[h3][b]Apostle Raids[/b][/h3][list][/list][b]Event Dates: Thursday, June 13th, After Maintenance - July 11th, Before Maintenance[/b][list][*]Ethel will provide players with Sponsored Missions: Apostle Raid.[/*][*]These missions are for up to 1, 2 and 8 players depending on the Apostle.[list][*]Girgashiy: 1 player[/*][*]Zebach: 1~2 players[/*][*]Hasidim: 1~8 players[/*][/list][/*][*]Missions will require Recommendation Letters.[/*][*]You can purchase up to [b]7[/b] Recommendation Letters for 777 Gold [b]per week[/b] from Ethel.[/*][*]Ethel will restock his recommendation letters [b]every Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time[/b].[/*][*]Visit the Alban Knights Emblem in Emain Macha to proceed with an Apostle Raid.[/*][*]Sponsored Missions are the same as before, with adjusted reductions to damage dealt. The rewards are 2 to 4 times higher.[/*][*]Girgashiy Mission: [list][*]Cleared the mission within 5 minutes: 4x increase for rewards[/*][*]Cleared the mission within 7 minutes and 30 seconds: 3x increase for rewards[/*][*]Cleared the mission after 7 minutes and 30 seconds: 1x increase for rewards[/*][/list][/*][*]Zebach Mission:[list][*]Cleared the mission within 5 minutes: 3x increase for rewards[/*][*]Cleared the mission after 5 minutes: 1x increase for rewards[/*][/list][/*][*]Hasidim Mission:[list][*]Cleared the mission: 2x increase for rewards[/*][/list][/*][*]If the mission fails before you are able to complete it, the Recommendation Letter will be granted back to you. [/*][/list]

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90906/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-5][b]Irusan's Check-in Attendance Event[/b][/url] will be restarting.[/*][*]Do you "got game"? Test out your mini-game skills in the new [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/91284/milletian-got-game-event][b]Milletian Got Game Event[/b][/url].[/*][*]The [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/91212/galaxy-brained-study-buddy-event]Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy Event[/url] [/b]is starting. Be sure to hit the books so you don't flunk![/*][*]Stylize your digital prowess with the new [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/91213/digital-destiny-box][b]Digital Destiny [/b][b]Box[/b][/url]![/*][*]Didn't get the prizes from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90914/16th-anniversary-gm-event][b]16th Anniversary GM Event[/b][/url]? We're doing another distribution! Be sure to check your mailbox after maintenance.[/*][*]As a thank you for your patience regarding the Extra Equipment Slot and Homestead Jukebox being affected with VIP Service, we're starting the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/91322/milletian-events-service-error-compensation][b]Milletian Events: Service Error Compensation[/b][/url] Hotday. Please see the post for more information.[/*][list][*]We know you're eager to receive the Pon reimbursement for the Style Tab changes. We prioritized the recent live issues surrounding the Extra Equipment Slot and Attendance Event so that it could be resolved quickly. Rest assured, we are still working to ensure your Pon amounts are correct and can be distributed as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience![/*][/list][*][b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Galaxy Brained Study Buddy Event
notes.content:
Siyu is in danger of flunking and needs your help preparing for the exams again! Use a Study Desk to copy notes from the Thick Books into a Notebook every day. The better the quality of your Notebook, the more rewards you'll earn! Remember, don't copy off of your Study Buddy! Check out the details below.
[h2]Event Details[/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, April 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Seeking a Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Siyu[/b] in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square.[/b][/*][*]Register a [b]main character[/b] with Siyu.[/*][*]You can only register [b]one character per account.[/b][/*][*]You will receive the following event items after completing [b][Guide] Seeking a Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy:[/b][/*][list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*]Unlock [b][Event] A Thorough Review[/b], [b][Event] Surefire Study Tactics[/b] and [b][Event] Hard Work Pays Off[/b] quests.[/*][*][b]Standard Study Desk (Event)[/b][/*][*][b]50 Thick Books[/b][/*][/list][*]Log in to receive 50 Thick Books once per day.[/*][*]The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]All event quests, items, and Blacksmith Manuals will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2]Daily Quest[/h2][list][*]Each day, you will receive the daily quest: [b][Event] A Thorough Review.[/b][/*][*]Stay online for 36 minutes or longer to complete the quest.[/*][*]When you complete the daily quest, you will receive:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]70 Thick Books[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Each day, you will also receive the daily quest: [b][Event] Surefire Study Tactics.[/b][/*][*]Complete the quest every day by using the Standard Study Desk and Thick Books to copy the notes.[/*][*]To copy the notes, you will need to craft a Notebook using the Thick Books.[/*][*]You can craft a Notebook anywhere. One Thick Book will create one Notebook.[/*][*]The craft success rate by grade will differ depending on the type of desk used. There are three desks:[list][*]Standard Study Desk (Event) (Received from [b][Guide] Calling All Study Buddies[/b])[/*][*]Smart Study Desk (Event) (Craftable)[/*][*]Elite Study Desk (Event) (Craftable)[/*][/list][/*][*]You can purchase a Blacksmith Manual to craft the Smart Study Desk (Event) and Elite Study Desk (Event) from Siyu.[list][*]The Smart Study Desk (Event) and Elite Study Desk (Event) Blacksmith Manuals will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][/*][*]When you complete the daily quest, you will receive:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]50 Thick Books[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Achievement Quest[/h2][list][*]You will receive the quest [b][Event] Hard Work Pays Off[/b] after registering the main character. [/*][*]Complete the Surefire Study Tactics daily quest 15 times, then talk to Siyu, to receive the following:[list][*][b]200,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Homestead Library Shelf[/b][list][*]Prop Installation Size: 1x3[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Milletian Got Game Event
notes.content:
[i]Clatha is a total noob and needs some coaching to improve his gameplay! Practice mini-games each day to show him how to get good. Do you have what it takes to be the king of games?! Check out the details below.[/i]

notes.title: Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 5
notes.content:
[i]Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Hymerark Regalia! Dress like the deity themself as you reject the Church of Lymilark or go for some unique Spirit Transformation Liquers. There's also brand-new Support Selection Boxes every single week. Check out the details below![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, April [strike]4th[/strike] 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July [strike]11th[/strike] 18th, Before Maintenance[/b]

[b]Update 2:[/b] [i]Hi Milletians, after further testing, we're postponing the start and end dates of the Irusan's Check-in Attendance Event by one week (Now 4/11 ~ 7/18) to allow further time to fine-tune the event and ensure it meets Edern-level standards of quality. We apologize to those who experienced issues in Erinn today because of Irusan stealing keys. (A certain guild stone may have taken the phrase "collect key items" too literally...). We'll provide further details if anything else changes prior to then.[/i]

[b]Update:[/b] [i]Hi Milletians, thank you for reporting the issue about not receiving treasure chest keys in your mission clears. After investigation, we believe that this issue occurs when there is one person in the party that has not yet received their stamp from the Irusan's Attendance Check-in event. The mission clear will count for the stamp check, however the key is not granted for the end chest reward for the party. As such, we recommend receiving your stamp through your preferred method first before doing higher dungeon clears such as Glenn Bearna. We will be forwarding the information regarding this issue to our development team and will notify you when there is an update on this. Thank you for your patience![/i]

[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] Stamp Employee Contract[/b].[list][*]Find [b]A Kitty in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue in Dunbarton to learn more about the contract.[/*][*]You’ll receive a [b]Stamp Employee Contract[/b]. Use it to register your [b]account[/b] for the event, allowing you to participate [b]on all characters[/b].[/*][*]Completing [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract will award you with the following items:[list][*][b]1,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]500 Gold[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen.[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2664/irusan-icon.png[/img][list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars with 28 days each, for a total of 84 days.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive your daily stamp, or how far along you are![/*][/list][/*][*]An Event Clock Timer is also available so you can check your Daily Stamp progress at a glance without opening the Event Menu.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Attendance Stamps[/b][/h2]
[list][*]You now have even more ways to earn a stamp each day![list][*]Complete any of the following to earn a stamp:[list][*]Daily Taillteann Shadow Mission.[/*][*]Daily Tara Shadow Mission[/*][*]Baltane Mission.[list][*]Excluding Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table missions.[/*][/list][/*][*]Lord Mission.[/*][*]Mag Mell Mission.[/*][*]Tech Duinn Mission.[/*][*]Clear Crom Bas.[/*][*]Clear Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]3 Part-Time Jobs perfectly.[/*][/list][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour to earn a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect the stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your Event Clock timer and it is already [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b], the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PDT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive [b]1 stamp per day[/b].[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[list][*]The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from [b]July 11th, After Maintenance ~ July 18th, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2663/irusan-check-in-board.png[/img]

[list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for [b]29 Pon[/b].[/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance - April 4th
notes.content:
[b]Maintenance has concluded as of 10:01 AM PDT and the servers are open once more. We thank you for your patience.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on April 4th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b] and last approximately [b]4 hours[/b].

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[h3][b]-Time-[/b][/h3]

[b]Thursday, April 4th[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CET, UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM
Sydney (AEDT, UTC +11) 1:00 AM - 5:00 AM (April 5th)

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Hope you enjoyed the fun. We say goodbye to the Guild Stone in Tara in this year's [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90773/a-mysterious-request][b]April Fools' Day Event[/b][/url].[/*][*]Did you get some extra training in over this past week? All the buffs from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90902/milletian-events-16th-anniversary-buffs][b]Milletian Events: [/b][b]16th Anniversary Buffs Event[/b][/url] is ending.[/*][*]Are you ready to [i]Check-in[/i]? Irusan's waiting for your attendance in a new season of [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90906/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-5][b]Irusan's Check-in Attendance Event[/b][/url].[/*][*]Your prizes from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/90914/16th-anniversary-gm-event]16th Anniversary GM Event[/url] will be distributed! Be sure to check your mailbox after maintenance![list][*]Pon Reimbursement from the Style Tab changes is still in the works.[/*][/list][*][b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*][strike]Fixed an issue where the Extra Equipment Slot and Homestead Jukebox was not working with VIP Service.[/strike][list][*][strike]As of a result of the issue not being fixed last week, we've provided an additional 7 days to the Extra Equipment Slot and Homestead Jukebox to all of those affected.[/strike][/*][*][b]Update:[/b] Unfortunately, the fix for this issue will be postponed. After reviewing the results, we found that some characters were still receiving a lesser amount of Extra Equipment Slot duration as intended. In order to ensure that the duration of this system is correctly adjusted with both VIP system and used coupons, additional time is needed to work on the scripts to fully resolve this issue. We know how frustrating it is to be unable to use this feature, so thank you for your understanding and patience.[/list][/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Producer's Letter: 2024 Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

It’s been awhile since I’ve updated you about the many content updates we love to see in Erinn. Things have been quite busy for the past few months as the team and I have been working tirelessly to implement all of the new contents you’ve seen in Q4 last year, as well as the January and February updates this year. With many aspects to review and features to test, it has been a whirlwind of conversation and discovery throughout each patch cycle. This is an ever trending cadence for us as we continue to work on each upcoming release, so we are always very appreciative of your excitement and understanding!

[hr][/hr]
Without further ado, we are so excited to share with you about some of the events and contents that you can expect to see this year. Starting off with our beloved…

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1963/doki-doki-banner.jpg[/img]

💕 [b]Doki Doki Island![/b] 💕

Sior and Reni are featured in adorable illustrations that remind us of the longing, reminiscent times we have spent with our Soulmates… digging potatoes, flying the skies, and forever fishing. I hope you have been enjoying these activities, along with all the exciting changes and activities added to the lovely Doki Doki Island this February! Don’t forget to check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/89375/doki-doki-island]full travel brochure[/url] to get the full experience.

P.S. you can download the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/media/video]wallpapers[/url] on our media page!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1962/16th-anniversary-banner.png[/img]

🌟 [b]16th Anniversary[/b] 🌟

Mabinogi NA is celebrating our 16th Anniversary this year! The [b]Festival of Stars[/b] will bring the return of many Festia activities like the Festia Instant Prize, and a new basketball minigame! Starry themed items like new damage skins, outfits, chairs, and a Starry Sheeptuplet will have you seeing stars all over Erinn. Alongside these in-game events, we will have our annual Anniversary GM Event to celebrate, and more Community contests held during the month! We can’t wait to send out some [url=https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1974/arcana-merch-bg.png]exclusive Arcana: Dark Arts physical prizes[/url] to the winners of these events, so keep an eye out for further news! We can’t wait to see you! 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1961/vip-renewal-banner.png[/img]

[b]VIP Service Renewal[/b] is just around the corner, as we finish up the final tests and tie up all the pretty bows on the addition of four new package types, including all your favorite features and more. We’ll share all of the details about the new packages soon (your current service will carry over, don’t worry!), as well as all the fun stuff like, what’s in the packages? (You’ll see!) Are they tradable? (Yes!) Can the Extra Equipment Slot be free with VIP? (Yes!) What about Style Tab? (What about it? It will be free for everyone!)

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1965/minigames-banner.png[/img]

[b]Mini-games Forever![/b] An update later this year will also bring many of the event mini-games to you to play anytime, anywhere~ What other kinds of mini-games would you like to see one day?

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1966/renovation-s5-banner.png[/img]

[b]Renovation Season 5[/b]

With the newly introduced Arcana talents, the combat of Mabinogi has begun to change. Additional skill revisions will make their debut with our fifth season of Renovation which aims to reduce the gap between some talent and Arcana skills, and increase usability. This update will focus on improving the overall viability of using certain skills in combat, such as increased damage, reduced cooldowns, and other changes to improve skills in the following areas:
[list][*]Combat (Smash, Bash, Counterattack, Assault Slash)[/*][list][*]Increased damage, reduced cooldowns, and some changes to skill functionality will supplement the skills usability[/*][/list][*]Lance [/*][list][*]Revising lance skill functionality and implementation of new lance-only skills that support the talent further, without the use of a mounted pet[/*][*]Lance ‘Blow’ will knockback enemies in a straight line with effective damage similar to Lance Charge, while Lance ‘Step’ will let you gain distance for Lance Charge and charge to enemies fast.[/*][/list][*]Breath of Ladeca[/*][list][*]Improving the movement speed and bonus damage effects[/*][/list][*]Shield Effects[/*][list][*]Changed damage reduction from being reduced by shield size to being reduced by the new [damage reduction] effect added for shield items.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1964/g26-banner.png[/img]

[b]Chapter 8: Generation 26[/b]

Maybe the most captivating news is that the beginning of a new Chapter will present itself this Summer! Chapter 8: Generation 26 will bring a new storyline, NPCs and monsters, and all the great stuff we love packed into Generation updates. Do you have any discoveries you wish to uncover?

[b]Moonlight Island[/b]

Moonlight Island is a new take on creating a unique lifestyle space for you and your favorite NPCs. With many new features to decorate and expand the island to your liking, such as changing the island’s topography, you can also invite residents to the island to engage in various production activities and acquire various items that are helpful to your Erinn life. We can’t wait to see what you’ll create, and I am sure we will have more to share regarding this special creative update once we grow closer to the update! What kinds of things would you want to add to your island? 

There will also be improvements to the Homestead so that you can decorate freely in your original sanctuary place! The purpose of these updates is to expand the options you have to create, rest, and make happy memories in places that you enjoy most! 
 
[hr][/hr]
Thank you, Milletians, for always supporting the world so many of us feel safe in. 2024 will bring many new memories for us in Erinn. With the Mabinogi Eternity in development, we are even seeing further glimpses of our future Fantasy Life, made possible from your everlasting love of Mabinogi. Please look forward to more update news later, and I hope to see you all in-game soon!

Until next time, 
[b]~ GM Mewlynne, a Milletian of 16 Years
Mabinogi Producer[/b]

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: Discussing the January 2024 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Hi Milletians,

With our January 18th update, we have released changes to Mabinogi that we recognize many Milletians have strong feelings about. In particular, we would like to address the changes to Tech Duinn missions and the weekly clear reward limits that have been integrated into these missions. As with Crom Bás or Glenn Bearna dungeons which had weekly clears from the start, Tech Duinn has now been updated to introduce similar weekly clear limits. Along with this change, the mission format has been reorganized, consolidating difficulty levels from four to two (Normal/Hard), improving the ease and intuitiveness of mission puzzles, adjusting dungeon rewards, and improving dungeon drop rates.

Many of these changes represent improvements on the existing system, but the community has expressed considerable uncertainty regarding the weekly clear limits. The team has been reading and digesting the many thoughts and feedback you have. While adding a limit to content that was previously unlimited understandably may not sit well initially, the reasons behind the change have been reviewed and considered deeply by the development team, whose thoughts we will share with you below.

As Mabinogi’s publisher, we will review and scrutinize the many facets of the game’s content, while also placing our trust in the best intentions of our developers. Our goal as a connected team aligns in our desire to do what is best not only for the longevity of the game, but for the enjoyment of our community.

From myself, and on behalf of my team at Nexon America and Nexon Korea, we will continue to put our whole hearts into Mabinogi to provide a service that we can all enjoy.

Sincerely,
[b]GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer[/b]
[h3][b][u]Developer’s Comments: Behind the Change [/u][/b][/h3]
The core purpose of dungeon-related updates is to increase the value of dungeons and rewards. Most dungeons in Mabinogi have a lower chance of rewarding the most desirable items. This is by design, to encourage repeated playthroughs. The items given as dungeon rewards are typically also tradable, so the reward probability has to be determined by taking into account repeated play. Our development team believed that this was causing repeated negative experiences in dungeons.

After reviewing the data and play patterns of our Milletians, we decided that it was necessary to make improvements so that you could grow and acquire equipment. However, there were concerns that simply increasing the probability of receiving rewards would increase the supply of materials excessively, decreasing the value of items and ultimately leading to a loss of motivation to play dungeons at all. This is also the reason why the average number of runs required to obtain a desired reward set in general Mabinogi dungeons was not able to be adjusted immediately, even though it might have felt somewhat difficult for Milletians trying their hardest to grow. Our development team has thought deeply about the best choice we could make for Mabinogi’s future, and has significantly increased the probability of rewards while limiting the number of clears so that Milletians, in their quest to grow ever stronger, can enjoy a meaningful challenge in the dungeons they are focusing on.

In preparing for this update, we considered the appropriate direction based on these contents as basic premises. 
[olist][*][u][u] Tech Duinn weekly clear limits[/u][/u] 
Tech Duinn is a dungeon with the most direct rewards that Milletians can achieve as intermediate goals in their growth process. If you look at the status of Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, they are generally receiving “Elite” passes on Feth Fiada Hard difficulty. In the case of Crom Bás, it is possible to enter without obtaining an entry pass to farm the Nightbringer weapon set, so the fact that you needed to separately obtain an Elite pass to acquire the materials for the Perseus weapon set felt like an unnatural part of the growth process. We eventually determined that to be one of the hassles, and thought of the way where you could play them without acquiring passes.

However, as acquiring passes is no longer required and the drop rates for the rewards have been increased, we have concluded that the amount of acquired items could increase too excessively, without the limitation to the entry. As maintaining items’ value is also an important part of the game, we concluded that the entry limit is necessary.

When looking at the play patterns of North American Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, the dev team found that most Milletians who were playing the Elite missions were clearing them fewer than 10 times per week, and around 80% of Milletians were clearing them fewer than 5 times a week. When considering the now-increased probabilities of receiving many of the rewards, we felt that clearing the mission about 15 times was a reasonable level, providing a better experience in clearing without significantly affecting the value of the rewards obtained.

We have also prepared the methods for Milletians who want to clear missions more by making it possible to clear more than 15 times a week (25 times or more in total) using additional entry passes received through events and Adventurer’s Seal Shop. We are also open to the possibility of gradually easing restrictions when the demand/supply of rewards has stabilized in the future.

We are also listening carefully to your concerns about situations that impede free play. We will continue to think about which values ​​are most important from a long-term perspective and find solutions that offer enjoyable experiences. 

[/*][*][u][u]Intention of introducing the Dungeon Re:fine system[/u][/u] 

A lot of Milletians have been asking about the details of the Re:fine System and the intention behind it.

Re:fine system is the system where the probability of a certain reward’s appearance remains the same regardless of the party member’s number. In practice, it works as below.

For certain items, the number and the probability of these items appearing in one dungeon run will remain the same regardless of whether it was cleared by one person or multiple people. Once the item’s appearance is decided, who will get the item among the party will be decided by an even probability.

In other words, if the probability of an item is 1%, and an individual clears the dungeon, the item will appear by 1% for them. If the dungeon is cleared by a party of 4, whether the item will appear or not will be decided by 1%, and the item will be given to the 1 of the 4 members by even probability.

The initial purpose of the Re:fine system was to bridge the compensation gap, accounting for multi-client usage. Although this will now be addressed to some extent by blocking the use of multiple clients, we still have to take into account abnormal styles of play. In particular, the higher the expected reward of a dungeon, the more advantageous it is to clear it using multiple computers. We intended to prevent this type of play pattern from being encouraged. With the update, we applied the Re:fine system to certain dungeons while increasing the drop rates of major rewards, to prevent the situation of using multiple clients or computers being advantageous while increasing the level of rewards for playing dungeons.
[/*][/olist]
The purpose of the development explained above is focused on changes for the long-term growth of Mabinogi. However, we believe that the freedom and variety of play styles that can be experienced in Mabinogi are also important values. We will strive to develop Mabinogi through a process of gathering opinions while doing our best to provide a sufficient explanation of our intentions to all Milletians.

Thank you,
[/u][b]Mabinogi Development Team[/b]

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The following books have been updated with a revised version to be more canonically accurate.[list][*][i]The Goddess Who Turned to Stone[/i][/*][*][i]The Knight of Light Lugh, The Hero of Mag Tuireadh[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]In the Bag Order Settings menu, 'PLUS Inventory' has been renamed to 'VIP Inventory', to match the tab name. Visions of a blue-haired girl and a black-wooled sheep cross your mind.[/*][*]Chain Slash Grandmaster has been renamed to Grandmaster Chain Slasher, to fit with the other GM Talents. [list][*][i]We'll always remember you, Chain Slash Grandma.[/i]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1165/this-goes-out-to-all-the-grandmas.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]The text when attempting to wear an invalid face accessory and headgear together has been improved to be much more clear and a bit less judgmental. 
[list][*]It was "Probably not a good idea to dress like this.", if you were curious.
[/*][/list][/*][*]When sending a message to an offline friend, it no longer will tell you that your friend is too busy to chat. They might still be busy, but that's not the reason why your message wasn’t received.
[/*][*]You can now earn Field Raid Contribution when using the following Harmonic Saint actions:

[/*][*]Resurrect an ally with Hymn of Resurrection[/*][/list][/*][*]When using Shadow Flare and Polar Vortex, 2x casting speed of wands will be applied to the Celtic Tribolt Wand and single-attribute wands.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Continued Text Polish on generations and items! 
[list][*]Why the catch-all item instead of listing them all out individually, you hypothetically inquire? These are usually small things, such as adding missing periods/spaces and other similar typos. We try to include the more impactful fixes and changes individually. Thank you as always for your reports![/*][/list][/*][*]The Abominable Rabbit from Glenn Bearna was being too abominable. Previously after using Roar, the unpleasant bunny would stackingly increase its allies Defense and Protection. As this was not intended to stack, we've asked the loathsome lagomorph to take it down a notch.[/*][*]In specific situations, Dauntless Defense’s cooldown would be applied incorrectly. This has been corrected.[/*][*]The damage is now applied correctly when using Thunderblight at rank 5 or higher against a target whose Magical Defense and Magical Protection have been reduced below zero.[/*][*]The bag sizes for the following Doll Bags were incorrectly listed. The text has been updated to match the actual values. 
[list][*]Bhatair Doll Bag[/*][*]Morfydrianas Doll Bag[/*][*]Tani Doll Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]The item descriptions for the following Doll Bags displayed the incorrect Collection Categories. Only the text was incorrect, the functionality for these items have not changed. 
[list][*]Talek Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy -> Gold, Ore, Gems[/*][*]Marleid and Piran Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring Materials -> Gold, Ore, Gems, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring Materials[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where Doll Bags did not collect Equipment if set to the Cooking and Equipment Collection Categories.[/*][*]The Shadow Reaper Mask was so stealthy that Milletians couldn't even see its textures. A series of off-screen montages has given all Milletians the power to properly see the mask.[/*][*]Improved the text when cooking the best food Erinn has seen. Continue your hunt for the essence of true flavor, Master Chefs![/*][*]When undertaking the Shuriken Charge Advancement test, the supervisor no longer refers to it as the Kunai Storm test.[/*][*]Corrected a minor visual error with the Vanguard Uniform Bandage (M).[/*][*]Corrected a minor visual error with the Cheerful Bride's Gloves.[/*][*]After waiting many long years to return, the Girl on the Moon was super excited to see all you ‘Mabinogians’ again for ‘second anniversary’! She's going to catch some well deserved rest.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bugs were fixed during the course of December:[/b]
[list][*]The Check Weekly Rewards Received for Glenn Bearna no longer inaccurately lists the weekly limit as 4x per week. The text now displays the correct 3x per week.[/*][*]Undye your hair and mourn no longer- Atrata now properly grants selected PTJ rewards, rather than just giving it out all as experience points.[/*][*]Chefs rejoice! You can now search for Cooking Potions on the Auction House![/*][*]The Echostones from the Erinn-go-Round Echostone Boxes were interacting unintentionally when an Echostone Supplement was applied. We have fixed the issue causing Echostone Grades to reset- you can no longer use the Echostone Supplement item on an Echostone that has not been advanced at least one Grade.[/*][*]The notification of your Auction House listings being sold are now correctly showing once more. Yayifications![/*][*]The Detective Squirrel Doll Bag description stated that it had a set effect when summoned with another doll bag. As this isn't the case, this line has been removed.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]🐛[/*][*]When using the new item Defender's Will, the stats displayed in the message incorrectly displays the stats from Aggressor's Will. This is a text issue only, the correct defensive stats are given. [/*][*]The new crafting recipes for Protective Red Upgrade Stone and Protective Blue Upgrade Stone incorrectly refer to 'Gem of Protection' as 'Gem of Protective Power'. The former is the correct name for the item, and is the item used in the craft.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Wishes to the Moon Event
notes.content:
[i]It's a new year! With a new year comes new ambitions, goals, and wishes... what will you wish for this year? You might need a lantern and a seesaw to make it come true.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, January 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 25th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you'll receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Mysterious Traveler.[/b][/*][*]Register your main character with Traveler Zeno in Port Cobh.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Guide] A Mysterious Traveler:[/b][list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*]You will also gain knowledge of both the Seesaw and Sky Lantern Festival quests, as well as the Event Shop.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th]Sky Lantern[/th][th]Seesaw Jumping[/th][/tr][tr][td]
[b][Guide] Sky Lantern Festival[/b]
[list][*]After completing [Guide] A Mysterious Traveler, you'll receive the quest [b][Guide] Sky Lantern Festival[/b].[/*][*]Talk to Ascon near the Lighthouse in Port Cobh to hear more about the Sky Lantern Festival.[/*][*]You'll receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Sky Lantern Festival.[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][td]
[b][Guide] A Traditional Game[/b]
[list][*]After completing [Guide] A Mysterious Traveler, you'll receive the quest [b][Guide] A Traditional Game[/b].[/*][*]Talk to Traveler Zeno once more to learn how Seesaw jumping works and to complete the quest.[/*][*]You'll receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A Traditional Game.[list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*]Seesaw Construction Kit (x1)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Daily Quests[/b][/h3]
[b][Event] Recreation Prep[/b]
[i]Getting to the moon is no easy feat, you'll need to prepare your mind, body, and soul...[/i]
[list][*]Talk to Traveler Zeno and select [b]Recreation Prep[/b] to receive your daily quest.[/*][*]You'll be given one of three choices with the following objectives:[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Recreation Prep[/th][th]Objective[/th][/tr][tr][td][b]Endurance[/b][/td][td]Complete 1 Commerce.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Focus[/b][/td][td]Gather 30 times.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Reflexes[/b][/td][td]Fish 10 times.[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]After completing the objective, you'll automatically complete the event and receive the following rewards:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Bunny Coin x20[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mabinogi Eternity Project: Finding the Erinn we dream of
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Hi Milletians,

We are excited to share the first developer blog post, [b]“Finding the Erinn we dream of" [/b]that has been written about the [b]Mabinogi Eternity Project[/b]! We are planning to share more with you in the future in a space created especially for Eternity. More information on the development of Eternity, behind-the-scenes blog posts, videos, screenshots and other related information are some of the things you can expect to see in those future posts. For now, we will continue to share some blog posts with you separately, until the space is ready. Please look forward to it! 

Please enjoy these four videos that we would love to share with you, showcasing what the world of Erinn could look like. 

[b]A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Tir Chonaill[/b]
[previewyoutube=-lylKimTxKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Nighttime Milletian[/b]
[previewyoutube=ZC0aWm0SlvM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Fishing[/b]
[previewyoutube=iyS1rYC3dFA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Milletian in Tir[/b]
[previewyoutube=S2ZuPC-2Op0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you, 
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[h2][b][b]“Finding the Erinn We Want”[/b][/b][/h2]
From the time we first made the decision to replace Mabinogi's Pleione engine with something newer and more modern, our list of factors that needed to be accounted for has only grown.

After all, if we replace the engine, we need to upgrade the game's visuals in turn. The problem is, we quickly discovered that everyone had a different idea of what "Mabinogi with updated graphics" would look like.

Some were picturing radical improvements, on the level of what someone might expect from a full-blown sequel. Others had far more modest changes in mind, more on the level of a simple HD remaster.

It got to the point where it was difficult to reach a consensus, so in order to make progress on this issue, we took a look at the game together to see which visual elements we thought needed to be improved.
[h2][b][b]"Which visual elements were most in need of improvement?"[/b][/b][/h2]
This was pretty clear right from the outset. 

In addition to the countless opinions and feedback we'd received from Milletians, the dev team had a long list of things they wished they could do but weren't able to due to the limitations of the old engine.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2756/visual-elements-improved.png[/img]

There were so many things we were frustrated about! Things that are considered part of the basic feature set of other engines were beyond the capabilities of ours, so it was only natural we'd have strong opinions on the matter.

[b]"Well then, let's fix all those things in the new engine!"[/b]

The dislocated shoulders, wonky physics on outfits and hairstyles, greater freedom in customizing textures, advanced ability to handle light and reflections... There was no shortage of things we wanted to take a crack at, so we on the Engine Replacement Task Force began excitedly uploading some of our existing resources to the new engine.

That said...
[h1][b]"Is this still Mabinogi …?"[/b][/h1]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2737/nao_standing_tir.png[/img]

Due to the fundamental differences in the new engine, even our fully-realized designs appeared very different from the look we'd all grown accustomed to.

It was only to be expected, though. Our current engine uses light in a very simple way, acting as a sort of gradient between 'brightness' and 'darkness', while the new engine specializes in the realistic expression of light, lending itself to very nuanced depictions of light and shadow.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2757/gap-between-engines-example.png[/img]

Of course, this was just a proof-of-concept--we hadn't configured the shaders or applied any other settings, so once we'd gotten those set up properly, it was possible to recreate a feel much closer to that of the Pleione engine.

Still, it was clear that even that initial configuration left a lot of room for improvement--we had our work cut out for us.

Our take-away from that experiment was clear:

[b]"If we set about 'improving' things without establishing a clear direction for ourselves, 
we might lose the heart and soul of Mabinogi."[/b]

As a Milletian who's played Mabinogi since its launch, I didn't want Mabinogi to lose its unique flavor in the pursuit of improvement, so I returned once more to Mabinogi's deep archives of art and design work.
[h2][b]"What IS the 'Mabinogi style'?"[/b][/h2]
It was surprisingly simple to uncover what the 'Mabinogi style' entails by revisiting the efforts our artists have made to overcome the limitations of the engine and create a richer, more abundant sense of expression within the game.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2739/ribbon-girlplusroyal-guard.png[/img]

Detailed texturing and modeling help to surmount the engine's limitations

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2740/erinn-world.png[/img]

[i]Meticulously thought-out environmental design helps to avoid a sense of monotony caused by the engine's simplistic ability to handle lighting expression.[/i]

Within the Pleione engine, nuanced lighting isn't really possible, as light calculations have to be done based not only on the source of the light, but also taking into account the data and positioning of the models.

To avoid a sense of visual monotony, Mabinogi's art team has focused on thoughtful environmental design, adding detail via textures, and placing each and every one of the background props with care.

It's those efforts to circumvent or overcome the limits of our existing engine that have contributed greatly to Mabinogi's unique style.

We felt that these values that have shaped the game are worth preserving.
[h2][b]"So, what direction should Eternity take?"[/b][/h2]
It may sound obvious when I put it this way, but our goal here is to keep Mabinogi's unique identity and values while improving upon those things that are currently lackluster or disappointing.

A simple update to a more modern graphical standard, while good, wouldn't be enough.

But we, the Milletians, already knew what was needed.

In all the retouched screenshots you've posted online and through social channels, we can see the hopes and dreams for how Mabinogi's world might change for the better.

Upgrading to a new engine will give us the ability to depict the world of Erinn in greater detail than ever before,

but rather than creating a new art style, we should focus our efforts on finally breaking through the previous engine's technical limitations that had limited our ability to express the things we'd imagined.
[h1][b]"Erinn should always feel like Erinn"[/b][/h1]
This is the goal we've set for ourselves with Mabinogi Eternity.

We promise to give the very best we have to give so that Mabinogi can become a tale that lasts forever.

Thank you for your continued support, Milletians.


[i]~  Mani, a Milletian of 19 Years

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2758/marnie.png[/img]

and, The Mabinogi Team
[/i]

notes.title: Upcoming Changes: Blocking Multi-Client and Improved Dungeon Drop Rates
notes.content:
Hi Milletians,

We are announcing in advance that the security for Mabinogi will soon be improved to strengthen the detection and prevention of third-party programs and multi-client use. We recognize there may be some beneficial aspects that client modifications can offer to improve a player’s game experience, although most functionalities are against the intentions of the game and impose unfair capabilities and barriers to players who don’t modify their files. There are also risks that come with modifying the game client and data for the player and the game.

Mabinogi has been steadily improving the playability of the game, adding commonly requested features that were previously mod-only, as well as other features that have improved the stability and performance of the game. [b]While it is important for us to continue to improve the in-game experience, we believe that at this present juncture, we need to further improve the security measures within the game to prevent security vulnerabilities and create a safer Mabinogi[/b].

[h3]Blocking Multi-Client and Third-Party Programs[/h3]
Multi-client use has not been allowed in Mabinogi and it is not possible to run multiple clients through normal means. However, there are many players who have been logging in on multiple clients through unauthorized methods, bypassing the game system to play on multiple accounts at one time. In order to provide a better game experience, we are enhancing the game’s security so that it is no longer possible to bypass the restriction. In the future, if you run two or more game clients on the same device, any instances of the client beyond the first will be automatically shut down. 

Other security improvements made to the game client and account system will terminate the use of third-party programs and launchers along with it. This notice is being posted early so that you can take care to play on a clean game client before the blocking measures begin to take effect. While special mods and third-party launchers may offer small gameplay tweaks or improve the game’s performance for some, there are more risky parts of client modifications that aren’t good for the game’s overall security. This must be addressed to prevent forms of illicit or fraudulent activity, egregious activities, game exploits, hacking, and other types of abuse. There are also cases in which third-party programs can alter the game’s intention too greatly in ways that are considered exploitative and unfair, such as changes to skill cooldowns, skill usage ranges, or skill uptime. Players found abusing the game while using these types of game modifications will be subject to sanctions. 

Further information about which actions are considered violations is outlined in the [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/legal/tou]Terms of Service[/url][/b] agreement that has been agreed to when creating a Nexon account.

[h3]Addressing the [i]Caravan Joe[/i] Problem[/h3]
Multi-client use is impacting many aspects of the game. In particular, it creates an environment that feels like a gatekeeper to many players of all types. It is not a fair experience to those wanting to play and grow their character when there is such an imbalance between players who are playing multiple accounts and those who are not. The area that has experienced the most significant impact of multi-client use is the supply of gold and rewards. If we take a look at the current dungeon play experience, for example, we have individuals that play and receive one reward chest, while those using multiple clients will receive the reward chest from each of the controlled characters. Milletians who focus on playing with one client are bound to feel like they are at a disadvantage, which we are deeply sorry for.

[table][tr][td][b]"The Many Cousins of Caravan Joe"[/b]

Let's take a look at two different players, Cowenna and Caravan Joe. Both players are looking to receive a Broken Magic Essence (BME) from the Alby Advanced Hard Mode (AAHM) dungeon, and have been farming a while in hopes of getting it.

Each time Cowenna plays, she does a few runs through AAHM. Sometimes by herself, sometimes she invites her friends- Rowan, Eochaid, and Loiscneach. For a successful clear she opens a single chest and takes the loot, as do her friends. One player gets one key to open one chest, or four players get four keys to open four chests.

Each time Caravan Joe plays, he does a few runs as well. He also plays by himself, but with a twist - he invites his [i]cousins[/i], all three of them also named Caravan Joe. For a successful clear each Joe opens a single chest and takes the loot, but after this, each Joe then trades their drops to a single Joe. One player gets four keys to open four chests.

In this scenario, Caravan Joe is four times more likely than Cowenna to receive a Broken Magic Essence. Due to this imbalance, it has been difficult to move forward with Drop Rate increases without accounting for how[i] Caravan Joe and his cousins[/i], aka multi-clienting, would create further imbalances. Cowenna is still doing her AAHM runs hoping to get her BME, but feels that it's unfair that Caravan Joe is getting more drops per run. [/td][/tr][/table]
In other words, this imbalance is not a sustainable way for players to gain resources and this must be addressed to ensure that reward opportunities are available to all players in the game.

[h3]Increasing Dungeon Drop Rates and Improving the Reward Experience[/h3]
A significant change that will be made to Mabinogi will be the addition of [b]improved drop rates to dungeons and missions[/b]. This will allow players to play dungeons with more opportunities towards their reward goals. [b]A major impact of this change will be the leveling-out of imbalances that inevitably became the norm due to multi-client use, and the creation of a better experience for those hoping to receive materials and other rewards from their dungeon runs[/b]. The drop rates of rewards from major dungeons and missions will be increased significantly to the same level that Mabinogi Korea has right now. We will increase the drop rates of many rewards, with our primary focus being–but not limited to–core high-level rewards such as crafting materials and Enchant Scrolls. For some dungeons, the Dungeon Re:Fine system will be applied with the increase of drop rates. 

We will share a detailed list of the dungeons and rewards affected by this change in a later announcement. Please look forward to the improved dungeon drop rates coming soon, with detailed information regarding the changes provided in the patch notes as usual! 

Another part of the game affected by multi-client use is the in-game events. Several players have been participating in events using multiple clients to get multiple rewards. Therefore, the reality of multi-client use was factored in when the Development team determined the coin shop prices for items in event shops. Oftentimes, there is also the need to pick and choose which rewards to spend coins on versus obtaining all rewards from the shop. This aspect is where players would feel that playing on an alternate account was required in order to earn the rewards, which we want to improve. There are certain events that allow all rewards to be obtained, and the aspect of choice is an integral element of game freedom, so this will still be a factor seen in events. However, to improve the experience after the multi-client block, we will adjust the event shop’s reward prices so that you can get enough rewards by solo playing, without using multi-clients.

[h3]Further Improving your Fantasy Life[/h3]
Even with the many improvements that have been made to Mabinogi in recent years, we recognize that there are still options that many players have requested that may be missing from the game. In addition to these changes mentioned above, we will continue to actively improve the elements that burdened the experience and made multi-client use feel like a significant improvement to the game experience.
We sincerely apologize for allowing the multi-client behavior to impact the game as much as it has and hope these changes will begin to change the experience for the better. We appreciate your understanding as we enter this next chapter of Mabinogi. As this is a very important step for the future, we will do our best to ensure the long-term growth and stable service of the game, rather than focusing on the short-term visible result, such as the number of concurrent players in the game.
Thank you for your continued support, and please look forward to more details about upcoming updates to the game. We will continue to work hard so that Mabinogi can continue to grow steadily for a long time.

Milletians, we also recommend following the tips below to ensure that you are playing on a clean client:
[list][*]Please ensure that you are launching Mabinogi through the [b][url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/download/launcher]Nexon Launcher[/url][/b] or [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/212200/Mabinogi/]Steam Launcher[/url][/b].[/*][*]Please delete any unofficial files that may be saved in the game installation folder.[/*][list][*]After removing any precarious files, [b][url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/204741785-My-client-doesn-t-patch-correctly-when-I-run-the-Mabinogi-launcher-Do-I-have-any-other-options-]perform a Repair Installation[/url][/b] if using the Nexon Launcher, or [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/204741785-My-client-doesn-t-patch-correctly-when-I-run-the-Mabinogi-launcher-Do-I-have-any-other-options-][b]Verify the Integrity of the Game Files[/b][/url] if using the Steam Launcher. [/*][*]Alternatively, we recommend deleting the entire game installation folder and preparing a full reinstallation of the game to ensure that all files have been directly downloaded from the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.[/*][/list][*]As the Nexon Game Security client will be improved and updated, ensure that your antivirus or firewall trusts and allows the Mabinogi client and related files to run. If you encounter any issues, please [b][url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us]contact Player Support[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
Thank you, 

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]
