notes.title: End-of-Sale Notice: Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

We are announcing the end of sale of the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll in the Cash Shop, effective immediately during the December 14th, 2023 maintenance.

With the Enchantment System Changes in the Arcana: Dark Arts Update, the expiration attribute of Enchant Scrolls has been removed entirely, and the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item no longer has an effective use. You can read more about these changes to the Enchantment system through the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87846/arcana-dark-arts-update#7]update patch note post[/url].

Existing Enchant Expiration Removal Scrolls have been retrieved from all characters. These items can be claimed once again through the mailbox of the highest cumulative level character on the account.

For players who still had an Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item on their account, and they obtained the item through methods such as crafting, bought the item from another player, got the item through an event, etc., the item can be exchanged to NPC Stewart for 50,000 Gold.

For players who purchased the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item directly and still had the item in their account, they will be refunded the original value spent on the item in Pon. If a player purchased the item and used it, they will not be refunded. The exchanges for Pon have been completed with the December 14th, 2023 maintenance.

Those eligible for the Pon are defined as below:
[list][*]An account who had purchased the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item within the last 1 year (December 1st, 2022 ~ December 14th, 2023)[/*][*]The account still had the item:[/*][list][*]Item was not claimed from the Cash Shop Inventory
OR[/*][*]Item is in the inventory of the character on the account[/*][/list][*]The Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll will be removed and 12 Pon will be added to the account. [/*][/list]
Thank you,

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Arcana: Dark Arts Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/88014/erinn-go-round-event]Erinn-go-Round Event[/url]: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/88277/iceborn-noble-box]Iceborn Noble Box[/url]: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87118/master-plan-winter-infinite-growth-event]Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87395/winter-specialist-doll-bag-box]Winter Specialist Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*]Winter Holiday Decorations in Erinn: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87846/arcana-dark-arts-update]Arcana: Dark Arts Update[/url] : Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Arcana Dark Arts Update:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added to help with your fantasy life! See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87846/arcana-dark-arts-update]Arcana: Dark Arts Update[/url][/b] and check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/darkarts]dedicated microsite[/url]![list][*]Two new Arcanas have been added - [b]Alchemic Sharpshooter[/b] and [b]Dark Diviner[/b]. Visit the Arcana Talent Association in Tara Rath Castle to learn more![/*][*]Special Upgrades have been improved to make your upgrades feel more special![/*][*]Enchantment has been given a remake! Timers on Enchant Scrolls are now a thing of the past![/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Within the Point Inventory (the shopping cart icon), we have renamed "Rearrange" to "Claim". This button has always claimed all of the selected items, which is technically a form of rearranging, but we felt it could be a lot more clear.[/*][*]Renamed "Mana Tunnel in Filia" to "Filia Mana Tunnel" to be consistent with other Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates.[/*][*]Small text improvements have been applied to Jousting and the Tara Banquet.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Due to equal parts of your helpful reports and our love for polishing, we continued to improve the text in November's Beyond content. This took several forms- Mainstory text, Spirit text, Stardust quest information, and several PTJs (especially those involving the Dunbarton Library).[list][*](Also, we convinced Stewart to rename the Magazine section to Periodicals.)[/*][/list][/*][*]Corrected the text for the materials needed in the Norman Warrior Armor. Previously this indicated that you needed Common Leather Straps, when the materials used were actually Common Leather.[/*][*]Endelyon will no longer ask you to "일반 아르바이트 완전 수행 성공" for your daily Renown. Hopefully "Earn full credit for the perfect completion of any Part-Time Job" is a little more understandable![/*][*]The Growth Guide now recognizes your hard work and will award you your Growth Guide Point when you complete "Work a Part-Time Job".[/*][*]The Upgrade Stone Selection Box from the Growth Guide no longer has a unfortunate adjective suggesting that this should be a Protective Stone. The intended rewards are and always have been Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x1 or Blue Upgrade Stone (Event) x1.[/*][*]The Inquisitive Black Friday Package previously stated that it granted only one Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) and 10x Forgetful Potions. This has been corrected to the proper values: Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) x5 and 10x Special Forgetful Potions. This is only an issue with the box text, the items within have always been correct. Although the sale has ended, we feel that it was best to right this in-game as well.[/*][*]The Skill Learn method for Metal Conversion has been referencing older requirements. This has been updated to reflect the actual requirements![/*][list][*]If you're still unable to learn the skill through the above methods, we heard nearby rumors that talking to Pierrick might help...[/*][/list][/list]
[b]The following bugs were fixed during the course of November:[/b]
[list][*]Corrected an issue causing the Commerce Rankings to not update.[/*][*]Fixed issues with a few Part Time Jobs:[list][*]Glenis was ignoring Nerys' ring.[/*][*]Fraser was not giving out selected rewards for his PTJs.[/*][*]Effie and Nicca's PTJs were not showing on the Rano PTJ board.[/*][/list][/*][*]Surging Hope Gems can once again be used as expected.[/*][*]The default Dollbag collection categories for Shyllien Ecology and Rare Mineralogy were not collecting all the same materials as the add-on collection categories. Both lists are now the same.[/*][*]The Premium Collection Category Add-on Slot was not properly working for the following Dollbags:[list][*]Cethlenn and Vayne Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Commerce Companions Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Crom Bas Brielle and Gillach Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Crom Bas Cast Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Deirbhile and Piran Compact Bag[/*][*]Enya and Etain Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Enya, Merlin, and Altam Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Expeditionary Force Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Folamh and Irusan Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]G22 Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Igerna and Caoimhin Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Linden and Sayiv Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Marleid and Piran Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Melwyn and Llywelyn Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Order of the Black Moon Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Pinkie and Katell Compact Doll Bag[/*][*]Splish-Splash Cat and Bug Catcher Pup Compact Doll Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]The Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon now correctly states that it can be used three times, up to a maximum of six.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Sometimes one of the baby reindeer gets a little too excited for Part-Time Jobs and will collide with the Part-Time Job bulletin board in Dunbarton. Don't worry, he's fine and will make a full recovery (after the holidays)![/*][*]A few bags are have incorrect sizes listed in their box description. This is only a text error and does not affect the actual bag.[list][*]Bhatair Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10[/*][*]Morfydrianas Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10[/*][*]Tani Doll Bag Box - states 7x7, actual 7x10[/*][/list][/*][*]🐛[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Erinn-Go-Round Event
notes.content:
[i]What better way to expand your Arcana skills than by traveling all around Erinn! Join Joy on an "Erinn-go-Round" tour to help expand your Arcana skills and even find her missing grandmother along the way. Details below![/i]
[hr][/hr][h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 11th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you'll receive the quest, [b][Guide] Erinn-go-Round Tour Guide's Plea.[/b][/*][*]Register your main character with [b]Erinn-go-Round Tour Guide Joy[/b] in Dunbarton.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Guide] Erinn-go-Round Tour Guide's Plea:[/b][list][*]5,000 EXP[/*][*]You will also gain access to the Erinn-go-Round board, Daily Quests, Achievement Quests, and Event Shop.[/*][/list][/*][*]During the event, earn [b]Dice Points[/b] when you earn [b]EXP through Combat or Production[/b].[list][*]You do [b]not [/b]earn EXP through quest completion.[/*][*]You'll earn 1 Dice Point for every 1,000 EXP you gain and does not accumulate between kills/items produced. Any extra EXP between points will be wasted.[/*][*][b]Dice Points reset each day at 7:00 AM PST.[/b][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2275/erinn-go-round-board-v2.png[/img][/*][*][b]Erinn-go-Round [/b]is a journey that begins in the Soul Stream, and ends right back to where you began.[list][*]You can only make this trip once a day.[/*][*]Use Dice Points to roll the dice.[list][*]You'll move as many spaces as the number you rolled.[/*][/list][/*][*]While Dice Points reset each day, the space you land on will not reset.[/*][*]When you land on a Treasure Chest space, you can get one of the following:[list][*]AP[/*][*]EXP[/*][*]Exploration EXP[/*][*]Crusader EXP[/*][*]Homestead Stones[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b] are event current currency that can be used in the event shop for rewards.[/*][*]Each event day will start at 7:00 AM PST.[/*][*]After the event ends, you will be unable to claim any rewards and the related event quests and coins will be removed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Daily Quest[/b][/h3]
[b][Event] Erinn-go-Round[/b]
[list][*]Travel around the Erinn-go-Round map and arrive back at the Soul Stream.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the daily quest:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]20x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]3x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][/list][/*][*]The daily quest will reset at 7:00 AM PST.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Erinn-go-Round Achievement Quests[/b][/h3][list][*]To unlock the achievement quest, you will need to register a main character.[/*][*]Complete the quest objectives by completing the daily quests and other quest objectives.[/*][/list]
[b][Event] A New Story for Grandma[/b]
[list][*]Complete the Erinn-go-Round Daily Quest 20 times.[list][*]Complete the 1st/6th/11th/16th round trip in Erinn-go-Round.[list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* Red Echostone Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 2nd/7th/12th/17th round trip in Erinn-go-Round[list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* Blue Echostone Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 3rd/8th/13th/18th round trip in Erinn-go-Round[list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* Yellow Echostone Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 4th/9th/14th/19th round trip in Erinn-go-Round[list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* Silver Echostone Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 5th/10th/15th/20th round trip in Erinn-go-Round[list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* Black Echostone Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]600x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]40x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2380/echostone_box.png[/img]
[*][b]*NEW* Echostone Box Details:[/b][/*]When opening an Echostone Box of any type, you will receive an Echostone that is between Grade 10 ~ 20.[*]Boxes expire after 30 days.[/*][/list]
[b][Event] Thank You Card[/b]
[list][*]After completing [Event] A New Story for Grandma, this quest will be unlocked.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest:[/*][list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]200x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][/list][/list]
[b][Event] Erinn-go-Round Explorer[/b]
[list][*]Travel to every one of the 32 locations in Erinn-go-Round.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest.[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]200x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]10x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][*][b]*NEW* Erinn-go-Round Explorer 2nd Title Coupon [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2326/egr-explorer-title.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]Grants +5% Exploration EXP for 30 Days once the coupon is redeemed. After the effects expire, the title can still be used for looks.[/*][*]The coupon is not tradeable.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Special Upgrade Conversion Kit (Event)[/b]
[list][*]A kit that converts the attribute of a Special Upgrade currently applied to a weapon. This does not affect the upgrade level.[/*][*]This item is not tradeable and expires in 30 days.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]The Pathway through Arcana: Dark Arts Quests[/b][/h3]
Joy may love to travel, but she also knows potential talent when she sees it. As you are helping find her grandmother, she will help you with your Arcana growth with the following quests.

[b][Event] Promising Arcana Candidates [/b]
[list][*]Meet the requirements to unlock Arcana Talents![/*][list][*]Reach Cumulative Level 20,000[/*][*]Become a Grandmaster Mage[/*][*]Become a Grandmaster Chain Slasher[/*][*]Become a Grandmaster Battle Alchemist[/*][/list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest:[/*][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]200x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]10x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][*][b]*NEW* Special Upgrade Reset Kit (Event)[/b][/*][list][*]A kit that [b]resets[/b] the state of the Special Upgrade currently applied to a weapon. This will [b]remove the upgrade level and attribute (R/S)[/b]. [/*][*]Although it can be used on “Unable to Special Upgrade” equipment, it does not revert the item to an upgradeable state.[/*][*]Item is not tradable and expires in 30 days.[/*][/list][/list][/list]
[b][Event] Exploring a New Arcana[/b]
[list][*]After completing [Event] Promising Arcana Candidates, this quest will be unlocked.[/*][*]Acquire a new Arcana Talent![/*][list][*]Acquire the Alchemic Sharpshooter or Dark Diviner Arcana Talent.[/*][/list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest:[/*][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]200x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]10x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][*]100x Smoldering Threads[/*][list][*]Threads expire after 30 days.[/*][/list][/list][/list]
[b][Event] The Secret to Strengthening Arcana[/b]
[list][*]After completing [Event] Promising Arcana Candidates, this quest will be unlocked.[/*][*]Strengthen your Arcana talents![/*][list][*]Unlock Arcana Link 1 time for any Arcana Talent.[/*][/list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest:[/*][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]200x Erinn-go-Round Coins[/b][/*][*]10x Finest Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][list][*]Stimulants expire after 14 days.[/*][/list][*]20x Frostflame Threads[/*][list][*]Threads expire after 30 days.[/*][/list][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Erinn-go-Round Emporium[/b][/h3]
Need more Echostone boxes? How about a cute Cowenna Speech Bubble Sticker? Joy has you covered! Check out all the goods at Joy's Erinn-go-Round Emporium!

notes.title: Letter from the Director: The First of Many!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1930/231117-wgc-499-mb-directorsletter-940x290.png[/img]

Greetings Milletians,

I am writing to you today to formally introduce myself to you. My name is Min Kyunghun, and I am the Director of Mabinogi. I have been working in the Mabinogi team as a developer for 10 years, and it is an honor to be your director for the last 3 years now. In the last 3 years, I have been in charge of the many updates such as the Commerce renewal, NEXT, Arcana, and the most recent BEYOND update. 

Last month, several members of my team and myself visited the Nexon office in North America to visit the Mabinogi team. During the trip, we aligned on future projects that will take place over 2024 and beyond, the current state of the game, and discussed ways to improve Mabinogi for players. It was a very meaningful trip where we could share our passion for Mabinogi, and based on this passion, I am hoping to share more messages and communicate closely with you. 

I am also preparing a short video to share with you to introduce myself. Since this is my first video to greet you, I will include my introduction, discuss light topics you might wonder, and will answer some questions asked to me by some active community members, the Soul Streamers, and Discord Moderators.

As a Milletian myself, I am constantly looking for ways to improve your gameplay experience by gathering and reviewing the many shared experiences and feedback from the community. 

With many changes released in the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/62617#2023UPDATES]past year[/url], such as the NEXT updates, the most recent [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86893/beyond-update]BEYOND update[/url], and coming very soon, [b]the “Arcana: Dark Arts” update[/b], I’m glad to see how bountiful and blooming Erinn has been in the North American service and I am proud to be your Director. In the upcoming months, please look forward to more announcements and news shared by myself, your producer, or other members of the Mabinogi team! I leave you with this, Milletians:

 
“Thank you, for coming to this world…“ 



[b]What’s next, you ask?[/b]

“A small lantern dangles loosely from his belt, casting a golden glow that moves gently with him.” 
[i](A description describing a familiar face, Loiscneach)[/i]

… the lantern’s glow catches your attention, and in the blink of an eye, a flash! 
As your vision unblurs, you see a blue gift box neatly gift wrapped at your feet. 

[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87637/director-s-box-of-goodies-hotday-event][b]Should you pick it up?[/b][/url]

notes.title: BEYOND Update - Patch Notes - November 16th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the BEYOND Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87118/master-plan-winter-infinite-growth-event]Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87395/winter-specialist-doll-bag-box]Winter Specialist Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/87031/part-time-for-the-holidays-event]Part-Time for the Holidays Event[/url]: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86955/resistance-box]Resistance Box[/url]: Thursday, November 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86893/beyond-update]BEYOND Update[/url] : Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]BEYOND Update:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86893/beyond-update]BEYOND Update[/url][/b]
[list][*]Part-time jobs have been improved. Read all about them with the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/system/87328/part-time-job-guide]Part-Time Job Guide[/url][/b]![/*][*]The Growth Guide has been added. Check out the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/system/87375/growth-guide-handbook]Growth Guide Handbook[/url][/b]![/*][*]Our beloved spirit, Eiry, has returned![/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Certain ranks of the Fishing skill’s description have been updated.[/*][*]Tamers rejoice, it has arrived. Fixed the issue where you could not collect the 5 star taming journal of the following monsters:
[list][*]Cloaker: Peaca Intermediate Dungeon[/*][*]Grumbill: Shadow Mission ‘Defeat Fomor Commander II’[/*][*]Wight: Peaca Basic Dungeon[/*][*]Kobold: Math Advanced Dungeon[/*][*]Ghoul: Peaca Normal Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]To address feedback that the dungeon vouchers were out of order on the Currency menu, we have renamed them from First/Second/Third/Fourth Vouchers to 1st/2nd/3rd/4th Vouchers. Behold the list in all its organized splendor.[/*][*]Polished the standard text on the Title menu for clarity.
[list][*]This change is being made to the UI text. The titles and title display are unchanged.[/*][/list][/*][*]In order to make the Welcome Milletian Package's contents as clear as possible, we have renamed the 'Spirit Weapon Contract and Growth Box' to 'Spirit Weapon Starter Kit and Growth Box'. The contents of this are unchanged.[/*][*]In order to make the action more clear, we have retranslated the menu when using a Loot-o'-Lantern. 
[list][*]Additionally, we have added a note to all Loot-o'-Lanterns that you must be in Iria to use it.[/*][/list][/*][*]As Rua deserves the best and only the best, we have improved her dialogue during the "[Dorcha Conversion] Artifacts of Bean Rua" quest.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]How strange- two enchant scrolls shared similar names of Strange and Strange_. We have renamed them as follows: 
[list][*]Strange (Rank 9) Enchant has been renamed to Weird.[/*][*]Strange_ (Rank 3) Enchant has had the stray space at the end of its enchant name removed. (Strange_ > Strange)[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally, the Water Drop (Rank A) Enchant should now be displayed as Water Drop in all areas, as opposed to Droplet.[/*][*]Corrected an issue where Elves could not move while the Eternal Resistance Two-Handed Sword Appearance Scroll was applied on an equipped weapon. Castanea asks that you forget this.[/*][*]Blue Coupons were displaying as blank items on the updated Logout screen, and shall no longer do so.[/*][*]Polished the text on a few Iria Exploration Quests. Most notably: 
[list][*]Two not-quite-as-famous deities of Erinn, Paea and Kheridwen, have been retranslated as "Phaea" and "Ceridwen".[/*][*]No longer shall two quests ask you to Defeat 10 Black Forest Mushroom Spiders, as one has been correctly renamed to Defeat 10 Blue Forest Mushroom Spiders.[/*][/list][/*][*]We accidentally'd a word on the Ace Hero Ampoule Sets. They now indicate that they are Ampoule Sets, rather than singular ampoules. Treasure Hunter is complaining, but Starlet will calm him down.[/*][*]Minor text polish on the Generations, while we were in there for Beyond.[/*][*]Removed a few more references to Inventory Plus Kit from certain Bag Coupons.[/*][*]Players reported a handful of items where the (M) and (F) descriptions were swapped. Whoops! These have been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed a rare crash issue on certain chairs.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug fixes from the October 19th and 26th Maintenances:[/b]
[list][*]Six NPC transformations from Samhain's Mysterious Transformation Medal Box were not properly registered, causing the relevant medals to display blank. The following transformations have been added, and previously blank medals are now able to be used.
[list][*]Altam the Energetic, Avelin the Wrap Artist, Caswyn the Listless, Llywelyn the Perpetually Unimpressed, Pihne the Seller of Souvenirs, and Talvish the Middle Manager[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue that prevented the use of Birman Bag Coupons while possessing specific Totem Bags.[/*][*]Giants have recently started to uniquely travel upon their Purrlings. In fear for the kitty backs, the act of Purrling Surfing has been made illegal by royal decree.[/*][*]Some players noted that the new logout/exit game feature was too big for their resolution.
[list][*]The number of items that can display has been reduced to improve this issue.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon displays the old increase totals of '+2 for a total of 5'. This item can correctly be used three times for a total of six Spirit weapons, only the text is incorrect.[/*][*]🐛[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1776/231113-wgc-485-wintermasterplanevent-2023-940x290.jpg[/img]

Get primed for a promotion this season with the Winter Infinite Growth Event! Clock-in to earn EXP and rewards through the various training and collection events, or log in for hotday rewards!
[h2][b]Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] It's Not Delivery, it's da Gig Economy![/b][/*][*]Find [b]FomorDash Talent Acquisition Specialist Joe[/b] in Dunbarton.[/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1511/boost-up-icon.png[/img][list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] It's Not Delivery, it's da Gig Economy!:
[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*]Access to the Employee Handbook menu
[list][*]View your play records during the event period, available benefits, or move to the Scouts through this menu![/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the quest: [b][Guide] Sign Up for Membership[/b][/*][*]Talk to FomorDash Talent Acquisition Specialist Joe in Dunbarton to register a main character for the event.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.
The main character will have access to the following benefits:
[list][*]Inventory Rental Bag (Master Plan Inventory)[/*][*]Pet Rental[/*][*]Weekly Quests[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Sign Up for Membership:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*]SuperCharge Energy Drink[list][*]Drink this to increase your stats for the duration of the event:[/*][*]Defense +10[/*][*]Protection +5[/*][*]Magic Defense +10[/*][*]Magic Protection +5[/*][*]HP +500[/*][*]MP +500[/*][*]Stamina +500[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Event Buffs[/b][/h2][list][*]During the [b]entire event period[/b], the following benefits will be active:[list][*]100% Free Repair Fee[/*][*]Free Hero Talent Rebirth[/*][*]Free Appearance Change for Pon styles[/*][*]Reward limit for obtaining the Crom Bas Weekly Reward will be increased to 12 times[/*][*]Reward limit for clearing the Daily Lord Mission will be increased to 5 times[/*][*]Reward limit for clearing the Alban Knights Training Mission will be increased to 5 times[/*][/list][/*][*]During [b]Hot Weekends[/b] (Saturday, Sunday, and Monday), the following benefits will be active:[list][*]Echostone Advancement Success Rate +10%[/*][*]Special Upgrade Success Rate +5%[/*][*]Enchant Success Rate +10%[/*][*]Alchemy Success Rate +10%[/*][*]Production Success Rate +10%[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Stardust Increase Level Success Rate +5%[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Weekly Event Quests and Benefits[/h2][list][*]Each week during the event period, select a store to take on a FomorDash Part-Time Gig for the week.
[list][*]On the finale week, you can receive the benefits and support from all of the stores![/*][*]Only the main character can receive the Combat Support Box.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the weekly quest, [b][Event] Choosing a FomorDash Part-Time Gig[/b].[/*][*]Once you choose a store for the week, you cannot select a new one until the weekly reset on [b]Thursdays at 7:00 AM PST[/b].
[list][*]The store selection can be reset if a [b]Contract Reset Coupon[/b] is used. Speak to Specialist Joe to learn more and use the coupon.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive two quests for the week depending on the store you choose: a [b]daily clock-in attendance quest[/b] and a [b]store’s weekly task quest[/b].
[list][*]Weekly Tasks quests will require you to complete several objectives for rewards.[/*][*]Weekly Attendance quests will require you to log in each day for 5 days for rewards.[/*][*]When each quest is completed, you will receive [b]FomorDosh x40[/b], which can be used in the FomorDash FoMarket event shop.[/*][*]All rewards from the Weekly Task Quest and Attendance Quest, except for the Gold Grandmaster Certificate, expires in 15 days.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Store & NPC
[/b][/th][th][b]Benefits[/b][/th][th][b]Weekly Task Quest Rewards[/b][/th][th][b]Attendance Quest Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
[b]General Shop[/b]
[b](Walter)[/b]

[h2][b]Finale Week[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, January 11th, 2024 After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During Week 9, all event benefits from the scouts will be available.[list][*]The following items will only be given to the main character:[list][*]Combat Buff Support Box[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]During Week 9, you will receive the quest [b][Event] Event FomorDash Member Missions[/b].[list][*]Complete quest objectives to receive more rewards![list][*]Baltane Mission Crystal (x3)[/*][*]Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][*]Potent Finest Shadow Crystal[/*][*]Pet EXP Potion (1 Day)[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest to receive FomorDosh x40.[/*][/list][/*][*]Also during Week 9, you will receive the quest [b][Event] FomorDash Member Attendance Award[/b].[list][*]Login each day to receive daily rewards.[list][*]Day 1: Dungeon/SM/Baltane Elite Pass Selection Box[/*][*]Day 2: Amplified Skill Training Seal (50)[/*][*]Day 3: Renown Seal (250) Selection Box x5[/*][*]Day 4: Pet Rebirth Potion (Event)[/*][*]Day 5: Mysterious Spirit Stone (50%)[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest to receive FomorDosh x40[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Marvelous Ma-BINGO-gi! Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1301/231017_marvelous_ma-bingo-gi_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

We put the "bingo" in Mabingo... Ma-bingo-gi... Mabinogi! Stay logged in and receive bingo coins to try your hand at the Marvelous Bingo Board. Check out all the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates: Thursday, October 26th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 16th, Before Maintenance[/b]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - October 19th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2913/230321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 10:04 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.
[/b]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on October 19th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, October 19th[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]The family is packin' it up and ready to go home after their long vacation. The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86167/family-weekend-fishing-event-returns]Family Weekend Fishing Event Returns![/url] is ending.[/*][*]Fashion Week is ending in Erinn, and we're cleaning up the apparel. The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86193/bleugenne-by-bleugenne-cosmetics-box]BLEUGENNE by Bleugenne Cosmetics Box Sale[/url] is ending.[/*][*]Heed our warning, Milletian: only the bravest in all of Erinn dare to open this jar... the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86718/midnight-investigator-loot-o-lantern]Midnight Investigator Loot-o'-Lantern Sale[/url] is starting![/*][*]As a reminder, it's the 7th and final week of the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85758/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-4]The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4[/url]![list][*]Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm), Mag Mell, and Tech Duinn Missions will have dungeon key drops and increased drop rates.[/*][/list][/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. Note: The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that prevented the use of Birman Bag Coupons while possessing specific Totem Bags.[/*][*]Giants have recently started to uniquely travel upon their Purrlings. In fear for the kitty backs, the act of Purrling Surfing has been made illegal by royal decree.[/*][*]Some players noted that the new logout/exit game feature was too big for their resolution. The number of items that can display has been reduced to improve this issue. [/*][/list]
- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: October Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - October 12
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the October Quality of Life Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86167/family-weekend-fishing-event-returns]Family Weekend Fishing Event Returns![/url]: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86193/bleugenne-by-bleugenne-cosmetics-box]BLEUGENNE by Bleugenne Cosmetics Box[/url]: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85758/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-4]Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86589/samhain-times-remembered-times-forgotten-event]Samhain: Times Forgotten, Times Remembered Event[/url]: Thursday, October 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86712/shopkeeper-s-sale-spooky-halloween-horror]Shopkeeper's Sale: Spooky Halloween Horror![/url]: October 12th, 2023, After Maintenance - November 2nd, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86488/moonshadow-emissary-box]Moonshadow Emissary Box[/url]: Thursday, October 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86550/october-quality-of-life-updates]October Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]October Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added with the October update. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86550/october-quality-of-life-updates]October Quality of Life Updates[/url]
[list][*]The Equipment Appearance Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]The Currency tab has been added.
The Quest Helper System has been improved.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Commerce Alban Eiler Season 2:[/b]
[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on November 1st, 2023 and run until March 1st, 2024 12:00 AM PST.[list][*]Alban Eiler Season 1 will conclude on Friday, October 31st, 11:59 PM PDT.[/*][*]The following new outfits and sewing patterns have been added. The sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop in Season 2 for 3,000,000 Seasonal Ducats:[list][*]Refashioned Coco Sailor Mini
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1128/refashioned-coco-sailor-mini.png[/img][/*][*]Refashioned Mini Leather Dress
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1129/refashioned-mini-leather-dress-image.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]Purchase limits within Sayiv’s shop will be reset.[/*][*]The Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger 2nd Title
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1134/alban-eiler-season-2-challenger-2nd-title-lorge.gif[/img]
[list][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][*]20 Precise Reforging Tools[/*][/list][/*][*]The Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Season 2, and Alban Eiler Season 1 information will be archived.[/*][*]The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.[/*][*]Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The width of the Character Status Effects UI menu has been increased so that active effect names are no longer cut… off.[/*][*]Added a line on Starblaze Fishing Rod's description to indicate that it increases the amount of Items fished up.[/*][*]As it wasn't entirely true, we've altered the Theta cooldown message from "resets during maintenance" to "resets Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time". We'll want to make this change in more places in the future for clarity.[list][*]While "Server Time" isn't perfect, we find it a bit more preferable to "Earth Time"- which as it turns out, has multiple time zones.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Text fixes to the Generations, renaming Mini Effects to Minimize VFX, Jousting corrections, and more fixes have been included during the September patch cycle, yet after the initial September patch. See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85554/september-jousting-renewal-quality-of-life-updates-patch-notes-september-7]September Patch Notes[/url] for more details![/*][*]Some people heard the whispers of a Weird Cat when failing to complete their Dan Tests. No longer shall they hear its mews.[/*][*]Elsie and Shuan have been feeling ill since eating Altam's leftovers, leaving them in a state of constant screams. They have since received Party Healing, and their mouths are back to their regular size and shape.[/*][*]Corrected a visual issue when wearing Languhiris Chaser Gloves alongside Royal Knight Armor.[/*][*]A few Sewing Patterns had counterfit copies issued. Walter has since issued a recall, and the following patterns now work as expected: 
[list][*]Sewing Pattern - Elegant Gothic Suit[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Lacard's Layered Muffler Robe[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Classic Shoes[/*][/list][/*][*]The Advanced Search for Pet Type now appropriately uses the pet type names instead of numbers.[list][*]Where "11" would previously bring up all the Bears, now "Bear" will.[/*][/list][/*][*]Lileas was a bit distracted during the 7:00 PM PT nightly Jousting Prelims, and started the initial match's registration time five minutes later than expected. Alpin was seen giving her a lecture on responsible Honey Drink consumption practices.[list][*]Registrations for 7:00 PM PT Jousting Preliminary matches now can be accessed at 6:45 PM PT as expected.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Giants have developed a unique way of riding Purrlings, causing their models to be misaligned.[/*][*]You cannot use Birman Flat Pouch coupon while possessing one of the new Horizontal Totem Bags.[b]
[/b][/*][*]You cannot use Birman Knapsack coupon while possessing one of the new Vertical Totem Bags.[/*][*][b]🐛[/b][/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Samhain: Times Remembered, Times Forgotten Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1139/231003-wgc-266-mb-halloweensamhain-940x290.jpg[/img]

You've been invited to participate in this year's Samhain. Watch the story unfold and retrieve precious memories as you complete the Singer of Secret's quests! Check out all the details here!

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, October 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b][b]Event Details[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A New Tale for Samhain Eve[/b].
You will receive an [b]Unsigned Invitation[/b] upon logging in during the event.[list][*]Use the invitation to be spirited to the Dunbarton Library instantly.[/*][/list][/*][*]Meet with the [b]Singer of Secrets[/b] in Dunbarton Library to register a main character.
You can only register one character per account.
You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A New Tale for Samhain Eve:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]2,023 Gold[/*][*][b]Story Snippet x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Story Snippets[/b] are event currency that can be used in the event shop for rewards.[/*][*]Every day when the main character logs in, [b]Story Snippet x10[/b] will be obtained.[/*][*]As a main character, you will be eligible to take part in a new story for Samhain, meet new characters, and immerse yourself with new BGM and NPC voice over (Korean) and obtain rewards along the way!
[list][*]The volume of the voices can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Voice Volume.[/*][/list][/*][*]The reset time for event quests and mini-games will reset each day at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][*]All event quests and event items will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2][b][b]Memories of Samhain Event Quests[/b][/b][/h2]
[b]Quests' Challenge Level [/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will select the challenge level. The difficulty of the story quests will change depending on the choice you make.[/*][*]You can change your choice at any time by speaking with the Singer of Secrets again about [b]Change Quest Challenge Level[/b].[/*][*]Quest rewards do not vary depending on difficulty, and all quest rewards are the same.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1136/quest-difficulty-ui.png[/img]

[b]Story Quests [/b]
[list][*]There are several story quests that you can complete during the event period.[/*][*]After clearing a story quest, the next story quest will unlock after 7:00 AM PT the next day.
[list][*][b][Event] A Thief of Memories [/b][/*][*][b][Event] In Search of Vanished Footprints[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Friday, October 13, 2023)[/*][*][b][Event] The World Within the Mirror[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Saturday, October 14, 2023)[/*][*][b][Event] What the Dead Remember[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Sunday, October 15, 2023)[/*][*][b][Event] As Time Slips Away[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Monday, October 16, 2023)[/*][*][b][Event] A Somber Greeting[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Tuesday, October 17, 2023)[/*][*][b][Event] To the Rekindler of Memories, our Guiding Light[/b] (Available after 7:00 AM on Wednesday, October 18, 2023)[/*][/list][/*][*]Some story quests will reward the following items once completed:
[list][*]100,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Story Snippet x30[/b][/*][*][b]Onyx x10[/b][/*][*][b]Fine Onyx x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Other story quests will reward the following items once completed:
[list][*]100,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Pocketwatch Amulet x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional Stat Stone (Regular) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Story Snippet x30[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]When completing the final story quest, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Life Goes On[/b].[/*][*]Meet with the Singer of Secrets to complete this quest, rewarding the following items:
[list][*]100,000 EXP[/*][*][b]The Singer of Secrets’ Mysterious Note[/b]
[list][*]Read the note, and right-click and select “Use” to play a cutscene.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Forgetful Potion (Not Tradable) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Pocketwatch Amulet x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional Stat Stone (Regular) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Story Snippet x30[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]When completing [Event] Life Goes On, you will be presented with an option - choose carefully![/*][/list][h2][b][b]Daily Quest and Mini-Game Details[/b][/b][/h2]
[b][Event] But the Memories Remain[/b]
[list][*]From week 2 on Thursday, October 19th (after maintenance), the [b][Event] But the Memories Remain[/b] daily quest will be available.[/*][*]To unlock the daily quest, you will need to complete the final story quest, [Event] Life Goes On.[/*][*]Each day, you will receive the Daily Quest, [Event] But the Memories Remain.[/*][*]Examine the huge mirror in the Dunbarton Library to play the mini-game, Searching for Memories.[/*][*]Talk to the Singer of Secrets to complete the quest. You will receive the following rewards after completing the daily quest:[list][*]30,000 Experience Points[/*][*][b]Onyx x5[/b][/*][*][b]Story Snippet x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The daily quest resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][/list]
[b][Event] In Search of Taller Tales[/b]
[list][*]From week 3 on Thursday, October 26th (after maintenance), the [b][Event] In Search of Taller Tales[/b] daily quest will be available.[/*][*]To unlock the daily quest, you will need to complete the final story quest, [Event] Life Goes On.[/*][*]Each day, you will receive the Daily Quest, [Event] In Search of Taller Tales.[/*][*]Meet with Annick at the pub in Port Cobh to play the mini-game, Card Seeker. [/*][*]Talk to the Singer of Secrets to complete the quest. You will receive the following rewards after completing the daily quest:
[list][*]30,000 Experience Points[/*][*][b]Fine Onyx x1[/b][/*][*][b]Pocketwatch Amulet x1[/b][/*][*][b]Story Snippet x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The daily quest resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][/list]
[b]Mini-games[/b]
[list][*]After completing the final story quest, you can play 2 types of mini-games.[/*][*]From week 2 on Thursday, October 19th (after maintenance), the [b]Searching for Memories[/b] mini-game will be available.[list][*][b]Searching for Memories[/b]
[list][*]Collect 10 memory fragments while avoiding the spinning clock hands.[list][*]Use the Action "Prone" to avoid the clock hands.[/*][/list][/*][*]Rewards include:[list][*][b]1x Onyx Box[/b][/*][*][b]Combat EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]From week 3 on Thursday, October 26th (after maintenance), the [b]Card Seeker[/b] mini-game will be available[list][*][b]Card Seeker[/b][list][*]To win, you must find the correct card two or more times among all of the shuffled cards.[/*][*]Rewards include:[list][*][b]1x Onyx Box[/b][/*][*][b]Combat EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]You may receive something special depending on your performance in the Card Seeker mini-game...[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The mini-games can be played an unlimited number of times.[/*][*]Rewards for mini-games can only be obtained up to 5 times per day, regardless of the type of mini-game.[/*][*]The mini-game reward count resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Achievement Quest Details[/b][/h2]
[b][Event] Stories of the Samhain Season[/b]
[list][*]To unlock the achievement quest, you will need to register a main character.[/*][*]Complete the quest objectives by completing the Story Quest and daily quests. [list][*]Clear the ‘Life Goes On’ quest.

notes.title: October Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1147/231003-wgc-319-mb-oct-update-940x290.jpg[/img][/h2][h2][b]October Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2]
[b]Equipment Inventory Slot[/b]

A new function has been added to the Dressing Room!
[list][*]The [b]Equipment Appearance Slot[/b] system has been added to the Dressing Room.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1151/equipment-appearance-slot.png[/img][list][*]Save the changed appearance of an equipment to a slot or change it to a different appearance using the change option.[/*][*]Characters will have three Equipment Appearance Slots by default.[/*][*]You can store different dyed versions of the same appearance scroll in separate slots.[/*][*]Equipment Appearance Slots are not shared among other characters within the account.[/*][*]Equipment Appearance Slots can be expanded by using [b]30 Pon[/b].[/*][*]Maximum expanded slots is up to 300.[/*][/list][/*][*]Weapon Appearance Scrolls of some weapons have been added to NPC Shop.[list][*]Sold from Nerys in Dunbarton when selecting the "Misc" tab.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls have been added:[list][*]Bastard Sword Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Mace Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Bipennis Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Claymore Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Leather Long Bow Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Crossbow Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Physis Wooden Lance Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Cardinal Chain Blade Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Basic Control Bar Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Wood Atlatl Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Spiked Knuckle Appearance Scroll[/*][*]Spiral Shuriken Appearance Scroll[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Currency Storage[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1153/currencies-ui-plus-button.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]The [b]Currency[/b] tab has been added.
[list][*]Currency items that are used to purchase items at NPC shops will now be stored in the Currency tab located when clicking the Inventory icon on the UI rather than in your inventory or bag. [/*][*]Gold and Ducats will remain in your inventory. [/*][*]Open the menu through Inventory > Currency tab, or set a hotkey for it under Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings > Currencies. [/*][/list][/*][*]The items that have been converted to currency and moved into three categories of the Currency tab are as follows:[list][*][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Adventurer Seal
[/*][*]Basic/Intermediate/Advanced Baltane Seal
[/*][*]Gold-Leaf Pine Cone
[/*][*]Royal Society Sponsorship Badge
[/*][*]Returned Milletian’s Seal[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Battle[/b]
[list][*]First Voucher
[/*][*]Second Voucher
[/*][*]Third Voucher
[/*][*]Fourth Voucher
[/*][*]Adamantine Coin
[/*][*]Frostwork Crystal Shard
[/*][*]Field Raid Memento[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Event[/b]
[list][*]Note: Limited timed event coins and currencies will be stored here while the corresponding event is active.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]With this new feature, the Currency Storage notification will always display each time you log in until you open the Currency Storage for the first time. [list][*]To remove this notification, open the Currency tab once.[/*][/list][/*][*]Certain currencies can be withdrawn from the bank menu.[/*][/list][h3]The Quest Helper System[/h3][list][*]The [b]Quest Helper System[/b] has been improved.[/*][*]The quest help button can be checked in the quest window.[list][*]The Altruist rankings reset periodically.[/*][*]This new season ranking is separate from the existing cumulative help score ranking with each season lasting for 3 months before resetting. [/*][*]The first season will run until January 1, 2024 at 12:00 AM PT. [/*][*]The [b]Season Ranking schedule[/b] for each season is:[list][*]January~March / April~June / July~September / October~December[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The quest helper related rewards have been changed and new rewards have been added.
[list][*]After the season ends, the top 100 players in the season will be able to support story shadow missions, similar to a Royal Alchemist, until the end of the next season.[/*][*]Titles are awarded based on the Total Quest Help Provided. (Effect applied when title is activated)[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Title[/b][/th][th][b]Total Quest Help Provided[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]The Courteous (2nd Title)[/td][td]More than 50 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Attentive Altruist (1st Title)[/td][td]More than 100 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Master Altruist (1st Title)[/td][td]More than 200 times [/td][/tr][tr][td]Erinn’s Most Benevolent Altruist (1st Title)[/td][td]More than 300 times[/td][/tr][/table][h3][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1154/altruist-titles.png[/img][/h3][list][*]Requirements to acquire “the Courteous” 2nd title have been changed.[list][*]Obtain title by completing 50 or more quest assists.[/*][*]If you have already completed 50 or more quest assists, then this title will be awarded after "Helping Out" 1 time after the update.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each title will have its own unique effect when equipped and will not expire.
[list][*]If you have already progressed the Quest Help more than the required number for the title acquisitions then you will obtain the title when you complete 1 "Helping Out" request after the update.
[/*][/list][/*][*]A Help button has been changed to Quest Help.
[list][*]The Quest Help button can be checked in the Quest window.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that notifications can be set on the Altruism Quest Board.[list][*]You can now enable [b]Altruist Notifications [/b]from the Altruism Quest Board.[list][*]This will send you a notification when a user requests assistance for a quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can still register to be an Altruist through the NPC Weird Cat in the Chief’s House in Tir Chonaill. [/*][*]The notification change limit will be reset every day at 7:00 AM Erinn time.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now check the number of Quest Help Provided on the Altruism Quest Board.[/*][*]Quests that can be requested for help will display a [b]Request Help[/b] button in the Quest Info window, and when pressed, the quest will automatically be set as a Help Request Quest.[/*][*]Quest Help criteria and scores have been improved.
[list][*]Completing a "Help Out" request has been changed from "when pressing the Complete button" to "when completing the last objective" of the quest.[/*][*]Removed the deduction of Altruism points if no help is provided for a certain period of time.[/*][*]Altruism points can now be obtained from an account only once per day.[/*][*]Altruism points can be earned again after 12:00 AM PT.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Additional Changes[/b][/h3]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1155/logout-ui.png[/img]

[b]New Log Off Notice[/b]
[list][*]New information will be displayed when attempting to log off.[/*][*]The following information will be displayed:[list][*]Items in your inventory that will expire within 24 hours[/*][*]Event currency[/*][*]Quests that are in progress[/*][*]Unclaimed quest rewards[/*][*]Attempting to log off during combat will show EXP and Gold penalty and time remaining until safe log off is possible[/*][/list][/*][*]Clicking on an item within the UI will open the inventory and the location of the item is displayed.
[/*][*]Clicking on a quest name in the UI will open the quest UI opens on the tab where the quest is in.[/*][/list]
[b]Individual Inventory and Chat Windows[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1158/inventory-splits.png[/img]
[list][*]Individual Inventory and Chat features have been added.[/*][*]The “Me” and VIP inventory tab can now be displayed in a separate window.[list][*]If VIP service is not active, the inventory cannot be separated into its own window.
[/*][*]The sorting and tagging features are not available for Me and VIP inventory when separated.
[/*][*]The effects of using the Inventory Expansion Coupon and Inventory Expansion Coupon PLUS items are equally applied to the separated Me and VIP inventory.
[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1157/individual-chat-windows.png[/img]
[list][*]You can also display various Message Log tabs in separate windows.[list][*]You can now have 20 active whisper chat logs visible.[list][*]Whisper chat logs will be reset when changing channels, or reconnecting to a channel.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each chat category will have their corresponding chat tags such as @ for Whisper or # for Party fixated in the message input box.[/*][*]You can recombine individual chat windows by pressing the X button on the separated individual windows.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Damage Skins[/b]
[list][*]Damage skins can be toggled on or off using "Activate" and "Deactivate".[/*][*]You can disable others' damage skins under Options > Performance > Hide Others' Damage Skins.[/*][/list][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - October 5th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2913/230321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 9:23 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.
[/b]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on October 5th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, October 5th[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]

notes.title: September Jousting Renewal & Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - September 7
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the September Quality of Life Updates & the September Jousting Renewal Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85541/sea-angel-box]Sea Angel Box[/url]: Thursday, August 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 21st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/86020/sestia-academy-box]Sestia Academy Box[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 5th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85758/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-4]Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85880/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-4]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4[/url]: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85932/jousting-tournament-renewal-update]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85915/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]September Jousting Renewal & Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]The Jousting Tournament Renewal is here! Check in with Lileas and review the updated details here: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85932/jousting-tournament-renewal-update]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/url]
[list][*]The preliminary and tournament match times have been updated.[/*][*]Up to 64 combatants can participate in the Jousting Finals.[/*][*]Skills exclusive to Jousting have been added.[/*][*]New rewards have been added to Lileas’ shop which Jousting Points can be exchanged for.[/*][*]The ability to cheer on combatants has been added, rewarding Jousting Points when spectating.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][*]Several quality of life changes have been added with the September update. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85915/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url]
[list][*]Several inventory improvements have been implemented, such as a fishing box, trash can function, and changes to the Inventory Search functions.[/*][*]Elves and Giants can now get married in Emain Macha![/*][*]Dan Advancement tests have been balanced so that you can achieve your Dan ranks more comfortably.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Updated the Word Filter to allow “Swap”, “C8”, and “Lesbian”.[/*][*]You can now use Rage Impact with the following Two-Handed Clubs: [list][*]Sheep Mace [/*][*]Lovey Dovey Cotton Candy [/*][*]Merchants' Guild Abacus [/*][*]Seashell Plushie [/*][*]Beluga Whale Plushie [/*][*]Dumbo Octopus Plushie [/*][*]Black Rose Bouquet [/*][*]Black Rose Clutch [/*][*]Glass Trim Bouquet [/*][*]Sacred Glow Censer [/*][*]Sacred Glow Holy Water [/*][*]Fairy Bubble Blower [/*][*]Seraphic Cantabile Holy Censer[/*][/list][/*][*]In order to better tell them apart, we have renamed the 24-Hour cooldown “Forgetful Potion” to “Special Forgetful Potion”. The 7-Day cooldown version will remain the same. [list][*]The descriptions for both have been updated to make the effects more clear. [/*][/list][/*][*]Renamed “Sephirot Arrow” to “Sephirot Bolt”, as these can only be fired via Crossbow. [/*][*]The buff effect for Baltane Mission Crystals has been changed from "Shadow Crystal" to "Baltane Crystal", in order to make them more distinct from Shadow Crystals.[/*][*](As of the August 10th Maintenance) It has been changed so that when you use a Weapon Appearance Scroll, the color of the item will now follow the color codes of the item the Weapon Appearance Scroll was based on. Before, the color was assigned randomly.[list][*]This change applies only to the appearance scrolls obtained after the August 10th update patch.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The Gather Stackable Items buttons will no longer restack and highlight stacks that are already at maximum. This improves the performance of this button.[/*][*]Improved the Pet Dye UI to fit RGB values properly.[/*][*]Continued our constant pursuit of polish by fixing up typos in G3, G24, and G25.[/*][*]Joust in time, we've performed a polish pass on the Jousting-related text![/*][*]Do you hear bells? We've also improved the Marriage-related text![/*][*]Fixed the text on Zone of Renewal to correct the ability cost from Phantasmal Amalgam to Phantasmal Remnant. The actual cost is unchanged.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Intact Shyllien (Part-Time Job only) and Energy Converter (Part-Time Job only) placed in pet inventories could not be retrieved.[/*][*]The ability Mirage Missile was not properly granting stats from ranking the skill up. For those whose Mirage Missile was already ranked up, you will receive the missing stats automatically following a Rebirth.[/*][*]Floating heads no more- Fixed an issue where NPC-style Transformations would lack a body when transforming with a full body Robe equipped in your Gear slot.[/*][*]Corrected a few graphical issues on the Rookie Barista Uniform (M).[/*][*](Fixed during the August 17th Maintenance) Commerce rejoice and wyverns beware - Fixed an issue with Poison Potions that would prevent players from crafting Poison Tip Wyvern Ballista Bolts.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug fixes from the September 14th Maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Heavy Strike! Fixed an issue where the number of players able to join the Jousting Tournaments was incorrect. Up to 16 players may join the Preliminary matches, and up to 64 players may join the Finals.
[/*][*]Counter! The ticker times for the Preliminary matches now correctly displays the proper times.
[/*][*]Focus! The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary now displays the proper Prelims Jousting times.
[/*][*]Unbreakable Defense! The Cheer Squad has set their alarms and will now properly show up at the updated match times.[/*][*]In an effort to improve the flavor of Mabinogi's early-game experience, we have revised the descriptions for a number of early-game weapons commonly available in NPC shops.[/*][*]Removed an out-of-date mechanic reference on some older Staves. More Stave descriptions will be updated in a later patch.
[/*][*]Polished the descriptions of the myriad Shadow Crystals to make the effect more clear.
[/*][*]Provided a little more polish for the Wedding text. Hope your love springs eternal!
[/*][*]The recipes for Arbalest and Highlander Long Bow have been updated to remove "Radiant Tough String" for the correct "Radiant String". This is a text only change, the functionality for these recipes is unchanged.[/*][*]Improved the objectives for the Carpentry Grandmaster Missions to better indicate that the [Average/Fine/Finest] Firewood must be Made, not Obtained.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]When viewing the additional information in the character information UI, there is some text cut off at the bottom of the Jousting information.[/*][*]The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary still has the incorrect time for the Sunday Jousting Finals.[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
[/*][*]There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.[/*][/list]
