notes.title: The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1476/210525-mbw-2583-investinyourgrowth-940x290.jpg[/img]

Ethel the Billionaire is here to support your growth needs once again! Ethel will be providing support to all Milletians by selling passes to dungeons. Along with Ethel, drop rates will be increased and you can also obtain the maximum amount of keys, regardless of how many players are in the dungeon! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Investing in the Future.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Ethel[/b] near the Bank in [b]Dunbarton[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Ethel.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Investing in the Future.[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Key Drop and Increased Drop Rates[/b][/h2][list][*]During certain weeks of the event, upon completing certain dungeons, your party will receive the [b]maximum amount of keys[/b] available, regardless of how many party members are in the dungeon.[/*][*]There will also be [b]increased drop rates[/b] of the dungeon end treasure chest.[list][*]During the Mag Mell week, drop rates for Boss Kills will also be increased. [/*][/list][/*][*]When you clear Taillteann or Tara Shadow Missions with [Elite Difficulty], you’ll have a chance to earn additional [b]Erinn Spirits[/b].[list][*]After collecting 10x [b]Erinn Spirits[/b], you can select “Use” to combine them together.[list][*]You will obtain one 2nd Title Coupon of a various NPC in Erinn.[/*][*]2nd Title Coupons obtained are not tradable, but can be shared within the bank.[/*][/list][/*][*]If the 2nd Title Coupon obtained is used but you already have the title, you will receive 1/10 Erinn Spirits back instead.[/*][/list][/*][*]On the final week of the event, all three listed dungeons/missions will have dungeon key drops and increased drop rates.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Week[/b][/th][th][b]Dungeon/Mission[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td][b]Week 1 - Week 2[/b]
Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 21st, Before Maintenance[/td][td][b]Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm)[/b]
- 4 Keys
- Increased Drop Rates[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Week 3 - Week 4[/b]
Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 5th, Before Maintenance[/td][td][b]Mag Mell[/b]
- 8 Keys
- Increased drop rates
- Increased drop rates for Boss Kills[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Week 5 - Week 6[/b]
Thursday, October 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before Maintenance[/td][td][b]Tech Duinn Missions[/b]
- 4 Keys
- Increased drop rates[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Week 7[/b]
Thursday, October 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/td][td][b]Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm), Mag Mell, Tech Duinn Missions[/b]
- Maximum amount of keys as listed above
- Increased drop rates for all dungeons/missions listed
- Mag Mell will have the additional drop rate increase for Boss Kills[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]If the number of keys available cannot be divided equally between party members, leftover keys will be given to party members at random.[list][*]Example: If 3 players clear Rabbie Phantasm, each party member will get 1 key and one party member will receive an extra key.[/*][/list][/*][*]Certain dungeons may have more dungeon end chests than the max available keys given to the party.[list][*]Example: Depending on the number of party members who cleared Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission, there may be 6-8 chests. However, the party will still only receive a maximum of 4 keys.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Elite Mission Pass Support[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, Ethel will sell [b]Ethel's Elite Mission Selection Box[/b].[list][*]Talk to Ethel and select [b]"Purchase Pass"[/b]. [list][*]The selection box costs [b]200,000 Gold.[/b][/*][*]The selection box has a 7-day expiration.[/*][*]You can choose either an Elite Pass for Tara or for Taillteann.[list][*]The selected pass has a 24 hour expiration.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only purchase 20 selection boxes per week.[list][*]The purchase limit is reset at midnight every Sunday.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Pass Support[/b][/h2][list][*]Ethel will also sell the [b]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Pass (Event).[/b][list][*]The dungeon pass is not tradeable.[/*][*]The dungeon pass has a 7-day expiration.[/*][*]The dungeon pass costs [b]400,000 gold.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Erinn Spirit Additional Drop Event [/b][/h2][list][*]When clearing Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions on Elite difficulty, there is an additional chance to obtain Erinn Spirit.[list][*]This is in addition to the normal end chest rewards.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Tech Duinn Mission Pass Box[/b][/h2]
[b][b]Event Dates: Thursday, October 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before Maintenance[/b][/b]
[list][*]When clearing Tech Duinn Missions during on Normal or Advanced difficulty, there is a chance to obtain an [b]Elite Tech Duinn Mission Pass Box:[/b]
[list][*][b]Feth Fiada (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Seven Nightmares (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Revived Illusion (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Awakened Abyssal Lord (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Pass Box expires after 3 days.[/*][*]The Pass Box is tradable 1 time.[/*][*]When the Pass Box is opened, an Elite Pass for the mission is granted and the pass will expire in 24 hours.[/*][/list][url=https://bit.ly/MabiBillionaireS3][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/MabiDiscord][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1245/220124_irusanattendanceevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Eochaid outfit set (appreciation for eel not included). Become the baby Harmonic Saint you've always wanted to be, or if you're a giant, an [url=https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2220/dunk-on-him-eochad.png][b]Eochad[/b][/url] when you finish the calendar! There's also brand-new Support Selection Boxes every single week. Check out the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.png[/img][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Stamp Employee Contract[/b].[/*][*]Log in during the event period to receive the [b]Stamp Employee Contract[/b].[/*][*]Register for the event with the [b]Stamp Employee Contract[/b].[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract:[list][*][b]1,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]500 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* 7x Irusan’s Support Selection Box [/b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2207/irusans-support-selection-box.png[/img][list][*]Use this box to select and receive one of the following items:[list][*]Light Physical Power Potion (30 min)[/*][*]Speed Walk Potion 40% (30 min)[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion (Not tradable) x10[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min) (Not tradable)[/*][*]Light Magic Power Potion (30 min)[/*][*]Party Phoenix Feather (Event)[/*][*]Refined Shadow Crystal (Event)[/*][*]Perfect Free Repair Kit[/*][*]Baltane Mission Crystal x3[/*][*]Golden Experience Fruit (100%)[/*][*]Production Boost Potion Selection Box (Not tradable)[/*][*]Special Gem Selection Box[/*][*]Royal Academy Crystal (Not tradable)[/*][*]Direct Metal Dye Ampoule[/*][*]Direct Pet Dye Ampoule (Not tradable)[/*][*]Divine Mineral Fragment (Event) x3 (Does not expire)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Only one box can be used per real day.[/b] Resets every day at [b]7:00 AM PT.[/b][/*][*]Items from this box expire after 1 day, with the exception of the Divine Mineral Fragment (Event)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Find [b]A Kitty in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue.[/*][*]Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.[/*][*]Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen.  
[list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 28 days, while the last calendar will only have 21 days of log in.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new Event Clock timer is available so you can check your Check-in progress at a glance without opening up the Event Menu.[/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2079/irusans-clock-ui.png[/img][h2][b]Attendance Stamps[/b][/h2][list][*]There is a new way to earn a stamp each day![list][*]Clear one of the following missions to get a stamp:[list][*]Daily Taillteann Mission[/*][*]Daily Tara Mission[/*][*]Baltane Mission (other than Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table)[/*][*]Lord Mission[/*][*]Mag Mell Mission[/*][*]Tech Duinn Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already [b]7:00 AM PT[/b], the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after [b]7:00 AM PT[/b] the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive 1 stamp per day.[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[list][*][b]The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from November 30th, After Maintenance - December 7th, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2141/irusan-s4-calendar.png[/img]
[h2][b]Attendance Pass Purchase[/b][/h2][list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for [b]29 Pon.[/b][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. [/*][*]Additionally, speak to A Kitty in Need and select “Gold Event Shop”.[list][*]A Kitty in Need sells [b]5x Magical Attendance Passes[/b] that can be used to recover stamps you’ve missed.[/*][*]This item will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1264/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-purchase-ui.png[/img]

notes.title: Jousting Tournament Renewal Update
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2177/230904_septemberupdate_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img][/h2][h2][b]Jousting Tournament Renewal Update[/b][/h2]
The Jousting Tournament has been newly improved!
[list][*]The preliminary matches for the Jousting Tournament will now be held on channels 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.[/*][*][b]The Jousting Tournament preliminary matches will be expanded to 6 matches, 3 times each, at the following times:[/b][list][*]Preliminary Round (10am PST / 1pm EST / 7pm CEST and 7pm PST / 10pm EST / 4am CEST)[list][*]Monday ~ Saturday: 10:00 | 10:15 | 10:30 | 19:00 | 19:15 | 19:30[/*][*]Channel 5, 6, 7, 8, 9[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Jousting Tournament Final Match will take place at the following time:[/b][list][*]Final Round  (1pm PST / 4pm EST / 10pm CEST)[list][*]Sunday 13:00[/*][*]Channel 8[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Registration for Preliminary Rounds starts 10 minutes before the match starts, and registration for the Final Round starts 30 minutes before the match starts.[/*][*]If you win in the Jousting preliminary round two times within the same week, you will receive the [b]Weekly Jousting Tournament Entry Ticket[/b] to enter the Final round.[/*][*]A maximum of 64 participants will be selected in order of arrival for the final match.[list][*]The final round can now start without the maximum number of players.[/*][*]There will still need to be 8 players participating for the final match to begin.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you have a Weekly Jousting Tournament Entry Ticket at the time of reception for the final Jousting, but are not selected for the final Jousting, 200 points will be refunded. Rewards are not available outside of these times.[/*][*]Jousting Points can be earned when participating in a Jousting match.[list][*]Preliminary Rounds:[list][*]Win: 50 points[/*][*]Loss: 25 points[/*][/list][/*][*]Final Round:[list][*]Win First Place: 3000 points[/*][*]Win Second Place: 1500 points[/*][*]Win Third Place: 300 points[/*][*]Loss: 150 points[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Jousting attack combos specific to a character’s race have been removed.[/*][*]Command (W,A,S,D) damage has been changed slightly.[/*][*]Skills exclusive to Jousting have been added.[list][*]Skills can be used by consuming skill points, and recovers +1 skill points when hit and +2 skill points when attacked.[list][*]Skill point costs are below the skill icon, and accumulated skill points are indicated below the health bars during a match.[/*][*]You can have up to 10 skill points.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can enter a combination of commands and skills during the command input time.[/*][*]If there is no key input during the command input time, the command is automatically selected randomly, but the skill will not be automatically selected.[/*][*]Skills can be used by selecting the skill icon or using the number keys 1, 2, 3, 4.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Skill[/b][/th][th]Attack Details[/th][/tr][tr][td]1. Heavy Strike
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2180/skill_1.png[/img][/td][td]Landing an attack deals twice the damage.[/td][/tr][tr][td]2. Counter
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2181/skill_2.png[/img][/td][td]Deal damage even if you lose a run 
(Additional Damage +10)[/td][/tr][tr][td]3. Focus
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2182/skill_3.png[/img][/td][td]Landing an attack deals additional damage. 
(Additional Damage +20)[/td][/tr][tr][td]4. Unbreakable Defense
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2183/skill_4.png[/img][/td][td]Blocks all attacks from the opponent. 
(Opponent skill point +1)[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]The Jousting Tournament cheering function is added, so cheer on and [b]favor[/b] the competitor you’d like to see win![list][*]Even if you are not selected as a Jousting tournament player, you can cheer for the competitor who participates in the game through the [b]Jousting Tournament Board[/b] placed throughout the Jousting tournament site. [/*][*]In the preliminaries, even if the cheering person wins or loses, Jousting points are rewarded.[list][*]Win: 30 points[/*][*]Loss: 15 points[/*][/list][/*][*]In the final round, even if notes.title: September Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2020/220916_septemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/b][/h2][h2][b]September Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2]
[b]Inventory Improvements[/b]

Many functions of the Inventory have been improved and some new functions are implemented.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2221/anglers-creel-item-and-inventory.png[/img]
[list][*]The [b]Angler’s Creel[/b] item has been added.[list][*]The Angler’s Creel is a fishing bucket where you can store fish and items acquired when using the Fishing skill, and up to 100 items can be stored.[/*][*]The Angler’s Creel occupies a size of 2x2 and can be placed in your inventory window or bag.[/*][*]You can obtain it by purchasing and using the [b]Angler’s Creel Coupon[/b] for 1,000,000 Ducats in the Limited Items tab of a Commerce Trading Post merchant.[list][*]The coupon is tradable. When used, the Angler’s Creel is a non-tradable item, and you can only have one per character.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can manage the items in the fishing bucket by selecting the acquired fish or item and move them to your inventory or destroy them.[list][*]Items moved to the inventory cannot be put back into the fishing bucket.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you catch a fish while summoning a seal, it will be acquired in the seal’s inventory first.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2171/trash-can-feature.png[/img]
[list][*]A [b]Trash Can[/b] function has been added.[list][*] The trash can is a function that allows you to select items that can be destroyed or dropped and remove them all at once.[/*][*] Select the trash can icon in your main inventory tab to open the trash can pop-up.[list][*]Select items to move to the trash by pressing Alt + Left click mouse button.[/*][/list][/*][*] Items in the trash can be removed at once with the [b]Destroy All[/b] button. [b]Items destroyed in this way will be deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.[/b][/*][*] A function to [b]move all items to the Trash Bin[/b] has been added to individual item bags.[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2169/bag-move-all-items-to-trash.png[/img][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2174/hidden-menu.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]A hidden button has been added to the main inventory tab, and some functions have been moved to the hidden window in a dropdown menu.[list][*]The Extra Equipment Slot icon is moved to the hidden window.[/*][*]The Bag Order Settings function is moved to the hidden window.[/*][*]Functions that have the same effect as a bag are moved to the hidden window. (Example: Soul Stream Inventory, Master Plan Inventory, etc.)[list][*]An option is available to open it at the same time as your main inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*]The function to bundle items with an expiration date is moved to the hidden window. [list][*]An option is available to activate it at the same time as the Gather Stackable items function.[/*][/list][/*][*]The function to remove items that have expired is moved to the hidden window. [list][*]An option is available to activate it and open the Trash Bin function at the same time.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2170/bag-rename-function.png[/img][list][*]When minimizing a bag, you can now set the bag name to further organize your belongings![list][*]A maximum of 16 characters can be used for the bag name. [/*][*]The bag name is saved only on individual PCs and is not available across devices.[/*][/list][/*][*]Several changes have been added to the [b]Inventory Magnifying Glass menu[/b].[list][*]8 new icons have been added to the favorites menu.[/*][*]The number of items that can be added to favorites has been increased from 6 to 10.[/*][*]An [b]Equipment Enhancement tag[/b] has been added and the following items are classified under that tag. [list][*]Celtic Signets[/*][*]Reforging Tools and Hope Gems[/*][*]Enchant Protection Potion, Enchant Extraction Protection Potion, Repair Protection Potions [/*][*]Red / Blue Upgrade Stones[/*][*]Equipment Durability and Proficiency increase hammers[/*][/list][/*][*]An option is available to open it at the same time as your main inventory.[/*][*]The [b]Recovery Potion tag[/b] has been revised to [b]Potions[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]When an item's maximum bundle stack has been reached, the color of the bundle count’s text color will change to yellow.[/*][*]The position of the 'NEW' display for newly acquired items has been corrected by 1 pixel.[/*][*]A [b]Reset[/b] function for the Jabchiel's Music Folio items have been added.[list][*]The Jabchiel's Music Score has been renamed to Jabchiel's Music Folio, and information related to resetting has been added to the item description. [/*][*]The Reset function can be used in the item menu that appears when you right-click Jabchiel's Music Folio in the Inventory window.[/*][*]Upon resetting the folio, the score scrolls stored in the Jabchiel's Music Folio are removed, and the non-tradable property is removed. [b]Any removed score scrolls cannot be restored.[/b][/*][*]If Jabchiel's Music Folio is in a bag, the items in the bag cannot be unequipped.[/*][*]An issue where Jabchiel's Music Folio could not be destroyed has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed an error where switching to an Extra Equipment Slot while Jabchiel's Music Folio was equipped would delete the music included in the book.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]A United Harmony[/b][/h3][list][*]It is now possible for elves and giants to marry! ❤ [/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2167/generation_07_-_atratas_memory_5.png[/img]
[list][*]Engagement and weddings between elves and giants can now be held in Emain Macha.[/*][*]If the marriage partner is a giant, humans and elves can ride on the marriage partner's shoulders regardless of whether or not they support the giant faction.[/*][*]Wedding attire for giants can now be rented in Emain Macha. [/*][*]Some of the content related to the existing wedding will be modified.[list][*]A wedding cutscene between an elf and a giant is added.[/*][*]Some unnatural parts in the Emain Macha wedding cutscene will be fixed.[/*][*]Some dialogue of the Vales and Filia marriage helper NPCs will be modified.[/*][*]It is modified so that rented wedding attire cannot be reforged, enchanted, or repaired.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Dan Advancement Test Changes[/b][/h3]
 Several changes and balance adjustments to the Dan Advancement tests have been implemented.
[list][*]All Advancement tests have been changed to satisfy all objectives except for the “Participate in the advancement ceremony” objective.[list][*]For example, if you reach the score to satisfy the SS Rank objective, it will also count for the S Rank objective at the same time.[/*][/list][/*][*]When you enter a promotion test, you will now be able to select your target rank of A, S or SS rank.[list][*]If you do not reach the target rank within the time limit, the test will be failed.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the target score is reached, the mission is completed immediately.[/*][*]All Advancement Ticket item descriptions have been modified to match the changed specifications.[/*][*]The additional information when asking about the advancement test from the Advancement Guide in the Advancement Hall has been updated to reflect the current specifications.[/*][/list]
[b]Tailoring[/b]
[list][*]Several items are removed from the list of required items and shops within the test.[list][*]Short Swordsmanship School Uniform (F)[/*][*]Long Swordsmanship School Uniform (M)[/*][*]Ring-Type Mini Leather Dress (F)[/*][*]Rosemary Gloves [/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Short Swordsmanship School Uniform (F)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Long Swordsmanship School Uniform (M)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - High-Class Leather Armor [/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Ring-Type Mini Leather Dress (F)[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Rosemary Gloves[/*][*]Thick Thread Ball [/*][*]Thin Thread Ball[/*][*]Yellow Young Potion [/*][*]Ice Silk [/*][*]Ice Fabric [/*][*]Iron Plate[/*][/list][/*][*]The amount of points received for completing a Tailoring Dan Test has increased. Previously the quality would be multiplied by 40, but now it will be multiplied by 60.[/*][/list]
[b]Blacksmithing[/b]
[list][*]Several items are removed from the list of required items and shops within the test.[list][*]Celtic Royal Knight Sword[/*][*]Celtic Royal War Hammer[/*][*]Celtic Royal Warrior Hammer[/*][*]Celtic Royal Battle Axe[/*][*]Celtic Royal Warrior Axe[/*][*]Celtic Throwing Star[/*][*]Celtic Edged Knuckle[/*][*]Celtic Tetra Cylinder[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Royal Knight Sword [/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Royal Warhammer [/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Royal Warrior Hammer[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Royal Battle Axe [/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Royal Warrior Axe [/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Throwing Star[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Edged Knuckle[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual - Celtic Tetra Cylinder[/*][*]Cheap Finishing Thread[/*][*]Common Finishing Thread[/*][*]Fine Finishing Thread[/*][*]Finest Finishing Thread[/*][*]Thick Thread Ball[/*][*]Thin Thread Ball[/*][*]Incomplete Seal Emblem[/*][*]Destroyed Seal Chain[/*][*]Broken Seal Chain[/*][*]Rusted Seal Chain[/*][*]Amplified Alchemy Crystal[/*][*]Blackened Blade Fragment[/*][*]Lightless Metal Fragment[/*][*]Shining Crystal Shard[/*][*]Forged Weapon Piece[/*][*]Huge Armor Fragment[/*][*]Jagged Soul Shard[/*][*]Subtle Mark[/*][*]Firm Blade Fragment[/*][*]Ruptured Black Metal[/*][/list][/*][*]The amount of points received for completing a Blacksmithing Dan Test has increased. Previously the quality would be multiplied by 40, but now it will be multiplied by 60.[/*][/list]
[b]Potion Making[/b]
[list][*]3 Medium-sized Beginner Bag and 1 Mysterious Purple Bag are provided during the test.[/*][*]NPCs have been changed to request the potion effect they need when their status is 80%, from 20%.[/*][*]For NPCs who need Stamina and Mana potions, the value of Stamina or Mana will be decreased in conjunction with their HP, allowing the current amount of Stamina or Mana to be gauged by looking at the NPC’s health.[/*][*]When the NPC's health drops below 30%, they will stand in place.[/*][*]Recovery points are changed as follows.[list][*]When the recovery value is less than 50% and more than 20%, it is changed to 500 points[/*][*]When the recovery value is less than 20% and more than 10%, it is changed to 300 points.[/*][*]When the recovery value is less than 10% and more than 5%, it is changed to 200 points.[/*][/list][/*][*]When an NPC dies, 2000 points are deducted from the score.[/*][/list]
[b]Hillwen Engineering [/b]
[list][*]The first required item quantity is changed as follows:[list][*]Hillwen: 40 -> 8[/*][*]Hexagonal Bolts: 80 -> 60[/*][*]Hexagonal Nuts: 80 -> 60[/*][*]Emerald Fuse: 30 -> 8[/*][*]Energy Converter: 15 -> 4[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon completion, the estimated score is displayed on the left.[/*][/list]
[b]Magic Craft[/b]
[list][*]The first required item quantity is changed as follows:[list][*]Shyllien: 30 -> 15[/*][*]Training Mana Bullet: 300 -> 150[/*][*]Purified Rabbit Foot: 8[/*][*]Sundew: 8[/*][*]Enchanted Firewood: 8[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon completion, the estimated score is displayed on the left.[/*][/list]
[b]Fynn Bead Burnishing[/b]
[list][*]All item prices are changed to 1 Fynni Gem.[/*][*]The number of monsters will always be 10.[/*][*]Upon completion, the estimated score is displayed on the left.[/*][/list]
[b]Common changes to Combat tests [/b]
[list][*]Ten HP, MP, and Stamina 300 potions are provided at the start.[/*][*]You will be able to use the Crisis Escape skill. (Excluding Healing test)[/*][*]If you die during the test, 2000 points will be deducted from the score. (Excluding Healing test)[/*][/list]
[b]Defense[/b]
[list][*]Monsters drop 300 HP potions.[/*][*]The score when defending successfully has been increased from 150 points to 500 points.[/*][*]The points received when wearing a round shield and defending is increased from 20 to 50 points.[/*][*]Some monsters have been changed: [list][*]The 4 Sahagin Warriors in Phase 3 of the 2nd Dan test are changed to 6 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][*]The 6 Sahagin Warriors in Phase 3 of the 3rd Dan test are changed to 6 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Counterattack[/b]
[list][*]The score for a successful counterattack has been increased from 150 to 300 points.[/*][*]Some monsters have been changed: [list][*]4 Sahagin Warriors in Phase 3 of the 2nd Dan Test will be changed to 6 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][*]6 Sahagin Warriors in Phase 3 of the 3rd Dan Test are changed to 6 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Charge[/b]
[list][*]Added marked areas so that if you move to the marked area, the cooldown for Charge and Crisis Escape is reset.[/*][*]The score for a successful Charge has been increased from 100 to 150 points.[/*][*]Some monsters have been changed: [list][*]2 Imps in Phase 2 of the 1st Dan test are changed to  2 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][*]4 Flying Swords in Phase 2 of the 1st Dan test are changed to 4 Sahagin Warriors.[/*][*]4 Imps in Phase 2 of the 2nd Dan test are changed to 4 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][*]4 Flying Swords in Phase 2 of the 2nd Dan test are changed to 4 Sahagin Warriors.[/*][*]6 Wisps in Phase 2 of the 3rd Dan test are changed to 6 Sahagin Soldiers.[/*][*]4 Flying Swords in Phase 2 of the 3rd Dan test are changed to 4 Sahagin Warriors.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Assault Slash[/b]
[list][*]A machete is provided as a basic weapon.[/*][*]The score for a successful Assault Slash has been increased from 150 to 200 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Lance Charge[/b]
[list][*]Added marked areas so that if you move to the marked area, the cooldown for Lance Charge and Crisis Escape is reset.[/*][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been reduced from 200 to 150 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been reduced from 100 to 80 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving high damage has been reduced from 50 to 40 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Windmill[/b]
[list][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been reduced from 200 to 50 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been reduced from 100 to 20 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving high damage has been reduced from 50 to 10 points.[/*][*]The score for defeating an enemy with Windmill has been reduced from 70 to 30 points.[/*][*]The score for attacking an enemy with Windmill has been reduced from 50 to 30 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Combat Mastery[/b]
[list][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been reduced from 200 to 100 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been reduced from 100 to 70 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving high damage has been reduced from 50 to 40 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Ranged Attack Combat Mastery[/b]
[list][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been reduced from 200 to 100 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been reduced from 100 to 80 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving high damage has been reduced from 50 to 40 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Magnum Shot[/b]
[list][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been increased from 100 to 200 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been increased from 50 to 100 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving high damage has been increased from 20 to 70 points.[/*][*]The score for defeating an enemy with Magnum Shot has been reduced from 70 to 30 points.[/*][*]The score for attacking an enemy with Magnum Shot has been reduced from 50 to 30 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Crash Shot[/b]
[list][*]The score for attacking an enemy with Crash Shot has been reduced from 100 to 30 points.[/*][*]If you attack 3 or more enemies with Crash Shot fragments, the cooldown for Crash Shot and Crisis Escape is reset.[/*][/list]
[b]Combo: Charging Strike[/b]
[list][*] Killed monsters will no longer disappear even if you kill all the monsters.[/*][/list]
[b]Combo: Spinning Uppercut[/b]
[list][*]Killed monsters will no longer disappear even if you kill all the monsters.[/*][*]The score for achieving extremely high damage has been decreased from 500 to 300 points.[/*][*]The score for achieving very high damage has been changed to 230 points.[/*][*]The score for attacking an enemy with Combo: Spinning Uppercut has been increased from 100 to 180 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Combo: Pummel[/b]
[list][*]An additional 100 points are provided when you damage an enemy with Pummel.[/*][/list]
[b]Shuriken Charge[/b]
[list][*]When attacking with Shuriken Charge, the damage score is displayed on the left.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2023 Year End Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Dear Milletians,

How has your summer been treating you? It’s been scorching hot in LA, but we’ve been keeping cool and staying hydrated [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]([/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]with our stackable water bottles[/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates])[/url]! How about your adventure in the Snowy Summer in Erinn? Glenn Bearna’s chill certainly stirred a bit of commotion in Tir Chonaill, so we hope your foray into Sliab Mis has been a manageable one. The team and I had a ton of fun working on the Glenn Bearna update this year. We were glad to see the intrigue and anticipation from you all with the update microsite and the July 13th release!

As you can tell, this year’s Summer Master Plan was also intended to coincide with this chilly summer update. We heard your desire for the event to return and it was tough for us to keep quiet until the event post went out. We are hoping to improve that experience and we’re brainstorming on ways to bring you more teasers and previews, even in small ways. My favorite part about working on Mabinogi is the rare opportunity to see all the sneak-peaks and the behind-the-scenes content being worked on by our talented team members and developers. Since we are constantly working on upcoming and future projects, it can be exciting to think of how you’ll react to it once it has been released. Recently, we’ve received many positive praises and feedback from you all, especially after the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84100/mabinogi-fantasy-party-announcement-recap]Fantasy Party and Mabinogi Eternity announcement[/url]. We can’t thank you enough for sharing your thoughts with us, and it has been incredibly heartwarming to know that our work is bringing joy for many people. 

Do you think the weather will be nicer in Connous? [b]I heard Arciellia is planning a beach party…[/b]
Stay tuned for more details!


[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1805/look-at-how-cute-we-are-gms-940x390.png[/img]

We love to check what all of our Milletians are up to, and what you are all enjoying. Many of you post and talk about events and activities in our community spaces, and it is always fun to see the range of interests that are discussed in there daily. It’s such a fun outlook because we all reside in Erinn and experience it differently, but at the end of the day, we’re all loving the same game. It is a pleasure to be a part of a community much larger and more vibrant than we think. Recently, we have had several community-run events in-game and offline with fun mini-games and rewards! Shout out to all of the event coordinators who make these community faires come to life! If you are interested in joining in on these events, or running your own, you can find all the details in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/880251252292849745]#community-events[/url] Discord channel. There are many more spaces where you can strengthen the bond of being a Milletian, and you may meet new friends where you didn’t think you could. 

You know what else excites us every month - [b]new content releases![/b] The team has been working on several updates, scaling from minor and major updates. I wanted to bring attention to this because we’ve heard your feedback and know that there are many updates you are hoping to see come to Mabinogi. While we can’t share all of the specifics just yet, there are many topics currently in discussion.

We hope to continue bringing changes and improvements to our service to enhance your gameplay and experience. On that note, [b]what else can we expect to come in 2023!?[/b] Let me share some of the contents we are preparing for you, and while not mentioned below, there will of course be other events and items to enjoy as well.

[b]In Q3...[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]Auction House overall improvements and changes[/url] have landed in Erinn! Many functional and visual changes have been prepared to improve areas where Milletians may have had a negative experience. Menu changes such as favoriting, displaying bank balance, addition of visual indicators for enchanted items, and more have been included to make it easier and quicker to search for items. You can now purchase individual items from a stacked bundle, and re-list or retrieve multiple items all at once! We know how much you wanted these features, and it was great to see how happy you were when the patch notes were released.[list][*]While we encountered a few (now resolved!) slight hiccups after the patch, we are incredibly thankful for your quick reports and understanding of our investigations and downtime required to fix those issues.[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional [b]quality of life improvements[/b] include increased item bundles and stack count for more items, improved inventory management (trash bin, fishing tackle box), and other minor bug fixes to come. [/*][*]More content changes? We can expect to see a renewal to the ol’ medieval sport: [b]Jousting[/b]! Let’s give Lileas a visit, hmm? With new Jousting-exclusive skills and new rewards, Jousting will become more thrilling![/*][*]Milletians looking to improve their academy scores will also be in luck, as changes to the [b]Dan Advancement Tests[/b] will be introduced, removing many elements that depend on luck and adjustments to the difficulty level of certain tests will be made. [/*][*]Another highly requested and incredibly anticipated change is the power of love between [b]Elves and Giants…in Marriage[/b][b]![/b] I can’t wait to see everyone’s intertwined love come true. ❤[/*][/list]
[b]In Q4...[/b]
[list][*]We have an exciting [b]new story event[/b] to share during the Halloween season. [/*][*]As we shared during the Fantasy Party stream and recap, [b]new[/b][b] improvements to the early game experience[/b] will be coming soon with several changes: the Part-time job renewal, spirit weapon tutorial (Eiry’s return!), a content growth guide, and many generation quests will be simplified. [/*][*]What we may all be the most hyped for is [b]new Arcana talents[/b]! Also shared during the Fantasy Party, these extraordinarily cool talents “Alchemic Stinger"* (Battle Alchemy + Archery) and "Dark Mage"* (Chain Slash + Magic) will be available in Erinn soon! *Names subject to change.[/*][/list]
Is there anything you are looking forward to from this list? We can’t wait to dive in to all the things in the works in Erinn this year!

Thank you for reading and catching up with me! I hope you all have pawsitive summer adventures, with apurrtizing summer foods, ameowzing sights, and take some time to relax and enjoy the world! Don’t procatstinate your skill training or leveling though, the purrfectly cuddly Purrlings will need levels too!

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1650/webimage_purrling_tabby02_crop.png[/img]

Sincerely,
[b]GM Mewlynne, [/b][b]Mabinogi Producer Cat Lover
& The Mabinogi Team ❤[/b]

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2913/230321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 4:30 PM PDT. Thanks for your patience.[/b]

[b][Update 2:20 PM Aug 11] [/b]The maintenance has been extended for 2 hours. The new proposed end time is 4:30 PM PDT. Thank you for your patience. We apologize for any inconvenience this has caused, and thank you for your understanding.

Mabinogi will have an unscheduled maintenance on August 11th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 11:30 AM PDT and last approximately 3 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Friday, August 11th
[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 11:30 - 2:30 PM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 2:30 - 5:30 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 8:30 - 11:30 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]The following known issue will be resolved. Affected players will receive the full amount of gold from their transactions in today's maintenance. [list][*][b]Known Issue[/b]: Some players that sold items in their Auction House prior to the August 10th maintenance are unable to reclaim gold from the transaction.[/*][*]All affected gold will be sent directly to the player's bank, so there will be players whose gold amount in bank will exceed their bank limit - they will be still able to withdraw their deposit, but they won't be able to add more deposit to their bank.[/*][/list][/*][*]The previously disabled Auction House (effective 12:45 AM PDT) will be available.[/*][*]Requested name changes will not be processed at this time. [/*][/list]
We apologize for any inconvenience this has caused.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: August Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - August 10th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the August Quality of Life Updates!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85163/connous-beach-vacation-event]Connous Beach Vacation Event[/url]: Thursday, August 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85181/purr-ilous-adventure-pet-box]Purr-ilous Adventure Pet Box Sale[/url]: Thursday, August 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84931/step-by-step-event]Step by Step Event[/url]: Thursday, July 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 24th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84978/desert-mirage-box]Desert Mirage Box Sale[/url]: Thursday, July 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84136/glenn-bearna-the-midwinter-fissure-update]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]August Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/85027/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url][/b][list][*]Several significant changes to the Auction House have been made![/*][*]Changes to several items' stack bundles has been made.[/*][*]Dungeon Guide UI changes have been made.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The amount of Pon required to instantly completely Baltane Squire Missions has been heavily reduced.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed several typos on the Dungeon Guide's Additional Info sections.[/*][*]Chinese Dragon Helm (Elf) can now be listed on the Auction House. [/*][*]Corrected a few visual issues when wearing Nightbringer Vanguard on your back.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the July 27th maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Continued to hunt down typos in our story- today's course: G12, G23, G24, and Glenn Bearna. Thank you as always for your reports, we will continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine![/*][*]Corrected the new description on the Ace Hero Talent Support window. We're hoping this provides an easier understanding about what the support does![/*][*]No more skipping leg day; you can now wear all shoes with the Special Seraphic Harmony Attire (M) without fear of your legs running off on you.[/*][*]Cleaned up stray punctuation in the names of a few Alban Knights Training Stones and the Ancient Nine-Tailed Fox Support Puppet.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Small Draconian Cute Dresses, Shoes, and Gloves to appear less cute than intended.[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs fixed during the July 20th maintenance:[/b]
[list][*]Renamed 'Shining Crystal Shard' to 'Frostwork Crystal Shard'.[/*][*]Improved the announcement ticker text for the Emain Macha Cook-Off.[/*][*]Changed the Hero Support menu name to be Ace Hero Talent Support menu, and improved the text.[/*][*]Corrected the Tailoring List name for the Ceann Bliana Scholar's Hairpin. It was previously incorrectly Ceann Bliana Scholar's Circlet.[/*][*]Renamed 'The Sulfur Spider inside Shadow Realm' to 'Sulfur Spiders of the Shadow Realm'.[/*][*]Fixed a player reported issue where Rabbie Phantasm was dropping fewer guaranteed items than expected.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Due to the removal of bidding, there is a known issue in the Auction House UI where the Per Unit and Total amount appears abnormally in the case of a failed bid.[/*][*]In the case of bundled items in a bid listing, there is a UI issue where the 'Per Unit' amount might not exactly match the total price of the auction listing, however the retrieved total price will be correct.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1682/230807_connousbeachvacationevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]


Beat the summer heat at Connous Beach! Enjoy a refreshing cocktail while opening up the Vacation Box each day you log in. Don't forget to play the Fun Fun Cart mini-games to earn Magical Pieces! Might I suggest a Mojito? Check out the details below.

[/b][/*][/list][*]Talk to Hafgan each day to receive a [b]cocktail[/b] and a [b]Vacation Box.[/b][/*][*]You will receive a different cocktail each day:[/*][list][*]Monday: [b]June Bug [/b](Instantly grants 500% of EXP needed)[/*][*]Tuesday: [b]Cosmopolitan x3[/b] (Recover full HP, MP, Stamina, and Wounds)[/*][*]Wednesday: [b]Mojito[/b] (Gain 50 AP)[/*][*]Thursday: [b]Martini[/b] (Increase EXP by 35% after Resting for 36 min. Lasts for 3 days)[/*][*]Friday: [b]Blue Hawaii [/b](Rewards from clearing a Shadow Mission will be increased by 360%)[/*][*]Saturday: [b]Pina Colada x3[/b] (Increase Movement Speed by 40%)[/*][*]Sunday: [b]Long Island Iced Tea[/b] (All Skill Training EXP x2)[/*][/list][*]These are event versions of existing consumables and will not stack with their non-event versions. For example, the Long Island Iced Tea item will not stack with a Complete Skill EXP Potion.[/*][/list]

notes.title: August Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1502/220819_augustupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]
[h2][b]August Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2]
[b]Auction House Changes[/b]

Many functions of the Auction House have been improved and some new functions are implemented.
[list][*][b]The bidding auction method will be removed.[/b]
[list][*]There were two types of transactions in the Auction House: normal/regular listings, and auction/bidding listings. Through this patch, [b]all auction listings have been integrated into a regular auction listing[/b] instead of the bidding auction listing, which has a remarkably low utilization rate.[/*][*]The Bid selection has been removed from the Auction House search options.[/*][*]If a bid has failed due to another character's higher bid/re-bid/purchase failure before the patch, the Gold for that failed bid will automatically be sent back to the bank of the account during the August 10 maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][*]The default sorting method of the Auction House search results has been changed so that items are sorted in order from lowest to highest price.[list][*]In addition, in order to minimize the damage caused by “Auction House fraud” or the act of “scamming”, which results in an unfair advantage by deceiving the selling price of an item, the default sorting method of the Auction House has been changed to sort by the lowest price per item sold.[/*][/list][/*][*]An option to [b]Purchase Individual Items[/b] has been added. When purchasing bundled items on the Auction House, you can now purchase them as a whole stack or individually. Buy now in the quantity you need![list][*]When purchasing bundled items, [b]Purchase All [/b]and [b]Purchase Individual[/b] buttons are displayed.   [/*][*]When purchasing an item, a window where you can check the purchase method, purchase quantity, and purchase amount will be displayed.   [/*][*]When registered bundled items, the amount entered in the listing will be the price per unit. [list][*][b]Example[/b]: 10 Dead Bees for a unit price of 1,000,000 gold each will be registered for a total price of 10,000,000 gold.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1692/dead-bees.png[/img]
[/*][/list][/*][*]For bundled items that have been sold individually, you can collect the payment and unsold items during the sale through the item’s listing.[list][*]After collecting the partial balance, any remaining items on sale will be canceled and the partial sale amount will be paid. Remaining items will be returned to the inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A [b]Favorites feature[/b] has been added, so you can add and manage favorite item searches in the Auction House.[list][*]Use the [b]Register Favorites[/b] option to save a preferred search term, auction category, search options, and detailed advanced options. [/*][*]Up to 10 favorites can be saved.[/*][*]The favorites information is saved only on individual PCs and is not available across devices.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Search Popular Items[/b] search function is added.[list][*]You can check the top 20 items with the highest daily trade volume in each Auction category.[/*][*]Transaction volume is updated in real time.[/*][*]The popular item search list is reset at 12:00 AM PDT every day in real time, and during maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Search bar function[/b] has been modified.[list][*]If you search for an item and click a related search term populated in the dropdown, it will be searched with the [Exact Match] check box activated.[/*][*]A [b]Search History function[/b] that saves up to 10 search terms is added and resets when you change channels or log off.[/*][*]Highlights are displayed when dragging a search term in the search bar.[/*][*]You can open and close the autocomplete window and search history by clicking the search bar.[/*][*]The width of the search bar is expanded.[/*][*]It is improved to enable search regardless of spacing in search terms.[/*][*]Suggested search options will appear when an item matches the search term inputted, as before.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improved the detailed search [b]Advanced options[/b] for auction listings.[list][*][Exact Match] can be used in all categories.[/*][*]Function-related information is added to the tooltip when hovering over auction functions.[/*][*]Improvements have been made so that you can set the rank, number of effects, name, and range when searching for Reforging.[list][*]When searching for Reforging, the character limit for names is extended to 40 characters.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can set the type and range of enhancement when searching for Special Upgrade.[/*][*]When searching Glyphwright, you can set the effect name and level range.[/*][*]When searching Echostone, you can set the effect name and level range.[/*][*]The following have been added to the Advanced option search.[list][*]Set Effects - Added to the Equipment and Accessories category.[/*][*]Motion - Added to the Armor Equipment category.[/*][*]Crafter Info - Added to the Equipment and Accessories category.[/*][*]When searching for Advanced options in the Sewing Patterns and Manual categories, you can search separately by production rank and production item name.[/*][*]Training Stone Type - Added to the Alban Stone category.[/*][*]Signet - Added to Weapon categories.[/*][*]Max ATT, Magic ATT, Food Quality - Added to Ingredient category.[/*][*]Glyph Quality - Added to the Glyph Imprint category.[/*][*]Location Used - Added to the Homestead category.[/*][*]Equip Restrictions - Added to Weapon, Equipment and Face Decoration categories.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Auction House menu[/b] has been improved.[list][*]Even if you click refresh, the sorting function and page are maintained.[/*][*]10 page turn buttons are added.[/*][*]Among items with the same price in the sorting state, the item registered first is positioned at the top.[/*][*]The bank balance is displayed at the top of the Auction House UI.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following subcategory tabs have been added:[list][*]Melee Weapons[list][*][b]Sword[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b] Other Equipment[/b][list][*][b]Life Skill Tools[/b][/*][*]The Cooking Tools category has been removed, and items will now be included in the Life Skill Tools category.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Fynn Bead category has been moved from the Other Equip subcategory to the Consumable subcategory.
[/b][/*][*][b]4 new subcategories have been added under the Misc category:
[/b][list][*][b]Tailoring/Weaving
[/b][/*][*][b]Fynni Pets
[/b][/*][*][b]Smoldering Thread
[/b][/*][*][b]Perfume
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]When registering an item, it is improved so that you can register a sale item using [b]Alt + Left Click[/b].[/b][/*][*]The display of item information in the Auction House is improved.[list][*]If items are listed that were purchased from the NPC shop, it is now displayed after the item name in the auction list.[/*][*]In the case of an item whose validity period has expired or durability is 0, a red shadow appears on the background of the item image.[list][*]Items with initial durability of 0, such as balloons and empty bottles, will not be displayed.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]For items with enchantments, a color is assigned to the enchantment name.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The restrictions that prevent you from using the Auction House in certain conditions are partially improved.[list][*]Some conditions and functions are limited to the use of the Auction House as before.[list][*]Flight state, umbrella open state - All Auction House functions are available.[/*][*]Transformation, demigod/Divinity state - All Auction House functions except preview are available.[/*][*]Pet/partner summon status, mounting, trade status, dungeon entry status, shadow mission entry status - You can use the Auction House and Preview functions.[list][*]You cannot use most of the core functions, such as purchasing or retrieving items and gold when a Pet or Partner is summoned.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Discount Coupon Settings[/b] feature is available, which allows you to set the minimum amount price cutoff for when the prompt to use an Auction House Fee Discount Coupon on a sold listing.[/*][*]It is improved so that you can set in-game notifications related to the Auction House under Auction House Settings > [b]Sold Item Notifications[/b].[/*][*]Added a checkbox to select multiple items in the My Auctions tab. [/*][*]A [b]Relist Selections[/b] function is added, and items that have failed to be sold are registered for sale again with the settings that were initially registered.[/*][*]A [b]Reclaim Selections[/b] function will be added and items that have failed to be sold will be returned to the inventory.[list][*]When using the Reclaim Selections function, you can choose to receive payment or receive items.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The batch processing function of Auction House items is improved and added.[/b][list][*][b]It is modified so that batch processing functions can be used without separate sorting.
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Preview function is improved.[list][*]It is improved so that you can move the location of the character and homestead props by right-clicking.[/*][*]A function to reset the viewpoint is added. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Some bugs are fixed.[/b][list][*][list][*]An issue where an infinite message pops up when entering the Enter key in the search box is fixed.[/*][*]The sales amount in the payout notification window will be modified to display [total amount] instead of [amount per item].[/*][*]Typos in the guarantee check notification window will be corrected.[list][*]The certified check notification window is modified to display the current bank balance.[/*][/list][/*][*]An issue where the enchantment list is not displayed when searching for an enchantment with 'Exact Match' enabled is fixed.[/*][*]An issue where items with both prefix/suffix enchantments were not searched when searching for an enchantment with 'Exact Match' enabled has been fixed.[/*][*][b]An issue where, when purchasing an item with a recent average price difference of 90%, an information window with overlapping information displayed twice will be fixed.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list][*]The readability of the text in the trade result window is improved.[/*][*]An improvement has been implemented for the Extra Equipment Slot when switching weapons and gear. [list][*]Equipment in the Extra Equipment Slot will now always be replaced with the equipment in First weapon slot (Ⅰ).[/*][*]If the Second (Auxiliary) weapon slot (ⅠⅠ) is currently equipped, it is automatically swapped to the First weapon slot (Ⅰ) and then replaced with the items stored in the Extra Equipment Slot.[/*][*]Example: When holding the weapon (Red Chain Blade) in the Auxiliary weapon slot (ⅠⅠ) and switching to the gear in the Extra Equipment Slot, it automatically changes to the First weapon slot (Ⅰ)(Yellow Staff) first before replacing the item with the weapon (Blue Bow) stored in the Extra Equipment Slot.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1657/auxiliary-slot.gif[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]Stack bundles have been improved for several items.[list][*]Empty Bottle, Water, Milk, Fragrant Honey Water, and Fragrant Honey Milk items can now be stacked up to 100 bundles.
[/*][*]When an item is used for gathering or used in a recipe, it is deducted from the bundle, and newly created items are also automatically bundled. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1660/stacks-on-stacks-baybee.png[/img][/*][*]The number of bundles for the following items has been increased to 100, and the number of bundles for some potions has been increased to 20.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Item Name[/b][/th][th][b]Bundle[/b][/th][th][b]Item Name[/b][/th][th]Bundle[/th][th][b]Item Name[/b][/th][th]Bundle[/th][/tr][tr][td]Handmade Bandages[/td][td]100[/td][td]Small Gem[/td][td]100[/td][td]Cotton Cushion Stuffing[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fine Handmade Bandages[/td][td]100[/td][td]Small Green Gem[/td][td]100[/td][td]Hay Bale[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Finest Handmade Bandages[/td][td]100[/td][td]Small Blue Gem[/td][td]100[/td][td]Antidote Potion[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tough Thread[/td][td]100[/td][td]Small Red Gem[/td][td]100[/td][td]Poison Potion[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fused Hillwen Alloy[/td][td]100[/td][td]Small Silver Gem[/td][td]100[/td][td]Holy Water of Lymilark[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Energy Converter[/td][td]100[/td][td]Arat Berry[/td][td]100[/td][td]Massive Holy Water of Lymilark[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Intact Shyllien[/td][td]100[/td][td]Wheat Flour[/td][td]100[/td][td]Energy Converter (Part-Time Job only)[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sundew[/td][td]100[/td][td]Barley Flour[/td][td]100[/td][td]Intact Shyllien (Part-Time Job only)[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Holy the [b]Fused Erg Sealing Box[/b] that can be crafted with Handicraft has been changed.[list][*]The probability of acquiring a type of wings has increased by about 4 times compared to before.[/*][*]The probability of acquiring a 2nd title coupon has increased by 1.5 times compared to before.[/*][*]All sub-rewards have been reorganized into Adamantine Coins.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Before[/b][/th][th]After[/th][/tr][tr][td]- Nightbringer Edged Wings

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1661/august-qol-dungeon-guide-favourites.png[/img]
[list][*]The [b]Favorites[/b] button and tab have been added.[list][*]A star-shaped Favorite icon is added to the dungeon information displayed when clicking the dungeon card, and you can register/unregister Favorites through this.[/*][*]Bookmarked dungeons can be collected and viewed through the Favorites tab at the top.[/*][*]If even one Favorite is registered, the Favorites tab will be displayed first when opening the dungeon guide.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Shop[/b] button is added.[list][*]You can use Eavan's Token Shop remotely using the Shop button.[/*][*]Items cannot be sold in the token shop through the shop button, and this menu cannot be used in some areas such as dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.content:

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 10:15 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.[/b]

[/b]

Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]

The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84016/hyperspace-aurora-box]Hyperspace Aurora Box Sale[/url] is ending.[/*][*]Ready to upgrade your gear and prepare for Glenn Bearna! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84820/dazzling-reforging-tool-and-reforging-time-weekends]Dazzling Reforging Tool and Reforging Time Weekends[/url] sale and event are starting.[/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. All players who have cleared the quest (and haven't completed it already) will now be able to complete the quest.[/*][*]Fixed a player reported issue where Rabbie Phantasm was dropping fewer items than expected.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The text is currently misaligned in the window of the Ace Hero Talent Support menu.[/*][*]Special Seraphic Harmony Attire (M) does not show the legs when equipped with many footwear.[/*][/list]
- The Mabinogi Team

We're hoping this provides an easier understanding about what the support does![/*][*]No more skipping leg day; you can now wear all shoes with the Special Seraphic Harmony Attire (M) without fear of your legs running off on you.[/*][*]Continued to hunt down typos in our story- today's course: G12, G23, G24, and Glenn Bearna. Thank you as always for your reports, we will continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine![/*][*]Cleaned up stray punctuation in the names of a few Alban Knights Training Stones and the Ancient Nine-Tailed Fox Support Puppet.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Small Draconican Cute Dresses to appear less cute than intended.[/*][/list]
- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Step by Step Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1514/230725_petwalkevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
Help these adorable mini-pets overcome their fears and take them for loving strolls through the world of Erinn! Keep them company and they'll reward you with brand-new Whistles! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, July 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 24th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Lamilla’s Request[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Lamilla[/b] in [b]Tir Chonaill[/b] by the Adelia stream.[list][*]You will receive an [b]Orange Wings of the Goddess (Tir Chonaill)[/b] that you can use to go to the event area.[/*][/list][/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Lamilla[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Lamilla’s Request:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]Roamin’ Coin x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Daily Quest - Step by Step[/b][/h2][list][*]Talk to one of the pets near Lamilla to take it out on a walk that day. [list][*]You can only walk one pet per day.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive a Mini-Gem of the pet you decide to walk. Right click and “[b]Summon[/b]” the pet to take it out with you on a walk! [/*][*]Keep the pet summoned for 10 minutes to complete the quest objective. Then, talk to the pet again near Lamilla.[/*][*]Once completed, you will earn the following rewards:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]Roamin’ Coin x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The daily quest resets every day at [b]7 AM PDT[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Completion Quest - Step towards Recovery[/b][/h2][list][*]Talk to Lamilla about taking each of the pets out for a daily walk.

You can walk the pets in any order.[/*][*]The available pets are:

Hello Milletians!

Due to the recent change in Twitter's API policy, we will no longer support creation of new Nexon accounts using Twitter, as of [b]Wednesday, July 19 (PT)[/b].

This restriction is only for new account registrations. There are no impacts to our Milletians who have already been using Twitter as a log-in method.

Please see additional details:
[list][*][b]Date[/b]: Wednesday, July 19 at 4:00 PM (PT)[/*][*][b]Details[/b]: New Mabinogi account creation using Twitter accounts will not be supported going forward.[/*][*][b]Please Note[/b]:
[list][*]Applies only to new account creation using Twitter.[/*][*]Does not affect players who are already playing with an existing Twitter account.[/*][*]If you already have an account linked to Twitter, you can log in again and play the game normally even if you log out of your account after the date above.[/*][*]If there are any changes in the future, we will let you know.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84016/hyperspace-aurora-box]Hyperspace Aurora Box[/url]: Thursday, June 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84264/budding-friendship-doll-bag-box]Budding Friendship Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, June 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84421/seraphic-cantabile-chest]Seraphic Cantabile Chest[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 10th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83560/star-fishing-event-returns][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84156/relay-attendance-check-in-event]Relay Attendance Check-In Event[/url]: Thursday, June 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84341/the-scouts-snowy-summer-warm-up-event]The Scouts' Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event[/url]: Thursday, July 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84536/a-snowy-preparation-glenn-bearna-events]A Snowy Preparation - Glenn Bearna Events[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 10th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84562/glenn-bearna-dungeon-support]Glenn Bearna Dungeon Support[/url]: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83337/renovation-season-4-archery-magic-and-race-specific-skill-changes][/url][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84136/glenn-bearna-the-midwinter-fissure-update]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update:[/b]
[list][*]A new dungeon, [b]Glenn Bearna[/b], and a new area, [b]Sliab Mis[/b], have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.[/*][*]You can meet the new NPC [b]Loiscneach[/b], the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.[/*][*][b]Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.[/b][/*][*]See the full post for more information: [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84136/glenn-bearna-the-midwinter-fissure-update]Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update[/url][/b]. Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/glennbearna]dedicated microsite[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
[b]Update Regarding Recent Lag[/b]

We have been working hard to fix the various lag issues that have been occurring of late. Though we reduced the heaviness of the lag a few weeks back, we wanted to improve things further. There are still a few reports we've seen that we will continue to look into, but we feel that the game is in a much better state than when this all began. 

In the future we will need to further update the affected areas which could cause some return of the lag. We will communicate this with you when the time comes, and do our best to avoid and mitigate any issues. 

We apologize for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determined the root causes.

- The Mabinogi Team

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*][b]Upgrade Reversion Kit[/b] can now be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/detail/cash/150742]Item Shop[/url].[/*][*]Print Casual Wear can no longer be upgraded.
[list][*]The upgrade options of already upgraded items will be kept but cannot be further upgraded.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Color has been added to the sword appearance in the animation of the Special Imperial Knight Uniform.
[/*][*]As a material item with the name "Shining Crystal Shard" already exists, the "Shining Crystal Shard" that can be obtained from Glenn Bearna will be renamed to "Frostwork Crystal Shard" in a future patch.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a rare issue that loading the skill UI could cause a client crash.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the charge count appeared abnormally when parallel-casting Elemental Knight skills.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the remaining time for Final Strike appeared abnormally when parallel-casting while using Final Strike. [/*][*]Fixed a rare issue where you could not finish casting Meteor Strike when you are attacked while parallel-casting. [/*][*]Fixed the issue where you could defend the skills which should not be defendable by Dauntless Defense. [list][*]Combo: Pummel[/*][*]Act 6: Crisis[/*][*]Succubus Queen's Butterfly Kiss[/*][*]Merrow’s Waterspout[/*][*]Roaring skills of dragons and Neid[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed the issue where Elemental Attunement was applied when using Thunder skill.[/*][*]Fixed missing plus marks on the announcement text when summoning (or unsummoning) a doll bag.[/*][*]Removed an incorrect mention of Royal Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day) being listed as part of the Snowy Scout's Warm Up Gold Shop.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Fantastic Chorus Enhancement effect to not further boost the reduction to enemy stats. All other portions of the effect are working as intended.[/*][*]An issue where the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title were granted when retrieving the previous season's rewards has been identified. Characters who obtained the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title have had these items replaced with the correct Imbolic Season 2 Challenger Box and Imbolic Season Challenger title automatically during the July 13th maintenance.[/*][*]Found and fixed many typos through the game, this time mostly around G22, G23, Techniques/Briogh, and Arcana quests. [list][*]Thank you players for continuing to report these![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
[/*][*]In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
[/*][*]The Journal images for Glenn Bearna display the dungeon name as "Glenn Berna".[/*][/list]
