notes.title: Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1148/230627_julyupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]
[h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*]A new dungeon, [b]Glenn Bearna[/b], and a new area, [b]Sliab Mis[/b], have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Sidhe Sneachta’s terrain has been partially changed.[/*][*]Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.[/*][*]You can meet the new NPC [b]Loiscneach[/b], the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.[/*][*]Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.[/*][*]Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/glennbearna]dedicated microsite[/url].[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Scenario Quests[/b][/h2][list][*]Cold winds from the northern lands have blown into Tir Chonaill. The Glenn Bearna prologue story will be available. [list][*]During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the quest [b][Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind[/b] is automatically given to characters who have met one of the following condition: Completed Memory Book Volume 3, Completed Generation 1's "Advent of the Goddess", Completed Arcana Guide Quest "Lighting the Arcana's Flame"[list][*]During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the difficulty of battles during quests will be lowered. [/*][/list][/*][*]After The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event ends, the quest [b][Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind[/b] will be automatically given to characters who have at least one Arcana Talent that has at least 1 Link unlocked.   [/*][/list][/*][*]The Glenn Bearna scenario quest line begins with the guide quest, [b][Content] A Flame of Burning Cold[/b].[list][*]This quest is given when the cumulative level is 20,000 or higher, an Arcana Link is unlocked at level 1 or higher, and the prologue story quest, [b][Content] A God of the Northern Winds[/b] is completed.[list][*]You may have to change channels to receive the quest after completing the prologue story.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can proceed with the quest by talking to NPC Laoire in the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.[/*][*]Progress through the story to discover the reason behind the abnormal weather.[/*][*]During the quest, [b][Content] A Tranquil Mirror of Dawn and Dusk[/b], you will discover Sliab Mis and be able to enter Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]After completing the last quest of the scenario, you will be able to enter Sliab Mis and Glenn Bearna without quest limitations.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Glenn Bearna Dungeon[/b][/h2]
[b]Entry Details[/b]
[list][*]Enter Glenn Bearna through the barrier in Sliab Mis, north of Sidhe Sneachta.[/*][*]Dungeon Entry Conditions:[list][*]Cumulative level 20,000 or higher [/*][*]Arcana total level 50 or higher[/*][*]Completing the final Glenn Bearna scenario quest: [Content] A Fantasia of Endless Winter[/*][/list][/*][*]A minimum of 2 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeon[list][*]Note: If you enter with an odd number, party members without pairs can have difficulty with some dungeon objectives.[/*][/list][/*][*]Glenn Bearna has two dungeon difficulty levels: [b]Normal[/b] and [b]Hard[/b]. [/*][*]There is no entry limit, but clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.[/*][/list]
[b]Entry Details[/b]
[list][*]In order to clear the dungeon, you must overcome the frost’s grasp within Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]Solve the paradox between the Day and Night timelines of Glenn Bearna. [/*][*]The dungeon is played in pairs with the Lifeline system.[list][*]The party will be split up into Day and Night groups, and you will be paired with someone from the other side.[/*][*]You can select which side to join and the pair will be randomly determined.[/*][/list][/*][*]You share Lifeline Health with your Lifeline Partner.[list][*]Lifeline Health gauges the shared health bar of the two paired party members depending on the dungeon difficulty.[/*][*]Lifeline Health can be reduced or restored by certain monsters or scenarios within the dungeon.[/*][*]When one gets knocked unconscious while paired in a Lifeline, the Lifeline Health will be reduced by the HP of the unconscious character. [/*][*]Resurrection is possible unless the Lifeline Health reaches 0, and the character who got knocked unconscious and used up the Lifeline Health cannot be revived.[/*][*]When Lifeline Health is reduced to 0, characters with remaining health can still play. [/*][*]If all of the party members' Lifeline Health decreases or there are no pairs left on either side, the dungeon will fail and you will not be able to proceed further.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is a 30-second cooldown when using potions in the dungeon.[/*][*]You can re-enter the Glenn Bearna Dungeon up to 3 times if disconnection occurs.[/*][*]You will move through the dungeon to clear the areas of enemies, and gather the necessary materials to survive the cold.[list][*]Party members in the Daytime are tasked with acquiring Firewood, while those in Nighttime are tasked with acquiring Ember. [list][*]These are accumulated as points and can be gathered by defeating certain enemies. Which party members have accumulated the Firewood and Ember is shown in the party details on the left of the screen.[/*][/list][/*][*]The party must work together to stop the enemies and correct the paradox affecting the areas of Glenn Bearna.[/*][*]Strategically use the braziers, lit brightly by the gathered Firewood and Embers, to collect the souls of enemies and unleash them upon your foes.[/*][*]What else may you encounter in the chill of the winter?[/*][/list][/*][*]You will encounter the following enemies and Boss monsters in Glenn Bearna:[list][*]Fianna Geimhridh[/*][*]Snuggly Sneachta[/*][*]Gwyllion[/*][*]Carnivorous Snowtrap[/*][*]Man-Eating Snowtrap[/*][*]Enkindled Wraith[/*][*]Ember Sprite[/*][*]Icicle Sprite[/*][*]Abominable Rabbit[/*][*]Abominable Rabbit of Equilibrium[/*][*]Frostwork Soul[/*][*]Folach Catt[/*][*]Gwyllgi[/*][*]Ice Golem[/*][*]Pallid Soul[/*][*]Unfinished Reverie[/*][*]Cnoc Oighir[/*][*]Cailleach[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Dungeon Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Rewards can be obtained when clearing the boss of Glenn Bearna. [/*][*]EXP and guaranteed rewards will be dropped from the Dungeon End Chest.[/*][*]Additional rewards such as gems, crafting materials and manuals, enchant scrolls, and set effect enhancement scrolls are also possible to obtain from the Dungeon End Chest. [/*][*]Clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.[list][*]Normal and Hard difficulty levels share the number of rewards obtained. (Resets every Saturday at 7:00 AM PT)[/*][*]You can check the weekly reward count by touching the dungeon entrance or entering the dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Difficulty
[/b][/th][th][b]EXP Obtained[/b][/th][th]Guaranteed Rewards
(Obtain all of the following guaranteed rewards from the Dungeon End Chest)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Normal[/td][td]120,000 EXP[/td][td]• Frostflame Threads x1~5
• Gold Check (300,000~400,000)
• Shining Crystal Shard x1~3
• Comprehensive Recovery 1,500 Potion x3~5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hard[/td][td]120,000 EXP
• Boss EXP 240,000 EXP (divided between party members)[/td][td]• Frostflame Threads x3~7
• Gold Check
(1,000,000~1,100,000)
• Shining Crystal Shard x3~7
• Winterglow Firewood
• Comprehensive Recovery 2,000 Potion x3~5[/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b]Arcana Link Level Up[/b][/h2][list][*]Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint’s Arcana Link has increased from 5 Link Levels to 10 Link  Levels. [/*][*]When you clear Glenn Bearna, you can acquire varying amounts of Frostflame Threads.[/*][*]Exchange Frostflame Threads at the Arcana Enkindling Lectern in the Arcana Association Room for Ice-Scorched Crests, used to further upgrade your Arcana Links.[/*][*]Additional effects have been added for each new stage of [b]Elemental Knight[/b]:[list][*]Link Stage 6: Elemental Knight skill mana consumption reduced by 50%[/*][*]Link Stage 7: Close Combat and Magic talent skill cooldowns reduced by 10% (excluding race-specific skills)[/*][*]Link Stage 8: Increases Min/Max damage by 10% (maximum 50) of Magic Attack when equipped with a Close Combat talent weapon[/*][*]Link Stage 9: Blazing Assault Slash Range increased by +0.8m, Shattering Windmill Attack Radius increased by +2m, Dynavolt Smash Attack Width increased by +1m, and Dauntless Defense Attack Radius increased by +2m[/*][*]Link Stage 10: Blazing Assault Slash, Shattering Windmill, Dynavolt Smash, and Dauntless Defense cooldown reduced by 1 second[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional effects have been added for each new stage of [b]Harmonic Saint[/b]:[list][*]Link Stage 6: Casting Healing or Party Healing grants a stack of Warmth of Life, and Hand of Restoration and Echoes of Salvation gain healing +7% and 200 Wound Recovery per stack of Warmth of Life[/*][*]Link Stage 7: Voice of Vitality Recovery amount increases by +50%, Increases Piercing Resistance by +1 while the Voice of Vitality effect is applied, and Increases Protection/Magic Protection by +20 while the Voice of Vitality effect is applied[/*][*]Link Stage 8: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 seconds, and Increases the duration of Blessing of Protection by 2 seconds[/*][*]Link Stage 9: Pulse of Purification recovers 160 HP and Wounds of allies within the attack range upon inflicting damage to enemies[/*][*]Link Stage 10: Allows self-revival at your location when incapacitated (60 minute cooldown), and resurrection is possible in most cases including even in restricted dungeons, such as Rabbie Phantasm and Glenn Bearna[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Harmonic Saint skills have been adjusted: [list][*]The Voice of Vitality skill-related effects are modified to be applied to all party members.[/*][*]Hand of Restoration skill cooldown is reduced from 5 seconds to 3 seconds (Based on rank 1).[/*][*]Echoes of Salvation skill cooldown is reduced from 8 seconds to 5 seconds (Based on rank 1).[/*][*]The casting time of the Echoes of Salvation skill is changed as follows:[list][*]Rank F ~ A: 2 seconds[/*][*]Rank 9 ~ 2: 1 second[/*][*]Rank 1: Instant activation[/*][/list][/*][*]Echoes of Salvation skill range has been increased from +15m to +20m.[/*][*]Hymn of Resurrection skill casting time is changed to instantly activate.[/*][*]Pulse of Purification is modified so that it will not be canceled even if attacked while in the Iron Will Technique state.[/*][*]Blessing of Protection skill is changed so the cooldown can no longer be reset by using the Time Shift Technique.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[*]To upgrade an Arcana to Link Stage 6 and above, the following materials are required:[list][*]Link Stage 6: 
[list][*]Smoldering Thread x100
[/*][*]Frostflame Thread x10
[list][*]150,000 Gold is required to exchange the Frostflame Thread for an Ice-Scorched Crest.

[h2][b]Introduction of Erg Grade[/b][/h2][list][*]The Erg Grade system has been implemented into the Erg System. [/*][*][b]B-Grade[/b] and [b]A-Grade[/b] Erg Enhancement methods have been added. Existing Erg enhancements are categorized as [b]S-Grade[/b][b] Erg[/b], being the highest grade.[list][*][b]Note: Existing Erg enhanced weapons will become S-Grade Erg enhanced weapons.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Advancement Catalyst B and Advancement Catalyst A items have been added.[/b][list][*]These Catalyst items can be crafted using the Magic Craft skill with at least Rank 9 Magic Craft.[/*][*]Advancement Catalyst B:[list][*]Shyllien Crystal x2[/*][*]Fine Firewood x20[/*][*]Hay Bale x5[/*][*]Holy Water of Lymilark x20[/*][/list][/*][*]Advancement Catalyst A:[list][*]Shyllien Crystal x5[/*][*]Divine Mineral Fragment x5[/*][*]Desecrated Charm Chunk x2[/*][*]Thorny Blue Shackle x2[/*][*]Massive Turtle Shell Chip x2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When attempting to apply Erg to your weapon, you can select one of the three grades which are B, A, and S to start grade enhancement.[/*][*]Weapons with a lower Erg grade will have a lesser Erg effect compared to a higher grade, however the effect is easier to achieve.[list][*]The basic effect of B-grade Erg starts from level 11.[/*][*]A-grade Ergs show the basic effect from level 16 and the bonus effect from level 26.[/*][/list][/*][*]After leveling up a B Grade Erg to level 50, you can talk to Kaelic with an Advancement Catalyst B to upgrade it to A Grade. After increasing the grade, the Erg level will start again at level 30.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1134/erg-advancement.png[/img]
[*]A-grade and B-grade Erg weapons can also be transferred using the Transference Catalyst, but cannot be transferred if the transfer target has a different Erg level.[/*][*]Erg Grade is added to the Auction House as a detailed search option.[/*][*]Additional Weapon Erg Effects have been added for the following weapon types:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1207/erg-weapon-types.png[/img]
*Note: Erg effects for each level based on S grade.
[list][*][b]Erg Enhancement has been improved to add an increased chance of success after a failure when attempting to level break. [/b][list][*]When attempting to level up Erg, the success rate now increases as the number of consecutive failures increases.[/*][*][b]Example[/b]: Success Rate: 0.70% → Failed Upgrade → Success rate: 0.71 (0.70+0.01)%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erg can now be removed from a weapon by talking to Kaelic and selecting the Remove Erg option.[/b][list][*][b]Caution: If an Erg is removed from a weapon, the Erg cannot be recovered. [/b][/*][*]Erg cannot be removed from weapons that are sealed with a Seal Scroll.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Additional Enhancement Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The readability of the equipment upgrade menu has been improved.[/*][*]Upgrades made to items can now be reverted using the [b]Upgrade Reversion Kit[/b].[list][*]Normal Upgrades, Artisan Upgrades, and Gem Upgrades can be removed to return to the previous upgrade. (Special upgrades cannot be removed.)[/*][*]When reverting an upgrade, the proficiency used for the upgrade is restored up to 100.[/*][*]This item can be used on equipment that has been specially upgraded, and does not affect the special upgrade status.[/*][*]This item cannot be used on equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).[/*][*]Upgrade Reversion Kit can be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.[/*][/list][/*][*]Items that have been upgraded will now show the list of current upgrades applied in the item tooltip.[list][*]You cannot check the list of upgrades for equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).[/*][/list][/*][*]The number of possible Echostone advancement attempts within Sidhe Finnachaid has been increased from 3 to 5.[/*][*]The number of Echostone awakenings has been limited according to the character's cumulative level.[list][*]The AP cost per awakening attempt has not been changed.[/*][*]The limit is refreshed upon entering the dungeon again.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Cumulative Level
[/b][/th][th]Awakening Attempts[/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 29,999 and below[/td][td]5 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 30,000 ~ 39,999[/td][td]10 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 40,000 ~ 49,999[/td][td]15 times[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 50,000 and above[/td][td]unlimited[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]A separate warning notice is now displayed when fragmenting an Echostone of grade 20 or higher.[/*][*]Success Rates for Echostone Advancements have been improved.[list][*]The Advancement Success Rate when clearing Sidhe Finnachaid Advanced is:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]Grade 18 or lower: [b]100%[/b][/td][td]Grade 19-21: [b]90%[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Grade 22-24: [b]75%[/b][/td][td]Grade 25 or higher: [b]45%[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]The drop rate of Runes used to upgrade the Alban Knights Emblem have increased.[/*][*]The number of Runes that can be acquired when clearing the Alban Knights Training Grounds is greatly increased.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - July 6th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2913/230321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 9:18 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.[/b]

Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on July 6th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 3 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, July 6th
[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 10:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]We used up all of the fireworks! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84126/independence-day-hot-day-event]Independence Day Hot Day Event[/url] is ending.[/*][*]We managed to fish up all of Vivi's stars just in time! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83560/star-fishing-event-returns]Star-Fishing Event Returns! Event[/url] is ending.[/*][*]The tide is coming in, and it's time to swim to shore. The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83692/open-ocean-box]Open Ocean Box[/url] sale is ending.[/*][*]The [b]Summer Master Plan Event[/b] is back! The scouts are here to help. Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/84341/the-scouts-snowy-summer-warm-up-event]Scouts' Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event[/url]![/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. Note: The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1016/230627_masterplanevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Is there a chill in the air? It looks like the Scouts' are training nearby in Tir Chonaill! Earn EXP and rewards through the various training and collection events, or log in for hotday rewards!

[h2][b]The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event [/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, July 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Cold Wind Blows in Tir Chonaill[/b]. Will you help the scouts investigate the cold?[/*][*]Find [b]Scout Leader Kalin[/b] in Tir Chonaill.[/*][/list][list][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A Cold Wind Blows in Tir Chonaill:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*]

[list][*]View your play records during the event period, available benefits, or move to the Scouts through this menu![/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the quest: [b][Guide] The Scouting Party’s Request[/b][/*][*]Talk to Scout Leader Kalin in Tir Chonaill to register a main character for the event.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]The main character will have access to the following benefits:[list][*]Inventory Rental Bag (Master Plan Inventory)[/*][*]Pet Rental[/*][*]Weekly Quests[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] The Scouting Party’s Request:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*]Scouting Party’s Special Potion[list][*]Drink this to increase your stats for the duration of the event:[/*][*]Defense +10[/*][*]Protection +5[/*][*]Magic Defense +10[/*][*]Magic Protection +5[/*][*]HP +500[/*][*]MP +500[/*][*]Stamina +500[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - June 29th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2913/230321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on June 29th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

notes.title: Mabinogi Fantasy Party - Announcement Recap
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2548/230616_mabinogifantasypartycampfirerecap_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Hi Milletians,

[b]Fantasy Party[/b] is an event that our partners and development team hold in Korea for the Milletians of the Korean Mabinogi service. This showcase is broadcast live to celebrate the Anniversary and reflect on Mabinogi, and new updates and concepts are often revealed! 

Did you join CM Arciellia during her livestream to listen in and watch the showcase? If not, we’re here to share a recap of the exciting updates to come to all Mabinogi services. 

If you would like to watch the livestream with CM Arciellia and GM Seeing (our Localization Translator), check it out here: 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1848305971][b]Twitch Video Link[/b][/url]

[b]You can also watch the Fantasy Party livestream here: 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/ssU2DPklghU?feature=share&t=3615]KR YouTube Broadcast Video Link[/url][/b]

During our livestream, CM Arciellia and GM Seeing watched the showcase together and shared their reactions and thoughts to all of the information presented. GM Seeing has also provided an English translation of the Korean presentation, [b]live[/b]! [i](Please keep in mind that this is a first for our team and context from a live interpretation can differ slightly from the original presenter’s intention.)[/i]

We highly recommend watching the livestream to hear the developer’s intentions and see all of the concept art that was showcased. Below, we will share a brief list of the contents discussed during the event:

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2533/fantasy-party-summer-update-infographic.png[/img]

[i][b]Summer Showcase[/b]

[b]*This content is expected to be released in Summer 2023 for the Korean Mabinogi service. We are excited to share these contents with you, and the release plan for our service will be shared at a later time. As the contents plan is not yet finalized and these contents are still in development, some details are subject to change.  [/b][/i]

Contents Leader Choi Dongmin presents the upcoming contents: 

[b]In July 2023 (KR):[/b]
[list][*]As a major Life contents, [b]Part-time Jobs[/b] will receive a major update. This update will make Part-time Jobs more accessible and convenient, and the rewards will see an improvement. Additionally, a server-wide buff will be added to boost the rewards![/*][*]With an improvement in Blaanid's Brave Boost, a new [b]Spirit Weapon Tutorial[/b] will be introduced, with a familiar returning face, [b]Eiry[/b]. Eiry is a spirit weapon for all Milletians and does not take up a spirit slot. She also loves all gems and accumulates EXP quickly![/*][*]Changes to mainstream quests will be added to improve the playability of RP dungeons, and the difficulty of certain dungeons will be reduced. The Quest UI will be improved, and the camera angle when talking to NPCs as a Giant will be updated.[/*][*]A [b]new content growth guide[/b] for Combat and Life will be implemented as a content progression system with rewards.[/*][/list]
[b]In August 2023 (KR):[/b]
[list][*][b]Two new Arcana Talents and new NPCs in charge of those talents have been revealed! 
[i]*Localized names subject to change[/i][/b][list][*]“Alchemic Stinger" - Battle Alchemy + Archery [/*][*]"Dark Mage" - Chain Slash + Magic [/*][/list][/*][*][b][b]Enchanting[/b] will see a change where upon failure of an enchantment, you can choose between losing all durability on the Enchant Scroll, or the weapon receiving failure penalties. 
[/b][/*][*][b]Special Upgrade changes will bring a new conversion feature where current special upgraded items can be converted to the opposing type using a new stone (released through events and as a crafting recipe). Blue Upgrades will also have a Bonus Max Damage effect added on top of the current effects. [/b][/*][/list]
[b]In September 2023 (KR):[/b]
[list][*]New [b]"[/b][b]Chronicle[/b][b]"[/b] Missions will be introduced in Avon. The first mission will relay the story of The First Battle of Mag Tuireadh.[list][*]Rewards introduced in the dungeon will include Untradable Rank 1 reforged Celtic Weapons and Protective Upgrade Stones, and New [b]Celtic Series weapons[/b] are finally here: the Celtic Bow, Celtic Two-handed Sword, Celtic Lance[/*][/list][/*][*]New [b]Perseus Weapons[/b] will be added![/*][*]New Nightbringer One-handed Blunt Weapon will also be added, and other Nightbringer weapons will be buffed to keep the value of these weapons above the new Perseus Weapons.[/*][*][b]Dungeon Reward Drop Rates[/b] will be improved![/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2534/mabinogi-x-unreal-engine.png[/img]

[i][b]Mabinogi Eternity[/b]
[b]*A special look at the future development of Mabinogi.[/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=wrbmZQF8g3E;full][/previewyoutube]

Director Min Kyunghoon highlights the start of a new journey for Mabinogi; replacing the game’s engine with Unreal Engine 5. Though this will be a long and difficult process, two main goals have been briefly shared with us. The first is the focus on the unique and captivating points of Mabinogi and the game’s visuals. It is expected that many graphical issues will be resolved. The team will continue to show improvements in the future through many more quality of life and content renewals. Though, certain contents that seldom see activity may be phased out. 

Further on, the expansion of fantasy life will be strengthened for Milletians to dream more broadly, such as underwater adventures, in-flight commerce fights, crafting your own boat to fish on, and more that we can only imagine thus far.

We hope this glimpse of what is to come for Mabinogi this year, and beyond, is as exciting for you as it is for us! We’re so happy to share these details with you. Please also look forward to an upcoming Producer Letter soon, where we will share more information about the upcoming updates expected this year.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

The success rate is 100%.[/*][*][b]Unstable[/b]: When used on an enchantable Sequel Figure, it will grant +1-2 of the indicated stat with a varying success rate of 15%~65% depending on the stat desired. [list][*]Example: When enhancing a figure to Max Damage (3/3) and achieving the maximum boost, a total of +6 Max Damage will be available. [/*][*]The number of available enhancements decreases upon failure as well as success.[/*][*]Can only be used on Sequel Figures that have been enhanced at least 5 times.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Boost Potions will expire after 7 days once received.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 4: Archery, Magic, and Race-Specific Skill Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2291/230530_juneupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]

[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2235/archer.png[/img][/b][b] Archery
[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2237/archery-compilation-resized.gif[/img][/b]

[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2306/ranged-attack.png[/img] Ranged Attack[/b]
[list][*]The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect is added. (+20% at Dan Rank 3)[list][*]The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect can be stacked.[/*][*]There is a maximum upper limit for the ranged attack minimum aim rate which cannot be exceeded. (Max +40%)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2240/magnum-shot.png[/img] Magnum Shot[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.
[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 560%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 590%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2238/crash-shot.png[/img] Crash Shot[/b]
[list][*]The fragment damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 280%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 370%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2241/urgent-shot.png[/img] Urgent Shot[/b]
[list][*]The Urgent Shot effect has been changed:[list][*][b]Before[/b]: Increased aiming speed for ranged attacks after Urgent Shot.[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Damage with Ranged Combat Skills +% for 10 sec. after Urgent Shot.[/*][/list][/*][*]After using Urgent Shot, damage with Ranged Combat Skills will be increased for 10 seconds. (12% at Rank 1)[/*][*]When using Urgent Shot, 10% of maximum health and stamina will be used.[/*][*]The Yellow Echostone awakening ability of “Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use” is replaced with “Urgent Shot Effect Duration.” (Increased by 0.1 seconds per level with a max of 2 seconds at level 20)[/*][*]The title effect of “the Master of Urgent Shot” has been changed:
[list][*][b]Before[/b]: DEX +20, Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use 30%, STR -20, Will -10[/*][*][b]After[/b]: DEX +20, Urgent Shot HP and Stamina Cost -2%, STR -20, Will -10[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2236/magic.png[/img] [/b][b]Magic 

[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2262/magic-compilation-resized.gif[/img][/b]

[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2260/hail-storm.png[/img] Hail Storm[/b]
[list][*]When knocked down while casting, it has been changed so that the number of charges accumulated will be reduced by 1.[list][*]The skill is canceled when knocked down with 1 charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2258/blaze.png[/img] Blaze[/b]
[list][*]The target range is increased.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: Melee attack distance + 0.5 meters[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Melee attack distance + 2 meters[/*][/list][/*][*]The casting time to max charge has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 3 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1.5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]A marker is displayed on all enemies within range while preparing the skill.[/*][*]The 2 second delay after using the skill has been removed, as well a the immunity to some negative effects that were applied during the delay.[/*][*]Improvements have been made to the mouse cursor when using the skill.[/*][*]The knockdown gauge dependence is reduced by 50% in the explosion damage formula.[list][*]Previously, 70% of the knockdown gauge could draw out all the explosion damage, but now it is possible to draw out all the explosion damage with only 35% of the knockdown gauge.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where damage was applied abnormally when switching weapons before applying explosive damage.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Wind Blast damage was applied abnormally when using it after using Blaze.[/*][*]Improved skill so that it is not canceled when an enemy is selected outside the range while charging.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2261/lightning-rod.png[/img] Lightning Rod[/b]
[list][*]Added a directional display effect that lets you know the attack direction while preparing the skill.[/*][*]The duration of the magic circle effect has been changed.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 20 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: Unlimited[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2264/shockwave.png[/img] Shockwave[/b]
[list][*]The delay after using the skill has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 1 second[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 0.3 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where the direction the character is facing changed after using the skill.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2265/spellwalk.png[/img] Spellwalk[/b]
[list][*]Improvements have been made so that skill use is maintained even when moving to a different area.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2263/meteor-strike.png[/img] Meteor Strike[/b]
[list][*]Improvements have been made so that the skill slot remains visible during the flashing effect when the skill hits.[list][*]This is also applied when using the “Mini Effects” performance option setting.[/*][*]You can now turn off the flashing effect of Meteor Strike by using the "Mini Effects" performance option setting.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2259/fusion-bolt.png[/img] Fusion Bolt[/b]
[list][*]When attacking with the skill, 50% of the opponent's magic defense is applied for each bolt.
[list][*]For bolt magic combinations, a total of 2 magic defense calculations are applied, once for each bolt magic combination.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Race-Specific Skills
[/b][/h2]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.[/*][*]Ladeca skills (Breath of Ladeca, Vision of Ladeca, Might of Ladeca) for all three races will no longer be canceled when changing channels, logging off, or rebirthing.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Human
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2257/human-compilation-compressed.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2254/arrow-revolver.png[/img] Arrow Revolver[/b]
[list][*]The damage multiplier for each shot is increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 110% / 120% / 125% / 145% / 190%[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 170% / 180% / 185% / 205% / 250%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The aim rate bonus that was applied only to the first hit has been removed.[/*][*]You can now perform a volley attack by pressing Ctrl + Right-Click on an enemy while preparing the skill. This will take into account the current aiming accuracy rate and damage multiplier of the current number of shots.[list][*][b]Example 1[/b]: When attacking with a volley immediately after preparing a Rank 1 skill, the first hit will attack 5 times in a row with a damaging multiplier of 170%.
[/*][*][b]Example 2[/b]: When attacking with a volley after firing 2 shots with a Rank 1 skill, the 3rd hit will attack 3 times in a row with a damage multiplier of 185%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]An issue where the skill use status was not displayed normally when cast during knockback has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2255/breath-of-ladeca.png[/img] Breath of Ladeca[/b]
[list][*]A 10% bonus damage effect has been added for close combat skills when dual swords are equipped.[list][*]Applicable skills include:[list][*]Normal Attack, Smash, Counterattack, Charge, Assault Slash, Rage Impact, Bash, Windmill, Final Hit
[/*][*]Elemental Knight skills are not directly applied, but instead indirectly applied due to increased damage of Smash/Windmill/Assault Slash.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Note: The bonus damage effect will stack with additional damage buffs for a combined calculation.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Elf
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2244/elf-compilation-resized.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2247/mirage-missile.png[/img] Mirage Missile[/b]
[list][*]The effect duration of the Mirage Missile has been increased. [list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill: [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 21 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 22 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Damage over time interval has been reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second.[/*][*]Damage for Mirage Shot based on the character’s Intelligence has been increased.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2245/elven-magic-missile.png[/img] Elven Magic Missile[/b]
[list][*]The Elven Magic Missile can now be used while Final Shot is active.[/*][*]The way to use the skill has been changed from the existing mini-game method to selecting and using the desired attribute.[list][*]When using the skill, 3 attribute options are activated. You can select the desired option by using F1~F3 keys and the chosen option will be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]It has been changed so that you can move while casting the skill.[/*][*]The cooldown of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 9 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]Casting time of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.[/*][*]The projectile speed of Elven Magic Missile is increased.[/*][*]The Fire, Lightning, and Ice attribute damage of Elven Magic Missile is increased.[/*][*]The splash radius of Elven Magic Missile's Lightning and Ice attributes is reduced.[/*][*]The freezing effect specifications of the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile are changed to be the same as the Ice Spear specifications.[/*][*]It is changed so that you can attack a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect.[list][*][b]When attacking a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect, the damage dealt is reduced by 30%.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2246/final-shot.png[/img] Final Shot[/b]
[list][*]When Final Shot is active, it has been changed so that the character cannot be stunned or knocked down.[/*][*]The duration of Final Shot has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 45 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 50 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Giant
[/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2249/giant-compilation-resized.gif[/img]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2248/final-strike.png[/img] Final Strike[/b]
[list][*]The stun time after attacking is reduced for each rage stage. [list][*][b]Before[/b]: 2 sec / 1.5 sec / 1 sec per level[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1.5 sec / 1 sec / 0.75 sec per level[/*][/list][/*][*]An issue where the rage level is reset when an Elemental Knight Instill skill is activated and a skill is casted has been fixed.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2251/stomp.png[/img] Stomp[/b]
[list][*]The cooldown for Stomp has been removed, and it can be used immediately.[/*][*]The stun time after use has been reduced.[list][*][b]Before[/b]: 1.5 seconds[/*][*][b]After[/b]: 1 second[/*][/list][/*][*]During the skill preparation, an indication mark has been added to identify enemies within attack range.[/*][*]Enemies that are stunned can now be hit by Stomp.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2252/taunt.png[/img] Taunt[/b]
[list][*]The enemies that can be lured have been expanded.[list][*]Boss-level monsters in content such as Crom Bás, Tech Duinn Missions, Mag Mell Missions, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeons, Apostle Raids and Field Raids cannot be lured.[/*][/list][/*][*]An effect that increases Defense and Magic Defense by 20 in proportion to the number of monsters successfully provoked has been added.[list][*]Taunt timer may differ from affected enemies after recasting the skill.[/*][/list][/*][*]The “Taunt Defense and Magic Defense increase per enemy provoked” Reforging attribute and Echostone Awakening ability has been added.[list][*]Equipment with the “Enhanced Taunt'” Reforging attribute and Red Echostones with the 'Strengthening Taunt Lure' Awakening ability have been changed to the “Taunt Defense and Magic Defense increase per enemy provoked” attribute of the same level.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2253/throwing-attack.png[/img] Throwing Attack[/b]
[list][*]You can activate Redoubled Offensive (Technique) and Blast (Stardust Support Effect) when attacking an enemy with Throwing Attack.[/*][*]“Throwing Attack - Cooldown Reduction” Reforging attribute has been added.[list][*]This attribute does not appear on Echostones.[/*][/list][/*][*]Atlatl with the “Attack Speed Increase - Set Effect Value'' Reforging attribute has been changed to the “Throwing Attack - Cooldown Reduction” attribute of the same level.[/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2250/giant-full-swing.png[/img] Giant Full Swing[/b]

notes.title: Quality of Life - Patch Notes - May 11th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the May Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82400/wandering-troupe-box]Wandering Troupe Box[/url]: Thursday, April 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 25th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82633/cotton-candy-sheep-event]Cotton Candy Sheep Event[/url]: Thursday, April 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 25th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83051/inquisitor-s-box]Inquisitor's Box[/url]: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82889/sweet-coffee-event-returns]Sweet Coffee Event Returns![/url]: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83113/milletian-events-a-may-zing-2x-boost-up]Milletian Events: A-May-Zing 2x Boost Up![/url]: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80656/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-3]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 3[/url]: Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82434/may-quality-of-life-updates]May Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82434/may-quality-of-life-updates]May Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]Enchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.[/*][*]The Adventurer Seal system has been renewed, and the shop has been updated with new items.[/*][*]The Mabinogi BGM song titles have been improved greatly, thanks to our localization team! [/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[i]Hey all, GM Quuku here from the Quality Assurance team!

You may have noticed that we've done some Spring Cleaning as of late- we've been correcting more older bugs in each of our patches, and trying to hit newly released bugs as soon as they crop up.

If you'd cast your eyes below, you'll notice that our Known Bugs list has shrunk. We want to shift this from an incomplete backlog of our bugs into a parseable list that contains the largest, newest, and most relevant issues. We still have a (sizeable!) internal backlog that we're cruising through- these bugs haven't just gone away. Our team is dedicated to bringing you a quality play experience, and working through all bugs (new and old) in this distinguished game we play is one of our goals.

Many Milletians have been extremely kind in assisting us in squashing these issues as well, thank you so much for your support and patience. If you spot an issue, feel more than welcomed to report it to us via the official [url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi]Mabinogi Discord[/url]![/i]

[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Players will now have more time during the G23 Card Flip minigame. [/*][*]Blaanid's Song "Where Memories Come Together" during Memoir Book 2 now properly plays. Yay Blaanid![/*][*]The Set Item name for Movement Speed Increase has been modified to differentiate the movement speed types.[list][*]Eweca Movement Speed Increase [list][*]Example: Items such as Fleet Feet or Shooting Star shoes. [/*][/list][/*][*]Ladeca Movement Speed Increase[list][*]Example: Items such as Abyss Dragon Armor or Imperial Knight Boots.
[/*][/list][/*][*]Eweca and Ladeca Movement Speed Increase effects can be applied to the character at the same time.
Note: At least 10 points of a set item effect must be equipped to activate the effect. Equipped items that exceed 10 points of a set item effect will not grant additional effects. Additionally, the highest value of a set effect type is applied to the character.[/*][/list][/*][*]Revised several in-game BGM song titles to accurately reflect the songs and their details.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing in-game lag after maintenances.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing login lag after maintenances.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the G10 quest "Prophecy of Irinid" would fail to start from the Crystal Ball.[/*][*]Fixed a few minor graphic issues with the following items:[list][*]Dragon Guardian Shoes[/*][*]Special / Imperial Commander Uniforms (M)[/*][*]Special Casual Tech Chic Outfits (M)(F).[/*][/list][/*][*]The map and region name for Gairech Hills have been properly translated.[/*][*]Fixed an issue causing the Daily Messages from specific Support Puppets to not display.[/*][*]The Space Cadet pet skill text for "Cleansing Dust" will now display correctly when the pet is unsummoned.[/*][*]Corrected the Set Item descriptions for the following set bonuses: 
[list][*]Troubadour[/*][*]Demolition[/*][*]Ruination[/*][*]Perseus[/*][*]Elemental Harmony[/*][*]Forest Ranger[/*][/list][/*][*]Found a rare issue where Cliona would only sell four items, instead of the expected five, during the Tara Auction.[/*][*]Sheared a looming timer on the Cotton Candy Sheep (Aspiring to TRUE STRENGTH!) description. [list][*]A f-ewe other edits were made as well, worthy of sheeps of praise. Mutton's gonna stop us now! We're on the lamb! We can-dy this all day, we have a cot-ton of these![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]During the Master Plan event, when you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][/list]

notes.title: May Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1774/230505_mayupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]May Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2][list][*]The maximum stack size for Golden Magic Wool has been increased to 100.[/*][*]The logic when mounting a summoned pet has been improved.[list][*]The problem of failing to mount a pet that is moving has been alleviated. [/*][*]An issue where the character did not respond to the mounting hotkey (Default: ‘R’ key) has been fixed.[/*][*]When using the hotkey to mount, if the pet is a certain distance away from the character, improvements have been made so that mounting takes place after the command to call the pet has been used. (Hotkey setting “Call the pet” in Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings)[/*][*]After using the hotkey command to guide the pet to you, it will no longer return to the target it was attacking after returning to its owner. [list][*]However, if the AI of the animal character is in the Collaborative Attack/Auto Attack mode, you can set another target and proceed with the battle again.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The visual effects of the Phantasmal Sight Technique have been changed. It has been improved so that each effect can be distinguished by a difference in shape.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1636/technique.png[/img]
[list][*]Improvements have been made so that higher enchant rolls can be received when the enchantment is successful, and the penalty that decreases durability when the enchantment fails has been alleviated.[list][*][b]Great Success[/b]: It has been changed to apply the enchantment with a value of 80% or more of the floating value when a Great Success enchantment occurs.[list][*]Example: For an effect outlined as, "When Bash is Rank 1 or higher, Max Damage +22-48", and a Great Success occurs, the enchant roll will have a value of 80% or more of the possible enchant rolls. The available rolls would be between +42-48.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Catastrophic Failure[/b]: The equipment durability penalty has been reduced when a Catastrophic Failure enchantment occurs.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that you can check detailed information such as the type of firewood used when burning an item, whether an Enchant Extraction Protection Potion has been applied, and the success rate of the enchant burn.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1790/enchant_burning.png[/img]
[list][*]An updated report function has been added.[list][*]When you right-click on a character, the “Report” option is now available.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Adventurer Seal System and Shop have been renewed.[list][*]The daily quests that award Adventurer Seals are the same as before, and the number of Adventurer Seals given as rewards has been doubled.[/*][*]The Adventurer Seal has been changed so that bank sharing between characters is not possible.[/*][*]New items have been added to the Seal Shop of NPC Seal Merchant in Dunbarton and Belvast. For a full list of available items, check the chart below. [/*][*]The following items have been removed from the Seal shop:[list][*]Exploration Journal, Page 1[/*][*]Exploration Journal, Page 2[/*][*]Exploration Journal, Page 3[/*][*]Exploration Journal, Page 4[/*][*]Exploration Journal, Page 5[/*][*]Golden Elephant Statue[/*][*]Golden Sundial Artifact[/*][*]Golden Dragon Statue[/*][*]Dowra SE[/*][*]Taunes MK3[/*][*]Hermit's Staff[/*][*]Fox Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Bowman's Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Skilled Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Mana Needle Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Wolf Hunter's Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Penetrating Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Water Drop Enchant Scroll[/*][*]Vine Enchant Scroll[/*][/list][/*][*]Precise Reforging Tools, types of Dungeon Passes, Marionettes, Skill Training Seals, or Stardust materials purchased with Adventurer Seals are not tradable.[/*][*]The purchase limit is applied per account, and the reset time is as follows.[list][*]Items sold at all times or on specific days of the week will reset at 12:00 AM PT.
The purchase limit for Precise Reforging Tools will reset every Thursday at 7:00 AM PT.
[/*][/list][/*][*]In the Stardust Material Selection Box, you can acquire 5 Core Fragments and 5 Regulators of the material type of your choice.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1791/adventurer-seal-shop-table.png[/img]
[list][*]Several revisions have been made to the titles of many songs in Mabinogi. You may notice these changes in the Jukebox or MabiNovel. After a diligent review by our localization team, we have improved the song titles to focus the original intention of the title and included tags to detail where the theme is from.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Regarding the Recent Lag Issues
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Dear Milletians,

As we shared [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82203/producer-s-letter-regarding-the-windows-server-maintenanc]during the April 6th maintenance[/url], the servers were updated from an older version to a much newer version. Although the deployment issue was resolved with our extended maintenance, we began observing login delays and lag issues. To resolve these issues in the short term, we opted to run an unscheduled maintenance in the middle of the week to restart the servers as we continued to investigate the cause.

After various investigations, we decided to revert the login server to the previous version during the April 24th maintenance. While this resolved the login delay/lag issue, the in-game lag, including skill usage and pet summoning delays, continued to occur. As such, our teams have continued to investigate, and during the May 4th maintenance, we made another server change to help address the in-game lag issue we were seeing. We will be working with the development team and performing additional tests to identify and resolve the root cause so that future server changes can be applied smoothly.

We truly appreciate the support and patience you've shown us through Discord and other platforms as we looked into this. Thank you for understanding! We will be running weekly buff events for the remainder of May. Please enjoy the following events as noted in [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/83113/milletian-events-a-may-zing-2x-boost-up]Milletian Events: A-May-Zing 2x Boost Up![/url] :
[list][*]2x Stardust Boost[/*][list][*]Material rewards from completing Society Sponsorship Quests are doubled.[/*][/list][*]2x Spirit EXP[/*][list][*]The Weekly cap for the Spirit EXP is also doubled.[/*][/list][*]2x Combat EXP [/*][*]2x AP[/*][*]2x All Skill Training[/*][/list]
Sincerely,
[i]~ GM Mewlynne, Mabinogi Producer
& The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[b]NEXT Step UP!:[/b]
[list][*]New additions come to Mabinogi with the NEXT Step UP! update. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82033/next-step-up]NEXT Step UP![/url] 
[list][*]New signet effect items have been added to amplify the Celtic and Divine equipment.[/*][*]The Journeyman’s Reforging Tool has been added.[/*][*]Additional dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Guide.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The [b]Festival Instrument Coupon[/b] can now be purchased from Walter’s General Shop for 50,000 Gold.[list][*]Festival Instruments have a unique sound. [/*][*]Using the coupon allows you to exchange your current instrument for one of the returned Festival versions:[list][*]Flute[/*][*]Lute[/*][*]Mandolin[/*][*]Ukulele[/*][*]Whistle[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b] When exchanging the instrument, existing attributes and dye colors of the original instrument will not be transferred.[/*][/list][/*][*]After defeating the Subject Theta boss in Apocalypse Raid, any incapacitated party members will now be revived automatically. [/*][*]Added the following missing items to the Dressing Room. [list][*]Hat:[list][*]Dairy Cow[/*][/list][/*][*]Accessory[list][*]Supreme Abyss Dragon Halo[/*][*]Gold Noble Marionette Halo[/*][*]Gold Royal Marionette Halo[/*][/list][/*][*]Robe[list][*]Infinite Angel Down Wings[/*][*]Snowy Celestial Daydream Pure Wings[/*][*]Blazing Angel Down Wings[/*][*]Lovely Seraph Down Wings[/*][*]Charming Long Faux Fur Coat[/*][*]Dramatic Long Faux Fur Coat[/*][*]Charming Short Faux Fur Coat[/*][*]Dramatic Short Faux Fur Coat[/*][*]Elegant Floral Crescent Wings[/*][*]Fresh Floral Crescent Wings[/*][*]Luminous Nebula Wings[/*][*]Radiant Dreamseer's Unicorn Wings[/*][*]Virtuous Dreamseer's Unicorn Wings[/*][*]Pure Dreamseer's Unicorn Wings[/*][*]Engimatic Dreamseer's Unicorn Wings[/*][*]Noble Bleugenne Angel Wings[/*][*]Snowy Celestial Daydream Pure Wings[/*][*]Icy Crow Wings[/*][*]Sunkissed Bleugenne Glass Wings[/*][*]Dazzling Ascent Wings[/*][*]Towering Ascent Wings[/*][*]Pure Enchanting Aroma Prism Wings[/*][*]Infinite Seraph Down Wings[/*][*]Infinite Celestial Daydream Pure Wings[/*][*]Special Hydrangea Wings (Enchantable)[/*][/list][/*][*]Chair[list][*]Flying Saucer
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Changed "Cotton Candy Poofs Sword" to "Mitarashi Dango Sword".[/*][*]Changed "Vintage Ray Guns Dual Guns" to "Dual Vintage Ray Guns".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Queen Eirawen's eyes were occasionally misaligned.[/*][*]Players have been letting us know they felt that the Fossil Restoration during G8 was too difficult. Belita will now accept less than utter perfection from you.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a rare issue where players would be unable to progress during the G13 quest "Avon".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Rank B Meditation skill quest was incorrectly named.[list][*]The quest has been renamed from "[Magic] Collect High Capacity Elemental" to "[Magic] Collect Massive Elementals".[/*][/list][/*][*]Lorna's blue eyes and bright smile are now correctly displaying in all areas.[/*][*]Under incredibly specific conditions, the text would fail to advance when speaking with Deian. Mature female Milletians can now successfully reject his advances.[/*][*]The skill requirement for Rank E Wine Making now correctly refers to Your First Glass of Wine Vol. 2 instead of Vol. 1. Aeira was trying to get an additional purchase out of you![/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where certain NPC Transformations are missing the models for their bodies.[/*][*]There is an issue where Shadow Mission Tarlach does not grant Baol Dungeon Pass.[/*][*]There is a minor issue where the Pet Skill Window is unable to collapse properly.[/*][*]When a Partner on the Homestead is using the Bird Buddy Gesture, certain UI menus will close erratically.[/*][*]The Tara Auction House notice may overlap with Event notices on the scrolling banner.[/*][*]When attempting to paint the "Subtle Cintamani Figure" and "Dragon's Broken Sword Figure" homestead items, the items appear abnormally in the preview menu.[/*][/list]

[b]New Celtic and Divine Signets[/b]
[list][*]New signet effect items have been added to amplify the Celtic and Divine equipment.[/*][*]You can use a Celtic/Divine Signet or Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet item to grant a signet effect to the corresponding Celtic or Divine equipment, or to increase the level of the given signet effect.[/*][*]Each Celtic/Divine Signet and Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet item can only be used on the designated target equipment. At this time, it is not affected by other enchantments of the target equipment.
[list][*]Example 1) Celtic Signet: Celtic War Hammer item can only be used for the Celtic War Hammer that has no signet effect or is level 1~4.[/*][*]Example 2) [b]Advanced[/b] Celtic Signet: Celtic War Hammer item can only be used for a Celtic War Hammer with a signet effect of level 5~9.
[/*][*]Example 3) [b]Divine[/b] Signet: Divine Crossbow can only be used for a Divine Crossbow that has no signet effect or is level 1~4.
[/*][*]Example 4) [b]Advanced[/b] Divine Signet: Divine Crossbow item can only be used for a Divine Crossbow with a signet effect of level 5~9.[/*][/list][/*][*]Granting a signet effect or enhancing the signet effect level succeeds with a certain probability for each item, and the used signet item is consumed regardless of the result.[list][*]Celtic/Divine Signet: Success Rate 10% 
[/*][*]Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet: Success Rate 5%
[/*][/list][/*][*]The signet effect level of an item can be enhanced up to 10, and the effect increases in proportion to the signet effect level.[list][*]Example) In the case of Celtic Tribolt Wand's signet effect, “Fusion Bolt Final Damage”, the 1st level effect amount is 0.8%, and the 10th level effect amount is 8%.[/*][/list][/*][*]The applied signet effect can be checked in the ‘Signet Effect' area of ​​the item description.[/*][*]Different signet effects are added to the equipment depending on the equipment type.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Equipment[/b][/th][th][b]Signet Effect Details[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Celtic Royal Knight Sword[/td][td]Increases Final Hit Final Damage by 0.4% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Celtic War Hammer, Celtic Royal War Hammer, Celtic Battle Axe, Celtic Royal Battle Axe[/td][td]Increases Bash Damage by 0.5% per level

Increases Fire/Water/Wind/Earth Alchemic Damage by +1 per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Celtic Edged Knuckles[/td][td]Increases Combo Damage by 2% per level Combo Cooldown Reset on Critical Hit with a 1.5% chance per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Celtic Control Bar[/td][td]Reduces Puppetry Skill Cooldown by 0.1 seconds per level

Increases Kunai Storm Final Damage by 0.8% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Celtic Dowra Ace[/td][td]Increases final damage of dual gun normal attacks while Way of the Gun is active by 1% per level

Increases Bash Damage by 0.5% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Shield[/td][td]Increases Bash Damage by 0.5% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Blade[/td][td]Increases Final Hit Final Damage by 0.4% per level 

Increases Final Strike Rage Obtained by 0.8% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Tribolt Wand[/td][td]Increases Fusion Bolt Final Damage by 0.8% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Spell Book[/td][td]Increases Magic Attack Power by +1.5 per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Crossbow[/td][td]Crash shot final damage per level increased by 0.8%, archery skill final damage increased by 0.5% while final shot was activated per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Short Lance[/td][td]Increases Max Damage by +1 per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Cinnsealach L2[/td][td]Increases final damage of dual gun normal attacks while Way of the Gun is active by 1% per level

[b]New Journeyman's Reforging Tool[/b]
[list][list][*]The [b]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool[/b] has been added.[/*][*]Three types of [b]Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool (Basic/Intermediate/Advanced)[/b] items can be acquired according to the difficulty of the dungeon.[list][*]The items can be obtained from certain dungeons and missions. [b]<Link to New Dungeon Rewards chart>[/b]
The Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can also be obtained from the Dungeon Voucher Shop. [b]<Link to Dungeon Guide System Changes Section>[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool items have an expiration date of 1 day and cannot be traded.[/*][*]When used, a specified amount of Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can be obtained. If a Huge Lucky Bonus is activated, you can obtain a larger amount than usual.[list][*]You can obtain 1 ~ 5 tools upon use of the Basic Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.[/*][*]You can obtain 5 ~ 10 tools upon use of the Intermediate Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool. [/*][*]You can obtain 10 ~ 15 tools upon use of the Advanced Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can acquire up to 60 [b]Journeyman’s Reforging Tools[/b] per day when using Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tools, and you can check the number of daily acquisitions through the notice message on the left of the screen. 
[/*][*]If you use the Calcified (Basic/Intermediate/Advanced) Journeyman’s Reforging Tools after reaching 60 daily acquisitions, you can acquire 1 [b]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool Fragment[/b] each.[list][*]If you collect and use 20 Journeyman’s Reforging Tool Fragments, you can exchange them for 1 Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.[/*][/list][/*][*]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool will expire in 5 days from acquisition, and cannot be traded.
[/*][*]The daily acquisition limit is reset every day in real time at 7:00 AM PT.
[/*][*]When using the [b]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool[/b]:[/*][/list][/list][table][tr][th][b]Function[/b][/th][th][b]Journeyman's Reforging Tool[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Number of Attribute Slots Increased[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rank Upgrade[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Granting Attribute[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Minimum Level[/td][td]None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Maximum Level[/td][td]Up to 75% of the maximum level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limit Break Appearance[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][/table][list][*][list][*]The number of attribute slots is limited to 1 reforging line.[list][*]When using a reforging tool with no limit on the number of attribute slots (line), new options can be granted again.[/*][/list][/*][*]Rank upgrades are possible.[/*][*]The attribute level range is limited to 75%.[list][*]The reforge attributes available are limited to 75% of the maximum level for each reforge rank.[/*][*]The maximum level does not include the limit breakthrough level.[/*][*]When reaching the maximum level that can be reached with the Journeyman’s Reforging Tool, a notice message indicating that the maximum level has been reached will be displayed.[/*][*]Attributes with a maximum level of 1 can be granted at level 1.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Updates to the Dungeon Guide[/b]
[list][*]The following dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Guide:[list][*]Ciar Advanced[/*][*]Rabbie Advanced[/*][*]Barri Advanced[/*][*]Fiodh Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Advanced[/*][/list][/*][*]From the time of update, when clearing the dungeon, you can acquire dungeon vouchers according to the difficulty of the dungeon.[/*][*]From the time of the update, when you clear the dungeon, you can acquire newly added repeated clear rewards for these dungeons.[list][*]Clear records before the update are not retroactive.[/*][/list][/*][*]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool has been added to the Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop when speaking to NPC Eavan.[list][*]Journeyman’s Reforging Tool will be included in the Second, Third, and Fourth Shop tabs.[/*][*]You can purchase up to six Journeyman’s Reforging Tool per day per account which will reset at 7:00 AM everyday in real time.[list][*]This weekly purchase limit for this item is shared across the Second, Third, and Fourth Shop tabs.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can be purchased with 10 vouchers from the corresponding shop tab.[/*][*]You can purchase Journeyman’s Reforging Tool regardless of the daily acquisition limit.[/*][/list][/*][*]The price of certain items in the Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop have been reduced from 70 vouchers to 25 vouchers each.[list][*]Unrestricted Dungeon Pass[/*][*]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass[/*][*]Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box[/*][*]Note: Only one pass of each type can be purchased per day.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list][*]The Beginner difficulty level has been added for some Tech Duinn missions: Revived Illusion, Feth Fiada, and Seven Nightmares.[list][*]On Beginner difficulty, the stats of bosses and normal monsters and the difficulty of some dungeon puzzles have been adjusted to a lower level than Normal difficulty.[/*][*]Quests that can be performed in Tech Duinn missions that do not have a difficulty level requirement can also be performed on Beginner difficulty.[/*][*]Even on Beginner difficulty, you can acquire a small amount of Briogh Crystals of Achievement, Briogh Crystals of Challenge, and Briogh Crystals of Discipline.[/*][*]On Beginner difficulty, Smoldering Thread and Enchant Scrolls, which are dropped from Tech Duinn missions on Normal difficulty and higher, do not drop.[/*][*]The clear journal for the Tech Duinn Beginner difficulty mission will not be added.[/*][*]The title acquisition requirements for the Mystic Pathfinder title is not affected by the Beginner difficulty.[/*][/list][/*][*]The required number of Restorative Potions required when crafting the Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Pass has been reduced from 15 to 12.[/*][*]Tech Duinn - Elite Passes can now drop from all Elite Tech Duinn missions.[/*][*]The drop rate of Mangled Ciar, Alby, and Rundal Dungeon Passes from the corresponding Advanced Dungeons have been increased. [/*][*]Set Effect item descriptions have been improved so that detailed information can now be seen in the description of the item.[list][*]Example) [list][*]Before: Enhanced Bash 5 Increase[/*][*]After: Enhanced Bash 5 Increase (Bash Damage +10%)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]New Dungeon Rewards[/b]
[list][*]New item rewards can be obtained from the reward box of certain dungeons and missions.[list][*]Celtic Signets, Divine Signets, Spirit Gems (100/500/1000), and Journeyman’s Reforging Tools have been added.[list][*]Spirit Gems and Journeyman’s Reforging Tools drop from every reward box.[/*][*]The Celtic or Divine Signet items can be obtained from every reward box, however only one Signet (Celtic or Divine) can be obtained from a reward box at one time. [/*][*]The Celtic Signet, Advanced Celtic Signet, Divine Signet, and Advanced Divine Signet items drop at different rates. Each equipment-specific Signet within the same category drops with an equal probability.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note[/b]: In Alby Advanced dungeons, instead of being dropped from the reward box, the items are dropped at the feet of each party member the moment the dungeon is cleared, and these items cannot be obtained from Yarn Key opened chests.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Regarding the Windows Server Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Dear Milletians,

We would like to sincerely apologize for the extended downtime with today's maintenance. To briefly explain, today's windows server maintenance required several different processes that are not commonly utilized during regular maintenances.

We encountered unexpected behavior after updating the servers from an older version to a much newer one. We are committed to bringing you a quality experience, and we wanted to make sure that there'd be no follow up maintenance. The server maintenance is now complete, and no further issues should arise. However, we will be monitoring the servers closely to ensure their stability.

We will be hosting a few [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/82202/milletian-events-double-rainbow-returns]buff events throughout this weekend[/url] for you to enjoy. Additionally, we will be sending [b]2x Magical Attendance Pass[/b] to all Milletians in a future maintenance so that your event progress is covered!
Thank you for your understanding,

~ GM Mewlynne, Mabinogi Producer
& The Mabinogi Team

[h2][b]DOUBLE RAINBOW
