[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/81261/march-quality-of-life-updates]March Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]The Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon has been added.   [/*][*]The Tara Auction House will be improved with new wares. [/*][*]Re-entry to Tech Duinn Dungeon is now possible.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Changed the sitting pose for the Homestead Blooming Romance Seat that could be earned from Yuri’s Valentine Event.[list][*]Giant character hands appeared awkward as their hands were floating so the pose has been adjusted to correct this issue.[/*][*]Though the issue didn’t occur for Human/Elf, the change will also be applied to those races to be consistent.[/*][/list][/*][*]Several changes have been made to the Saga Mission “Proceed with the ritual!”.[list][*]The amount of gold that monsters drop has been decreased. [/*][*]Monsters will spawn about 10 seconds after defeating all monsters. [/*][*]Monsters will now only spawn up to 25 times maximum. [/*][/list][/*][*]Added the following missing items to the Dressing Room. Thank you for reporting these items, Milletians![list][*]Chairs:[list][*]Snowflower Parade Podium[/*][*]Snowflower Table and Chair[/*][*]Kotatsu with Pan[/*][*]Nice Fishing Chair[/*][*]Comfortable Fishing Chair[/*][*]Dancing Far Darrig[/*][*]Vanity Lounge Studio Set [/*][*]Romantic Balcony[/*][/list][/*][*]Accessories:[list][*]Red Forest Aura Halo[/*][*]Gold Forest Aura Halo[/*][*]Black Forest Aura Halo[/*][*]White Forest Aura Halo[/*][*]Natural Forest Wood Halo[/*][*]Gold Forest Wood Halo[/*][*]Black Forest Wood Halo[/*][*]White Forest Wood Halo[/*][*]Full Balloon[/*][*]Persian Support Puppet[/*][*]Persian Flying Puppet[/*][*]Ancient Persian Support Puppet[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Revised previous season's All Wings Orb item names.[list][*]Fourth All Wings Orb -> Fabulous All Wings Orb[/*][*]Fifth All Wings Orb -> Glorious All Wings Orb[/*][*]Sixth All Wings Orb -> Magnificent All Wings Orb[/*][*]Seventh All Wings Orb -> Extravagant All Wings Orb[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements to several dialogues within the Arcana storyline quests have been made. [/*][*]Several minor typo revisions to item descriptions and dialogue texts have been updated.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where it was difficult to proceed during the G21 Quest, "Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight".[/*][*]The following items will no longer show in both Dressing Room gender filters:[list][*]Eluned Pitch Black Eye Patch (F)[/*][*]Men's Sleek Shades (M)[/*][*]Height-Boosting Insoles (M)[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where the "Wait until Nighttime" version of Tarlach would not properly respond to requests for a Baol Dungeon Pass during the G3 Quest, "Decisive Battle".[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.[/*][*]The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where certain NPC Transformations are missing the models for their bodies.[/*][*]There is an issue where Shadow Mission Tarlach does not grant Baol Dungeon Pass.[/*][*]There is a minor issue where the Pet Skill Window is unable to collapse properly.[/*][*]When a Partner on the Homestead is using the Bird Buddy Gesture, certain UI menus will close erratically.[/*][*]The Tara Auction House notice may overlap with Event notices on the scrolling banner.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - March 16th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2305/220321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290-1.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 10:52 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.[/b]

Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on March 16th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, March 16th
[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CET, UTC+1): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Happy 15th Anniversary, Milletians! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/81054/15th-anniversary-starlight-festival]15th Anniversary Starlight Festival Event[/url] is starting.[/*][*]Pick up a special package to celebrate our 15th Anniversary! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/81279/15th-anniversary-sale]15th Anniversary Sale[/url] is starting.[/*][*]Fly high and soar over Erinn with a brand new set of wings! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/81195/spectacular-wings-box]Spectacular Wings Box Sale[/url] is starting.[/*][*]Get the last of your spins in while you can! [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80454/rilka-s-roulette-event]Rilka's Roulette Event[/url] is ending.[/*][*]The royals have all departed, and they took the chests with them. The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80459/nobles-heirloom-chest]Nobles' Heirloom Chest Sale[/url] is ending.[/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. Note: The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change submission site[/url] will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
- The Mabinogi Team

notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2662/230310_marchupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]March Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2][list][*]The Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon has been added.[list][*]You can purchase a Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass from the Researcher at Poulnabrone. You can enter Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon by using the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass at the entrance of the dungeon.[/*][*]Weapon durability does not decrease while in the practice dungeon, and if you become incapacitated, you will automatically revive after 5 seconds.[/*][*]The monsters appearing in the practice dungeon are the same as those from Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon.[/*][*]Defeating monsters will not reward items, gold, or experience.[/*][*]Completing the practice dungeon will not have a reward box and will not count towards the dungeon guide completion.[/*][*]Quest progression relating to Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon will not count, and you cannot acquire titles or Journal achievements.[/*][*]When entering the dungeon, you will receive the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Guidebook which can be used to help clear the dungeon.[list][*]The Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Guidebook can only be used within the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed the progression of A Dreamy Story quest for the objective “Receive a special pass from Manus after hearing his story.”[list][*]In addition, 1 Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass will be given.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Re-entry to Tech Duinn Dungeon is now[/b] possible.[list][*]Re-entry is allowed up to 3 times in all difficulties of the Tech Duinn missions Revived Illusion, Feth Fiada, Seven Nightmares, and Awakened Abyssal Lord.[/*][*]Leaving and re-entering a mission with a time limit will still reduce the mission timer for as much as the time you left the mission.[/*][*]If you have already cleared the mission or the time limit has expired, you will not be able to re-enter the mission regardless of whether or not you received a reward.[/*][*]Optimized the progression of area 1 of Tech Duinn mission, Awakened Abyssal Lord to reduce delays.[/*][/list][/*][*]The announcements that appeared when reaching the 1st, 5th, 10th, notes.title: 15th Anniversary Starlight Festival
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2715/230314_15thanniversaryevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

It's time to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of Mabinogi! Log in during the Event Hotdays to earn items that are out of this world! Help Neo and his friends, and win stellar prizes. Explore all sorts of mini games, such as Guess the Gesture, Dice Battle, or Enter the Stage of Trials! This is an event you won't want to space out on! Check out the full details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, March 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 13th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Welcome to the 15th Anniversary Starlight Festival![/b][/h2]
[list][*]During this event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Light of the Stars[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Neo[/b] in [b]Dunbarton[/b] to register a main character.[list][*]You can only register one main character per account.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the guide quest:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x10[/b][/*][*]10,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][*]Only the main character can participate in the quests and mini-games.[/*][*]When issuing a check from any bank in Erinn, all characters can receive a 15th Anniversary Check design.[/*][*]Note: You will be able to see shooting stars at night between 8 PM - 6 AM Erinn Time.[list][*]During the event, Star Cards can only be used at night.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]15th Anniversary Hotdays[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Login any time during the event period to receive the [b]*NEW* 15th Anniversary Fantasy Star 2nd Title Coupon (Not Tradable)[/b].[list][*]Max Damage +15[/*][*]Magic Attack +15[/*][*]Fire/Wind/Earth/Water Alchemic Damage +10[/*][*]Strength +15[/*][*]Intelligence +15[/*][*]Dexterity +15[/*][*]Will +15[/*][*]Luck +15[/*][*]Movement Speed +1%[/*][/list][/*][*]Every [b]week[/b] (resets every Monday at 7:00 AM PDT), you will receive a special [b]5 Tiny Starbrite[/b] by logging in during the event period.[/*][*]Every [b]weekend on Saturday and Sunday[/b], you will receive [b]10 Tiny Starbrite[/b] and other items by logging in during the event period.[/*][*]Claim the item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your character or choose [b]Claim Later[/b] if you want to receive it on another character.[/*][*]The item can be moved between characters through the bank.[/*][*]You can only claim the item once during the event period.[b]

[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]15th Anniversary Quests[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Neo and his friends crash-landed their spaceship in Erinn! Everyone got scattered across the land and Neo needs your help finding everyone. A series of story quests will be available:[list][*][Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1[/*][*][Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 2[/*][*][Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 3[/*][*][Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 4[/*][/list][/*][*]Each quest must be completed before you can receive the next quest.[list][*]i.e. After completing [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1, you will receive [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 2, and so on.[/*][/list][/*][*]When completing each quest, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x10[/b][/*][*]10,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Achievement Quest - [Event] Party Favors[/b]
[list][*]You will receive the achievement quest, [b][Event] Party Favors[/b].[/*][*]Complete the daily quest, [Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous, [b]5 times[/b] to receive the following reward:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x60[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the daily quest [b]10 times[/b] to receive the following reward:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x110[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the daily quest [b]2[/b][b]0 times[/b] to receive the following reward:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x160[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Communicator Gesture Card
[/b][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2481/communitcator-gesture-card.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest, [b][Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 4[/b][/*][*]After completing all of the previous objectives, talk to Neo in Dunbarton to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x210[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Flying Saucer[/b][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2479/flying-saucer.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the [Event] Party Favors quest to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Tiny Starbrite x300[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Homestead Erinn Command Outpost [/b][list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2480/homestead-erinn-command-outpost.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]10,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Daily Quest - [Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous[/b]
[list][*]Every day, you will receive the daily quest, [b][Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous[/b].[/*][*]You will need to complete different tasks around the Starlight Festival:[list][*]Help out Neo’s friends 1 time[list][*][b]Reward: Tiny Starbrite x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Claim victory in a mini-game[list][*][b]Reward: Tiny Starbrite x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Enter the Stage of Trials[list][*][b]Reward: Tiny Starbrite x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The daily quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT every day.[/b][/*][/list]
[[b]Daily Quest Task] Help out Neo’s friends[/b]
[list][*]Each of Neo’s friends will offer a daily quest.[/*][*]Daily quests from each friend will become available after completing the event quests, [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1 through 4.[/*][*]Each quest will reward a different Star Card. Ruelle's missions also reward festival food![/*][*]Only one daily quest can be completed each day.[/*][*][b]The daily quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT every day.[/b][/*][/list]
[b][Daily Quest Task] Claim victory in a mini-game[/b]
[list][*]Talk to Neo to play the [b]Guess the Gesture[/b] or [b]Dice Battle[/b] mini-game.[list][*]Dice Battle will be available after the 3rd week of the event: March 30th, after maintenance.[/*][*]You can play either mini-game, but you can only win one mini-game each day.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guess the Gesture[/b][list][*]Enter a mission with Neo and start the game. [/*][*]Neo will perform different gestures. [/*][*]Guess five gestures correctly in a row to win![/*][*]You can only win this mini-game once each day.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Dice Battle[/b][list][*]Battle against Neo with dice![/*][*]Each player will start with 100 HP.[/*][*]Roll the dice to deal damage to the other player.[/*][*]If Neo’s HP reaches 0, you win![/*][*]You can only win this mini-game once each day.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][Daily Quest Task] Enter the Stage of Trials[/b]
[list][*]Talk to Neo to enter the [b]Stage of Trials[/b] mini-game.[/*][*]The Stage of Trials is a one room dungeon with 15 waves of enemies.[/*][*]You can enter the Stage of Trials up to 3 times each day. ([b]resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT[/b].)[list][*][b]Note[/b]: You [b]cannot enter[/b] the Trials if you have Remote Coupons, or summoning dolls (Tiger Rag Doll, Marshal Cat Claw, etc.) in the inventory. Please deposit them in the bank or pet inventory to continue.[/*][/list][/*][*]Two modes are available:[list][*][b]Stage of Trials[/b][list][*]You cannot revive.[/*][*]You cannot bring a party or summon pets.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Stage of Trials (Veteran Mode)[/b][list][*]All restrictions of Stage of Trials.[/*][*]You cannot use potions.[/*][*]You cannot use Anchor Rush or Tumble.[/*][*]EXP reward is quadrupled.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Depending on how many rounds you clear, you can earn Combat EXP, Exploration EXP, Music Renown EXP, or Life Renown EXP.[/b][list][*][b]Talk to Neo and choose [b]“Change Reward Type”[/b] to select your preferred EXP type.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]If you fail a round, you will be automatically revived and healed.[/*][*]Clear at least one round in the Stage of Trials to receive the 1st title:[list][*][b]who is Just Getting Started[/b][list][*]Luck +18[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Clear all rounds in the Stage of Trials (any mode) to receive the 2nd title:[list][*][b]Stage of Trials Champion[/b][list][*]Max Damage +18[/*][*]Magic Attack +18[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2478/stage-of-trials-champion.gif[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Tiny Starbrite Event Shop[/b][/h2]

[b]Consumable Shop[/b]
[list][*]Exchanges Tiny Starbrites for various goodies in Neo’s shop.[/*][*]Tiny Starbrites can be obtained from Event Quests and Hotdays.[/*][*]Items with a weekly purchase limit will reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]Items in the Consumable Shop tab have an item duration of 14 days.[/*][*]Star Cards do not stack with other items that provide the same effect.[/*][*]Star Cards can only be used while the shooting stars are falling in Erinn, between 8 PM - 6 AM Erinn Time.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Item Name[/b][/th][th][b]Item Details[/b][/th][th][b]Purchase Limit[/b][/th][th][b]Cost[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Power[/td][td]Increases Min/Max Damage and Magic Attack by 5% for 2 hours.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Training[/td][td]Grants 2x Skill EXP for 2 hours.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Production Selection Box[/td][td]Increases the success rate of the next skill production by 2% for 2 hours. 
Select a Star Card of Production of your choice for one of the following skills: 
Tailoring, Handicraft, Blacksmithing, Potion Making, Carpentry, Hillwen Engineering, or Magic Craft.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Erg[/td][td]Increases the success rate of the next Erg unlock attempt by a certain amount.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Spirit[/td][td]Increases the amount of Spirit EXP gained by 2x for 2 hours.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW*[/b] Star Card of Echostones[/td][td]Increases the success rate of the next Echostone advancement by a certain amount.[/td][td]N/A[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box[/td][td]3[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Event)[/td][td]3[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Unrestricted Dungeon Pass (Event)[/td][td]3[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Gem Selection Box[/td][td]3[/td][td]10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Pass Box[/td][td]1[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Crom Bas Reward Key Coupon[/td][td]1[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Abyss Advanced Dungeon Pass Selection Box[/td][td]1[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tech Duinn Elite Mission Pass Selection Box[/td][td]1[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mag Mell Hard Mission Pass Selection Box[/td][td]1[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 3
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1245/220124_irusanattendanceevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Folamh outfit set. Admire your favourite Fomor from the comfort of your own homestead instead of from Crom Bás when you finish the calendar, too! Check out the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 1st, Before Maintenance[/b]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.png[/img][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Help Wanted, Meow![/b][/*][*]Find [b]A Kitty in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue.[/*][*]Register for the event with [b]A Kitty in Need[/b].[/*][*]Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.[/*][*]Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. 
[list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 27 days of log in.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new Event Clock timer is available so you can check your Check-in progress at a glance without opening up the Event Menu.[/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2079/irusans-clock-ui.png[/img][list][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already [b]7:00 AM PT[/b], the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after [b]7:00 AM PT[/b] the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive 1 stamp per day.[/*][*]Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[list][*][b]The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from Thursday, June 1st, After Maintenance - June 8th, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2078/irusans-ui.png[/img]
[h2][b]Attendance Pass Purchase[/b][/h2][list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for [b]29 Pon.[/b][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1264/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-purchase-ui.png[/img]

notes.title: Rilka's Roulette Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2077/230217_rilkasrouletteevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Rilka's wheely excited to give out some prizes! Complete daily quests and Rilka will reward you with coins. Come test your luck with Rilka's Roulette Wheel! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, February 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 16th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Spin to Win![/b][/*][*]Find [b]Rilka[/b] in the Dunbarton Town Square.[/*][*]Register a main character with Rilka.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Spin to Win!:
[list][*]2,000 EXP[/*][*]2,000 Gold[/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][*]Log in every day to receive [b]Revolutionary Roulette Coins[/b].[/*][*]Every 30 minutes, you will receive Revolutionary Roulette Coin x5 up to 6 times for a total of [b]30 coins[/b].[/*][*]On the weekends, you will receive Revolutionary Roulette Coin x5 up to 10 times for a total of [b]50 coins[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2]
[b]Roulette Quest VIP (Achievement)[/b]
[list][*]Help Rilka out by completing various daily tasks.[/*][*]Talk to Rilka and click "[b]Select Daily Quest[/b]".[/*][*]Select one of the following quests to complete:
[list][*]Clear Daily Shadow Mission 1 time[/*][*]Clear Uladh Dungeon 1 time (any difficulty)[/*][*]Clear Daily Tara Mission Quest 1 time (any difficulty)[/*][*]Clear Daily Taillteann Mission Quest 1 time (any difficulty)[/*][*]Defeat 100 monsters[/*][*]Complete a Part-Time Job 2 times[/*][*]Gather 10 Eggs[/*][*]Gather 20 Wool[/*][*]Use Cooking 5 times[/*][*]Use Potion Making 5 times[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only select [b]one daily quest per real life day.[/b][/*][*]Once you complete the daily quest, you will get the following rewards:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Revolutionary Roulette Coin x15[/b][/*][*][b]Revolutionary Roulette Coin x30[/b] on the [b]weekends only[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete a daily quest for Rilka 16 times to receive the following rewards:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Revolutionary Rilka’s Gift Box x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Coupon Clipper (Daily)[/b]
[list][*]Talk to Rilka and click "Find Roulette Coupons".[/*][*]To collect Roulette Coupons, defeat monsters that are of Similar, Strong, Awful, or Boss level.[/*][*]Higher level monsters have higher drop rates.[/*][*]Deliver Roulette Coupons x2 to Rilka five times (for a total of 10 coupons) to receive the following rewards:[list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Revolutionary Roulette Coin x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*] You can only receive this quest once per real life day.[/*][/list][h2][b]Roulette Wheel[/b][/h2][list][*]Use [b]Revolutionary Roulette Coin x20[/b] to spin the Roulette Wheel for prizes.[/*][*]You can win any of the following prizes from the Roulette Wheel:[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Unstable Phoenix Wings
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1908/unstable-phoenix-wings-2.gif[/img][list][*]Wings have Set Item stat effects valid for 182 days (6 months).[list][*]Attack Delay Reduction 10 Increase[/*][*]Magic Attack Increase 10 Increase[/*][*]Max Damage Increase 10 Increase[/*][*]Movement Speed Increase 10 Increase[/*][/list][/*][*]When the wings expire, the Set Item effects can no longer be used.[/*][*]Take the wings to Lassar in Tir Chonaill and select “Exchange Phoenix Wings” to exchange for the Eternal Phoenix Wings, a permanent version of the wings of the same look, without set effects.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=#outfitbox1][b]*NEW* Revolutionary Rilka’s Random Outfit Box 1[/b][/url][/*][*][url=#outfitbox2][b]*NEW* Revolutionary Rilka’s Random Outfit Box 2[/b][/url][/*][*]Erg Unlock Assist Potion (Event)[/*][*]Fine Echostone Awakening Stimulant[/*][*][url=#giftbox][b]*NEW* Revolutionary Rilka’s Gift Box[/b][/url][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Revolutionary Rilka’s Random Outfit Box 1[/h2]
You can receive one of the following items when opening the box:
[list][*]Autumn Outfit (M)[/*][*]Autumn Outfit (F)[/*][*]Candy Pop Denim Jacket Outfit (M)[/*][*]Candy Pop Riding Hood Outfit (F)[/*][*]Majestic Knight Armor (M)[/*][*]Majestic Knight Armor (F)[/*][*]Winter Messenger Outfit (M)[/*][*]Winter Messenger Outfit (F)[/*][*]Kyle Formal Outfit[/*][*]Colton Hunting Outfit[/*][*]Waffle Wizard Suit[/*][*]Waffle Witch Dress[/*][*]Suspiciously Blinged Out Costume[/*][*]Chic Outfit (M)[/*][*]Chic Outfit (F)[/*][*]Duffel Coat (M)[/*][*]Duffel Coat (F)[/*][*]Sheep Sonata Outfit (M)[/*][*]Sheep Sonata Outfit (F)[/*][*]Odd Kitty Outfit (M)[/*][*]Odd Kitty Outfit (F)[/*][/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life - Patch Notes - February 16th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the February Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80156/updated-yuri-s-valentine-s-day-event]Yuri's Valentine's Day Event[/url]: Thursday, February 9th After Maintenance - Thursday, March 9th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79928/moonlit-howls-box]Moonlit Howls Box[/url]: Thursday, February 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80459/nobles-heirloom-chest]Nobles' Heirloom Chest[/url]: Thursday, February 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 16th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80177/february-quality-of-life-updates]February Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80110/mabinogi-64-bit-client-update]64-bit Client Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80127/producer-s-letter-2023-first-half-upcoming-contents]Producer’s Letter: 2023 First Half Upcoming Contents[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80177/february-quality-of-life-updates]February Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]New Dressing Room categories for Chairs and Accessory items, including halos and support puppets.[/*][*]New Accessory slot added to the Style tab for halos and support puppets.[/*][*]Improvements to the Dye Ampoule system for ease of finding that perfect color code.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]February Update[/b]
[list][*]The February Update is here!
[list][*]Commerce Related Adjustments[list][*]To increase trade inventory resilience, the maximum inventory of trade items, excluding limited items, is adjusted and the inventory has been reset.[list][*]Inventory recovery speed now increases up to 5 times.[/*][/list][/*][*]The overall yield rate has been adjusted for Commerce Trading Post goods for a smoother inventory circulation of the entire trade system through general trading.[list][*]In order to minimize the phenomenon that only some trade goods are exhausted, the difference in the basic yield rate between trade goods has been reduced.[/*][*]As a result, some items are also improved to make higher profits depending on inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*]The number of weekly exchanges for exchanging materials for trade goods at each Barter Trading Post has been reduced.[/*][*]The price of the Air Transport License has been lowered to 5,000,000 Seasonal Ducats. [/*][/list][/*][*]Commerce Season 3 Changes[list][*]Seasonal Commerce Imbolic Season 3 will begin at 12:00 AM PST on March 1st, 2023 and run until July 1st, 2023 12:00AM PDT.[list][*]Several sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop, including newly added Portia and Bassanio outfits and shoes sewing patterns. [/*][*]The Season 3 Erinn Merchants' Guild Erg Material Box will be available.[/*][*]The Imbolic Season 3 Challenger Title and Challenger Box will be available.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/75214/seasonal-commerce-system-guide]Seasonal Commerce Guide[/url] has been updated with archived Season 1~2 information and Season 3 information.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Cabbage Pancake and Seafood Pancake have been renamed Cabbage Jeon and Seafood Pajeon.[/*][*]Made the descriptions for the Horn Bugles consistent.[/*][*]Portia’s Shoes can now be worn by Female Giants.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixes for typos found across C6 and C7 Generations reported by our players!
[list][*]"Thanks, Milletians!" - GM Quuku, CM Arciellia, Prod. Mewlynne[/*][/list][/*][*]The enemy debuff "Phantom's Roar" has been renamed to "Wraith's Roar" to match the enemy source. [/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.[/*][*]The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][*]There is an issue where certain NPC Transformations are missing the models for their bodies.[/*][*]There is an issue where Shadow Mission Tarlach does not grant Baol Dungeon Pass.[/*][*]There is a minor issue where the Pet Skill Window is unable to collapse properly.[/*][/list]

notes.title: February Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1947/230210_febuaryupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]February Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2][list][*]The maximum bundle for Giant Horn Bugle of Shouting and Horn Bugle - World Premium is increased to 100.[/*][*]Added a UI header for the pet skill hotbar.[/*][*]Bachram Boost percentage is now displayed when the Dorcha Gauge window is minimized.[/*][*]The skill switch hotbar button tooltip text is changed to mention the set hotkey that you are swapping to. [/*][*]Included additional information in the hotkey slot change tooltip on how to set the hotkey.[/*][*]Status Effects are now sorted in ascending order of duration in the Character Status List UI.[/*][*]The Homestead Exit button has been relocated to the Homestead status window.
 [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1956/homestead-ui.png[/img][/*][*]Adjusted the position, size, and expression of the Announcement and Horn Bugle scrolling banner so that it does not overlap the Skill Hotbar.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where event and notice announcements overlapped.[/*][*]Popup windows are temporarily hidden while a cutscene is playing.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where characters could not be resurrected if they chose to wait for rescue twice while incapacitated.[/*][*]The “remaining summoning time” text in Pet/Partner Information now specifies today’s remaining summoning time.[/*][*]When using Physical Power Potion, Magic Speed Potion, Magic Power Potion, High Gathering Speed Potion, or Special High Speed Gathering Potion, a usage confirmation popup window will appear if applying the same buff while it is currently active after 3 minutes have passed. However, if the currently applied buff is better than the item’s effect, it cannot be used.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with gathering when you could not move to the gathering node even though you were far away from it. [/*][*]Fixed an issue where you were able to collect potatoes though it was not a potato field in certain areas in Dunbarton.[/*][*]The following functions are added to Dye Ampoule items. [list][*]You can now search for the color you want in the Dye Palette in the Dye Minigame by inputting the RGB values.[/*][*]If no matching color is found then a color within the margin of 5 is searched instead.[/*][*]Dye Ampoules, other than Direct Dye Ampoules, will now show the RGB value of the corresponding color in the expected dyeing result menu.[/*][*]The current color and 8 surrounding colors are now displayed together on the mouse cursor (eyedropper).[/*][*]The color selection time is doubled compared to before.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1955/dyeing-form-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The Face Accessory slot icon has been changed in the Style slot and Dressing Room.
 [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1953/accessory-in-dressing-room-icon.png[/img][/*][*]Accessories can now be equipped in the Style tab of your inventory.[list][*]Equip balloons, puppets, and other accessories in the Style tab to decorate your character even more! [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1957/style-tab.png[/img]
[list][*]Accessories and Chair tabs are added to the Dressing Room, so you can collect even more items![list][*]Some consumable items (e.g. resurrection balloons) and non-tradeable items cannot be collected.[/*][*]The preview feature for Chairs will be added at a later time. [/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Yuri's Valentine's Day Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1890/230206_yurisvalentinesdayevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Yuri needs help preparing for Valentine's Day! Help her through a series of tasks, like making special chocolates and getting dressed up and ready for a date! Who knows? Love might hit you on the head, just like the new Blooming Romance Toy Hammer, too. Valentine's Day mascots Biscuit and Sprinkle will be there to help you if you get bonked too hard! Check out the details below.

[b]Note:[/b] Previously, there was incorrect information regarding accumulating [b]Yuri's Valentine Coins [/b]when logged in for a set amount of time. This has been updated. We apologize for the inconvenience.

 [b]Yuri's Valentine's Day Event[/b]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: [b]Thursday, February 9th After Maintenance - Thursday, March 9th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Prologue - Yuri’s Valentine’s Day[/b].[/*][*]Find[b] Yuri[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Square[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Yuri.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Guide] Prologue - Yuri’s Valentine’s Day[/b]:[list][*]3,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*]Unlock the Weekly Event Quests and Achievement Quest.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]10x Yuri's Valentine Coins[/b] will be rewarded [b]once a day[/b] after logging in for a consecutive [b]36 minutes[/b] on the main character.[/*][/list][h2][b]Weekly Quest Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Week 1 [/b](Thursday, February 9th, After Maintenance)
[list][*]Talk to Yuri to see what she needs help with.[list][*]You will receive an Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Event) (Expires in 24 Hours).[/*][/list][/*][*]Get the ingredients for the Special Chocolate by completing an Elite Shadow Mission.
[list][*]Ingredients can be found only in Elite Shadow Missions in Tara or Taillteann. [/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Event] Special Chocolate Ingredient[/b]:[list][*]3,000 EXP[/*][*]Yuri’s Valentine Coin x10[/*][*][b]Yuri’s Handmade Chocolate x3 [/b](Expires after 30 days)[list][*]STR +5[/*][*]Dexterity +5[/*][*]Intelligence +5[/*][*]Will +5[/*][*]Luck +5[/*][*]Max Damage +2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 2 [/b](Thursday, February 16th, After Maintenance)
[list][*]Talk to Yuri to see what she needs help with.
[list][*]You will receive an Unrestricted Dungeon Pass (Event) (Expires in 24 hours).[/*][/list][/*][*]Get the ingredients for the Special Elixir by completing Hard Mode Advanced Dungeons of Uladh.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Event] Special Elixir Ingredient[/b]:[list][*]3,000 EXP[/*][*]Yuri’s Valentine Coin x10[/*][*][b]Special Elixir x3 [/b](Expires after 30 days)[list][*]STR +5[/*][*]Dexterity +5[/*][*]Intelligence +5[/*][*]Will +5[/*][*]Luck +5[/*][*]Magic Attack +2[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 3 [/b](Thursday, February 23rd, After Maintenance)
[list][*]Talk to Yuri to see what she needs help with.[/*][*]Pick out an outfit you'd like to craft, and talk with Yuri again.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [b][Event] Cut, Sew, and Dye[/b]:[list][*]3,000 EXP[/*][*]Yuri’s Valentine Coin x10[/*][*][b]Yuri's Valentine Gift Box x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]After completing [Event] Cut, Sew, and Dye, you are able to purchase additional Event-Exclusive Dye Ampoules (regular and metal) from Yuri for 1,000 Gold.

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2023 First Half Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Dear Milletians,

After the release of the New Beast updates and Arcana talents, we are happy to see Mabinogi flourishing with new and returning faces. We feel the excitement and passion from our loyal Milletians, too. We’ve been reviewing your feedback on these updates and appreciate you sharing your thoughts with us. If you haven’t already, please tell us what you think! Share with us on Discord by joining the discussion with the community or check out the [url=https://discord.com/channels/278742874097582081/1059987315952463992/1059987317978316810]Arcana Feedback Thread[/url].

This year, we have more updates to come. We’d like to share a high level overview of some upcoming contents to be expected in the first half of this year. Please look forward to the following updates:

[b]Masterpiece Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 Update, [/b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79482/masterpiece-chapter-6-and-7-update]recently released[/url] in January
[list][*]Replay ability for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 Generations.[/*][*]Changes to some NPC interactions and permanent NPCs in Avalon. [/*][*]New replay reward boxes and Jukebox songs.[/*][/list]
[b]64-bit Client Update[/b]
[list][*]To improve game performance and reduce memory issues, we will implement the 64-bit client update. Please check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/80110/mabinogi-64-bit-client-update]dedicated notice[/url] for more details about this change.[/*][/list]
[b]Mabinogi's 15th Anniversary[/b]
[list][*]With events, fun rewards, GM shenanigans and more, we hope to celebrate 15 years of Mabinogi with all Milletians.[/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]

Improvements to several game features are being prepared this year. We are excited to share some of the changes, including:
[list][*]New Dressing Room categories for Chairs and Accessory items, including halos and support puppets.[/*][*]New Accessory slot added to the Style tab for halos and support puppets.[/*][*]Improvements to the Dye Ampoule system for ease of finding that perfect color code.[/*][*]Improved production gathering distance so you don’t have to chase those potatoes down![/*][*]The Tara Auction House will be updated with new wares for auction soon.[/*][*]The Adventurer Seal system and shop will be renewed with new items.[/*][*]New Dungeon features, such as re-entry to Tech Duinn missions and craftable Avon mission passes.[/*][*]Enchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
[b]NEXT Step Up![/b]

To help new and returning Milletians to progress through to higher levels, we’re making a few changes intended to improve the performance limit of intermediate equipment and make reforging tools more accessible.
[list][*]In an effort to improve the phenomenon where you stay with the Celtic or Divine weapons for too long while struggling to get better equipment, Celtic Symbol and Divine Symbol items will be introduced to bridge the gap between these weapons and advanced equipment.[/*][*]We plan to add Beginner’s Reforging Tools obtainable through playing dungeons, so that you can obtain reforging tools and try out limited reforging options with less stress. [/*][*]These changes may not completely resolve current issues, but we hope it will become natural to try and experience various options before reaching a higher level, and help newer Milletians to smoothly move on to the later game stages.[/*][/list]
[b]Renovation Season 4[/b]

Changes to skills for Humans, Elves, and Giants will bring improvements to combat.
[list][*]Improvements will be made for Archery skills, including race specific skills.[list][*]Elven Magic Missile, Mirage Missile, Final Shot, and Human’s Arrow Revolver.[/*][*]Ranged Attack, Magnum Shot, Crash Shot, and Urgent Shot.[/*][*]Throwing Attack will also see an improvement.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements for Giant skills, including Taunt, Stomp, Final Strike, and Giant Full Swing.[/*][*]Minor improvements for several Magic skills will be added.[/*][/list]
Although the mentioned contents are in the current pipeline, depending on testing and development plans, the plan could change. More information regarding confirmed content will be shared in our regular Update posts and Patch Notes! As always, we thank you for your support and love for Mabinogi.

Sincerely,
[b]GM Mewlynne
[/b][b]Mabinogi Producer[/b]

notes.title: Mabinogi 64-bit Client Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Hello Milletians!

In an upcoming maintenance, we will be implementing our [b]64-bit Client Update[/b]. We highly recommend that you update your Mabinogi game clients, but this [b]does not require a full[/b][b] re-install of the game[/b] when upgrading to the 64-bit Client.

With the February update, Mabinogi's game client will be upgraded to 64-bit, enabling improved performance on modern systems and to help us support Mabinogi long into the future. As part of this update, [b]Mabinogi will no longer be playable on 32-bit (x86) operating systems[/b].
[h2][b]Why Upgrade to a 64-bit Game Client?[/b][/h2]
Mabinogi on 32-bit was limited in its memory usage, depending on the needs of the operating system. With the change to 64-bit, it will allow the Mabinogi client to use more memory and improve client performance in various memory-intensive situations. It has been a recurring issue that any Mabinogi client exceeding more than 4GB of memory during normal gameplay would result in memory allocation failure, ultimately resulting in client crashes. In order to avoid such problems, the transition to 64-bit client may improve overall service quality. 

While the 64-bit client will improve some client performance issues, please keep in mind that it will not resolve every issue you may have encountered previously.
[h2][b]How can I learn what Operating System I have?[/b][/h2]
If you are unsure of what sort of operating system you have running on your PC, you can find out in the "About Your PC" System Setting page:
[list][*]Use the Windows key to bring up the Start Menu, and click on the Gear icon to open up the settings.[/*][*]Under "System" menu, select "About" at the bottom of the sidebar.[/*][*]Look under "System type", which will tell you which type of operating system and processor you have.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1531/about-windows-64-bit-operating-system.png[/img]

It should show one of three possible options:
[list][*][b]64-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x64-based [/b]processor: No changes required, your computer is already set-up and good to go![/*][*][b]32-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x64-based [/b]processor: Your computer's operating system is still 32-bit, however your system's processor is able to support a 64-bit operating system. In order to play Mabinogi after the update, you will need to upgrade your operating system to a 64-bit version.[/*][*][b]32-bit [/b]operating system, [b]x86-based [/b]processor: Unfortunately, your computer is not able to support a 64-bit operating system, and will not be able to run Mabinogi after this update.[/*][/list][h2][b]Updated Sound Library[/b][/h2]
Finally, with the future update, Mabinogi's [b]sound library[/b] will also be updated. The sound library (MSS) used in the existing 32-bit client will be replaced with FMOD. When it came to the previous sound library, it was difficult to provide a stable environment when loading high-quality sound sources or loading sound sources of multiple instruments at once. As a result, the addition of an updated sound library will further reinforce "sound", one of the indispensable facets of Mabinogi. We will continue to strive to provide audio content that will satisfy all Milletians in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!

- The Mabinogi Team

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78456/imperial-knight-box]Imperial Knight Box[/url]: Thursday, January 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79456/desperate-designer-event]Desperate Designer Event[/url]: Thursday, January 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 16th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79551/winter-premiere-pet-box]Winter Premiere Pet Box[/url]: Thursday, January 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 16th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79482/masterpiece-chapter-6-and-7-update]Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79535/january-quality-of-life-updates]January Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]A new Lock function for Combo Cards has been added.[/*][*]4 new basic Stardust appearances have been added and can be purchased from Melwyn.[/*][*]Minor changes have been made to Dan Advancement Exams.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update[/b]
[list][*]The Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update is here. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/79482/masterpiece-chapter-6-and-7-update][b]Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update[/b][/url]
[list][*]Chapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse generations can now be replayed.[list][*]New Replay Rewards such as the new Homestead items, Mini-Gems, Balloons, Titles, and 20 new Jukebox BGMs are available.[/*][/list][/*][*]Overall improvements have been made to C6 and C7 NPCs and Missions.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where visual effects for certain Spirit Liqueurs were not appearing on the player's weapon.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where visual effects for certain eyes' were not displaying properly.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Queen Eirawen's eyes were occasionally misaligned.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the [Pet/Partner?] help button's information.[/*][*]Fixed a text error where Arcana Talents' text was being cut-off in the Talent Select Menu when rebirthing.[/*][*]Fixed a text error with the rank up requirements for the skill "Hydra Transmutation".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where after completing G7 Quest "Atrata’s Wind Bell", the Storyline Menu doesn't update.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the G25 quest "Love's Flame Enkindled" was not properly progressing.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where after completing G24, the first quest of G25 would not arrive, and could not be manually started in the Storyline Menu.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.[/*][*]The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.[/*][*]Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - January 19th, 2023
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2305/220321_updatedmaintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_940x290-1.jpg[/img]

[b]The maintenance has been completed at 11:27 AM PST. Thanks for your patience.[/b]

Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on January 19th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 6:00 AM PST and last approximately 6 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, January 19th
[/b]

Pacific (PST, UTC -8): 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Eastern (EST, UTC -5): 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM

notes.title: Desperate Designer Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1555/mabinogi-desperate-designer-event_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img] Cindy is in sew much trouble and has too many orders, and she's hanging by a thread! It seams like she'll need a lot of help, and we hope you don't feel strung in to help! Will any crafty Milletians step up to create dazzling Sewing Patterns? Cindy is willing to reward your help with super new items like the Professional's Mannequin or a Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature's Beauty! Check out the details below.  [b]Desperate Designer Event[/b] [b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, January 19th After Maintenance - Thursday, February 16th, Before Maintenance [b]Event Details[/b] [list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea[/b].[/*][*]Find [b]Craft Designer Cindy[/b] in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Cindy.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea:[/*][list][*][b]2,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Beginner's Mannequin (Event)[/b][/*][/list][*]Log in to receive 100 Design Notes once per day.[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][*]All event quests and items will be removed when the event ends. These items will also be completely removed from the Auction House when the event ends, regardless of Sold or Not Sold status, along with all the gold.[/*][/list] [b]Quests[/b] [b] Craft Designer Cindy's Sewing Pattern (Daily)[/b] [list][*]Complete the quest every day by using the Beginner's Mannequin received in [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea.[/*][*]The daily quest resets every day at [b]7:00 AM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][*]To complete the quest, you must craft [b]10 Sewing Patterns[/b].[/*][*]You can craft a Sewing Pattern using the Design Note.[/*][*]You can craft a Sewing Pattern anywhere. One Design Note will create one Sewing Pattern.[/*][*]The craft success rate by grade will differ depending on the type of mannequin used. notes.title: January Quality of Life Updates
notes.content: [h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1381/201009-mbw-2123-qualityoflife-940x290.jpg[/img][/h2][h2][b]January Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2][list][*]Combo Card lock function[list][*]A lock function has been added to Combo Cards.[/*][*]You can lock or unlock combo cards with the right mouse button.[/*][*]The “[b]Remove All[/b]” toggle will now exclude all locked Combo Cards when using the “Eliminate” function.[/*][*]Activated Combo Cards are not removed when using the “Remove All” function.[/*][/list][/*][*]4 new basic Stardust appearances have been added.[list][*]Form of Basic Stardust Type B ~ E can be purchased in Melwyn's shop for 1x Royal Society Sponsorship Badge.[/*][/list][/*][*]The “Manage Crystals” button for Guard Cylinders has been adjusted to appear at the top of the item menu.[/*][*]The items “Shyllien Assimilation Essence” and “Hillwen Assimilation Essence” items have been added.[list][*]When using each item, the character will not be recognized by monsters in the Shyllien Nature Reserve and Hillwen Mine.[/*][*]The effect will last for 10 minutes.[/*][*]These items can be crafted with Magic Craft and Hillwen Engineering skills respectively.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minor changes made to Dan Advancement Exams[list][*]If there is not enough room in your inventory during an Advancement Exam, the item will be dropped on the floor.[/*][*]The Mysterious Purple Bag will be added to your inventory during the Advancement Exam quest.[/*][*]The Potion Making Kit has been added to the NPC shop during the Advancement Exam quest. [/*][/list][/*][/list][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1117/230106_januaryupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 6: The Divine Knights[/b] and [b]Chapter 7: Apocalypse[/b] generations can now be replayed.[list][*]If you have played all of[b] G19 The Divine Knights, G20 The Gate of Sanctuary, and G21 The Guardian's Path[/b], you can start the replay for the Chapter 6 Generations.[list][*]You can obtain the C6 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you have played all of[b] G22 Apocalypse, G23 Tempest, G24 Ascension, and G25 Eclipse[/b], you can start the replay for the Chapter 7 Generations.[list][*]You can obtain the C7 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can replay a completed Generation by clicking the Start Replay button belonging to that generation and chapter in the Storyline menu.[/*][*]Only one replay can be played through one Generation at a time.[/*][*]While replaying a Generation, some NPCs may not be available or it may be difficult to enter or move to certain areas. Upon completion or forfeiting of the replay, NPCs are normally visible again and you can enter certain areas.[/*][*]You cannot start a replay from the middle of a Generation.[/*][*]If you forfeit a replay or start a replay of another generation while a replay is in progress then, all replay progress of the generation will be reset.[/*][*]If the daily replay count limit has been reached for the part, the replay progress for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will be saved and you can start from the next part the next day.[/*][*]During replay, there is no delay in accepting quests, and it has been improved that the next quest will be received immediately.[/*][*]Replay quest has been improved to receive quests while indoors.[/*][*]Quests given between Generations Part 1 and Part 2 that are not related to the story have been excluded from Replay.[/*][*]Optional titles can be collected through repeated replays.[/*][*]Completing Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 replays will award [b][url=#c6replayrewards]C6 Replay Reward Box[/url][/b] and [url=#c7replayrewards][b]C7 Replay Reward Box:[/b][/url][list][*]Opening the box will reward a chance to receive a variety of items such as new C6/C7 Homestead Housing decorations, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.[list][*]The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.[/*][/list][/*][*]Balloons obtained from the replay reward box cannot be traded.[/*][/list][/*][*]Replay starting conditions require all chapters of a Generation to be completed.
[list][*]Example: To replay G1, you must have completed Chapter 1 by clearing all of G1, G2, and G3.[/*][*]If you are currently replaying G1, G2, or G3, the replay progress will be reset upon logging in after the update. You will receive one C1 Replay Reward Box and 3,000 gold by mail.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The number of replay episodes that can be started per day has been changed from 5 to 7.[/b][/*][*]Improvements to existing Chapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse are as follows:[list][*]When progressing through a generation in Chapter 6, optional dialogue will be presented even when talking to a character outside of the quest progression order.[/*][/list][/*][*]Completing all the Generations in Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will permanently add NPCs in Avalon.[list][*]After the update, you will need to complete the Generations for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 for the first time or complete a replay once.[list][*]Even if you have cleared all previous Generations for Chapter 6 and 7, you must complete a replay for any belonging to the chapter at least once to encounter the NPCs.[/*][/list][/*][*]Depending on the day of the week, the NPCs that are available will be split amongst the days; however, they won’t appear on Saturday.[/*][*]You cannot meet them during the replay though they will appear normally again when replay is completed or forfeited.[/*][*]In the case of NPCs that can be met in the sanctuary, they will appear or disappear normally only after entering the sanctuary once, even on the specified day of the week.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that you can present some items to the permanent NPCs you can meet at the entrance of Tech Duinn.[/*][*]Travel Diary conversation keywords for some NPCs will be modified or added.
[list][*]Upon clearing G19, keywords for Altam or Avelin are acquired. 
[list][*]This does not apply if you have previously cleared G20 and possessed the keyword and possession history remains.[/*][/list][/*][*]Upon clearing G20, keywords for Caswyn or Pihne are acquired.[/*][*]Upon clearing G21, keywords for Talvish or Llywelyn are acquired.[/*][*]After the update, you can learn the keywords when you complete each generation first and the replay.[list][*]For those that have previously cleared all Generations, you must complete each Generation through replay at least once to obtain the keywords.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]For some NPCs, special dialogues that are only displayed during replays will be added.[/*][*]For some NPCs, reaction dialogue lines when wearing specific outfits are added.[/*][*]The description of Port Ceann in some generations will be modified to match the situation after the Great Era of Commerce update.[/*][*]Many typos and awkward expressions throughout the G19, G20, G21, G22, G23, G24, and G25 storyline have been corrected.[/*][*]A number of situations in which conversations with an NPC are impossible due to the storyline dialogue have been improved.[/*][*]Camera direction has been changed to the following missions within G19, G20, and G21.[list][*]G19: “Incidental Inevitability,” “The Wolf and the Man,” “Things with Wings,” “Shattered Trust,” and “Do or Die”[/*][*]G20: “Graveyard Night,” “Grave Keeper 1,” “Any Way the Wind Blows,” “A Knight’s Musings,” “Circle of Damnation,” and “Clashing Blades 1”[/*][*]G21: “First Communication,” “Second Communication,” “Third Communication,” “Sixth Communication,” “Colossal Enemy by the Shore,” “Ambush,” “Seventh Communication,” “Avelin’s Nightmare,” “Gravebound,” “Sanctuary Erg,” “The Keeper of the Gate,” “That Which Remains,” “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight,” “Winds of Madness,” and “Guardians”[/*][/list][/*][*]In G20, issues have been fixed where the change in the NPC’s relationship and emotional lines were inconsistent.
[list][*]If you don’t select a speech option when offered to accompany Altam in the Budding Beginning quest, it will increase Avelin’s favorability instead of Altam.[/*][*]If you ask the reason for Pihne’s request in the quest Circle of Damnation, Caswyn’s favorability will drop instead of increasing.[/*][*]If you interrupt Pihne’s conversation in the quest Forward Progress, it will decrease Talvish’s favorability instead of Pihne’s.[/*][/list][/*][*]The balance for some of the G21 story missions has been modified.[list][*]When using the item “Prayer of Protection” in the shadow mission “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight”, the duration of the protection effect is increased.[/*][*]In the shadow mission "Guardians”, the boss has been modified so that it does not attack while dialogue is in progress. If the boss’ HP is reduced to 80%, the boss becomes invincible until entering phase 2 of the fight.[/*][/list][/*][*]The appearance of characters in some G22 cutscenes has been changed.[/*][*]In G24, information for “Things That Go Bump in the Night“ has been changed to include more details under the Story Guide.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Enya and Etain’s gloves were displayed incorrectly when playing G25 RP Missions or using Transformation Medals.[/*][*]The G25 Storyline start method has changed.[list][*]If you select “Start G25 Eclipse” in the Storyline Menu, the related cutscene will play and you will immediately enter the story mission.[/*][*]This has changed so that you can proceed with the first quest regardless of whether or not you have cleared the first story mission to enter.[/*][/list][/*][*]20 new BGM themes have been added to the Jukebox.[/*][/list][h2][b][b]C6/C7 Replay Reward Boxes[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]When you complete a Generation Replay for C6 and C7, you will receive a [b]C6 Replay Reward Box [/b]and [b]C7 Replay Reward Box[/b] respectively.[/*][*]Opening the box will reward one item from the following droplist, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.
[list][*]The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.[/*][*]Both C6 and C7 Replay Boxes have the possibility of dropping Mini-Gems/Mini-Gem Selection Boxes, and Balloons! [/*][/list][/*][/list]
