notes.title: NEXT: Arcana - Patch Notes - December 15
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the NEXT: Arcana Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th 2021, After Maintenance - January 19th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78420/dark-moon-box]Dark Moon Box[/url]: Thursday, December 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 29th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78493/snow-cloud-for-sale]Snow Cloud for Sale![/url]: Thursday, December 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 29th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78452/snowflower-tree-festival-event-returns]Snowflower Tree Festival Event Returns![/url]: Thursday, December 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 12th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77918/next-update-celebration-events]NEXT Update Celebration Events[/url]: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78526/next-arcana-update]NEXT: Arcana Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]NEXT: Arcana Update[/b]
[list][*]The NEXT: Arcana Update is here. See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/arcana]dedicated microsite[/url] and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78526/next-arcana-update]update post[/url] [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78002/next-new-beast-update][/url] for more information!
[list][*]New [b]Arcana Talents[/b], [b]Elemental Knight[/b] and [b]Harmonic Saint[/b] have been added.[list][*]You must be over cumulative level 10,000 in order to start prerequisite quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]New Skills are added for both Arcana Talents.[/*][*]New titles have been added for the new Arcana Talents.[/*][*]The existing Grandmaster Guide quests have been removed and replaced.[/*][*]New UIs have been added for Managing Arcana and Arcana Links.[/*][*]Information related to Arcana has been added to the Basic Info tab of the Character Info menu.[/*][*]The Arcana tab has been added to the Talent menu.[/*][*]An active Arcana Talent tab is added to the Skill menu.[/*][*]New NPCs Laoire, Cowenna, and Eochaid have been added.[/*][*]A new area, the Arcana Association Room, has been added.[/*][*]And more! [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where certain Moon-Gates and Mana-Tunnels when used on the World Map would lead to incorrect destinations.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where during the Memoir Quest "Nele's Music Basics", some objectives were displayed incorrectly.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where  Beach Vacation Pedicure was invisible on Giant characters wearing Morrighan's Regalia (F).[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.[/*][*]There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.[/*][*]The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.[/*][*]After completing G24, the first quest of G25 does not arrive, and cannot be started in Storyline UI.[/*][*]There is a text error with the rank up requirements for the skill "Hydra Transmutation".[/*][*]The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.[/*][*]In the Storyline menu, Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will inaccurately allow players to start a replay, though this will only consume resources.[/*][*]Certain Moon Gates and Mana Tunnels are leading to wrong locations when teleporting with the Traveler's Guide.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Snowflower Tree Festival Event Returns!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2135/221213_snowflowertree-festival_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

The mysterious Snowflower Tree has reappeared in Vales! Send your wishes to the Snowflower Tree and earn some rewards such as the Snow Cloud Bed or the various Homestead items! Help make this festival a lively one by completing daily quests every day. Check out the details below!
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, December 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 12th, 2023, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Wishing Snowflower Tree Festival[/b].[/*][*]You will also receive [b]Orange Wings of a Goddess (Snowflower Festival)[/b] that will teleport you.[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Lily[/b] at the festival location.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once registered, you will receive the daily quest [b][Event] Make a Wish[/b].[/*][*]Stay logged in for 36 minutes each day to receive a [b]Wishing Snow Crystal[/b].[/*][*]You can help [b]Nelche[/b] and [b]Garon[/b] to receive more Wishing Snow Crystals![/*][*]When you use the Wishing Stone Crystal 2 times, and talk to Lily, you will receive the following rewards:
[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3 Snowflower Tree Festival Gift Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Each time you put a wish into the Wishing Snow Crystal, you will receive 1 Snowflower Tree Festival Giftbox.[/*][*]If enough players put wishes into the Wishing Snow Crystal and send it off to the Snowflower Tree, the tree will shine for 2 hours.[/*][*]If you talk to Lily while the tree is shining, you will receive [b]1 Special Snowflower Tree Festival Box[/b] and [b]1 Snowflower Tree Festival Coin Box[/b].[/*][*]Wishing Snow Crystals will disappear every day at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b] so be sure to use them all beforehand.[/*][/list][h2][b]Daily Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]You have a choice of either helping Nelche or Garon for the daily quest.[/*][*]To receive the daily quest, talk to Lily and click on Receive Daily Quest.[/*][/list]
[b]Helping Neche collect Mysterious Pages[/b]
[list][*]If you decide to help [b]Nelche[/b], you will receive the daily quest [b][Event] Gather Mysterious Pages[/b].[/*][*][b]Mysterious Pages[/b] have a chance to drop from all monsters in Erinn.[/*][*]The higher ranked monsters have a higher drop rate.[/*][*]When you gather 10 Mysterious Pages and talk to Nelche, you will receive the following rewards:[/*][list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]1 Wishing Snow Crystal[/b][/*][*][b]1 Snowflower Tree Festival Gift Box[/b][/*][/list][*]Mysterious Pages disappear daily at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Helping Garon collect Lively Melodies[/b]
[list][*]If you decide to help [b]Garon[/b], you will receive the daily quest [b][[/b][b]Event] Gather Lively Melodies[/b].[/*][*]You can get a [b]Lively Melody[/b] each time you play a song that lasts at least 1 minute and consists of 300 or more notes.[/*][*]You must use the [b]Playing Instrument[/b] skill in order to obtain Lively Melodies.[/*][*]The quality of your performance does not affect whether or not you get Lively Melodies.[/*][*]When you gather 10 Lively Melodies and talk to Garon, you will receive the following rewards:[/*][list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]1 Wishing Snow Crystal[/b][/*][*][b]1 Snowflower Tree Festival Gift Box[/b][/*][/list][*]Lively Melodies disappear daily at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Event Quest Details[/b][/h2]
[b][Event] Wishes Come True[/b]
[list][*]Completing the daily quest [b][Event] Make a Wish[/b] a set amount of times will earn you a Snowflower Tree Festival Coin Box.[/*][*]Opening the Coin Box will reward you with a Copper, Silver, or Gold Snowflower Tree Coin (Totem). [/*][*]Talk to Lily to complete the quest and receive the following rewards:[list][*]500,000 EXP[/*][*]Special Snowflower Tree Festival Gift Box x15[/*][*][b]*NEW* Eternal Heart 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Max Damage +18[/*][*]Magic Attack +25[/*][*]Music Buff Effect +6[/*][*]Water/Fire/Wind/Earth Alchemic Damage +12[/*][*]Critical +5%[/*][*]Defense +10[/*][*]Protection +6[/*][*]Magic Defense +10[/*][*]Magic Protection +6[/*][*]Movement Speed +2%[/*][*]The effects can be used for 30 days. The title can still be equipped without the effects afterwards.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2138/eternal-heart-2nd-title-coupon.gif[/img][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][b][Event] The Fairy Tale Parade[/b][/b]
[list][*]Each objective of the quest will reward you with a Snowflower Tree Festival Coin Box.[/*][*]If you complete the daily quest [b][Event] Gather Mysterious Pages[/b] 8 times, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]300,000 EXP[/*][*]Snowflower Reindeer Whistle
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2193/sftf_reindeer_v1.png[/img] [list][*]This new pet can also pull a sled anywhere, not just on the snow![/*][/list][/*][*]3 Special Snowflower Tree Festival Gift Box[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Noble Mansion Floor Tile[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][b][Event] The Snowflower Tree Band[/b][/b]
[list][*]Each objective of the quest will reward you with a Snowflower Tree Festival Coin Box.[/*][*]If you complete the daily quest, "[Event] Gather Lively Melodies" 8 times, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]300,000 EXP[/*][*]Snowflower Husky Whistle

notes.title: NEXT: Arcana Update
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2042/221201_decemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]
[h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Arcana[/b]
[list][*]New [b]Arcana Talents[/b], [b]Elemental Knight[/b] and [b]Harmonic Saint[/b] have been added. [/*][*]New Skills are added for both Arcana Talents.[/*][*]Arcana Talents combine the elements of two Grandmaster talents.[/*][*]Additional details for Arcana can be viewed on the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/arcana]dedicated microsite[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
[b]How to Learn Arcana[/b]
[list][*]Characters over cumulative level 10,000 will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Grandmaster’s Path[/b].[list][*]The existing Grandmaster Guide quests have been removed.[/*][*]You can receive the Arcana Guide Quest, [b][Guide] One Step Higher[/b] after progressing in the quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]After completing [b][Guide] One Step Higher[/b], you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame[/b].[/*][*]You must complete the Arcana guide quests [Guide] One Step Higher and [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame to learn Arcana talents.[/*][*]After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, the permanent NPC [b]Laoire[/b] will be added to the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.[/*][*]You can accept the Arcana Talent acquisition quest by talking to NPC Laoire about [b]Promising Arcana Candidates[/b].[/*][*]In order to acquire [b]Elemental Knight[/b], the character must meet the following requirements:[list][*]Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher [/*][*]Acquire the Grandmaster Spellsword Talent Title[list][*]Requires the Grandmaster Mage and Grandmaster Warrior talent levels[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest, [Elemental Knight] A Dress Too Hot to Handle[list][*]You can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Spellsword and talking to NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates - Elemental Knight.[/*][*]When completing the quest, NPC [b]Cowenna[/b] will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Elemental Knight Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to acquire [b]Harmonic Saint[/b], the character must meet the following requirements:[list][*]Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher [/*][*]Acquire the Grandmaster Choirmaster Talent Title[list][*]Requires the Grandmaster Bard and Grandmaster Cleric Talent levels[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest, [Harmonic Saint] An Unremembered Dream[list][*]You can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Choirmaster and talking to NPC Laoireabout Promising Arcana Candidates - Harmonic Saint.[/*][*]When completing the quest, NPC [b]Eochaid[/b] will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Harmonic Saint Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Manage Arcana[/b]
[list][*]A new area, the [b]Arcana Association Room[/b] is added.[list][*]You can enter through the Great Hall on the 2nd floor of the Tara Rath Royal Castle.[/*][*]To enter the area, you must complete the [Guide] One Step Higher quest.[/*][*]After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, you can go directly to it by pressing the [b]Go to Arcana Association Room[/b] button in the Talent menu under the Arcana tab.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can check the [b]Manage Arcana[/b] menu at the [b]Arcana Enkindling Lectern[/b] located in the area.[list][*]Several options related to Arcana Level and Arcana Link are available to enhance the Arcana talents.[/*][/list][/*][*]Information related to Arcana has been added to the Basic Info tab of the Character Info menu.[list][*]You can check the Arcana level, experience, and link level of the currently active Arcana Talent.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Arcana tab has been added to the Talent menu.[list][*]In the Arcana tab, you can check the details of all Arcana talents.[/*][*]You can check the Arcana bonus effect applied to the character and the upper limit increase in stats.[/*][/list][/*][*]An active Arcana Talent tab is added to the Skill menu.[list][*]You can check Arcana's exclusive skills in the corresponding tab.[/*][*]Through the skill management button, you can acquire and rank up Arcana specific skills.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2162/talent-ui-hud.png[/img]

[b]Arcana Talent Enhancement[/b]
[list][*]At the [b]Arcana Enkindling Lectern[/b], you can select and activate one of the acquired Arcana Talents.[list][*]100 AP can be consumed to switch the active Arcana talent.[/*][*]Acquired Arcana level bonuses are maintained even if you switch to another Arcana talent.[/*][/list][/*][*]Whenever the character level increases, the currently active Arcana talent experience increases.[/*][*]When the Arcana Talent's EXP reaches its maximum level, the Arcana Talent's level increases.[/*][*]Each Arcana Talent level can be increased up to 50.[/*][*]Depending on the Arcana level, you can get bonus stats or learn additional skills for the talent.[list][*]Training Arcana skills requires the character to reach specific Arcana Levels or rank other Arcana skills to a certain rank.[/*][*]AP is required when ranking up the skills.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Total Arcana Level[/b] is the cumulative level of all Arcana Talents, and the upper limit of the character's stats increases according to the Total Arcana Level.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2163/manage-arcana-hud-ui.png[/img]

[b]Arcana Link[/b]
[list][*]You can unlock Arcana Link stages when reaching a certain level of an Arcana talent.[/*][*]Arcana Links can be unlocked up to 5 stages, and more bonus effects can be obtained as the stage increases.[/*][*]The Arcana Link Bonus applies only to the currently active Arcana Talent.[/*][*]In order to unlock Arcana Links, the Link Unlock Requirements must be met, requiring a certain Arcana Talent Level, AP, and Scorching Crests.[list][*]Arcana Talent-Specific Scorching Crest items are required for each stage.[/*][*]Scorching Crests can be obtained by converting the Smoldering Thread item and 10,000 Gold via the Crest Forging menu when Managing Arcana.[/*][*]Smoldering Thread can be obtained from certain dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][*]When reaching certain Arcana Link stages, Arcana Link Quests will be available for both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana Talents.[/*][*]You can proceed with the Link Quest when each Arcana Talent Link stage 1, 3, and 5 is achieved.[/*][*]You can unlock the next link stage without completing the link quest.[/*][*]Stage 1 and 3 link quests are accepted automatically upon reaching the link level.[/*][*]If you do not complete the previous stage link quest, you will not be able to progress or accept the next stage quest.[/*][*]If you do not receive the quest automatically or in the case of the 5th stage link quest, you can accept the quest by talking to the NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates.[list][*]Stage 5 link quests can be accepted after learning both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana talents.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Elemental Knight[/b][/h2][list][*]Elemental Knight skills can only be used while equipping a melee weapon.[/*][/list]
[b]Instill Flame[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that grants the power of the fire elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.[/*][*]You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.[/*][*]While the Instill Flame skill is active, you gain the following effects.[list][*]Increases minimum/maximum damage.[/*][*]Splash damage range is added during normal attack.[/*][*]Increases skill damage of Blazing Assault Slash.[/*][*]Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.[/*][*]Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click][/*][*]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using fire magic.[/*][*]Increases the Fire Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Fire Elemental to equipment.[/*][*]Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Instill Frost[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that grants the power of the ice elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.[/*][*]You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.[/*][*]While the Instill Frost skill is active, you gain the following effects.[list][*]Increases minimum/maximum damage.[/*][*]Reduces the target's movement and attack speed when using normal attacks.[/*][*]Increases skill damage of Shattering Windmill.[/*][*]Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.[/*][*]Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click][/*][*]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using ice magic.[/*][*]Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.[/*][*]Increases the Ice Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Ice Elemental to equipment.[/*][*]Movement speed and attack speed reduction effects are refreshed based on the last applied effect.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Instill Thunder[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that grants the power of the lightning elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.[/*][*]You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.[/*][*]While the Instill Thunder skill is active, you gain the following effects.[list][*]Increases minimum/maximum damage.[/*][*]When using a normal attack, the target’s Defense and Protection are partially ignored and the stun time is increased. In higher ranks, it also negates target’s Heavy Stander effect.[/*][*]Increases skill damage of Dynavolt Smash.[/*][*]Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.[/*][*]Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click].[/*][*]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using lightning magic.[/*][*]Increases the Lightning Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Lightning Elemental to equipment.[/*][*]Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Blazing Assault Slash[/b]
[list][*]It is an active skill that jumps towards the enemy and damages surrounding enemies.[/*][*]Able to select a landing location during the jump animation after using the skill.[/*][*]If you do not select a landing location, you will land at the point where you attacked.[/*][*]Damage increases while Instill Flame skill is active.[/*][*]Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Assault Slash skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Blazing Assault Slash skill increases.[/*][/list]
[b]Shattering Windmill[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that attacks enemies around the caster.[/*][*]Damages and freezes enemies on hit.
[list][*]The movement speed and attack speed are reduced for enemies that are immune to being frozen.[/*][/list][/*][*]Deals additional damage when the freezing effect ends.[/*][*]Damage increases while Instill Frost skill is active.[/*][*]Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Windmill skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Shattering Windmill skill increases.[/*][/list]
[b]Dynavolt Smash[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that attacks enemies in a straight line.[/*][*]Damage increases while Instill Thunder skill is active.[/*][*]Depending on the damage of the Smash skill, the damage of the Dynavolt Smash skill increases.[/*][/list]
[b]Dauntless Defense[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that blocks enemy attacks and counter attacks while in defense.[/*][*]While you hold down the skill button, you will continue to defend against enemy attacks, and in this state, if you release the button or after a certain period of time, you will attack the surroundings.[/*][*]Each enemy's attack blocked while in this defensive state will increase the counter attack damage inflicted to the target up to three times.[/*][*]The higher the defense proficiency of the Defense skill, the higher the defense proficiency of the Dauntless Defense skill.[/*][*]Reduces incoming damage based on the size of the shield.[list][*]Small shield = 20% damage reduction[/*][*]Medium shield = 40% damage reduction[/*][*]Large shield = 60% damage reduction[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2][b]Harmonic Saint[/b][/h2][list][*]Harmonic Saint skills can only be used while equipping a staff or wand.[/*][/list]
[b]Hand of Restoration[/b]
[list][*]A single target skill that recovers Health and Wounds.[/*][*]Additional HP recovery based on Healing skill’s recovery value.[/*][*]The maximum HP recovery amount does not exceed the maximum injury recovery amount.[/*][/list]
[b]Echoes of Salvation[/b]
[list][*]A skill that restores the Health of party members within an area of effect.[/*][*]Increased MP and Stamina Recovery Speed for affected party members for a short time.[/*][*]Increased HP recovery based on Party Healing skill rank.[/*][*]Additional MP and Stamina Recovery Speed based on Enduring Melody’s skill rank.[/*][/list]
[b]Voice of Vitality[/b]
[list][*]A skill that continuously recovers the Health of all nearby party members for a certain period of time.[/*][*]HP recovery occurs at regular intervals for affected party members and their elemental resistance is increased.[/*][*]Increased elemental resistance of Voice of Vitality based on the skill ranks of Fire Shield, Ice Shield, and Lightning Shield.[/*][/list]
[b]Pulse of Purification[/b]
[list][*]A skill that continuously inflicts damage to surrounding enemies within a certain range centered on the caster. (Can be channeled for up to 15 seconds)[/*][*]While holding down the skill button, enemies will receive damage at regular intervals, but Health and Mana will be consumed continuously.[/*][*]When channeling ends, additional damage is dealt in proportion to the channeling duration.[/*][*]Skill casting will stop if the HP/MP required to maintain the skill is insufficient or if you are hit by an enemy.[/*][/list]
[b]Pall of Ruination[/b]
[list][*]An active skill that grants a stat reduction effect to all enemies around the caster.[/*][*]Reduced stats are as follows:
[list][*]Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection[/*][*]Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Casting Speed[/*][/list][/*][*]Increased Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection reduction of Pall of Ruination based on the Dance of Death skill rank.[/*][*]Increased speed reduction effect of Pall of Ruination based on the Fantastic Chorus skill rank.[/*][*]The Time Shift technique cannot be used for the Pall of Ruination skill.[/*][/list]
[b]Blessing of Protection[/b]
[list][*]A skill that amplifies the survivability of nearby party members by creating a shield for a short period of time.[/*][*]The shield negates most attacks for a short period of time. (It is not effective for certain gimmicks and instant kills.)[/*][*]Party members affected by Blessing of Protection gain the following stats for a certain period of time:
[list][*]Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection[/*][/list][/*][*]Increased Defense and Protection effects of Blessing of Protection based on the Enduring Melody skill rank.[/*][/list]
[b]Hymn of Resurrection[/b]
[list][*]A skill that revives an incapacitated party member.[/*][*]A party member revived with Hymn of Resurrection recovers some of their Health and Wounds.[/*][*]After reviving, incoming damage is reduced for a short time.[/*][*]Increased recovery of Hymn of Resurrection based on the First Aid skill rank.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list][*]You can obtain the Arcana Collection Book from NPC Laoire.[/*][*]Laoire, Cowenna, and Eochaid have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Campfire Invitation.[list][*]Laoire: Jet 10cm[/*][*]Cowenna: Picnic Chicken Kebab[/*][*]Eochaid: 20 Finest Handmade Bandages[/*][/list][/*][*]Arcana related items have been added.[list][*]Smoldering Thread[/*][*]Scorching Crest: Elemental Knight[/*][*]Scorching Crest: Harmonic Saint[/*][/list][/*][*]You can obtain Smoldering Thread from various dungeons.[list][*]It can be obtained from the dungeon end chest each time the dungeon is cleared.[/*][*]At least one Smoldering Thread is dropped, and there are variations depending on the dungeon and difficulty.[/*][*]A large amount of Smoldering Thread can also be obtained at a low probability.[list][*]Alby Advanced Hard Mode[/*][*]Ciar Advanced Hard Mode [/*][*]Rundal Advanced Hard Mode[/*][*]Alby Veteran[/*][*]Ciar Veteran[/*][*]Rabbie Veteran[/*][*]Math Veteran[/*][*]Fiodh Veteran[/*][*]Barri Veteran[/*][*]Coill Veteran[/*][*]Rundal Veteran[/*][*]Peaca Veteran[/*][*]Coill Abyss[/*][*]Peaca Abyss [/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm (Excludes Mirror World) [/*][*]Mag Mell -  Forest of the Four Seasons (Normal, Hard)[/*][*]Mag Mell - Dynamic Lands (Normal, Hard)[/*][*]Tech Duinn - Revived Illusion (Normal, Advanced, Elite)[/*][*]Tech Duinn - Feth Fiada (Normal, Advanced, Elite)[/*][*]Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares (Normal, Advanced, Elite)[/*][*]Tech Duinn - Awakened Abyssal Lord (Normal, Advanced, Elite)[/*][*]Crom Bas (Normal, Advanced, Elite)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Grandmaster Spellsword and Grandmaster Choirmaster Hidden Talent titles have been added.[/*][*]When talents related to Hidden Talents become Grandmasters, the level of hidden talents automatically increases.[/*][*]In the talent selection window that appears during rebirth, a guide to Arcana-related talents has been added.[/*][*]The increased casting speed effect of the Echostone is modified so that it is applied to the wand twice, the same as the reforge of the same effect.[/*][*]If both the increased casting speed effect from an Echostone and the casting speed increase effect from a reforge are equipped, only the highest effect value will be applied.[/*][*]When equipping items with related set effects, it has been modified so that only the highest effect value is applied regardless of the order in which they are equipped.[list][*]Movement Speed Increase[list][*]The movement speed increase effects of certain shoes are separate effects, so they can be stacked. notes.title: NEXT: New Beast - Patch Notes - November 17
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the NEXT: New Beast Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76107/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-2]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2[/url]: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77599/an-impish-impasse-event]An Impish Impasse Event[/url]: Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77643/classic-maid-box]Classic Maid Box[/url]: Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77991/erinn-beauty-box-2022]Erinn Beauty Box[/url]: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 15th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77918/next-update-celebration-events]NEXT Update Celebration Events[/url]: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 19th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77990/shopkeeper-s-sale-welcome-milletian-packages]Welcome Milletian Packages[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78002/next-new-beast-update]NEXT: New Beast Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]NEXT: New Beast Update[/b]
[list][*]The NEXT: New Beast Update is here. See the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/newbeast]dedicated microsite[/url] and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78002/next-new-beast-update]update post[/url] [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/78002/next-new-beast-update][/url] for more information!
[list][*]Skill Training Improvements have been added. Reduced training requirements make it easy to reach higher ranked skills, including the removal of CP Training. [/*][*]Changes have been added for Renown and Crusader training. [/*][*]Dan Advancement tests can be completed up to twice a day.[/*][*]Grandmaster now only require 10 Talent Seals to achieve a Grandmaster Talent.[/*][*]Changes to Blaanid’s Brave Boost have been added, easing the progression of questing and leveling for new Milletians.[list][*]New rewards, including pets, Blaanid’s Blessing buff, and more![/*][*]The Memory Book has been reset, so any character can start Blaanid's Brave Boost from the beginning again.[/*][/list][/*][*]Additional quest changes and the addition of the Receivable Quest Board have been added.[/*][*]Modifications to the Beginner Benefits have been added, and characters under level 10,000 will now receive Beginner Benefits.[/*][*]And more! [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Party Boards have been removed from Uladh and Iria towns. The Party Board can still be accessed through the Party Menu (P) -> Party Board option.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue causing the Book of the Sacred Chalice to be named incorrectly. [/*][*]Fixed an issue where characters could not progress in the G8 questline.[/*][*]During the G1 questline, a certain song is now properly synced with the cutscene.[/*][*]Fixed text and spacing discrepancies in Chapter 7 Storyline UI display.[/*][*]Fluttering Demon Headband and Fluttering Devil Headband display properly.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][*]A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. [/*][*]A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.[/*][*]During the Memoir Quest "Nele's Music Basics", some objectives are displayed incorrectly.
[/*][/list]

The Guild Activity Coins will still remain, but you will not be able to use Roy's Guild Event Shop, and the special Guild Member Buffs.[/*][*]If you quit a guild while participating in the event, and rejoin another guild, you will be considered a new guild member and will need to wait 3 days to participate in certain parts of the event.[/*][*]Right-click "Use" on the Guild Activity Journal to open it and check information related to guild activities.[list][*][b]Check Guild Activity EXP[/b][list][*]You can check your [b]Individual Guild Activity EXP Points[/b] and the [b]Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points[/b] that have been obtained for the week.[/*][*]There are several ways to gain Guild Activity EXP points.[/*][*]Guild Activity EXP resets every week on Thursday at 7:00 AM PST in real time.[/*][*]Please note that it can take up to 5 minutes for the Guild EXP to update in the Guild Activity Journal.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Claim your Weekly Guild Reward[/b][list][*]To achieve the weekly guild reward, you and your guild will need to obtain a certain amount of Guild Activity EXP Points.[/*][*]5,000 or more Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points[/*][*]500 or more Individual Guild Activity EXP Points[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Once both of the above requirements have been meet, the [b]Weekly Guild Reward Box[/b] can be claimed.[/b][list][*]This reward can only be claimed once per week.[/*][*]You can only claim the reward during the week, before the reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Skill Training Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Skill Training has been greatly improved across Skills and Talents to improve training requirements and shorten the time it takes to reach high ranked Skills. [/*][*]The number of training requirements has been reduced and the EXP received from training will be increased. (The adjusted amount varies depending on the Skill)[/*][*]Training has been adjusted so that the training items related to failure of production Skills are not essential for Skill advancement.[/*][*]CP (Combat Power) Training requirements have been removed from Skills.[list][*]Skills that required training with monsters of a specific level (Combat Power) have been changed so that it can be trained without this requirement.[/*][/list][/*][*]A function has been added to automatically rank up a Skill when maximum training has been reached.[list][*]You can activate the function by checking the [b]Rank Up Skills upon Completing Training[/b] box at the bottom of the Skill window or the Skill Info menu.[list][*]If you uncheck this option, it will be disabled again.[/*][/list][/*][*]Skills that become available for rank up by reaching 100 or more training experience while the function is activated will be automatically promoted without a separate verification process.[list][*]Note: Dan Skill Advancement will still require participating in the Advancement Ceremony.[/*][/list][/*][*]AP required for Skill rank up will be consumed, and if there is insufficient AP, automatic rank up is not possible.[/*][*]Note: Skills that are already available for ranking at the time the feature is activated will not be promoted immediately.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Dan Skill Advancement Test has been adjusted so that the promotion test can now be completed up to twice a day.[list][*]Failing the promotion test does not reduce your daily count towards it.[/*][/list][/*][*]The conditions for acquiring the Master title for each Skill has been reduced.[list][*]Skills that are rank 1 or higher will only require 100% training experience for the master title to be awarded for that Skill.[/*][/list][/*][*]The conditions for acquiring a Grandmaster Talent have been adjusted.[list][*]The required Talent Seals to achieve Grandmaster has been reduced from 20 to 10.[/*][*]It is now possible to start Grandmaster challenges for a Talent that is not actively set.[/*][/list][/*][*]Crusader level training and sub-skill acquisition adjustments have been added.[list][*]Crusader EXP gained has been increased for Daily and Weekly Orders, Apostle Raids, and Alban Knights Training Grounds.[list][*]Daily Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:[list][*]Girgashiy related Daily Order: 100 → 200[/*][*]Hasidim related Daily Order: 150 → 300[/*][*]Intermediate Bonus: 300 → 500[/*][*]All Clear Bonus: 300 → 1,000[/*][/list][/*][*]Weekly Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:[list][*]Girgashiy related Daily Order: 300 → 500[/*][*]Hasidim related Daily Order: 400 → 700[/*][*]Intermediate Bonus: 1,000 → 2,000[/*][*]All Clear Bonus: 1,000 → 3,000[/*][/list][/*][*]Apostle Raid Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:[list][*]Girgashiy: Easy 100, Normal 200, Hard 300, Very Hard 400 (Limit 800 per day)[/*][*]Hasidim: Hard 600 (Limit 1200 per day)[/*][*]Zebach: Hard 800 (1600 per day limit)[/*][/list][/*][*]Alban Knights Training Grounds Crusader EXP is doubled when clearing.[/*][/list][/*][*]The function of the Dogma Books (Dogma of Smithing, Dogma of Warding, Dogma of Binding) have been changed so that the selected sub-skill training is completed and the maximum level rises by 1 when used on a sub-skill.[list][*]It can only be used for sub-skills with a maximum level of 14 or less.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Renown training has been adjusted.[list][*]The upper limit of Renown EXP that can be obtained per day has been increased by 5 times. (2,000 -> 10,000 EXP)[/*][*]The Nele Renown training requirements that had a negative impact on the use of the Bard Bulletin Board has been replaced with a new training requirement.[/*][*]When using the Music/Life Renown Seal items, you will now be able to acquire Renown EXP regardless of the daily limit of Renown EXP.[/*][/list][/*][*]To coincide with changes to Skill training requirements, adjustments to Skill training bonuses have also been added.[list][*]The maximum multiplier of Skill training buffs you can receive has been changed to a maximum of [b]8x Skill Training[/b].[/*][*]The effect from Skill Training EXP Potions will no longer stack. Alongside the change, you will be unable to use another Skill Training Potion while already having the same effect from a potion active.[list][*]For example, when you are receiving 2x Magic Training EXP from the Double Magic Training EXP Potion, you will be unable to receive the EXP bonus from a Complete Skill Training EXP Potion.[/*][*]However, you can use the Double Ninja Skill Training EXP Potion while receiving the buff from Double Magic Training EXP Potion.[/*][/list][/*][*]If item bonuses surpass the maximum amount of training available, the maximum amount of training received will still be capped at the [b]Max Training EXP Bonus: x8[/b].[/*][*]The Character Level Effect that boosted the Skill training of an active talent when when a character reached level 100 or higher has been removed.[/*][/list][/*][*]NPC Duncan's skill untrain function will no longer be available.[/*][/list]
[b]Memoir Renewed[/b]
[list][*][b]Blaanid’s Brave Boost[/b] has been renewed with changes to quests, rewards, and leveling while progressing through Blaanid’s Memoirs and the four Memory Books. [/*][*]If you have already completed or are in the process of completing the Memory Book, you can proceed from the beginning again with the new changes.[list][*]If you have previously progressed through the Memory Books, you can acquire additional Blaanid Weapons when replaying. However, in the case of the Blade of Blossoming Memories item, even if you have two, you cannot dual wield them.[/*][/list][/*][*]Book 4 of the Memory Book has been replaced with objectives that require progressing up to Chapter 5 of the Generation Storyline quests. [/*][*]Certain quests and dialogue that were lacking in guidance will be improved, and the progress of some quests will be reduced.[/*][*]The experience point acquisition method when completing Memoir quests has been changed to increase the [b]cumulative level of the character automatically[/b].[/*][*]It is possible to reach cumulative level of up to 20,000 when you progress through the 4th Memory Book.[/*][*]As the cumulative level increases through the progress of Memory Book, the AP also increases by the same value.[list][*]Note: AP gained is not affected by events, items, etc. that affect AP acquisition amounts.[/*][/list][/*][*]Characters over level 20,000 will receive 1/5th of the value of levels and AP when completing Memoir quests.[/*][*]Some of the Rebirth Potions that were rewarded during the Memoir quests have been changed to the [b]Talent Coupon[/b] item.[list][*]Talent Coupons can be used to change your currently active combat or life talent without requiring a Rebirth.[/*][/list][/*][*]Essential items and Blaanid’s weapons are now provided early on, and you can acquire additional skills of various talents to help you in battle by progressing through the Memoirs.[/*][*]When you clear the guide quest [b][Brave Boost] A Blue Fragrance on the Wind[/b], you will receive a pet, the [b]Brainy Sheep Whistle[/b] (Once per account).[/*][*]When you clear Memory Book 1, 2, and 3, you can acquire 3 Doll Bag Box items.[list][*]First Memoir: Baby Bunny Doll Bag Box (7x7)[/*][*]Second Memoir: Fennec Fox Kit Doll Bag Box (7x7)[/*][*]Third Memoir: Bear Cub Doll Bag Box (7x7)[/*][/list][/*][*]When you clear Memory Book 2, you can acquire the [b]Memorial Link[/b] skill.[list][*]This skill is only available for characters who do not have the Divine Link skill, and will disappear when Divine Link is acquired.[/*][*]This skill is a lesser version of Divine Link.[/*][*]When Memorial Link is used with a pet, the pet will take enemy aggro, and both the character and pet will receive a temporary stat boost.[/*][/list][/*][*]When you clear Memory Book 4, you can acquire the [b]Support Bone Dragon Whistle[/b] item.[/*][*]A new support effect, [b]Blaanid’s Blessing[/b], can be obtained by each volume of the Memory Book progress for the character.[list][*]Blessing Effects do not overlap and the effect is applied to the character by the highest Stage.[/*][*]The Blessing can be set in Character Info > Additional Info > Blaanid’s Blessing to switch the Halo effect above the character.[/*][*]The Recall Book allows you to register a specified location, which can be teleported to by using the ‘Move’ function in the Recall Book. [/*][*]Blaanid’s Blessing unlocks the following effects at each stage:[list][*]Stage 1[list][*]Recall Book Stage 1[/*][*]Movement Speed +2%[/*][*]All Stats +1[/*][*]Acquire 1 additional AP at rebirth[/*][*]Blessing Effect Stage 1 (White Halo effect)[/*][/list][/*][*]Stage 2[list][*]Recall Book Stage 2[/*][*]Movement Speed +4%[/*][*]All Stats +2[/*][*]Acquire 2 additional AP at rebirth[/*][*]Blessing Effect Stage 2 (Red Halo effect)[/*][/list][/*][*]Stage 3[list][*]Recall Book Stage 3[/*][*]Movement Speed +6%[/*][*]All Stats +3[/*][*]Acquire 3 additional AP at rebirth[/*][*]Blessing Effect Stage 3 (Blue Halo effect)[/*][/list][/*][*]Stage 4[list][*]Recall Book Stage 4[/*][*]Movement Speed +8%[/*][*]All Stats +4[/*][*]Acquire 4 additional AP at rebirth[/*][*]Blessing Effect Stage 4 (Yellow Halo effect)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]It has been changed so that the Blaanid’s Brave Boost notification banner is not displayed on the menu bar at the bottom of the screen.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
[list][*][b]Generation progression has been improved.[/b][list][*]Generation quests for Chapters and Generations are now started in sequential order, and the delay time when awaiting the next quest has been removed.[/*][*]In G7, some information for quests that were lacking in guidance have been added. (Using Kousai's Lipai Tea)[/*][*]The shadow mission acquisition method has been improved in G11 and G12 so that you can enter the shadow mission immediately when talking to the NPC.[/*][*]The Shylock RP mission in the G15 'Price of Love' quest has been changed so that 1 to 3 players can enter it.[/*][*][b]Talking to the Bear NPC in Sidhe Sneachta during the day and selecting the Wait until Nighttime option will now allow you to enter a mission to meet NPC Tarlach in Sidhe Sneachta at night time.[/b][/*][*][b]The dungeon length of some RP missions in Chapter 1 is shortened and the movement speed is increased by 40%.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Receivable Quest Board has been added.[/b][list][*][b]It has been changed so that new characters will no longer receive non-essential quests all at once.[/b][list][*][b]Only non-essential quests that satisfy the conditions after the quest board has been added will be moved to the quest board. Therefore, it does not affect existing quests.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After completing the quest, [b]Memories of a Chain Slasher[/b] in Book 3 of Blaanid’s Brave Boost, characters will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] About the Receivable Quest Board[/b].[/b][/*][*][b]Characters that progress through quests will unlock quests available to select through the Receivable Quest Board.[/b][/*][*][b]Characters can select and start the quests anytime through the quest board.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Improvements have been made to the quest location check function and it is now possible to warp to locations using the world map.[/b][list][*]When checking the quest location, the viewpoint of the mini map will be modified to show the quest location and the character's current location at the same time. (May not be applicable in some areas)[/*][*]For quests in other areas, you will be guided to the world map as before, and the Moon Gates and Mana Tunnels will now be displayed on the world map.[/*][*][b]You can use the warp function of Traveler’s Guide by selecting the Moon Gate or Mana Tunnel displayed on the world map.[/b][/*][*][b]It is also possible to set a hotkey to open the world map in Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings > World Map.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Enchantment system specifications have been improved.[/b][list][*][b]Enchants of rank 9 or higher can now be enchanted regardless of rank.[/b][list][*][b]This means that no step enchantment process will be required when using Enchant Scrolls above rank 9. [/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The phrase 'Enchant enabled regardless of Rank' in the Enchant Scroll description of certain enchants has been removed.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The [b]Portable Diffuser (Spider)[/b] item has been added.[/b][list][*]You can obtain the item by passing the hill in front of Alby Dungeon in Tir Chonaill or talking to NPC Trevor.[/*][*]The Portable Diffuser (Spider) can be activated by right clicking the item to Activate it.[/*][*]When the Diffuser is activated, spider monsters will appear in the form of an Aroma bear. This is visible only to you.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Some contents of the [b]Dungeon Guide[/b] have been improved.[/b][list][*]It has been changed so that all characters can acquire Vouchers without having to designate a main representative character.[list][*][b]You can change it so that certain characters do not receive vouchers through NPC Eavan in Dunbarton.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The expiration date of the Forgetful Potions obtained from the 1st ~ 4th Support Boxes has been changed to 30 days. (It does not apply to items that have already been acquired.)[/*][*]The Skill Training Seal (30) for Combat and Magic talents has been added to the 2nd ~ 4th Voucher shop.[/*][*]The image and text has been improved to increase the visibility of the recommended dungeon display on the Dungeon Guide UI.[/*][*]The recommended dungeon will be displayed based on the character's maximum damage.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Lorna and Pan tutorial has been improved.[/b][list][*][b]The part where the new character had to unnecessarily re-talk to Lorna during the [b]First Steps in Erinn[/b] quest has been fixed.[/b][/*][*]It has been fixed so the [b]Item Equipping and Usage[/b] quest flow started shortly after completing the previous quest.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The content of the Talent selection window has been changed when rebirthing or creating a character.[/b][list][*]The Glyphwrighting talent is excluded from the recommended talent.[/*][*]Magic talent and Gunslinger talents are added to the recommended talent list.[/*][*]The NEW mark of Glyphwrighting talent has been removed.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]A preset function is added when creating a character for the first time.[/b][list][*]When creating a character, you will be able to set the appearance based on several presets with premium appearances.[/*][*]Character presets can only be used when creating a character using a character card that can use a premium appearance, such as a Novice card.[/*][*]If you are using a character card that cannot use a premium appearance, the character appearance can be selected in the same way as before.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Some appearances have been changed to premium appearances, indicated by the ‘P’ icon.[/b][list][*][b]These appearances can be selected by creating a character using a character that can use premium appearances, or by using a Pon during Rebirth or in the Dressing Room.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Beginner Benefits have been updated.[/b][list][*]The criteria for Beginner Benefits has been increased to characters under cumulative level 10,000.[/*][*]Free warp using the Traveler’s Guide has been increased up to level 10,000.[/*][*]It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive 3 types of beginner potion items when logging in.[/*][*]It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive Heart Sticker items when logging in.[list][*]All heart sticker items will be deleted.[/*][*][b]Heart Points Info has been removed from the Character Info > Additional Info menu.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The reduced time between Rebirths of a beginner character has been changed as follows:[/b][list][*]Cumulative level 1 ~ 4,999: 1 day (24 hours)[/*][*]Cumulative level 5,000 ~ 7,999: 2 days (48 hours)[/*][*]Cumulative level 8,000 ~ 9,999: 4 days (96 hours)[/*][*]Cumulative level 10,000 or more: 6 days (144 hours)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]The [b][Return Incentive] Explorers League Patronage[/b] quest which can start the Returned Milletian benefits will no longer be available.[/b][list][*][b]You can continue to use the benefits you have already received and the ongoing [b]Ten Missions of the Returned Milletian[/b] quests until the validity period of the Returned Milletian title expires.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: An Impish Impasse Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1400/221028-mbw-2856-impbrosruckusevent-940x290.jpg[/img]

Help out Imp Fizzy and Imp Dizzy with their requests! Play a new mini-game each week to earn Fresh Dewdrops, then exchange them in Fizzy’s Exchange Shop for new rewards! Check out all the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] I'm trying to find a Milletian[/b].[/*][*]Find Imp Fizzy in Dunbarton Square.[/*][*]Register a main character with Fizzy the Imp.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] I'm trying to find a Milletian:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Fizzy’s Request[/b] item[list][*]This item can be used to play mini-games or view information about them.[/*][/list][/*][*]Unlock the Daily Event quests and Achievement Quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PT[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Daily and Weekly Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Each week, different mini-games will be unlocked! [/*][*]All mini-games will be available throughout the event period, however the [b]Daily quest[/b] will change depending on the week.[/*][*]You can receive the mini-game rewards a [b]total of 5 times a day[/b], regardless of which mini-game you play.[/*][*]This resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.[/*][*]The EXP rewards from successfully completing mini-games are doubled during the weekend! [list][*]Weekend: Saturday 7:00 AM PT to Monday 6:59 AM PT[/*][*](Excludes Fresh Dewdrops rewards)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 1 [/b](Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 10th, Before Maintenance)

[b]Crack the Coded Box[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1385/crack-the-coded-box-ui.png[/img]
[list][*][list][*]On Week 1, you will receive the [b]Daily Quest[/b], [b]Crack the Coded Box![/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Dizzy and Fizzy need help unlocking all the boxes that have different passcodes![/*][*]Play the mini-game by using the [b]Fizzy’s Request[/b] item and select [b]Crack the Coded Box[/b].[/*][*]You will be required to create a mini-game party. After creating the party, click “Start mini-game” through the Party menu [Default key: P] to begin![list][*]You can play the mini-game alone or in a party up to 8.[/*][*]In a party, EXP rewards are granted based on the party member’s rank. [/*][*]The Fresh Dewdrops reward is rewarded the same in a party or alone.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can attempt to unlock a box 10 times. There is a time limit.[/*][*]Once the timer hits 0 and the round is over, the number of correct digits in the correct spot will be displayed under [b]the Circle column[/b] and the number of correct digits in the incorrect spot will be displayed under [b]the Triangle column[/b]. Incorrect digits in the incorrect spot will be displayed under [b]the X column[/b].[/*][*]When you complete the daily quest by playing the mini-game 1 time, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]15,000 EXP [/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]50 Fresh Dewdrops[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]After successfully finding the correct code, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]30,000 EXP or up to 100,000 EXP when in a party[/*][*][b]10 Fresh Dewdrops[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][b]Week 2 [/b](Thursday, November 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 17th, Before Maintenance)[/b]

[b]Imp-romptu Dance Party[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1382/imp-romptu-dance-party-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]On Week 2, you will receive the [b]Daily Quest[/b], [b][Event] Imp-romptu Dance Party![/b][/*][*]Play the mini-game by using the [b]Fizzy’s Request item[/b] and select [b]Imp-romptu Dance Party[/b].[/*][*]Show off those dance moves! Press the WASD and the Space keys in the correct order to dance to the rhythm. [/*][*]When you complete the quest by playing the mini-game and scoring 50+ points 1 time, you will receive the following rewards:
[list][*]15,000 EXP [/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*][b]50 Fresh Dewdrops[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]When you earn 50+ points in the mini-game, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]30,000 EXP and 100 Music Renown EXP (all types)[/*][*][b]10 Fresh Dewdrops[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][b]Week 3 [/b](Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance)[/b]

notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 1 - Patch Notes - October 20th
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76634/updated-balloon-festival-returns]Balloon Festival Event[/url]: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 27th,  Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76906/moonlight-hunter-s-loot-o-lantern-box]Moonlight Hunter's Loot-o'-Lantern Box[/url]: Thursday, October 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd,  Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77164/moonlight-dreams-season-2]Moonlight Dreams Season 2[/url]: Thursday, October 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77239/milletian-events-masterpiece-celebration-hotday]Milletian Events: Masterpiece Celebration Hotday[/url]: Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 10th, 11:59 PM PST[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77221/star-fishing-event]Star-Fishing Event[/url]: Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 17th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77302/casual-tech-chic-box]Casual Tech Chic Box[/url]: Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 17th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76107/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-2]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2[/url]: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77256/masterpiece-chapter-1-update]Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update[/b]
[list][*]The Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update is here. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77256/masterpiece-chapter-1-update][b]Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update[/b][/url]
[list][*]Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess can now be replayed.[list][*]New Replay Rewards such as the new Homestead items, including the Jukebox and Goddess Statue, Title, and Journal Achievements are available. [/*][/list][/*][*]NPC Voiceover, in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.[/*][*]Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole, with graphic updates and minor quest changes.[/*][*]The Chapter Info menu has been replaced with the [b]Storyline Menu[/b] with improved generation information.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Several changes to the [b]Campfire Spirit[/b] have been implemented.[list][*]The cooldown for obtaining Burning Firewood has changed to be within 5 to 10 hours. [/*][*]The duration of the Burning Firewood and Campfire Invitation items have been reduced from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.[/*][*]Improvements have been made so that, when burning an item in a campfire, an additional notice message appears during the time period when Burning Firewood can appear.[/*][*]Brielle and Gillach have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Campfire Invitation.[list][*]Brielle: Cotton Cloud Candy[/*][*]Gillach: Tourmaline 10cm[/*][/list][/*][*]The reward items sent by some NPCs after using a Campfire Invitation have been changed to the following items:[list][*]Duncan: Physical Power Potion (1 hour)[/*][*]Castanea: Magic Power Potion (1 hour)[/*][*]Melwyn: Stardust Dye Ampoule[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Seasonal Commerce Imbolic Season 2 will begin on November 1st, 2022.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with certain G3 cutscenes not playing and deducting gold when using the Crystal Ball.[/*][*]Fixed untranslated notice message when using Supply List item during trade action.[/*][*]Fixed several names of Enchant Scrolls that Stewart requests to exchange for Restoration Powder are incorrect. (Sheep Raising is Sheperd's, Excavator is Digger, Gusty is Windy, Boar is Wild Boar, Earthling is Earthen)[/*][*]Fixed the unnecessary line breaks within the Field Raid Messenger's dialogue.
[/*][*]Fixed the few text discrepancies when a Field Raid boss monster attempts to recover or recovers from Pragarah and Brionac attacks.[/*][*]Fixed the known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]Fixed the line break issue in the notice message when burning an item in a campfire.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][/list]

notes.content:

Vivi dropped all her magic items into the water and she needs your help! Will you help Vivi fish them out of the lake? She is willing to share the magic with you! Check out all the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 17th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Freshwater Star[/b].[/*][*]Find [b]Vivi[/b] near [b]Abb Neagh Lake[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Vivi.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Freshwater Star:[/*][list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Enchanted Bait Tin 50x[/b][/*][*]Unlock the daily event quest, [b][Event] Find the Stars[/b] and the Achievement Quest, [b][Event] Fish up the Stars[/b].[/*][/list][*]Each day, you will receive [b]50x Enchanted Bait Tin[/b] when logging in on the character you registered for the event. [/*][*]Use the [b]Enchanted Bait Tin[/b] with the [b]Fishing skill[/b] in [b]Abb Neagh[/b] [b]Lake[/b] to participate in the event.[/*][*]When fishing with the bait, you can obtain Vivi’s Star.[/*][*]Exchange [b]1x Vivi’s Star[/b] to Vivi for [b]10x Vivi’s Gift Box[/b].[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM Pacific Time[/b].[/*][*]Vivi’s Star, Small Glittering Star, and Enchanted Bait Tin items and event quests will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2][b]Daily Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Each day, you will receive the daily quest, [b][Event] Find the Stars[/b].[/*][*]Complete the daily quest by fishing up a Vivi’s Star and deliver it to Vivi![/*][*]When you complete the daily quest, you will receive the following rewards:[/*][list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*][b]30x Enchanted Bait Tin[/b][/*][/list][/list][h2][b]Achievement Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Each day, you will receive the daily quest, [b][Event] Fish up [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1094/shining-bright-2nd-title.gif[/img]

The [b]Masterpiece C1 Update[/b] is here! For more information on the update, view the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/77256/masterpiece-chapter-1-update][b]Masterpiece C1 Update[/b][/url] post! 
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 10th, 11:59 PM PDT[/b]
