notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
notes.content:
[h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1203/221011_octoberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/h2][h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess[/b] can now be replayed.
[list][*]If you have played all of [b]G1 Advent of the Goddess[/b], you can replay G1.[/*][*]If you have played all of [b]G2 Paladin[/b], you can replay G2.[/*][*]If you have played all of [b]G3 The Dark Knight[/b], you can replay G3. However, side quests cannot be replayed. [/*][*]You can obtain the C1 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]NPC Voiceover[/b], in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.[list][*]The volume of the voice can be adjusted in [b]Options > System > Sound > Voice Volume[/b].[/*][*]Voices are not provided in general conversations and keyword conversations.[/*][*]A microphone icon is displayed in the upper left corner of the NPC's chat window when voiceover is playing.[list][*]Audio is not provided for lines without this microphone icon.[/*][/list][/*][*]Voices are also provided for Chapter 1 NPC's speech bubbles.[list][*]The volume may be loud or low depending on the distance from the character.[/*][*]The volume of the speech bubbles can be adjusted in [b]Options > System > Sound > Sound Effect Volume[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole.[list][*]Quest information for some of Chapter 1's quests has been improved to provide more detail.[/*][*]Some story dialogue has been improved throughout the Chapter 1 Generations. [/*][*][b]Some changes to cutscenes and RP dungeons have been added, including graphic overhauls for major Chapter 1 NPCs such as Mari, Ruairi, and Tarlach. [/b][/*][*]The pictures that appear during quests have been adjusted to a larger size.[/*][*]The length of Math dungeon in some quests has been shortened.[/*][*]The difficulty of some RP dungeons in some G2 quests has been adjusted lower.[/*][*]The length of Baol dungeon in some G3 quests has been shortened.[/*][*]During the first playthrough of Chapter 1, the [b]Goddess Teleportation Support Scroll[/b] items will be provided for movement convenience.[list][*]This scroll can be used to move to a Moon Gate location.[/*][/list][/*][*]The time for receiving certain quests has been shortened, and the quest dialogue will indicate the amount of time to wait to receive the next quest.[/*][*]The performance of the Adventurer’s items received when playing the Chapter 1 quests for the first time has been increased.[list][*]The Smash Enhancement and Decreased Durability Loss set effects have been added and will activate when equipping all 4 Adventurer’s items. [/*][/list][/*][*]A [b]Clear Reward Box[/b] can now be obtained when clearing the G1, G2, and G3 generation quests for the first time, containing Gold, EXP, AP, and an Adventurer’s Bag Coupon (7x7).[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Notice[/b]: Some character’s quest status for “Old Advent of the Goddess” quests have been reorganized.[list][*]“Old Advent of the Goddess” refers to quests from Pre-Genesis Chapter 1 (G1~G3) received before June 2012.[/*][*]Characters who log in after the update will receive the proper quest progress automatically and the status will be revised to the progress of current "Advent of the Goddess" quests.[list][*]G1~G3 completion rewards will be sent to the character's mailbox.[/*][*]Title/Journal achievements will automatically be obtained when logging in after 10/20 (Thu) maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][*]Data related to the "Gathering Dark Knight Armor Pieces" quests will not be reset.[/*][*]The “Bind” quest will be removed from all characters.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Storyline Menu[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1190/storyline_menu.png[/img]
[list][*]The existing Chapter Info menu has been updated to the [b]Storyline Menu[/b] with improved information.[/*][*]You can start a Generation directly through the Storyline Menu. [/*][*]You can check the Summary information of the Chapter, story information by Generation, and detailed story information alongside quest progression.[list][*]Chapter: Shows chapter information, distinguishing the Generations within the Chapter. [/*][*]Generation: Shows the generation information, including starting conditions, and completion reward information.[/*][*]Quest: You can check the list of quests that make up the story.[/*][*]Story Guide: You can check the information necessary to progress the story depending on which part of the story is selected in the menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can check your character's Chapter progress at a glance.[list][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1176/ch_ns.png[/img] Chapter has not been started.[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1175/ch_ip.png[/img] A Generation within the Chapter is 'In progress'.[/*][*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1174/ch_complete.png[/img] You have completed all of the Generations of that chapter.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also check your character's Generation progress.[list][*]  [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1178/g_ip.png[/img]   The Generation is 'In progress'[/*][*]  [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1177/g_complete.png[/img]   You have completed all of the quests of that Generation.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Generation Replay[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]The [b]Replay[/b] function is added so that you can begin the story again at any time.[/*][*]Only Chapters that have already been completed can be replayed.[list][*]To replay a single generation, you must complete all Generations in the Chapter that the Generation belongs to.[/*][*]For example, to replay G1, you must clear all of G1, G2, and G3 to complete Chapter 1 first.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Replay function is currently only available for Chapter 1: G1, G2, and G3 storylines.[/*][*]Replays can be started by using 3,000 gold. [/*][*]The replay is specific to each story part in the Storyline menu.[/*][*]Only [b]5 stories per day[/b] per character can be replayed, and only one story can be replayed at a time.[/*][*][b]The daily replay count is reset at 7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][*]You can complete a replay immediately using [b]50,000 gold, 1 Pon, or 1 Instant Replay Completion Ticket[/b] to receive a C1 Replay Reward Box.[list][*]However, this does not count towards the “Completed Replays” completion count (Title and Journal Achievements).[/*][/list][/*][*]While undergoing a replay, you can [b]Forfeit Replay[/b], however the 3,000 Gold is not refunded.[list][*]Even if the replay is canceled through this method, the replay will still count towards the daily replay count.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Replay Rewards[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]You can check the total number of replay completions for your character in the [b]Storyline > Replay Rewards[/b] section of ​​the Storyline Generation Info window.[list][*]Regardless of the selected story, the total number of replays completed by your character is displayed in this section.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]New Title Details[/b]
[list][*]After completing a total of 100 replays, you will be awarded the 1st title, [b]Master Storyline Binger[/b].
[list][*]Will +30[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]New Journal Achievement Details[/b]
[list][*]After completing a certain amount of cumulative replays, you can acquire a total of 3 journal achievements.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Journal Name[/b][/th][th][b]Achievement Requirement[/b][/th][th][b]Journal Score[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
Complete Replay 10x!
[/td][td]
Complete Storyline Replay 10 times.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1187/journal_1.png[/img]

[/td][td]
5
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Complete Replay 100x!
[/td][td]
Complete Storyline Replay 100 times.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1188/journal_2.png[/img]

[/td][td]
10
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Complete Replay 1000x!
[/td][td]
Complete Storyline Replay 1000 times.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1189/journal_3.png[/img]

[/td][td]
15
[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b][b]C1 Replay Reward Box[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]When you complete a Generation Replay, you will receive a [b]C1 Replay Reward Box[/b].[/*][*]Opening the box will reward one item from the following droplist, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.[list][*]The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]C1 Replay Reward Box Droplist[/b]
[list][*][b]*NEW* Instant Replay Completion Ticket[/b][list][*]Use this ticket to instantly complete a Generation Replay and receive the C1 Replay Reward Box.[/*][*]Using the item to replay does not count towards Title and Journal completion counts.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Jukebox Coupon (7 Days)[/b][list][*][b]Use this coupon to extend the usage period for the Jukebox in the Homestead.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Jukebox Coupon (30 Days)[/b][list][*][b]Use this coupon to extend the usage period for the Jukebox in the Homestead.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Goddess's Grace[/b][list][*]Use this item to enhance the stats of the Goddess Statue in the Homestead for 7 days. [/*][*]Defense +5[/*][*]Magic Defense +5[/*][*]Protection +5[/*][*]Magic Protection +5[/*][*]Combat EXP +10%[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1185/hs_set_1.png[/img]
[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Sidhe Sneachta Snowman[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Tir Na Nog Town Square Tree[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Tir Chonaill Town Square Tree[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Strange Tir Chonaill Magic School Tree[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Blue Dunbarton Magic School Tree[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Red Dunbarton Magic School Tree[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1186/hs_set_2.png[/img]
[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Emain Macha Street Light[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Emain Macha Fence[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Emain Macha Fountain[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Emain Macha Garden Turf Block[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Bangor Tree[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Bangor Torch[/*][/list]

[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Tir Chonaill Healer's House Desk and Chair[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Tir Chonaill Healer's Bed[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Tir Chonaill Healer's Vanity[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Tir Chonaill Chief's House Vase[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Tir Chonaill Inn Vase[/*][/list]

[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Dunbarton School Table and Chair[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Dunbarton School Blackboard[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Dunbarton School Horse Statue[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1184/hs_housing_set_4.png[/img]
[list][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Dunbarton Clothing Shop Mirror[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Dunbarton Clothing Shop Closet[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Emain Macha Flower Pot[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Housing Emain Macha Restaurant Table[/*][/list][h2][b][b]Homestead Jukebox[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1180/homestead_jukebox.png[/img]
[list][*]The [b]Jukebox[/b] is now available in the Homestead. [/*][*]You can set your preferred BGM such as world, storyline, and dungeon music as the background music for the Homestead.[/*][*]Installing a Jukebox can be done through the menu [b]Construction List > Product > Jukebox[/b] using [b]50 Homestead Stones[/b].[/*][*][b]The installed Jukebox can be used after extending the usage by using a Jukebox Coupon.[/b][list][*][b]Jukebox Coupon (7 Days)[/b] and [b]Jukebox Coupon (30 Days)[/b] can be obtained from the C1 Replay Reward Box.[/*][*]The Jukebox usage period can be extended when the current usage period is below 30 Days.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]A [b]Title[/b] BGM song, [b]An Old Tale from Grandma (ver. 10th)[/b], will be unlocked automatically.[/b][/*][*][b]Select your preferred song, then click “[b]Apply[/b]” to apply it to the[/b] Homestead.[list][*]The currently playing song will appear in the Homestead Menu. [/*][/list][/*][*]Each time you use the C1 Replay Reward Box, one additional BGM song will be unlocked.[/*][/list][h2][b][b]Goddess Statue[/b][/b][/h2]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1179/goddess_statue.png[/img]
[list][*]The [b]Goddess Statue[/b] is now available in the Homestead. [/*][*][b]Installing a Goddess Statue can be done through the menu Construction List > Product > Jukebox using 50 Homestead Stones.[/b][/*][*][b]When placed in the Homestead, the following stats are received:[/b][list][*]Defense +1[/*][*]Magic Defense +1[/*][*]Protection +1[/*][*]Magic Protection +1[/*][*]Combat EXP +1%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Using the [b]Goddess’s Grace[/b] item strengthens the stats of the Goddess Statue for [b]7 days[/b].[/b][list][*][b]Goddess’s Grace[/b] can be obtained from the C1 Replay Reward Box.[/*][*]Defense +5[/*][*]Magic Defense +5[/*][*]Protection +5[/*][*]Magic Protection +5[/*][*]Combat EXP +10%[/*][/list][/*][/list][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Moonlight Dreams Season 2
notes.content:
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1070/221006-mbw-2846-moonlightdreamss2-940x290.jpg[/img][/b]

Kristell and her apprentice, Maydi, need your help! A strange energy is spreading throughout the land and they need you to investigate. Check out all the details here!

[b]Part 1:[/b] Thursday, October 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd, Before Maintenance
[b]Part 2:[/b] Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd, Before Maintenance[b][b]
[/b][/b]
[h2][b][b]Event Details[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Kristell’s Calling[/b].[/*][*]Find [b]Kristell[/b] at the [b]Dunbarton Church[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Kristell.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Kristell's Calling:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Moonlit Eweca and Ladeca Amulet x1[/b][/*][*][b]Onyx x1[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]As a main character, you will be eligible to investigate the strange energy through a series of quests and obtain rewards along the way![/*][*]All event quests and event items will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2][b][b]Part 1 - Investigate the Strange Energy[/b][/b][/h2]
[b]Part 1: Thursday, October 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]There are several story quests that you can complete during the event period.[list][*][Event] Spread of the Strange[/*][*][Event] Source of the Strange[/*][*][Event] Tracking the Moonlight[/*][/list][/*][*]Each story quest will reward the following items once completed:[list][*]70,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x15[/b][/*][*][b]Onyx x5[/b][/*][*][b]Fine Onyx x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional State Stone (Regular) x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Part 2 - Exploring the Wardrobe[/b][/b][/h2]
[b]Part 2: Thursday, October 20th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 3rd, Before Maintenance[/b]
[h2][b][b]Event Details[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]There are several story quests that you can complete during the event period.[list][*][Event] Truth in the Moonlight[/*][*][Event] Turning Back the Clock[/*][*][Event] The End, And…[list][*]You will receive a 1st Title depending on your dialogue choices during the quest. [/*][*][b]Note: If you’ve received a 1st Title from the 2019 event before, the title will be replaced with the title received from the 2022 event.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Each story quest will reward the following items once completed:[list][*]70,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x15[/b][/*][*][b]Onyx x5[/b][/*][*][b]Fine Onyx x1[/b][/*][*][b]Additional State Stone (Regular) x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Daily Quest Details[/b][/b][/h2]
[b]Kristell’s Request [/b]
[list][*]To unlock the daily quest, you will need to complete the Part 1 Story quest, [b][Event] Tracking the Moonlight[/b][/*][*]Each day, you will receive the Daily Quest,[b] [Event] Kristell’s Request (Daily)[/b] [/*][*]Use the [b]Yellow Event Wings (Strange Wardobe)[/b] to go to the event area quickly.[/*][*]Complete [b]Pino’s Missions[/b] in the Moonlight Room to receive the quest items required complete the quest. [list][*]You will also receive [b]1 Onyx[/b] or [b]1 Fine Onyx[/b] when completing the mission.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the daily quest:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Moonlit Eweca & Ladeca Amulet x1[/b][/*][*][b]Sluether Token x1[/b][list][*]Sleuther Tokens can be exchanged with Maydi for [b]1 Onyx per Token[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Onyx x5[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list]
[b]Maydi’s Commissions
[/b]
[list][*]After registering a main character, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Stopping the Strange[/b][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x1[/b][/*][*]Access to Maydi’s Commissions.[/*][/list][/*][*]Maydi will send out a commission by owl to you! [/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour to receive the [b]Maydi’s Commission[/b] item in your inventory.[/*][*]Use [b]Maydi’s Commission[/b] to choose a commission to complete.[list][*]Mad Taitinn Carp can be fished from the Emain Macha Fishing area.[/*][*]Gather Milk from a Mad Cow[/*][*]Gather Wool from a Mad Sheep[/*][*]Clear Today Mission Once (Daily Shadow Mission)[/*][*]Go Fishing for Mad Taitinn Carp [list][*]Mad Taitinn Carp can be fished from the Emain Macha Fishing area.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can only receive one commission at a time.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing a commission quest:[list][*]15,000 EXP[/*][*]5,000 Gold[/*][*]Divine Holy Water x1 [list][*]Divine Holy Water can be given to [b]cursed Juju Dolls around Uladh[/b].[/*][*]Tir Chonaill Juju Doll: [b]Onyx Box x1[/b][/*][*]Dunbarton Juju Doll: [b]Purified Ore x1[/b] (Gain 4,000 Exploration EXP when sold to NPC)[/*][*]Emain Macha Juju Doll (Available during Part 2):[b] Golden Experience Fruit (40%) x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Worldly Courage (Available in Part 2)[/b]
[list][*]To unlock the daily quest, you will need to complete the Part 2 Story quest, [b][Event] The End, And…[/b][/*][*]Each day, you will receive the Daily Quest, [b][Event] Worldly Courage (Daily)[/b] [/*][*]Complete [b]Chio’s Missions[/b] in the Moonlight Room to receive the quest items required complete the quest. [list][*]You will also receive [b]1 Onyx[/b] or [b]1 Fine Onyx[/b] when completing the mission.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the daily quest:[list][*]50,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Fine Onyx x1[/b][/*][*][b]Problem Solver Token x1[/b][list][*]Problem Solver Tokens can be exchanged with Maydi for [b]1 Onyx per Token[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Onyx x5[/b][/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]You can get bonus rewards for every 3, 8, and 10 times you clear the [b][Event] Worldly Courage[/b] quest.[list][*]Talk to Brielle in the Moonlight Room to check the quest completion count.[/*][*]Complete the quest [b]3 times[/b]: Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) x1[/*][*]Complete the quest [b]7 times[/b]: Divine Holy Water x15[/*][*]Complete the quest [b]10 times[/b]: Receive the [b][Event] Maydi’s Thanks[/b] quest.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b][b]Achievement Quest Details[/b][/b][/h2]
[b][Event] The Moonlight Truth Seeker[/b]
[list][*]To unlock the achievement quest, you will need to complete the Part 1 Story quest, [b][Event] Spread of the Strange[/b][/*][*]Complete the quest objectives by completing the Part 1 and Part 2 Daily Quests.[list][*][b](Part 1)[/b] Collect 3 Sleuther Tokens by completing the [Event] Kristell’s Request (Daily) quest [b]3 times or more[/b].[/*][*][b](Part 2)[/b] Collect 3 Problem Solver Tokens by completing the [Event] Worldly Courage (Daily) quest [b]7 times or more[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the achievement quest:[list][*]100,000 EXP[/*][*]20,000 Gold[/*][*][b]Moonlight Coin x40[/b][/*][*][b]Halloween Brielle’s Bed[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Moon and the Sundrop 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Max Damage +15[/*][*]Magic Attack +20[/*][*]Critical +10%[/*][*]Defense +10[/*][*]Protection +10[/*][*]Magic Defense +10[/*][*]Magic Protection +10[/*][*]Music Buff Effect +4[/*][*]The stat bonuses granted by this title lasts for 21 days after the coupon has been used, but you can continue to use the title after that without the stats.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1092/moon-and-the-sundrop-2nd-title.png[/img]

[b][Event] Maydi’s Thanks[/b]
[list][*]To unlock the quest, complete the [b][Event] Worldly Courage (Daily)[/b] quest [b]10 times[/b] to receive the [b][Event] Maydi’s Thanks[/b] quest.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest:[/*][list][*]30,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Divine Holy Water x10[/b][/*][*][b]Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) x1[/b][/*][*][b]Halloween Eccentric Workshop Bench[/b][/*][/list][/list][h2][b][b]Halloweekend Hot Days[/b][/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, every weekend, Hotday rewards will be available![/*][*]Only the main character can participate in the hotday.[/*][*]You will receive a reward by logging in each day during the event period.[/*][*]Claim the item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your character or choose Claim Later if you want to receive it later.[/*][*]You can only claim the item once during the event period.[/*][*]The reward can be claimed any time on the day from [b]12:00 AM PDT ~ 11:59 PM PDT[/b].[/*][/list][table][tr][th]

Check out this month's Patch Notes below!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75868/study-event-season-2][/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75868/study-event-season-2]Study Event Season 2[/url]: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 29th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76107/irusan-s-check-in-attendance-season-2]Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2[/url]: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76202/absolute-box]Absolute Box[/url]: Thursday, September 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 6th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76680/young-miss-and-master-box]Young Miss and Master Box[/url]: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76634/balloon-festival-returns]Balloon Festival Returns[/url]: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76725/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76722/field-raid-improvements]Field Raid Improvements[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Field Raid Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Several changes have been added to the Field Raid system. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76722/field-raid-improvements]Field Raid Improvements[/url][/*][list][*]Changes to the Field Raid schedules have been made.[/*][*]Field Raid Announcements have been improved with more detailed information.[/*][*]Contribution quests have been renewed.[/*][*]Earn Field Raid Mementos when defeating Field Raid monsters and exchange them for materials.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/list]
[b]September Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76725/september-quality-of-life-updates]September Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]Improvements to Enchanting and Special Upgrades have been added: [/*][*]Improvements have been made to the Inventory Search function with a new Inventory list menu and new item tags. [/*][*]UI Improvements have been added for Synthesis, Fragmentation, Metal Conversion, and Mana Crystallization[/*][*]The flashy effects for skill rank-up, Critical Hits, Meteor Strike, etc. have been reduced.[/*][*]You can now sell Fynni Pet Whistles all at once to Fionnait.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]As announced, prior to the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76482/upcoming-nx-prepaid-and-nx-credit-merge]upcoming NX Merge[/url], changes to the Trade Restriction Protection system have been made.[list][*]For security reasons, there are restrictions on how NX can be spent. When NX is purchased for the first time on an account and when certain other criteria are met, the Trade Restriction Protection begins and a 4-day restriction timer is started on the account. The account will be restricted from certain trade-related actions in-game. Players will be notified in-game when attempting the restricted trade actions.[/*][/list][/*][*]The criteria in place that requires a certain Cumulative Level limit to purchase certain Cash items in the Mabinogi Item Shop have been removed.[/*][*]Information regarding Enchant Burning has been added to the Enchant and Campfire Skill Descriptions and several related menus. [/*][*]With the August update, there were several issues with Campfire Spirit contents. Since these changes were not stable, the following changes have been removed:[list][*]Gifts from some NPCs had been changed.[/*][*]You could invite some NPCs that hadn't officially been added.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a typo in the mini-map for Errans Gorge name.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with not being able to end the dialogue with the Fashion Contest Helper.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Cherry Delight 2nd title appeared untranslated.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the listed items for Finishing Materials for Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]Fixed an issue in south Pantay Swamp mini-map where Lutra River appeared untranslated.[/*][*]Fixed an issue in La Terra Highland mini-map with the Mana Tunnel appearing untranslated.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known issues:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]Found an issue with the Fahmes Ruin ranking rewards distribution and further investigation is in progress. If you are affected by this issue, please submit a [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us]Player Support Ticket[/url].[/*][*]There are unnecessary line breaks within the Field Raid Messenger's dialogue.[/*][*]There are a few text discrepancies when a Field Raid boss monster attempts to recover or recovers from Pragarah and Brionac attacks.[/*][*]Several names of Enchant Scrolls that Stewart requests to exchange for Restoration Powder are incorrect.[list][*]Sheep Raising is Sheperd's, Excavator is Digger, Gusty is Windy, Boar is Wild Boar, and Earthling is Earthen[/*][/list][/*][*]Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [Updated] Field Raid Improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2035/220919-mbw-2843-fieldraidrevamp-940x290.jpg[/img]

Field Raid Improvements are here! New Raid schedules, improved announcements, and Field Raid Mementos can be collected to exchange for guaranteed rewards.
[h2][b]Field Raid Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Field Raid Boss monsters only appear on designated channels: [b]Channel 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10.[/b][/*][list][*]White Dragon and Black Dragon Summon Scrolls can be used regardless of channel.[/*][/list][*]The Field Raid announcements have been improved with more detailed information.[/*][list][*]The Quest zone will open and announcements will take place 3 minutes before the start of a Raid. [/*][*]The announcement will include the channel, time, and region for the Raid. [/*][*]Announcements will appear in all channels.[/*][*]A dedicated “Field Raid” tab has been added to the chat window.[/*][*]Scrolling announcements appearing at the top of the screen can be turned off in Options > Game > ETC. > View Field Raid Announcements[/*][list][*]Even when the announcements are turned off, you can check the announcements in the Field Raid tab of the chat window.[/*][/list][*]Announcements do not appear for Raids started through a summon scroll.[/*][/list][*]The Field Raid [b]Messenger[/b] will always be available in the following towns: Tir Chonaill, Dunbarton, Tara, Filia, and Vales.[/*][list][*]You must have completed G3 in order to see the Messenger.[/*][*]Talk to the Messenger for more information about the Field Raids.[/*][*]When a Field Raid monster spawns, you can talk to the Messenger with [b]Move to Field Raid[/b] to select an ongoing Raid and move to the location.[/*][/list][*]The improved Raid Schedule can be found in the Traveler’s Guide > Raid menu, including Raid information for Sylvan Dragon and Mokkurkalfi. [/*][*]It has been changed so that Field Raid monsters appear at a fixed time, not randomly during a specific time range. The Field Raid will start at certain times on certain days.[/*][list][*]Appears on the hour (White Dragon, Black Dragon)[/*][*]Appears at 15 minutes of the hour (Red Dragon, Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon)[/*][*]Appears at 30 minutes of the hour (Mokkurkalfi, Sylvan Dragon)[/*][*]Appears at 35 minutes of the hour (Ifrit, Mammoth, Yeti)[/*][*]Appears at 45 minutes of the hour (Giant Lion, Giant Alligator, Giant Sandworm)[/*][/list][*]Raids do not spawn from 2:15 AM PDT to 10:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Contribution and Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Contribution[/b] is a score that shows how much you contributed during a Field Raid.[/*][*]Contribution can be earned by attacking the Raid monster, summoned enemies during the Raid, healing or resurrecting other Milletians, or other methods depending on the Field Raid Quest.[/*][*]The Field Raid quest zone is activated 3 minutes before the Field Raid monster appears.[/*][*]Contribution cannot be acquired before the monster appears.[/*][*][b]Field Raid Quests[/b] are automatically received when entering the Field Raid quest zone. [/*][list][*]For the Sylvan Dragon Raid, the quests are received after selecting a role.[/*][/list][*]Some existing quests and Contribution methods have been revised.[/*][list][*]You will now receive a Hunter’s Role or Vanguard’s Role quest related to the Field Raid monster. [/*][*]The requirement to use Smash and Magnum Shot skills has been removed.[/*][*]The amount of Contribution that can be obtained by attacking the Raid monster has been increased.[/*][*]The contribution value that is reduced due to death has been increased.[/*][/list][*]You can check how you can obtain Contribution from the quest in the ‘Field’ tab of the Quest window.[/*][*]In some Field Raids, your Contribution may decrease upon death: Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon, Red Dragon, White Dragon, Black Dragon, Sylvan Dragon, Mokkurkalfi[/*][*]The amount of gold you can receive from a successful Raid increases according to the Contribution obtained, up to a maximum of 50,000 gold.[/*][*]There is a minimum Contribution required in order to obtain the main rewards from a successful Field Raid. The minimum contribution of some Field Raids has changed.[/*][list][*]Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon, Red Dragon, White Dragon, and Black Dragon: 5000 Contribution[/*][*]Mokkurkalfi and Sylvan Dragon: 1500 Contribution[/*][/list][*]The more Contribution you earn, the more likely you will obtain the main rewards. [/*][list][*]Contribution for the maximum main rewards probability has been increased. [/*][/list][*]If your Contribution is below a certain level, you will not be able to obtain major rewards, including new Field Raid Mementos.[/*][*][b]Field Raid Mementos[/b] can now be earned by defeating Field Raid monsters.[/*][*]The amount of Field Raid Mementos earned is based on the defeated Field Raid and your Contribution.[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Field Raid Boss Monster[/th][th]Quantity of Mementos Obtained by Contribution Level[/th][/tr][tr][th]~4,999 Contribution[/th][th]5,000~49,999 Contribution[/th][th]50,000~ Contribution[/th][/tr][tr][td]Giant Lion, Giant Alligator, Giant Sandworm[/td][td]none[/td][td]2 to 99 [/td][td]100~[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ifrit, Yeti, Mammoth[/td][td]none[/td][td]               1 to 30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Prairie Dragon, Red Dragon, Desert Dragon[/td][td]none[/td][td]5 to 199[/td][td]200~[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Dragon, Black Dragon[/td][td]none[/td][td]10 to 249 [/td][td]250~[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sylvan Dragon, Mokkurkalfi[/td][td]none[/td][td]6 to 299[/td][td]300~[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Field Raid Mementos can be exchanged through the Field Raid Messenger for rewards.[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Type[/th][th]Item[/th][th]Cost
(Field Raid Memento)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Iria[/td][td]Dragon Claw[/td][td]300[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Bone Fragment[/td][td]300[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Flesh[/td][td]1,500[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Scale Fragment[/td][td]45,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Dragon Blood[/td][td]3,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Black Dragon Blood[/td][td]3,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Dragon Eye[/td][td]50,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Black Dragon Eye[/td][td]50,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Dragon Heart[/td][td]60,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Black Dragon Heart[/td][td]60,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Avalon[/td][td]Divine Mineral Fragment[/td][td]100[/td][/tr][tr][td]Amplification Catalyst[/td][td]1,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fine Amplification Catalyst[/td][td]1,500[/td][/tr][tr][td]Finest Amplification Catalyst[/td][td]2,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ancient Monster Core[/td][td]4,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Desecrated Charm Chunk[/td][td]5,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mokkurkalfi Death Mask[/td][td]200[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mokkurkalfi Venom[/td][td]200[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sylvan Dragon Eye[/td][td]200[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sylvan Dragon Scale[/td][td]200[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ancient Golden Crystal[/td][td]10,000[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]Field Raid Monster Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The survivability of Field Raid monsters has been improved.[/*][list][*]The monster's Health, Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection have been increased.[/*][*]The stats reduction by the Brionac and Technique: Pragarah effects have been limited.[/*][*]After a certain period of time, the stats reduced by Brionac and Technique: Pragarah are restored.[/*][*]The effects of Lullaby, Sand Burst and Wind Blast cannot be applied to Field Raid monsters. [/*][*]After the Act 2: Threshold Cutter skill is used, it cannot be used again for a certain period of time.[/*][*]Field Raid monsters that can be downed have been changed so that they can no longer be knocked down.[/*][/list][*]Black Dragon, Giant Alligator, and Giant Sandworm have been changed to be more aggressive.[/*][*]Field Raid monsters' normal monster summoning method has been changed.[/*][list][*]The first 15 monsters are summoned, and 7 additional monsters are summoned every minute if less than 15 normal monsters are currently summoned.[/*][*]The Snowfield Slayer summoned by the White Dragon does not follow the rules above.[/*][/list][*]All Field Raid Monsters now have several effects that can occur during the Field Raid.[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Effect[/th][th]Characteristic[/th][/tr][tr][td]Focus Buff[/td][td][list][*]The Field Raid monster's health and injuries are restored, and skill damage is increased.[/*][*]As the number of players participating in the Field Raid and the duration of the Raid increases, the recovery power of the Field Raid monster decreases.[/*][*]As the number of players participating in the Field Raid increases, the skill damage increase rate of the Field Raid monster decreases.[/*][*]Characters are excluded if inactive, using Hide, Crisis Escape, Flight, or Playing Dead.[/*][*]Used by all Field Raid monsters[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Shockwave[/td][td][list][*]Deals damage and knocks back player targets at close range of the Field Raid monster, and reduces their movement speed for a short time.[/*][*]Used by all Field Raid monsters except Giant Lion and Giant Alligator[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Life Ender[/td][td][list][*]Summons an area where you will die immediately if you are within the range of the effect. [/*][*]It can appear a certain distance away from the Field Raid monster, where player targets are located.[/*][*]Used by all Field Raid monsters except Giant Alligator[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Dissolving Moonlight[/td][td][list][*]If you do not block the action of the Dragon within a set time, it will inflict heavy damage to the surrounding area.[/*][*]Used by Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon, Red Dragon, White Dragon, and Black Dragon[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Impending Death[/td][td][list][*]When the Field Raid monster's HP decreases by more than a certain amount, Impending Death is applied to a random player target.[/*][*]When Impending Death is applied, the target's HP continues to decrease after a certain period of time.[/*][*]If the target dies, Impending Death is applied to two additional random targets.[/*][*]While the effect is applied, you cannot receive the Glyphwright effect that restores life, and you cannot use recovery items.[/*][*]Used by Giant Alligator, White Dragon, Black Dragon, Mokkurkalfi, and Sylvan Dragon[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Vast Might[/td][td][list][*]The Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection per summoned normal monster within range of the boss is increased according to the number of summoned monsters.[/*][*]Used by White Dragon, Black Dragon, Mokkurkalfi, and Sylvan Dragon[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.gg/mabinogi][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: [Updated] Balloon Festival Returns
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2029/220916_balloonfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Zeno is back! That means it's time to party, so let's get some balloons! Check out all the details below.

[b]Known Issue:[/b] After the 9/29 maintenance, there is an issue where the amount of balloons delivered to Zeno has not been reset from Week 1 to Week 2. Additionally, there is an issue where claiming the Balloon Festival Gift Box distributes Stage 1 rewards instead of Stage 4 rewards. These issues are under further investigation and additional updates will be provided. We apologize for the inconvenience. 
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 27th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] You’re invited to the Balloon Festival.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Zeno[/b] in the Dunbarton Town Square.[/*][*]Register a main character with Zeno.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following event items after completing [b][Guide] You’re invited to the Balloon Festival[/b][/*][list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]Balloon Festival Guide[/b][/*][list][*]Using the guide will show you the details on the Balloon Festival event progression[/*][/list][*][b]Blow Balloon Action[/b][/*][list][*]Use this to inflate the Deflated Balloons into Full Balloons[/*][/list][*][b]Deflated Balloon x1[/b][/*][/list][*]As a main character, you can receive [b]event rewards[/b] through the following methods:[/*][list][*]Log in once per day.[/*][list][*]Monday - Friday: [b]Deflated Balloon x1[/b][/*][*]Saturday - Sunday: [b]Deflated Balloon x3[/b][/*][/list][*]Stay logged in for 36 minutes. (Once per day)[/*][list][*]You will receive the following items:[/*][list][*][b]Deflated Balloon x1[/b][/*][*][b]Fighting Inflation 2nd Title Fragment[/b][/*][list][*]Collect 15 fragments and bundle them together to receive the *[b]NEW* Fighting Inflation 2nd Title (Luck +30).[/b][/*][*][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1991/balloon-pop.gif[/img][/b][/*][/list][*][b]Balloon Festival Attendance Box x1[/b][/*][/list][/list][*]Finish the daily quests, [b][Event] Look for a Deflated Balloon (1)[/b] and [b][Event] Look for a Deflated Balloon (2)[/b][/*][list][*]Both quests require you to complete the daily Shadow Mission.[/*][*]Each quest will reward [b]Deflated Balloons x2.[/b][/*][*]The daily VIP Shadow Mission does not count.[/*][/list][*]From the reward box from completing Shadow Missions.[/*][list][*]You can obtain a maximum of [b]7 Deflated Balloons per day.[/b][/*][/list][/list][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][*]All event quests and event items will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2][b]Balloon Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Inflate the Deflated Balloon with the [b]Blow Balloon Action[/b], then deliver them to Zeno.[/*][*]Each Full Balloon you deliver will reward you with [b]Balloon Festival Coin x1.[/b][/*][*]You can deliver up to [b]15 Full Balloons per day.[/b][/*][*]The delivery time resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][*]You will also receive more [b]Balloon Festival Coins[/b] depending on how many Full Balloons you deliver [b]within each week[/b]. [/*][list][*]You can claim these rewards after the Balloon reset period by talking to Zeno.[/*][/list][/list][table][tr][th]Amount of Balloons Submitted[/th][th]Rewards[/th][/tr][tr][td] 0 - 29 Balloons[/td][td]5 Balloon Festival Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td] 30 - 69 Balloons[/td][td]10 Balloon Festival Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td] 70 Balloons[/td][td]20 Balloon Festival Coins[/td][/tr][/table][list][*][b]Work together with your fellow Milletians to turn in as many Full Balloons as possible within the collect period to receive better rewards![/b][list][*][b]Known Issue: [/b]When using the [b]Balloon Festival Guide[/b], the UI information stating how many more Full Balloons need to be delivered is incorrect. The goals below are the correct amount of Balloons required for each Stage reward:[list][*][b]Balloon Stage 1:[/b] 0 ~ less than 3,000 Full Balloons[/*][*][b]Balloon Stage 2:[/b] 3,000 ~ less than 15,000 Full Balloons[/*][*][b]Balloon Stage 3:[/b] 15,000 ~ less than 25,000 Full Balloons[/*][*][b]Balloon Stage 4:[/b] 25,000 Full Balloons or more[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Balloons are counted for the server each week.[/*][*]The collection period ends when the reset period is reached for the week. [/*][*]When the reset is complete, talk to Zeno to claim your Balloon Festival Gift Box determined by the stage the server achieved during the collection period.[list][*][b]You must deliver at least 1 Full Balloon during the week to be eligible for this reward.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]If Balloon Stage 4 is reached within the time period, then the balloons will float away during the reset period![/*][*]You cannot deliver Full Balloons to Zeno during the reset period.[/*][/list][table][tr][th]Week[/th][th]Collection Period (PDT)[/th][th]Reset Period (PDT)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Week 1 [/td][td] After maintenance, September 22nd - September 29th, 6:59 AM[/td][td]September 29th, 7:00 AM - 7:04 AM[/td][/tr][tr][td]Week 2 [/td][td] September 29th 7:05 AM - October 6th, 6:59 AM[/td][td]October 6th, 7:00 AM - 7:04 AM[/td][/tr][tr][td]Week 3 [/td][td] October 6th, 7:05 AM - October 13th, 6:59 AM[/td][td]October 13th, 7:00 AM - 7:04 AM[/td][/tr][tr][td]Week 4[/td][td]October 13th, 7:05 AM - October 20th, 6:59 AM[/td][td]October 20th, 7:00 AM - 7:04 AM[/td][/tr][tr][td]

notes.title: September Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2020/220916_septemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/b][/h2][h2][b]September Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2][h2][b]Enchant & Special Upgrade Experience Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*]The [Suffix] and [Prefix] tag has been added to the item description of an enchanted item.[/*][*][b]The result of failing an Enchant or Special Upgrade has been changed.[/b] [/*][list][*]If an enchantment of rank 6 or higher fails, the item status is changed to the [b](Unable to enchant)[/b] state instead of being destroyed.[/*][*]If the special upgrade of level 6 or higher fails without using a Protective Upgrade Stone, the item will be changed to the [b](Unable to Special Upgrade)[/b] status instead of being destroyed. [/*][*]The status of the item is displayed with a red background, and in the item’s name and item description.[/*][/list][*]The following search filters have been added to the Auction House’s Advanced search settings to filter items by the Enchant or Special Upgrade status.[/*][list][*][b]Enchant Enabled[/b] - Available or Unavailable option[/*][*][b]Special Upgrade[/b] - Available or Unavailable option[/*][/list][*]The function of the Enchant Protection Potion has been changed to protect items from receiving the [b](Unable to enchant)[/b] status if the enchantment fails, instead of protecting the item from item destruction.[/*][list][*]You will be unable to use an Enchant Protection Potion on an item that already has this status applied to it. The status must be removed through NPC Stewart.[/*][/list][*]The function of Protective Upgrade Stones have been changed to protect items from receiving the [b](Unable to Special Upgrade)[/b] status, instead of protecting the item from item destruction.[/*][*][b]Enchant Recovery Essence, Special Upgrade Recovery Essence, Restoration Scroll and Restoration Powder [/b][b]items[/b] have been added.[/*][list][*]The Enchant Recovery Essence and Special Upgrade Recovery Essence can be crafted using Handicraft Rank 5 or higher.[/*][/list][/list][table][tr][th]Crafting Materials[/th][/tr][tr][th]Enchant Recovery Essence[/th][th]Special Upgrade Recovery Essence[/th][/tr][tr][td]-Magic Powder (10)
-Ancient Magic Crystal (40)
-Purified Enhancer (100)
-Gold-Leaf Pine Cone (1000)
-Dragon Flesh (40)
-Mystic Pearl (10)
-Teardrop Gem (50)
-Restoration Scroll (10)
-Restoration Powder (100)
-Restorative Powder (50)[/td][td]-Eweca Red Upgrade Stone (10)
-Ladeca Blue Upgrade Stone (10)
-Purified Enhancer (100)
-Gold-Leaf Pine Cone (1000)
-Dragon Flesh (40)
-Mystic Pearl (10)
-Teardrop Gem (50)
-Restoration Scroll (10)
-Restoration Powder (100)

Using the Enchant Recovery Essence will remove the (Unable to Enchant) status from the item. [/*][*]Talk to Stewart using the [b]Exchange Enchant[/b] option to convert specific Enchant Scrolls into [b]Restoration Powder[/b].[list][*]The Enchant Scroll that can be exchanged for each day of the week is changed every Odd/Even month.[/*][*]Each Enchant Scroll can be exchanged for one Restoration Powder.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2039/09222022-patch-notes-table.png[/img][list][*][b]Edern[/b]:[/*][list][*]Talk to NPC Edern using the [b]Nearby Rumors[/b] keyword to unlock the [b]Remove Special Upgrade Unavailability[/b] option.[/*][*]Talk to Edern using the [b]Remove Special Upgrade Unavailability[/b] option with [b]Special Upgrade Recovery Essence[/b] to select an item to use it on. notes.title: Upcoming NX Prepaid and NX Credit Merge
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

In early October, we will be making a major change to how NX, the paid currency for many Nexon games including Mabinogi, is handled. With this change, [b]NX Prepaid and NX Credit will be merged[/b], with every Nexon player's balance of the two currencies being combined together. We hope to make for a simpler process for our customers, no longer having to sort out between the two forms of currency, and how each is acquired.

As part of this, within an upcoming Mabinogi update, there will be some changes to how certain Cash Shop purchases and actions function, in order to prevent fraudulent charges and protect the game economy. These changes include:
[list][*]Level Restriction on Cash Shop purchases will be removed from all items.[/*][*]Trade Restrictions will be changed to accomodate the combined NX currency.[/*][*]Note: First Charge restrictions that are in place for NX Credit will also be applied to the merged NX. If you have cleared those restrictions in the past, then that status will be carried over to the new merged NX.[/*][/list]
We will let you know more as the update approaches.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Irusan’s Check-in Attendance Season 2
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1245/220124_irusanattendanceevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Morrighan outfit set. And if you finish the attendance calendar before the end of the event, there is a bonus attendance calendar with more rewards! Check out the details below.

[h1][b]Event Details[/b][/h1]

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [b]Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] A Girl's Request.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]A Girl in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue.[/*][*]Register for the event with A Girl in Need.[/*][*]Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.[/*][*]Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. [/*][list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[/*][list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 9 days of log in.[/*][/list][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.[/*][/list][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.[/*][list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.[/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][*]You will only receive 1 stamp per day.[/*][*]Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).[/*][*]Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.[/*][list][*]The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from [b]Thursday, November 24th, After Maintenance - December 1st, Before Maintenance.[/b][/*][*]When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. [/*][/list][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1601/irusan_board.png[/img]

[h1][b]Attendance Pass Purchase[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for [b]29 Pon.[/b][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.[/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1264/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-purchase-ui.png[/img]

[h1][b]Bonus Attendance Check[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]When you complete all 3 calendars, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Champ of Stamps.[/b][/*][*]Talk to the Girl in Need to start the Bonus Attendance Check.[/*][*]When you start this Bonus Attendance Check, the calendar is replaced with a new calendar.[/*][*]There are a total of 27 attendance days with additional rewards.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out this month's Patch Notes below!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75018/2022-summer-master-plan]2022 Summer Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75155/glass-trim-box]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75465/connous-beach-vacation-2022]Connous Beach Vacation Event[/url]: Thursday, August 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75619/commerce-companions-doll-bag-box]Commerce Champions Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, August 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75706/regal-retreat-box]Regal Retreat Box[/url]: Thursday, August 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 8th, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75017/the-secrets-of-the-commerce-champion]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75612/my-own-portrait-attendance-event]My Own Portrait Attendance Event[/url]: Thursday, August 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75943/ox-quiz-event]OX Quiz[/url]: Thursday, August 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75953/fairytale-gardener-s-teapot]Fairytale Gardener's Teapot[/url]: Thursday, August 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 22nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76019/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/76019/august-quality-of-life-updates]August Quality of Life Updates[/url][list][*]Enchant Scrolls can now be traded once. (Applies to scrolls obtained after the August 25th update.)[/*][*]Bag Order Settings have been added, so you can control the order of where obtained items go into your inventory.[/*][*]New changes have been added to the Friends List.[/*][*]And more![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where players would encounter NGS errors more often.[/*][*]Fixed various typos and grammar errors in some Commerce related tooltips.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where players would abnormally receive the Memento Scenario event quest.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a character's neck would become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is untranslated text in the mini-map at La Terra Highland zone and south Pantay Swamp zone.[/*][*]There is a typo in the world map for Errans Gorge.[/*][/list]

notes.title: August Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h1][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1502/220819_augustupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]August Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Several graphical bugs affecting equipment have been fixed.[/*][*]When selecting a normal pet as a sub-pet during Fynn Sync, a confirmation window will now appear.[/*][*]If you attempt to rebirth shortly after being in combat, a notice window with the combat penalty will be displayed.[/*][*]The "Max Bundle Size" information has been added to the item description for items that can be stacked.[/*][*]The following NPC shops now sell the Trinity Staff item: Stewart, Castanea, Kirine, Heulfryn, Royal Physician (Tech Duinn Entrance), Berched, Finola, Lassar[/*][*]The following dungeon passes can now be obtained from the Partner's Gift Box, Partner Laighlinne's Gift Box, and Partner William's Gift Box. [/*][list][*]Barri Basic Fomor Pass[/*][*]Barri Intermediate Fomor Pass[/*][*]Fiodh Intermediate Fomor Pass[/*][*]Rabbie Basic Fomor Pass[/*][*]Rabbie Intermediate Fomor Pass[/*][*]Math Basic Fomor Pass[/*][*]Math Intermediate Fomor Pass[/*][*]Coill Basic Fomor Pass[/*][*]Coill Intermediate Fomor Pass[/*][/list][*]Items will now automatically bundle in the inventory when purchased from an NPC shop (Ctrl+Click) or when acquiring the following items:[/*][list][*]Pet Expedition rewards[/*][*]Adventurer Seal[/*][*]Festia VIP Pass[/*][*]Dan Advancement Badge[/*][*]Full Recovery Potion and Massive Holy Water of Lymilark when acquired from VIP Advanced Items[/*][*]Onyx and Fine Onyx (during Halloween Events)[/*][*]Note: This only applies to items without duration or trade count limits. [/*][/list][*]It has been changed so that the "Rebirth" option in the character lobby is available only for pets that have a corresponding pet character card.[/*][*]The "Get Same Animal Character" menu that appears when you right-click another pet character has been removed.[/*][*]When transferring Erg to a weapon that has been trade unlocked, it has been changed so that the trade unlock status is maintained.[/*][*]It has been changed so that when you obtain an Exclusive Enchant Scroll, it can now be traded one time. [/*][list][*]This includes enchantments received from monsters, treasure chests, or quest rewards. [/*][*]This change applies to items obtained after the August 25th update.[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scrolls obtained through Enchant Burning will not be eligible for the one-time trade count.[/*][*]Note: The Scroll Trade Unlock Potion cannot be used on Exclusive Enchant Scrolls that have remaining trade counts.[/*][/list][*]The "[b]Complete All[/b]" function has been added to both the Baltane Squire’s Special Unit Training Board and Pet Expedition Bulletin Board so you can complete all ongoing missions at once.[/*][*]The "[b]Exclude Song Part[/b]" checkbox has been added to Composing. [/*][list][*]When selected, the Song part is excluded, and the available characters are distributed evenly between the Melody, Harmony 1, and Harmony 2 parts so that you can compose longer Score Scrolls.[/*][/list][*]Several changes have been made to the Friends List and message function to be more convenient.[/*][list][*]It has been changed so that the friend request window does not disappear if the channel is changed while receiving a friend request.[/*][*]You can now send and receive messages to others that you do not have added on the Friends List.[/*][list][*]This can be disabled through the Friends List > Option > "Receive Messages from Friends Only" checkbox setting. [/*][*]Characters who have been blacklisted cannot send or receive messages from the party who blacklisted the character.[/*][/list][*]It has been improved so that the open chat window does not close when changing channels.[/*][*]A new option to disable closing the chat window with the ESC key has been added. [/*][list][*]This can be enabled through the Friends List > Option > "Disable ESC from Closing Chat Window" checkbox setting.[/*][/list][*]A new function to expand/collapse all groups in the Friends List has been added.[/*][list][*]All groups can be expanded or collapsed at once via the button added to the Friend Menu. Right click on the group, then select Expand All or Collapse All.[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1500/friends_group.png[/img][/b][/*][*]You can also expand or collapse all groups at once by double-clicking a group name while holding down the Ctrl key.[/*][/list][/list][*]The [b]Combat[/b] and [b]Horn[/b] message channels have been added, so it is now possible to separate system messages.[/*][list][*]You can set up these channels via the Options > Game > Chat > Combat and Horn settings.[/*][/list][*]The notice message when the dungeon is cleared has been simplified for all difficulties of Sidhe Finnachaid (Curiosity, Fear, and Sorrow).[/*][*]You can now skip the cutscene when entering Sidhe Finnachaid by choosing the "Enter (No Cutscene)" option through NPC Enn.[/*][*]The following items can now be registered to a slot in the hotbar.[/*][list][*]Full Recovery Potion[/*][*]Phoenix Feather[/*][*]Party Phoenix Feather[/*][*]Advanced Phoenix Feather[/*][/list][*]A change has been made so that the trees will no longer obscure the camera vision in the second area of the Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission.[/*][*]The visibility of the portal pattern on the floor in the Falias area in Alban Knights Training Grounds has been improved.[/*][*]It has been improved so that when the ALT key is pressed to view item name tags, the character name tags will not overlap and change the order of the name tags on the screen.[/*][*]The name tags of summoned doll bags will no longer be visible when the ALT key is pressed.[/*][*]Doll bags can now pick up items that dropped from monsters killed by the Baltane Squires in Baltane Missions.[/*][/list][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1499/bag_order_settings.png[/img][/b][list][*]A function has been added to allow you to set the order in which items are placed into inventory bags when acquiring new items.[/*][list][*]The "[b]Bag Order Settings[/b]" menu is available as a newly added button at the top of the main inventory.[/*][*]If you set the bag order, items will be placed in the order of the bag starting from number 1.[/*][*]If there are empty slots in the basic inventory (Normal, Me, VIP), items will go into the main inventory first, then the bag inventory.[/*][*]If the bag is tagged, the item is preferentially placed in the bag in which the tag is set.[/*][*]However, in the case of equipment items, even if there are bags that have tags set, they will go into the clothing bag first.[/*][/list][/list]

notes.title: OX Quiz Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1507/220819-mbw-2835-oxquiz-940x290.jpg[/img]

Locke is back, and this time he's hosting everyone's favorite quiz! The OX Quiz has returned, and there's plenty of rewards to grab this time around. Check out all the details below!

[h1][b]Event Details[/b][/h1]

[b]Event Dates: [/b][b]Thursday, August 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 8th, Before Maintenance[/b]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest, [b][Guide] The OX Quiz is Back![/b][/*][*]Talk to Locke located near the Vales Mana Tunnel to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following:[/*][list]
[*]10,000 EXP[/*][*]3,000 Gold[/*][*]Locke's OX Quiz Invitation[/*][list][*]Allows you to move near the OX Quiz location.[/*][*]The item is given to the main character every day, and can be purchased from Locke using Gold.[/*][/list][*]Unlock the daily quest, [b][Event] Daily OX Quiz[/b] and achievement quest, [b][Event] To Be an OX Quiz Master[/b][/*][/list][*]Anyone can participate in the OX Quiz even if they are not the main character, but only the registered main character can participate in the event quests.[/*][*]Note: OX Quiz Vouchers and Locke’s OX Quiz Invitation event items will be removed from the inventory during the 9/15 maintenance.[/*][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1436/ox_quiz.png[/img]
[h1]OX Quiz Details[/h1]
[list][*][b]The OX Quiz will take place every hour on the hour during the event period.[/b][/*][*]Visit the event location by using the Locke’s OX Quiz Invitation or use the Vales Mana Tunnel.[/*][*]You must be standing in the [b]O or X quiz squares[/b] on the hour to participate in the OX Quiz.[/*][*]The OX Quiz is a game of True (O) or False (X) and there are a total of 30 quiz questions each round.[/*][*]When the quiz starts, you have 10 seconds to choose your answer for the statement.[/*][*]Stand on the square of the answer you think is correct.[/*][*]If you answer incorrectly, you will be removed from the quiz area for the round. Try again next time![/*][*]For each correct answer, you will receive Combat EXP or Renown EXP:[/*][list][*]Combat EXP - 10,000 EXP[/*][*]Music Renown - 35 EXP[/*][*]Life Renown - 175 EXP[/*][/list][*]You can change your preferred experience reward as the main character by talking to Locke.[/*][*]If you are not a main character, you cannot change the reward, and you can only receive 1,000 combat experience for each correct answer.[/*][*]If you answer all 30 in a round correctly, you will receive an [b]OX Quiz Gift Box.[/b][/*][*][b]The main character is eligible to achieve 1st titles according to the results of the OX Quiz. [/b][/*][list][*]who was Foiled by a Cat (Luck +30)[/*][*]who was SO CLOSE  (Luck +30)[/*][*]the Quiz Pro (Luck +30)[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Daily Quest[/h1]
[list][*]The main character can receive the daily quest each day, [b][Event] Daily OX Quiz[/b] [/*][*]Daily quests reset at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b]. [/*][*]To complete the quest objective, participate in the OX quiz and answer 10 OX Quiz questions correctly.[/*][list][*]These do not have to be answered consecutively.[/*][/list][*]Once completed, you will receive:[/*][list][*]20,000 EXP[/*][*]5,000 Gold[/*][*][b]*NEW* Locke's Book (Totem) Selection Box[/b][/*][*][b]20 OX Quiz Vouchers[/b][/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Achievement Quest[/h1]
[list][*]The main character will receive the achievement quest, [b][Event] To Be an OX Quiz Master[/b][/*][*]To complete the quest objectives, clear the Daily OX Quiz quest several times.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive:[/*][list][*]1st Objective: Clear the Daily OX Quiz quest 3 times[/*][list][*]Reward: [b]Locke's Book (Totem) Selection Box x3[/b][/*][/list][*]2nd Objective: Clear the Daily OX Quiz quest 3 more times[/*][list][*]Reward: [b]*NEW* [/b][b]Encyclopedia Erinnica: Secrets and Mysteries (Bonus Damage Totem)[/b][/*][list][*]Totem stats range from 0.1 to 1%[/*][*]The totem can be exchanged with Locke for new totem stats.[/*][*]You can also sell the totem to an NPC for 1000% Exploration EXP.[/*][/list][/list][*]3rd Objective: Clear the Daily OX Quiz quest 3 more times[/*][list][*]Reward: [b]Encyclopedia Erinnica: Secrets and Mysteries (Bonus Damage Totem)[/b][/*][/list][*]4th Objective: Talk to Locke near the Vales Mana Tunnel[/*][list][*]Reward: [/*][*]100,000 EXP[/*][*]10,000 Gold[/*][*][b]100 OX Quiz Vouchers[/b][/*][/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Locke's Book (Totem) Selection Box[/h1]

[b] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1435/book_totems.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]You can select and receive one of the following books (totems) from the Selection Box:[/*][list][*]Finding Balance: A Life Primer (All-Stats Totem) [/*][list][*]Stats range from 1 to 25[/*][/list][*]Getting Hard the Mage’s Stone Way (Defense and Magic Defense Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 1 to 22[/*][/list][*]The Thrill of the Skill (Max MP Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 10 to 110[/*][/list][*]Chop Till You Drop: How to Gather 200 Million Firewood (Max Stamina Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 10 to 110[/*][/list][*]The Secret of Longevity: Outlasting Your Enemies (Max HP Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 10 to 110[/*][/list][*]Hitting Where it Hurts (Critical Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 1 to 22[/*][/list][*]Easy Workouts for Legendary Heroes (Max Damage Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 1 to 30[/*][/list][*]What a Wand-erful World (Magic Attack Totem)[/*][list][*]Stats range from 1 to 20[/*][/list][/list][*]Right-click “Activate” to receive the effects of the totem. [/*][*]You can also sell these totems to an NPC for 200% Exploration EXP. [/*][/list]

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2022 Year End Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png[/img]

Dear Milletians,

It is a pleasure to share more with you in my second Producer’s Letter. Thanks to your support, the Great Era of Commerce update has been completed throughout the Summer. The Mabinogi Team is now focusing on the updates for the second half of the year to bring various and exciting content to you in Autumn and Winter.

To provide you with useful rewards and items, we have prepared a new version of the Portrait Attendance event called the “[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75612/my-own-portrait-attendance-event]My Own Attendance” event[/url]. You can start the event anytime during the registration period to begin receiving daily rewards. As you may have noticed, this will reward the Mysterious Blue Bag (10x17 inventory slot bag) that we know you’ve been asking for! I hope this will give you a bit more space in your inventory~

I’d like to share more information about the upcoming contents that we expect within the rest of 2022. Here is a preview of what’s to come: 

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]

Many quality of life updates are being prepared to improve features and options in the game. Some of the notable changes are:
[list]
[*] Inventory Bag re-order function   
[*] Exclusive Enchant Scrolls can be traded once
[*] Full Recovery Potions and Phoenix Feathers can be added to the hotbar
[*] Reduced flashy effects for skill rank-up, Critical Hits, Meteor Strike, etc
[*] You can sell Fynni Pet Whistles all at once to Fionnait
[*] Item Enchanting and Special Upgrade Improvements
[*] Improved Inventory Search function, allowing a list view of the Inventory
[*] And more!
[/list]

[b]Field Raid Revamp[/b]

[list]
[*] Field Raid Bosses will be rebalanced to become stronger and more resilient.
[*] Participating in raids will become more convenient (announcement for all channels, fast travel, etc.)
[*] Rewards improvements
 - A voucher shop will be added for guaranteed prizes.
 - You will be more likely to get rewards if you have a higher contribution. 
[/list]

[b]Masterpiece C1[/b]

[list]
[*] The Chapter Info UI will be revamped.
[*] Replay feature for Chapter 1 Generations (G1, G2, and G3) will be added. 
[*] Graphic overhauls for major NPCs from C1. 
[*] Korean voiceover will be added for NPCs in C1.
[/list]
[b]Progression Improvements[/b]

To help Milletians adapt to Erinn life more easily and improve the beginner’s experience, we will bring multiple updates to Mabinogi.


[list]
[*] The level standard for “Beginner” characters will be increased to 10,000, and you will be able to receive various benefits based on revamped level standards.
[*] Blaanid’s Memoir will be revamped with better rewards. 
 - Significantly, a lesser version of the Divine Link skill, which could only be obtained through playing G19, will be available through the Memoir.
 - We will also add new rewards that will be useful to beginners, such as pets and doll bags.
[*] Skill training, Renown, Grandmaster, and leveling for Crusader skills will become a lot easier. 
 - The amount of skill training required will be reduced greatly, especially notable for the skills that required extremely huge amounts of training.
 - Skill training requirements centered around character and monster CP, which has been a hurdle for many Milletians, will be removed.
 - There will also be many other changes including increased Renown EXP, unlocking Crusader sub-skills at once, and more.
[/list]


[b]Arcana Update[/b]

[list]
[*] The Arcana Talent is a new talent that has the characteristics of two combined talents, and it will bring a new charm to your combat experience, different from the other talents.
[*] This Winter, we will introduce the Elemental Knight – a damage-dealing talent with Close Combat and Magic talents combined – and the Saint Bard – a supporting talent with Holy Arts and Music talents combined, which will both be added as new Arcana Talents.
[*] Of course, new skills and bonus stats for these talents will be added as well.
[*] We are also hoping to introduce more and more new Arcana Talents in the future.
[/list]

We will be reviewing and testing these contents and the plan could change, but I am excited to bring all of these listed contents to you soon! 

Sincerely,
[b]GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer[/b]
