notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Great Era of Commerce Part 2 update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75017/the-secrets-of-the-commerce-champion]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75018/2022-summer-master-plan]2022 Summer Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75155/glass-trim-box]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75297/return-of-the-beautiful-lights-for-the-night-event]Return of The Beautiful Lights for the Night Event[/url]: Thursday, July 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 4th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75350/royal-brawler-s-box]Royal Brawler's Box[/url]: Thursday, July 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75573/return-of-the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-3]Return of The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3[/url]: Thursday, July 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75574/return-of-the-family-weekend-fishing-event]Return of the Family Weekend Fishing Event[/url]: Friday, July 22nd, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, August 14th, 11:59 PM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75464/let-s-fly-together-now]Let's Fly Together Now![/url]: Thursday, July 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75542/sealed-dragon-pet-box]Sealed Dragon Pet Box[/url]: Thursday, July 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 25th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75587/great-era-of-commerce-part-2]The Great Era of Commerce Part 2 Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Great Era of Commerce Part 2[/b]
[list][*]Take to the skies with the second part of the Great Era of Commerce! For full details, check out the Great Era of Commerce Part 2 update on [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75587/great-era-of-commerce-part-2]its dedicated webpost.[/url][list][*]Merchant Group Commerce is now available.[list][*]To create a Merchant Group, visit a Merchant Group Commerce Bulletin Board near an Iria Trading Post.[/*][/list][/*][*]Merchant Group Exclusive Trading Posts and exclusive trade goods have been added.[/*][*]Airships have been added exclusively for Merchant Groups.[/*][*]You can now encounter enemies while traveling in airships.[/*][*]New side quests have been added for the Iria Trade Association NPCs.[/*][*]New items have been added to the Trade Merchant shops.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The name of the “Ascension Boost” 2nd Title has been changed to “Ascension”.[/*][*]Some skill ranks of Succubus Fiends from Fahmes Ruin Stage 6 have been reduced.[/*][*]Adjusted the option name and announcement text for the Plain Bandit Badge exchange when speaking to a Trade Merchant.[/*][*]Doll Bags can now be summoned during Commerce.[list][*]Doll Bags with Movement Speed buffs will be applied to Backpack and Handcart trade mounts.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the issue where the purchase limit of the Edgy Enchant in the Summer Master Plan shop appeared as 0, and the purchase limit has been removed.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where players using Windows 11 would encounter NGS errors more often.[/*][*]Fixed several text issues on the Connous map.[/*][*]Fixed the typo for Belvast on the World Map.[/*][*]Fixed four Sewing Patterns that showed no data.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where talking to Iven or Eirwana while being in a Commerce Trade and having a Stowaway ticket would show XML text.[/*][*]Fixed several text issues on the Rano map.[/*][*]Fixed the NPC name for Reminiscing Old Man.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the was a space in front of the name "Fragrant Wild Rose Outfit (F)", causing it to be at the top of the Tailoring List.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is untranslated text in the mini-map at La Terra Highland zone and south Pantay Swamp zone.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce - Part 2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Merchant Group Commerce[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Merchant Group Commerce[/b] is now available.
[list][*]This is a party group where 2 to 8 party members can do Commerce together.[/*][*]Merchant Group Commerce can only be formed at the Qilla, Fillia, Cor, and Vales trading posts.[/*][*]Group trading can only be performed in Iria.[/*][*]There are two types of group trading: 
[list][*]On-Foot Travel when trading on land.[/*][*]Air Travel when trading by air.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Visit the [b]Merchant Group Commerce Bulletin Board[/b] near an Iria trading post to create a new group.
[list][*]Merchant group parties cannot be registered to the Party Board.[/*][*]The group leader can choose the method of travel, the starting trading post and the Destination trading post, and modify the Finishing and EXP rules for the party.[/*][*]From the Group Info menu, you can view the group status, transportation method of the party members, or right-click a party member for more options such as appoint a new leader, or check a member’s purchased trade goods information.[/*][/list][/*][*]To start trade for the merchant group, the party leader can purchase trade goods when there are at least 2 people in the group.
[list][*]Trade goods can only be purchased at the trading post designated as the launch point.[/*][*]When the leader purchases trade goods and trading starts, no additional party members can be recruited until the trade ends.[/*][*]Once the leader has purchased the trade goods, members can purchase trade goods.[/*][*]You can get additional bonus profits when selling to the trading post designated as the Destination.
[list][*]Each member can go to any desired trading post and sell trade goods, it does not have to be the Destination point for the merchant group.[/*][/list][/*][*]When all members sell the trade goods, trade ends for the merchant group and new trade goods can be purchased.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Merchant Group Exclusive Trading Posts[/b] and exclusive trade goods have been added.
[list][*]Access to the exclusive trading posts is only possible while in a merchant group.[/*][*]Exclusive trade goods can be bought and sold at the Qilla, Filia, Cor and Vales Trading Posts in Iria.
[list][*]The number of purchases available for trade goods differs by each trade good at each Trading Post.[/*][*]The number of exchanges available resets weekly on [b]Saturdays at 7 AM PT.[/b][/*][*]The characters within the account share trade counts.[/*][/list][/*][*]All merchant group members can choose and purchase the trade items they want.[/*][*]If you close the Trading Post UI after purchasing a trade item, you cannot purchase again until the trade ends for the group.[/*][*]When one of the party members arrives first at the Destination and sells a trade good, the sale price is fixed for the merchant group.
[list][*]Party members who arrive late can also sell trade goods at the same price without a drop in the market price.[/*][*]When all members sell trade goods and trade ends, the saved market price ends.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]On-Foot Travel:[/b][list][*]Party members can use any transportation methods owned by the individual (Backpack, Camel, etc.).[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Air Travel:[/b][list][*]The Airship has been added as a means of transport exclusively for Air Travel while in a Merchant Group.
[list][*]18 Slots, 2500 Weight[/*][/list][/*][*]An Air Transport License can be purchased by talking to an Iria Transportation Association NPC.
[list][*]Requires Seasonal Commerce Rank Silver 5 and 10,000,000 Seasonal Ducats to unlock during the season.[/*][*]The Airship transportation method rental will expire when the Commerce Season is over.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If the leader of the merchant group has an Air Transport License, the Airship can be boarded by all members in the group.[/*][*]The Airship can only be operated by the leader of the merchant group. 
[list][*]Use the Airship controls and click on the ground or select a waypoint on the minimap to move to an area.[/*][*][b]TIP:[/b] Hold Shift and Left Click to select multiple waypoints![/*][*]You can board the Airship and fly around Iria to trade. All members must board before it can take off.[/*][*]Pets and Partners cannot be summoned while aboard the Airship.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new [b]Event Encounter[/b] system has been added during merchant group trading. 
[list][*]You can encounter it randomly during trade.[/*][*]If one of the merchant group party members triggers an event, all members within a certain range can receive the effect.[/*][*]Different events occur during On-Foot Travel and Air Travel.[/*][*][b]On-Foot Travel[/b] 
[list][*]Discover an Ancient Stela and interact with it to increase trade profits by 2% for all party members within range. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)[/*][*]Discover hidden chests and open them to find 50,000 to 500,000 Seasonal Ducats within![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Air Travel[/b]
[list][*]Two effects can be approached during Air Travel, granting one of the following:
[list][*][b]Gust of Wind[/b] - increase the Airship’s speed.[/*][*][b]Wind Essence[/b] - recover the Airship’s HP.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The encountered enemies while merchant group trading are stronger than the regular trade bandits, so defeat them together with your party members!
[list][*]During On-Foot Travel, you can encounter bandits during merchant group trading.[/*][*]During Air Travel, you can encounter Wyverns and Red Dragon.[/*][/list][/*][*]Combat missions may occur randomly during Air Travel.
[list][*][b]Wyvern Battle:[/b] 
[list][*]Defeat all Wyverns using ranged skills and the Airship’s ballista to earn one of the following buffs. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)
[list][*]Increased Airship Movement Speed[/*][*]Increased Seasonal Ducat acquisition when trade is completed[/*][*]Increased Merchant Rating when trade is completed[/*][/list][/*][*]If the Airship’s HP is reduced by 30%, the battle will fail and the Airship Movement Speed will be decreased until the trade ends.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Red Dragon Battle:[/b]
[list][*]Attack the Red Dragon using ranged skills and the Airship’s ballista. If you hit the dragon more than a certain number of times, the dragon will retreat and you can earn one of the following buffs. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)
[list][*]Increased Airship Movement Speed[/*][*]Increased Seasonal Ducat acquisition when trade is completed[/*][*]Increased Merchant Rating when trade is completed[/*][/list][/*][*]If the group fails to hit the dragon a certain number of times within the time limit, the battle will fail and the Airship Movement Speed will be decreased until the trade ends.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the Airship’s HP reaches 0%, the Airship crashes to the floor, returns 75% of the purchase price of trade goods as Seasonal Ducats, and lowers the Merchant Rating.[/*][*]To prevent the Airship from crashing, all party members must work together to defeat the monsters![/*][/list][/*][*]Iria Trade Association merchants now sell the following items to help you during Air Travel Battles in the “Merchant Group” tab which can be purchased using Gold:
[list][*][b]Enhancement Stone: [/b]Increases Ballista's attack speed for a certain period of time during combat.
You will also receive 5 when starting a new trade by Airship.[/*][*][b]Protection Stone:[/b] Airship's durability is not consumed for a certain period of time during combat.
You will also receive 5 when starting a new trade by Airship.[/*][*][b]Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group): [/b]Can be used for the ballista of the Airship during combat.[/*][/list][/*][*]Side Quests related to the Iria Trade Association NPCs have been added. The quests can be obtained by meeting the following requirements:

[list][*]Achieve Seasonal Commerce Rank Bronze 1 or higher[/*][*]Talk to Igerna with the keyword “Nearby Rumors” to receive the quest.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Longing Flowing through the Desert Sea[/b]
[list][*]Complete G17 The Saga Iria Part 1[/*][*]Achieve Seasonal Commerce Rank Gold 5 or higher[/*][*]Talk to Caoimhin with the keyword “Nearby Rumors” to receive the quest.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Other Commerce related additions and improvements have been added:
[list][*]You can obtain the Great Era of Commerce Collection Book from Sayiv.[/*][*]Linden, Sayiv, Igerna, and Caoimhin have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited using a Campfire Invitation for the Campfire Spirit.[/*][*]7 new Journal Achievements related to the Merchant Group Commerce can be obtained.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following products will be added to the Trade Merchant NPCs and Sayiv’s Shop.
[list][*][b]Commerce Mount Extra Style Ticket - Airship (Imbolic)[/b] - 150,000,000 Ducats or Seasonal Ducats

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Team Status Update and News for 2022
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

I am writing to you today to update you on the current status of our team and share a brief outlook of what’s next for us in Mabinogi this year!

Please let me introduce myself; I am GM Mewlynne, your new Mabinogi Producer. It’s nice to meet you! And for those who already know me, hello! We last left off with our Producer, GM Supreme, sharing his farewell as he has moved on from Nexon America. I am honored to have worked alongside Supreme while he was on the team. He is an admirable mentor and friend, and I am proud to be his successor.

To share a bit about myself, I’ve been working with the Mabinogi team since 2016, and have been a Milletian since 2008. I’ve spent countless hours playing, testing, and living my fantasy life in Mabinogi, so I’ve been an advocate for Milletians since the very beginning. I started my journey at Nexon on the Customer Support team before joining the Production team. To be honest, it’s hard to believe that I have made it here; it was always my dream! I will continue to support you and the game moving forward, and I’m very delighted to be in this role. Please give me a bit more time to get settled, and I’d love to see you all in-game for a GM event sometime.

The Mabinogi Team has been working on quite a few things this year. We are so excited to have brought the community together in Erinn and hope to continue the adventures with our upcoming content updates. In the fall, we will first focus on polishing older content with updates such as the Chapter 1 Masterpiece update, Raid improvements, and multiple Quality of Life changes. We are also working hard to bring the progression improvement update that has been recently introduced in Korea along with exciting new talent content to NA by this winter.

I’m looking forward to sharing more details with you in the near future through the Producer’s Letter again.

Sincerely,

[b]GM Mewlynne[/b]
[b]Mabinogi Producer[/b]

—

Hi Milletians,

I have important news to announce: Friday, July 29th, 2022 will be my last day as your Community Manager, as I will be leaving Nexon America for a new adventure. I have been on the Mabinogi team since 2017 and have been a Milletian since 2008.

My time spent being your Community Manager has been an amazing experience and I will miss each and every one of you. Thank you to everyone on the Mabinogi Team for believing in me and helping me take the next step from a QA tester to a Community Manager. I know that Mabinogi will continue to do great things in my absence; just take a look at all of the exciting updates that we have coming this year alone!

To everyone in the community, thank you for welcoming me with open arms and for attending each and every one of my streams. I loved being your Community Manager and I look forward to seeing your excitement for the upcoming content as a player in the future. Until next time, Milletians.

Sincerely,

[b]Katherz[/b]
[u][b]Queen of Cheese Management[/b][/u]
[u][b]Milletians Don’t Read Club President[/b][/u]
 
—

Thank you for your constant support, Milletians. While our team bids farewell to Katherz, she has made an everlasting impact that will not be forgotten. Please join us in Discord and keep an eye on our future posts as we will continue to update you on what’s to come.

[u]- The Mabinogi Team[/u]

notes.title: Return of The Beautiful Lights for the Night Event
notes.content:
The Master Lantern Maker can only have one successor and his Students need your help! Collect Firefly Lights so they can create an extra special lantern to impress their Master. And don't forget to enjoy the Fireflies and Night Petals throughout Tir Chonaill! Check out the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, July 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 4th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Passing the Torch.[/b][/*][*]Talk to the [b]Master Lantern Maker[/b] in [b]Tir Chonaill[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with the Master Lantern Maker.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally, after registering a main character, a Crystalumen Potion is added to your inventory once [b]every 10 minutes[/b] after [b]7 AM PDT[/b], in real-time every day.[list][*]You can receive up to 5 each day.[/*][*]The Crystalumen Potion is only added to the main character's inventory.[/*][*]Time does not reset when you change channels, re-login, or rebirth, but the time in the Soul Stream does not count.[/*][*]The Crystalumen Potion is used to crystalize Firefly Light, which is needed to complete the quest.[/*][*]It can only be used between [b]8 PM and 4 AM Erinn time.[/b][/*][*]It can only be used in Tir Chonaill.[/*][/list][/*][*]All event quests and items, including the Firefly Box, will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list][h2][b]Daily Quest - Some Light Work[/b][/h2][list][*]The daily quest resets [b]every day at 7 AM PDT.[/b][/*][*]Talk to one of the Master's Students to select which student you will help on that day. You can only help one student per day.[/*][*]Once completed, you will earn the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Firefly Coin x30[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Completion Quest - The Lantern Maker's Successor[/b][/h2][list][*]Help the Master's Students complete their lanterns by completing their daily quest, "Some Light Work" a total of 5 times.[/*][*]To help all the students, you would need to complete the daily quest a total of 20 times (5 times for each of the four students).[/*][*]You will earn the following rewards after helping out each student:[list][*][b]Master's First Student: [/b]Firefly Coin x25[/*][*][b]Master's Second Student:[/b] Firefly Coin x25[/*][*][b]Master's Third Student:[/b] Firefly Coin x25[/*][*][b]Master's Fourth Student:[/b] Firefly Coin x25[/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have completed the completion quest, you will earn the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Firefly Coin x50[/b]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1022/mabinogi-nightlights-memories-of-the-fairies-2nd-title-coupon.gif[/img]
[/*][*][b]*NEW* Memory of the Fairies 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Luck +30[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]After completing the quest, you can still collect and deliver Firefly Lights. [list][*]Talk to the Master Lantern Maker and select [b][Firefly Light].[/b][/*][*]Deliver 5 Firefly Lights to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Firefly Coin x30[/b][/*][*][b]Firefly Box x3[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]Great Era of Commerce Part 1[/b]
[list][*]Trade has now been expanded into Iria! For full details, check out the Great Era of Commerce Part 1 update on its [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/75192/great-era-of-commerce-part-1]dedicated webpost[/url].[list][*]8 new Trading Posts have been added in Iria.[/*][*]There are new NPCs in Iria as part of the Iria Trade Association.[/*][*]There are new daily quests related to Commerce.[/*][*]3 new transportation methods have been added.[/*][*]2 new ports have been added.[/*][*]A new [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/75214/seasonal-commerce-system-guide]Seasonal Commerce system[/url] has been added.[/*][*]Seasonal Ducats are a new type of currency that can be used for trading during a season.[/*][*]The Seasonal Commerce Rank Board has been added.[/*][*]Seasonal Rank Rewards have been added.[/*][*]The Outlaw Pursuit Wanted Board bounty tracking system has been revamped.[/*][*]7 new Outlaws have been added.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The naming format of the “Increases Attack Delay” Set Effect has been changed to “Attack Delay Reduction”.[/*][*]The training method of Commerce Mastery has been changed from Ducats to Seasonal Ducats.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Production Boost Potion's effect disappeared before calculating the production success rate.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where when you entered Tech Duinn or Baltane Elite Missions, the passes with shorter expiration would appear first in the selection UI.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with active Personal Shops displaying untranslated text when holding down the Alt key.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with two Red Flame Fire Dragons appearing in the Transformation Diary UI.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the journal achievement for completing 1,000 crafts was stating 100 crafts.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary had text that was cut-off or was overlapping.[/*][*]Fixed some Weaving crafting recipes that were incorrectly labeled:[list][*]Fabric -> Cheap Fabric[/*][*]Common Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)[/*][*]Silk -> Cheap Silk[/*][*]Common Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)[/*][*]The material for crafting Ice Silk was incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread[/*][/list][/*][*]Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith manuals showing no data have been fixed and can now be used. Crafting these items will also collect them in the Production Diary.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Existing Guilds cannot create guild stones or invite new members.[/*][*]Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.[list][*]A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: [UPDATED] The Secrets of the Commerce Champion
notes.content:

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce - Part 1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Iria Trade Expansion[/b][/h2][list][*]Commerce has been expanded into the Iria region![/*][*]Characters who have completed the third Memoir of Blaanid's Brave Boost will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Iria, the Land of Opportunity.[/b][/*][*]8 Trading Post have been added to the continent of Iria.[list][*]4 General Trading Posts: [b]Qilla[/b], [b]Filia[/b], [b]Cor[/b] and [b]Vales Trading Posts[/b][list][*]These Trading Posts function the same as the existing Uladh Trading Posts.[/*][*]Purchase goods using Seasonal Ducats and sell them to other trading posts.[/*][/list][/*][*]4 Barter Trading Posts: [b]Karu Forest[/b], [b]Oasis[/b], [b]Calida[/b], and [b]Pera Trading Posts[/b]
[list][*]These Trading Posts function similarly to the existing Scathach Beach Trading Post. You can exchange materials for trade goods and sell them to other Trading Posts.[/*][*]In order to use the Barter Trading Post, you must reach a Seasonal Commerce Rank of Silver 5.[/*][*]Items required for exchange can be obtained via crafting using life skills, such as Potions, Firewood, Leather, and more.[/*][*]You cannot purchase trade items using Seasonal Ducats at the Barter Trading Posts.[/*][*]The exchange count for exchanging materials for trade goods differs by each trade good at each Barter Trading Post.[list][*]The number of exchanges available resets weekly on [b]Saturday at 7 AM PT.[/b][/*][*]The characters within the account share trade counts.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]In the newly added Trading Posts, you can trade with members of the Iria Trade Association, similar to the Merchant Imps on Uladh.[/*][*]New daily quests related to Commerce in Iria have been added.[list][*]You can receive daily quests from the Iria Commerce Association NPCs at the Iria Trading Posts.[/*][/list][/*][*]New BGM has been added when engaging in Commerce in Iria.[/*][*]Additional Commerce transportation methods are now available, including three types of rental transport mounts:[list][*][b]Dog Sled[/b][/*][*][b]Camel[/b][/*][*][b]Trader's Skiff[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]These mounts can be rented after unlocking the permanent Commerce transportation methods: Backpack, Wagon, and Elephant.
[list][*]These mounts can only be rented using Seasonal Ducats.[/*][*]The rental period lasts the duration of the current Commerce trade season, and the mounts must be rented again during the next trade season.[/*][*]After renting both a Dog Sled and Camel, you will be able to rent a Trader's Skiff.[/*][*]Each mount has a different weight capacity and number of slots available for transporting goods.[/*][*]Camels can move quickly in the desert of Connous, and move slower than usual in the snowy areas of Physis.[/*][*]Dog Sleds can move quickly in Physis.[/*][/list][/*][*]Two new ports, [b]Port Connous [/b]and [b]Port Sella[/b], have been added. The existing ports, Port Ceann and Port Cobh, have been upgraded.[/*][*]Ships in Port Cobh, Port Qilla, and Port Ceann have been replaced with gigantic ships.[/*][*]Port Sella has been added to Sella Beach in Iria.[/*][*]Port Connous has been added to Connous Beach in Iria.[/*][*]A new port route has been added to Port Ceann on Uladh that leads to Port Sella and Port Connous in Iria.[/*][*]A new port route has been added to Port Cobh on Uladh that leads to Port Qilla.[/*][*]Four new NPCs are available to help you sail and trade with Iria:[list][*][b]Igerna (Port Sella - Port Ceann)[/b][/*][*][b]Caoimhin (Port Connous - Port Ceann)[/b][/*][*][b]Linden (Port Qilla - Port Cobh)[/b][/*][*][b]Sayiv (Port Qilla)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The existing navigator for Port Cobh, Karis, is now vacationing in Port Connous.[/*][*]A Smuggler NPC has been added to each new port to help smuggle Milletians; Iven at Port Sella and Eirwana in Port Connous.[list][*]If you bring the Stowaway Ticket item to the Smuggler during the evening and nighttime, you can immediately move to Port Ceann through the Smuggler.[/*][*]Smuggling will decrease your Merchant Rating 20,000 each for all trading posts in Uladh and Iria.[/*][*]Stowaway Tickets can be obtained by Bandits that appear during Commerce and Bandit Hunting.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that the remaining time until departure and time remaining until arrival during a voyage between ports are displayed.[/*][*]A unique BGM will now play while sailing.[/*][/list][h2][b]Commerce Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]A new [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/75214/seasonal-commerce-system-guide]Seasonal Commerce system[/url] has been introduced.[list][*]Seasonal Ducats are a new type of currency used for trading during the season.[/*][*]Earn rewards as you raise your Seasonal Commerce Rank.[/*][*]Place on the Ranking Board to become a Commerce Champion and receive rewards at the end of the season.[/*][/list][/*][*]The market price cost range and Ducat yield of trade goods for each Uladh Trading Post have been improved.[/*][*]The weight and max quantity per slot of some Uladh trade goods have been changed.[/*][*]You can now check the current Market Price for the trade goods you have when you click on the INFO button at the top right corner after starting Commerce.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2206/mabinogi-commerce-current-market-price.png[/img]
[list][*]The Outlaw Pursuit Wanted Board bounty tracking system has been revamped.[list][*]All Outlaws are shown on the Wanted Board regardless of their criminal records.[/*][*]The reward for bounties registered on the board will increase in value periodically.[/*][*]As before, the reward will increase if a Milletian's goods have been stolen.[/*][*]If you succeed in catching the Outlaw, the bounty will be re-registered on the bulletin board after 30 minutes.[/*][*]You cannot use the Wanted Board when playing as a pet.[/*][/list][/*][*]An [b]urgent wanted alert system[/b] has been added for Wanted Outlaws.[list][*]If you catch an Outlaw with a wanted bounty, you can get a bonus amount of Seasonal Ducats.[/*][*]Any Outlaw with an urgent wanted bounty will be marked on the board.[/*][*]If an Outlaw with an increased bounty is not defeated and another event occurs on the same Outlaw, the bounty is increased, up to a maximum of 1,000,000 Seasonal Ducats.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2205/mabinogi-commerce-wanted-poster.png[/img]
[list][*]Seven new Outlaws have been added.[list][*]You can obtain a journal achievement once for defeating each Outlaw.[/*][/list][/*][*]The way Bandits are encountered during Commerce has been changed.[list][*]It has been changed to spawn within a random range around the character when moving into a Dangerous Area, rather than appearing at specified coordinates.[/*][*]The Bandits can still be avoided if you proceed with caution.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new Iria Bandit group has been added. They consist of Humans, Elves, and Giants.[list][*]These Bandits only appear in Iria.[/*][/list][/*][*]A function to limit the number of weekly exchanges has been added to Barter Trading Posts.[list][*]Scathach Beach Trading Post's trading feature now has a limit of 200 times per material.[/*][*]The number of exchanges available resets on Saturday at 7 AM PT weekly.[/*][*]Characters on the same account share trade counts.[/*][*]In order to use the Barter Trading Post, you must reach a Seasonal Commerce Rank of Silver 5.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Trade Assistant Imp's conversation UI no longer shows during trade (some support puppet's dialogue function still appears).[/*][*]PVP is no longer possible during Commerce.[/*][*]The stock of each trade item is displayed in the Trading Post.[/*][*]If you stop engaging in Commerce, the stock of the Trading Post you purchased goods from will be restored.[/*][*]A new bridge across the Suytu River, near the town of Cor in Iria, has been added.[/*][*]Yvona sells the following items for Ducats, which can now also be purchased with Seasonal Ducats. Note that her shop's stock changes every Erinn day:[list][*]Pitfalls of Composition[/*][*]A Composer's Life[/*][*]Unknown Song Vol. 1[/*][*]Portable First Aid Kit[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been added to the Limited Items tab when trading with the Iria Trade association or the Merchant Imps in Uladh. These items can be purchased using [b]Ducats.[/b][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Item Name[/b][/th][th][b]Item Details[/b][/th][th][b]Cost (Ducats)[/b][/th][th][b]Purchase Restrictions[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]First Commerce Ogre Brooch[/td][td]Accessory

notes.title: Champions of Commerce
notes.content:
The Great Era of Commerce is among us, Milletians, and it is time to become the Champions of Commerce! Check in with Commerce Joe and complete all of the Commerce objectives. Can you rise to the top of the Rankings Board and become the Number 1 Commerce Champion? Check out the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, June 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] Champions of Commerce.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Commerce Joe[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Commerce Joe's Trade Journal[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Use Commerce Joe's Trade Journal to view the event details and objectives.[/*][/list][h2][b]Today's Objective[/b][/h2][list][*]Every day, you will be tasked with [b]Today's Objective.[/b][list][*][b]Perform Commerce - [/b]3 times a day[list][*]After completing 3 Commerce trades, you will receive [b]15 Commerce Coins.[/b][list][*][b]Note: [/b]Commerce trades conducted through Smugglers will not be counted.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Setting Up the Iria Trading Posts - [/b]once a day[list][*]Commerce Joe has a selection of missions for you to lend a hand with the efforts to get the Iria Trading Posts up and running.[/*][*]Choose a mission and you will be sent straight to the location (enter the mission).[/*][*]On your first clear, you will receive [b]15 Commerce Coins.[/b][/*][*]For each time you clear, [b]up to 5 times per day, [/b]you will receive [b]5 Commerce Coins.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]After clearing both objectives, you will receive the following items:[list][*][b]20 Commerce Coins[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Trading Post Merchant Rating Potion (7000)[/b][list][*]Use this potion to select a Trading Post and increase your Trading Post Merchant Rating by 7,000.[/*][*]If you use the potion after the Great Era of Commerce Update (June 30th), you can increase the Merchant Rating of the Iria continent's Trading Post.[/*][*]The potion can only be used once per day in-game time. It can be used again after 7 AM Erinn time.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The daily objectives will reset at 7 AM PDT in real-time.[/*][/list][h2][b]Event Period Objectives[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, you will be tasked with the following objectives:[list][*][b]Commerce Count [Today's Objective][/b][list][*]Complete Today's Objective 10 times by performing Commerce.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Setting Up the Iria Trading Posts [Today's Objective][/b][list][*]Complete Today's Objective 10 times by clearing the mission through Commerce Joe.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Uladh Trading Post Merchant Rating Total[/b][list][*]Raise your Uladh Trading Post Merchant Rating and reach a cumulative total of Level 30 between all 8 Uladh Trading Posts.[list][*][b]Note: [/b]If your Trading Post Merchant Rating is already at or above a cumulative Level 30, the objective will be completed when you register the main character for the event.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]After clearing the objectives, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]*NEW* Commerce Champion Erg Material Box[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* New Commerce notes.title: Dragon Master Season 2
notes.content:
Meiling is back and needs your help to craft the dragon! Brave Uladh's Dungeons and Shadow Missions to collect the items needed for the dragon. Or, log in in every day to make this majestic pet your own! Check out the details below.
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, June 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[list][*]Log in during the event period to receive the quest [b][Guide] Return of the Dragon Clan.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Meiling[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[list][*]The character must be [b]above Level 1,000[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Attendance Scroll[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Crafting a Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a [b]Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn.[/b][/*][*]You can only craft one Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn during the event period.[/*][*]You can also obtain a Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn as a reward from the Attendance Scroll event.[/*][*][b][u]The event items (Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Old Dragon, Fire Dragon's Hard Red Leather, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, Incomplete Horn, and Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.[/u][/b][/*][*]You must gather one [b]Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon[/b], one [b]Fire Dragon's Hard Red Leather[/b], one [b]Golden Yarn of the First Dawn[/b], and one [b]Strength Essence[/b] for Meiling to attempt to craft the [b]Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn.[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1836/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-marshal-fire-dragon-horn.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]You have a chance to collect the [b]Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon[/b] by [b]clearing an Uladh Dungeon[/b]:
[list][*]Alby Intermediate[/*][*]Alby Advanced[/*][*]Alby Advanced Hardmode[/*][*]Ciar Intermediate[/*][*]Ciar Advanced[/*][*]Ciar Advanced Hardmode[/*][*]Rabbie Basic[/*][*]Rabbie Advanced[/*][*]Fiodh Intermediate[/*][*]Fiodh Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Basic[/*][*]Rundal Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Advanced Hardmode[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Fire Dragon's Hard Red Leathe[/b]r when you complete a [b]Tara or Tailteann Shadow Mission[/b]:[list][*]Basic[/*][*]Intermediate[/*][*]Advanced[/*][*]Hard[/*][*]Elite[/*][*]Lord[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Golden Yarn of the First Dawn[/b] when you [b]fish at Tir Chonaill Fishing Area[/b] with [b]Bait Tin[/b].[/*][*]You can receive the [b]Strength Essence[/b] when you reach current level 50, 100, 150, or 200.[/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Eminent Alchemist’s Note[/b] when you complete Tech Duinn Missions.
[list][*]When the Eminent Alchemist’s Note is in your inventory, it increases the success rate of crafting the Incomplete Horn.[/*][/list][/*][*]The harder the dungeon or mission difficulty, the better the chance to collect the material.[/*][*]When the crafting succeeds, you will receive an [b]Incomplete Horn[/b]. Stay logged in for 1 hour to convert it to a [b]Marshal Fire Dragon’s Horn[/b]...and the Dragon might have something special for you!
[list][*]If you change channels or log out before the hour has finished, the timer will reset. You will need to stay logged in for the full hour to convert it to a Marshal Fire Dragon’s Horn.[/*][*][b]*NEW* Valiant Fire Dragon’s Aura 2nd Title Coupon[/b]
[list][*]Luck +30
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1839/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-valiant-fire-dragon-aura-2nd-title.gif[/img][/b]
[/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Shamala’s Transformation Medal: Marshal Fire Dragon[/b]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1835/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-marshal-fire-dragon-horn-transformation-medal.png[/img][/b]
[/*][/list][/*][*]When the crafting fails, you could keep all three materials or could lose one or more materials. You will also receive a consolation item.[/*][/list][h2][b]How to Feed Your Dragon Event[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, June 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[list][*] After logging in during Week 4 of the event, you will received the event quest, [b][Event] Foods that Dragons Enjoy.[/b][/*][*]Talk to Meiling to start the quest and help her feed her Dragon by delivering food.[/*][*]Each day, for 5 days, deliver the requested dish that the Dragon likes.[/*][*]You can deliver the next dish after 7 AM PDT the next day.[/*][*]After delivering all 5 dishes, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]*NEW* Fire Dragon's Aura 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Luck +30
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1838/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-fire-dragon-aura-2nd-title.gif[/img][/b]
[/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Shamala's Transformation Medal: Red Flame Fire Dragon[/b][list][*][u][b]NOTE:[/b] [u]This transformation medal is incorrectly labeled as Shamala's Transformation Medal: Marshal Fire Dragon.[/u][/u]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1837/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-red-flame-fire-dragon-horn-transformation-medal.png[/img][/b]
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Attendance Scroll Event Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, June 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[list][*]Every day, spend at least 36 minutes logged in to Mabinogi on your main character to receive a reward.[/*][*]To receive your reward, you must use the Attendance Scroll and click 'Receive Gift.'[/*][*]There is a maximum of 28 rewards to collect during the event period.[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b].[/*][*]You can collect the following rewards:[list][*][u][b]Day 1:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Coupon (Not tradable)[/b][list][*]Redeem this voucher for a Fire Dragon Bag. Its default size is 11x3, offering a total of 33 slots.[/*][*]When you apply a Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch to it, you can later expand its capacity to up to 11x12.[/*][*]The bag takes up a 2x2 space in your Basic Inventory. You can only have one such bag.[/*][*][b]Fire Dragon Bag is a Personal Shop Bag.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][u][b]Day 2:[/b][/u] Rusty Hammer of Proficiency (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 3:[/b][/u] AP Potion (Event) (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 4:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)[/b][list][*]A special Royal Pouch that can be applied to the Fire Dragon Bag. Use it on the Fire Dragon Bag to add 1 extra row at the bottom.[/*][*]Up to 9 Royal Pouches can be applied to one Fire Dragon Bag.[/*][/list][/*][*][u][b]Day 5:[/b][/u] Direct Dye Ampoule[/*][*][u][b]Day 6:[/b][/u] Golden Experience Fruit (300%) x5[/*][*][u][b]Day 7:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 8:[/b][/u] Full Recovery Potion x5 (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 9:[/b][/u] AP Potion (Event) (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 10:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 11:[/b][/u] Unrestricted Shadow Mission Pass (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 12:[/b][/u] Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 13:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 14:[/b][/u] Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 15:[/b][/u] Perfect Free Repair Kit (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 16:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 17:[/b][/u] Platinum Hammer of Durability (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 18:[/b][/u] Enchant Protection Potion (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 19:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 20:[/b][/u] Artisan Upgrade Removal Kit[/*][*][u][b]Day 21:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 22:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 23:[/b][/u] Rebirth Potion (Event) (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 24:[/b][/u] Exquisite Reforging Tool (Not tradable) x3 (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 25:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][*][u][b]Day 26:[/b][/u] Protective Blue Upgrade Stone (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 27:[/b][/u] Protective Red Upgrade Stone (expires in 15 days)[/*][*][u][b]Day 28:[/b][/u] [b]*NEW* Fire Dragon Bag Royal Pouch[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Renovation Season 3 Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/updated-extended-crom-b-s-support]Crom Bás Fever Time[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73320/milletian-events-server-merge-celebration]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73321/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-3]The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3[/url]: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73587/milletian-events-the-grand-guild-gathering]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74240/shopkeeper-s-sale-enhancement-package]Shopkeeper's Sale: Enhancement Package[/url]: Thursday, May 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74242/sweet-coffee-returns]Sweet Coffee Returns![/url]: Thursday, May 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 9th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74249/hydrangea-box]Hydrangea Box[/url]: Thursday, May 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 9th, Before Maintenance [/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74458/milletian-events-renovation-buffs-and-hotdays]Milletian Events: Renovation Buffs and Hotdays[/url]: Thursday, May 26th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74459/guardian-of-the-divine-beast-box]Guardian of the Divine Beast Box[/url]: Thursday, May 26th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74433/gold-renewal-update]Gold Renewal Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74392/renovation-season-3-dual-guns-ninja-and-puppetry-talent-changes]Renovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes[/url]: Permanent [/*][/list]
[b]Renovation Season 3[/b]
[list][*]Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Dual Gun, Ninja, and Puppetry Talents! For full details, check out the Renovation Season 3 [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74392/renovation-season-3-dual-guns-ninja-and-puppetry-talent-changes]dedicated webpost[/url].[/*][/list]
[b]Gold Renewal Update[/b]
[list][*]Improvements to the Gold system have been made! For full details, check out the Gold Renewal Update [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74433/gold-renewal-update]dedicated webpost[/url].[list][*]Gold no longer occupies your inventory space and is instead stored as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.[/*][*]The maximum Gold limit that your character can hold is 1 million Gold. However, there are different ways to increase the maximum Gold limit.[list][*]One way is by using Gold Boxes and Special Gold Boxes as these items have been turned into a consumable object.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can still withdraw Gold from your inventory.[/*][*]Gold Pouch items have been removed the game.[/*][*]Gold Purse items are now Item Bags.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The Mana Shield Enhancement Set Effect of the Elemental Harmony Gloves (M) and the Elemental Harmony Gloves (F) has been changed:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]Increases Magic Defense by 10 and Magic Protection by 8 when you use Mana Shield.[/*][*][b]After: [/b]Increases Mana Shield's damage reduction per 1 MP by 0.30.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Medium-sized Bag (5x5) can be purchased from the General Shop for 3,980 Gold.[/*][*]"Defense Penetration" has been changed to "Armor Pierce" in the skill description for Axe Mastery, Crossbow Mastery, and Dual Wield Mastery skills.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]On May 19th, the character deletion issue and the log off issue were fixed.[/*][*]The "Macaroon" recipe and food item name has been changed to "Macaron".[/*][*]Enchanted Thread has been renamed back to Enchanted Thread after being accidently renamed Magical Golden Thread[/*][*]The following Sewing Patterns have been fixed:[list][*]Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature's Beauty[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Gloves of Nature[/*][*]Sewing Pattern - Shoes of Nature[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.[/*][*]Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.[/*][*]The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.>[/*][*]A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:[/*][list][*]Common Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)[/*][*]Silk -> Cheap Silk[/*][*]Common Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)[/*][*]The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread[/*][/list][*]The issue regarding Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith Manuals not having any data is still being investigated.[/*][*]Special Small Draconian Wings (3 types) and Coupon can be found in the Auction House, but these items won't be available when the other wings are released.[/*][list][*]They will be released under a different name, the Special Forgotten Draconian Wings (3 types).[/*][*]The Special Small Draconian Wings have a Dressing Room entry, while Special Forgotten Draconian Wings do not have a Dressing Room entry.[/*][/list][/list]

notes.title: Milletian Events: Renovation Buffs and Hotdays!
notes.content:
To celebrate the new Renovation Season 3 update, there will be a hotday event on weekends as well as buffs! Check out the details below.
