notes.title: Renovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Gunslinger
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1715/dualguns.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
[b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The stat calculation for determining damage while using Dual Guns has been changed.[list][*][b]Before:[/b][list][*]For every 6 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][*]For every 5 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]After:[/b][list][*]For every 5 Strength and 5 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][*]For every 4 Strength and 4 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.[list][*]The stun time is adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.[/*][*]Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.[/*][/list][/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Flash Launcher[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1706/mabinogi-renovations3-flash-launcher.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Flash Launcher has been changed to a skill with ranged attack properties so you can attack from a distance.[/*][*]The skill casting time has been greatly reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]950% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]1300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Bullet Storm[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1705/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-storm.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The attack method of Bullet Storm has been changed so that it fires a set number of bullets at enemies within a certain range.[list][*]The more enemies there are within the skill casting range, the more powerful the attack. If there is only one enemy, all bullets are concentrated in one place.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the Technique Seal: Pragarah is activated, the Magic Defense and Protection of the target are reduced according to the number of Bullet Storm hits.[/*][*]The Mana Bullet consumption amount is fixed by Rank.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 24 Mana Bullets[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum number of targets per Rank has been changed:[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 9 maximum targets[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill's attack range has been expanded.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]A basic damage multiplier per bullet has been added to each skill Rank.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 50% per bullet[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage multiplier per additional target has been adjusted from 2 or more targets.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]120% damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]60% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The final damage multiplier is now determined by adding up the base damage multiplier and the damage multiplier that increases per target.
[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]For 3 targets: 50% + (60% *2) = 170% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum damage limit has been adjusted per bullet and is applied at a fixed amount.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 400% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Grapple Shot[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1707/mabinogi-renovations3-grapple-shot.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Grapple Shot has been changed so you can now use the skill by directly clicking on the ground where you want to move.[/*][*]When you arrive at the targeted location, damage is inflicted to enemies near the targeted location within a certain radius.[/*][*]The skill has been modified so that you no longer get hit for a short time while moving, similar to Chain Slash's Anchor Rush skill.[/*][*]The skill cooldown has been reduced for skill Ranks Novice to Rank 2. Rank 1 remains unchanged at 10 seconds.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank Novice of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]16 seconds[/*][*][b]After: [/b]13 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]200% damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]400% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Bullet Slide[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1710/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-slide.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Bullet Slide has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.[/*][*]The skill's casting range has been increased to a range similar to that of a normal attack.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been greatly reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]250% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]1200% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Skill motion can no longer canceled with the ESC key.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Shooting Rush[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1709/mabinogi-renovations3-shooting-rush.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shooting Rush has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.[/*][*]The skill will be cast in the direction of the location selected by the cursor, regardless of the direction the character is facing when attacking.[/*][*]The enemy will be knocked back according to the direction of the skill attack.[/*][*]Skill casting time has been slightly reduced.[/*][*]The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]520% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]600% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Reload[/b][/u]
[list][*]Reload has been changed so that the skill is not canceled even if you are attacked by an enemy while casting the skill.[/*][*]The skill is only canceled if you are knocked down or die while reloading.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Way of the Gun[/b][/u]
[list][*]Bonus Damage has been added to all Ranks of Way of the Gun.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 15% Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]Bonus Damage will also be provided to other Gunslinger skills while Way of the Gun is activated.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]Ninja
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1714/ninja.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
[b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The damage calculation method for Ninja skills have been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage.[/*][*]The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.[list][*]The stun time has been adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.[/*][*]Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Evasion based on an enemy's Luck stats will no longer occur.[/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed: 
[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b]
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b]
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Explosive Kunai[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1708/mabinogi-renovations3-explosive-kunai.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Skill activation time has been slightly reduced.[/*][*]The method of triggering the skill's explosive attack has been changed.[list][*]When an enemy steps on the explosive kunai, all kunai explode at the same time.[/*][*]All enemies in a 3m area around each kunai that explodes will take damage.[/*][/list][/*][*]Depending on the location, one enemy may receive damage multiple times.[/*][*]Enemies caught in the explosion are stunned for 3 seconds, and at the same time, the target's movement speed is decreased for 6 seconds.[/*][*]The damage for each Rank is increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]200% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Shuriken Charge[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1711/mabinogi-renovations3-shuriken-charge.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shuriken Charge has been changed so that you no longer have to charge the skill. Instead, the attack hits at full damage when the skill is used on an enemy.[/*][*]The previous animation that played when charging the skill is now played while you have the skill activated.[/*][*]You can now move your character while the skill is activated.[/*][*]You can also cancel the skill using the ESC key or by clicking on the skill balloon.[/*][*]Splash damage now always occurs when the skill is used on an enemy within 2m, and the same damage multiplier as the selected target is applied.[/*][*]The damage for the skill has been changed to be a fixed amount at each skill rank instead of requiring it to be fully charged for the full skill damage.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill - 690% Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Successfully use a fully charged attack" training requirement for Rank A and higher skill ranks, has been changed to "Defeat an enemy with Shuriken Charge".[/*][/list]
[u][b]Shadow Bind[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1712/mabinogi-renovations3-shadow-bind.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Shadow Bind has been changed so that binding an enemy persists while you are using the skill, keeping your character in place as you bind.[/*][*]A max binding duration has been added.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 20 seconds[/*][/list][/*][*]The continuous binding can be stopped by canceling the use of the skill. It will also be stopped if you are stunned or knocked back due to an enemy's attack.[/*][*]Even if the skill use is completed or canceled, an additional binding time is applied to the target.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 5.5 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Shadow[/b][b] Cloak[/b][/u]
[list][*]A bonus damage effect has been added for Ninja skills used while Shadow Cloak is active.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 10% Bonus Damage[/*][/list][/*][*]The skill duration has been increased to 10 seconds.[/*][*]The damage of the skill's Tornado attack has been increased.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b]120% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]300% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Smokescreen[/b][/u]
[list][*]Smokescreen has been changed so that it now reduces the target's Magic Defense and Magic Protection. The reduction is the same as the Defense/Protection reduction.[/*][*]The smoke effect of the skill will now disappear naturally.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Kunai Storm[/b][/u]
[list][*]Damage for Kunai Storm has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been changed to the damage amount rather than the damage multiplier.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:[list][*][b]Before: [/b] +460% Damage[/*][*][b]After: [/b]560% Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Sakura Abyss[/b][/u]
[list][*]Sakura Abyss has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been updated to include more information.[/*][/list][h2][b]Puppetry
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1713/puppetry.png[/img]
[/b][/h2]
 [b]System Changes[/b]
[list][*]The damage calculation method for Puppetry skills has been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage. [/*][*]The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:[list][*][b]Awakening Attack Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Awakening Range Enhancement[/b][list][*][b]Example: [/b]At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been change to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The formula that applies the increased Marionette Damage from the Spirit Enhancement Attack effect "Spirit Training" has been changed. Damage is now increased when using a Spirit.[/*][*]The "Marionette Critical Damage" set effect has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]Increases Marionette's Critical Damage by 40%[/*][*][b]After: [/b]Increases the Marionette's Critical Damage multiplier by 80% when a Critical hit occurs.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list][*]For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.[/*][*]The following skills have not been changed, however the Skill Info has been slightly updated:[list][*][b]Act 1: Inciting Incident[/b][/*][*][b]Act 4: Rising Action[/b][/*][*][b]Act 6: Crisis[/b][/*][*][b]Act 7: Climactic Crash[/b][/*][*][b]Wire Pull[/b][/*][*][b]Puppet's Snare[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Control Marionette[/b][/u]
[list][*]The Marionette will now gain 70% of the Puppeteer's Armor Pierce and Piercing Level.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 2: Threshold Cutter[/b][/u]
[list][*]The Combo Card damage bonus has been changed. It will now be applied to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd consecutive hits while using the skill.[/*][*]Additional information has been added to the skill info and description.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 9: Invigorating Encore[/b][/u]
[list][*]While using Act 9: Invigorating Encore, the Marionette's Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection is increased. Bonus damage is also applied when the Marionette attacks.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill[list][*]Marionette Attack Bonus Damage +10%[/*][*]Defense, Magic Defense Increase: +580[/*][*]Protection, Magic Protection Increase +80[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill effect is maintained, even if the Marionette dies and is resurrected or if the summon is canceled and re-summoned. The skill effect will continue to be applied to the Marionette for the remaining effect duration.[/*][*]The skill's activation time has been reduced.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Additional Content Changes[/b][/h2][list][*] Some content and NPC dialogue of the following tutorial missions have been changed to match the talent changes:[list][*]Intro Gun Training[/*][*]Intro Gun Training: Movement Skills[/*][*]Intro Gun Training: Ranged Attack Skills[/*][*]Try Talents[/*][*]Continue to Try Talents[/*][*]Learn Shuriken Charge[/*][/list][/*][*]The following NPC's Gunslinger and Ninja talent skill Ranks will be lowered and their AI has been changed:[list][*][b]Enemy NPCs[/b][list][*]Cessair's Heart in the following missions:[list][*]Heart Awakening Mission[/*][*]Fading Pulse Mission[/*][*]Into Battle Mission[/*][*]Cave of Trials Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Llywelyn in the following mission:[list][*]Fading Pulse Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Llywelyn's Thoughts in the following mission:[list][*]Alban Knights Training Grounds Mission[/*][/list][/*][*]Succubus Fiend in the following mission:[list][*]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon[/*][*]Rabbie Phantasm Mirror World Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][*]Disciple, Dark Disciple, and Melci Diafol in the following dungeon:[list][*]Crom Bás Dungeon[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Ally NPCs[/b]
[list][*]Treasure Hunter[/*][*]Llywelyn[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The attribute option text has been changed slightly for certain content to reflect the talent changes.[list][*]Only the name of the option has been changed. The content, appearance, and probability are unchanged.[/*][*]This affects certain descriptions for Reforging and Echostone attributes, Glyphwrighting stats, Erg stats, and the Skill Master titles related to Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Gold Renewal Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Gold Update[/b][/h2]
Improvements to the Gold currency system have been made!
[list][*]Gold no longer occupies inventory space. It is now stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.[/*][*]All Gold stored in your inventory in the form of Gold, Gold Pouches, and Gold Boxes has been changed to the value amount of Gold you have.[list][*][b]Immediately after the update, your Gold amount may exceed the maximum Gold storage limit.[/b] You will be unable to obtain Gold until you store the amount you have in the Bank or in a Pet's inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1733/mabinogi-gold-amount-of-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]The maximum Gold limit that each character, Pet, or Partner character can store is 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).[/*][*]A character's maximum Gold limit can be increased by an additional 1 Million Gold when the character achieves cumulative level 10,000. [list][*]This is not applicable to Pets/Partners.[/*][*]Characters who have already reached cumulative level 10,000 or higher will have their maximum Gold limit increased the first time they log in after the update.[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum Gold limit can be increased further up to 100,000,000 Gold (100 Million).[list][*]Gold Box items have been changed to a consumption item that increased the maximum Gold limit for the character that consumes it.[/*][*]When using Lorna or Pan's Gold Box, the limit is increased by 50,000 Gold.[/*][*]When using Lorna, Pan, or Blaanid's Special Gold Box, the limit is increased by 100,000 Gold.[/*][*][b]Important Notes[/b][list][*]Pet and Partner gold limit cannot be increased.[/*][*]The Gold Box Upgrade Coupon items function as usual to upgrade a Gold Box to the Special version.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If you obtain Gold that exceeds your character's carrying capacity, the excess amount will fall to the floor.[/*][*]If the total amount of Gold you are holding reaches the maximum limit, you can no longer pick up Gold.[/*][*]When selling items at an NPC shop, you cannot sell any items if the sale price exceeds your maximum Gold limit.[/*][*]Gold can be exchanged through the [b]Give [/b]and [b]Claim[/b] buttons in a Pet's or Partner's inventory.[list][*][b]Give [/b]can be used to store Gold in a Pet/Partner's inventory, up to 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).[list][*]You can also pick up Gold and transfer them directly.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Claim[/b] can be used to withdraw and receive the Gold amount to your character's inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1732/mabinogi-gold-give-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]Gold now stacks to 50,000 when picked up from the character's inventory or when obtained from certain content.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Gold dropped from a Dungeon End Chest will now be dropped as a Gold stack instead of a Big Gold Pouch.[/*][/list][/*][*]Gold can be divided and picked up from a character's inventory by clicking on the Gold button in the main inventory.[list][*]50,000 Gold is the maximum amount that can be picked up.[/*][*]You can drop Gold on the ground or give them to NPCs this way.[/*][*]If you put the Gold back into your inventory, it will return your Gold value.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1731/mabinogi-gold-pick-up-gold.png[/img]
[list][*]When Trading (including Trading during Pet battles), the Gold button can be clicked to select the amount of Gold you wish to trade.[list][*]A maximum of 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million) can be traded at once through this method.[/*][*]Checks can be traded as normal and the total value of Gold being traded will be shown as the cumulative amount of Gold and Checks added to the trade.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1730/mabinogi-gold-checks.png[/img]
[/*][*]If the trade recipient does not have enough room in their inventory to receive the Gold amount, Gold cannot be added to the trade window.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]Gold cannot be picked up from the main inventory window while trading.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you attempt to withdraw Gold from the Bank and you have already reached the maximum Gold limit in your inventory, the Gold value will be shown as 0.[list][*]You are still able to issue a Check however.[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Gold" tag has been removed as a selection from the list of bag tags for Item Bag organization.[/*][*]The acquisition method for obtaining Gold from certain content has been changed to distribute Gold to your Gold value automatically.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]Raids, Alban Knights Training Grounds, Sidhe Finnachaid, notes.title: Gold Pouch Removal
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

Recently, we’ve posted a [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/74397/producer-s-letter-upcoming-summer-content]Producer’s Letter[/url] with more information on what is to come for Mabinogi in the next few months. We’ve announced that the Gold Renewal Update is coming soon... on [b]May 26th, 2022[/b]!

A few changes to come with this update include:
[list][*]Gold coins stored in gold pouches, gold boxes, and in the inventory will be changed to be stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.[/*][*]The maximum Gold storage limit in your character’s inventory will start at 1,000,000 Gold, and will be increased by another 1,000,000 Gold when you reach cumulative level 10,000.[/*][*]The carrying capacity can be increased even higher using gold boxes up to 100,000,000 Gold.[/*][/list]
With the update, [b]all gold pouches will be removed from the game.[/b] This includes gold pouches being traded on the Auction House. [b]Please remove all gold pouches from the Auction House so that you do not lose any Gold from the auction sale.[/b]

We are excited to share more about the update and all that is to come on May 26th!

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Upcoming Summer Content
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

Now that we are all together in Erinn, I would like to share a list of updates that we have planned for the remainder of Q2 and the start of Summer. Much of this content has been pre-determined, and we are looking into adding more content, events, improvements, sales, and more for you to enjoy. We are checking your feedback regularly and we are doing our best to include them in our current and future plans.

[b]May[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1629/mabinogi-producer-letter-renovation-s3.png[/img]

[b]Renovation Season 3: Combat Talent Update (Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry)[/b]
[list][*]
Updates to 3 classic combat Talents including Skills, Stats, and more. Damage calculation of these Talents will become more effective, and some of the inconvenient or ineffective aspects of some Skills will be improved.
[/*][/list]
[b]Gold Renewal[/b]
[list][*]
Storing Gold will be changed to be similar to the Bank/Ducats. Existing and newly acquired Gold boxes can be used to increase the Maximum Gold limit in your inventory.
[/*][/list]
[b]June[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1501/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-5.png[/img]

[b]Fahmes Ruin[/b]
[list][*]
In early June, a new 30 level solo dungeon in Iria will be available called the Fahmes Ruin. Higher levels of the dungeon should prove to be challenging for even the most seasoned Milletians. There will also be a monthly ranking system that provides rewards for those who reach the highest ranks.
[/*][/list]
[b]Great Era of Commerce[/b]
[list][*]
Later in June, Commerce will be renewed with new transports and updated commodities to trade. New ports will be added, bringing Commerce to Iria and further connecting the world of Erinn. 
[/*][/list]
[b]Summer Master Plan[/b]
[list][*]
Weekly Buffs, Missions, etc are back again for the bi-annual event.
[/*][/list]
[b]July[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1628/mabinogi-producer-letter-commerece-2.png[/img]

[b]Great Era of Commerce expansion throughout Erinn[/b]
[list][*]
New stories will be shared, and air trade is on the horizon. Grab a party and commerce together and discover the wealth of being a merchant.
[/*][/list]
Thank you for your continued support of Mabinogi.

Sincerely,

[i]-Enrico “GM Supreme”
Mabinogi Producer[/i]

[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.[/*][*]Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.[/*][*]The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.[/*][*]A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.[/*][*]There is a chance that when logging off, you will not return to the character selection screen and will be kicked to the start menu with the error, "Server cannot be reached". This means you will need to shut down your game client and log in to the account again if you are attempting to switch characters.[/*][*]Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.
[/*][*]Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.[/*][*]The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.[/*][*]A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:[list][*]Fabric -> Cheap Fabric[/*][*]Common Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)[/*][*]Silk -> Cheap Silk[/*][*]Common Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)
[/*][*]The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread[/*][/list][/*][*]"Macaroon" recipe and food item name is incorrect and will be changed to "Macaron".[/*][*]Attempting to delete a character may result in a "Failed to delete the character." error message.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Life Master's Order Event
notes.content:
The time has come to train your life skills. Head to the Lazing-about Life Master so that they may guide you with their wisdom to achieve your life skill dreams! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, April 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Life Master Snooping Around Dunbarton.[/b][/*][*]Find the [b]Lazing-about Life Master Milletian[/b] in front of the [b]Dunbarton Bank.[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Lazing-about Life Master Milletian.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A Life Master Snooping Around Dunbarton:[list][*][b]77,777 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]After registering your main character, you will also receive the Achievement quest, [b][Event] 2nd Generation Life Master's Additional Orders.[/b][/*][*]Talk to the Lazing-about Life Master Milletian again to learn more about the event and to receive the following:[list][*][b]2nd Generation Master's List of Orders[/b][list][*]Use this item to select up to [b]2 Daily Order quests per day.[/b][/*][*]Resets every day at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]Per daily quest completion, depending on each quest, you'll obtain the following rewards:[list][*][b]2nd Generation Master's Good Job! Stamp x1 or x2[/b][/*][*][b]Special Experience Fruit (300%) (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/b] [b]x1 OR Life Skill 2x EXP Potion (10 Minutes) (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/b] [b]x2[/b][/*][*][b]77,777 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]2nd Generation Master's Gift Card[/b][list][*]Use this item to exchange your Good Job! and Nice to Meet You! stamps for rewards.[/*][*]You cannot use this item after the event ends.[/*][*]Exchange your Good Job! stamps for [b]Skill Training Seal (10) Coupons[/b] via the 2nd Generation Master's Gift Card.[list][*]Skill Training Seal (10) Coupons can only be used during the event period.[list][*]Use this coupon to select a Skill Training Seal of your choice.[/*][*]If you have a Life Talent as your active talent, you will also receive one extra Skill Training Seal for a random skill as a bonus.[list][*]Can be applied to Life Talents: Adventure, Mercantile, Cooking, Smithing, Medicine, Carpentry, Pet Training, and Glyphwriting (excluding Holy Arts)[/*][/list][/*][*]You cannot use ordinary Skill Training Seals on skills Rank 1+ or Hero Talent Skills. [/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Login Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*]Every day when you log in, you will receive the [b]2nd Generation Master's Nice to Meet You! Stamp.[/b][list][*]Exchange your Nice to Meet You! Stamps for [b]Master's Skill Training Seal[/b] (Not tradable) (Expires in 60 days) if your talent is at least Expert or Master levels via the 2nd Generation Master's Gift Card.[/*][*]You can only earn up to 14 Nice to Meet You! Stamps during the event.[/*][/list][/*][*]This resets every day at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Achievement Quest[/b][/h2][list][*]The Lazing-about Life Master Milletian will have rewards for you when you complete the daily order quest 6, 12, and 18 times respectively.[/*][*]You must receive a reward in order to continue progress on the next completion reward.[/*][*]You will earn the following rewards:
[list][*]Complete the 2nd Generation Master's Order Quest [b]6 Times:[/b]
[list][*][b]2nd Generation Master's First Gift Box (Untradeable)[/b] which contains:
[list][*]Rebirth Potion (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][*]AP 30 Potion (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][*]Royal Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day) (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 2nd Generation Master's Order Quest [b]12 Times:[/b]
[list][*][b]2nd Generation Master's Second Gift Box (Untradeable)[/b] which contains:
[list][*]Rebirth Potion (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][*]Royal Academy Crystal x10 (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][*]Enhanced Alban Knights Divine Fruit (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the 2nd Generation Master's Order Quest [b]18 Times:[/b]
[list][*][b]2nd Generation Master's Third Gift Box (Untradeable)[/b] which contains:
[list][*]Mysterious Spirit Stone (300%) (Not tradeable) (Expires in 7 days)[/*][*]Master's Skill Training Seal (Tradable Once) (Expires in 60 days)[/*][*]Lucky Advancement Ticket Selection Box (Box is not tradable and expire in 30 days) (Contents are tradable once and expire in 30 days)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Event Notes[/b][/h2][list][*]If you accidentally destroy the 2nd Generation Master's List of Orders or 2nd Generation Master's Gift Card, you can talk to the event NPC again using [Ask about the event] to receive the item again.[/*][*]If you keep completing daily order quests without talking to the Lazing-about Life Master Milletian in Dunbarton at 6 and 12 completions, you will not accrue progress towards the next completion goal. Make sure to turn in your completion quest once you've finished each stage of it![/*][*]All event quests and event items (including Good Job!/Nice to Meet You! Stamps, 2nd Generation Master's Gift Card, and Skill Training Seal (10) Coupons) will be deleted after the event ends.[/*][/list]

notes.title: RE:Life Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Production Crafting Diary[/b][/h2][list][*]The Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.
[list][*]You can also set a hotkey shortcut for this menu in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings -> Crafting Diary.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1446/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary.png[/img]
[list][*]You can view the production completion records for all items crafted for the following skills:[list][*][b]Tailoring[/b][/*][*][b]Weaving[/b][/*][*][b]Handicraft[/b][/*][*][b]Blacksmithing[/b][/*][*][b]Potion Making[/b][/*][*][b]Carpentry[/b][/*][*][b]Hillwen Engineering[/b][/*][*][b]Magic Craft[/b][/*][*][b]Stationery Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Fynn Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Refining[/b][/*][*][b]Milling[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Any time an item is crafted, it is automatically collected in the Crafting Diary.[list][*][b]Note: [/b]Items made with Sewing Patterns and Manuals that can only be obtained from specific ways, such as part-time jobs or events/mainstreams quests, are excluded from the collection of the Crafting Diary.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1448/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The Crafting Diary is divided into two sections; Collection Items and Achievements.[/*][*]When viewing an item from the [b]Collection Items[/b] tab:[list][*]You can view all craftable items that can be collected in the Crafting Diary and view the date you've first crafted an item.[list][*]You can sort by View All, Completed Items, or Uncompleted Items.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can view any related achievements that the item is associated with and your achievement progress. Clicking on a related achievement will bring up the achievement details.[list][*]Example: Crafting a Hairband fulfills the requirement for the achievement, "Novice Crafter - Tailoring".[/*][/list][/*][*]You can open the corresponding crafting menu by clicking on the hammer icon.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1444/mabinogi-relife-crafting-diary-achievements.png[/img]
[list][*]On the [b]Achievements[/b] tab, you can view items needed to complete each achievement.[list][*]If you craft all the items related to an achievement, you can obtain the [b]Completion Rewards[/b] for each achievement.[/*][*]You can only obtain the Completion Rewards once per crafting achievement.[/*][*]You only need to craft an item once for it to count towards all related achievements that require collecting the same item.[/*][*]You can obtain different item rewards when completing each achievement, such as crafting materials, Forgetful Potions, Training Potions, and more.[/*][*]The following rewards are new items that can be obtained from the Crafting Diary:[list][*][b]Crafting Quality Increase Potion Selection Box (Not tradable)
[/b][list][*]Select a potion for one of the following skills:
[list][*]Hillwen Engineering[/*][*]Magic Craft[/*][*]Blacksmithing[/*][*]Tailoring[/*][*]Carpentry[/*][/list][/*][*]When the potion is used, your skill's production quality is increased by 5 for your next crafting finishing attempt.[/*][*]The effect disappears after completing your item craft.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Echostone Advancement Assist Potion[/b]
[list][*]Increases the level up chance for your next Echostone level advancement attempt by a set amount of 10%. It is consumed once the advancement attempt has been made.[/*][*]This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erg Unlock Assist Potion[/b]
[list][*]Increases the unlock chance for your next Erg level break attempt by a set amount based on the current Erg level. It is consumed once the unlock attempt has been made.[/*][*]This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Erg Level[/b][/th][th][b]Potion Percentage Increase[/b][/th][th][b]Final Success Rate[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]5 -> 6[/td][td]10%[/td][td]100%[/td][/tr][tr][td]10 -> 11[/td][td]10%[/td][td]70%[/td][/tr][tr][td]15 -> 16[/td][td]10%[/td][td]40%[/td][/tr][tr][td]20 -> 21[/td][td]10%[/td][td]25%[/td][/tr][tr][td]25 -> 26[/td][td]5%[/td][td]10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]30 -> 31[/td][td]4%[/td][td]6%[/td][/tr][tr][td]35 -> 36[/td][td]3%[/td][td]4%[/td][/tr][tr][td]40 -> 41[/td][td]1.30%[/td][td]2%[/td][/tr][tr][td]45 -> 46[/td][td]0.70%[/td][td]1%[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]New Journal Achievements[/b]
[list][*]New Journal achievements for crafting items and completing Crafting Diary achievements have been added.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Journal Name[/b][/th][th][b]Achievement Requirement[/b][/th][th][b]Journal Score[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Crafting 100 Items - Complete![/td][td]

You can search for craftable items using the search bar.[/*][*]Even if you do not have the equipment required for crafting, you can check the related UI and crafting information.
[list][*]This excludes Milling as it requires being next to a Mill.[/*][*]Crafting is possible only after wearing equipment needed and putting in required materials into the crafting menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]The "Auto Register Tools and Materials" button has been added so that all materials and crafting tool items can be automatically registered and equipped.
[list][*]You will need to manually equip corresponding skill's crafting equipment if you already have different tools equipped.[/*][/list][/*][*]Improvements have been made so that the remaining materials are returned when more material items are put in the crafting menu than the recipe's required quantity.[/*][*]In the case of the Cooking skill, if the the equipment you wear does not match the cooking recipe as a result of the selection, it will not be crafted.[/*][*]The UI text for "Automatic Production" and "Production Quantity" has been changed as follows:[list][*]Queue/Automatic Production -> Continuous Auto Craft[/*][*]Produce/Production Quantity -> Quantity[/*][/list][/*][*]When using [b]Tailoring or Blacksmithing skills,[/b] you can now toggle to show only the Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith Manuals that you have in your inventory.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1445/mabinogi-relife-manuals.png[/img]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1450/mabinogi-relife-cooking.png[/img]
[h2][b]Crafting Success Rate Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*]The maximum success rate cap of 99% has been removed.[/*][*]You can now achieve 100% success rate when attempting to craft using the following crafting skills:[list][*][b]Tailoring[/b][/*][*][b]Blacksmithing[/b][/*][*][b]Weaving[/b][/*][*][b]Refining[/b][/*][*][b]Milling[/b][/*][*][b]Potion Making[/b][/*][*][b]Handicraft[/b][/*][*][b]Carpentry[/b][/*][*][b]Hillwen Engineering[/b][/*][*][b]Magic Craft[/b][/*][*][b]Fynn Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Stationery Crafting[/b][/*][*][b]Mana Crystallization[/b][/*][*][b]Crystal Making[/b][/*][*][b]Metal Conversion[/b][/*][*][b]Using the Magical Spinning Wheel (Making Theatre Mission Passes)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The chance of failure has been removed when gathering Water, Fragrant Honey Water, and Fragrant Honey Milk.[/*][*]Experience gained for all Production crafts has been increased across the board.[/*][/list][h2][b]New Crafting Recipes and Items[/b][/h2][list][*]18 new Tailoring Sewing Patterns for new outfit sets have been added.[/*][*]You can view the materials required for each craft in the Tailoring Crafting menu.[/*][*]These Sewing Patterns can be obtained from certain Tech Duinn Missions (all difficulties).[list][*]The more difficult the Tech Duinn mission, the higher the probability of obtaining a Sewing Pattern.[/*][*]Each Sewing Pattern requires Rank 1 Tailoring and has a use count limit of 10.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Sewing Patterns can be obtained from [b]Tech Duinn Mission - Revived Illusion:[/b]

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Regarding the Erinn Server Merge
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

I want to sincerely apologize for the longer than expected downtime experienced while merging Alexina and Nao. To give you all an understanding of the events, here is a summarized timeline of the maintenance and issues that occurred on April 14th.

Our testing prior to the merge went as we had planned and we were proceeding along as we had expected. We opened the servers publicly at 4 PM PDT as we had announced. Though the high volume of logins was expected, the Login Server was unable to handle amount of simultaneous requests shortly after opening. This resulted in players unable to reach the lobby or enter into the game world. After closing the server, we found errors related to Fynni Pets causing extra requests to the login and fixed them before re-opening again at 7:45 PM PDT.

Unfortunately, the login issues remained so we shut down the servers again to resume investigating the cause. We tried our best to fix the login issue to the best of our ability. There is a chance that when logging off, you will return to the Character selection screen and return to the start menu with an error, "Server cannot be reached." This means that you will need to shut down your game client and log in to the account again (if you are attempting to switch characters). We will continue to work on a permanent fix to this issue in a future patch.

Currently, we will extend the Double Rainbow Event until the end of Monday, April 18th. Other compensations will be discussed and announced next week and applied during the next scheduled maintenance on April 21st.

Thank you for your understanding throughout all of this. We are truly sorry that this has affected your ability to share the world of Erinn together the past two days. We will continue to update the situation and hope to have better news soon.
Humbly,

[i]- Enrico "GM Supreme"
Mabinogi Producer[/i]

notes.title: Milletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering
notes.content:
Have you ever wished you had a chance to do more activities with your guild and earn rewards for it? Well now you can, Milletians! Roy is here to help you earn rewards for playing with guild members! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[h2][b]The Grand Guild Gathering[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Roy [/b]in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square.[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with Roy.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Guild Activity Journal[/b][list][*]This item can be stored in the "Me" inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to participate, your character must be in a guild. [list][*]If you have just joined a guild, you will be considered a [b]new guild member. [/b]You can participate in certain parts of the event after 3 days have passed since you've joined the guild.[/*][/list][/*][*]If you are not in a guild, you can still receive Guild Activity Coins, but you will not gain Guild Activity EXP Points.[/*][*]If you quit a guild while participating in the event, the Guild Activity EXP Points you've earned will reset. The Guild Activity Coins will still remain, but you will not be able to use Roy's Guild Event Shop, and the special Guild Member Buffs.[/*][*]If you quit a guild while participating in the event, and rejoin another guild, you will be considered a new guild member and will need to wait 3 days to participate in certain parts of the event.[/*][*]Right-click "Use" on the Guild Activity Journal to open it and check information related to guild activities.[b]
[/b][list][*][b]Check Guild Activity EXP[/b][list][*]You can check your [b]Individual Guild Activity EXP points [/b]and the [b]Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points[/b] that have been obtained for the week.[/*][*]There are several ways to gain Guild Activity EXP points.[/*][*]Guild Activity EXP resets every week on Thursday at 7:00 AM PDT in real time.[/*][*]Please note that it can take up to 5 minutes for the Guild EXP to update in the Guild Activity Journal.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Claim your Weekly Guild Reward[/b][list][*]To achieve the weekly guild reward, you and your guild will need to obtain a certain amount of Guild Activity EXP Points.[list][*][b]5,000 or more Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points[/b][/*][*][b]500 or more Individual Guild Activity EXP Points[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Once both of the above requirements have been meet, the [b]Weekly Guild Reward Box[/b] can be claimed.[b]
[/b][list][*]This reward can only be claimed once per week.[/*][*]You can only claim the reward during the week, before the reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Earning Guild Activity EXP and Coins[/b][/h2][list][*]To earn Guild Activity EXP and Guild Activity Coins, you must participate in various activities.[list][*]One way to earn EXP and coins is by clearing the [b]Erinn Adventure Journal [/b]missions.[list][*]You will receive an equal amount of Guild Activity EXP and Guild Activity Coins as the EXP awarded when completing an Erinn Adventure Journal mission.[/*][*][b][u]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/u] We recommend registering for this event and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73309/erinn-adventure-journal-special-server-merge-season]Erinn Adventure Journal[/url] on the same character as the Guild Activity EXP and Coins are obtained through the Erinn Adventure Journal[/b]. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Eliminate Mokkurkalfi [/b]is a special mission that you can participate in with other guild members to earn EXP and coins.[list][*]Speak with Roy to [b]Enter Guild Cooperative Mission.[/b][/*][*]You can enter solo or in a party with up to 8 guild members.[/*][*]All party members must be in the same guild.[/*][*]If you are a [b]new guild member[/b], you will not receive Guild Activity EXP until 3 days have passed since you joined the guild.[list][*]If you complete the mission after 3 days have passed, you can earn the 500 Guild Activity EXP.[/*][/list][/*][*]For the first clear, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*]500 Guild Activity EXP[/*][*]500 Guild Activity Coins[/*][*]Eliminate Mokkukalfi Reward Box[/*][/list][/*][*]You can still enter the mission multiple times, but you can only receive the rewards once per week.[/*][*]The weekly clear will be reset every week on Thursdays at 7 AM PDT in real time.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Special Guild Buffs[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, you will receive the special [b]Power of Guild Pride [/b]buff after registering your main character.[list][*]New guild members can acquire the buff by talking to Roy after 3 days have passed since joining a guild.[/*][*][b]Power of Guild Pride Buff[/b][list][*]Increases Attack Power by 15[/*][*]Increases Magic Attack by 10[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When participating in the Eliminate Mokkurkalfi notes.title: Erinn Adventure Journal - Special Server Merge Season
notes.content:
The Erinn Adventure Journal is here! Complete different tasks to update the Journal and gain rewards each time the Journal levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can use Pon to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.

[b]Season Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[h2][b]Erinn Adventure Journal[/b][/h2][list][*]During the Special Server Merge Season (Season 1), you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Chronicling an Adventure.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Eavan [/b]in [b]Dunbarton[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only participate with one character, and this [b]CANNOT[/b] be changed.[/*][*][b][u]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/u] We recommend registering for this event and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73587/milletian-events-the-grand-guild-gathering]Grand Guild Gathering[/url] event on the same character as the Guild Activity EXP and Coins are obtained through the Erinn Adventure Journal[/b]. [/*][*]To open the [b]Erinn Adventure Journal,[/b] on the main task bar click on Character -> Adventure Journal.[list][*]You can also set a hotkey shortcut for it in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings[/*][/list][/*][*]With the Journal, you will receive various Daily, Weekly, and Challenge missions.[list][*][b]Daily missions [/b]reset every day at [b]7 AM PDT.[/b][b]
[/b][/*][*][b]Weekly missions[/b] reset every [b]Thursday at 7 AM PDT.[/b][/*][*][b]Challenge missions[/b] can be completed [b]once during the season period.[/b]
[list][*]When some Challenge mission are completed, a newly linked mission will be available for the following missions:[list][*][b]Fish Fear Me[/b] - Catch a fish 100 times (any type) -> 200 times -> 300 times[/*][*][b]A Time to Reap [/b]- Gather 100 times (any type) -> 200 times -> 300 times[/*][*][b]Pet Projects - [/b]Complete a Pet Expedition 15 times -> 30 times -> 45 times[/*][*][b]Expert Exterminator [/b]- Defeat 500 monsters (any type) -> 1,000 monsters -> 1,500 monsters[/*][*][b]Complete Sidhe Finnachaid of -  [/b]Curiosity 1 time -> Fear 1 time -> Sorrow 1 time[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Each time you complete a task, the mission will automatically complete and you will receive [b]Adventure EXP.[/b][/*][*]Collect Adventure EXP to raise the [b]Journal Grade.[/b][/*][*]There are 21 grades in total and each grade requires 200 EXP to reach the next grade.[list][*]Reaching Grade 21 requires 4,200 Adventure EXP.[/*][/list][/*][*]A total of 5,400 Adventure EXP can be obtained by completing missions during Season 1.[list][*][b]Daily Missions[/b] = 1,960 EXP (70 EXP daily * 28 days)[/*][*][b]Weekly Missions[/b] = 1,640 EXP (410 EXP per week * 4 weeks)[/*][*][b]Challenge Missions[/b] = 1,800 EXP (including linked missions)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Normal Rewards[/b] can be claimed any time you reach a new grade.[/*][*][b]Special Rewards[/b] can be unlocked using [b]150 Pon[/b].[/*][*][b]Note:[/b] You can only Claim Rewards while the Erinn Adventure Journal season is active. Unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character’s Point Inventory after the season ends.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1073/mabinogi-adventure-journal-s1-ui.png[/img]

[u]Season 1 of the Erinn Adventure Journal contains many exclusive rewards to commemorate the Server Merge. These rewards are better than ever, including special titles, the new Heavy Jacket outfit set, and more![/u]

notes.title: Together in Erinn - Updated FAQ
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

We’re a few days away from being [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73024/together-in-erinn][b]Together in Erinn[/b][/url]! You can view the maintenance details here: [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73595/server-merge-scheduled-maintenance-april-14th]Scheduled Maintenance - April 14th[/url]

We’ve verified several details during testing and have updated several questions below. We have also removed the [b]Bard Bulletin Board[/b] and [b]MabiNovel Bulletin Board[/b] from the list of contents that will be reset with the merge, as these contents will be merged and not reset.

As noted previously, there are several restrictions that are required when merging the Alexina server data with the Nao server data. Please review the below restrictions which will mainly affect characters from Alexina, and check the FAQ for further details on each content.
[table][tr][th][b]Content[/b][/th][th][b]Alexina[/b][/th][th][b]Nao[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Character Name across servers (Character/Pet/Partner)[/td][td]Will be changed to "Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Homestead Names across servers[/td][td]Will be changed to "Homestead Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Family Names across servers[/td][td]Will be changed to "Family Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marriage Info and Marriage Title[/td][td]Marriage Info will be merged.

If the character's name is changed, the new name will not be reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title.[/td][td]Marriage Info will be merged.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wedding Rings[/td][td]Cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Wedding Rings remain in-game for Nao characters.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets[/td][td]Cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets remain in-game for Nao characters.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pet Houses, Pet Expeditions, and Partners in Homestead[/td][td]Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will not remain in this state.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will remain in this state.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Housing Shop Marketplace[/td][td]Items stored in the Shop will be merged. Unfortunately, Gold used to bid on the shop originally and Gold stored in the Shop will not be merged. 

If you have any Gold stored in the marketplace before the merge maintenance, please claim it so that no gold is lost.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Items and gold stored in the Shop will be merged.[/td][/tr][tr][td]UI/Hotkey Reset[/td][td]Will be affected by Hotkey/UI Reset.
Unique to Alexina characters, the pets assigned to a Fynn Pet's Friend Summoning hotkey slot will be reset. Pets can be added to the hotkey slot as normal after merge.[/td][td]Will be affected by Hotkey/UI Reset.
Pets assigned to a Fynn Pet's Friend Summoning hotkey slot will not be reset.[/td][/tr][/table]
We’ll see you all very soon!

[u]- The Mabinogi Team[/u]

[b]Updated FAQ[/b]

[b][Updated] Q: When is the server merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] You can view the maintenance details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/73595/server-merge-scheduled-maintenance-april-14th]on the webpost.[/url]

[b][Updated] Q: How will this affect my character?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] Please check the full restrictions posted at the top of the FAQ.

[b][Updated] Q: Will I be able to change my character name? Can I change my name back to my original name if it was changed?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We will offer additional name change support for Alexina characters in certain cases. Please view the [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/5412435980436][b]Customer Support article[/b][/url] for more information.

[b][Updated] Q: Will anything happen to my Family or Family Name?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Duplicate family names across both servers will be changed for Alexina characters: 'Family Name+Server Name', e.g. My Sweet Family+Alexina. Nao family names will not be changed.

[b][Updated] Q: Will my Marriage Info be affected by the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] For both Nao and Alexina characters, Marriage Info will be merged. If the character's name is changed, the new name will not be reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title.

Wedding Rings for Alexina cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game. Though the ring will be removed, please be assured that this will not break the character or the character’s marriage status. Should you wish to divorce and re-marry, it may be necessary to perform a ‘Forced Divorce’ option through both spouses first. Wedding Rings for Nao characters will remain intact.

[b][Updated] Q: What happens if I have a Shop in the Marketplace (formerly Housing)? What about the items that are left in the Shop Inventory?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [u]The Marketplace contents will not be merged.[/u] The option to bid on a Shop has been temporarily turned off with the March 24th maintenance, and any currently leased shop contracts will expire before the merge date. [u]Please retrieve any items placed in your Marketplace Shop Inventory or any items in the 'Retrieve Items' menu accessed through the Marketplace bank NPC before the merge date on April 14th so that any items are not lost. Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.[/u]

Items stored in the Marketplace for Alexina characters will be merged. Unfortunately, the gold or the gold used to originally bid on the Shop will not be merged. If you have any Gold stored in the marketplace before the merge maintenance, please claim it so no gold is lost. Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Items and gold stored in the Marketplace for Nao characters will be merged.

After the merge, accounts that owned a Shop will be able to claim the items stored in the Shop through the Bank NPC in the Marketplace where the original Shop was.

[b][Updated] Q: Will the Meet-Cute Bracelet/Rose Couple’s Bracelet effect still work after the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] For Alexina characters only, after the merge, the paired effect will no longer work and will be removed from the game.

All current Meet-Cute Bracelets/Rose Couple's Bracelets will be removed for Alexina characters, and the Peas in a Pod Gift Box/Rose Couple's Bracelet Gem Box will be distributed back to the character that originally opened the box. The Couple’s Bracelets will need to be traded to your preferred partner again after the merge. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets remain in-game for Nao characters.

[b][Updated] Q: Will the merge affect my Ego Spirit Weapon?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All Spirit Weapons will be merged. The Spirit Bond, Spirit Level/EXP, Spirit Skills, and Spirit Appearances will all remain intact.

[b][Updated] Q: What will happen to my data from newer contents, such as the Dungeon Guide, Stardust, Pet Houses, Fynn Pets, Fynni Pets, Pet Perks, Beauty Slots, Spirit Weapons, etc.?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All data will be merged for your character.

Pet Related: Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will not remain in this state for Alexina characters only. Pets/Partners will be removed from the Homestead and can be summoned normally or placed back in the Homestead after the merge.

[b]If you have any ongoing or completed Expeditions, please claim the rewards before the merge maintenance.[/b]

Nao characters will not be affected by this.

Dungeon Guide: For accounts that registered for the Dungeon Guide across servers, the Dungeon Guide clear counts will be merged.

Example: If you cleared Alby Dungeon 10 times on Nao and 10 times on Alexina, your Dungeon Guide clear count for Alby Dungeon will be at 20 clears after the merge.

After the merge, you can change your registered main character to receive Vouchers at NPC Eavan in Dunbarton. Additionally, Vouchers received across characters can be transferred across characters through the bank.

Unclaimed rewards will be merged. [b]However, we suggest claiming any unclaimed Dungeon Guide Repeated Clear Rewards before the merge if you played on both servers.[/b]

[b][Updated] Q: What contents will be reset with the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The following contents will be reset with the merge:
[list][*]Altruist Leaderboard[/*][*]Apocalypse Raid first party clear[/*][*]Auction House Market Price Data[/*][*][u]Bard Bulletin Board[/u][/*][*]Commerce Trading Board Information (each town)[/*][*]Cooking Journal: The 'Master Chef' and Master Chef's comments for the server.[/*][*]Current Guardian Guilds[/*][*]Fashion Contest Winner[/*][*]Festia Weekly Ranking Board[/*][*][u]MabiNovel Bulletin Board[/u][/*][*]Royal Alchemists and Upgrade Methods found by Royal Alchemists.[/*][*]Seal Stones
[list][*]The Seal Stones will need to be broken again in the new server, granting the respective Seal-Breaker titles to the character who breaks the seal.[/*][*]Characters who obtained the Seal-Breaker title previously will still be able to use the Seal-Breaker title.[/*][/list][/*][*]Though all events should end before the merge date, please be advised that the main character selection will be reset.[/*][*]General UI saved settings will be reset, including hotkey bar placements, extra skill slots, and saved pet organization and tabs.[/*][/list]
We know this can be an inconvenience, so we sincerely apologize in advance! We strongly suggest taking screenshots of your hotkey placements so you may set up your hotkeys again once the merge is complete.

[b][Updated] Q: Will the Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward be reset for the Erinn Server?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward will be reset. Who will be the next party to claim the Gravedigger title?

[b][Updated] Q: Will anything happen to my Homestead?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Duplicate Homestead names across both servers will be changed for Alexina characters: Homestead Name+Server Name', e.g. My Sweet Home+Alexina. Nao Homestead names will not be changed.

[b][Updated] Q: Will I still receive royalties for a MabiNovel that has been posted prior to the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [u]As the MabiNovel Bulletin Board has been reset,[/u] you may not receive these royalties. We apologize for any inconvenience.

The MabiNovel Bulletin Board will no longer be reset.

Milletians, the servers will be down until further notice to address an issue found with the login servers caused by Fynni Pets. We will continue to update the ETA when we can. For the seal stone concerns, only 1 seal stone was broken in Rabbie.
