notes.title: Together in Erinn
notes.content:
Hello Milletians!

By the time you are reading this post, we have just had our 14th Anniversary livestream where we've announced a [b]super special TOTALLY SECRET surprise![/b]

[b]Together in Erinn
[/b][b]April 14th, 2022[/b]

[b]Alexina and Nao servers will be merged together into a new server, Erinn.[/b] The anticipated server merge date is [b]Thursday, April 14th.[/b] We know that this merger has been highly anticipated and are excited to announce that all players of Mabinogi will be together on one server moving forward. We hope that this will bring new opportunities for you as a community to come together and create more memories in the world of Erinn.

Please carefully [b]read[/b] below for the information related to the upcoming April 14th server merge.

[b]March 24th Changes[/b]

Several restrictions to the game have been added in order to prepare for the upcoming server merge. [b]As of the March 24th maintenance, the following changes have been made, affecting Alexina and Nao servers:[/b]
[list][*]New character, pet, and partner creation has been turned off until April 14th.
[list][*]New characters will be unavailable to be created using character cards or pet whistles.[/*][/list][/*][*]Guild creation and guild stone creation will be unavailable until April 14th.
[list][*]Note: The 'Guild Formation Permit' and 'Guild Stone Installation Permit' will be available for purchase, but cannot be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]Leasing a Taillteann farm option will be disabled until April 14th.[/*][*]Leasing a Shop Marketplace (Housing) option will be disabled until April 14th.[/*][*]Any currently leased shop contracts in the Marketplace will expire before the April 14th merge. Please be sure to retrieve any items left in the Shop inventory [b]as these items cannot be merged.[/b][/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change[/url] page on the website will be unavailable for use until after the server merge on April 14th. [/*][/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience that these restrictions hold for this duration of time as we prepare the servers.

[b]Important Notice[/b]

Below we have compiled several frequently asked questions about the server merge, many of which have not changed since the Nao server merge.

However, we want to highlight an important difference for the merge this time. During the Nao merge, there were several restrictions that impacted all characters. As we felt it was crucial to reduce the impact to Nao characters, who have already been through a merge previously, certain restrictions [b]will only affect Alexina characters.[/b] For example, duplicate character names across servers will only be changed for Alexina characters to “Name+Alexina” and Nao character names will not be changed. As there are certain limitations when merging servers together, these restrictions affecting Alexina characters cannot be avoided. We are still verifying how this will affect each server and the details for certain data unable to be merged, such as Wedding Rings.

We will follow up with the full list of restrictions for each server when we are closer to the merge date, as this will need to be fully confirmed during our testing. Thank you for your understanding, and please find the answers to the FAQ below.

[b]Server Merge FAQ[/b]

[b]Server Information[/b]

[b]Q: When is the server merge?
[/b][b]A:[/b] The anticipated server merge date is [b]Thursday, April 14th, 2022[/b]. Details on the merge maintenance will be shared at a later date.

[b]Q: Which servers are merging?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Alexina server will be merged together with the Nao server into a new server, Erinn.

[b]Q: How many channels will the Erinn server have?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Erinn server will have 10 main channels. We will be monitoring this in case we need to increase the number of channels in the future[b].
[/b]

[b]Character and Pet Information
[/b]

[b]Q: How will this affect my character? [/b]
[b]A:[/b] All characters will be merged. Certain restrictions, such as name changes, will only apply to Alexina characters. In many cases, Nao characters will remain unaffected as we prepare to merge the data. More information will be provided regarding the differences of these restrictions for characters on both servers once confirmed.

[b]Q: Will my character name be changed during the merge? What happens if there are multiple characters with the same name?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Only characters on Alexina will be affected by name changes. Characters (pets, partners, characters) with duplicate names will have their name changed to 'Name+Server', e.g. Name+Alexina.
[list][*]
A duplicate name can be a pet, partner, or character name, across Alexina and Nao servers.
[/*][*]
e.g. If a pet is named 'Potato' on one server, and a character is named 'Potato' on another server, the Alexina character’s name will be changed to Potato+Alexina.
[/*][/list]
However, if there are no duplicate character names, the character name will remain unaffected. Nao character names will not be changed.

[b]Q: Will I be able to change my character name? Can I change my name back to my original name if it was changed?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All accounts that have character names changed during the merge process will receive an equal amount of [b]free[/b] Character Name Changes automatically added to their account after the server merge is completed on April 14th. More information on the Name Change system can be found [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/webshop/paidnamechange]here[/url]. All name change limitations will remain the same.

Unfortunately, if the name has been changed, it may not be possible to change the name back to the original name if it is already taken by a pet or character on the new server, Erinn.

[b]Q: What happens if an account is inactive during the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All accounts will be merged regardless of whether or not you have logged in recently.

[b]Q: Will I be able to change my pet's name?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The pet name change option will not be available at this time.

[b]Q: Will anything happen to my pets if the pet name is changed because of the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] You will be able to summon and interact with your pets as normal even if their name is changed. However, if a partner character's name is changed, the partner's likeability toward your character will be reset. If the character’s name is changed, the partner’s likeability towards that character will also be reset. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[b]Q: After the merge to the Erinn server, can I summon any pet regardless of which server they were originally created on?[/b]
A: All pet and partner characters created on both servers on an account will be merged with their inventory and stats intact. You will be able to access all of your pets on the Erinn server!

[b]Q: Will anything happen to my Family or Family Name?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Families will be merged. We are still confirming the details regarding Family Names for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

[b]Q: Will anything happen to our Friends List and Notes? Will these contents be wiped?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Friends List and Notes will be merged and will not be wiped. However, if a character’s name is changed, any notes in the character's Notes Inbox will be lost. In the case that the original sender's name is changed, the name change will be reflected on the Friend's List, but may not be reflected on the Notes Inbox.

[b]Q: Will my Marriage Info be affected by the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Marriage Info will be merged. During the Nao merge, if a character's name was changed, the new name was not reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title. Additionally, Wedding Rings could not be merged and were removed from characters. We are still confirming the details for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

[b]Q: What is the current limit on characters and pets? Will the merge cause me to be unable to use characters or pets if I've reached the max limit?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The merge will not affect your character limit, as the character limit is the same across the account. The current character and pet limit for an account is 300. An account may not have more than 300 total combined characters and pets. However, once an account has 200 characters on it, then only pets and partners may be created up to the 300 limit.

[b]Q: Will unused character and pet cards on the account be merged? What about pet whistles?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes, all unused character cards will be available on the account, as well as any pet whistles that may be in any character inventories.

[b]Q: Will the Anniversary Milletian title change, or will the character creation date change when merged to the new server?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Your character creation date and your titles will all remain intact.

[b]Item Information[/b]

[b]Q: Will anything happen to my items if my name is changed because of the merge?
A:[/b] All of your items will be merged, even if the character name is changed. Items stored in a character's inventory, bank, and pet's inventory, will be merged. Your items will be available in their respective places after the merge maintenance has completed! Please read the notices regarding the Shop Marketplace and Dressing Room in the below answers.

[b]Q: What happens to items that are character-exclusive if the character name is changed?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Items that are character exclusive (via upgrade, special upgrade, or enchant exclusive) will be able to be equipped as normal, even if your name was changed. However, if the item is currently unbound as a result of using a Trade Unlock Potion, the item will become re-bound to the character. The item will need to be unbound again by using another Trade Unlock Potion, should you wish to trade it. Customer Support will not be able to help unbind the item again.

[b]Q: What happens to the contents in my bank?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Any gold and items in the bank across both servers on an account will be merged. If the amount of gold in the bank exceeds the [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/209764243-Why-Can-t-I-Deposit-My-Check-in-the-Bank-]account's bank limit[/url], gold cannot be deposited into the bank.
Please be advised that the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/support/bankpinreset]account's bank pin[/url] will be reset and can be changed after the merge.

[b]Q: What happens to items that are left in the Auction House?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Auction House contents will be merged, and any items currently left in the Auction House inventory can be retrieved after the merge. If you have items across servers on the Auction House, the items will be stored in the Auction House, and new listings cannot be posted until the items are retrieved.

[b]Q: What happens to items that are left in the cash shop Item Shop Inventory?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All cash items stored in the cash Item Shop Inventory will be merged. This includes characters whose names are changed during the merge.

[b]Q: What will happen to items in the Point Inventory?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Items stored in the Point Inventory will be merged, and any items currently left in the inventory can be retrieved after the merge. However, the Point Inventory will also be used to merge duplicate items stored in the Dressing Room. As such, please be aware of the condition below regarding the Dressing Room.

[b]Q: What will happen to items in the Dressing Room?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Duplicate items across characters on both servers on an account will be moved to the Point Inventory after opening the Dressing Room for the first time after the merge. If you only play on one server, your Dressing Room contents will merge with all of the items intact.

The [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/360001474323-I-bought-an-item-from-the-cash-shop-but-can-t-locate-it-on-my-account-#h_01EQY85ZTV715GATDWJVKSM995]Point Inventory[/url] can hold up to 1000 items. If the amount of duplicate items (across servers) is over 1000, up to 100 items will go into the temporary inventory of your character. If the amount of the remaining duplicate items is over 100, the items will be dropped. [b]We strongly suggest to place items in pets or bank storage if you believe you have over 1100 duplicate items in the Dressing Room across characters on different servers on the account[/b], so that any items are not lost. There is no guarantee the items can be recovered if they are dropped from the temporary inventory.

[b]Q: What happens if I have a Shop in the Marketplace (formerly Housing)? What about the items that are left in the Shop Inventory?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [b]The Marketplace contents will not be merged.[/b] The option to bid on a Shop has been temporarily turned off with the March 24th maintenance, and any currently leased shop contracts will expire before the merge date. [b]Please retrieve any items placed in your Marketplace Shop Inventory or any items in the 'Retrieve Items' menu accessed through the Marketplace bank NPC before the merge date on April 14th so that any items are not lost.[/b] Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.

[b]Q: Will the Meet-Cute Bracelet/Rose Couple’s Bracelet effect still work after the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We are still confirming the details for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

[b]Q: Will the merge affect my Ego Spirit Weapon?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] As the Spirit Weapon system has been updated, we are still confirming the details and will share more information regarding this system once confirmed.

[b]Q: What happens to items and mail left in the mailbox?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All contents in the Inbox and Outbox of a character's mailbox will be merged.

[b]Q: Will my Pon amount be affected by the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Pon amount will merge and can be accessed across all characters on an account

[b]Content Information[/b]

[b]Q: What contents will be reset with the merge?
A:[/b] The following contents will be reset with the merge:
[list][*]Altruist Leaderboard[/*][*]Auction House Market Price Data[/*][*]Bard Bulletin Board[/*][*]Commerce Trading Board Information (each town)[/*][*]Cooking Journal: The 'Master Chef' and Master Chef's comments for the server.[/*][*]Current Guardian Guilds[/*][*]Fashion Contest Winner[/*][*]Festia Weekly Ranking Board[/*][*]MabiNovel Bulletin Board[/*][*]Royal Alchemists and Upgrade Methods found by Royal Alchemists.[/*][*]Seal Stones
[list][*]The Seal Stones will need to be broken again in the new server, granting the respective Seal-Breaker titles to the character who breaks the seal.[/*][*]Characters who obtained the Seal-Breaker title previously will still be able to use the Seal-Breaker title.[/*][/list][/*][*]Though all events should end before the merge date, please be advised that the main character selection will be reset.[/*][*][b]General UI saved settings will be reset, including hotkey bar placements, extra skill slots, and saved pet organization and tabs.[/b]
[list][*]We know this can be an inconvenience, so we sincerely apologize in advance! We strongly suggest taking screenshots of your hotkey placements so you may set up your hotkeys again once the merge is complete.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Q: What will happen to my data from newer contents, such as the Dungeon Guide, Stardust, Pet Houses, Fynn Pets, Fynni Pets, Pet Perks, Beauty Slots, Spirit Weapons, etc.?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] We are checking contents such as these with the merge testing and will share more information regarding these contents once confirmed.

[b]Q: Will the Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward be reset for the Erinn Server?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We are checking this content with the merge testing and will share more information regarding it once confirmed.

[b]Q: Is there a safe location we can log off before the server merge because of the Seal Stones?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] You do not need to log off in a certain location, as all locations can be accessed regardless of a Seal Stone's current status. If you need to move from a specific location for any reason, you may use 'Continent Warp' in the Actions menu, or the Traveler's Guide to travel to any Moon Gate or Mana Tunnel.

[b]Q: Will anything happen to my Homestead?[/b]
A: Homestead contents will be merged, including favorited homesteads, homestead visitor's list, and all of your props placed inside of the homestead. If the Homestead was expanded using the Homestead Expansion Permit, the homestead will keep the expansion.

We are still confirming the details regarding Homestead Names for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

[b]Q: What will happen to my guild?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Guild names will not be changed, as guild names are unique across all servers. Guild GP and Gold stored in the guild stone will be merged. Any accumulated Play Points can still be converted into GP when visiting the guild stone after the merge. Any guilds that have a Guild Title will be able to use the Guild Title as normal.

[b]Q: What happens to my guild stone location?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] All guild stone locations will be removed during the merge, and the guild stone will need to be placed again by the guild leader after the merge.

[b]Q: What if I am in a Guardian Guild prior to the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Any current Guardian Guilds prior to the April 14th merge day will be reset.

[b]Q: How many Royal Alchemists can there be on the new server?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] 100 Royal Alchemists. The maximum amount of Royal Alchemists will not change.

[b]Q: Will the Baltane Squire Special Unit be affected by the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The Baltane Squire Special Unit will not be affected by the merge. You will be able to access your Special Unit and interact with your squires as normal after the merge!

[b]Q: Will the contents of the Collection Journals be reset?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The various Collection Journals within the Character Info menu will be merged with your character's collections intact. However, the 'Master Chef' and the Master Chef's comments will be reset on the Cooking Journal.

[b]Q: Will the Commerce contents be reset with the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] A character's Commerce Merchant Rating will not be reset. However, the specific town's Commerce Trading Board Information will be reset.

[b]Q: Will I still receive royalties for a MabiNovel that has been posted prior to the merge?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] As the MabiNovel Bulletin Board has been reset, you may not receive these royalties. We apologize for any inconvenience.

If you have further questions, please reach out to us through [url=https://bit.ly/MabiDiscord]Discord[/url], [url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/]Forums[/url], and other community channels, as we will be reviewing your concerns and will be providing further updates through upcoming posts related to the Server Merge as we come closer to the merge date.

We are looking forward to future adventures, Milletians!

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Client Reinstallation Notice and Hotday Event
notes.content:
Hello Milletians!

After the March 17th maintenance, you will be required to download new client files due to a change in the way Mabinogi installs to your game folder. As a thank you for your understanding, we have prepared the Client Update Package to all players who log in during the event period of [b]March 17th, 7:00 AM PDT to March 24th, 7:00 AM PDT.[/b] 

[b]Hotday Details[/b]
[list][*]Claim the [b]Client Update Package [/b]item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose [b]Claim Later[/b] if you want to receive it on another character.[/*][*]While the package itself can be moved between characters through the bank, some of the items cannot be bank-traded, so please open the package on the correct character.[/*][*]You can only claim the item once during the event period.[/*][/list]
The [b]Client Update Package [/b]contains the following items:
[list][*][b]Style Tab Key (30 days) x1 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Extra Equipment Slot Coupon (30 days) x1 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Forgetful Potion x1 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Artisan Upgrade Removal Kit x2 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Combat Quadruple EXP Potion (30 min) (Event) x1 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Precise Reforging Tool x5 (expires in 5 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Alban Knights Training Stone Selection Box x1 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Notorious Magic Powder (Event) x3 (expires in 15 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Protective Upgrade Stone Selection Box x1 (15 days)[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Client Update Details[/b]

[b]Nexon Launcher[/b]
[list][*]If you have[b] “Enable automatic updates”[/b] checked in the Nexon Launcher Settings under Mabinogi -> Update, the installation will begin once the patch is made available.[/*][*]If you do not have “Enable automatic updates” checked in the Nexon Launcher Settings, after launching the Nexon Launcher, you may see the “Play” or “Update” button on the Mabinogi game page. notes.title: 14th Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
It's time to celebrate Mabinogi's 14th Anniversary! Explore the Night Bazaar and play all sorts of mini-games, such as Balloon Popping, Whack-an-Armadillo, and more! Win prizes with the Festia Instant Prize and test your skills in the Cave of Trials. Check out the full details below. [b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, March 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance [b]Welcome to the 14th Anniversary Night Bazaar![/b] [list][*]During this event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Night Bazaar.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Dero the Eventsman[/b] near [b]Festia's Main Gate[/b] and register a main character.[list][*]You can only register one main character per account.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing the guide quest:[list][*][b]Cave of Trials Entry Pass x3[/b][/*][*][b]Instant Prize Ticket x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Only the main character can participate in the quests and mini-games.[list][*]All characters can obtain the [b]Great Mood [/b]buff.[/*][*]When issuing a check from the [b]Tir Chonaill[/b] bank, all characters can receive a [b]14th Anniversary Check design.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]14th Anniversary Quests[/b][/h2] [b]Achievement Quest - [Event] Bazaar Experience[/b] [list][*]You will receive the achievement quest, [b][Event] Bazaar Experience.[/b][/*][*]Complete the daily quest [b]6 times[/b] to receive the following reward:[list][*][b]Sewing Pattern - Festival Souvenir Hebona Robe[/b][list][*][u][b]Note:[/b] The pattern has a usage count of 4. This pattern is only usable during the event period, and will be removed once the event ends.[/u] [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2085/mabinogi-14th-festival-souvenir-hebona-robe.png[/img][/b] [/*][*]Can be used to craft the [b]Festival Souvenir Hebona Robe[/b].[/*][*]When equipped, the robe grants the [b]Cooking Buff Duration 10%[/b] and[b] Combat EXP 10% Increase[/b] set effect.[/*][*]Cooking Buff Duration increases the duration of the food effects you receive when consuming foods made by Cooking by 10%. Does not apply to Catering. [list][*][b]Example:[/b] Consuming a Rank 1 food dish will last 20 minutes. When wearing the robe, it will last 22 minutes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the daily quest [b]14 times[/b] to receive the following reward: [b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2086/mabinogi-14th-cute-garland-2nd-title.png[/img][/b] [list][*][b]*NEW* Cute Garland 2nd Title Coupon (Luck +30)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the daily quest [b]21 times[/b] to receive the following reward:[list][*][b]Festival Commemorative Luxury Equipment Bag Box (10x15)[/b][list][*][b]Note: [/b]Only one can be carried per character. Can be used alongside other types of Luxury Equipment Bags.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete all of the objectives to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Instant Prize Ticket x25[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list] [b]Daily Quest - Finding Fruitful Fulfillment[/b] [list][*]Every day, you will receive the daily quest, [b][Daily] Finding Fruitful Fulfillment[/b].[/*][*]You will need to complete different tasks around the Night Bazaar:[list][*]Receive Cotton Candy by talk to a Dessert Merchant[/*][*]Get into a Great Mood[list][*]Reward: [b]Night Bazaar Sticker x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Play 1 Night Bazaar Game[list][*]Reward: [b]Night Bazaar Sticker x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Help 1 Night Bazaar Shopkeeper[list][*]Reward: [b]Night Bazaar Sticker x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Enter the Cave of Trials[list][*]Reward: [b]Night Bazaar Sticker x2[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Dero the Eventsman once you've completed all the daily tasks to turn in the quest.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Night Bazaar Sticker x2[/b][/*][*][b]Instant Prize Ticket x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The daily quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT every day.[/*][*]To see how many days you've completed the daily quest, click [b]Daily Quests [/b]when talking to [b]Dero the Eventsman.[/b][/*][/list] [[b]Daily Quest Task] Receive Cotton Candy by talking to a Dessert Merchant[/b] [list][*]Talk to the Dessert Merchant in the [b]Fun Zone[/b] or the Dessert Merchant [b]next to Fez[/b] to receive one [b]Festival Souvenir Cotton Candy[/b] once a day.[/*][*]When consuming a Festival Souvenir Cotton Candy, you can receive either EXP, Exploration EXP, Crusader EXP, or AP.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]Festival Souvenir Cotton Candy will be removed once the event ends.[/*][/list] [b][Daily Quest Task] Get into a Great Mood[/b] [list][*]Use the [b]Rest [/b]skill anywhere in the [b]Break Zone[/b] for 10 minutes to receive the [b]Great Mood [/b]buff.[/*][/list] [b][Daily Quest Task] Play 1 Night Bazaar Game[/b] [list][*]Talk to [b]Karo the Night Bazaar Game Guide[/b] to browse the available Night Bazaar Games.[/*][*]To complete the daily quest task, you'll have to score a certain amount of points or complete the puzzle while playing the Night Bazaar Games.[list][*][b]Memory Match[/b][list][*]Objective: Match all pairs within 50 seconds[/*][*]How to Play:[list][*]Select a card to flip it over to the front, showing either a delicious drink or food item, then select another card to see if it is a match.[/*][*]If it is a match, the cards will stay flipped over.[/*][*]If it is not a match, the cards will flip back over.[/*][*]Match all the food and drinks to their pair, and clear the board to win.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Whack-an-Armadillo[/b][list][*]Objective: Achieve a score of 100,000 points[/*][*]How to Play:[list][*]Whack an Armadillo holding fruit or the Royal Armadillo holding a ring to score points and increase your Combo streak![/*][*]If you click on a hole with no Armadillo or click on a Bomb Armadillo, your Combo will reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Sliding Puzzle[/b][list][*]Objective: Match all the puzzle pieces[list][*]How to Play:[list][*]Click on a puzzle piece to move it in the direction of an open spot.[/*][*]Slide the puzzle pieces into the correct spots to complete the puzzle.[/*][*]When any of the four corner puzzles pieces have been placed in the correct spot, a check mark will appear in the corner where it belongs.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Balloon Popping[/b][list][*]Objective: Pop all the balloons within 2 minutes[list][*]How to Play:[list][*]Pop the balloons by typing out the exact letters written on them.[/*][*]Spacing matters as well, so keep that in mind when typing.[/*][*]The round will end when you've popped all 16 balloons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Completing any of the above mini-games will mark your Daily Task as complete.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]Even after you've completed a mini-game for the Daily Quest, you can still play the mini-games by talking to Karo.[/*][*]If you are done with a mini-game press the [b]ESC[/b] key to close the window.[/*][/list] [b][Daily Quest Task] Help 1 Night Bazaar Shopkeeper[/b] [list][*]You can find the shopkeepers Paula, Moirin, and Shaun in the [b]Break Zone, [/b]wearing [b]Panda Party Hats![/b][/*][*]Every day, you can choose to [b]Help[/b] a shopkeeper and receive their corresponding quest.[/*][*]Each shopkeeper gives out different requests to deliver food, gather ingredients, pick up trash, or clear a shadow mission or dungeon depending on the shopkeeper's needs.[/*][*]Completing[b] any shopkeeper's request[/b] will reward the following:[list][*][b]Night Bazaar Sticker x5[/b][/*][*][b]Instant Prize Ticket x3[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note: [/b]Quest items will be removed at 7:00 AM PDT the next day if the quest is not completed.[/*][/list] [b][Daily Quest Task] Enter the Cave of Trials[/b] [list][*]Talk to [b]Duro the Trialkeeper,[/b] located in the Frontier Zone in Festia.[/*][*]Use a [b]Cave of Trials Entry Pass[/b] to enter the trials.[/*][/list][h2][b]Cave of Trials[/b][/h2] [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2013/mabinogi-duro.png[/img][list][*]Every day, you will receive [b]3 Cave of Trials Entry Passes[/b] when you log into the main character.[/*][*]The Cave of Trials is a one room dungeon with 17 waves of enemies.[/*][*]You cannot revive in the Cave of Trials and you cannot bring a party or pets.[/*][*]Clear waves to receive Conqueror's Chest. These chests hold a multitude of rewards, which will randomly be selected.[/*][*]Completing each wave will replace your existing Cave of Trials title with a new version of it.[list][*]The Overcomer of notes.title: Secondary Password Removal
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

As a result of the rollout of Two-Factor Authentication and the Trusted Devices system, we are excited to share with you that during the[b] March 17, 2022 update[/b], the[b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/support/secondarypasswordinfo] Secondary Password system[/url] will be removed from Mabinogi. [/b]Two-Factor Authentication provides better security for our Milletians and we believe that is will be a welcomed change. 

The Two-Factor Authentication methods and Trusted Devices can be found in the [url=https://www.nexon.com/account/en/setting][b]"Password & Security" tab in the Account Settings[/b][/url] page. We encourage all Milletians to set up one of the followings methods as soon as possible.

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1372/two-factor-authentication-nexon.png[/img][/u]
[list][*][b]Authenticator App:[/b] This option allows you to generate a secure, single-use passcode through your smartphone, using the free Google Authenticator app. This code will be required whenever you sign into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer, and changes frequently to prevent the code from being reusable or guessable.[/*][*][b]SMS:[/b] The SMS (Short Message Service, better known as Text Messaging) option will allow you to register your phone number with your Nexon account, where you will be texted a single-use passcode to be used alongside your password in order to log into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer.[/*][*][b]Email Verification:[/b] Upon logging into the Nexon Launcher on a non-trusted computer, you will be sent an email with a secure, single-use passcode required to verify your account. This is required of all Nexon accounts, in order to limit the likelihood of an unauthorized user gaining control over your account.[/*][*][b]Trusted Devices:[/b] Once you have completed email verification, you will be given the option to trust the device you are logging on with, allowing you to bypass both Email Verification and any other Two-Factor Authentication protections on that device for an even smoother login process. You can remove trusted devices via the Account Settings page at any time.[/*][/list]
Again, we strongly encourage everyone to set up Two-Factor Authentication on your Nexon Accounts, either with an Authenticator App or through SMS (Text) Messaging. Doing so will help keep your account as safe and secure as can be. Please note that you can disable either factor whenever you wish, and while we encourage you to add an additional layer of security to your account in one of the manners described above, this is by no means a requirement to play Mabinogi.

Thank you,

[i]-The Mabinogi Team[/i]

[list][*]The [b]View Outfits with Motion[/b] checkbox has been added to the Dressing Room -> Clothing tab[/*][*]When this checkbox is checked, only outfits with custom idle motions will be displayed in the Dressing Room.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1444/mabinogi-custom-motion-dressing-room.png[/img]
[list][*]To apply a motion of an outfit in the Dressing Room to your Style Tab, click on the green [b]Motion[/b] button next to the desired outfit in the Dressing Room. Once the motion is applied, the button will change to a yellow [b]Applied [/b]button.[list][*]You cannot apply the motion of outfits that you do not own, or that cannot be equipped on your current character.[/*][*]The motion of special collaboration outfits cannot be applied.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once a motion has been applied, it will change the custom idle motion of outfits worn in the Style Tab to the motion of the selected outfit.[list][*]The motion can only be swapped between outfits that have motion.[/*][*]Only one motion can be applied at a time.[/*][*]Even if you change the clothing equipped in the Style Tab, the applied motion is maintained.[/*][*]Even if there is a motion being applied in the Dressing Room, the motion will not be applied if the outfit you are wearing has no motion, or if the Style Tab has expired.[/*][*]The motion of an outfit will not change if it is equipped in the Gear Tab instead of the Style Tab.[/*][*]If you remove the outfit with the motion that is being applied from the Dressing Room, the motion is turned off.[/*][/list][/*][*]To remove an applied motion, click the [b]Applied[/b] button again, or select a different outfit using the [b]Motion [/b]button to change to a different motion.[/*][*]When an outfit with motion is worn in the Style Tab, a small icon is visible on the bottom-left corner of the Outfit slot. Click on this icon to bring up the Dressing Room with the [b]View Outfits with Motion[/b] option selected.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Doki Doki Island 2022
notes.content:
Do you hear that? It's the sound of your heart. Doki...Doki...That's right, Doki Doki Island is back! There's new rewards, such as a new, romantic way to fly around Doki Doki's gorgeous beaches, as well as new outfits, 2nd titles, and Homestead items! Check out the full details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 17th, Before Maintenance
[h1]The Newcomer’s Guide to Doki Doki Island[/h1]
Feel your toes sink into the warm sand as you step foot on Doki Doki Island. This secluded paradise boasts beautiful scenery, and beach parties that rage all day, all night... all the time.

[h2]The Guide Quest[/h2]
A Guide Quest, "[b][Event] Doki Doki Island Festival[/b]", is given to all players so long as this special seasonal event is active. Your travel agent is none other than [b]Caravan Joe[/b], located in [b]Dunbarton[/b]. Speak to him about arranging a journey to Doki Doki Island.

When you disembark, you'll find a [b]Matchmaker[/b] on the beach, waiting to welcome you to Doki Doki Island.

As part of the Guide Quest, she can [b]register[/b] your Matchmaking profile. Doki Doki Island is an experience best suited to couples, so find yourself a Soulmate and get your heart beating! Already have a partner in mind? Just right-click and “[b]Select Soulmate[/b]” on anyone on the island.

Finish the Guide Quest, and earn your very first[b] Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/b] by talking to [b]Wenger the Caretaker[/b] – he knows how to get you home.
[table][tr][th][b]Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
This special item is awarded for completing various events and mini-games around the island, or by redeeming Cat's Paw to Mansur the Jeweler. [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71890]Click here for a full list of items you can obtain from this box.[/url]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1458/mabinogi-doki-doki-commermorative-box.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]The Soulmate System[/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1460/mabinogi-doki-doki-soulmates.jpg[/img]
Matchmakers all over Doki Doki Island are ready and willing to set you up with the Milletian of your dreams! Existing couples can skip the formalities, but singles are advised to [b]set up a profile[/b]. If you're not one for online dating, there’s nothing stopping you from meeting that special someone on your own! [b]You can proposition any unclaimed player regardless of race or gender.[/b]

You can break up with your Soulmate at any time. Just remember that if you do, you’ll lose all the [b]Romantic Points[/b] you’ve built up with that player and will have to start all over again.

[h2]Romantic Points[/h2]
They say love can’t be measured… except on Doki Doki Island! By enjoying all of what Doki Doki has to offer, you’ll acquire [b]Romantic Points.[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Action[/b][/th][th][b]Romantic Points[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Score 50 points or more in a Doki Doki Dance Party[/td][td]40 Romantic Points[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stand by your Soulmate (within 20m)[/td][td]10 Romantic Points every 5 minutes[/td][/tr][tr][td]Successfully complete the Depths of the Heart Test[/td][td]100 Romantic Points (1% of overall likeability)[/td][/tr][/table]
The more points you accrue, the more you’ll fall in love with your partner, as indicated by the likability meter. [b]100 Romantic Points = 1%. [/b]The Soulmate UI has also been improved to show the decimal point, so you can now see the increase in 0.1% increments to show how precise your love is.

Earn enough points and you’ll earn the greatest gift of all…

TRUE LOVE.

Oh, and the power of [b]Flight.[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1461/mabinogi-doki-doki-island-midnight-flight.png[/img][/b]

[h2]Couples Flight: Fly with the Power of Love![/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1462/mabinogi-doki-doki-flight-image.png[/img]
If you want love to lift you up off your feet, you’ll need to reach [b]20% likability[/b] with your partner, though your new abilities will be confined to the island. You’ll be pretty in love… but you know – not really in love.

If you want to see the entirety of mainland Erinn from amongst the clouds, you and your Soulmate will need to achieve 100% likeability.
[list][*][b]Flight[/b] - The ability to fly anywhere on Doki Doki Island.[/*][*][b]Couples Flight[/b] - The ability to fly anywhere in Erinn where flying is permitted.[/*][*][b]Sweethearts Flight[/b] - Fly around Erinn with your partner, embracing them as you do so. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.[/*][*][b]Moonlight Couples Flight[/b] - Fly around Erinn with your partner, dancing with them as you do. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.[/*][*][b]Harmony Flight[/b] - Fly around Erinn with your partner, lifting them in the air as you do so. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.[/*][*][b]*NEW* Midnight Flight[/b] - Fly around Erinn and dance the night away with your sweetie. Obtain with Cat's Paw from Mansur.[/*][/list]

[h1]Getting to Know the Island[/h1]
Doki Doki is a beautiful place, and simple to navigate once you’ve memorized all the major landmarks.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1471/mabinogi-doki-doki-map.png[/img]

[h2]The Harmony Torch[/h2]
An ancient, mystical torch in the center of Doki Doki’s Town Square is the hub of the island's activity. Celebrate the Harmony Torch by lighting a fire of your own! Building a campfire and resting nearby will [b]award EXP every 5 seconds.[/b] 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1463/mabinogi-doki-doki-harmony-torch.jpg[/img]

Starting to feel a little intoxicated? Spend too much time resting at the Torch and you’ll get a tingling [b]Lovey Dovey[/b] feeling…

[table][tr][th][b]Lovey Dovey Buff[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
- All Stats +20
- Max HP +100
- Max MP +100
- Max Stamina +100
- Max Damage +30
- Critical +5
- Defense +5
- Protection +5
- Magic Defense +5
- Combat EXP +50%
[/td][/tr][/table]
This special buff will last for 30 minutes, beginning the moment you stop resting. You can also receive up to [b]5 Doki Doki Commemorative Boxes[/b] when receive the Lovey Dovey Buff each day. This will reset every day at 7:00 AM PT.

[h2]The Depths of the Heart Test[/h2]
Psychology Students can be found throughout Doki Doki, studying the effects of love and romance on volunteer test subjects. Show one how well you know your Soulmate by taking the Depths of the Heart Test.

You’ll be asked a random question, and if you and your match answer simultaneously and prove you’re in-sync, you’ll win a [b]Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/b] and advance 1% on your likability meter.

This special test is only available [b]once per day[/b]. It will reset at 12:00 AM PT.

[h2]Fun & Games[/h2]
There’s no end to the amount of fun you can find on Doki Doki Island. Take a little time off from your daily routine to play mini-games and win a variety of Romantic Rewards…

The [b]Doki Doki Dance Party[/b] is an opportunity to strut your stuff for all the Town Square to see. Match the steps in order and on-time to execute strong, effective dance moves. If you and your Soulmate score [b]50 points or above[/b] you'll both earn [b]40 Romantic Points[/b]!

To start dancing, you’ll need a Boom Box. Browse [b]Mansur the Jewel Collector's shop[/b].

Grab your band mates and rent out the special Stage found on the south side of the island for anywhere between 5 to 30 minutes. You won't take home any points or boxes, but Starlet will be the first to tell you: the joy of performing is its own reward.

The [b]Soulmate-Seeking Milletian [/b]is waiting on the island with a special request. Provide them with [b]1 Silk Snapper[/b], [b]1 Salmon[/b], and [b]1 Bluefin Tuna [/b]to feed their pet seal, Cotton Candy, and they will reward you with [b]15 Silvervine Fruit[/b] and [b]15 Potatoes[/b]! You can only complete this request [b]once per real life day[/b], only on [b]one character per account[/b].

[h1]Helping Out & Kicking Back[/h1]
Games are all well and good, but this island doesn’t sustain itself. If you’re planning on spending any amount of time here, ask Wenger about how you can give back to the community and lend a helping hand.


[h2]Daily Quest: Fishing, Cooking, and Metallurgy[/h2]
Doki Doki's old caretaker sure has his hands full catering for all the guests. How about helping out a little in return for some Cat's Paws?
[table][tr][th][b]Quest Name[/b][/th][th][b]Details[/b][/th][th][b]Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: Taters Please[/td][td]Deliver 30 Potatoes[/td][td]3 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: A Fine Fruit[/td][td]
Deliver 15 Silvervine Fruit

Tip: When collecting Silvervine Fruit, Phantasmal Sight can be used
[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: A Good Meal[/td][td]Deliver 5 Onion Fried Tuna
(Cooking Method: Mixing)[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: On the Line[/td][td]Deliver 7 Salmon[/td][td]3 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: On the Line[/td][td]Deliver 1 Pink Starfish[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: The Cat's Meow[/td][td]
Deliver 5 Cat's Paw

Note: The Cat's Paw is not automatically delivered when talking to Wenger. Instead, the [Hand Over Cat's Paw] button is now available for use.
[/td][td]1 Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/td][/tr][/table]
Prefer to get your hands dirty? If you've got a Metallurgy Sieve, you could find all sorts of treasures buried in the sand, including Cat's Paw. 

Their unique shimmer makes night-time the best time to find them, but they’re easily missed with the hot sun beating down on the sand.

There are rumors that they’re most prevalent in the Southeast corner of the island…

[h2]Daily Quest: Natural Dyes[/h2]
Want to make your own dyes with organic ingredients? [b]Register a main character[/b] at the[b] Natural Dye Helpe[/b]r near the[b] Festival Market[/b] on Doki Doki Island. In doing so, you will also be rewarded [b]5 Cat's Paw. [/b]The Natural Dye Helper will let you play a fun mini-game, allowing you to add blueberries, cherries, and herbs to create your own dye! Dyes are based in RGB form for the mini-game.

However, keep in mind that the Natural Dye Event and quest will only available during Week 1 and Week 3 of the event.
[list][*][b]Week 1:[/b] Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b]Week 3:[/b] Thursday, March 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 10th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
Once the dye is made you can click on the [b]Dye Ampoule or Metal Dye Ampoule icon[/b] in the bottom right hand corner to convert the left-overs into a new dye. You can only choose [b]one[/b] though! These special dyes are [b]not tradable[/b]. Take the Natural Dye Ampoule to one of the sheets located around Doki Doki Island to dye it a new color for [b]3 Cat's Paw[/b] and [b]1 Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/b]!

[h2]Daily Quest: Dancing with DJ Romantic[/h2]
Dance the night away, under the moonlight of Doki Doki Island! [b]Register a main character [/b]with DJ Romantic at the Town Square in Doki Doki Island. After registering, you will be rewarded with [b]5 Cat's Paw[/b].[b] [/b]Show off those moves by talking to DJ Romantic and selecting [b]Dance Challenge[/b]. Use WASD and the Space key to dance to the rhythm. If you earn 50+ points, DJ Romantic will reward you with [b]15 Cat's Paw.[/b] You can challenge DJ Romantic as many times as you want, but you can only earn the reward once per day. [b]
[/b]

Since DJ Romantic is very famous, he will only be available during Week 2 and Week 4 of the event as he needs to go do some judging for a gig.
[list][*][b]Week 2:[/b] Thursday, February 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b]Week 4: [/b]Thursday, March 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 17th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]

[h2]Cat's Paw[/h2]
Take Cat's Paws to [b]Mansur[/b] [b]the Jewel Collector[/b], who hangs out beside Wenger. He’s crazy for these little gems, and he’s got some very rare items he’s willing to trade if you collect enough…

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: What’s New This Year
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

First, I would like to introduce myself to the community. My name is Enrico aka GM Supreme and I am the Producer of Mabinogi for Nexon America.

This year we have planned to release content that will improve your life and experience in the world of Erinn. We have been gathering many of your suggestions for improvements and are actively discussing how and when we can make these changes with the development team.

One of the things I want to do is share more updates on what you can expect to see added to the game. That being said, here is a high-level list of updates that should be implemented within the first half of 2022.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1417/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-1.jpg[/img]

[b]Custom Motion/Hands Remodel[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1421/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-4.png[/img][/b]

[b]Doki Doki Island[/b] 

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1420/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-8.jpg[/img][/b]

[b]14th Anniversary Celebration[/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1419/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-7.jpg[/img]

[b]Repair Cost Reduction/Crom B[u]á[/u]s Dungeon Polishing[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1416/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-3.jpg[/img][/b]

[b]Life Skill Update[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1418/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-2.jpg[/img][/b]

[b]Renovation Season 3[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1501/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-5.png[/img][/b]

[b]Uladh Commerce Update & Commerce in Iria[/b]

Please note that there are no confirmed dates or details for the content listed above. There are still many discussions and other planning that needs to happen when deciding what content to include each month. I want to be sure that we give the most accurate details once we have confirmed the content and information. Additionally, I'd like to announce that there will be a special livestream and announcement for our 14th Anniversary.

I know that the Mabinogi community has many overall topics and discussions that you would like reviewed. While we may not be able to address all of your concerns at once, please continue to give us your feedback and thoughts through all of our community and social channels. We are listening and discussing as many of your concerns as possible, and believe that we can accomplish many of them.

Sincerely,

[i]-Enrico “GM Supreme”
Mabinogi Producer[/i]

notes.title: Irusan's Attendance Check-in
notes.content:
Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Incubus King outfit set. And if you finish the attendance calendar before the end of the event, there is a bonus attendance calendar with more rewards! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] [u]Thursday, January 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance[/u]
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.png[/img][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] A Girl's Request.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]A Girl in Need[/b] in front of the Unicorn Statue.[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]A Girl in Need.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. 
[list][*]You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.[list][*]There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 9 days of log in.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.[/*][/list][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.[/*][*][b]You can only receive the stamp prizes on your main character.[/b][/*][*]If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.[/*][*]If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.[/*][*]Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive 1 stamp per day.[/*][*]Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).[/*][*]Rewards that aren't claimed when the event is over will automatically be added to the registered main character's Point Shop Inventory.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1265/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-calendar-ui.png[/img]
[h2][b]Attendance Pass Purchase[/b][/h2][list][*]If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for [b]29 Pon.[/b][/*][*]The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.[/*][*]The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.[/*][*]The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1264/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-purchase-ui.png[/img]
[h2][b]Bonus Attendance Check[/b][/h2][list][*]When you complete all 3 calendars, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Champ of Stamps.[/b][/*][*]Talk to the Girl in Need to start the Bonus Attendance Check.[/*][*]When you start this Bonus Attendance Check, the calendar is replaced with a new calendar.[/*][*]There are a total of 19 attendance days with additional rewards.[/*][/list][h2][b]Stamp Rewards[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2 - Patch Notes - January 13th, 2022
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Crom Bás Part 2 update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/extended-crom-b-s-support]Extended Crom Bás Support[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70893/mischievous-pet-box]Mischievous Pet Box[/url]: Thursday, December 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71194/winter-fishing-event-2022]Winter Fishing Event 2022[/url]: Thursday, January 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 3rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/71195/crom-b-s-doll-bag-box]Crom Bás Doll Bag Box[/url]: Thursday, January 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 10th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/unveiledabyss]Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2:[/url] Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2[/b]
[list][*]Part 2 of the Crom Bás Update is here! To learn more about the Crom Bás update, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/unveiledabyss]microsite[/url] and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/70535/crom-b-s-guide]dungeon guide[/url].[list][*]Additional [b]story quests [/b]have been added.[/*][*]Crom Bás [b]Quest Mode[/b] has been added:[list][*]Weaker enemies and automatic revivals are available in quest mode.[/*][*]Only gold rewards can be obtained from this mode.[/*][/list][/*][*]Two final Bosses, [b]Completed Glas Ghaibhleann[/b] and [b]Giga Glas Ghaibhleann[/b] lurk in the deepest depths of the Crom Bás dungeon.[/*][*]Gillach's Shop has been unlocked. You can use [b]Adamantine Coins[/b] to buy new rewards.[/*][*]New crafting materials can be obtained from the Crom Bás Advanced and Elite dungeon difficulty.[b]
[/b][list][*]Dark Erg Chunk[/*][*]Adamantine[/*][*]Glas Ghaibhleann Heart[/*][*]Damaged Glas Ghaibhleann Feather[/*][/list][/*][*][b]16 new weapons of the Nightbringer series [/b]can now be crafted:[list][*]Nightbringer Assault - One-handed Sword[/*][*]Nightbringer Predator- Bow[/*][*]Nightbringer Rogue - Crossbow[/*][*]Nightbringer Elementalist - Wand [/*][*]Nightbringer Technician - Cylinder[/*][*]Nightbringer Trickster - Control Bar[/*][*]Nightbringer Warlord - Two-handed Sword[/*][*]Nightbringer Berserker - Two-handed Axe[/*][*]Nightbringer Inquisitor - Staff[/*][*]Nightbringer Spearhead - Lance[/*][*]Nightbringer Vagabond - Knuckles[/*][*]Nightbringer Vanquisher - Dual Gun[/*][*]Nightbringer Infiltrator - Shuriken[/*][*]Nightbringer Wraith - Chain Blade[/*][*]Nightbringer Vanguard - Shield[/*][*]Nightbringer Prophet - Spell Book[/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally, you can obtain the new [b]Nightbringer Huntsman - Arrows[/b] from the two final bosses.[/*][*]The [b]Fused Erg Sealing Box[/b] can be crafted using Handicraft (Rank 1), and contains various rewards such as the Nightbringer Wings and Crom Bás NPC 2nd Title Coupons.[/*][*]The [b]Sturdy Loop[/b] item and crafting recipe has been added to Weaving.[/*][*]Blessings that were given by the Soul have been removed, and have been changed so that Blessing above level 2 will be reduced by 1 level upon death. If the Blessing is level 1, it will still be removed when you die.[/*][*]The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/extended-crom-bas-support]Extended Crom Bás Support Event[/url] has been updated.[list][*]3x Adamantine Coins can be obtained from Advanced and Elite mode during the event period.[/*][*]On Sundays only, the Dark Erg Fragment can be purchased from Gillach's Shop.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Doll Bag AI Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Dolls will now pick up to 20 of all available items within a certain range around the doll at once, instead of picking up each item one at a time.[/*][*]Dolls now move in a more efficient way in certain situations, such as when there are obstacles, or when moving away from the character.[/*][*]The interval between the doll's attempts to reacquire items that you do not own, such as other party member's drops, has been changed from 10 seconds to 10 minutes.[/*][*]Dolls will now search for the next item instead of wandering around an item it can not pick up.[/*][*]There is no longer a notice message that appears when a Doll fails to pick up an item.[/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]The following set effects can now be seen in the Character Status Effects list:[list][*]Battle Alchemy Enhancement[/*][*]Transmutation Enhancement[/*][*]Hero Alchemy Enhancement[/*][*]Marionette Stun Resistance Rate[/*][*]Marionette Critical Damage[/*][*]Puppetry Skill Cooldown Decreased[/*][*]Enhanced Critical Damage[/*][*]Enhanced Bash[/*][*]Decreased Durability Loss[/*][*]Increased Movement Speed[/*][*]Reduced Attack Delay[/*][*]Increased Max Damage[/*][*]Increased Magic Attack[/*][/list][/*][*]With the November 2021 update, the attack speed of Divine Cinnsealach L2 weapons was increased.[list][*]Weapons created before the update had a slower attack speed than weapons created after the update.[/*][*]The attack speed of all Divine Cinnsealach L2 weapons have now been updated to the same Very Fast attack speed.  [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some minor spacing issues in the Crom Bás shadow mission quest dialogue.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the "Continue" button would disappear during the Crom Bás quest, "The Souls Speak - Part 2".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where XML code would appear when you obtained the title, "whose Flow was Hotter than Raspa Volcano" and "who Dropped the Mic".[/*][*]Fixed text issues in the dialogue for the Crom Bás quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".[/*][*]Fixed the inconsistent naming for the Belvast Supplier when opening their shop.[/*][*]Fixed minor text issues when speaking to the Belvast NPCs.[/*][*]Fixed multiple typos in the dialogue for the quest, "Waves Amidst the Calm".[/*][*]Fixed the overlay of the World Map when using the Tory Ravine Moon Gate.[/*][*]Changed the event name of the Winter Master Plan Hotday UI to 2021 Winter Master Plan Weekly Hotday Event.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the tooltip for Rank 8 First Aid.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue in the Dungeon Notebook where it incorrectly stated that Heavy Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Dungeon instead of Light Armor Fragments.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue in the Dungeon Notebook where it incorrectly stated that Light Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Hardmode Dungeon instead of Heavy Armor Fragments. [/*][*]Fixed a typo in Melwyn's dialogue during the quest, "[Guide] An Astronomical Discovery".[/*][*]Fixed a typo for Spirit Control that incorrectly stated that Alchemic Damage is increased as a percentage of base HP, when it is actually increased as a percentage of base STR.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the incorrect pronouns were used during the quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.[/*][*]Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.[/*][*]If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.[/*][*]The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.[/*][*]Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.[/*][*]There is a rare occurrence that Completed Glas Ghaibhleann will appear to T-pose after the cutscene once defeating it.[/*][*]The training methods for Handicraft Rank E are not counted when you make a Fused Erg Sealing Box.[/*][*]There is a missing dialogue line for Gillach during the quest, "Ne'er to Linger in the Darkness".[/*][*]There is a missing sentence in the item description for the Divine Cinnsealach L2 Dual Guns.[/*][*]The Folamh Doll Bag item description incorrectly mentions minerals instead of various ores.[/*][*]When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.[/*][*]There is a grammar issue when using the Erg Crystal from the Milletian Full Boost event.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss - Patch Notes - December 9th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Crom Bás update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70318/updated-forgotten-tomb-dungeon-2021]Forgotten Tomb Dungeon 2021[/url]: Thursday, December 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 23rd, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69237/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-2]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70488/crom-b-s-celebration-events]Crom Bás Celebration Events[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 13th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70497/2021-winter-master-plan]2021 Winter Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/extended-crom-b-s-support]Extended Crom Bás Support[/url]: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/unveiledabyss]Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss:[/url] Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss[/b]
[list][*]To learn more about the Crom Bás update, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/unveiledabyss]microsite[/url] and the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/70535/crom-b-s-guide]dungeon guide[/url].[list][*]The Crom Bás area and dungeon have been discovered in Tory Ravine.[/*][*]You will receive the Crom Bás Dungeon quest, [b][Contents] Waves Amidst the Calm, [/b]and a [b]Wings of the Blue Goddess (The Dunbarton Mailbox) [/b]if your character's Total Combat Skill Level is 1,500 or higher.[b]
[/b][/*][*]New enemies have been added, including the dungeon Boss, Irusan.[/*][*]Clear the Crom Bás dungeon to earn new rewards as well as Adamantine Coins which can be used in Gillach's Shop.[list][*]Gillach's Shop will unlock in the Crom Bás Part 2 update.[/*][/list][/*][*]New enchant scrolls and crafting materials can be obtained from the Crom Bás dungeon.[list][*]A new accessory, [b]Irusan's Bell,[/b] can be crafted using the new material, Grumpy Cat's Marble.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Moon Gate - Tory Ravine - Crom Bás Entrance [/b]has been added and can be teleported to using the Traveler's Guide.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Holiday Decorations[/b]
[list][*]Erinn is celebrating the holidays from [b]Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance [/b]to [b]Thursday, January 13th, Before Maintenance,[/b] and the following areas will be decorated with holiday cheer:
[list][*]The town of [b]Dunbarton[/b][/*][*]The [b]Dunbarton Church Tree[/b][/*][*][b]Festia[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Additionally, it will snow instead of rain during the event period.[/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Players from the Netherlands now have trade limitations placed on them. For more information, please refer to the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70689/netherlands-trade-limitations-update]announcement post.[/url][/*][*]Female Giants will no longer have closed hands when standing.[list][*]With the above change, the standing model of all characters, regardless of race or gender, has been changed so that the hands are either opened or closed randomly. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a minor typo in the G16 quest, "The Crow's Call".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the title "the Super Diligent" would be incorrect when equipped.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the movement speed of an Elf character would be slow if they had a Bouquet item equipped.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Chef's Passion item could not be reforged.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the newly added Shadow Missions did not drop Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Tickets.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Pet Skill window not being able open with a shortcut key.[/*][*]Fixed a visual issue with the Fynn Bead Skill details button in the Pet/Partner Information window.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - December 9th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on December 9th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PST and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, December 9th[/b]

Pacific (PST, UTC-8): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM 
Eastern (EST, UTC-5): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CET, UTC+1): 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]The dark abyss is here. Are you ready to face the Boss? The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/unveiledabyss]Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss[/url] update will be added to Mabinogi.[/*][*]Winter is coming, which means a Milletian favorite event is back! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70497/2021-winter-master-plan]Winter Master Plan[/url] event is starting.[/*][*]To celebrate the release of Crom Bás, collect Soul Shards and the Abyss will reward you! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70488/crom-b-s-celebration-events]Crom Bás Celebration Events[/url] are starting.[/*][*]To help with the exploration of Crom Bás, we are providing some additional support! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70498/extended-crom-b-s-support]Extended Crom Bás Support[/url] events are starting.[/*][*]Training is now over, Milletians! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70097/milletian-full-boost]Milletian Full Boost[/url] event is ending.[/*][*]The Netherlands trade limitations will be going live. For more information, please refer to the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70689/netherlands-trade-limitations-update]announcement post[/url].[/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. [b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change[/url] submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PST time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Netherlands Trade Limitations Update
notes.content:
Dear Dutch Milletians,

We've updated more details on the trade functionality changes that we announced in our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69540/notice-for-netherlands-players-part-2]Notice for Netherlands Players: Part 2[/url]. In order to comply with Netherlands regulations, the following in-game trade functions will be restricted for Dutch players:
[list][*]Give and Receive items via 1:1 Exchange trade[/*][*]Item dropping[/*][*]Buy and Sell via the Auction House[/*][*]Mailing messages with items attached[/*][*]Personal shop sales or purchases (viewing other players' shops is still possible)[list][*]Even if you have a Personal Shop Bag, you cannot open a Personal Shop.[/*][*]You can still buy the Merchant License from the Bank, but you cannot use it.[/*][/list][/*][*]Housing shop purchases (viewing items is still possible)[/*][*]Kiosk sales or purchases (viewing other players' Kiosks is still possible)[/*][*]Items given in exchange for an Enchant Entrustment[/*][*]Items acquired through pet battles[/*][*]Entering Uladh/Iria Dungeons using Item Drops, or touching the statue[list][*]If you are in a party as a party member, you can enter the dungeon with other players when they enter.[/*][*]You can enter a dungeon if you use a Unlimited Dungeon Pass.[/*][/list][/*][*]Receiving Mail Delivery part-time jobs from the Tara Bank[/*][/list]
The above limitations will be implemented during the [b]December 9th, 2021[/b] maintenance.

Thank you,

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Crom Bás Celebration Events
notes.content:
Collect Soul Shards and trade them in for items to help you in Crom B[u]á[/u]s. Additionally, you can receive a giftbox from the dark Abyss. Patience is key so remember to wait before you open the box! Check out the details below.

[/b][/*][*][b]Soul Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Irusan's Box of Bounty x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Specters of the Abyss[/b][/h2][list][*]You need to collect [b]Soul Shards[/b], which are stored in the [b]Soul Pouch[/b].[list][*]Use the Soul Pouch to learn how to obtain Soul Shards, view the current amount of Soul Shards you have, and check how many have been earned for the day.[/*][/list][/*][*]200 Soul Shards can be obtained each day during the event period.[list][*]50 Soul Shards are obtained upon logging in once a day.[/*][*]Soul Shards can also be obtained when clearing the following dungeons or missions:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Dungeon/Mission[/b][/th][th][b]Amount of Soul Shards[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Alby Advanced[/td][td]10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ciar Advanced[/td][td]10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Math Advanced[/td][td]15[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rabbie Advanced[/td][td]15[/td][/tr][tr][td]Barri Advanced[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Coill Intermediate[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fiodh Advanced[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rundal Advanced[/td][td]40[/td][/tr][tr][td]Peaca Intermediate[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ciar Advanced Hard[/td][td]70[/td][/tr][tr][td]Alby Advanced Hard[/td][td]70[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rundal Advanced Hard[/td][td]70[/td][/tr][tr][td]Abyss Coill Advanced[/td][td]70[/td][/tr][tr][td]Abyss Peaca Advanced[/td][td]70[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hard Shadow Missions[/td][td]30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Elite Shadow Missions[/td][td]50[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]Talk to the Ghost of Crom Bás to [b]Deliver Soul Shards[/b] to exchange Soul Shards for the following rewards:
[list][*][b]Irusan's Box of Bounty - 100 Soul Shards[/b][list][*]To view the reward list, [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/70513]click here[/url].[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Crom Bás Infiltration Ticket - 500 Soul Shards[/b][list][*]Use this ticket to enter Crom Bás while under Combat Skill Level 1,500.[/*][*]When entering Crom Bás, one ticket is consumed and removed from your inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Crom Bás Reward Key Coupon - 700 Soul Shards[/b][list][*]Use this coupon to open the Dungeon End Chest when clearing Crom Bás after reaching the weekly reward limit (7 times).[/*][*]When entering the dungeon and clearing the boss, you will acquire a Treasure Chest Key and the Adamantine Coin reward for clearing the dungeon depending on the Dark Erg difficulty.[/*][*]The Crom Bás Reward Key Coupon is consumed and removed from your inventory.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Unused Crom Bás Infiltration Tickets and Crom Bás Reward Key Coupons will be removed once the event ends.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1820/mabinogi-crom-bas-events-figure-teaser.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Gift from the Abyss[/b][/h2]

[list][*]During the event period, log in consecutively for 3 days to receive and fully upgrade the [b]Gift from the Abyss Box[/b].[/*][*]The fully upgraded box, [b]Gift from the Abyss Box (Day 3)[/b], includes 2 bonus rewards![b]
[/b][/*][*]You will receive the [b]Gift from the Abyss Box (Day 1)[/b] by logging in during the event period.
[list][*][b]Claim[/b] the box to receive it on your character or choose [b]Claim Later[/b] if you want to receive it on another character. notes.title: [UPDATED] Extended Crom Bás Support
notes.content:
To help out Milletians with the exploration of Crom Bás, we are running support events! Equipment in Crom Bás will lose durability at a slower rate and Milletians will be rewarded with more Adamantine Coins! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
[h2][b]Crom Bás Durability Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, the durability of equipment items decreases slowly.[/*][*]This effect is only applied within the [b]Crom Bás[/b] [b]Dungeon[/b].[list][*]This is automatically applied when entering the Crom Bás Dungeon during the event period.[/*][*]This effect is also applied even when a character dies and re-enters the dungeon.[list][*]It will not be applied when you exit the dungeon or change channels.[/*][/list][/*][*]The effect does not apply when using Life Skills in the Crom Bás Dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Blessing effect from Holy Water of Lymilark and the event effect overlap.[/*][*]During the event period, you can speak to [b]Gillach[/b] about the event details at the entrance of Crom Bás.[/*][/list][h2][b]Crom Bás Fever Time Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Every weekend during the event period (Friday, Saturday, and Sunday), the [b]Crom Bás Fever Time[/b] event will be available.[list][*]On [b]Sundays[/b], in real-time, Dark Erg Fragments can be purchased in Gillach's Shop for [b]500 Adamantine Coins[/b].[list][*]You can combine 5 Dark Erg Fragments to obtain 1 Dark Erg Chunk.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When you clear Crom Bás, you will get 3 times more [b]Adamantine Coins.[/b][/*][*]The amount of coins rewarded is based on the Dark Erg % level when the dungeon is cleared.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1101/extended-support-update-part2.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Note:[/b] If you reach the weekly clear limit (7 times) for Crom Bás, the Adamantine Coin reward is not increased until the weekly reset.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
Adventurous Milletians can trek to the Forgotten Tomb, where high-tier Gear, Weapons, and Treasures await. Defeating the enemy can lead to great riches, if you dare. This year, you can even find the Forest Ranger Set! Check out the details below.

[/b][/*][*]You must have at least one [b]Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket[/b] or [b]Forgotten Tomb Special Key Exchange Ticket[/b] to enter the Forgotten Tomb dungeon. Tickets are exchanged for keys that will open the treasure chests.

Use the Forgotten Tomb Treasure Chest Key or Forgotten Tomb Special Treasure Chest Key to open the chests. Each key will open one chest.[/*][*]There are several ways to obtain tickets.
