notes.title: Milletian Full Boost!
notes.content:
To prepare all Milletians for the upcoming abyss, Boost Joe has created a special training program for everyone! Boost Joe will run weekly boost events that include Stardust, Techniques, Echostones, Spirit Weapons, Renown, and Erg! Additionally, you will be able to create a Black Combo Card. Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, November 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 9th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Milletian Full Boost![/b][/*][*]Talk to Boost Joe in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Boost Joe[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Milletian Full Boost:[list][*][b]12,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Incomplete Black Combo Card[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Boost Joe's Special Training[/b][/h2][list][*]You will receive the daily quest, [b][Daily] Boost Joe's Special Training.[/b][/*][*]You will also receive one [b]Boost Joe's Special Training Mission Pass.[/b][/*][*]Use the Boost Joe's Special Training Mission Pass and complete the mission. To enter the mission, right-click "Use" on the pass.[list][*]You are able to choose the difficulty level for the mission.[list][*][b]Beginner [/b]is about the same as the Hard difficulty Shadow Missions.[/*][*][b]Intermediate[/b] is about the same as the Elite difficulty Shadow Missions.[/*][*][b]Hard [/b]is as hard as Tech Duinn Missions.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can complete this mission with a party of up to 4 people.[/*][*]When completing this mission, you will receive [b]EXP[/b], [b]Gold[/b], and a [b]Mission Reward Box[/b] depending on the difficulty level.[list][*]The Mission Reward Box will grant a random [b]Skill Combo Card Fragment[/b] of a Talent.[/*][*]The higher the difficulty of the mission, the more Skill Combo Card Fragments you will receive.[list][*]Combine 10 Skill Combo Card Fragments of the same Talent to receive a [b]Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon[/b] of that Talent.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]By completing Boost Joe's Special Training Missions, you can receive [b]30 Combo points[/b], up to [b]90 Combo points per day[/b].[/*][*]Combo points can be used to modify the Incomplete Black Combo Card.[/*][*]Right-click "Use" on the Incomplete Black Combo Card in your inventory, then click [b]Customize Combo Card.[/b][list][*]Select a Slot Number of the Incomplete Black Combo Card and choose to change the skill, or unlock the slot.[/*][*]You can use [b]40 Combo points[/b] and a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon to change one skill of the Incomplete Black Combo Card to a skill of the Talent.[/*][*]You can use [b]60 Combo points[/b] to unlock a new skill on the selected Slot Number.[list][*][b]Note:[/b] Slots must be unlocked in order from Slot Number 4 to Slot Number 6.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can click on [b]Bonus Reset[/b] for Slots 2 through 6, and reset the bonus value of the Slot using [b]35 Combo points.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]When you are satisfied with the Black Combo Card, click on[b] [/b][b]Complete Combo Card [/b]to receive the Black Combo Card in your Combo Card menu.[list][*][b]Do not complete the card until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.[/b][/*][*][b]Completing the Combo Card is NOT reversible. Even if you complete the card by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Black Combo Card will [b]expire in 30 days, [/b]but can be extended or made permanent using the [b]Permanent Combo Card Coupon [/b]item.[/*][*]Once you have completed the card, you can no longer edit it.[/*][*]Similar to normal Combo Cards, you can customize it using [b]Advancement Badges[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Weekly Boost Events[/b][/h2]
[b]Week 1 (November 18th, After Maintenance - November 25th, 7:00 AM PST)
[/b][b]Stardust Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, you will receive [b]double[/b] of the following materials received from completing Melwyn's Society Sponsorship quests:
[list][*]Stardust Core Binding Agent[/*][*]Stardust Core Fragment (All Types)[/*][*]Stardust Regulator Frame Connector[/*][*]Stardust Regulator Frame (All Types)[/*][/list][/*][*]Royal Society Sponsorship Badges are [b]not doubled[/b] during the event.[/*][*]The bonus from the Royal Academy Crystal [b]will stack[/b] with the event bonus.[/*][/list]
[b]Technique Growth Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, you will obtain double Briogh. The maximum Briogh that can be earned per week will also be increased.[list][*][b]Briogh of Achievement[/b]
[list][*]Each time your character levels up, [b]20[/b] Briogh is obtained.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Briogh of Challenge[/b][list][*]Each time you complete a Dungeon or Mission, [b]100 [/b]Briogh is obtained.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Briogh of Discipline[/b][list][*]Each time you complete a repeatable quest, [b]100 [/b]Briogh is obtained.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b] Using 1 AP to exchange for 10 Briogh [b]will not be doubled[/b], however the System message will state "Obtain 2x Briogh" as other methods to gain Briogh during the event is doubled.[/*][*]The maximum amount of Briogh that can be earned per week is increased by 2x.[list][*]The weekly Briogh limit is increased to [b]3,000 [/b]during the event.[/*][*]The weekly Briogh limit resets on [b]Saturday at 12:00 AM PST.[/b][/*][*]If you reach the 1,500 Briogh limit before the event, you can still acquire the additional 1,500 Briogh up to the event cap of 3,000 Briogh until the weekly reset.[/*][*]When the event ends, the weekly gain is reduced back to 1,500. If you are over this weekly limit, you can no longer acquire Briogh, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event until the weekly reset.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b] The maximum amount of Briogh you can store at a given time is still 5,000 per Briogh type and it does not change during the event.[/*][/list]
[b]Week 2 (November 25th, 7:00 AM PST - December 2nd, Before Maintenance)
[/b][b]Echostone Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, the Echostone Advancement success rate is increased by 10%.[/*][/list]
[b]Spirit Growth Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, your Spirit Weapons will earn double EXP, and the weekly Spirit EXP limit will be increased.[list][*]The Spirit Growth menu will show EXP 2x when selecting items to feed the Spirit Weapon.[/*][/list][/*][*]The weekly Spirit EXP limit increased to 800,000 EXP during the event period.[list][*]This weekly Spirit EXP limit resets on[b] Saturday at 7:00 AM PST.[/b][b]
[/b][/*][*]If you reached the 400,000 EXP limit before event starts, you can still acquire the additional 400,000 EXP up to the event cap of 800,000 until the weekly reset.[/*][*]When the event ends, the weekly gain is limited to 400,000 again. If you are over this weekly limit, you can no longer acquire EXP, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event period until the weekly reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 3 (December 2nd, After Maintenance - December 9th, Before Maintenance)
[/b][b]Renown Growth Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]During the event period, you will receive double Renown EXP when completing a requirement for accumulating Renown. The daily Renown EXP limit will also be increased.[list][*][b]Note: [/b]Using Music or Life Renown Training Seals will not be doubled.[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum amount of Renown that can be earned per day will be increased by 2x.[list][*]You can receive up to [b]4,000 Renown EXP [/b]for [b]Nele, Yvona, [/b]and [b]Briana.[/b][/*][*]You can receive up to [b]20,000 Renown EXP [/b]for [b]Endelyon, Edern, [/b]and [b]Eluned[/b].[/*][*]This daily Renown EXP limit resets at [b]7:00 AM PST.[/b][/*][*]If you reached the daily Renown limit before the event starts, you can still acquire the additional Renown up to the event cap for the Music and/or the Life Renown NPCs until the daily reset.[/*][*]When the event ends, the daily gain is limited once again. If you are over this daily limit, you can no longer acquire Renown, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event until the reset.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Erg Boost Event[/b]
[list][*]When you log in during the event period, you will receive different items to help you with Erg. [list][*]On the first log-in during the event you will receive:[list][*][b]Lv. 10 Erg Infusion Catalyst[/b][list][*]This item can only be used after the event ends on [b]December 9th, After Maintenance.[/b][/*][*][b][u]Known Issue:[/u][/b] If you try to use this item while the event is in progress, the message that appears is untranslated.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster Coupon[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]On subsequent log-ins during the event, up to 4 times:[list][*][b]Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster Coupon[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note: [/b]The [b]Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster Coupon [/b]can only be used during the event. If you use the coupon outside of the event, you will receive an AP 5 Potion instead.[/*][*]The daily event reset time is [b]12:00 AM PST.[/b][/*][*]Use the Booster Coupon to upgrade the Erg Infusion Catalyst by [b]2 levels [/b]each time.[list][*]Use up to [b]5 coupons[/b] to increase the Erg Infusion Catalyst to [b]level 20[/b].[/*][*]The upgraded Erg Infusion Catalyst will [b]expire in 15 days[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b] Only the main character registered for the event can receive the rewards.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Reflections: Reforged - Patch Notes - November 4th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections: Reforged update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68469/return-of-the-playful-puzzles-2021]Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69237/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-2]The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2[/url]: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69327/midnight-loot-o-lantern]Midnight Loot-o'-Lantern[/url]: Thursday, October 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69915/milletian-event-erinn-attendance]Milletian Event: Erinn Attendance[/url]: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69736/autumn-night-camping]Autumn Night Camping[/url]: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69811/royal-mage-s-box]Royal Mage's Box[/url]: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69735/erinn-revitalized-quality-of-life-updates]Erinn Revitalized - Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69759/reforging-renewed-new-reforging-tools]Reforging Renewed - New Reforging Tools[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]New Reforging Tools[/b]
[list][*]To learn more about the New Reforging Tools, check out the full details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69759/reforging-renewed-new-reforging-tools]here.[/url][list][*]New Reforging Tools have been added to the game:[list][*]Basic Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through in-game contents.[/*][*]Precise Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through in-game contents.[/*][*]Exquisite Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through the Cash Shop.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new item, Hope Essence, can be obtained by using Exquisite Reforging Tools.[list][*]You can exchange Hope Essence with Lassar in Tir Chonaill or Stewart in Dunbarton for additional items that can help you reforge items.[/*][/list][/*][*]Existing Reforging Tools can still be used in-game, but they have been discontinued from the Cash Shop.[/*][*]The Reforging Tool menu and overall UI has been changed and usability has been improved.[/*][*]The way that Reforging Attributes are displayed in the item tooltip has been changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]
[list][*]To learn more about the November 2021 Quality of Life updates, check out the full details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69735/erinn-revitalized-quality-of-life-updates]here[/url].[list][*]Several Combo Card improvements have been added to the Combo Card menu.[/*][*]There are also several new improvements made to the Spirit menu.[list][*]You are also now able to seal items to exclude them from the list of available items to feed your Spirit.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some of the enchants on the Blossoming Memories weapons have been changed to enchants that do not increase the repair fee for the weapons.[/*][*]There are new changes to the Auction House.[list][*]New buttons have been added to the Auction House for your convenience.[/*][*]New functions have been added to prevent mistakes when buying or selling items on the Auction House.[/*][*]Expired items, excluding Enchant Scrolls, can no longer be listed on the Auction House.[/*][*]A feature to check the Item Details of items not currently being sold on the Auction House has been added.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]A change has been made so that when the Shadow Effect in Options>System>Effect is set to Not Used, the Shadow Blurring option will be deactivated.[/*][*]A change has been made to include the bank fee when purchasing items back from the Repurchase tab if originally sold to an NPC using Direct Bank Transaction.[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Dexterity stat did not increase when you consume certain amounts of specific food items.[/*][*]Fixed an intermittent issue where the Echostone Advancement UI and Inventory closes while upgrading Echostones.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a Trade Unlock Potion could be used on a Falias Treasure that was equipped.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the icon displayed above the targeted enemy will disappear if you press the skill hotkey again while Spinning Slasher is already loaded.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the character’s Skill window gets closed when you view the pet or partner's Skill menu while the character’s Skill window is open.[/*][*]Fixed the skill Arrow Revolver so that it no longer inflicts elemental damage to elemental damage immune monsters.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the incorrect image was used for the Bebhinn 2nd Title when equipped.[/*][*]Fixed various text issues in the Uladh Dungeon section of the Dungeon Guide.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the description of the Subject Theta Bag Fragment item.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Ethel's dialogue for the Billionaire's Bankroll Event.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Blaanid's dialogue.[/*][*]Updated the Dungeon Guide for main rewards information to clarify [Refined] Blacksmith Manual Fragment Set.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Music Buffs extended by the Spirit of Tuan pet were not reflected in the Status List.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][*]Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.[/*][*]There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.[/*][*]There is an issue with movement speed when an Elf character equips bouquet items.[/*][*]Chef's Passion is unable to be reforged.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Erinn Revitalized - Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][b]Combo Card Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]Several Combo Card improvements have been added to the Combo Card menu.
[list][list][*]The maximum number of Combo Cards that you can have at one time has been expanded to 30.[/*][*]The [b]Multi-Delete[/b] function has been added. 
[list][*]When ‘Multi-Delete’ is checked, select the Combo Cards to remove, then click [b]Eliminate[/b] to remove them from the list.[/*][*][u][u][b]Note: Combo Cards cannot be recovered once deleted.[/b][/u][/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][/list][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1360/mabinogi-qol-nov-combo-change-order.png[/img][list][*]The [b]Change Order[/b] function has been added.[list][*]When 'Change Order' is checked, select a Combo Card then use the arrows in the menu to change the card’s position in the list, then click [b]Save[/b] to confirm.[/*][/list][/*][*]An improvement has been made so that when trying to delete the currently activated Combo Card, a Warning message highlights that an activated card is selected.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Spirit Menu Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]Several improvements to the Spirit menu have been added. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1361/mabinogi-qol-nov-spirit-select-unseal.png[/img][list][*]A new function to seal items has been added to the Spirit menu. This function allows you to exclude items from the list of available items to feed to the Spirit in the Spirit Growth section.[/*][*]To seal an item, open the Spirit Information menu -> Growth -> Etc. tab and right-click items to select them, then click the [b]Seal Item[/b] button to seal them.[/*][*]Sealed items will appear in the [b]Sealed Item tab[/b] under Spirit Information -> Growth.[list][*]To unseal items, click to select items in this tab, then click [b]Break the seal[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Non-equipment items will be filtered as Miscellaneous items in the Sealed Item tab.[list][*]The following equipment items will be filtered in the Misc. tab:[list][*]Empty Bottle[/*][*]Poison Bottle[/*][*]Strawberry Cookie Wand[/*][*]Chocolate Cookie Wand[/*][*]Vanilla Cookie Wand[/*][/list][/*][*]Selecting 1 Misc. item of the same type will automatically select all items, and will appear as 1 Misc. Item in the Sealed tab regardless of how many items of the same type are in the character’s inventory.[/*][*]The Spirit’s Fav. Gem information has been moved to the top-left, above the Spirit’s portrait in Spirit Information -> Growth.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Blossoming Memories Weapons Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]Some of the enchants on the Blossoming Memories weapons given in Blaanid's Brave Boost have been changed to enchants that do not increase the repair fee. 
[list][*]The Blossoming Memories weapons that you already own will have their enchants changed during the November 4th, 2021 maintenance.[/*][*]Obtaining any of the Blossoming Memories weapons from Blaanid's Brave Boost will come with new enchants without the Repair Fee increase.[/*][*]The new enchants have the same effects as the previous enchants, excluding the repair fee increase.[/*][*]The Blue Fragrance enchant substituting the Girgashiy enchant will increase Max HP by 80 regardless of the equipped title.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Auction House Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]When purchasing items on the Auction House, the confirmation menu that used to display after clicking the [b]Purchase[/b] button has been removed. 
[list][*][b]Current process[/b]: Click the item listing -> Item Details menu is displayed -> click [b]Purchase[/b] button -> purchase is completed.[/*][/list][/*][*]When selling items on the Auction House, the confirmation menu that used to display after clicking the [b]List[/b] button has been removed. 
[list][*][b]Current process[/b]: From the My Auctions tab, click [b]Listings[/b] button -> Listings menu is displayed -> click [b]List[/b] button -> listing is completed.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Price information for listings has been aligned to the left on the My Auctions tab.[/*][*]When listing an item on the Auction House, the Duration time selection box now populates in descending order, sorted in order of longest (60 hours) to shortest duration (6 hours).[/*][*]When claiming a successfully purchased item, the [b]Claim Item[/b] button has been added to the right of the Price column. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1362/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-claim-item.png[/img][/*][*]When claiming the gold for a successfully sold item, the [b]Get Paid[/b] button has been added to the right of the Price column. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1364/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-get-paid.png[/img][/*][*]When a listing has expired and the item has not sold, the [b]List Again[/b] and [b]Reclaim[/b] buttons have been added to the right of the Price column. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1363/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-list-again-reclaim.png[/img][/*][*]The [b]Select All[/b] and [b]Claim/Reclaim Picks[/b] buttons have been added to the bottom right on the My Auctions tab.
[list][*]To use these buttons, the Auction Status column must be filtered to Purchase Failed, Purchase Succeeded or Sold items.[/*][*]After clicking [b]Select All[/b], click [b]Claim/Reclaim Picks[/b] to retrieve all items or the gold for the successful sales.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some functions have been added to prevent mistakes when purchasing or selling items on the Auction House.
[list][*]When registering an item for sale, a waiting time of 1 minute is added. 
[list][*]The listed item will appear in Auction House searches 1 minute after listing.[/*][*]The On Waiting List time is displayed in Auction House -> My Auctions -> Auction Status.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Purchase Settings[/b] option has been added.[list][*]This option restricts the purchase of items if the price of the item listing deviates from the recent average price by more than a set value.[/*][*]To set the value, click the [b]Settings[/b] button at the top right of the Auction House. [/*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1366/mabinogi-qol-ah-purchase-settings.png[/img][*]Once the value is set, if attempting to purchase an item that deviates from the recent average price, the [b]Confirm Purchase[/b] box must be checked before the item can be purchased.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Changes to item listings for items with an expiration timer have been added.[list][*]Expired items cannot be listed on the Auction House.[list][*][b]Note:[/b] Enchant Scrolls can be listed regardless of the time duration.[/*][/list][/*][*]A notification will appear if the item being purchased has less than 3 hours remaining.[/*][*]The listing duration cannot exceed the expiration time of the item.[list][*]If the duration of the item to be listed is less than the listing duration, the listing duration will be automatically adjusted to match the item’s remaining time.[/*][/list][/*][*]Items with a shorter expiration time than the listing waiting time will not be able to be listed on the Auction House.[/*][/list][/*][*]A feature to check the Item Details of items not currently being sold on the Auction House has been added.[list][*]When searching an item, if no current listings for that item are available, a Notice pop-up will appear. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1367/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-no-listings.png[/img][/*][*]When clicking the [b]OK[/b] button, you can view the Item Details such as the Average Recent Price, check the Market Price Data, or Preview the item, if applicable.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now search for items in the All (Total) tab using partial terms. The search will bring up listings from all different categories at the same time.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Searching “Ribbon” shows listings that contain the word Ribbon in the name. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1368/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-search-partial-term.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]If an item has been previously listed on the Auction House, the next listing for the same item type is filled with the same details such as unit price and listing duration.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] A Direct Dye Ampoule is listed for a gold amount with a listing duration of 24 hours. The next listing for an item of the same type (Direct Dye Ampoule) will automatically have the details filled in for the same gold amount and same listing time.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Reforging Renewed - New Reforging Tools
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Reforging Tools[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Basic Reforging Tools[/b], [b]Precise Reforging Tools[/b], and [b]Exquisite Reforging Tools[/b] have been newly released.[/*][*][b]Exquisite Reforging Tools[/b] can be purchased from the [b]Cash Shop[/b].[/*][*][b]Basic Reforging Tools[/b] and [b]Precise Reforging Tools[/b] can be obtained through in-game contents.[/*][/list]
[b]Basic Reforging Tool[/b]
[list][*]The [b]Basic Reforging Tool[/b] can be purchased for 5,000 gold from some General Shops such as Walter in Dunbarton and some Partner Shops.[/*][*]This Reforging Tool can only be used on items that have not been reforged before.[/*][*]This Reforging Tool has no expiration and cannot be traded.[/*][/list]
[b]Precise Reforging Tool[/b]
[list][*]You can now obtain [b]Precise Reforging Tools[/b] from the following in-game shops:[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Content[/b][/th][th][b]Cost[/b][/th][th][b]Weekly Purchase Limit (per account)[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Melwyn's Royal Society Sponsorship Shop[/td][td]Royal Society Sponsorship Badges x80[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mag Mell Fionnait's Shop[/td][td]Gold-Leaf Pine Cones x60[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Explorer's League Adventurer Seal Shop[/td][td]Adventurer Seals x40[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Commerce Ducat Shop[/td][td]350,000 Ducats[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Eavan's Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop[/td][td]20 Second, Third, or Fourth Vouchers[/td][td]4 (The purchase limit is shared across Voucher types)[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]This Reforging Tool has a 5-day expiration and is not tradable.[/*][*]The weekly Purchase Limit resets every [b]Thursday[/b] at [b]7:00 AM PT[/b].[/*][/list]
[b]Exquisite Reforging Tool[/b]
[list][*]The [b]Exquisite Reforging Tool[/b] can purchased from the Cash Shop.[/*][/list][list][*]This Reforging Tool does not expire and can be traded once.[/*][*]The Exquisite Reforging Tool can increase the number of Attributes, and the Reforging Rank.[/*][*]When using this Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher [b]Minimum Level[/b], depending on the Reforging Rank of the item.[list][*]The Attributes will not be granted lower than the Minimum Level.[/*][/list][/*][*]When using this Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher level than the Maximum Level, known as the [b]Limit Break.[/b][list][*]The appearance and availability of a Limit Break depends on the Available Attributes for an item, and can be checked in the Reforging Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]By using this Reforging Tool, one [b]Hope Essence[/b] will be obtained.[list][/list][/*][*]Hope Essence can be exchanged with Lassar in Tir Chonaill or Stewart in Dunbarton for additional items that can help you reforge items.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Exchange Amount[/b][/th][th][b]Item[/b][/th][th][b]Function[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x7[/td][td]Blossoming Hope Gem[/td][td]- Increases the number of Attribute Slots to 3 of a selected item
- Only items that have less than 3 Attributes can be selected
- When the item is reforged next, it is guaranteed to receive 3 Attributes
- Tradable once[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x15[/td][td]Exquisite Reforging Tool (Not Tradable)[/td][td]- Use this item to reforge a selected item.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x50[/td][td]Surging Hope Gem[/td][td]- Increases the Rank of a selected item to Rank 1
- Only items that are below Rank 1 can be selected
- [u]Tradable once[/u][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Reforging Tool Comparison[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Function[/b][/th][th][b]Exquisite Reforging Tool[/b][/th][th][b]Precise Reforging Tool[/b][/th][th][b]Basic Reforging Tool[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Number of Attribute Slots Increased[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rank Upgrade[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Granting Attribute[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Minimum Level[/td][td]Yes[/td][td]None[/td][td]None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limit Break Appearance[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]Existing Reforging Tools Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]Existing Reforging Tools can still be used as before. However, they have been discontinued from the Cash Shop.[list][*]Reforging Tool[/*][*]Fine Reforging Tool[/*][*]Credne's Reforging Tool[/*][*]Commerce Reforging Tool[/*][*]Refined Reforging Tool[/*][*]Refined Reforging Tool PLUS[/*][*]Premium Reforging Tool[/*][*]Amazing Reforging Tool[/*][*]Reforging Tool of Memory[/*][/list][/*][*]Obtaining Attributes and Reforge Rank ups while using Existing Reforging Tools is the same as before.[list][*]New Reforging Tools and features such as the List of Available Attributes only applies to new Reforging Tools.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Reforging Tools that can be obtained in-game have been changed as follows:[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Content[/b][/th][th][b]Before Change[/b][/th][th][b]After Change[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Festia Commemorative Gift Box[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool[/td][td]- None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Festia Treasure Hunt[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool

[list][*]The Reforging Tool menu and overall UI has been changed and usability has been improved.[/*][*]Improvements have been made so that you can see at a glance the number of Attributes, Reforging Rank, and Attribute changes before and after using a Reforging Tool.[/*][*]When a high-level Reforging attribute appears, it has been improved so that it can be easily checked within the Reforging Menu instead of the existing cutscene method that was inconvenient to use. [/*][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1374/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-reach-high-level_reforging.gif[/img][*]You can conveniently check the Reforging Attributes that appear on the equipment you are trying to reforge from the [b]List of Available Attributes[/b] menu. [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1404/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-available-attributes-list.png[/img][list][*]To access the menu, click on the “[b]Check List of Possible Attributes[/b]” button in the top right of the Reforging Menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]The populated list is relevant to the item currently placed in the Reforging Menu.[/*][*]The [b]List of Available Attributes [/b]and [b]Level Available [/b]columns are displayed based on the Reforging Tool being used and the current Rank of the item that is being reforged.
[list][*]The Level Available column is displayed as a level range.
[list][*]When using the Exquisite Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher Minimum Level depending on the Reforging Rank of the item.[/*][*]The Attribute levels will not be granted lower than the Minimum Level.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Maximum Level[/b] column is displayed based on Reforging Rank 1.[/*][*]When using the Exquisite Reforging Tool on items that are Reforging Rank 1, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher level than the Maximum Level, known as the [b]Limit Break[/b].[list][*]The appearance and availability of a Limit Break depends on the Available Attributes for an item.[/*][*]The Limit Break column is displayed based on Reforging Rank 1.[/*][*]The minimum/maximum level of the Limit Break level is determined according to the maximum level based on Reforging Rank 1 of the Attribute.
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] Attribute with a maximum level of 20 based on Rank 1: Limit Break Level 21~25[/*][*][b]Example:[/b] Attribute with a maximum level of 10 based on Rank 1: Limit Break Level 11~13[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Click the question mark icon the top-right corner of the Reforging menu to open the [b]Help[/b] menu to read more about the Reforging Tool and its functions.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1375/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-help-menu.png[/img]
[h2][b]Additional Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The way Reforging Attributes are displayed in the item tooltip has been changed to indicate the maximum level when displaying the Reforging Attribute. This change applies to all items reforged prior to the change in the display method.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1371/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-reforging-before-after-arrow.png[/img]
[u]Before/After[/u]
[list][*]The contents displayed in parentheses are as follows:[list][*]Attribute Name (current Attribute level/maximum level of the Attribute: Attribute effect increase).[/*][/list][/*][*]The maximum level displayed is based on the Exquisite Reforging Tool.[/*][*]The maximum level does not include the Limit Break level.
[list][*]Limit Break levels will appear as follows:
 [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1369/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-limit-break.png[/img][/*][/list][/*][*]In order to provide information on which Reforging Attributes can be obtained when reforging, the item type information that classifies equipment items has been added in the Item Attributes section of the item tooltip.[/*][*]The actual item name and item type classification of some items may be different.
[list][*][b]Example[/b]: Royal Diamond Leather Light Boots item is classified as Heavy Armor Shoes.[/*][/list][/*][*]The item type for enchantment, upgrades, Erg, and Spirit Contracts may differ from the item type for reforging.
[list][*][b]Example[/b]: The Practice Short Sword item is classified as a One-handed Sword when reforging, but One-handed Sword Erg enhancement and the One-handed Sword Spirit Contract cannot be performed.[/*][*][b]Example:[/b] The Gamyu Wizard Robe Armor (M)/(F) item is classified as Light Armor when reforging, but both enchantments for Clothing and enchantments for Light Armor can be applied.[/*][/list][/*][*]The 'Classic Spirit’ weapon type has been integrated into the general weapon type. 
[list][*]‘Classic Spirit’ weapons are classified as such when using existing Reforging Tools.[/*][*][b]Example[/b]: 'Classic Spirit One-Handed Sword' is displayed as 'One-Handed Sword' and reforges are applied as a 'One-Handed Sword' type when using a new Reforging Tool, but is still classified as 'Classic Spirit One-Handed Sword' when using existing Reforging Tools.[/*][/list][/*][*Sun Road Colt, Mana Knuckles, Chef’s Passion, Royal Pumpkin Rapier, Romeo's Rapier, Lambent Light Rapier, Rose's Thorn Rapier, and Scythes can now be reforged using existing and new Reforging Tools.[/*][*]Item tooltip details have been added to the Item Attributes section for the items listed below. The available reforging Attributes will differ for items with these labels when compared to other items.
[list][*]Added the “Giant Full Swing Exclusive Weapon” label to Giant Full Swing-only weapons.[/*][*]Added “Unable to use Enthralling Performance” to instruments that cannot be used with this skill.[/*][*]Added “Commerce Enhancement Outfit” label to Commerce Outfits.[/*][/list][/*][*]Shield-Mastery related Attributes that only appeared on Reforging Rank 3 items have been removed.[/*][*]Unlike the previous system where a Reforging Tool purchased from the General Shop must be used on items that have not been reforged before, any item can be reforged using any new Reforging Tool.[/*][*]Attributes can be received at an equal probability.[/*][*]The minimum level of all Attributes has been adjusted to level 1.[/*][*]The maximum level of Attributes is unified based on the highest level at which the Attribute can appear and can be reviewed in the Reforging Menu.[/*][*]Attributes that can only be used by a specific race appear only on equipment that that race can wear.
[list][*][b]Example[/b]: The Final Hit Cooldown Reduction Attribute, which can only be used by Human races, is organized into 'Heavy Armor' and 'Hat' item types, and can be worn by Humans in equipment items categorized for all races, Human only, Human/Elf only, and Human/Giant-only.[/*][*][b]Example[/b]: The Magnum Shot Damage Attribute, which can only be used by Human and Elf races, is organized into 'Heavy Gauntlets', 'Gloves', and 'Accessory' item types, and can be worn by Humans or Elves in equipment items categorized for all races, Human only, Elf-only, and Human/Elf-only.[/*][/list][/*][*]The following Attributes can now appear for all items.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - November 4th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on November 4th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, November 4th[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC-7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM 
Eastern (EDT, UTC-4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CET, UTC+1): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Thank you for restoring the reputation of the Willie Aknow's Candy Factory! [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69567/the-milletian-detective-s-journal]The Milletian Detective's Journal[/url] event is ending.[/*][*]Last chance to update your look! The[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69431/erinn-beauty-sales-2021] Erinn Beauty Sales 2021[/url] are ending.[/*][*]It's that time again to take attendance and collect stamps every day. The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69915/milletian-event-erinn-attendance]Erinn Attendance[/url] event is starting.[/*][*]Dust off your tents and gather some firewood cause it's time to go camping! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69736/autumn-night-camping]Autumn Night Camping[/url] event is starting.[/*][*]Spice up your Dressing Room with a new collection of outfits! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69811/royal-mage-s-box]Royal Mage's Box[/url] sale is starting.[/*][*]More quality of life updates are coming to Mabinogi! The Erinn Revitalized - Quality of Life Updates will be permanently added to the game.[list][*]More information regarding this update will release after the maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][*]Out with the old and in with the new! The Reforging Renewed - New Reforging Tools[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69759/reforging-renewed-new-reforging-tools] [/url]will be permanently added to the game.[list][*]More information regarding this update will release after the maintenance.[/*][*]A reminder that current Reforging Tools will be removed from the Cash Shop. For more information, please read this [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69753/end-of-reforging-tool-sales-new-reforging-tool-release]announcement[/url].[/*][/list][/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. [b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change[/url] submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Milletian Event: Erinn Attendance
notes.content:
Collect stamps every day to earn items, including the new Paparazzi Mage Imp pet! You can even earn the new Reforging Tools just by logging in daily! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]Log in to Mabinogi with a character above Level 30 and speak with [b]Caravan Joe[/b] by the [b]Dunbarton Statue[/b] to claim an [b]Erinn Attendance Book[/b].[list][*]This book will be used to record your attendance during the event.[/*][/list][/*][*]Every day, spend at least [b]36 minutes[/b] logged in to Mabinogi on that character, and you'll earn a stamp. Earn stamps to claim prizes! [/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]Attendance Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Day 1:[/b] Guardian Soul Stone x3[/*][*][b]Day 2:[/b] Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass x1[/*][*][b]Day 3: [/b]Pon x5[b]

notes.title: Autumn Night Camping
notes.content:
The leaves have turned from green to beautiful shades of red, yellow, and orange and the night air is crisp with the smell of a burning campfire nearby. Grab your tents, Milletians— it is time to go camping! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [b][Guide] Camping Under the Autumn Night Sky[/b].[b]
[/b][list][*]You will also receive an [b]Orange Wings of the Goddess (Camping Site) [/b]that can be used to teleport to the Camp Site event area.[list][*]You can also use the wings to teleport to the Dunbarton Town Square and the Tara/Taillteann Shadow Mission Boards.[/*][*]The Wings can be used every 10 minutes.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Find the [b]Camp-Loving Milletian[/b] at the Camp Site in [b]Blago Prairie.[/b][/*][*]You do not need to register a main character, and can play the event on any character on the account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Camping Under the Autumn Night:[list][*][b]21,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Happy Camping Coins x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets each [b]Thursday [/b]at 7 AM PDT.[/*][/list][h2][b]Weekly Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]You will receive the weekly quest, [b][Event] A Week of Happy Camping.[/b][/*][*]Complete Camping Helper quests [b]15 times[/b] to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]21,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Happy Camping Coins x50[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]To receive Camping Helper quests, talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian and select "[b]Receive Camping Helper Quests[/b]".[list][*]These quests can be received every hour in real-time between the top of the hour to 10 minutes after the hour.[/*][*]Once you receive the Camping Helper quest, there is a 12-minute time limit to complete the quest. (8 hours Erinn time)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Camping Helper Quests[/b]
[list][*]There are different Camping Helper quests that you may receive:[list][*][b]Making Bonds While Camping![/b][list][*]You will receive Autumn Camping Fireworks Kits to deliver to the people around the Camp Site.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Autumn Night Dance Party![/b][list][*]Get 3 Combos during a Freestyle Jam.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Delicious Food Shared at Camping Site![/b][list][*]Share Food with other players 5 times.[list][*]To share food with other players, press "Use" on a food item in your inventory while sitting in one of the chairs at the Camp Site.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Fireworks Over The Campgrounds![/b][list][*]Use the 3 Autumn Camping Fireworks Kit items that you received.[list][*]There is a 24-minute time limit to complete the quest. (16 hours Erinn time)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Each Camping Helper quest will reward you with the following items:[list][*][b]21,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Happy Camping Coins x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Achievement Quest Details[/b][/h2][list][*]You will receive the achievement quest, [b][Event] To Everyone Who Loves Camping![/b][/*][*]To complete this quest, you need to complete the following objectives:[list][*]Complete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping once[/*][*]Complete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping twice[/*][*]Complete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping three times[/*][*]Complete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping four times[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Event] To Everyone Who Loves Camping:[list][*][b]21,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Happy Camping Coins x200[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Blissful Aura Buff[/b][/h2][list][*]Camp out under the autumn night sky and rest near the Camp Site for [b]5 EXP per second[/b].[list][*]You can obtain this buff for up to 6 hours real-time.[list][*]The EXP gain will reset at [b]7 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have rested for 10 minutes, you will receive the [b]Blissful Aura [/b]buff. This buff lasts 1 hour:[list][*][b]Combat EXP +30%[/b][/*][*][b]1.5x Item Drop Rate[/b][/*][*][b]Movement Speed +5%[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Happy Camping Coins and Coin Shop[/b][/h2][list][*]Happy Camping Coins can be obtained by completing Camping Helper Quests as well as donating food to the campers at the Camp Site.[list][*]Talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian between 7:00 PM to 9:50 PM Erinn time and select "[b]Deliver Daily Food[/b]".[list][*]Food can be delivered once per in-game day.[/*][/list][/*][*]Select a food item in your inventory to donate it, and you'll be rewarded with [b]3 Happy Camping Coins[/b].[/*][*]If you deliver a food that fits the camping theme, you'll be rewarded with [b]5 Happy Camping Coins.[/b][list][*]The Camping Guide Bulletin Board will provide you with a hint on what food to deliver.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian to purchase items in the [b]Happy Camping Coin Shop.[/b]

[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68469/return-of-the-playful-puzzles-2021]Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69074/erinn-merchant-s-bottomless-pack]Erinn Merchant's Bottomless Pack[/url]: Thursday, September 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 21st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69326/milletian-events-free-repair-weekends]Milletian Events: Free Repair Weekends![/url]: Friday, September 24th, 11:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October 10th, 11:59 PM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69237/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-2]The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2[/url]: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69431/erinn-beauty-box-2021]Erinn Beauty Sales 2021[/url]: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 4th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69238/dungeon-re-fine-celebration-hotdays]Dungeon RE:Fine Celebration Hotdays![/url]: Saturday, October 9th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October 10th, 11:59 PM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69299/beauty-update]Beauty Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69239/dungeon-re-fine-update]Dungeon RE:Fine[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Dungeon RE:Fine Update[/b]
[list][*]To learn more about the Dungeon RE:Fine Update, check out the full details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69239/dungeon-re-fine-update]here[/url].[list][*]The Dungeon Notebook has been added to Mabinogi.[list][*]This item will list main rewards from dungeon end chests.[/*][/list][/*][*]Four new Refined Armor sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.[/*][*]New materials have been added.[/*][*]A new reward acquisition condition system has been added to Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.[/*][*]There are new changes to Uladh Dungeons, including changes to how Dungeon Keys work, how long a dungeon is, the view inside Fiodh and Coill Dungeons, etc.[/*][*]There are dungeon reward changes that have been made.[list][*]Some Enchant Scrolls can now be obtained in dungeons.[/*][*]Four new Exclusive Enchant Scrolls have been added.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are new reward changes made to Shadow Missions.[/*][*]A new item, Erinn Spirit, can now be obtained from Elite Shadow Missions.[list][*]Combining 10 Erinn Spirits will grant a 2nd Title Coupon according to their drop rate.[/*][/list][/*][*]Spirit Gems (100) can now be obtained from Shadow Missions.[list][*]This items provides 100 Spirit EXP when fed to a Spirit Weapon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Beauty Update[/b]
[list][*]To learn more about the Beauty Update, check out the full details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69299/beauty-update]here[/url].[list][*]30 new eye colors have been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]30 new skin colors have been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]The Beauty Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.[list][*]Beauty Slots will allow you to store and change your Hair, Eye, Face, and Mouth appearances.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Blinking System has been added to the Dressing Room, allowing you to set different options to your character's blinking.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Rich Chaotic Rune has been renamed to Condensed Chaotic Rune.[/*][*]Quivers can now hold 1,000 arrows.[list][*]The price of the item has been updated to 1,520 Gold.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a naming inconsistency issue with the Erinn Merchant's/Erinn Trader's items. All items have been renamed to "Erinn Merchants' Guild".[/*][*]Fixed an issue in the Homestead UI where item names were overlapping with the time duration.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appeared abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][*]The incorrect image for the Bebhinn 2nd Title is displayed when you equip the title.[/*][*]There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.[/*][*]If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.[/*][*]There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.[/*][*]The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - October 7th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on October 7th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69237/the-billionaire-s-bankroll-season-2]Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2[/url] event is starting.[/*][*]Dungeons are getting a much needed update! The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69239/dungeon-re-fine-update]Dungeon RE:Fine Update[/url] will be permanently added to the game.[/*][*]To celebrate the release of the Dungeon RE:Fine Update, the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69238/dungeon-re-fine-celebration-hotdays]Dungeon RE:Fine Celebration Hotdays[/url] are starting.[/*][*]No longer will your Milletian have dry eyes! notes.title: Beauty Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Beauty Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][b]30 new eye colors[/b] have been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]Changing your eye color will cost [b]3 Pon.[/b][/*][list][*]Sandy Brown[/*][*]Poppy Brown[/*][*]Deep Olive[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2268/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-eye-colors.png[/img][/*][*]Irish Mint Green[/*][*]Rainy Gray[/*][*]Smog Gray[/*][*]Ancient Blue-Green[/*][*]Thunder Gray[/*][*]Gloomy Gray[/*][*]Bold Sky Blue[/*][*]Soft Blue-Green[/*][*]Shadow Navy[/*][*]Premier Violet[/*][*]Caramel[/*][*]Scented Pink[/*][*]Sophie Green[/*][*]Lovely Pink[/*][*]Sweet Violet[/*][*]Soft Magenta[/*][*]Forest Brown[/*][*]Nostalgic Gray[/*][*]Light Beige[/*][*]Light Apricot[/*][*]Clear Gray-Blue[/*][*]Snow Gray[/*][*]Deep Dark Gray[/*][*]Devil's Shadow[/*][*]Soul Red[/*][*]Apricot[/*][*]Silky Pink[/*][/list][*][b]30 new skin colors[/b] have been added to the Dressing Room.[/*][*]Changing your skin color will cost [b]4 Pon.[/b][/*][list][*]Soft Tan[/*][*]Dark Mud[/*][*]Almond[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2269/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-skin-colors.png[/img][/*][*]Light Peach[/*][*]Deep Brown[/*][*]Silver[/*][*]Light Red[/*][*]Dark Tan[/*][*]Soft Ebony[/*][*]Pale Apricot[/*][*]Dark Almond[/*][*]Pale Copper[/*][*]Pale Water[/*][*]Cloud[/*][*]Light Tan[/*][*]Water[/*][*]Peanut[/*][*]Mauve[/*][*]Oak[/*][*]Dark Water[/*][*]Berserk[/*][*]Butter[/*][*]Mud[/*][*]Sweet Potato[/*][*]Red Snow[/*][*]Zombie[/*][*]Black[/*][*]Poison[/*][*]Spectral Soul[/*][*]Light Pink[/*][/list][/list][h2][b]Beauty Slots[/b][/h2][list][*]The [b]Beauty Slot[/b] system has been added to the Dressing Room.[list][*]This system allows you to store and change your Hair, Eye, Face, and Mouth appearances.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2279/beauty-slots.png[/img]
[olist][*]Access the Slot Section in the Dressing Room by clicking on the Beauty Slot icon.[/*][*]Select an appearance tab: Hair, Eye, Face, or Mouth.[/*][*]Click on [b]"Save Appearance"[/b], depending on which tab you are currently viewing, to save the current appearance of your character.[/*][*]Click on [b]"Save All Appearances"[/b] to save all currently applied appearances of the character.[list][*]If an appearance has not been saved, each appearance will be saved in an applicable empty Beauty Slot.[/*][*]Appearances that have already been saved will not change.[/*][*]If there are not enough empty Beauty Slots available, this option will not be available for use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Select an appearance in a Beauty Slot, then click [b]"Delete Appearance" [/b]to remove the selected appearance from the saved Beauty Slot.[list][*]Deleting an appearance [b]cannot be reverted.[/b][/*][*]After a saved appearance is deleted, the Beauty Slot will become empty and will be available for use.[/*][/list][/*][*]Click [b]"Beauty Slot Expansion"[/b] to increase the number of empty Beauty Slots using [b]Pon.[/b][list][*][b]60 Pon [/b]can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the [b]Hair [/b]tab.[/*][*][b]45 Pon[/b] can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the [b]Eyes, Face,[/b] and [b]Mouth [/b]tabs.[/*][/list][/*][/olist]
[b]Additional Details[/b]
[list][*]All appearances can be saved once in a Beauty Slot.[/*][*]When saving an appearance, the Hair, Eye, and Skin colors are also saved.[/*][*]You can change the character's appearance between all saved appearances at any time.[list][*]After clicking on a saved appearance, click the [b]"Change" [/b]button to apply the saved appearance to the character.[/*][*][u][b]If you change to an appearance saved in the Beauty Slot, without saving the current character's appearance, you will not be able to revert back to the unsaved appearance.[/b][/u][/*][/list][/*][*]Beauty Slots are exclusive to a character, and are not shared across your account.[list][*]Each character receives 3 free empty Beauty Slots per appearance type.[/*][*]Saved appearances are available only for the individual character that saved the appearance.[/*][*]Additional empty Beauty Slots can be expanded up to 300 for each appearance tab.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Eye Blinking[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2271/access_blinking_settings.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]The [b]Eye Blinking [/b]feature has been added.[list][*]This feature can be accessed in the Dressing Room under (1) Appearance Change -> (2) Eye -> (3) Blink Settings.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2272/blinkingsettings.png[/img]
[olist][*]Click on the [b]"Enable Blinking" [/b]checkbox to turn the blinking settings on or off.
[list][*]If checked, the blinking settings are applied to the character.[/*][*]If unchecked, the blinking settings are not applied.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Blinking Interval" [/b]can be set from a minimum of 1 second to a maximum of 60 seconds.[list][*]This determines the time between eye blinks. The character will blink randomly between the set times.[/*][*]Example: If set to a minimum of 1 second and a maximum of 10 seconds, the eyes blink randomly between 1 and 10 seconds. Immediately after blinking, the cycle is reset, and blinks randomly again.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Number of Blinks"[/b] can be modified for the blinking setting.[list][*]Blink Once[/*][*]Blink Twice (consecutive blinks)[/*][*]Randomize[list][*]If selected, your eyes will blink once or twice (consecutively) at random[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]"Blinking Speed" [/b]can be adjusted.[list][*]This is the time it takes for a character to open and close their eyes.[/*][*]This time can be set from a minimum of 0.03 seconds to a maximum of 0.15 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/olist][list][*]Once the blinking settings have been set up, click [b]Apply[/b] to save it to the character.[/*][*]To apply the default eye blinking settings, click on the [b]Default[/b] option, then click [b]Apply.[/b][/*][/list]
 

 

[u][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2274/default.gif[/img][/u]

[u]Default Blinking Speed
[/u][b]Blinking Interval: [/b]Min. 1 seconds/Max. 10 seconds
[b]Number of Blinks:[/b] Blink Once
[b]Blinking Speed: [/b]0.10 seconds

[b]Notes[/b]
[list][*]Blinking does not apply to Partner characters.[/*][*]Blinking does not apply to the following eyes:[list][*]Fox Eyes[/*][*]Innocent and Pure Look[/*][*]Too-solemn Look[/*][*]Languid Look[/*][*]Too-righteous Look[/*][*]Sharp Look[/*][*]Cartoonish Eyes[/*][*]Tired Eyes[/*][*]Bright Eyes[/*][*]Cai's Eyes[/*][*]Elatha's Eyes[/*][*]Pencast's Eyes[/*][*]Buchanan's Eyes[/*][*]Claudius's Eyes[/*][*]Romeo's Grateful Eyes[/*][*]Juliet's Grateful Eyes[/*][*]Shylock's Eyes[/*][*]Duncan's Eyes[/*][*]Crying Eyes[/*][*]Akule's Eyes[/*][*]Culinary Artist's Eyes[/*][*]Sour[/*][*]Bangled[/*][*]Horror[/*][*]Slight Frown[/*][*]Naive[/*][*]Dot Eyes[/*][*]Shady Eyes[/*][*]Guarded Eyes[/*][*]Deceiving Eyes[/*][*]Vagabond Eyes[/*][*]Two-Toned Hidden Heart Eyes[/*][*]Two-Toned Kyururu Eyes[/*][*]Serval Eyes[/*][*]Caracal Eyes[/*][*]Northern White-Faced Owl Eyes[/*][*]Western Parotia Eyes[/*][*]Superb Bird-of-Paradise Eyes[/*][*]Common Raccoon Eyes[/*][*]Fennec Fox Eyes[/*][*]Crested Ibis Eyes[/*][*]Beast Eyes[/*][*]Sleeping Eyes[/*][*]Meditating Eyes

notes.title: The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2
notes.content:
Ethel the Billionaire is here to support your growth needs again! Ethel will be providing support to all Milletians by covering 90% of your repair cost fees and selling Elite Shadow Mission passes. Along with Ethel, you can also obtain the maximum amount of keys, regardless of how many players are in the dungeon! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Investing in the Future.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Ethel[/b] near the Bank in [b]Dunbarton[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Ethel.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Investing in the Future.[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Key Drop[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, upon completing Tech Duinn Missions, your party will receive the [b]maximum amount of keys[/b] available, regardless of how many party members are in the mission.[b]
[/b][list][*][b]Tech Duinn Missions[/b][list][*]4 keys[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If the number of keys available cannot be divided equally between party members, leftover keys will be given to party members at random.[list][*]Example: If 3 players clear a Tech Duinn Mission, each party member will get 1 key and one party member will receive an extra key.[/*][/list][/*][*]Tech Duinn Missions may have more end chests than the max available keys given to the party.[list][*]Example: Depending on the number of party members who cleared Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission, there may be 6-8 chests. However, the party will still only receive a maximum of 4 keys.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Repair Fee Support[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, Ethel will help support your growth by paying for [b]90%[/b] of your repair fees.[list][*]Talk to Ethel and select "Repair Fee Support".[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Elite Mission Pass Support[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, Ethel will sell [b]Ethel's Elite Mission Selection Box[/b].[list][*]Talk to Ethel and select [b]"Purchase Pass"[/b]. [list][*]The selection box costs 200,000 Gold.[/*][*]The selection box has a 7 day expiration.[/*][*]You can choose either an Elite Pass for Tara or for Taillteann.[list][*]The selected pass has a 24 hour expiration.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only purchase 20 selection boxes per week.[list][*]The purchase limit is reset at midnight every Sunday.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Level Growth Support[/b][/h2][list][*]If you are between [b]cumulative level 5,000 and 15,000[/b], you can participate in the Level Growth Support event.[/*][*]Talk to Ethel and select "Level Growth Support".[/*][*]You will receive two quests, the daily quest, [b][Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Level[/b], and the achievement quest, [Challenge] Billionaire's Level Growth Support.[/*][*]For the daily quest, clear the Advanced Uladh Dungeon that is specified in the quest details.[list][*]This quest can be received once a day.[/*][*]This quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*][b]Reminder:[/b] You can now purchase Advanced Dungeon Passes from the [b]Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock[/b] in Dunbarton.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Level:[list][*][b]8,000,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Rebirth Potion x1[/b][list][*]Does not expire[/*][*]Cannot be traded[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]For the achievement quest, your objective is to [b]reach cumulative level 15,000.[/b][/*][*]Once you complete the objective, talk to Ethel for the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Ethel's Celebratory Gift Box x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Skill Growth Support[/b][/h2][list][*]If you are [b]under Total Combat Skill level 1,700[/b], you can participate in the Skill Growth Support event.[/*][*]Talk to Ethel and select "Skill Growth Support".[/*][*]You will receive two quests, the daily quest, [b][Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Skill[/b], and the achievement quest, [b][Challenge] Billionaire's Skill Growth Support.[/b][/*][*]For the daily quest, clear the daily Shadow Mission in Tara or Taillteann.[list][*]This quest can be received twice a day.[/*][*]The quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Skill:[list][*][b]Combat Skill Training Seal (10) Selection Box x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]For the achievement quest, your objective is to [b]reach Total Combat Skill Level 1,700.[/b][/*][*]Once you complete the objective, talk to Ethel for the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Ethel's Celebratory Gift Box x1[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Erinn Spirit Additional Drop Event [/b][/h2][list][*]When clearing Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions on Elite difficulty, there is an additional chance to obtain Erinn Spirit.[list][*]This is in addition to the normal end chest rewards.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Tech Duinn Mission Pass Box[/b][/h2][list][*]When clearing Tech Duinn Missions on Normal or Advanced difficulty, there is a chance to obtain an [b]Elite Tech Duinn Mission Pass Box:[/b]
[list][*][b]Feth Fiada (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Seven Nightmares (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Revived Illusion (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][*][b]Awakened Abyssal Lord (Elite) Pass Box[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Pass Box expires after 3 days.[/*][*]The Pass Box is tradable 1 time.[/*][*]When the Pass Box is opened, an Elite Pass for the mission is granted and the pass will expire in 24 hours.[/*][/list][h2][b]Ethel's Celebratory Gift Box[/b][/h2][list][*]Ladeca Combat 4x EXP Potion (1 Hour) (expires in 15 days)[/*][*]Unrestricted Dungeon Pass (expires in 15 days)[/*][*]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (expires in 15 days)[/*][*]Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box (expires in 15 days)[/*][*]Skill Training Seal (30) (Not tradable) (expires in 15 days)[/*][*]AP Potion (50) x2[/*][*]Guardian Soul Stone (Event) x3[/*][/list][h2][b]Combat Skill Training Seal (10) Selection Box[/b][/h2][list][*]Close Combat Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Archery Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Martial Arts Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Lance Combat Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Ninja Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Music Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Puppetry Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Transmutation Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Dual Gun Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Magic Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Battle Alchemy Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][*]Chain Slash Skill Training Seal (10)[/*][/list]
