notes.title: Dungeon RE:Fine Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The [b]Dungeon Notebook[/b] has been added to the game.[list][*]The Dungeon Notebook can be obtained by speaking to the Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock using the "Dungeon Notebook" option.[/*][*]The Main Rewards that can be obtained from dungeon end chests and dungeon boss kill drops are now listed in the Dungeon Notebook for the following dungeons and their corresponding difficulties: [list][*]Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Baltane Missions[/*][*]Tech Duinn Missions[/*][/list][/*][*]You can reference the Recommended Dungeon based on your Total Skill Level in the Dungeon Notebook.[/*][*]The Dungeon Notebook can be stored in the Me tab.[list][*]If you destroy the item, talk to the Researcher again to obtain a new one.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Four new [b]Refined Armor [/b]sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Type of Armor[/b][/th][th][b]Armor Set[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Heavy[/td][td]- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Helm
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Armor
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Vambraces
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Greaves[/td][/tr][tr][td]Heavy[/td][td]- Refined Royal Knight Armor
- Refined Royal Knight Gauntlets
- Refined Royal Knight Boots[/td][/tr][tr][td]Light[/td][td]- Refined Northern Lights Armor (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Armor (F)
- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (F)
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (F)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Light[/td][td]- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (F)[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Two new [b]material items[/b] have been added.[list][*]Phantasmal Ingot[list][*]Can be crafted using Hillwen Engineering[/*][/list][/*][*]Polished Plate[list][*]Can be created using Handicraft[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]A [b]reward acquisition condition system[/b] has been added when playing Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.
[list][*]In Uladh Dungeons and Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions, you must meet a certain level of [b]participation time in battle[/b] to fully obtain all rewards.
[list][*]60 seconds of battle is required for Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]30 seconds of battle is required for Shadow Missions[/*][/list][/*][*]These conditions apply to individual characters within the dungeon or mission.[/*][*]These conditions apply to the following:
[list][*][b]Uladh Dungeons:[/b] Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced[/*][*][b]Shadow Missions:[/b] Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and Elite[/*][/list][/*][*]Some dungeons are excluded from this reward acquisition system, such as Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, Lord Missions, Sinead’s Secret Missions, and special dungeons and missions exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.[/*][*]A dedicated icon has been added to the top left of the screen next to the list of party members when entering Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2282/checkmark_combat_icon.png[/img]
[/*][*]If you [b]meet the conditions[/b] for obtaining rewards, the icon will be highlighted with a check mark, indicating that the condition has been fulfilled and rewards can be obtained.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2280/grey_combat_icon.png[/img]
[/*][*]If you [b]do not meet the conditions[/b] for obtaining rewards, the following penalties will be applied:
[list][*][b]Uladh Dungeons:[/b] The dungeon itself is cleared, but the key to the reward box is not obtained after the boss is defeated.[/*][*][b]Shadow Missions:[/b] The mission itself is cleared, but the key of the reward box is not obtained and only half of the completion experience and completion gold is rewarded.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Avon Theater Mission passes of the Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced difficulty can now be purchased from [b]Marlowe[/b] in Avon.[/*][*]Crafting recipes for the Play Pages that can be collected from Avon Paper Sheep have been added so that it is now possible to create Play Pages of a higher difficulty when using the Magic Spinning Wheel.
[list][*]5 Faded Play Page -> 1 Bronze Play Page[/*][*]5 Bronze Play Page -> 1 Silver Play Page[/*][*]5 Silver Play Page -> 1 Gold Play Page[/*][/list][/*][*]Color values ​​have been applied to Avon Theater Mission passes to make it easier to distinguish passes by difficulty.[/*][*]During a Grandmaster Mission, the durability of items equipped and used inside the mission will not decrease.
[list][*]The durability will still decrease if using certain Life skills in the mission, such as Handicraft or Cooking.[/*][/list][/*][*]The issue of walls blocking the view has been improved for the following:
[list][*]The boss room in the Lord Mission: Fragments of a Trivial Fate[/*][*]The Alby Battle Arena room in the Alban Knights Training Grounds[/*][/list][/*][*]The Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon Pass can now be stacked up to 10 passes.[/*][*]The newly added rewards to several dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Reward List on the Dungeon Guide.[list][*]Repeated Clear Guaranteed Rewards have not changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Uladh Dungeon Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]There have been several changes made to Uladh Dungeons.
[list][*]These changes apply to Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced Uladh Dungeons.[/*][*]These changes do not apply to Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, and special dungeons exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]The length of the entire dungeon and the number of rooms have been reduced.
[list][*][b]Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeons[/b] = 1 floor[/*][*][b]Peaca Intermediate Dungeon, Hard Mode Advanced Dungeons[/b] = 2 floors[/*][/list][/*][*]When entering dungeons from Basic to Advanced difficulty, the mini-map inside the dungeon will be displayed from the beginning.
[list][*]When entering dungeons above Advanced difficulty, including Hard Mode and Advanced Hard Mode, the mini map is hidden as before.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Dungeon Key[/b] has been changed so that it no longer drops on the ground for pickup.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2281/key.png[/img]
[list][*]Now, if the party meets the conditions for the key to drop, the key will be acquired and displayed as a separate icon in a new special Dungeon Key menu.[/*][*]Any party member can use the Dungeon Key to open dungeon doors.[/*][*]Once the key is used, it will disappear from the menu until a new key is acquired.[/*][*]This change [b]does not[/b] apply to Uladh Dungeons that do not use a key such as Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, and Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now purchase Dungeon Passes from Basic to Advanced difficulty levels from the [b]Poulnabrone Researcher.[/b]
[list][*]The shop tabs are now separated by Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeon Passes.[/*][/list][/*][*]The shop list of [b]Tiro,[/b] who appears in some dungeons, has been changed.
[list][*]All of the items in the Potion tab have been changed.
[list][*]HP 100 Potion[/*][*]HP 100 Potion x10[/*][*]HP 300 Potion[/*][*]HP 300 Potion x10[/*][*]MP 100 Potion[/*][*]MP 100 Potion x10[/*][*]MP 300 Potion[/*][*]MP 300 Potion x10[/*][*]Stamina 100 Potion[/*][*]Stamina 100 Potion x10[/*][*]Stamina 300 Potion[/*][*]Stamina 300 Potion x10[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 500 Potion[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 500 Potion x10[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion[/*][*]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion x10[/*][/list][/*][*]Some items have been added to the Consumables tab[list][*]Special Arrow Bundle (500 arrows)[/*][*]Special Arrow Bundle (1000 arrows)[/*][*]Special Bolt Bundle (500 bolts)[/*][*]Special Bolt Bundle (1000 bolts)[/*][*]Training Mana Bullet (500)[/*][*]Mana Bullet (500)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Some iron cage-shaped dungeon doors have been improved so that they are easier to click on.[/*][*]The field of view inside the [b]Fiodh[/b] and [b]Coill[/b] Dungeons has been improved to reduce the view being blocked by bushes, trees, etc.[/*][*]The [b]Fountain of Blessing[/b] that can be found inside some dungeons has been improved.
[list][*]The size of the Fountain of Blessing has been slightly increased.[/*][*]The Fountain of Blessing will always appear in the Hard Mode Advanced difficulty.[/*][*]When clicking the Fountain of Blessing, the penalty effects have been removed, and the following fixed effects will be provided:
[list][*][b]Intermediate difficulty[/b] = Acquire 50% ~ 100% EXP. This acquisition effect is similar to the Golden Experience Fruit.[/*][*][b]Advanced difficulty[/b] = Acquire 50% ~ 200% EXP[/*][*][b]Hard Mode Advanced difficulty[/b] = Acquire 100% ~ 300% EXP or 1 ~ 3 durability of one equipped item will be repaired
[list][*]If there is no item to repair, the 100~300% EXP effect is acquired.[/*][*]The following items are not included as a repairable target:
[list][*]Brionac[/*][*]Falias Treasures[/*][*]Stardust[/*][*]Items in the Style tab[/*][*]Items in the Extra Equipment Slot[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Characters who are already level 200 will receive the Holy Water blessing effect for all equipped items instead of the EXP acquisition effect.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*]Several dungeon reward changes have been implemented.
[list][*]A change has been made so that the reward level of the dungeon end chest is the same regardless of the number of party members.[/*][*]The probability of obtaining each reward level of the dungeon end chest has been increased.[/*][*]The Shop Sales Bonus EXP attribute has been added to some equipment items obtained from the dungeon end chest. When sold to an NPC, the EXP bonus effect is gained by the character.[/*][*]The pool of dropped items when [b]defeating the dungeon boss[/b] has been improved. 
[list][*]Items with few uses in existing drop rewards have been removed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b] can now be obtained from the Uladh Dungeon boss of different difficulties with different probabilities.[list][*]If you combine two of the same Blacksmith Manual Fragment items together, you can obtain one Blacksmith Manual for each category with the same probability from the list.[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual Fragments cannot be traded.[/*][*]Blacksmith Manual items obtained from combining the Fragments can be traded.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Blacksmith Manual Fragment[/b][/th][th][b]Dungeons Found In[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
[b][Refined Light Armor] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Northern Lights Armor (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Armor (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Armor (F)

[b][Refined Light Gauntlets] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Gauntlets (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Gauntlets (F)

[b][Refined Light Greaves/Boots] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (M)
- Refined Northern Lights Greaves (F)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (M)
- Refined Majestic Knight Boots (F)
[/td][td]- Alby Intermediate ~ Advanced
- Ciar Basic ~ Advanced
- Rabbie Basic ~ Advanced
- Math Basic ~ Advanced
- Barri Basic ~ Intermediate
- Coill Basic[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b][Refined Heavy Armor] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Armor
- Refined Royal Knight Armor

[b][Refined Heavy Armor Vambrace/Gauntlet] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Vambraces
- Refined Royal Knight Gauntlet

[b][Refined Heavy Armor Greaves/Boots] Blacksmith Manual Fragments[/b]
- Refined Dustin Silver Knight Greaves
- Refined Royal Knight Boots
[/td][td]- Fiodh Intermediate ~ Advanced
- Barri Advanced
- Coill Intermediate
- Rundal Basic ~ Advanced
- Peaca Basic ~ Intermediate
- Alby Advanced Hardmode
- Ciar Advanced Hardmode
- Rundal Advanced Hardmode[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Blacksmith Manual - Refined Dustin Silver Knight Helm[/b][/td][td]- Peaca Intermediate 
- Alby Advanced Hardmode
- Ciar Advanced Hardmode
- Rundal Advanced Hardmode[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Some Enchant Scroll rewards can now be obtained.
[list][*]Even if different types of boss monsters or multiple boss monsters appear due to the number of party members in the dungeon, the overall probability of obtaining the reward from the dungeon difficulty is the same.
[list][*][b]Barri Advanced[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Midnight)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Coill Intermediate[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Coma)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Trader)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Rundal Advanced[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Chorus)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Reunion)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Peaca Basic[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Dreamy)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Trustworthy)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Nocturne)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Peaca Intermediate[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Dreamy)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Trustworthy)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Spiraling)[/*][*]Enchant Scroll (Enigmatic)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Ciar Advanced Hard Mode[/b] 
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Nocturne)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Trader)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Clashing)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Brainstorm)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Alby Advanced Hard Mode[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Midnight)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Coma)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Meteoroid)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Resolution)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Rundal Advanced Hard Mode[/b]
[list][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Reunion)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Chorus)[/*][*]Exclusive Enchant Scroll (Supernova)[/*][*]Enchant Scroll (Sonata)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Four new [b]Exclusive Enchant Scrolls[/b] have been added and can be obtained when defeating some of the Uladh Dungeon bosses.[/*][/list][table][tr][th][b]Enchants[/b][/th][th][b]Stats[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Dreamy (Prefix: Rank 8)[/b]
[/td][td]- Enchant enabled for headwear
- When Exploration Level is 20 or higher, grants Max Damage +7-15
- When Fusion Bolt is Rank 1 or above, grants Intelligence +25

[b]Midnight (Prefix: Rank 8)[/b]
[/td][td]- Enchant enabled for footwear

- Luck -20
- Enchanted equipment made exclusive[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Reunion (Suffix: Rank 8)[/b]
[/td][td]- Enchant enabled for headwear
- Max Damage +9-16 when Act 1: Inciting Incident is Rank 1 or higher
- Strength +17-25 when Puppet's Snare is Rank 1 or higher
- Marionette Max Damage +40
- Dexterity +10
- Intelligence -20
- Enchanted equipment made exclusive[/td][/tr][tr][td]

- Dexterity -20
- Enchanted equipment made exclusive[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]The Shop Sales Bonus EXP attribute has been added to some equipment items obtained from the dungeon boss. When sold to an NPC, the EXP bonus effect is gained by the character.[/*][/list][h2][b]Shadow Mission Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]There have been several changes made to [b]Shadow Missions.[/b]
[list][*]These changes apply to Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and Elite Taillteann and Tara Shadow Missions.[/*][*]These changes do not apply to Lord Missions, Sinead’s Secret Missions, Order Missions (Protect Corrib Valley and The Smell of Wine), and special missions exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.[/*][/list][/*][*]Several Shadow Mission reward changes have been implemented.
[list][*]Items with few uses have been removed or now appear less frequently.[/*][*]The drop rate of Combo Cards has been increased overall in all missions of Advanced, Hard, and Elite difficulty.[/*][*]The drop rate of the Lord Mission Pass and Sinead’s Secret Mission Passes in all missions has been improved.[/*][*]Improvements have been made so that the Baltane Mission Pass, Alban Knights Training Stone, and Combo Card items appear in all missions.
[list][*]Baltane Mission Passes and Combo Cards now can be obtained from Advanced Shadow Missions.[/*][*]Alban Knights Training Stones can now be obtained from Elite Shadow Missions.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]A [b]Spirit EXP attribute[/b] has been added to some equipment items that are dropped from the Mission Reward Box. When fed to the Spirit Weapon, the EXP bonus effect is gained by the Spirit.[/*][*][b]Regular Gems[/b] and [b]Regular Gem Powder[/b] can now be obtained from Shadow Missions.[/*][*][b]Erinn Spirit[/b] can now be obtained from Elite Shadow Missions.
[list][*]This item can be obtained from the Mission Reward Box in Elite Shadow Missions.[/*][*]Collect 10 of Erinn Spirit items, right-click on the stack, and select "Use" to combine them together. You will obtain one 2nd Title Coupon of the various NPCs in Erinn, according to each one's drop rate.[list][*][b]Note: [/b]2nd Title Coupons obtained via the Erinn Spirit item are not tradeable.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/69432]Click here to view the full list of 2nd Title coupons that you can obtain when combining Erinn Spirit items.[/url][b]
[/b]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2283/erinnspirit1.png[/img]
[/*][*]If the 2nd Title Coupon obtained is used, and you already have the title, you will receive 1 Erinn Spirit.[/*][*]The 2nd Title Coupons obtained via Erinn Spirit items can be shared within the account through the bank.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Spirit Gems (100)[/b] can now be obtained from Shadow Missions.
[list][*]This item can be obtained from the Mission Reward Box in Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and Elite Shadow Missions.[/*][*]This item provides 100 Spirit EXP when fed to a Spirit Weapon.[/*][*]The same EXP is provided regardless of the weapon type of the Spirit.[/*][*]This item cannot be given to Classic Spirit Weapons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The progress and entry conditions for some Shadow Missions have been improved.[list][*]If all enemies appearing in one wave are defeated, the next wave will proceed faster for the following Shadow Missions:[list][*]Rescue the Scout[/*][*]Taillteann Defensive Battle[/*][*]Offering[/*][*]Ghost of Partholon[/*][*]Fomor Attack[/*][/list][/*][*]The party size has been modified to allow entry with 1 player for the following Shadow Missions:
[list][*]Rescue the Scout[/*][*]Taillteann Defensive Battle[/*][*]Conflict! An Unexpected Battle[/*][*]Provocation[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Taillteann Defensive Battle Shadow Mission[/b] has been changed as follows:[list][*]The mission is cleared by defeating all monster waves at the East, West, and South gates 9 times each.[/*][*]Each time you defeat a monster wave, a warp zone appears so that you can move to a different gate.[list][*]The location of the warp zone that appears depends on the location of the current defense line.[/*][*]The warp zone is destroyed when used once.[/*][/list][/*][*]Monsters will no longer appear at a gate if all monster waves are defeated.[/*][*]Whenever there are too many remaining monsters or an NPC ally dies, the defense line moves inward towards Taillteann Square, and if the final defense line collapses, the mission will fail.[/*][*]The mission’s Experience and Gold Rewards have been lowered.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 30th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 30th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

[b]-Time-[/b]

[b]Thursday, September 30th[/b]

Pacific (PDT, UTC-7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AM 
Eastern (EDT, UTC-4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM

[b]To address the following:[/b]
[list][*]Weekly server upkeep.[/*][*]Windows update.[/*][*]Processing of requested name changes. [b]Note:[/b] The [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/shop/namechange]Name Change[/url] submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Milletian Events: Free Repair Weekends!
notes.content:
For a limited time, enjoy free repairs for your weapons and gear on the weekends! Stop by any NPC that does repairs to enjoy this event, without the need of selecting a main character. Check out the details below.

notes.title: Reflections - Patch Notes - September 9th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68469/return-of-the-playful-puzzles-2021]Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68484/bleugenne-viola-box]Bleugenne Viola Box[/url]: Thursday, August 26th, 10:00 AM PDT - Thursday, September 23rd, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68867/wish-upon-a-star-candy]Wish Upon a Star Candy[/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68743/shopkeeper-s-sale-homestead-refreshments-and-hotdays]Shopkeeper's Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays![/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68794/royal-teacup-box]Royal Teacup Box[/url]: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68742/family-weekend-fishing-event-2021]Family Weekend Fishing Event 2021[/url]: Friday, September 10th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October, 3rd, 11:59 PM PDT[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68691/renovation-season-2-combat-talent-changes]Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68866/renewed-adventures-quality-of-life-updates]Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates[/url]: Permanent[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68597/refresh-your-homestead]Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]Reflections Update[/b]
[list][*]September is a month of reflection, and we have several updates to renew your fantasy life in Erinn. Check out each of the individual posts below to learn more about each of the updates:
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68597/refresh-your-homestead-homestead-update][b]Refresh your Homestead![/b][/url]
[list][*]The Homestead can be expanded to be even bigger than before.[/*][*]New Sales items and returning favorites are here, including Partner pets! Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68743/shopkeeper-s-sale-homestead-refreshments-and-hotdays]Shopkeeper’s Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays[/url] post for more details.[/*][*]Changes have been made to the Homestead Options menu, and you can now view your Homestead visitor count.[/*][*]You can now place your Partners on your Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68691/renovation-season-2-combat-talent-changes][b]Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes[/b][/url]
[list][*]Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Close Combat, Archery, Magic, Puppetry, and Alchemy talents.[/*][/list][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68866/renewed-adventures-quality-of-life-updates][b]Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Changes[/b][/url]
[list][*]Over 40 game changes and updates are here to improve your Quality of Life in Erinn, such as no durability decrease outside of combat, visual skill cooldown timers and music buff duration, a hotkey to pick up items off of the ground, and more![b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following change has been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Changed the title for "a Soul Streamer" to "the Soul Streamer".[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the crafting materials for Energy Amplifiers were switched.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Weapon Magic Attack was incorrectly labeled as Weapon Magic Damage while Erging.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.[/*][*]There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.[/*][*]There is a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appears abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.[/*][*]There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.[/*][*]The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.[/*][*]Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.[/*][*]There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.[/*][*]Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.[/*][*]There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a partner has something equipped in their left hand.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 9th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

notes.title: Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Homestead Expansion[/b][/h2][list][*]The size of your Homestead can now be expanded to be even bigger than before.[/*][*]Increase the size of your Homestead past the existing Stage 3 size using the following all-new items:[list][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 4[/b][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 5[/b][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 6[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1865/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-stages.jpg[/img]

[b]Homestead Size by Level[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Homestead Level[/b][/th][th][b]Size[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 1[/td][td]9x9[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]2 - 3[/td][td]17x17[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]4 - 9[/td][td]25x25[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]10 - 13[/td][td]33x33[/td][/tr][tr][td][u]Level [/u]14 - 15[/td][td]49x49[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Homestead Size when using a Homestead Expansion Permit[/b]
[table][tr][th][b]Stage[/b][/th][th][b]Size[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]55x55[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]61x61[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]67x67[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 4[/td][td]75x75[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 5[/td][td]83x83[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 6[/td][td]91x91[/td][/tr][/table]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1866/mabinogi-homestead-update-homestead-items.jpg[/img]

[b]Homestead Expansion Permit Details[/b]
[list][*]Homesteads that are [b]Level 14 or higher[/b] can be expanded in size using [b]Homestead Expansion Permits[/b], up to Stage 6.[list][*]Each Expansion Permit will increase the size of the Homestead.[list][*]Stage 1 - 3: Size will be expanded by 6 tiles horizontally and vertically.[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Stage 4 - 6: Size will be expanded by 8 tiles horizontally and vertically.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Permit can only be used on a Homestead once.[/*][*]Each Permit, past Stage 1, requires the previous Stage Permit to be used on the Homestead.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] The Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 4) cannot be used until a Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 3) has already been used to expand the Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Homestead Expansion Permits[/b] are permanently available and can be purchased in the Item Shop:[list][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 1)[/*][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 2)[/*][*]Homestead Expansion (Stage 3)[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Homestead Expansion (Stage 4)[/*][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Homestead Expansion (Stage 5)[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Homestead Expansion (Stage 6)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]New Homestead Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]Options and Permissions[/b]
[list][*]Upon entering your Homestead, two new buttons can be accessed in the Homestead Information menu in the top right. 
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1879/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-1.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Options: [/b]Apply overall Homestead permissions through this menu.
[list][*]This option button replaces the need to click on the Homestead Entrance -> View Information button to open the Building information menu previously.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Minimize: [/b]This Homestead menu can now be minimized.[list][*]You can also minimize this menu when visiting other character's Homesteads.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]When you click on the [b]Options [/b]button in the Homestead menu, you can view the Homestead Options.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1868/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-2.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Entry Permissions[/b]: Set the permissions of who can enter your Homestead.[/*][*][b]Item Permissions:[/b] Apply permissions to all Homestead Props.[list][*]This has been changed from needing to set the option for each Homestead prop.[/*][*]You can still set the option for each Homestead prop individually.[list][*]However, if you set the permissions for a prop individually, the saved option in Homestead Options -> Item Permissions will be unchecked. If checked again, it will change the permissions of all props once more.[/*][/list][/*][*]When placing a new Homestead prop, the permission setting is reflected on the new item as well.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Visitor Count[/b]
[list][*]The Homestead visitor count is now displayed.[/*][*]Open the Homestead menu (Default Hotkey: U) when outside of your Homestead to view the Today and Total visitor count.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1869/mabinogi-homestead-update-vistor-count.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Today's Count:[/b] View the total number of visitors to your Homestead for the day.[list][*]This will count once per visiting character per day, and resets at 7:00 AM PT daily.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Total Count: [/b]View the total number of visitors who have visited your Homestead.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Partner Homestead Placement[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1870/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-1.gif[/img][/b]
[list][*]You can now place your Partners in your Homestead.[/*][*]Upon entering your Homestead, a new [b]Partner Placement[/b] button is available underneath the Edit and Construction List Homestead buttons.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1871/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-buttons-partnerplacement-added.png[/img]
[/*][*]Open up the menu to view the list of available Partners that can be placed in your Homestead.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1957/mabinogi-homestead-update-placement-menu.png[/img]
[list][*]Select [b]Static Placement[/b] from the menu to place a Partner anywhere in your Homestead.[/*][*]Select [b]Interactive Placement[/b] from the menu to place a Partner on a Homestead Prop, such as a chair.[list][*]A silhouette view will appear and it will show where the Partner can be placed on all available Homestead props.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1872/mabinogi-homestead-update-silhouette-before.png[/img]
[/*][*]You can move a Homestead prop that has a Partner placed on it and the Partner will be moved with it.[/*][*]If you remove a Homestead prop that has a Partner is placed on it, the Partner will also be removed with the prop. The Partner can be placed again from the Partner Placement menu.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You are unable to select a Partner that is already placed in another Homestead within the same account.[/*][*]Partners cannot be placed inside a Homestead House.[/*][*]Partner take up a 1x1 space when placing them in your Homestead.[/*][*]Partners cannot overlap existing Homestead prop grids.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1873/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-2.png[/img]

[b]Partner Homestead Options[/b]
[list][*]While outside of the Partner Placement menu, click on a placed Partner to view the following options:[list][*]Partner Gesture[/*][*]Move[/*][*]Switch Out[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1874/mabinogi-homestead-update-partner-options.png[/img]
[list][*]You can now modify the Gestures of Partners place in your Homestead.[list][*]You are unable to modify Partner Gestures when a Partner is placed on a Homestead prop.[/*][*]Crossover Partners such as Ram and Rem from the Re:ZERO crossover cannot use Partner Gestures.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Basic Motion[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Homestead Partner Cards[/b] can be used to add new basic motions to a Partner, like an idle stance.[list][*]Homestead Partner Cards can be obtained from the [b]Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Box[/b] sold in the Maid and Butler Partner shops for 500,000 gold.[list][*]You can obtain 1 of [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/68889][b]85 Basic Motions[/b][/url] with an equal chance when opening the box.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have a Homestead Partner Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Motions" column, click [b]Add[/b], then select a Card to give to your Partner, and then click OK.[b]
[/b][list][*]Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.[/*][*]You can add up to 100 Basic Motions.[/*][*]You can [b]Delete[/b] the added motion, but the Motion Card will not be returned.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1875/mabinogi-homestead-update-adding-motion.gif[/img]
[list][*]If a Partner is wearing an outfit with an animation, the animation will play when the default "Basic Motion" option is selected.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Gesture Motion[/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Gesture Cards[/b] can be used to add Gestures that a Partner can use.[list][*]Existing Gesture Cards can be used.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have a Gesture Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Gesture" column, click [b]Add[/b], then select a card to give to the Partner, and click OK.[list][*]Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.[/*][*]You can add up to 100 Gestures.[/*][*]You can [b]Delete[/b] the added Gesture, but the Gesture Card will not be returned.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can change the time interval (in seconds) that the Gesture will repeat.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1876/mabinogi-homestead-update-interval.png[/img]
[/*][list][*]At 0, the Gesture will continuously repeat from beginning to end. If the set interval is shorter than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture is cut off and plays again.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1877/mabinogi-homestead-update-2sec-repeated-gesture.gif[/img]
[/*][*]If the Gesture interval is set longer than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture will play. When it ends, the Basic Motion will play until the Gesture plays again.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1878/mabinogi-homestead-update-15sec-gesture-then_basic-motion.gif[/img]
[/*][*]The max interval can be set is 999 seconds.[/*][/list][*]If you do not want a Gesture motion to be played, select the default "Do Not Use" option and the selected Basic Motion for the Partner will play instead.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Move[/b][/u]
[list][*]You can move the Partner around your Homestead, similar to a Homestead prop.[/*][*]You are unable to move the Partner if they are placed on a Homestead prop.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Switch[/b][b] Out[/b][/u]
[list][*]You can remove a Partner from the Homestead.[/*][*]Once a Partner is placed on the Homestead, you cannot summon it until you've removed them from the Homestead.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Wish Upon a Star Candy
notes.content:
Clodagh and Fovish are back with a new event! Have you ever wished upon a star...candy? Create and enjoy these delicious sweet treats for new rewards! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Wishing Upon a Star Candy.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Clodagh[/b] across from the [b]Healer's House [/b]in [b]Dunbarton.[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Clodagh[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Wishing Upon a Star Candy:[list][*]21,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list][h2][b]Let's Make a Star Candy![/b][/h2]

[list][*]You will receive the quest, [b][Event] Let's Make a Star Candy![/b][/*][*]To proceed through the quest, you will need to make and eat different flavor Star Candies.[/*][*]Summon a [b]Star Candy Sprite[/b] using a [b]Star Candy Sprite Summon Ticket[/b].[list][*][b]Star Candy Spirit Summon Tickets [/b]can be received at a chance from the end reward chest when clearing dungeons such as:[list][*]Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]Alban Knights Training Grounds[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Baltane Mission[/*][*]Tech Duinn[/*][*]Mag Mell[/*][*]Sidhe Finnachaid[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Each week, a different Star Candy Sprite will be available to summon.[list][*][b]Week 1: [/b]Strawberry[/*][*][b]Week 2: [/b]Lemon[/*][*][b]Week 3: [/b]Melon[/*][*][b]Week 4:[/b] Grape[/*][/list][/*][*]After summoning the Star Candy Sprite, attack the sprite to get [b]Star Candy Crumbs.[/b][list][*]The Star Candy Sprite summon will last for 5 minutes.[/*][*]You can attack Star Candy Sprites that other players have summoned.[/*][*]You can summon Star Candy Sprites in town.[/*][*]Only one Star Candy Sprite can be summoned per region.[/*][*]You cannot summon the Star Candy Sprite in instances such as Homesteads, or Avalon Gate, dungeons, or Shadow Missions.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will need [b]10 Star Candy Crumbs[/b] to make [b]1 Star Candy.[/b][list][*]You can receive a [b]maximum[/b] of [b]5 Star Candies per day[/b] by taking them to Clodagh.[/*][*]Any Star Candy Crumbs that were not turned in to Clodagh for the day will be removed.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once a Star Candy is created, eat it![list][*]For every Star Candy you eat, you will receive [b]1 Star Candy Coin.[/b][/*][*]Use Star Candy Coins to purchase rewards from [b]Fovish[/b] in the [b]Star Candy Shop.[/b][/*][*]You can choose to make [b]one wish[/b] while eating a Star Candy.[list][*]Depending on the wish, you will receive a reward. notes.title: Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Changes[/b][/h2][list][*]The Bank's Gold Deposit Fee has been removed.[/*][*]You can now turn off the PVP option in the revival menu when you become incapacitated by PVP.[list][*]You can also turn this option off in the [b]Options -> Game -> ETC -> Allow PVP[/b] settings.[/*][/list][/*][*]The channel you are currently on will now be highlighted in the Move Channel window.[list][*]The Move Channel window has also been slightly increased in size.[/*][/list][/*][*]The number of characters you can register in the chat blacklist has been increased from 20 to 60.[list][*]You can use this setting in [b]Options -> Game -> Chat -> Blacklist Setting[/b].[/*][*]This setting blocks chat from Bugles, Normal Chat, Party Chat, and Whisper Chat of the users registered on the blacklist.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1967/mabinogi-qol-sept-new-options-3.png[/img]
[list][*]The max bundle/stack count for the Altar of Restoration item has been changed to 20.[/*][*]The cost of the Altar of Restoration item in NPC shops has decreased from 10,000 gold to 500 gold.[/*][*]The Partner conversation menu has been improved.[list][*]When talking to a Partner, some actions have modified so that the conversation does not end automatically, and you can choose a different action.[/*][*]The camera no longer switches to a fixed angle when talking with a Partner.[/*][/list][/*][*]Rebirth Potions can no longer be used in a state when Rebirthing is already available.[list][*]The description of a Rebirth Potion stating that you can drink it, even when Rebirth is possible, has been removed.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new hotkey option to open up the Dungeon Guide has been added.[list][*]You can set the related shortcut for the [b]Dungeon Guide Window[/b] in [b]Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where characters would intermittently get stuck in the wall when entering the boss room of the Taillteann Shadow Mission, "Defeat the Shadow Wizard".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Spirit's bleeding damage ignored the PvP percentage setting and abnormally affected PvP battles.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you were temporarily unable to attack a monster after it entered a deadly state from the Final Hit skill when using Knuckles with an Erg effect.[/*][*]To resolve the issue where music continued to play even after Enthralling Performance ended, it has been changed so that the music ends in the following situations:[list][*]When the corresponding score is played to the end[/*][*]When re-using Enthralling Performance[/*][*]When logging out of the game client[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where Ghost Pirates in the banquet hall spawned inside the wall during the Shadow Mission "Deep Sea Clues" in the G24 quest "A Sleepless Voyage".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Crystal Golems that appear at the Scathach Beach - Springs Mana Tunnel would spawn on cliffs.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where when the Succubus Queen used Sweet Illusion on a character that used a pet's hide skill, and the target character's pet was unsummoned, the hide state was not removed.[/*][*]Improvements have been made to the Exclusive Spirit Effect "Analysis" so that it will now apply on enemies with Magic Defense and Magic Protection reduction statuses.[list][*]The description of the Analysis Effect has been updated.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection were not applied to damage once Mana Shield deactivated, and the character would be inflicted with high damage.[/*][*]The Demigod skills have been improved so that activating the skill will no longer consume Training EXP.[list][*]The skill description has been modified to remove the mention of EXP consumption.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]The Wings of Eclipse skill still works the same as before where EXP decreases each time an attack is blocked.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue that prevents a pet from moving and acting due to a counterattack while mounted.[list][*]If the Auto Combat option is unchecked in [b]Options -> Game -> Control -> Reserve Attack[/b], the pet will not automatically counterattack even if it is hit while riding.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue that caused the screen to appear dark if the game client was terminated and reconnected during a dungeon.[/*][*]The durability decrease of equipment due to the passage of time has been removed.[list][*]This applies to all equipment worn by the player character and Partners.[/*][*]The durability of equipment equipped in the robe slot will also decrease when being hit during combat.[/*][*]The durability decrease of equipment in the robe slot due to being hit is reduced by about half less than the existing time decay value.[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed the party count limit from 1 to 2 players for the "Light and Darkness" Shadow Mission in the G10 quest, "Courcle's Heart".[/*][*]The notice message that appears after clearing the daily maximum number of dungeons in the Dungeon Guide has been changed so that it displays only once upon reaching this daily limit.[/*][*]Instead of the Skill Rank up menu, only an on-screen notice message and a system message are now displayed when ranking up the Shine of Eweca skill.[/*][*]When Adniel's Horn is used, the name of the character who used it will now appear in the message log.[/*][*]The [b]Targeting Options[/b] setting has been added to [b]Options -> Game -> Control[/b] tab.[/*][list][*]You can select “Cursor Proximity” or “Character Proximity”.[/*][*]Cursor Proximity targets the enemy closest to the mouse cursor.[/*][*]Character Proximity targets the enemy closest to the character's position.[/*][/list][*]You can now pick up items from monsters killed by Squires during Baltane Missions.[/*][*]The [b]Auto-Decline Guild Invitation[/b] function has been added to [b]Options -> Game -> ETC[/b] tab
[list][*]When this option is checked, you will turn down any guild invitations automatically.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Lock Pet Skill Slot[/b] option has been added to [b]Options -> Game -> ETC[/b] tab.
[list][*]When this option is checked, the Pet Skill Slot that appears when a Fynn pet is summoned will be locked so you cannot remove any skills or move the window.[/*][/list][/*][*]A new clock icon has been added to make it easier to identify items in the inventory that have an expiration timer.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1969/mabinogi-qol-sept-clock-icon.png[/img]
[list][*]A new function to stack items with different expiration timers has been added to the top right of the inventory window.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1964/mabinogi-qol-sept-stackable-expirables.png[/img]
[list][*]A new hotkey option to pick up items from the ground has been added.
[list][*]The default shortcut is set to [b]Alt + C.[/b][/*][*]You can set the related shortcut for [b]Item Collection[/b] in [b]Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The item tooltip for the Forgetful Potion item now displays a cooldown timer.[list][*]If there is no current cooldown for the character, it will state “Available Now”.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] If you recently used a Forgetful Potion with a 7-day cooldown, this cooldown will be visible on other Forgetful Potion items.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1971/mabinogi-qol-sept-forgetful-cooldown.png[/img][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1970/mabinogi-qol-sept-forgetful-available.png[/img]
[list][*]A new hotkey option to target objects such as lamp posts and trees has been added.
[list][*]You can set the related shortcut for [b]Object Targeting[/b] in [b]Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]A minimize function has been added to the Character Status List window.
[list][*]This can be accessed by clicking the Details button on the Character Info window under [b]Basic Info -> Status Effects[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Status icons and the skill usage gauge no longer overlap above the character's head.
[list][*]When the Character Status List window is activated, the status icon is not displayed above the character's head.[/*][/list][/*][*]Relevant information for active buffs are now displayed on the Character Status List for the following skills:
[list][*]Battlefield Overture[/*][*]Vivace[/*][*]Enduring Melody[/*][*]Harvest Song[/*][*]March Song[/*][*]Chain Burst[/*][*]Berserk[/*][*]Snap Cast[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1963/mabinogi-qol-sept-music-timer.png[/img]
[list][*]Skill cooldown information is now displayed as a number at the bottom of the skill icon.
[list][*]This also applies to the summon cooldown time for pets that are added to the hotkey bar.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1965/mabinogi-qol-sept-skill-cooldown.gif[/img]
[list][*]The skill cooldown of Glyph Evocation has been changed from 150 seconds to 140 seconds across all Ranks.[/*][*]Increased the skill duration of Glyph Evocation by 10 seconds per Rank. 
[list][*][b]Example -[/b] Based on Rank 1 of the skill:
[list][*]100 seconds -> 110 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill casting time of the Glyph Evocation has been greatly reduced.[/*][*]When using a Glyph Recovery Scroll (10), a new Max Recovery option has been added.[list][*]This will allow the use of several scrolls to automatically recover the Glyph’s durability.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Combat Penalty notification window is now displayed when moving channels shortly after combat.[list][*]This will show the Gold/EXP loss if the channel is changed and the remaining duration of the penalty.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Share Music Buffs[/b] option has been added to [b]Options -> Game -> ETC[/b] tab.
[list][*]When this option is [b]unchecked[/b], you cannot give music buffs to party members, or receive music buffs from party members.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Combo Card Slot Change Coupon can now be used on Combo Cards with permanent duration.[/*][*]The Combo Card Slot Change Coupon can now be used while using VIP service.[/*][*]The issue of the Blue Ghost enemy breaking through dungeon walls has been improved.[/*][*]The Field Raid optimization pop-up window will no longer be displayed.[/*][*]Two new Wall and Flooring options are available for use inside of the Homestead House and can be purchased with gold.[list][*][b]Antique Wallpaper and Large Window: [/b]103,000 Gold[/*][*][b]Refreshing Wallpaper and Large Window: [/b]103,000 Gold[/*][/list][/*][*]The Combo Card Slot Change Coupon (Trade Limit: 1) can now be listed on the Auction House.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Magic[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1836/mabinogi-talent-update-magic.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*]The magic system has been changed so that only 1 magic charge (previously 2 magic charges) is decreased if you are knocked down while charging [b]Healing[/b] or any of the following intermediate magic skills:[list][*][b]Thunder[/b][/*][*][b]Fireball[/b][/*][*][b]Ice Spear[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The magic system has been changed so that the charge count is not removed if you are knocked down while charging [b]any type of Bolt Magic[/b].[/*][/list]
[u][b]Item Changes[/b][/u]

[b][u]Wand[/u][/b]
[list][*]You can now use all intermediate magic regardless of the type of Wand you have equipped.
[list][*]For example, Thunder, Fireball, and Ice Spear can all be cast using a Lighting Wand, Fire Wand, or Ice Wand.[/*][/list][/*][*]Each Wand receives 5% bonus damage when the intermediate magic being used matches the elemental attribute of the Wand.[list][*][b]Lightning Wand[/b] - Thunder Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Fire Wand[/b] - Fireball Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Ice Wand[/b] - Ice Spear Bonus Damage +5%[/*][*][b]Divine Tribolt Wand[/b] - Can receive Bonus Damage +5% effect from all intermediate magic[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][u]Staff[/u][/b]
[list][*]All Staves can use intermediate magic.[list][*]You no longer need to collect elemental charges with some Staves, such as a Trinity Staff.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Fireball[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1833/mabinogi-talent-update-fireball.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Fireball has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fireball can now be used from 1 charge, instead of requiring 5 charges.[/*][*]The charge can still be stacked to 5, and the damage will increase with each charge up to 5.[list][*]Damage ratio per charge = 1: 2: 3: 4: 6.5[list][*]1 Charge: 1/6.5 Damage[/*][*]2 Charge: 2/6.5 Damage[/*][*]3 Charges: 3/6.5 Damage[/*][*]4 Charges: 4/6.5 Damage[/*][*]5 Charges: 6.5/6.5 Damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The time that Fireball will fly in the air has been shortened to 1 second.[list][*]Previously, the time was 2.5 seconds.[/*][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Ice Spear[/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Ice Spear has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Thunder[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1846/mabinogi-talent-update-thunder.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Thunder has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The time it takes for lightning to strike has been reduced to one second, regardless of the skill Rank.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Blaze[/b][/u]
[list][*]While charging Blaze, stun is now ignored, and no longer cancels the skill.[list][*]Being knocked down will still cancel Blaze.[/*][*]Attacks that inflict a special stun will still cancel Blaze.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Hail Storm[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1835/mabinogi-talent-update-hail-storm.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Hail Storm can now be used with Spellwalk, enabling you to walk freely while the skill is charging, or while having active Hail Storm charges.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Spellwalk[/b][/u]
[list][*]The way Stamina is consumed for Spellwalk has been changed.[list][*]Stamina no longer decreases while Spellwalk is active.[/*][*]Stamina will only decrease when moving while charging a skill, or before using a skill that has been charged.[list][*]This only applies to skills that you cannot normally move with without Spellwalk active.[/*][*]10 Stamina points are consumed per second in this state.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Meteor Strike[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1844/mabinogi-talent-update-meteor-strike.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The damage of Meteor Strike has been increased.[list][*]This increased damage also applies to some enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The casting time of Meteor Strike has been reduced to 2 seconds from 4 seconds.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The time it takes for Meteor Strike to hit has been reduced to 2 seconds from 5 seconds.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage reduction based on the distance furthest from the center of impact has been removed.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Close Combat[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1830/mabinogi-talent-update-close-combat.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Windmill[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1853/mabinogi-talent-update-windmill.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The maximum damage per Rank has been increased.[list][*][b]Example -[/b] Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]Human/Giant: 250% -> 400%[/*][*]Elf: 200% -> 320%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Windmill's attack range has been increased depending on the Rank of the skill.[/*][*]When you have a melee Combat talent weapon equipped and are using Windmill, enemies hit by Windmill are knocked down in place. They are no longer knocked back and scattered.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies who use Windmill.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Charge/Lance Charge[/b][/u]
[list][*]The position lag issue when using Charge/Lance Charge has been improved.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Assault Slash[/b][/u]
[list][*]Assault Slash's cooldown has been reduced to 7 seconds across all Ranks.[/*][*]The activation speed has been increased when using Assault Slash after Smash.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Alchemy[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1841/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemy.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1854/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemic-damage.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Alchemic Damage[/b] has been added to the Character Information menu.[list][*]It now shows stats for Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth attributes based on the character's equipped titles, gear, and talent bonuses.[/*][/list][/*][*]The stats that affect Alchemy have been changed.
[list][*]Damage is increased by the average of the character's Max HP, Max MP, and Max Stamina.[/*][*]The affected skills are as follows:[list][*]Water Cannon[/*][*]Flame Burst[/*][*]Wind Blast[/*][*]Heat Buster[/*][*]Sand Burst[/*][*]Frozen Blast[/*][*]Shock[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Water Cannon[/b][/u]
[list][*]Water Cannon has been changed to apply a fixed maximum damage amount regardless of the distance from the target.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][*][b]Before:[/b] Base damage 1x * Damage by Distance from target (0.6x to 1.4x)[/*][*][b]After:[/b] Base damage 1x * Distance 1.4x[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Flame Burst[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1834/mabinogi-talent-update-flame-burst.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Flame Burst's duration has been increased for some Ranks of Flame Burst.[/*][*]If the new duration includes a time less than 1 second, the Flame hit will be calculated as 1 second.[list][*]In this case, the last hit of Flame Burst will deal damage proportional to the original duration.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]If the duration of Flame Burst's usage is 4.2 seconds, it will hit 5 times over 5 seconds. The last hit will be applied at 20% of the damage of 1 hit.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Wind Blast[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1839/mabinogi-talent-update-wind-blast.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Wind Blast's activation structure has been changed to be activated by clicking the ground after casting.[/*][*]When activated, enemies within a 4 meter radius around the character are pushed in one direction.[list][*]Enemies behind the character are pushed in the direction the character is facing.[/*][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][*]The reforge option, Wind Blast Range, has been changed to Wind Blast Attack Range.[list][*]Previously, the reforge started at 1 meter, and increased the range by 0.25 meters per level.[/*][*]This has now been changed to an option that increases the attack range by 0.15 meters per level.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Stardust Support Effect for Wind Blast has been changed from Blast to Flare.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Heat Buster[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1837/mabinogi-talent-update-heat-buster.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Heat Buster has been changed so that you can activate this skill when the cylinder pressure is 50% or higher.[list][*]Previously, it required 100% cylinder pressure.[/*][/list][/*][*]When activated, the damage is proportional to the pressure amount.[list][*][b]Example: [/b]When activated at 50% pressure, it is activated at 50% damage.[/*][/list][/*][*]When activated at maximum pressure, an additional 20% damage is inflicted as before.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Life Drain[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1858/mabinogi-talent-update-life-drain.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Life Drain can now be activated even when you have Max HP.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Summon Golem[/b][/u]
[list][*]The stats of the summoned Golem's HP, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection have been increased.[/*][*]The casting time and attack time of the summoned Golem's Smash, Defense, and Windmill skills have been reduced.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the summoned Golem's Taunt skill did not have a cooldown.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Puppetry[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1838/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1855/mabinogi-talent-update-marionette-info.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*][b]Marionette Information [/b]can now be viewed in the Character Information menu. [list][*]It outlines the stats of the summoned marionette and can only be viewed when a marionette is summoned.[/*][*]This menu can also be opened by right-clicking the summoned marionette character and clicking on "View Status".[/*][/list][/*][*]A new option has been added.[list][*]Options -> Game -> Controls -> [b]Use Marionette Camera[/b][list][*]When activated, the camera moves around the doll instead of the player.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Marionettes can now pick up items.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Control Marionette[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1857/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry-dismount-pet.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The Control Marionette skill has been changed so that if the marionette summon is canceled due to mounting a pet, the marionette will be summoned automatically after dismounting the pet. [list][*]The Control Marionette skill will also be activated after dismounting the pet.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 1: Inciting Incident[/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 1: Inciting Incident has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]200% -> 300% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 2: Threshold Cutter[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1843/mabinogi-talent-update-act-2.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been increased.[list][*][b]Example[/b] - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]700% -> 960% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The character and marionette motion when using the skill has been changed.[/*][*]The skill has been changed to an AoE attack skill that simultaneously attacks enemies within a 2 meter radius from the original targeted enemy.[/*][*]Attack speed has been increased.[/*][*]The Stardust Support Effect for Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been changed from Blast to Flare.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 4: Rising Action[/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 4: Rising Action has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]300% -> 560% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 6: Crisis[/b][/u]
[list][*]The invincibility duration of enemies hit by the skill has been removed.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Act 7: Climactic Crash[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1847/mabinogi-talent-update-act-7.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]The base damage of Act 7: Climactic Crash has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1 of the skill:[list][*]550% -> 860% damage[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]It has been changed so that the control of the marionette is not canceled after the attack is completed so long as the position of the marionette is within the control range.[/*][*]The enemy is knocked back in the same direction as the skill casting direction, increasing the probability of enemies being hit by all 3 hits.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the marionette would not move intermittently when using the skill in front of obstacles.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you are intermittently unable to attack enemies when using the skill in front of obstacles.[/*][/list]

[h2][b]Archery[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1845/mabinogi-talent-update-archery.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]System Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1831/mabinogi-talent-update-archery-rework.gif[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Archery has been changed so that regardless of the aiming rate, the Archery Talent attack will always hit an enemy.[list][*]If attacking outside of the attack range, the attack will miss.[/*][/list][/*][*]The damage is determined by the character's minimum/maximum damage in proportion to the aiming rate at the time of the attack.[list][*]When the aiming rate is 100%, the minimum/maximum damage is 100% reflected.[/*][/list][/*][*]Various effects that previously affected accuracy have been changed to now affect aiming rate.[list][*]Certain text descriptions that mention Accuracy have been changed to Aim Rate.[/*][/list][/*][*]The delay time when aiming from 99% to 100% is now removed.[/*][*]The effect that appears when the aiming rate is 100% has been changed to now appear when the aiming rate is 70%.[/*][*]A bonus to the aim rate is now applied when reaching 70% aim rate, regardless of the aiming speed.[list][*]This change only applies to player characters.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Item Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*]The [b]Bow[/b] and [b]Crossbow Erg Bonus Effects[/b] have been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Skill cooldown upon aim failure"
[list][*][u]Decreased time by seconds per Erg level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After: [/b]"Archery Skill Cooldown"
[list][*][u]Decreased time by seconds per Erg level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*]The Erg effect reduction value per level has been decreased[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on level 50 Erg:[list][*]Max 2 seconds -> 1 second[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Various arrows and bolts can now be bundled up to 500 pieces.[list][*]The number of bundles of arrows/bolts sold by weapon shop NPCs has increased.[/*][/list][/*][*]1,000 arrows can now be inserted into the Quiver.[/*][*]The [b]Piercing Forest Arrow[/b] description has been corrected to include the additional 12% maximum damage bonus.[/*][/list]
[u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u]

[u][b]Crash Shot[/b][/u]

[u][b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1859/mabinogi-talent-update-crash-shot.png[/img][/b][/u]
[list][*]Crash Shot has been changed so that the fragment attack occurs at the same time as Crash Shot hits an enemy.[list][*]This change does not apply to enemies.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Urgent Shot[/b][/u]
[list][*]Urgent Shot has been changed so that you can use the skill regardless if the previous attack hit or missed.[/*][*]Skill cooldown has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:
[list][*]10 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill training requirement has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Use the skill successfully immediately after missing."[/*][*][b]After:[/b] "Use Urgent Shot to defeat an enemy."[/*][/list][/*][*]The Glyph Effect for Urgent Shot has been changed.[list][*][b]Before: [/b]"Urgent Shot Available Time"[list][*][u]Increased by 0.05 seconds per level[/u][/*][/list][/*][*][b]After: [/b]"Urgent Shot Cooldown Decreased"[list][*][u]Decreased by 0.2 seconds per level[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[u][b]Final Shot[/b][/u]
[list][*]When using Final Shot, you can now immediately activate the skill without casting time.[list][*]Previously, the casting time was 2 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][*]The duration of the skill has been increased.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:[list][*]30 seconds -> 45 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Skill cooldown has been reduced.[list][*][b]Example - [/b]Based on Rank 1:[list][*]260 seconds -> 240 seconds[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill has been changed so that the durability of the equipped weapon does not decrease when using the skill.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Fairy Village Event 2021
notes.content:
The Fairies of the Fairy Village need your help. Five of their villagers have gone missing while exploring the wide world of Erinn, and they need you to lend a hand and find their missing friends. The good news? All you need to do is lure the curious little Fairies out with your Life Skills! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Thursday, September 9th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Runaway Fairy.[/b][/*][*]Talk to the [b]Fairy in Need[/b] in [b]Dunbarton.[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with the [b]Fairy in Need[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Event] Runaway Fairy:

notes.title: Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021
notes.content:
Oh no! Someone has spilled puzzle pieces all over the place and it is up to you to put it back together! Log in every day to get a puzzle piece and fit it on the puzzle board. The more puzzle pieces you collect, the more prizes you'll get! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] A Boy's Request[/b].[/*][*]Find the NPC [b]A Boy In Need[/b] in [b]Dunbarton [/b]in front of the Unicorn Statue.[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]A Boy In Need[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once registered, a Puzzle icon will appear on your screen.
[/*][*]Stay logged in for [b]36 minutes[/b] every day to receive a [b]Puzzle Event Gift Box.[/b][/*][*]Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a puzzle piece.[list][*]Staying logged in on [b]any character[/b] will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a puzzle piece.[/*][*][b]You can only receive the puzzle piece prizes on your main character.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]You will only receive 1 puzzle piece per day.[/*][*]Every weekend, you will receive 2 puzzle pieces per day (for a total of four).[/*][*]To find out how many puzzle pieces you have, how much time is remaining before you receive the puzzle piece, or how far along you are on the puzzle, click on the Puzzle icon.[/*][*]Once you obtain a puzzle piece, click on "Fit" on the Puzzle Event UI to place the puzzle piece on the board.[/*][*]The more puzzle pieces you obtain, the more prizes you get![/*][*]When you complete [Event] Piecing Together the Puzzle!, you will receive the following rewards:

notes.content:

notes.title: Regarding Recent Bans
notes.content:
Hello Milletians

We would like to address the community as recently there have been spam messages invoked across the screen by users who are manipulating the game. Our team has been aware of these messages and have been investigating. We would like to ensure that these messages are not official. Any official announcements will be posted on official Nexon channels, including the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/]Mabinogi Website[/url], [url=https://forums.mabinogi.nexon.net/]Mabinogi Forums[/url], the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/212200/allnews/]Mabinogi Steam page[/url], and the [url=https://bit.ly/MabiDiscord]Official Mabinogi Discord server[/url]. We will continue to monitor this situation and work with our development team to provide the best service possible to Mabinogi.

Additionally, we've detected the usage of third-party programs used for illicit or malicious intent, and have banned approximately 107 accounts today. While we cannot disclose the details of the bans directly, we can state that those affected were only those detected for using potential hacking software.

If you have any questions regarding your account, please submit a ticket to [url=https://support-mabinogi.nexon.net/hc/en-us]Customer Support[/url]. Be sure to also review Mabinogi's [url=https://www.nexon.com/main/en/legal/tou]Terms of Service[/url].

Thank you for your understanding.

[i]- The Mabinogi Team[/i]

notes.title: Rebirth Potion Parade 2021
notes.content:
Come and join the Rebirth Potion Parade! We have Rebirth Potions galore! Talk to Parade Helper Caravan Joe to get things started and be sure to check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, August 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 2nd, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest [b][Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor[/b].[/*][*]Find [b]Parade Helper Caravan Joe[/b] in [b]Dunbarton[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Parade Helper Caravan Joe.[list][*]You must be cumulative level 30 or above to participate.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor:[list][*][b]5,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to Caravan Joe every day to receive the daily quest, [b][Event] [/b][b]Obtain Incomplete Rebirth Potion.[/b][list][*]Clear a daily Shadow Mission in Taillteann or Tara to complete the daily quest requirement. [/*][/list][/*][*]Completing the daily quest will reward you with [b]3 Incomplete Rebirth Potions.[/b][/*][*]Combine [b]10 Incomplete Rebirth Potions [/b]to receive a [b]Rebirth Potion[/b].[list][*]Rebirth Potions can be used to immediately rebirth your character, regardless of how long it has been since your last rebirth.[/*][*]Incomplete Rebirth Potions are tradeable.[/*][*]Rebirth Potions created through the event will expire 72 hours after creation.[/*][/list][/*][*]Incomplete Rebirth Potions will be removed at the end of the event.[/*][*]The event resets at[b] 7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list]

[b]Stardust Part 1 Update[/b]
[list][*]Discover the power of Stardust with [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/stardust]Stardust: Part 1[/url]! [/*][*]After reaching [b]cumulative level 3,000[/b], help out the Royal Society of Astronomy by starting the quest [b][Guide] An Astronomical Discovery[/b] found in the "Society Sponsorship" quest tab.[/*][*]Learn more about the new Stardust System through the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/67779/stardust-stardust-info-and-support-effects-guide]guide[/url]. 
[list][*]The Stardust equippable item can be obtained from the Stardust quest, [b][Guide] Stardust Cores and Regulators.[/b][/*][*]Equip the Stardust in a new special Stardust item slot in the bottom left of your main Inventory.[/*][*]Right-click the Stardust item to view [b]“Stardust Info”[/b].[/*][*]The Stardust Info menu details all things Stardust, including your Stardust Rank, Support Effects, and materials for Stardust. 
[list][*]Stardust Rank can be advanced up to Rank 10 in Part 1.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Learn more about the Royal Society of Astronomy Society Sponsorship quests through the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/67713/stardust-royal-society-sponsorship-guide]guide[/url].
[list][*]Complete Society Sponsorship Quests to receive new materials necessary for ranking up your Stardust Rank and strengthening your Stardust Support Effects.[/*][/list][/*][*]The [b]Total Skill Level[/b] has been added on the Additional Info tab of the Character Info menu, and can also be found at the bottom of the Skill window.
[list][*]Total Combat Skill Level and Total Life Skill Level can be increased by ranking certain skills.[/*][*]All skills that have already been ranked will be reflected in the Total Skill Level.[/*][*]The higher the Total Combat Skill Level and Total Life Skill Level, the higher difficulty ranks of the Society Sponsored Quests will be available.[/*][/list][/*][*]Receive [b]Royal Society Sponsorship Badges[/b] to purchase items in Melwyn’s Shop.[/*][*]A new Title and Journal Achievements are available when completing Society Sponsorship Quests.[/*][*]New Intermediate Dungeons and Shadow Missions have been added, and new Enchant Scrolls can be obtained as rewards.[list][*]Intermediate Dungeon Passes can be purchased from the Researcher near the Poulnabrone Rock in Dunbarton.[/*][*]Elite Passes for the new Shadow Missions can be obtained from the mission end chests in Tara and Taillteann.[/*][/list][/*][*]The new Shadow Missions will be added as a possible Daily Mission for the [b]Today's Daily Mission[/b] daily quest.[/*][*]Completing each new Intermediate Dungeon and Shadow Mission (all difficulties) will grant a Journal Achievement.[/*][/list]
