notes.title: Celebrate the Fourth of July!
notes.content:
It is time to celebrate America's Independence Day–the Fourth of July! Enjoy a display of Star-Spangled Banners in Tir Chonaill and Dunbarton. Light up the night sky with fireworks and be sure to log in for special rewards! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, July 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, [b]Star-Spangled Banners[/b] will be displayed in Tir Chonaill and Dunbarton![/*][*]Players who log in during the event period will receive the following item:[list][*][b]*NEW* Star-Spangled Banner Bearer 2nd Title Coupon[/b][list][*]Max HP +80[/*][*]Max MP +10[/*][*]Max Stamina +50[/*][*]Magic Attack +8[/*][*]Critical +1%[/*][*]Movement Speed +5%[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Star-Spangled Banner Bearer 2nd Title will [b]expire after 7 days[/b] of using the coupon.[list][*]However, you can still equip the title without the effects.[/*][*]The coupon is only bank-tradable.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will also receive additional Hotday boxes for 3 days of sequential logins.[list][*][b]Day 1 - [/b]First Independence Day Hotday Gift Box:
[list][*]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Refined Shadow Crystal x1 (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min.) (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Yellow Prism Box (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Star-Spangled Fabric (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable)[list][*]Will be removed once the event ends[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Day 2 - [/b]Second Independence Day Hotday Gift Box:[list][*]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Refined Shadow Crystal x1 (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min.) (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Sky Blue Prism Box (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Flagpole (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable)[list][*]Will be removed once the event ends[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Day 3 - [/b]Third Independence Day Hotday Gift Box[list][*]Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Refined Shadow Crystal x1 (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min.) (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*]Blue Prism Box (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1[/*][*][b]*NEW*[/b] Thread (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable)[list][*]Will be removed once the event ends[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can get one hotday box per day.[list][*]The day resets at [b]12:00 AM PDT[/b].[list][*]If you are logged in before the reset time, you need to change channels or re-login to receive the hotday box.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Click on either the Star-Spangled Fabric, Flagpole, or Thread and select [b]"Use"[/b] to create the installable homestead prop, [b]Homestead Star-Spangled Banner.[/b]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1798/mabinogi-4thofjuly-homestead-star-spangled-banner.png[/img]
[list][*]You need to receive the reward boxes on the same server in order to create the homestead prop.[/*][*][b]NOTE:[/b] Regardless of the server, the first character that logs in will receive the reward box.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Independence Day Fireworks[/b][/h2][list][*]Visit [b]Walter [/b]in [b]Dunbarton[/b], or any General Store merchant, to purchase Firework Kits.[list][*]General Store merchants in Taillteann, Tara, and Iria do not sell Firework Kits.

notes.title: Doc Caravan Joe's Secret Method Class
notes.content:
Word on the street is that you want to become stronger, Milletian. Well, never fear because Doc Caravan Joe is here to help! Doc Caravan Joe is willing to tell you the secrets of strength...for a price. Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, July 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 15th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] The Secrets of Strength.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Doc Caravan Joe[/b] in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square.[/b][/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Doc Caravan Joe[/b].[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing, [Guide] The Secrets of Strength:[list][*]2,000 EXP[/*][*]2,000 Gold[/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2]
[b]Deliver Wondrous Elixirs (Daily)[/b]
[list][*]You will receive the quest, [b][Daily] Deliver Wondrous Elixirs.[/b][/*][*]You will need to deliver a [b]Wondrous Elixir[/b] to Doc Caravan Joe daily.[/*][*]To craft a Wondrous Elixir, you will need the following items:[list][*][b]Potion Concoction Kit x1[/b][list][*]Can be purchased in most Healer Houses [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Combat Talent Aura x10[/b][list][*]Can be received at a chance when using a Combat Talent skill[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Life Talent Aura x10[/b][list][*]Can be received at a chance when using a Life Talent skill[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Secret Method Potion x1[/b][list][*]Received every 10 minutes, up to 10 per day[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Use the [b]Potion Making [/b]skill to craft one Wondrous Elixir.[list][*]There is no limit on how many Wondrous Elixirs you can craft per day.[/*][/list][/*][*]When you complete the daily quest, [Daily] Deliver Wondrous Elixir, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Secrets of Strength Box x1[/b][/*][*][b]Doctor Caravan Joe's Wondrous Elixir (100%)[/b][list][*]Using this item will provide 100% EXP[/*][/list][/*][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Extra Wondrous Elixirs can be consumed for 10% EXP or exchanged with Doc Caravan Joe for Secret of Strength Boxes.[list][*]There is no limit on how many Wondrous Elixirs can be exchanged per day.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir (Achievement)[/b]
[list][*]You will receive the quest, [b][Event] Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir[/b].[/*][*]Deliver the Wondrous Elixir to Doc Caravan Joe 10 times and talk to Doc Caravan Joe.[/*][*]When you complete the quest, [Event] Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* 1 Mysterious Spirit Stone (300%)[/b][list][*]Using this item will increase your Spirit's EXP gain by 300%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Talent Training Quests[/b]
[list][*]Talk to Doc Caravan Joe to select 2 Talents to train each day.[/*][*]You can select either Life Talents, Combat Talents, or a combination of both:[list][*][b]Combat Talents[/b][list][*]Close Combat[/*][*]Lance Combat[/*][*]Martial Arts[/*][*]Transmutation[/*][*]Magic[/*][*]Music[/*][*]Gunslinger[/*][*]Archery[/*][*]Puppetry[/*][*]Ninja[/*][*]Battle Alchemy[/*][*]Chain Slash[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Life Talents[/b][list][*]Adventure[/*][*]Tailoring[/*][*]Mercantile[/*][*]Medicine[/*][*]Holy Arts[/*][*]Carpentry[/*][*]Cooking[/*][*]Pet Training[/*][*]Smithing[/*][*]Glyphwriting[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once you select a Talent to train, you will receive a corresponding quest.[/*][*]You can only train two talents per day.[/*][*]Training quests that were not completed can be continued on the following day.[/*][*]Quests can only be completed once.[/*][*]Once you complete a training quest, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]Secrets of Strength Box x2[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Regimen A - Train Your Combat Talents (Achievement)[/b]
[list][*]You will receive the quest, [Event] Regimen A - Train Your Combat Talents.[/*][*]Train all 12 Combat Talents to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Secrets of Strength Box x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]You will receive the quest, [Event] Regimen A - Train Your Life Talents.[/*][*]Train all 10 Life Talents to receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Secrets of Strength Box x10[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Secrets of Strength Box[/b][/h2][list][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Starry Ambiance Lamp[/*][/list]

notes.title: The Exciting Summer Vacation in Erinn
notes.content:
The sun is shining, the birds are singing, the water temperature is just right...so that means summer is here! Time to enjoy the summer sun! What? What do you mean you have homework?! Well, complete your homework this summer and get the Summer Vacation set! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, June 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 15th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Summer Vacation Homework.[/b][list][*]You will also receive the following item:[list][*][b]Vacation Homework Notice Board[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Use the Vacation Homework Notice Board to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Summer Vacation Homework:[list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2]
[b]Daily Assignments[/b]
[list][*]Use the Vacation Homework Notice Board to choose an assignment.[list][*]You can only do one assignment per real life day.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are 12 different assignments you need to complete.[list][*][b]Homework: Fishing, the Art of Patience![/b][list][*]There are 4 assignments related to Fishing that can be completed:[list][*]Fishing: The Art of Patience - Part 1 (Daily)[/*][*]Fishing: The Art of Patience - Part 2 (Daily)[/*][*]Fishing: The Art of Patience - Part 3 (Daily)[/*][*]Fishing: The Art of Patience - Part 4 (Daily)[/*][/list][/*][*]You will also receive:[list][*]Summer Vacation Bait Tin (Event) x50[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Homework: Bug Catchers' Ball![/b][list][*]There are 4 assignments related to Bug Catching that can be completed:[list][*]Bug Catchers' Ball! Part 1 (Daily)[/*][*]Bug Catchers' Ball! Part 2 (Daily)[/*][*]Bug Catchers' Ball! Part 3 (Daily)[/*][*]Bug Catchers' Ball! Part 1 (Daily)[/*][*]Hunting for Treasure Together! Part 2 (Daily)[/*][*]Hunting for Treasure Together! Part 3 (Daily)[/*][*]Hunting for Treasure Together! Use the Vacation Homework Notice Board and select [b]Homework: Time to Turn it In![/b][list][*]When you complete an assignment, you will receive:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Life Skill 2x EXP Potion (2 Hours) (Expires in 24 hours)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If you need more materials to complete the daily assignments, you can select [b]Receiving Homework Materials[/b] on the Vacation Homework Notice Board to receive Bait Tins, Wood Chips, or a Treasure Hunt L-Rod, depending on the assignment you are on.[/*][/list]

[b]Studying in the Summer (Achievement Quest)[/b]
[list][*]After registering a main character, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Studying in the Summer.[/b][/*][*]Complete the vacation homework [b]4 times[/b] to receive:[list][*][b]Homestead Bug Catcher[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the vacation homework [b]8 times[/b] to receive:[list][*][b]Homestead Fishing Pond[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the vacation homework [b]12 times[/b] to receive:[list][*][b]Homestead Summer Rest Area[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1740/mabinogi-summer-vacation-homestead-items.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]The new Homestead items are part of the [b]"Summer Vacation"[/b] Decoration set.[list][*]Place each decoration in your homestead to receive the following effects:[list][*][b]1 Set Effect[/b][list][*]Dexterity +2[/*][*]Intelligence +1[/*][*]MP +5[/*][*]Stamina +5[/*][/list][/*][*][b]2 Set Effect[/b][list][*]Dexterity +3[/*][*]Intelligence +4[/*][*]MP +10[/*][*]Stamina +10[/*][/list][/*][*][b]3 Set Effect[/b][list][*]Dexterity +4[/*][*]Intelligence +5[/*][*]Luck +10[/*][*]MP +20[/*][*]Music Buff Effect +1[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]The Set Effect stacks with each other, so in total, you will receive:[list][*]Dexterity +9[/*][*]Intelligence +9[/*][*]Luck +10[/*][*]MP +35[/*][*]Stamina +35[/*][*]Music Buff Effect +1 [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b] If there are multiple bonuses in the same stat from other Homestead decorations, only the highest stat will be applied to the Homestead Bonuses list.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 10, 2021
notes.content:
[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66890/the-billionaire-s-bankroll]The Billionaire's Bankroll[/url]: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66893/enchanting-peacock-box]Enchanting Peacock Box[/url]: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66892/shopkeeper-s-sale-time-to-train]Shopkeeper's Sale: Time to Train![/url]: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67141/inline-skating-team-support]Support Dasha's Inline Skating Team[/url]: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67156/apricot-blossom-box]Apricot Blossom Box[/url]: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66952/reforging-tools-update-compensation]Reforging Tool Compensation[/url]: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
[b][b]Fireflies in Tir Chonaill[/b][/b]
[list][*]To celebrate the start of summer, fireflies will appear in Tir Chonaill.[list][*]Fireflies will appear from June 10th, After Maintenance to July 15, Before Maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Reforging Tools Update[/b]
[list][*] Reforging Tools have been updated.[list][*]To view all of the updates, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/67336/reforging-tools-bug-fixes]Reforging Tools Update Details webpost[/url].[/*][/list][/*][*]Due to the Reforging Tool update, there will also be compensation.[list][*]To view the details of the compensation, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66952/reforging-tools-update-compensation]Reforging Tools Update Compensation webpost[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a player would get a login alert of another player, even after already receiving that player's login alert.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Blaanid would provide inaccurate information to players during the dialogue in the quest, "Be Stronger: Winning Weapons for Warriors".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where some tooltip screenshots in the New Memory Book help menu had Korean text in the UI.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][*]There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".[/*][*]There is an issue with multiple Chinese Dragon Gauntlets sharing the same name, however, each item is race-specific.[/*][*]There is an issue where the "Start Mabinogi" and "Exit" buttons on the login screen become unresponsive.[/*][*]There is an issue with G25 text not using the correct localization.[/*][/list]

notes.title: The Billionaire's Bankroll
notes.content:
Ethel the Billionaire is here to support your growth needs! Ethel will be providing support to all Milletians by covering 90% of your repair cost fees and selling passes to dungeons. Along with Ethel, drop rates will be increased and you can also obtain the maximum amount of keys, regardless of how many players are in the dungeon! Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Investing in the Future.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Ethel[/b] near the Bank in [b]Dunbarton[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Ethel.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Investing in the Future.[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Key Drop [/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, upon completing certain dungeons, your party will receive the [b]maximum amount of keys[/b] available, regardless of how many party members are in the dungeon.[list][*][b]Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm)[/b][list][*]4 keys[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Veteran Uladh Dungeons[/b][list][*]8 keys[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Mag Mell Missions[/b][list][*]8 keys[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Tech Duinn Missions[/b][list][*]4 keys[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If the number of keys available cannot be divided equally between party members, leftover keys will be given to party members at random.[list][*][u]Example:[/u] If 3 players clear Rabbie Phantasm, each party member will get 1 key and one party member will receive an extra key.[/*][/list][/*][*]Certain dungeons may have more dungeon end chests than the max available keys given to the party.[list][*][u]Example:[/u] Depending on the number of party members who cleared Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission, there may be 6-8 chests. However, the party will still only receive a maximum of 4 keys.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Repair Fee Support[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, Ethel will help support your growth by paying for [b]90%[/b] of your repair fees.[list][*]Talk to Ethel and select "Repair Fee Support".[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Dungeon Pass Support[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event period, Ethel will sell notes.content:
[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65234/return-of-the-playful-puzzle]Return of the Playful Puzzle[/url]: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66545/the-adventures-in-paper-flipping]The Adventures in Paper Flipping[/url]: Thursday, April 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 20th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66527/street-art-box]Street Art Box[/url]: Thursday, April 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66852/a-fresh-memory-celebration]A Fresh Memory Celebration[/url]: Check the post for the full dates of all the events[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66777/noble-chevalier-box]Noble Chevalier Box[/url]: Thursday, May 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 10th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66663/a-fresh-memory-update-preview]A Fresh Memory Update[/url]: Permanent[/*][/list]
[b]A Fresh Memory Update[/b]
[list][*]Blaanid's Memoir questline has been updated! For full details, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66663/a-fresh-memory-update-preview]Update Preview.[/url][/*][*]For details on what quests were removed during this update, please check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66448/memory-book-renewal-announcement]previous announcement[/url].
[list][*]New and existing characters will receive the quest, "A Blue Fragrance on the Wind", which will start Blaanid's Brave Boost.[list][*]You need to complete the quest, "Strange Signs" in order to get the quest, "A Blue Fragrance on the Wind".[/*][/list][/*][*]To open the Memoir Books, you can go to "Character" -> "Blaanid's Brave Boost".[list][*]You can also use the shortcut, '.[/*][/list][/*][*]Blaanid is now fully voice-acted, in Korean, throughout the questline.[list][*]You can turn off the voice over by going to Options -> Sound -> Voice Volume.[/*][/list][/*][*]Weapons and outfits obtained throughout the questline cannot be traded, dropped, bank traded, pet traded, upgraded, enchanted, or burned.[list][*]You are able to dye the weapons and outfits.[/*][*]Some items received will also be enchanted during the questline as part of a quest objective.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed script errors that appeared when accessing the in-game cash shop.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a player will get a login alert of another player, even after already receiving that player's login alert.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where an untranslated notice message would appear for Elf exclusive items.[/*][*]Fixed typos in the dialogue during the quest, "Finding the Ideal Types".[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.[/*][*]There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.[/*][/list]

notes.title: A Fresh Memory Update Preview
notes.content:
Help Blaanid recover her lost memories with the revamped Memoir questline! Obtain new rewards, level up your character, and train your skills as you proceed through your journey in Erinn. Don't forget to read our [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/66448/memory-book-renewal-announcement]previous announcement[/url] to see what is being changed/removed in this update. Check out the details below.

[h2][b]Blaanid's Brave Boost[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1261/mabinogi-boost-up.png[/img]
With the new Blaanid's Brave Boost quests, you can level up quickly and earn AP!
[list][*]If your cumulative level is less than 5,000, completing Blaanid's Brave Boost quests grants 5x EXP.[/*][*]AP is also doubled when leveling up.[list][*]This effect is applied only with the experience obtained through Blaanid's Brave Boost quests. AP is earned at a fixed rate of 2, regardless of the use of items that affect the amount AP that can be earned.[/*][/list][/*][*]Whenever you complete a quest, you will receive a Rebirth Potion. [list][*]If you leveled up by completing a quest, reset your level by rebirthing.[/*][*]Please note that you will only receive a Rebirth Potion if you are under cumulative level 5,000.[/*][/list][/*][*]When a Rebirth Potion is used, the waiting time for rebirthing is reset, and you can rebirth immediately.[/*][*]Only characters under cumulative level 5,000 can use the Rebirth Potion given.[/*][/list]
[/url]
[h2][b]Memoir Books[/b][/h2][list][*]There are four Memoir books you will need to complete.[/*][*]Each Memoir book will show you different aspects of the game. [list][*][b]The First Memoir:[/b]
[list][*]Rebirthing[/*][*]Traveler's Guide[/*][*]Basics of Battle [/*][*]Potions[/*][*]Inventory Window[/*][*]Gold Boxes[/*][*]Titles[/*][*]Healing[/*][*]Flying Pets[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Second Memoir: [/b]
[list][*]How to Acquire Basic Skills[/*][*]Upgrading Equipment[/*][*]Reforging Equipment[/*][*]Repairing Equipment[/*][*]Enchanting Equipment[/*][*]Uladh Dungeons[/*][*]Shadow Missions[/*][*]Baltane Missions[/*][*]Exploration Quests[/*][*]Commerce[/*][*]Food[/*][*]Buffs from Food and Music[/*][*]Festia[/*][*]Homesteads[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Third Memoir:[/b][list][*]Music Basics[/*][*]Cleric Basics[/*][*]Life Basics[/*][*]Close Combat Basics[/*][*]Chain Blade Basics[/*][/list][/*][*][b]The Fourth Memoir:[/b][list][*]Archery Talent[/*][*]Magic Talent[/*][*]Fighter Talent[/*][*]Puppeteer Talent[/*][*]Gunslinger Talent[/*][*]Ninja Talent[/*][*]Battle Alchemy Talent[/*][*]Chain Slash Talent[/*][*]Crusader Training[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1257/mabinogi-memoir-book-ui.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Improved Quests[/b][/h2][list][*]Any quests that require you to move a long distance from your current location will now allow you to teleport for free. Click on the Wing icon in the Memoir Book to teleport![/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1254/mabinogi-wings-icon-memoir.png[/img]
[list][*]Easily followed explanations are now available in Blaanid's Memoir books along with improved images.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1280/mabinogi-image-tips.png[/img]
[list][*]Blaanid will also give you various tips and guidance throughout Blaanid's Memoir questline.[/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1284/mabinogi-blaanid-guide-image.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Enhanced Content[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1255/mabinogi-blaanid-cutscene-image.png[/img][list][*]The Memoir questline has been improved with more emotional scenarios, various cutscenes, and images.[/*][*]Korean voice over has been added for Blaanid, as well as new BGM.[list][*]You can turn off the voice over by going to Options -> Sound -> Voice Volume.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[/url]
[h2][b]The First Memoir Major Rewards[/b][/h2]

notes.title: The Adventures in Paper Flipping
notes.content:

[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Kraken Rex boss would fail to spawn in Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Missions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the thread effects for Puppetry and Gunslinger skills did not appear properly.[/*][*]Fixed and issue where the Lucky Beast Doll Bag and the Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effect did not stack with each other.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where items that changed character's skin would cause broken interactions with Transformations.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Little Hopper pet was unable to be used with two players.[/*][*]Fixed a minor typo in the dialogue with the quest "The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 3".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Friends List would display the message "Attempting to access Friends List".[/*][/list]

[list][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][*]There is an issue where a player will get a login alert of another player, even after already receiving that player's login alert.[list][*]Example: If Player A and Player B are friends, and both are logged in, if one of them opens up their Friend List when the Friend List gets refreshed, they will get a login alert of the other player even if they have already received the login alert.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Quality Time with Pets
notes.content:
Clodagh and Fovish have arrived in Dunbarton with their pets and need your help. They have one, simple question: Who is the closest to their pet? Earn points with your pets and prove to Clodagh and Fovish that YOU are the closest to your pet! Check out the details below.

[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Who's Closest to Their Pet.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Clodagh[/b] across from the Healer's House in [b]Dunbarton[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with [b]Clodagh.[/b][/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [Event] Who's Closest to Their Pet:[list][*]10,000 EXP[/*][*][b]*NEW* Score Scroll: Peeping Cutie- Solo[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]12:00 AM PDT.[/b][b]
[/b][/*][/list][h2][b]Login Rewards[/b][/h2][list][*]For every day you log in, you will receive a [b]Special Experience Fruit (100%):[/b][list][*]Increases a pet's EXP by 100%.[/*][*]3-day expiration timer.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will get a bonus amount of Special Experience Fruit (100%) depending on the amount of consecutive logins you have.[list][*][b]Example:[/b] On Day 4 of logging in, if you have consecutively logged in, you will receive 4 Special Experience Fruit (100%). On Day 5, you would receive 5 Special Experience Fruit (100%).[/*][/list][/*][*]The login counter will reset if the consecutive login streak is broken.[/*][*]If you log in on the weekend, you will get [b]Clodagh and Fovish's Special Box:[/b][list][*][b]Titi and Pepe's Supplement[/b][list][*]Raises the level of the currently summoned pet by 50.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Special Artifact (500%) (3 Day)[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Only 1 bonus reward is granted on the weekend.[/*][/list][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2]
[b]Let's Earn Points Today! (Daily)[/b]
[list][*]To earn points, you will need to do tasks every day.[list][*]You can check how many points you have by checking the [b]Bulletin Board[/b] next to Clodagh and Fovish in Dunbarton.[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the daily quest doing the following objectives:[list][*]Keep a pet summoned for 30 minutes.[list][*]Can only be completed once per day.[/*][*]Points cannot be earned by a pet that has all Pet Rebirth points.[/*][/list][/*][*]Play "Peeping Cutie - Solo" to Titi and Pepe.[list][*]Can be completed up to 20 times per day.[/*][*]You must play the song for at least a minute.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]You can earn up to [b]50 points per day[/b].[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing the daily quest [b][Event] Let's Earn Points Today[/b]:[list][*]2,000 EXP[/*][*]2,000 Gold[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Make a Doll with Titi (Week 3)[/b]
[list][*]During Week 3 of the event, you will get the quest, [b][Event] Make a Doll with Titi.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Titi[/b] in front of Clodagh in Dunbarton.[/*][*]Give Titi a [b]Sewing Pattern - Lesser Panda Rag Doll.[/b][list][*]You can buy the Sewing Pattern from Walter in Dunbarton.[/*][*]The Sewing Pattern is found in the event tab.[/*][/list][/*][*]Come back the next day after [b]12 AM PDT[/b] and talk to Titi again.[/*][*]Titi will ask you to[b] craft[/b] and then hand over multiple crafting materials to make a Lesser Panda Rag Doll for Clodagh.[list][*]You will need to craft and bring Titi the following items:[list][*]3 Cheap Silk[/*][*]5 Thin Thread Ball[/*][*]100 Wool[/*][/list][/*][*]Each time you bring Titi the requested crafting material, you will need to wait until the reset at[b] 12 AM PDT[/b] before Titi requests the next crafting material.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once [b]Clodagh's Lesser Panda Rag Doll[/b] is completed, give the item to Clodagh and talk to Titi to receive the following items:[/*][/list]

[b]Make a Doll with Pepe (Week 4)[/b]
[list][*]During Week 4 of the event, you will get the quest, [b][Event] Make a Doll with Pepe.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Pepe[/b] in front of Fovish in Dunbarton.[/*][*]Give Titi a [b]Sewing Pattern - Baby Kitty Rag Doll.[/b][list][*]You can buy the Sewing Pattern from Walter in Dunbarton.[/*][*]The Sewing Pattern is found in the event tab.[/*][/list][/*][*]Come back the next day after [b]12 AM PDT[/b] and talk to Pepe again.[/*][*]Pepe will ask you to[b] craft[/b] and then hand over multiple crafting materials to make a Baby Kitty Rag Doll for Fovish.[list][*]You will need to craft and bring Pepe the following items:[list][*]3 Cheap Silk[/*][*]5 Thin Thread Ball[/*][*]100 pieces of Wool[/*][/list][/*][*]Each time you bring Pepe the requested crafting material, you will need to wait until the reset at[b] 12 AM PDT[/b] before Pepe requests the next crafting material.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once [b]Fovish's Baby Kitty Rag Doll[/b] is completed, give the item to Fovish and talk to Pepe to receive the following items:[/*][/list]

notes.title: Pals from Pixel World
notes.content:
Erinn is in trouble and needs your help! Help the pals from Pixel World defeat the evil Demon Lord for some pixelated prizes! Craft Legendary Weapons, find the Demon Lord's castle and defeat the evil Demon Lord. The fate of Erinn lies in your hands, hero. Check out the details below.

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, April 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 29th, Before Maintenance

[b]Pals from Pixel World[/b]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Pals from Pixel World.[/b][/*][*]Find [b]Pixel Rami[/b] in [b]Tir Chonaill[/b], near Duncan.[/*][*]Register a main character with Pixel Rami.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once registered, for every [b]hour[/b] you are online, you will receive [b]1 Pixel Box.[/b][list][*][b]Note: [/b]The [b]Pixel Box[/b] will be [b]REMOVED[/b] once the event period is over so remember to open the boxes before the end of the event.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing, [Guide] Pals from Pixel World:[list][*][b]2,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Pixel Box x5[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7 AM PDT.[/b][/*][/list]
[b]The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 1[/b]

In order to defeat the Demon Lord, you must first gather a party strong enough to take on the Demon Lord! Recruit Pixel Rami, Pixel Raiuri, and Pixel Carthal into your party by bringing them their [b]Legendary Weapons. [/b]Ferghus will craft these weapons for you, but only if you bring him the [b]Stone of the Legendary Weapon[/b] first. 

[b]How to craft Legendary Weapons[/b]

Each Legendary Weapon can be crafted by bringing the corresponding stone to Ferghus. You can find the stone by completing Legendary Dungeons. You can enter the Legendary Dungeon by using a special pass, obtained through different NPCs. You can obtain a special pass [b]once a day.[/b]

Legendary Weapons are amazingly strong and take a long time to craft...[b]24 hours[/b] in fact! You can only craft [b]1 Legendary Weapon per real day[/b]. Check back in with Ferghus at 7 AM PDT to see if he has finished crafting a Legendary Weapon.

[b]Note: [/b]If you have the quest [b][Daily] Uladh Dungeon[/b], to clear an Uladh Dungeon, and you clear a [b]Legendary Dungeon[/b], the clear will count for the [Daily] Uladh Dungeon quest, instead of the event quest. Since you are only able to obtain one special pass daily, you will need to wait until the next day to clear the event quest. This issue will be fixed after the April 15th maintenance.

You will receive the following items after completing this questline:
[list][*][b]2,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Pixel Box x10[/b][/*][/list]
[b]The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 2[/b]

With your party recruited, you must now find the Demon Lord's castle. Find the [b]9 pieces[/b] of the map and put them together to find out the location of the castle. You will be given clues as to where each map piece is located. Your first clue is [b]"the place above the bridge of Adelia Stream". [/b]Good luck hero!

Once the map is completed, head to the [b]Dunbarton Library[/b], to research more on the Demon Lord. Talk to Pixel Carthal to collect and combine [b]5 Demon Lord's Castle Notes.[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2208/mabinogi-pixel-library.png?width=1111px&height=521px[/img][/b]

Let's be realistic, 5 Demon Lord's Castle Notes is not enough data, so come back the next day after [b]7 AM PDT [/b]to collect and combine [b]5 more Demon Lord's Castle Notes[/b]. Just to be sure, return the next day, [b]once again[/b], after [b]7 AM PDT[/b] to collect and combine another 5[b] Demon Lord's Castle Notes[/b]. There is a lot of data needed to defeat the Demon Lord!

It takes a long time to cross-reference and compile all the data you collected and Pixel Carthal needs the extra time! The data should be compiled after [b]7 AM PDT[/b] the next day. Don't forget to give the compiled data to Pixel Rami.

Once the data is compiled, find the Suspicious Item in the Dunbarton Library. Once retrieved, bring the item back to Pixel Rami.

[b]How to open the Sealed Box[/b]

To open the Sealed Box, you must crack the super secret code! The code is a number between 1 and 9 and any given number will not appear more than once in the code. If you get the code wrong [b]8 times[/b], the code will change. Good luck!

notes.title: 13th Anniversary - Patch Notes - March 18, 2021
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the 13th Anniversary Update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65234/return-of-the-playful-puzzle]Return of the Playful Puzzle[/url]: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65316/sweet-academy-box]Sweet Academy Box[/url]: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 1st, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65744/magnificent-wings-box]Magnificent Wings Box[/url]: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 15th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65683/13th-anniversary-update-preview]13th Anniversary Update[/url]: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
[b]13th Anniversary Update:[/b]
[list][*]Happy Anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate the 13th Anniversary of Mabinogi with tons of festivities and earn amazing rewards! Check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65684/13th-anniversary-celebration]event page[/url] for in-depth details![list][*]Talk to Thirteen in Festia to start the 13th Anniversary celebration.[/*][*]Complete daily and weekly quests to receive 13th Anniversary Coins, 13th Anniversary Special Gift Boxes, and 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets.[/*][*]How fast can you type? Compete in the Balloon Popping Mini-game and see how you stack up against other Milletians.[/*][*]Grow some mysterious balloons and hand them over to Balune the Balloon Artists for daily rewards.[/*][*]Test your strength with the Clobbermeister Mini-game![/*][*]Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.[/*][*]Use gold or 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets from different events at the Capsule Machine in Festia.[/*][*]Exchange your 13th Anniversary Coins for special prizes![/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Spirit Transformation Liqueur Update:[/b]
[list][*]You can now have up to 3 Spirit Transformation Liqueurs on your Spirit Weapons.[/*][*]You no longer need to go to Berched to apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur.[list][*]You can apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur by simply clicking on it in your inventory.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can switch between the different Spirit Transformation Liqueurs in the Spirit Information UI.[/*][*]To remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur, right-click on the icon in the Spirit Information UI.[list][*[b]IMPORTANT: [/b]If you remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur from a Spirit Weapon, you will [b]NOT[/b] receive the removed Spirit Transformation Liqueur item.[b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Note:[/b]Some Spirit Weapons may have overlapping text in the Spirit Transformation section of the UI and the Awakening Skill Enhancement section.[/*][/list]
[b]Chain Slash Skills Fix and Compensation:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills not giving stats when ranking from Rank 2 to Rank 1.[list][*]To receive the missing stats with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills, you will need to rebirth with the age and level reset checked on after the fix is live.[/*][/list][/*][*]Users that have been affected by this issue will receive the following compensation:[list][*]Rebirth Potion x1[/*][*]Skill Reset Capsule x2[/*][*]Perfect Skill Reset Capsule x1[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the dungeon information for Erinn Martial Arts Competition in the Dungeon Guide UI to specify Final Round.[/*][*]Fixed the pop-up notice message to clarify that you cannot have more than one Check Folio in your inventory. [/*][*]Fixed the Autumnal Diligence Suit (M) outfit animation that had slight blinking near the bottom pockets.
[list][*]Fixed the slight cutoff of hair texture when wearing a wig with the outfit.[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a typo in the pop-up notice message when an unknown error occurs when adding a friend or blacklisting a player.[/*][*]Fixed the Slurp gesture animation; the animation now displays the teacup in your hand.[/*][*]Fixed a quest progression issue in the G1 quest, "Fomor Medal".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the Taurus Balloon item description.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the stats for "the Price is Wright" title.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]There is a Friend's list issue where it displays the message "Attempting to access Friends List".[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]The Little Hopper is unable to be used with two players.[/*][*]The Kraken Rex boss fails to spawn in Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Missions sometimes.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.[list][*]This issue does not occur for all players.[/*][/list][/*][*]Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 13th Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2004/210311_13thanniversaryeventlive_newsarticleheader_940x290.png[/img]

It's time to celebrate Mabinogi's 13th Anniversary! Pop the balloons with the Balloon Popping mini-game, win instant prizes with the Festia Instant Prize, and test your might in the Cave of Trials! Check out the full details below.

[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 8th, Before Maintenance
[h2][b]Have fun at the 13th Anniversary Festival![/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2006/mabinogi-13-npc.png?width=135px&height=476px[/img][list][*]During this event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Have fun at the 13th Anniversary Festival![/b][/*][*]Find the NPC [b]Thirteen[/b] in [b]Festia[/b] and register a main character.[list][*]You can only register one main character per account.[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing the guide quest:[list][*]13th Anniversary Coin x13[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x4[/*][/list][/*][*]Every day, you will receive 13th Anniversary Coins, 13th Anniversary Special Gift Boxes, and 13th Anniversary Festia Entry Passes.[list][*]You will receive one 13th Anniversary Coin when logging in, and an additional coin every 20 minutes. [list][*]You will receive an extra bonus coin for the 4th and 5th 20-minute milestones.[/*][*]You can receive up to 7 coins per day.[/*][/list][/*][*]Once you reach 100 minutes of playtime, you will receive one 13th Anniversary Special Gift Box per day.[/*][*]You will receive nine 13th Anniversary Festia Entry Passes daily.[/*][/list][/*][*]Talk to the Dessert Merchant in the Fun Zone or the Dessert Merchant next to Fez to receive a free [b]13th Anniversary Cotton Candy[/b] once a day.[list][*]When consuming a 13th Anniversary Cotton Candy, you can receive EXP, Exploration EXP, Crusader EXP, or AP.[/*][*][b]Note:[/b] 13th Anniversary Cotton Candy will be removed once the event ends.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Enjoy the 13th Anniversary Festival today![/b]
[list][*]Every day, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Enjoy the 13th Anniversary Festival today![/b][/*][*]Complete the daily tasks to receive the following:[list][*]13th Anniversary Coin x7[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x4[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[/url]
[h2][b]13th Anniversary Coin Shop [/b][/h2][list][*]Talk to Thirteen in Festia to exchange your 13th Anniversary Coins for rewards![/*][/list][table][tr][th]Cost[/th][th]Item[/th][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x200 [/td][td]Cute Formal Ribbon Outfit Box (M)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x200[/td][td]Cute Formal Ribbon Outfit Box (F)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x180[/td][td]Ribbon Lightning Dragon Whistle (for 2)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x200[/td][td]13th Anniversary Luxury Equipment Bag Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x180[/td][td]13th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Doll Bag)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x150[/td][td]13th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Shop Bags)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x150[/td][td]13th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Birman Bags)[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x20[/td][td]13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x11[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x2[/td][td]13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x1[/td][td]13th Anniversary Campfire Kit[/td][/tr][tr][td]13th Anniversary Coin x1[/td][td]13th Anniversary Firework Kit[/td][/tr][/table]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2007/mabinogi-cute-ribbon-outfits-and-pet.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Balloon Popping Mini-game[/b][/h2][list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Can't Stop the Pop.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]Patriot the Balloon Popper[/b], located in Festia's Fun Zone.[/*][*]Your skill in the Balloon Popping mini-game will be ranked each day.[list][*]If you place in the top 100 by 7:00 AM PDT, you will receive a [b]special gift[/b] in your mailbox at 8:00 AM PDT.[list][*]The special gift will be in your mailbox until Wednesday, April 7th, 8:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list][/*][*]Rankings are updated every hour.[/*][*]The Balloon Popping mini-game will become inaccessible every day from 7:00 AM PDT to 8:00 AM PDT while rankings are tallied up.[/*][*]If you play the mini-game every day, you will receive a special gift.[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the Balloon Popping mini-game once to receive the following:[list][*]13th Anniversary Coins x5[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets x4[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Special Gift[/b]
[table][tr][th]Rank[/th][th]Rewards[/th][/tr][tr][td]1st Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping Victory Box[/b]
- Triumphant Typist Title Coupon (Luck +30)
- 13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x3
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x6[/td][/tr][tr][td]2nd Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping 2nd Place Gift Box[/b]
- Keyboard Warrior Title Coupon (Luck +25)
- 13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x2
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x5[/td][/tr][tr][td]3rd Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping 3rd Place Gift Box[/b]
- Hunt-and-Peck Hero Title Coupon (Luck +20)
-13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x1
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]4th Place - 10 Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping Gold Gift Box[/b]
- 13th Anniversary Gift Box x3
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x3[/td][/tr][tr][td]11th Place - 50th Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping Silver Gift Box[/b]
- 13th Anniversary Gift Box x2
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x2[/td][/tr][tr][td]51st Place - 100th Place[/td][td][b]Balloon Popping Bronze Gift Box[/b]
- 13th Anniversary Gift Box x1
- 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x1[/td][/tr][/table][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2009/mabinogi-hanging-garden-in-my-hands-edit.png[/img]
[b]Balloons Begone![/b]
[list][*]After completing the quest, [b][Event] Can't Stop the Pop[/b], you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Balloons Begone![/b][/*][*]Complete the Balloon Popping mini-game every day for 13 days.[list][*]Completing the Balloon Popping mini-game multiple times a day will not count towards the quest progression.[/*][/list][/*][*]After completing the mini-game for 13 days, talk to Patriot to receive the following items: [list][*][b]*NEW* [/b]Hanging Garden in My Hands[/*][*]13th Anniversary Coin x24[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x24[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]How to Play[/b]

[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2008/mabinogi-balloon-popping.png[/img][/b]
[list][*]Pop the balloons by typing out the exact letters written on them.
[list][*]Spacing matters as well![/*][/list][/*][*]Every time you make a mistake, there is a 10-second penalty.[/*][*]The round will end when you've popped 16 balloons.[/*][/list]
[/url]
[h2][b]Mysterious Balloons[/b][/h2]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, March 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 8th, Before Maintenance
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2010/mabinogi-balune.png[/img][list][*]During the Mysterious Balloons event period, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] Keeping Balune Afloat[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Balune the Balloon Artist[/b], located in Festia's Frontier Zone.[/*][*]After completing the quest, you will receive the following: [list][*]13th Anniversary Coin x13[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x3[/*][/list][/*][*]Balune will also give you a random revival balloon if you talk to him daily.[/*][/list]
[b]A Bounty of Balloons[/b]
[list][*]Every day, you will receive the quest, [b][Event] A Bounty of Balloons[/b].[/*][*]Complete the daily quest by planting the Homestead Balloon Tree Seeds in your Homestead. Harvest the tree once it is fully grown and give a [b]Mysterious Balloon[/b] to Balune.[list][*]Balune will give you 2 Homestead Balloon Tree Seeds to begin with.[/*][*]He will send out 2 more Homestead Balloon Tree Seeds every 20 minutes.[/*][*]You can get up to 10 Homestead Balloon Tree Seeds daily.[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest to receive the following:[list][*]13th Anniversary Special Gift Box x1[/*][*]13th Anniversary Coin x3[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x3[/*][/list][/*][*]For each additional Mystery Balloon you give to Balune, you will receive one 13th Anniversary Gift Box.[/*][/list]
[b]Market Inflation[/b]
[list][*]You will receive the weekly quest, [b][Event] Market Inflation[/b].[/*][*]Complete the daily quest, [b][Event] A Bounty of Balloons[/b], 10 times to receive the following:[list][*]Ribbon Battle Pegasus Whistle[/*][*]13th Anniversary Coin x39[/*][*]13th Anniversary Instant Prize Ticket x24[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2011/mabinogi-ribbon-battle-pegasus-2.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]It's Clobbermeister Time![/b][/h2][list][*]Every day, you will receive the following quest, [b][Event] It's Clobbermeister Time![/b][/*][*]You can access the Clobbermeister mini-game by using a 13th Anniversary Festia Entry Pass or a Festia VIP Pass.[list][*]The 13th Anniversary Festia Entry Pass will be used first.[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest daily to receive the following: [list][*]13th Anniversary Gift Box x1[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2012/mabinog-clobbermeister.png[/img]

[/url]
[h2][b]Cave of Trials[/b][/h2][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2013/mabinogi-duro.png[/img][list][*]Talk to [b]Duro the Trialkeeper[/b], located in the Frontier Zone in Festia.[/*][*]Use a 13th Anniversary Festia Entry Pass to enter the trials.[/*][*]The Cave of Trials is a one room dungeon with 16 waves of enemies.[/*][*]You cannot revive in the Cave of Trials and you cannot bring a party or pets.[/*][*]Clear waves to receive Conqueror's Chest. These chests hold a multitude of rewards, which will randomly be selected.[/*][*]Completing each wave will replace your existing Cave of Trials title with a new version of it.[list][*]The Subjugator of the First Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Second Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Third Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Fourth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Fifth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Sixth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Seventh Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Eighth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Ninth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Tenth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Eleventh Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Twelfth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Thirteenth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Fourteenth Trial[/*][*]The Subjugator of the Fifteenth Trial[/*][*][b]The Subjugator of the Final Trial[/b][list][*]Strength +16[/*][*]Intelligence +16[/*][*]Dexterity +16[/*][*]Will +16[/*][*]Luck +16[/*][*]Max HP +33[/*][*]Max Stamina +33[/*][*]Max MP +33[/*][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]If you show an improved performance in this year's Cave of Trials compared to the previous year, you will earn a special title.[list][*][b]The Developed[/b][list][*]Max Damage +16[/*][*]Critical +16%[/*][*]Movement Speed +3%[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[/url]

The puzzle pieces have been scattered across Erinn and A Boy in Need could use your help. Log in daily to collect the puzzle pieces and fit them to the board. The more puzzle pieces you collect, the more rewards you can earn including Etain's outfit! Check out the details below.

notes.content:

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64837/winter-forest-wanderer-backpack]Winter Forest Wanderer Backpack[/url]: Thursday, February 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 4th, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63660/updated-winter-2020-master-plan]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64943/valentine-shards-event]Valentine Shards Event[/url]: Thursday, February 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 25th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65118/milky-way-box]Milky Way Box[/url]: Thursday, February 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/65137/desperate-designer-event]Desperate Designer Event[/url]: Thursday, February 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a typo in the 2nd Support Box item description.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the item requirement for crafting Magic Ink with the Stationary Crafting Skill. [/*][*]Fixed a typo where Glyph effects would say "Chain: [Fighter Skill]". It has been updated to say "Combo: [Fighter Skill]".[/*][*]Fixed a text issue with the announcement message for the Emain Macha Cooking Contest.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue with the Glyph Formulation training details.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue in the warning message for Glyph Design when a Magic Quill Pen is not in your inventory. Error message will now state "You don't have all the materials needed for Glyph Design. Glyph Design requires both Magic Parchment and a Magic Quill Pen."[/*][*]Fixed a typo at the end of the G25 Hypernova credits.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the skill, Act 6: Crisis, that causes the player to be in a walking stance after desummoning a puppet.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:[/*][list][*]If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.[/*][*]If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.[/*][*]If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.[/*][*]If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.[/*][*]If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.[/*][*]If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.[/*][*]If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.[/*][/list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]There is a typo in the "Price is Wright" title. It should state Magic Attack +20.[/*][*]There is a minor typo in the Taurus Balloon item description.[/*][*]New players cannot add friends to their friend's list.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Desperate Designer Event
notes.content:
Oh no, Cindy has too many orders pouring in and she's desperate for help! Will any crafty Milletians step up to create dazzling Sewing Patterns? Cindy is willing to reward your help with super new items like the Professional's Mannequin or a Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature's Beauty! Let your creativity flow as you assist this desperate designer. Check out the details below.

 [h2]Desperate Designer Event[/h2]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, February 18th After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before Maintenance

[h3]Event Details[/h3]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea[/b].[/*][*]Find [b]Craft Designer Cindy[/b] in the [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Cindy.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]You will receive the following items after completing [b][Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea[/b]:[/*][list][*][b]2,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]2,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]Beginner's Mannequin (Event)[/b][/*][/list][*]Log in to receive 100 Design Notes once per day.[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][*]All event quests and items will be removed when the event ends. [b]These items will also also be completely removed from the Auction House when the event ends, regardless of Sold or Not Sold status, along with all the gold.[/b][/*][/list]
[h2]Quests[/h2]

[h3] Craft Designer Cindy's Sewing Pattern (Daily)[/h3]
[list][*]Complete the quest every day by using the Beginner's Mannequin received in [b][Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea.[/b][/*][*]The daily quest resets every day at [b]7:00 AM PST/PDT[/b].[/*][*]To complete the quest, you must craft [b]10 Sewing Patterns[/b].[/*][*]You can craft a Sewing Pattern using the Design Note.[/*][*]You can craft a Sewing Pattern anywhere. One Design Note will create one Sewing Pattern.[/*][*]The craft success rate by grade will differ depending on the type of mannequin used. There are three mannequins:[/*][list][*][b]Beginner's Mannequin (Event)[/b] (Received from [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea)[/*][*][b]Journeyman's Mannequin (Event)[/b] (Craftable)[/*][*][b]Professional's Mannequin (Event)[/b] (Craftable)[/*][/list][*]You can use the [b]Handicraft Skill[/b] to craft the Journeyman's Mannequin (Event) and Professional's Mannequin (Event).[/*][*]Journeyman's Mannequin (Event) and Professional's Mannequin (Event) are tradable and can be purchased from other players.[/*][*]When you complete the daily quest, you will receive:[/*][list][*][b]20,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]50 Design Notes[/b][/*][/list][/list]
[h3]Help Cindy the Designer![/h3]
[list][*]Complete the Craft Designer Cindy's Sewing Pattern quest 18 times to receive the following:[/*][list][*][b]200,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Mannequin Selection Box[/b][list][*][i]You can select one of the following:[/i][/*][*]Beginner's Mannequin
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1511/mabinogi-beginners-mannequin.gif[/img][/*][*]Journeyman's Mannequin
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1510/mabinogi-journeymans-mannequin.gif[/img][/*][*]Professional's Mannequin
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1509/mabinogi-professionals-mannequin.gif[/img][/*][/list][/*][*][b]*NEW* Sewing Pattern - Gloves of Nature
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1506/mabinogi-gloves-of-nature.png[/img]
[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* Sewing Pattern - Shoes of Nature
       [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1507/mabinogi-shoes-of-nature.png[/img]
[/b][/*][/list][/list][h3]Crafting a Journeyman's Mannequin and Professional's Mannequin[/h3]
 You can use the [b]Handicraft Kit[/b] to craft the Journey's Mannequin (Event) and Professional's Mannequin (Event).

notes.title: G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright - Patch Notes - January 21, 2021
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/img]
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright update!

[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63118/weapon-and-pet-rental]Weapon and Pet Rental[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63660/updated-winter-2020-master-plan]
[/url][/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63660/updated-winter-2020-master-plan]Winter 2020 Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63768/shy-s-night-sky-shop-2020]Shy's Night Sky Shop 2020![/url]: Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64234/ailionoa-haute-box]Ailionoa Haute Box[/url]: Thursday, January 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 28th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64505/dragon-master-event]Dragon Master Event[/url]: Thursday, January 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64508/magical-fairy-tale]Magical Fairy Tale[/url]: Thursday, January 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/64016/g25-hypernova-glyphwright-update-preview]G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright Update[/url]: Permanent [/*][/list]
[b]G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright Update[/b]
[list][*]For an in-depth look into the new Glyphwrighting Talent, check out the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/64528/glyphwrighting-guide]Glyphwrighting Guide[/url]![list][*]To become a Glyphwright, you can either rebirth into the Glyphwrighting Talent, or buy the book, "Patterns of Power (1)" from Aeira in Dunbarton.[/*][*]If you create a new character and select Glyphwrighting as your first talent, you will gain a special title called, "the Aspiring Glyphwright".[list][*]The title will disappear once you hit cumulative level 1,000.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]To start part 2 of the G25 Hypernova storyline, use the Familiar White Feather in your inventory that was given during part 1 of the G25 Hypernova storyline.
[list][*]During the storyline, you will receive the new technique, Pragarah.[list][*]When Pragarah is activated, the enemy's Magic Defense and Magic Protection are reduced.[/*][/list][/*][*]There are new titles that you can receive for completing the G25 Hypernova storyline.[list][*]You will get the title, "the Star of the Dawn" when you complete G25 Hypernova.[/*][*]You will get one of the following titles depending on your story decisions throughout G25 Hypernova.[list][*]Virtuous[/*][*]Kind[/*][*]Unmoved[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Homestead Map Update[/b]
[list][*]When viewing the Homestead Map, you can now view your favorite Homesteads in list form by clicking on the Favorites List button.[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Ball Update[/b]
[list][*]The Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library has been updated![list][*]You can now view cutscenes from Chapter 6 (G19, G20, G21) and Chapter 7 (G22, G23, G24, G25).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Llywelyn's special dialogue to address Altam as Commander.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Avelin's dialogue in "A Wavering Gaze".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "Another Path".[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) when it is equipped with a hat, the hat either is not visible or the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) loses textures.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a button on Doll Bags was previously untranslated.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Crazy Rich Milletian Fur Scarf did not appear when worn with Macha Hair.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Marleid's dialogue in "The Old Blood".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "White Wisps of Breath".[/*][*]Fixed a typo in "Slicing Through the Silence".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you could not gift Score Scrolls to the Laighlinne partner.[/*][*]The Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon and the Special Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon are now tradeable.[/*][/list]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:[/*][list][*]If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.[/*][*]If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.[/*][*]If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.[/*][*]If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.[/*][*]If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.[/*][*]If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.[/*][*]If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.[/*][/list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.[/*][*]While crafting Magic Ink with the Stationery Crafting skill, the item required says "[Color] Dye". It should say "[Color] Paint".[/*][*]Some Glyph effects say "Chain: [Fighter Skill]". It should say "Combo: [Fighter Skill]".[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dragon Master Event
notes.content:
Now's your chance to wrangle the new Red Flame Fire Dragon! Brave the Uladh Dungeon and Shadow Missions to collect what Meiling needs to craft the dragon. Or, log in every day to make this majestic pet your own! You can also earn hot rewards like Nao's Festival Bag Coupon or the Aura of Vitality 2nd Title. Check out the details below!

[b]Dragon Master Event[/b]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, January 21st After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance

[h2]Dragon Master Event Details[/h2]
[list][*]Upon log in you will receive the quest [b][Guide] Dragon Clan Across the Sea[/b].[/*][*]Talk to [b]Meiling[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account. The character must be above Level 30.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Walter Attendance Scroll[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3]Crafting a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle[/h3]
[list][*]During the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a [b]Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle[/b].[/*][*]You can only craft one Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle during the event period.[/*][*]You can also obtain a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle as a reward from the Walter Attendance Scroll event.[/*][*]The event items (Horn of Thousand Year Dragon, Fire Dragon's Red Leather, Golden Yarn of Dawn, Incomplete Horn Bugle, and Walter Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.[/*][*]You must gather one [b]Horn of Thousand Year Dragon[/b], one [b]Fire Dragon's Red Leather[/b], and one [b]Golden Yarn of Dawn[/b] for Meiling to attempt to craft the [b]*NEW* Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle[/b].
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1161/mabinogi-red-flame-fire-dragon-resting.png[/img][/*][*]You have a chance to collect the [b]Horn of Thousand Year Dragon[/b] by [b]clearing Uladh Dungeon[/b]:
[list][*]Alby Intermediate[/*][*]Alby Advanced[/*][*]Ciar Intermediate[/*][*]Ciar Advanced[/*][*]Rabbie Basic[/*][*]Rabbie Advanced[/*][*]Fiodh Intermediate[/*][*]Fiodh Advanced[/*][*]Rundal Basic[/*][*]Rundal Advanced[/*][*]Hard Alby[/*][*]Hard Ciar[/*][*]Hard Rundal[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Fire Dragon's Red Leathe[/b]r when you complete a [b]Tara or Tailteann Shadow Mission[/b]:[list][*]Basic[/*][*]Intermediate[/*][*]Advanced[/*][*]Hard[/*][*]Elite[/*][*]Lord[/*][/list][/*][*]You have a chance to collect [b]Golden Yarn of Dawn[/b] when you [b]fish at Tir Chonaill Fishing Area[/b] with Bait Tin.[/*][*]The harder the dungeon or mission difficulty, the better the chance to collect the material.[/*][*]When the crafting succeeds, you will receive an [b]Incomplete Whistle[/b]. Stay logged in for 1 hour to convert it to a [b]Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle[/b]...and the Dragon might have something special for you![list][*]If you change channels or log out before the hour has finished, the timer will reset. You will need to stay logged in for the full hour to convert it to a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle.[/*][/list][/*][*]When the crafting fails, you could keep all three materials or could lose one or more materials. You will also receive a consolation item.[/*][/list]
[h3]Walter Attendance Scroll Event Details[/h3]
[list][*]Every day spend at least 36 minutes logged in to Mabinogi on your main character to receive a reward.[/*][*]To receive your reward, you must use the Attendance Scroll and click 'Receive Gift.'[/*][*]There is a maximum of 28 rewards to collect during the event period.[/*][*]The event resets daily at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]You can collect the following rewards:[list][*]Day 1: [b]*NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Coupon [/b](Not tradable)
[list][*]Redeem this voucher for Nao's Festival Bag. Its default size is 10 by 3, offering a total of 30 slots, and can hold a variety of items.[/*][*]When you apply a [b]Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[/b] to it, you can later expand its capacity to up to 10 by 13.[/*][*]The bag takes a 2 by 2 space in the Basic Inventory. You can only have one such bag.[/*][*][b]Nao's Festival Bag is a Personal Shop Bag.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Day 2: Perfect Free Repair Kit (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 3: Guardian Soul Stone (Event) x10[/*][*]Day 4: [b]*NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[/b] (Not tradable)[list][*]A special royal pouch that can be applied to [b]Nao's Festival Bag[/b]. Use it on Nao's Festival Bag to add 1 extra row at the bottom.[/*][*]Up to 10 royal pouches can be applied to one Nao's Festival Bag[/*][/list][/*][*]Day 5: AP Potion (Event) (AP 30) (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 6: Rusty Hammer of Proficiency (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 7: [b]*NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[b] [/b][/b](Not tradable)[/*][*]Day 8: Direct Dye Ampoule (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 9: Golden Experience Fruit (300%) (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 10: [b]*NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[/b][b] [/b](Not tradable)[/*][*]Day 11: AP Potion (Event) (AP 30) (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 12: Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 13:[b] *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[/b][b] [/b](Not tradable)[/*][*]Day 14: Enchant Protection Potion (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 15: Full Recovery Potion x5 (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 16: [b]*NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch[/b][b] [/b](Not tradable)[/*][*]Day 17: Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Expires: 15 days)[/*][*]Day 18: [b]*NEW* Aura of Vitality 2nd Title Coupon (Luck +30)

notes.title: Winter Fishing Event
notes.content:
Jan has returned to smelt you away with a fish-tastic request. Show off your ice fishing skills this winter by going after the Glacier Smelt to catch some cool rewards, like the new Comfortable Fishing Chair! Check out the fishy details below!
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Winter Fishing Event[/h2]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, January 7th After Maintenance - Thursday, January 21st, Before Maintenance

[h2]Event Details[/h2]
[list][*]Upon log in you will receive the quest [b][Guide] Jan's Request[/b].[/*][*]Jan can be found next to the [b]Reus River Mana Tunnel[/b].[/*][*]Talk to Jan to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once a character is registered, that character will receive a [b]Snowfield L-Rod (Event)[/b] and a stack of [b]Glacier Smelt Bait Feeder (Event)[/b].[/*][*]Use the Snowfield L-Rods and the Land Maker action to make fishing holes along the river.[/*][*]Bring Jan some Glacier Smelts to receive rewards depending on the amount you bring him. Please be aware the [b][Event] Phishy Phobia in Physis[/b] quest must be in progress to receive the rewards.[/*][*]To get more bait complete the daily quest [b][Event] Be the One Who Smelt it and Dealt It[/b].[/*][*]To create a fishing hole in the river, Humans and Elves must use Snowfield L-Rods. However, Giants can use Stomp to open one.[/*][*]You will receive [b]100 bait each day for logging in[/b] on the character you registered as a main character.[/*][*]Bait will be received the day after you register a main character.[/*][/list]

[h2]Hot Days Details[/h2]
Log in on the listed days below to be able to receive [b]70 Iceberg Smelt Bait Feeders[/b]. You must re-log, or change channels for the hot days.
