notes.title: Helping Hands in Erinn
notes.content:
'Tis the season for giving and the Warm-Hearted Volunteer is looking for helpers! Travel around Erinn spreading good will and cheer (and the occasional carol) to earn sweet rewards such as the new Christmas Wreath Chair or Homestead Glowing Christmas Tree!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Helping Hands in Erinn Event[/h2]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Wednesday, December 23rd After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th Before Maintenance

[h2]Volunteering for the Holidays[/h2]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest [b][Guide] Volunteering for the Holidays[/b].[/*][*]Talk to the [b]Warm-Hearted Volunteer[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Daily Quest[/h2]
[list][*]Each week during the event, there will be a different daily quest. See the schedule below for what quest will be available each week.[/*][*]The daily quest is only available for the main character.[/*][*]The daily quest will reset each day at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]If you have any items in the Temporary Inventory, you will not receive a new daily quest when it resets at 7:00 AM PST. Please empty the Temporary Inventory and then re-login to the game to receive a new daily quest.[/*][*]Each day, you will need the [b]Carol Score Scroll[/b] to complete the daily quest. You can also purchase it from the Warm-Hearted Volunteer for 10,000 Gold.[/*][*]The Carol Score Scroll will be removed when the event ends.[/*][*]For the Week 2 quest, the snacks reset every day when the daily quest resets. You will receive new snacks each day.[/*][/list]
[b]Week 1[/b]: Wednesday, December 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 31, 6:59 AM PST
[list][*]During Week 1 you will receive [b][Event] Christmas with a Lonely Neighbor[/b].[/*][*]Travel to [b]Emain Macha[/b] to donate gold to the beggar and play a carol.[list][*]Tip: You can 'SHIFT + Click' on the Gold to drag and drop it for the Lonely Neighbor[/*][/list][/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* [url=#gift-box]Gift Box for Devoted Milletians x3[/url][/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 2[/b]: Thursday, December 31st, 7:00 AM PST - Thursday, January 7th, 6:59 AM PST
[list][*]During Week 2 you will receive [b][Event] Christmas with Lonely Animals[/b].[/*][*]Travel to [b]Tara[/b] to give the kitten and puppy some treats, and play a carol for them.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b][b]*NEW* [/b]Gift Box for Devoted Milletians x3[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Week 3[/b]: Thursday, January 7th, 7:00 AM PST - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance
[list][*]During Week 3 you will receive [b][Event] Christmas with a Lonely Elder[/b].[/*][*]Travel to [b]Port Cobh[/b] to play a carol for Ascon.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]100,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]3,000 Gold[/b][/*][*][b][b]*NEW* [/b]Gift Box for Devoted Milletians x3[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Completion Quest[/h2]
[list][*]After registering your main character you will receive the completion quest, [b][Event] Spread the Holiday Spirit[/b].[/*][*]Complete each week's daily quest three times, then talk to the [b]Warm-Hearted Volunteer[/b] to receive the following:[list][*]Week 1[list][*][b]Nele Music Renown Seal (10)[/b][/*][*][b]Yvona Music Renown Seal (10)[/b][/*][*][b]Briana Music Renown Seal (10)[/b][/*][*]All of the above items are untradeable, bank shareable, and have a 30-day expiry[/*][/list][/*][*]Week 2[list][*][b]*NEW* Christmas Wreath Chair (Tradeable)
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2381/mabinogi-christmas-wreath-chair.png[/img]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Week 3[list][*][b]*NEW* Steamed Bun Hat (Tradeable)
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2380/mabinogi-steamed-bun-hat.png[/img]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Once you have completed the completion quest, you will receive the following:[list][*][b]200,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]10,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]*NEW* [url=#advancement]Advancement Ticket Box x2[/url][/b][list][*]You will receive a random ticket from the following: Combat, Magic, Alchemy, Martial Arts, Puppetry, Dual Gun, Ninja Skill, or Chain Skill Advancement Ticket[/*][*]Tickets have a 30-day expiry and are tradeable once[/*][*]When you use these tickets, you will be able to automatically pass the Advancement Test for the Dan skill Advancement Test[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]New Year's Firework[/h2]

[b]Event Date[/b]: Friday, January 1st, 12:00 AM PST

Celebrate the start of 2021 with some New Year's Fireworks! This spectacular display will take place in [b]Dunbarton[/b] starting at midnight PST on January 1st, 2021. Enjoy the holiday season and we'll see you in 2021!

notes.content:
[h2][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h2]
[list][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/61953/playful-puzzle-returns]Playful Puzzle Returns![/url]: [/b]Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday December 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63118/weapon-and-pet-rental]Weapon and Pet Rental[/url]:[/b] Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63660/updated-winter-2020-master-plan]Winter 2020 Master Plan[/url]:[/b] Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63691/kartrider-pet-box]KartRider Pet Box[/url]:[/b] Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Wednesday, December 23rd, Before Maintenance[/*][b][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63758/hyper-bingo-event]Hyper Bingo Event[/url]:[/b] Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance[/*][b][*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63859/black-rose-box]Black Rose Box[/url]:[/b] Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63768/shy-s-night-sky-shop-2020]Shy's Night Sky Shop 2020![/url]:[/b] Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63838/g25-hypernova-eclipse-update-preview]G25 Hypernova: Eclipse Update[/url]:[/b] Permanent [/*][/list]
[h2][b]G25 Hypernova: Eclipse Update[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Check out the [b][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/63838/g25-hypernova-eclipse-update-preview]G25 Hypernova: Eclipse post [/url][/b]for more details![*]To start G25 Hypernova, click on 'Start' on the Chapter Info UI.
[*]You must be cumulative level 3,000 in order to start G25.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The Chipmunk Bag has been renamed to the Squirrel Bag.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Rainbow Sprite pet was not changing colors.[/*][*]Fixed an issue in the G21 quest, "A Glimpse of the Future", that stated the incorrect objective.[/*][*]Modified the description of Nele's Music Renown and Spirit Unleashing from "Critical Rate Max Increase" to "Final Critical Rate Increase (Can exceed max)."[/*][*]Fixed an issue of Nele's Music Renown and Spirit Unleashing effects not applying when the Final Critical Rate is less than 30%.[/*][*]A minimum success rate of 0.1% has been added when using the Tame Wild Animal skill on a monster.[/*][*]The bank password input window will now close if the Auction House window is closed.[/*][*]Sealed items can no longer be reforged.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Catsidhe pet pushing targets back with the Gummy Attack skill.[/*][*]The Point Inventory window can no longer be opened while using a production skill.[/*][*]You can now set a shortcut key setting for Technique Set activation. [/*][list][*][Options]->[Game]->[Control]->[Hotkey Settings][/*][/list][*]Fixed an issue where the Festia Clobbermeister matryoshka could be killed.[/*][*]You can no longer proceed through the Scathach Beach Purification mission when joining a squad, mini-game, or jam band.[list][*]Added a "Failed to Create" notification window when trying to create a jam band or mini-game party during the Scathach Beach Purification mission.[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now obtain EXP, regardless of combat power, in a Baltane Mission.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the age of a character was displayed as "0" in some RP missions.[/*][*]The following monsters/NPC fights have been fixed so that they cannot be knocked down. Additionally, the location lag has been improved.[list][*]Tabhartas (Grandmaster mission)[/*][*]Cessair's Heart (Saga Season 1)[/*][*]Tarlach (Saga Season 1)[/*][*]Enslaved Ifrit (Saga Season 2)[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where a Chain Blade hit in the G22 quest, "Wheel of Misfortune", would not be properly counted in the last phase.[/*][*]The dungeon walls inside the G24 quest, "Blessed Again", have been modified so that they do not block the player's view. Additionally, the maximum range of vision has been expanded.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where a character would freeze and would not be able to move after knocking on the door in the hallway during the G24 quest, "Deep Sea Clues".[/*][*]Fixed an issue where you are unable to click on the UI when the Stealth Potion UI overlaps another UI during the G24 quest, "Insufferable Presence".[/*][*]The issue of the cutscene in the G24 quest, "Stalemate", playing abnormally has been fixed.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Dark Thrust skill by the Incubus King was randomly not inflicting damage.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Divine Link effect was displaying in cutscenes.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Ctrl key was randomly detected as active when not actually pressed[/*][*]The Character Selection screen speed has been improved.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Character Selection sound effect would overlap.[/*][*]Fixed an issue of characters/cards/pets being shown during the loading process when they are hidden by the filter.[/*][*]Fixed the issue of characters/cards/pets overlapping in one slot.[/*][*]Fixed the issue where connecting to the world would be slower when there were more characters/cards/pets shown in the Character Selection screen.[/*][*]Fixed the issue of being able to play the game abnormally when recognition delay was created on monsters by using Anchor Rush during some missions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue of not being able to use a pet without inventory (Beginner's Horse and Beginner's Eagle) as a sub-pet during Fynn Sync.
[/*][*]A change has been made so that the mouse cursor will move normally on the screen when the Blacksmithing window is covered by another window[/*][*]Fixed the issue of text in the Blacksmithing finish window displaying abnormally under certain UI themes.[/*][*]Fixed the issue of randomly not being able to receive the Field Raid contribution quest.[/*][*]Fixed untranslated text that appeared when trying to learn the Blaze skill from Berched.[/*][*]The browser size for the in-game cash shop has been increased.[/*][*]The dungeon difficulty text in the Dungeon Guide for Alby and Ciar has been changed from Basic to Normal][/*][*]Changed the dungeon name in the Dungeon Guide from Sidhe Finnachaid of Sadness to Sidhe Finnachaid of Sorrow.[/*][/list]
[h2][b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:[/*][list][*]If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.[/*][*]If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.[/*][*]If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.[/*][*]If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.[/*][*]If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.[/*][*]If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.[/*][*]If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.[/*][/list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]When a hat is equipped with the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive), the hat is either not visible, or the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) loses textures.[/*][*]There is a disconnection error that asks players to reset their secondary password.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Soul Streamers - Next In Fashionogi Contest
notes.content:
Join [b]Reagan Kathryn[/b] and the Soul Streamers for a cosplay-themed fashionogi contest! Tune in on our official [url=http://twitch.tv/mabinogi]Twitch channel[/url] this [b]Friday, December 18th at 4:30 PM PST (7:30 PM EST)[/b]. 

[h2]Cosplaying Etain[/h2]

Host Reagan Kathryn will be modeling her cosplay of the G25 protagonist, Etain. We hope you’re as excited as we are to see the finished costume!

[h2]Next in Fashionogi Contest[/h2]

Get your outfits ready! Soul Streamers will be showcasing the winners for our Next in Fashionogi contest. In honor of Reagan’s hard work, the theme is cosplay. If you’d like to enter, please submit your in-game cosplay outfits through [url=https://forms.gle/NVLY4D4mgNwCUHZw9]our form[/url]. Winners will receive a variety of awesome prizes and may choose to walk the Tara Runway on stream. See you there!

notes.title: Hyper Bingo Event
notes.content:
Caravan Joe has returned after successfully infiltrating the Order of the Black Moon and wants to thank his savior for protecting him with the Hyper Bingo event! Complete the Bingo Board to earn rewards such as the new Eclipse 2nd Title, Etain Miniature, Mini Winter Outfits, and more!

[h2]Hyper Bingo Event[/h2]

[b]Event Dates[/b]: Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance

[h2]How Caravan Joe Shows Gratitude[/h2]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest[b] [Guide] How Caravan Joe Shows Gratitude.[/b][/*][*]Talk to [b]G25 Event Helper Caravan Joe[/b] in [b]Dunbarton's Town Square[/b] to register a main character.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed you will receive the following rewards:[list][*][b]12,001 EXP[/b][b]
[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The Bingo Sticker Packs will be removed when the event ends.[/*][/list]
[h2]Bingo Board[/h2]
[list][*]After registering your main character, you gain access to the Hyper Bingo UI.[/*][*]Click on the Hyper Bingo icon to open the Hyper Bingo Board.    [img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2212/mabinogi-bingo-board-icon.png[/img][/*][*]The Hyper Bingo UI has a bingo board, the number of Bingo Sticker Packs and duplicate stickers available, and the current Daily and C7 Challenge progress. [/*][/list]
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2214/mabinogi-bingo-board-ui.png[/img]
[list][*]The bingo board has 7 slots which correspond to the 7 trials of Hymerark. Obtain a sticker that matches each slot and complete the board.[/*][*]You gain rewards by obtaining Bingo Sticker Packs, completing bingo rows, and completing the entire board.[/*][*]Once you have completed the board, you will receive a new board and can start again![list][*]Bingo Sticker Packs, Duplicates, Daily Challenge progress, and C7 Challenges do not reset when you start a new board.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 [h2]Obtaining Stickers[/h2]
[h3]Daily Challenge[/h3]
[list][*]The Daily Challenge resets every day at [b]7:00 AM PST[/b].[/*][*]If you are logged in before 7:00 AM PST, you [b]must change channels[/b] to reset the Daily Challenge.[/*][*]You can complete these challenges each day during the event:[list][*]Log in to Erinn each day during the event to receive [b]one Bingo Sticker Pack[/b].[/*][*]Clear the Daily Shadow Mission Quest to receive [b]one Bingo Sticker Pack.[/b][/*][*]Clear the Advanced Uladh Dungeon to receive [b]one Bingo Sticker Pack.[/b][/*][*]For every 30 minutes you are logged in to Erinn, you will receive [b]one Bingo Sticker Pack[/b], up to a maximum of[b] 5 Bingo Sticker Packs per day[/b].
[list][*]Time accumulated by minutes does not reset when you change channels or logout. [/*][*]For example, if you change channels or logout after 29 min 50 sec, you will need to stay logged in for 1 min to receive a Bingo Sticker Pack.[/*][/list][/*][*]Complete the quest [b][Event] Caravan Joe's Caravan Adventure[/b] to receive [b]one Bingo Sticker Pack[/b].[list][*]You will receive a [b]Venture Contract - [Caravan Repair][/b] with the quest. This item expires in 12 hr and you can bulk delete any items that have expired.[/*][*]You can only use the Venture Contract if you have completed the [b][Guide] Thrilling Pet Expedition[/b] and have the [b]Pet Expedition Board[/b] in your Homestead. You can find out more details about the Pet Exhibition Board in the [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/guide/advancedguide/general/61453/pet-adventurer-guide]Pet Adventurer Guide[/url].[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3]C7 Challenge[/h3]
[list][*]You will receive [b]7 Bingo Sticker Packs[/b] for clearing each of the following:[list][*]G22 [Apocalypse][/*][*]G23 [Tempest][/*][*]G24 [Climax][/*][*]G25 [Eclipse] Part 1[/*][/list][/*][*]You will receive the Bingo Sticker Packs for any generations that were cleared before the event began.[/*][*]C7 Challenges do not reset.[/*][/list]
[h2]Opening Bingo Sticker Packs[/h2]
[list][*]Opening a Bingo Sticker Pack will create a random sticker.[list][*]If the sticker is new, it will be placed on the bingo board.[/*][*]If the sticker is a duplicate of one already on the board, it will be added to the [b]Duplicates[/b] count on the bingo board.[/*][/list][/*][*]Five duplicate stickers can be exchanged for a new sticker. Clicking the [b]Exchange[/b] button allows you to obtain the sticker of your choice, which can be placed on any free spot on the board.[/*][*]Every time you open a Bingo Sticker Pack you will receive [b]one [url=#doubhca]*NEW* Doubhca Box[/url][/b].[/*][/list]
[h2]Completing a Bingo[/h2]
[list][*]You complete a bingo when you have filled in 7 stickers in a row. Bingo can be achieved horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.[/*][*]Each time you complete a bingo you will receive [b]one *NEW* [url=#eclipse]*NEW* Eclipse Box[/url].[/b][/*][*]You will receive additional bonus Eclipse Boxes when completing multiple rows:[list][*][b]Complete 3 Rows: [/b]3 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes[/*][*][b]Complete 6 Rows[/b]: 3 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes[/*][*][b]Complete 9 Rows[/b]: 4 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes[/*][*][b]Complete 12 Rows[/b]: 6 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes[/*][/list][/*][*]When you finish the entire bingo board you will receive the following:[list][*][b]6 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes[/b][/*][*][b]1 *NEW* [url=#hypernova]*NEW* Hypernova Box[/url][/b][/*][/list][/*][*]After you have finished the entire board, you will be given a new bingo board to try again![/*][*]You will receive additional rewards based on the number of bingo boards you have completed:[list][*]1st Time Completion

notes.title: G25 Precursor Event
notes.content:
Caravan Joe needs your help! Rescue Caravan Joe every day to earn sweet rewards and experience to get you ready for G25. Check out the details below.

Table of Contents
[list][*][url=#favor]Caravan Joe's Favor[/url][/*][*][url=#fragments]Black Moon Stone Fragments[/url][/*][*][url=#quest]Daily Quest[/url][/*][*][url=#skill]Skill Combo Card Fragments[/url][/*][*][url=#combocard]Black Combo Card[/url][/*][*][url=#seal]Breaking the Seal[/url][/*][/list]
[b]G25 Precursor Event[/b]
Event Dates: Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance
 [/url]
[h2=favor]Caravan Joe's Favor[/h2]
[list][*]During the event, you will receive the quest, [b][Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor[/b].[/*][*]Talk to the [b]G25 Precursor Event Helper Caravan Joe[/b] in [b]Dunbarton's Town Square[/b].[/*][*]Register a main character with Caravan Joe.[/*][*]You can only register one character per account.[/*][*]Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:[/*][list][*][b]12,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day)[/b][/*][*][b]Black Moon Stone Fragment (21 days)[/b][/*][*][b]Unlock the daily quest [url=#quest][Event] Caravan Joe in Crisis[/url][/b][/*][/list][*]Once the event ends, you can no longer grow the Black Moon Stone Fragment and will only be able to break the seal.[url=#skill]
[/url][/*][*][b]Important Notes[/b][list][*] [url=#skill]Skill Combo Card Fragments[/url] and [url=#combocard]Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons[/url] will be removed when the event ends.[list][*][b]These items will also also be completely removed from the Auction House when the event ends, regardless of Sold or Not Sold status, along with all the gold.[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]The skill slots in the Black Combo Cards can only be changed with the Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons before breaking the seal and obtaining it permanently from the event.[/*][*]]Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons cannot be used to change the skill slots in the Black Combo Cards after obtaining it from the event.[list][*]This is regardless of VIP status.[/*][/list][/*][*]Do not break the seal until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.[/*][*][b]Breaking the seal is NOT reversible. Even if you break the seal by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list][/url]
[h2=fragments]Black Moon Stone Fragments[/h2]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2034/mabinogi-black-moon-stone-fragment.png[/img]
[list][*]Press the[b] Black Moon Stone Fragment image[/b] to open the event graphic. From here you can check the Black Moon Stone Fragment's growth status.
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2036/mabinogi-g25-precursor-event-ui.png[/img]
[/*][list][*][b]2[/b]: Growth status of the fragment, up to 12 stages[/*][*][b]1.8 cm[/b]: 12 sizes of gems that you can obtain after breaking the seal[/*][*][b]100 pts[/b]: Growth points of the Combo Card that you can use[/*][/list][*][b]Note[/b]: Obtaining Combo Card points and growing Black Moon Stone Fragments is not possible beyond 12 stages or after breaking the seal. However, you can still complete the daily quest.[/*][*]Filling the gauge 100% within a day will cause the fragment to grow by 1 stage.[/*][*]You can fill the gauge in the following ways:[/*][list][*]Stay logged in for 90 sec real-time to increase the gauge by 1%.[/*][list][*]Changing channels or logging out doesn't reset the gauge. However, if you change channels or log out before increasing the gauge by 1% (for example, only being logged in for 85 sec), you will need to stay logged in for the full 90 sec again.[/*][*]This resets daily at 7:00 AM PST. If you are online before 7:00 AM PST, it will reset without you needing to change channels.[/*][/list][*]Your gauge increases 25% each time you complete Today's Special Mission.[/*][list][*]Check Today's Special Mission - Taillteann/Tara Mission to determine what you need to do.[/*][*]Completing both missions will increase the gauge by 50%.[/*][/list][*]The gauge increases 50% upon completing the daily quest [url=#quest]Caravan Joe in Crisis[/url].[/*][*]As a bonus, each time you clear G22, G23, and G24 your fragment will grow by 1 stage.[/*][list][*]You will earn a stage for each generation completed before the event starts. If you have already completed all three generations, you will start at stage 4.[/*][*]If you clear G22 - G24 before the event begins, you will automatically reach stage 2 - 4 when the event starts:[/*][list][*]Clear G22: [b]Stage 2 Rewards[/b][/*][*]Clear G23: [b]Stage 3 Rewards[/b][/*][*]Clear G24: [b]Stage 4 Rewards[/b][/*][/list][/list][/list][*]You will receive the following rewards for each stage:[/*][list][*]Note: Item rewards are untradeable and expire in 14 days[/*][/list][/list][table][tr][th]Stage[/th][th]Gem Size (cm)[/th][th]Combo Card Points (Accumulated)[/th][th]Item Reward by Growth Stage[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]1.0[/td][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]1.8[/td][td]100[/td][td][b]AP Potion (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]2.6[/td][td]200[/td][td][b]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]3.4[/td][td]300[/td][td][b]Skill Training Seal (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]4.2[/td][td]400[/td][td][b]AP Potion (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]5.0[/td][td]500[/td][td][b]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]5.8[/td][td]600[/td][td][b]Skill Training Seal (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]6.6[/td][td]700[/td][td][b]AP Potion (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]7.4[/td][td]800[/td][td][b]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]10[/td][td]8.2[/td][td]900[/td][td][b]Skill Training Seal (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]11[/td][td]9.0[/td][td]1,000[/td][td][b]AP Potion (30)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]12[/td][td]10.0[/td][td]1,100[/td][td][b]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/b][/td][/tr][/table][/url]
[h2=quest]Daily Quest: Caravan Joe in Crisis[/h2]
[list][*]The[b] [Event] Caravan Joe in Crisis[/b] unlocks after completing [b][Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor[/b].[/*][*]The daily quest resets [b]every day at 7:00 AM PST[/b]. After you have completed the daily quest, you will receive one Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day) every day when you log in, starting the day after the first time you completed the quest.[/*][*]Use the Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day) to start the mission.[/*][*]You can enter the mission with a party of one to four people.[/*][*]If any member of the party is not registered as a main character for the event or has reached that day's limit of 10 missions, the party will not be able to start the mission.[/*][*]Before starting you can select the mission difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard).[/*][*]The difficulty level will determine your rewards, including how many Skill Combo Card Fragments you receive.[/*][list][*][b]Easy[/b][/*][list][*][b]45,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]1,000 Gold Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Reward Box (2 - 3 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 Random Potion, x1 Random Tailoring Material)[/b][/*][/list][*][b]Medium[/b][/*][list][*][b]90,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]15,000 Gold Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Reward Box (4 - 5 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 [b]Random [/b]Potion, x1 [b]Random [/b]Tailoring Material)[/b][/*][/list][*][b]Difficult[/b][/*][list][*][b]190,000 EXP[/b][/*][*][b]25,000 Gold Pouch[/b][/*][*][b]Reward Box (6 - 7 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 [b]Random [/b]Potion, x1 [b]Random [/b]Tailoring Material)[/b][/*][/list][/list][*]Once you have completed the quest, you will earn the following rewards:[/*][list][*][b]Fragment gauge fills up 50%[/b][/*][*][b]x2 Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day)[/b][/*][*][b]300,000 EXP[/b][/*][/list][/list][/url]
[h2=skill]Skill Combo Card Fragments[/h2]
[list][*]You earn Skill Combo Card Fragments by participating in the Daily Quest.[/*][*]When you collect 10 Fragments for the same type of Skill Combo Card, you can exchange them for a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon.[/*][*]The Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon is used to change the selected skill in the Black Combo Card.[/*][*]There are 10 different types of Skill Black Combo Card Fragments and Exchange Coupons. All are tradeable.[/*][list][*][Warrior] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Archer] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Mage] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Alchemist] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Merchant] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Fighter] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Puppeteer] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Gunslinger] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Ninja] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][*][Chain Slasher] Skill Black Combo Card[/*][/list][/list][/url]
[h2=combocard]Black Combo Card[/h2]

notes.title: Harvest Festival
notes.content:
Greetings Milletians!

Autumn is here, and that means it is time for the Harvest Festival once again! If you remember from last time, Thanksgiving is my favorite holiday: friends, and food! Once again however, it's too much work for just one person (meaning me, of course). Can you help me gather what I need to throw a marvelous feast? If you help me out, I'll reward you with some sweet rewards!

Love,
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00I8Z-40756681-de36-43fe-89ba-03c495ea8a1f.png[/img]

notes.title: Dungeon Guide System - Patch Notes - November 12th, 2020
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Dungeon Guide System update!

[h2][b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b][/h2]
[list][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLJ/]Playful Puzzle Returns![/url]: Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 24th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00JLf]Attendance Check Event[/url]: Thursday, October 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 19th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00JLk]Steam Engineer Toolbox[/url]: Thursday, October 29th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 25th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLt/]Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLr/]Generation Boost Event[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JM1/]Weapon and Pet Rental[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance[/*]	[*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLq/]Dark Divination Box[/url]: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLs/]Dungeon Guide System[/url]: Permanent[/*]	[/list]	

[h2][b]Dungeon Guide System:[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The Dungeon Guide System update is now live! Easily see which dungeons you've cleared or find new dungeons to explore with the new Dungeon Guide UI. You can also earn a ton of rewards and buy items from a brand new shop. [/*]	[list]	[*]You can check out the full details of the Dungeon Guide System update [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLs/]in the guide![/url][/*]	[*]You can access the Dungeon Guide UI by clicking on the Info tab, and selecting Dungeon Guide.[/*]	[*]Each dungeon and mission listed on the Dungeon Guide UI will show information about that dungeon/mission. It will also show some of the main rewards of that dungeon/mission, as well as the guaranteed repeated dungeon clear rewards.[/*]	[*]Clearing dungeons or missions multiple times will have guaranteed rewards. You can obtain these rewards in the Dungeon Guide UI.[/*]	[*]Each dungeon or mission can only be repeated 10 times per account per real life day. The repeat timer resets at 12 AM server time.[/*]	[*]The Dungeon Guide UI will also show recommended dungeons based on your physical or magical damage output.[/*]	[*]Completing certain dungeons will yield you Support Boxes that will aid your character in getting stronger.[/*]	[*]There is a new shop that you can access via Eavan in Dunbarton.[/*]	[*]To purchase items in this shop, you will need Vouchers.[/*]	[*]Vouchers can be obtained by registering a main character at Eavan and completing dungeons/missions.[/*]	[*]You are able to change your registered character once per day after registering.[/*]	[*]There are 4 different types of Vouchers that you can obtain in different dungeons and missions.[/*]	[/list][/list]	

[h2][b]Permanent Changes:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Dungeon Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The 8-Player Dungeon event will be turned on permanently with the Dungeon Guide update.[/*][*]You are now able to enter any of the following dungeons with 8 players on any difficulty:[/*]	[list]	[*]Alby[/*]	[*]Ciar[/*]	[*]Rabbie[/*]	[*]Math[/*]	[*]Fiodh[/*]	[*]Barri[/*]	[*]Coill[/*]	[*]Rundal[/*]	[*]Peaca[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]Chapter 7: Apocalypse Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The required level to start Chapter 7: Apocalypse has been reduced from level 5,000 to level 3,000.[/*][*]All enemy stats and skill ranks have been nerfed.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]G22: Apocalypse Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Chance and Destiny":[/*]	[list]	[*]In the last phase of the mission, the amount of time that you need to survive the wave of enemies is now displayed on screen.[/*]	[*]The mission will not fail if the player is knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Wheel of Misfortune":[/*]	[list]	[*]During the last phase of the mission, the target submerges into the water, but does not move too far.[/*]	[*]An issue where Dorcha Snatch was not counted as a hit to the target has been fixed.[/*]	[*]When using certain Chain Blades skills that cannot hit the target, a message containing instructions will appear.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Holy Barrier":[/*]	[list]	[*]Picking an incorrect answer will no longer cause the mission to fail.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 quests, "In Search of Clues 1-7" and "Collect Clues 1-4":[/*]	[list]	[*]The amount of glowing spots that you needs to find during "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been reduced.[/*]	[*]The instruction text that guides you throughout "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been improved.[/*]	[*]Directional markings have been added to lead you to the destination in the quests "In Search of Clues 2" and "Collect Clues 2".[/*]	[*]A location marker has been added to the NPC that needs to be found in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".[/*]	[*]The mission guide dialogue has been improved in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".[/*]	[*]The cooking difficulty for the quest "In Search of Clues 5" has been drastically reduced.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 quests, "Seven Eyelids", "Phantoms Among the Snow", "A Memory of Emain Macha", "Seeking the Last Symbols", and "A Missing Memory":[/*]	[list]	[*]If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "The Broken Prison Gate":[/*]	[list]	[*]You are now able to proceed with the quest, even if you do not have the skill, Life Drain.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "Seeking the Last Symbols":[/*]	[list]	[*]The instruction text that appears during the quest has been improved.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Executive Discretion":[/*]	[list]	[*]The amount of time you need to survive the wave of enemies will now be displayed on screen.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Castling":[/*]	[list]	[*]A message to better understand the mission progress has been added.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "A False Promise":[/*]	[list]	[*]The damaging field left by Salamanders and the damage from the Salamanders has been reduced.[/*]	[*]The duration of the summoned Fire Pillars and the damaging fields that appear have been reduced.[/*]	[*]The overall damage from the boss enemy has been reduced.[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]G23: Tempest Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Winter Festival":[/*]	[list]	[*]The hints provided for the Quiz Contest will be more direct.[/*]	[*]You are now able to skip the sliding Picture Puzzle mini-game.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Preparing for the Plague":[/*]	[list]	[*]The number of quest items needed to proceed with the quest has been reduced from 5 of each item, to 1 of each item.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered by the Winds":[/*]	[list]	[*]If you lose the Topaz Arrow that Hagel gives you to enter the dungeon, you can request another one from him.[/*]	[*]No matter which Topaz Arrow you use to enter the dungeon (either the one given before the update or the one given after the update), the quest item, a Fresh Water Bottle, will now be given 100% of the time.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered Omens":[/*]	[list]	[*]If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Jarlath's Trail":[/*]	[list]	[*]The required quest item can now be obtained 4 at a time.[/*]	[*]The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%, regardless of the difficulty of the Shadow Mission.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Rain and Fire:"[/*]	[list]	[*]Enemy stats in the quest mission have been nerfed.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Eye Spy":[/*]	[list]	[*]You can now locate the target on the mini-map.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "New Path in an Old Land":[/*]	[list]	[*]The number of sketches that need to be checked has been lowered.[/*]	[*]You can now locate all of the targets needed on the mini-map.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Nightmare's Embrace":[/*]	[list]	[*]Enemy stats in the mission have been nerfed.[/*]	[*]The chance of the enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.[/*]	[*]You are now able to revive in the mission using Nao Stones.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Generations":[/*]	[list]	[*]The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "On the Brink":[/*]	[list]	[*]The warp device's recovery rate has been increased by 1.5x.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Who Rules the Sea":[/*]	[list]	[*]Some skill damage from enemies has been nerfed.[/*]	[*]The amount of summoned enemies that you need to defeat has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The amount of summoned enemies appearing at the same time has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The chance of an enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Failed Hypothesis":[/*]	[list]	[*]While possessed by the enemy, the debuff effect has been decreased.[/*]	[*]When the enemy is enraged, the attack damage increase rate has been nerfed.[/*]	[*]The damage needed to cancel the enraged effect has been decreased.[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]G24: Ascension Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Blue and White":[/*]	[list]	[*]The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.[/*]	[*]The skill damage of the enemy has been nerfed.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "The Secret in the Swamp":[/*]	[list]	[*]The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Deep Sea Clues":[/*]	[list]	[*]You no longer need to play the sliding puzzle mini-game.[/*]	[*]The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Undertow":[/*]		[list]	[*]The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Gaze of the Blood Moon":[/*]	[list]	[*]You are now able to clear Phase 2 of the mission when the enemy's HP drops below 50%.[/*]	[*]The damaging field and the damage the enemy can deal have been decreased.[/*]	[*]The duration of the Fire Pillar and the damaging field have been decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "A Lonely Obsession":[/*]	[list]	[*]The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The close combat damage of the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The number and range of the bombs dropped by the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[*]You will no longer get knocked out when hit by a bomb.[/*]	[*]The number of summoned orbs has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The time limit that you have to defeat the summoned orbs has been increased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Lullaby of the Abyss": [/*]	[list]	[*]The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The duration of the bleed effect from the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[/list][*]The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "At the End of the Road":[/*]	[list]	[*]Since the enemies have been nerfed, the RP character has also been nerfed.[/*]	[/list][*]The following changes have been made to the G24 quest, "Moonlight of Death":[/*]	[list]	[*]The amount of HP the enemy has, based on the number of party members you bring into the mission, has been decreased.[/*]	[*]The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.[/*]	[*]You will no longer get stunned or knocked out when attacked by the enemy.[/*]	[/list][/list]

[h3][b]Technique Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The cooldown time of the Techniques, Iron Will, Relentless Assault, and Exploit Weakness, has been changed to 10 minutes.[/*][*]The cooldown time of the Technique, Time Shift, has been changed to 15 minutes.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Tory Ravine Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Poison Alligator, Doubcha Saturos, and Doubcha Floating Stone will no longer attack on sight.[/*][*]You will no longer be invincible when talking to a G24 NPC.[/*][/list]
	

[h3][b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where cash items purchased with NX Credit required you to try and claim the items twice before it moves into your inventory.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with skill training EXP potions having the same name as EXP potions. Skill training EXP potions will name have "Skill" in the name.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with Shamala's Transformation Medal item tooltip displaying the incorrect name for Caravan Joe. The name has been changed to Halloween Caravan Joe.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with promotional crossover items appearing with random color when previewing in the Dressing Room.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where multiple items were previously not listable in the Auction House.[/*][/list]
[h3]
[b]The following are known bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.[/*][*]There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:[/*][list][*]If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.[/*][*]If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.[/*][*]If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.[/*][*]If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.[/*][*]If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.[/*][*]If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.[/*][*]If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.[/*][/list][*]There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".[/*][*]There is an issue where you are unable to enter the Forgotten Tomb because it will say you are already in a Shadow Mission.[/*][/list]

[h2]Soul Streamers Livestream Event[/h2]	
Join Soul Streamers for their very first livestream event! Tune in on our official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mabinogi]Twitch channel[/url] this [b]Thursday, November 12th at 4:00 PM PST (7:00 PM EST)[/b]. 
	
	[h2]Soul Streamers Dungeon Crawl[/h2]	
Hosts Toasterlady and Casket Kicker are joined by the rest of our Soul Streamers crew: Rixi, Way3, Cryozen7, Reagan Kathryn, Mabi Nerd, Brahfizzle, and Fyhir. Together, they’ll be tackling Uladh dungeons in 8-party teams on both Nao and Alexina. Be sure to check it out for giveaways throughout the stream!

notes.title: Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event
notes.content:
For a limited time, enjoy an increase in drop rates for some of Uladh's rarest items! Eight party dungeon teams are now a permanent addition to Mabinogi, so gather 7 friends and get ready to clear those dungeons. Check out the details below.


[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, November 12, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17, Before Maintenance

[h2][b]Event Details[/b][/h2]
[list][*]You can enter Uladh Dungeons with a [b]maximum of 8 party members.[/b][/*]	[*] [b]Entering dungeons with 8-party teams is a permanent addition. You can continue to use 8-party teams after the Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event ends.[/b][/*][*]These dungeons include the following, on any difficulty:[/*]  [list]  [*]Alby Dungeon[/*]  [*]Ciar Dungeon[/*]  [*]Math Dungeon[/*]  [*]Rabbie Dungeon[/*]  [*]Barri Dungeon[/*]  [*]Coill Dungeon[/*]  [*]Fiodh Dungeon[/*]  [*]Rundal Dungeon[/*]  [*]Peaca Dungeon[/*]  [/list][*]During the event, drop rates of dead end treasure chests from Uladh Dungeons are increased. This means that there will be an increased drop rate for items such as [b]Destructive Robe sewing patterns, Succubus Fiend sewing patterns,[/b] and [b]weapon crafting materials[/b]![/*]  [list]  [*][b]Affected Dungeons[/b][/*]    [list]    [*]Math Dungeon (Regular, Basic, Advanced)[/*]    [*]Rabbie Dungeon (Regular, Basic, Advanced)[/*]    [*]Barri Dungeon (Regular, Basic, Advanced)[/*]    [*]Rundal Dungeon (Regular, Basic, Advanced, Hard Mode Advanced)[/*]    [*]Peaca Dungeon (Regular, Basic, Intermediate)[/*]    [/list]  [*][b]Affected Items[/b][/*]    [list]    [*]Sewing Patterns: Destruction Robe, Succubus Fiend[/*]    [*]Crafting Materials: Awakened Strength Fragment, Cleansed Mage's Gem, Forged Weapon Piece, Destroyed Seal Chain, Ruptured Black Metal etc.[/*]    [*]Free Repair Kits[/*]    [/list]  [/list][*]There is also an increased drop rate of [b]Milky Way Instrument Materials[/b] from [b]Math Music Dungeon.[/b][/*]    [list]  [*]Song Stardust[/*]  [*]Melodic Metal Board[/*]  [*]Harmonic Wood Board[/*]  [*]Instrument Strings[/*]  [/list][*]There is also an increased drop rate of [b]Soluna Blade materials[/b] from [b]Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon[/b] and[b] Alban Knights Training Grounds SS.[/b][/*]  [list]  [*]Blacksmith Manual- Soluna Blade[/*]  [*]Duskblade[/*]  [*]Dawnblade[/*]  [*]Solite[/*]  [*]Lunite[/*]  [*]Fate Fragment[/*]  [/list][*]You can buy Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Passes for 400,000 gold from the [b]Researcher at the Poulnaborne Rock[/b] in [b]Dunbarton.[/b] [/*] [/list]

notes.title: Lorraine's Nightmare
notes.content:
Lorraine has returned and so have her nightmares! Lorraine's dreams are haunted and she needs your help to stop the Arc Lich and his minions. Are you ready to enter the shadows? Check out the full details below.
[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]Lorraine's Nightmare[/b][/h1]
[b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, October 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 12th, Before Maintenance

[list]  [*]During the event, you will receive the quest [b]The Eight Nightmares of Lorraine[/b].[/*]  [*]The quest will lead you to [b]Lorraine[/b] in [b]Dunbarton Town Square[/b].[/*]  [*]Party up with 3-6 of your friends to enter Lorraine's Nightmare Shadow Mission.[/*]  [*]Select your role! You can choose from Warrior/Fighter, Mage/Bard, or Alchemist/Ranger (limit 2 per role).[/*]  [*]The Shadow Mission has up to [b]8 waves of monsters[/b], and must be cleared 3 times, to complete The Eight Nightmares of Lorraine quest.[/*]		[*]The Eight Nightmares of Lorraine quest can be completed once per day. The quest resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][/list]
[h2]Quest Details[/h2][list]  [*]When you enter the Shadow Mission, you'll first need to talk to [b]Lorraine[/b]. She can't fight the monsters on her own![/*]		[*]Speaking to her will allow you to purchase supplies to help you in your battle against the undead or select the wave of monsters you'd like to fight.[/*]  [*]In the Shadow Mission you will also find [b]Marcellus[/b]. You can select your role for the Shadow mission through him.[/*]  [*]You can purchase stat or skill upgrades from him with a 5,000 gold allowance to start off. Choose your upgrades wisely, as any upgrades purchased cannot be undone![/*][/list]

notes.title: Attendance Check Event
notes.content:
Earn some great rewards, including Reforging Tools, for playing every day! Get everything you need for a romantic wedding with the new Homestead Wedding-themed items and a new Wedding Carpet or Wedding Long Bouquet pet! Check out the details below!
	[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]Attendance Check Event[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Event Dates:[/b] Thursday, October 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 19th, Before Maintenance[/h3]

notes.title: Picnic Gift Event
notes.content:
Every day you play takes you one coupon closer to earning the cute Corgi Picnic Mat! You can also get a daily power up with an out of this world Starbright potion from the Star-Powdered Pouch. Check out the details below.

[hr][/hr]
 
[h2]Picnic Gift Event[/h2]
Event Dates: Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, October 15th, Before Maintenance
[h2]Event Details[/h2][list][*]Log in for 36 minutes each day to receive the following:[/*][list][*]1x Star-Powdered Pouch[/*][*]1x Picnic Gift Coupon[/*][/list][*]The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.[/*][*]The Star-Powdered Pouch and Picnic Gift Coupon will be removed when the event ends.[/*][*]Combine 15 Picnic Gift Coupon to receive a Corgi Picnic Mat.[/*][/list]
 
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2466/mabinigi-corgi-picnic-mat.gif[/img]
 
[h3]Star-Powdered Pouch[/h3][list][*]You will randomly receive one of the following when using a Star-Powdered Pouch:[/*][list][*][b]Aquarius Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Item Drop Rate by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Aries Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Production Skill Success Rate +10% for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Cancer Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Strength, Intelligence, Dexterity, Will, and Luck +15 for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Capricorn Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Defense, Protection, Magic Defense and Magic Protection +5, and Critical +2 for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Gemini Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases AP from leveling up by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Leo Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Skill Training EXP for Close Combat, Magic, Battle Alchemy, and Martial Arts Talent Skills by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Libra Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Quest Completion Gold by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Pisces Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases EXP from defeating Monsters by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Sagittarius Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Max Damage +5 and Magic Attack +15 for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Scorpio Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Skill Training EXP for Archery, Lance, Dual Gun, and Ninja Talent Skills by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Taurus Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Quest Completion EXP by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][*][b]Virgo Starbright Potion[/b] (Increases Skill Training EXP for Puppetry, Music, Transmutation, and Chain Slash Talent Skills by 2x for 1 hour)[/*][/list][*]All Starbright Potions are not tradeable and have a 15-day expiration.[/*][*]The effects of multiple Starbright Potions cannot be active at the same time, and each type of Starbright Potion can only be used once per day. The cooldown will be reset at 00:00 each day.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Campfire Spirit - Patch Notes - September 10th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Campfire Spirit & Quality of Life update!
[b]The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:[/b]
[list][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JKr/]Modern School Uniform Box[/url]: Thursday, August 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JKl/]Connous Beach Vacation Event[/url]: August 27th, After Maintenance - September 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JK3/]Summer Master Plan[/url]: Thursday, July 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 24th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JKz/]Study Event[/url]: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JKv/]Historian's Old Trunk Sale[/url]: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 8th, Before Maintenance[/*][*][url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JLA/]Inventory Expansion Coupon and Inventory Expansion Coupon PLUS[/url]: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Permanent[/*][/list]

[b]New Updates:[/b]
[list][*]The [b]Campfire Spirit & Quality of Life[/b] update is now live! Gather round the campfire and invite your friends and favorite NPCs to kick back and relax with you. There are ample changes to make your life in Erinn even better![/*][*]The Campfire Spirit is an update to the Campfire skill![/*][list][*]Check out an in-depth overview of how the Campfire Spirit works [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JL2/]on the guide![/url][/*][*]Earn increased EXP and items for burning items in the campfire.[/*][*]Occasionally obtain Burning Firewood and Campfire Invitations when performing normal burns.[/*][*]Before you set up the Campfire Spirit Campfire, use the [b]Campfire Invitation[/b] to invite one Erinn resident to the campfire (note that if you set up a campfire without using the invitation, the invitation will be deleted).[/*][*]Use [b]Burning Firewood[/b] to create a Campfire Spirit campfire to summon the Campfire Spirit.[/*][*]Earn additional rewards for burning items at a Campfire Spirit campfire and bonus EXP.[/*][/list][*]Check out all of the [b]awesome quality of life improvements[/b] in this update [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00JL8/]on its dedicated webpost[/url]![/*][list][*]There are numerous improvements to the pet UI, Auction House, Shadow Missions, dressing room, general UI, and inventory![/*][/list][/list]

[b]The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the name of a duplicate Cute Heart Star Face Beauty Coupon (F) to Plump Heart Star Face Beauty Coupon (F).[/*][*]Some Shadow Mission Quest titles will no longer display and overlap the mission details in the Quest UI.[/*][*]Added "Pet Training" as a selectable Life Talent to receive a Skill Training EXP 2.0 bonus for the Catsidhe Pet.[/*][*]Fixed the Music Buff Duration of Fleur's Grass Tiara to match the description.[/*][*]Fixed the warning message that appears when buying limited allowable trade items or bidding/enlisting in the Auction House.[/*][*]Fixed overlapping text issue when using a Talent Reset Capsule and scrolling through the description.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the hair colors from the Spring 2020 Hair Dye Selection Box did not display the color code correctly on Hairstyle Reversion Coupons.[/*][*]Fixed a typo for the Required Materials when making a Courageous Borage Perfume.[/*][*]Fixed a typo in the description of the "Unfading Flower".[/*][*]Changed Homestead item names to be Camping Bicycle, All-Terrain Bike and Trailer, and All-Terrain Bike Set.[/*][*]Fixed the issue where the Windmill Skill of the Gio, Lento, and Alto pets cannot be loaded.[/*][*]Changed the name for Long Wavy Hair Beauty Coupon (F) to Long Wavy Ponytail Hair Beauty Coupon (F).[/*][*]Fixed an issue with overlapping text in Blaanid's Memoir 3 Share Food 50 Times quest.[/*][/list]

[b]The following are known bugs:[/b]
[list][*]The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.[/*][*]The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.[/*][*]Cash items purchased with NX Credit will require you to try and claim the items twice before it moves into your inventory.[/*][*]Player character will hold the item Cup o' Joe incorrectly with a closed fist.[/*][*]Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.[/*][*]Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlon Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).[/*][*]Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.[/*][*]There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.[/*][*]The gold and ducats bar is misaligned in the main inventory.[/*][*]Pop-up UI message will have the header display as "OK" when listing or bidding in the Auction House.[/*][*]The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.[/*][*]Some mail sent by Erinn Residents invited to a Spirit Campfire may have cutoff text.[/*][*]Some items in the Dressing Room will have random colors displayed when previewing them.[/*][*]The new Repurchase tab for NPC Shops appears in alphabetical order. This will be moved to the last tab for NPC Shops later.[/*][*]Manually inputting numbers above the maximum for Production queues will automatically change to the correct maximum amount after clicking "Start".[/*][*]The newly added expiration highlights for items in Pet and Partner inventories do not display correctly.[/*][/list]

[h2][u]Pets[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Current and Cumulative levels of a pet can now be viewed in the Pet/Partner Window when you hover over a pet's name.[/*]
[*]The Hotkey Settings button has been added to the Pet/Partner Info window.[/*]
[*]You can now delete expired items in your pet's inventory by using the Expired Items function signified by the 'Hourglass' icon.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]Auction House[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the "Equip Restrictions" search filter when searching in the "Armor" category of the Auction House.[/*]
[list]
[*]Additionally, the following searchable keywords have been added:[/*]
[list]
[*]Human[/*]
[*]Elf[/*]
[*]Giant[/*]
[*]Male[/*]
[*]Female[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]When searching for specific options in the Auction House using the "Advanced Search Filter", the search filter is maintained even when refreshing the search.[/*]
[*]When listing an item in the Auction House, it has been changed so that you can modify the price amount after highlighting any area with the mouse.[/*]
[*]Added the "Yearly" market price range option when viewing an Item's Market Price Data in the Auction House.[/*]
[*]The speed of searching for item names in the Auction House has been improved.[/*]
[*]You can now list Pet Adoption Medals with stored pets on the Auction House.[/*]
[*]The following categories have been added to the Misc section of the Auction House:[/*]
[list]
[*]Beauty Coupon[/*]
[*]Adoption Medal[/*]
[list]
[*]The following advanced search filters have been added for Adoption Medals:[/*]
[list]
[*]Price[/*]
[*]Remaining number of adoptions[/*]
[*]Pet race name[/*]
[*]Pet cumulative level[/*]
[*]Pet points[/*]
[*]Pet type[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]You can now preview the following items in the Auction House:[/*]
[list]
[*]Shamala's Transformation Medals[/*]
[*]Beauty Coupon[/*]
[*]Appearance Scrolls[/*]
[*]Homestead Props[/*]
[*]Outfit animations[/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Additionally, the issue of seeing abnormal animation when previewing a weapon with unique animation in the Auction House has been fixed.[/*]
[/list]
[*]The average price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal are now individually calculated according to the individual kind of Sewing Pattern, Blacksmith Manual, or Shamala's Transformation Medal item.[/*]
[list]
[*]With the above change, the average selling price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal has been reset.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Shadow Missions[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]When receiving an Elite Shadow Mission, a menu will show a list of all Elite Pass items available for use in the inventory.[/*]
[list]
[*]Items with an expiration timer will be listed first, depending on which pass expires first.[/*]
[*]The number of passes owned won't matter.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Daily Shadow Missions now start at the same time when you first log in.[/*]
[list]
[*]The day will reset at 7:00 AM server time.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Any daily Shadow Missions from the previous day are now automatically cancelled if you did not complete them before the reset.[/*]
[*]The time requirement for when these Daily Shadow Missions can be completed has been removed.[/*]
[*]A change has been made to prevent Daily Shadow Missions from being forfeited.[/*]
[*]You cannot start the Daily Shadow Mission of that day if you have a previous quest that can be completed.[/*]
[list]
[*]You must complete the quest and log in again or change channels to start the quest of that day.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Dressing Room[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now preview items that are not collected in the Dressing Room. These items will be previewed in random colors each time you preview them.[/*]
[list]
[*]Some wings are not currently available for preview, including some dyeable wings.[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a feature in the Dressing Room that shows if you currently have the needed Beauty Coupon in your inventory for Hair, Eyes, Face, and Mouth styles when hovering over a style.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]UI Improvements[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Favorite 1st and 2nd Titles can be added/removed by right-clicking the title in the Title menu. Favorites are signified by a star icon.[/*]
[*]The "Keep Equipped Equipment" option is checked by default during rebirth. Additionally, any titles that were equipped before rebirthing are retained if you rebirth using this option.[/*]
[*]When attempting to enter a Homestead shortly after combat, a pop-up window will now display the amount of time you must wait before entering.[/*]
[*]The max auto-craft quantity for items created with the following Production skills have been increased to 100. Please note that special items that can only be crafted 1 at a time has not been increased.[/*]
[list]
[*]Weaving[/*]
[*]Handicraft[/*]
[*]Refining[/*]
[*]Potion Making[/*]
[*]Carpentry[/*]
[*]Hillwen Engineering[/*]
[*]Magic Crafting[/*]
[*]Fynn Crafting[/*]
[*]Milling[/*]
[*]Theatre Mission Pass Crafting[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a "Status List" menu to view all active status effects for the character.[/*]
[list]
[*]This menu can be opened by clicking on "Details" in the Character Info menu.[/*]
[*]The remaining duration for any status effect with a time limit can also be viewed in the Status List.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Improvements have been made to the recipe search function in the Production skill menu.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]Party Board[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The party board now displays the party's name..[/*]
[*]A party created for the Mini-game Mafia can now be registered to the Party Board.[/*]
[*]You can now sort the party list by clicking on the Party Name, Party Leader, Party Goal, Detailed Items, Restrictions, Members, or Features tab of the Party Board.[/*]
[*]The Party Board tooltip will now display if a member of the party has a title with a Party EXP increase effect.[/*]
[list]
[*]The tooltip will also display if the Grandmaster Cleric Unique Effect is activated.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Options Improvement[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]There is now an on/off option for game sounds to play even when the game screen is not active.[/*]
[list]
[*]You can toggle this option by going to Options -> System -> Sound.[/*]
[/list]
[*]There is now a "Borderless Full Screen" mode.[/*]
[list]
[*]You can set this mode by going to Options -> System -> Screen.[/*]
[/list]
[*]The "Full Screen" button has been removed from the System menu.[/*]
[list]
[*]Pressing the Left Alt + Enter buttons in windowed mode will now switch to borderless full screen mode.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Bank[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Bank inventory window will now display above your inventory when you access the Bank.[/*]
[*]Bank items can now be freely moved, similar to bags, as long as there is space available.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]NPC Shops[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now select the quantity of individual items in a NPC shop.[/*]
[*]There is now a "Repurchase" tab in all NPC Shops. Items sold to a NPC shop can be repurchased for the price it was sold at.[/*]
[list]
[*][u]Only up to 10 items, starting from the ones you sold recently, can be repurchased.[/u][/*]
[*]When you log out or move channels, the list of repurchasable items is reset.[/*]
[*]You cannot repurchase items that have a Shop Sales Bonus or Exploration EXP.[/*]
[*]You cannot repurchase items that are exempt from Bank fees.[/*]
[/list]
[*]Items with the enchants that give you extra gold when selling, cannot be repurchased.[/*]
[/list]
[h2][u]Traveler's Guide[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]The Traveler's Guide search function has been improved with the following changes:[/*]
[list]
[*]You can now search without needing to add a space.[/*]
[*]You can now search by typing a single letter.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Friend's List[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]New options have been added to the Friend's list for notifications:[/*]
[list]
[*]You can now set the use of Offline Groups for your friend's list via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[*]You can now toggle guild member login notifications on/off via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[*]You can now set an alert for unread notes when logging in via Friend's List -> Options.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Graphics[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Characters will no longer appear semi-transparent while in Screenshot Mode.[/*]
[*]Resolution settings are now based on the monitor in use.[/*]
[list]
[*]4K and Ultrawide (21:9) resolution is now supported.[/*]
[*]The "Widescreen support" option has been removed.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][u]Other[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]In-game video clips now sync with your BGM volume option.[/*]
[*]Screenshot filenames will now be saved with the year, month, day, hour, and minutes.[/*]
[list]
[*]Hours are displayed in the 24-hour format.[/*]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Pawsitively Elite Training Part 2
notes.content: Continue your journey with the second part of the Pawsitively Elite Training update! Clear two new dungeons in Mag Mell to earn cool rewards such as Faded Fynn Beads. Explore the Pet Harmony system and craft new recipes as you grow your Pet Trainer skills to the next level. Check out the details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/pet/part2]here[/url].

notes.title: Pawsitively Elite Training
notes.content: The Pawsitively Elite Training (P.E.T.) update brings exciting ways to interact with your pets! The new Pet Trainer cultivates the power of the Fynn to tame and connect with Erinn's pets. Use Fynn Syncing to transform your pet into a Fynn Pet, improving their abilities. You can also defeat monsters to obtain Fynni Gems and bloom the Fynni Gems through the Fynni Blossoming skill to gain a Fynni Pet! Check out the details [url=https://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/pet/part1]here[/url].

notes.title: My Little Pet
notes.content: There’s more to do with your adorable pets in Mabinogi! Summon your lovely pets and send them on expeditions to explore the vast world of Erinn. After the adventures are over, your pets can rest and play in the Pet House. Check out the details [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/micro-site/pet/mylittlepet]here[/url]!

notes.title: KartRider: Drift Closed Beta Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[url=http://kartrider.nexon.net/en/news/article/56227][img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1013/kartrider-drift-sign-up-for-closed-beta-2-1000x200-en.png[/img][/url]

Milletians,

[b]KartRider: Drift[/b] is revving up and racing towards its second Closed Beta period! We've been working hard on this new free-to-play, cross-platform kart racer since we announced it last November, and we're looking to see what you think of the high-speed action this June!

[previewyoutube=SXfwSR1n2m0;full][/previewyoutube]

Sign up today and join us on [b]June 3[/b] to see Nexon America's next game in action as KartRider: Drift shows off new tracks, a new character, new skins, and a bevy of improvements made thanks to our beta testers' feedback!

notes.title: Memento Update
notes.content:
The bards encamped by Abb Neagh Lake have stumbled across something: music, an unfamiliar sound from an unfamiliar instrument, drifting over the water, stirring their curiosity. Help them meet a strange young girl in the surreal new adventure in the land of Erinn: Memento!


[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-00c9cee9-d5c1-4be8-862b-11a9af7b5017.jpg[/img]

[b]New Storyline: Memento[/b]

The music drifts over the lake at night. Those that have gone to look have found no one behind the enchanting bells, ringing and ringing as midnight passes by. The bard Yvona, out of curiosity, or perhaps just a desire to have her rest go undisturbed, seeks out help to find out what is behind the strange sounds in the night sky...

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-b843a58c-0b8c-4842-a506-beec554be663.jpg[/img]

Characters with a cumulative level of 500 or higher will be given a quest to meet with Yvona on the banks of Abb Neagh Lake, to begin the Memento storyline. 

[b]New Dungeons: Sidhe Finnachaid[/b]

The Memento Update brings us a new dungeon, Sidhe Finnachaid, sitting beneath the waters of Abb Neagh Lake. This dungeon has a special twist: Every time you enter the dungeon, your party leader will be able to select a version of the dungeon to battle in: Sorrow, Fear and Curiosity, each with a different Water Level, different foes to defeat and different rewards to claim.

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-8de88326-c67b-48e3-a356-1e984f2f805f.jpg[/img]

[b]Echostones[/b]

Echostonesare a brand new collection of power-boosting items that you'll only find in Sidhe Finnachaid. Equipped in the new Echostone section of the inventory, each stone will grant a boost to a primary stat or your Heath, Mana and SP pool, even beyond the 1500 point stat cap. But while you can Upgrade your Echostonesat the end of each Sidhe Finnachaid run, there's far more power to unlock here...

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-1ea1b9e4-3320-45e0-b715-8c72839182a2.jpg[/img]

At the end of Sidhe Finnachaid, you'll also be able to Awaken an Echostone by spending AP and Awakening materials collected throughout Sidhe Finnachaid. Awaken an Echostone to give it additional effects, including ones that can be found via Reforging and a special set of new abilities to grow your power even further. And if you don't like an existing Echostone's power, you can dismantle Echostones, granting Echostone Catalysts, Magic Powders and random items, including Elite Passes, gems, equipment and more.

[b]New Skill: Dance of Death[/b]

Finish the quest, "So That You Are Not a Memory", in the Memento storyline to learn the brand new Dance of Death Skill! This skill allows you to move freely while busting a move, causing damage to enemies around you. If doing Ballet with floating hearts isn't your thing, then you can switch to different moods and themes, which you can obtain in the new Sidhe Finnachaid dungeon, by clicking the Manage Button next to the skill. Earn double EXP this weekend, get through the storyline for a special new title, earn AP potions every day and claim special prizes for the next three weeks.

Check out the full details in the [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/All/1/00J5H/]Memento Events post[/url].

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - APR. 19, 2017
notes.content:
[COMPLETED] Maintenance is now completed in Mabinogi. Enjoy your day in Erinn
https://support.nexon.net/hc/en-us/articles/115001370723-Scheduled-Maintenance-on-April-19th

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00HIC-902a4875-0fa6-4a98-a660-255d82d28aac.jpg[/img]

On [b]Wednesday, April 19[/b], all services for Mabinogi will perform a scheduled maintenance in order to enable everyone around the globe to better enjoy Mabinogi and other Nexon titles. The following services will be offline during this time:[list]
[*]Game Access (Both Nexon Launcher and Nexon Steam Launcher)
[*]Game Website
[*]Game Forums
[*]Account Login and Sign up
[*]Account Billing[/list]

Maintenance Times:[list]
[*]PDT: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM
[*]EDT: 3:00 AM – 3:00 PM
[*]GMT: 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
[*]CEST: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
[*]AEDT: 5:00 PM – 5:00 AM (April 20th)[/list]

This maintenance is part of a global account migration from a specific Nexon America Account system to a Global Account system.

Once maintenance is complete, the process for logging in to our games will remain essentially the same. However, there will be a few minor changes for those players who currently log in with their Nexon username, as all account logins will now be performed using an email address. This will greatly improve the process of logging in across multiple titles.

The situations below will cover those players who currently log in with a username, and those who currently log in with either a verified or unverified email address. Please note that the following will apply across website login, the Nexon Launcher and the Nexon Steam Launcher moving forward.[list]
[*]If you currently log in with a [b]verified email address[/b], you should notice zero changes.
[*]If you currently log in with your [b]Nexon username[/b], and is it [b]associated with a verified email address[/b], you will need only to confirm your email address. This email address will become your new login, in place of your username.[/list]


[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J3q-2ec0f088-37be-4a23-a19a-10a7cfa61e16.jpg[/img][list]
[*]If you currently log in with your [b]Nexon username[/b], and it is [b]associated with an [/b][b]unverified email address[/b], we will ask you to verify the email address in order to log in. This email address will become your new login.
[*]If you currently log in with your [b]Nexon username,[/b] and it is [b]not associated with an email address[/b], we will ask you to provide and verify a unique email address in order to login. This email address will become your new login.[/list]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J3q-9cb8a0e0-a7ed-4531-8b87-69aadcad4743.jpg[/img]

As part of this account migration, please note that we are no longer allowing sign-up via a Facebook-connected account, and players will need to maintain a verified email address in order to participate across all Nexon titles. We also recommend you never duplicate passwords across accounts, and that you update your unique personal password from time to time.

If you have any issues with your account after this maintenance, please file a Customer Support ticket at [url=https://support.nexon.net/]https://support.nexon.net/[/url].

notes.title: Mabinovel and Find the Suspect Event
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IxG-b10efad1-a262-4919-b80f-446e840637e4.jpg[/img]

Let your creative spark free with Mabinovel, an all-new activity coming to Mabinogi for good!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IxG-490179a0-af34-4d26-81d6-0a0d0b24e7c8.jpg[/img]

With Mabinovel, you can craft your own stories and cutscenes using the characters, audio and artwork from Mabinogi. Set up the characters, write their dialogue, use sound and visual effects to spice up the action and share your work with your fellow Milletians!

You're not just writing for posterity, though: Every reader means Gold for you through the power of royalties, collectable through the Mabinovel Bulletin Board. All you need to do is speak to Aeira at the Dunbarton Bookstore and register as an Author to get started. Just remember, you can only have one character registered as an Author per account.

[url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IxG/mabinovel-and-find-the-suspect-event]Read More[/url]

notes.title: Mabinovel and Find the Suspect Event
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IxG-b10efad1-a262-4919-b80f-446e840637e4.jpg[/img]

Let your creative spark free with Mabinovel, an all-new activity coming to Mabinogi for good!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IxG-490179a0-af34-4d26-81d6-0a0d0b24e7c8.jpg[/img]

With Mabinovel, you can craft your own stories and cutscenes using the characters, audio and artwork from Mabinogi. Set up the characters, write their dialogue, use sound and visual effects to spice up the action and share your work with your fellow Milletians!

You're not just writing for posterity, though: Every reader means Gold for you through the power of royalties, collectable through the Mabinovel Bulletin Board. All you need to do is speak to Aeira at the Dunbarton Bookstore and register as an Author to get started. Just remember, you can only have one character registered as an Author per account.

[url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IxG/mabinovel-and-find-the-suspect-event]Read More[/url]
