notes.title: Refined Reforged Tools PLUS
notes.content:
We've got a brand new type of Refined Reforging tool for you! The Refined Reforging Tools PLUS works much like the standard Refined Reforging tool, with the same maximum possible enhancements when used. However, the Refined Reforging Tools PLUS stand apart with their reliability: Even the worst possible Reforgings will still give a powerful boost to your item. You can pick up stacks of 1, 11, 35 and 50 of the Refined Reforging Tools PLUS from now through July 5th!

[url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IwZ/refined-reforged-tools-plus]Read More[/url]

notes.title: G20 Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-732ad486-6719-4727-8175-f22c377f9a69.jpg[/img]

A new threat awakens and the Alban Knights need your help to safeguard Erinn from this unholy threat. G20 is here with the next part in the story of Mabinogi!

[h1]G20: The Gate of Sanctuary[/h1]
It has been a time of troubles for the Alban Knights. The attacks by the Prophets have taxed their soldiers and shown that Erinn is not as safe as it once seemed... and now something new and terrible has seeped into Tir Chonaill. Human bodies, glowing with a golden energy before rising from the dead. Those that have completed G19's story can speak to Talvash in Tir Chonaill to get started with G20 and discover The Gate of Sanctuary!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-aff30329-dd0f-4901-b600-473cf3880696.jpg[/img]

[h1]Squires of Baltane[/h1]

War has few constants, but two parts remain true: You need soldiers to fight in them, and they won't all return. No matter how well you fight, eventually new soldiers will need to be trained, and the Alban Knights have given you that honor.

For full details, [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00ItR]click here[/url]!

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-1bf1df26-4df0-4d7b-b63d-33fd5193a8bb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Divine Skill Changes[/h1]

G19 saw the addition of the Divine Knights' central abilities, the Divine Skills. With G20, a brand new set of Divine Skills have been added, and a few of the previous set have been improved to grow even stronger.

For full details, [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00ItR]click here[/url]!

[h1]New Items[/h1]

A new story, new abilities and new students to train not enough? A gross of new items have also made their way to Mabinogi! Grab the following items in your quest to defend Erinn.

For full details, [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00ItR]click here[/url]!

[h1]G20 Registration Rewards[/h1]

Don't forget: If you Registered for G20, you have until May 11th, 2016 in order to claim your prizes! Simply login with your Level 50 or higher Character and claim all the goodies below!

For full details, [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00ItR]click here[/url]!

notes.content:

August is for Mabinogi Mastery! Join us during The Master Plan event for lots of buffs, free items, and weekly free rebirths!

notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IMV-8631fd60-ee81-413e-9de2-b42e8c7d1552.jpg[/img]
We’re celebrating 7 years of Mabinogi in March! Enjoy MabiLand from March 18th  - April 21st. MabiLand is a special carnival to commemorate our 7th Anniversary, filled with delicious foods, fun carnival games, and awesome prizes. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00IMV]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IO2-0ef6a581-b7a2-4570-8a69-371a89f686b1.jpg[/img]
St. Patrick’s Day is also being celebrated from March 18th – April 7th, defeat the Leprechaun and earn irresistible St. Patrick’s Day themed prizes. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00IO2]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00INj-daf8959b-f164-4863-93b7-3b39146de72b.jpg[/img]
Need more of a challenge? A New Apostle Raid Mode has been unleased! You’ll now be able to face Girgashiy in the new Very Hard Mode, so grab your friends and work together to take down this Apostle! [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00INj]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IO1-c3f804e3-ce28-4ce4-8fad-c0e3561c4bfd.jpg[/img]
The 7th Anniversary Assorted Gift Set is also on sale this month, from March 18th – April 21st you can get the best items in Mabinogi all at once! This item features Nao’s Cheerful chest which will gift you with a new item daily. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00IO1]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IO3-bf2f7333-5c09-469e-9f06-b17acd71a126.jpg[/img]
The Eweca Orb has also been renewed, and includes fun new outfits and hats to show off to all your friends. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/News/Announcements/1/00IO3]Read More[/url]

Happy 7th Anniversary Milletians, let’s have some fun!

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fMA6V36.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Lunar Fortune![/u][/b]
2015 is the Year of the Sheep, and this event is one way to see if your luck will be good or baaaaaad. A mysterious Fortune-teller has appeared in Dunbarton, passing out Fortune Boards to all those seeking some sheep thrills. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IK5/lunar-fortune]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK8-4940e438-fedd-4f8b-97a0-8ec94c775a8d.jpg[/img]

[b][u]The Adorable Sheeptuplets Box[/u][/b]
You've never seen sheep like these before. They walk on two legs, wear cute little outfits, lure over other sheep with their amazing personalities, and they don't even need their little wings to fly - they'll lift you off your feet as an epic Cumulosheepus! Adopt your very own Sheeptuplet, just in time for Lunar New Year!  [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IK8/the-adorable-sheeptuplets-box]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK6-9dbe15f5-3805-482a-8121-e8a2360c501f.jpg[/img]

[b][u]New Gingerbread Truck[/u][/b]
It's a bird, it's a plane - no, it's much tastier than that! The sweet soaring Gingerbread Truck is more than just a mobile business, it's a lifelong companion with a sugary constitution. Go where you will and bring your buddies along for the ride, the land of milk and cookies is just beyond the horizon! [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IK6/new-gingerbread-truck-pastry-perfection-on-the-go]Read More[/url]

[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00G2Y-416dd02e-96fe-4459-aa0b-7b654c6b7c51.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Homestead Candy Bonanza Returns[/u][/b]
Your Homestead grows and changes with the seasons, and now is the perfect time to indulge in some seasonal Valentine's Day treats. Whether you're a botanist looking to grow a Candy Tree, a fisherman seeking some special goodies or an interior-decorating shopaholic, Candy Bonanza offers something for every homebody. [url=http://mabinogi.nexon.net/news/all/1/00IK9/update-homestead-candy-bonanza-returns]Read More[/url]

notes.title: Chapter 6 Prologue Events
notes.content:
Already, the ripples of Saga: Iria II are being felt throughout Erinn. The course of history has been changed forever... can life ever go back to how it was? A new threat is on the horizon and you're the only one who can stop it. Prepare for the unknown as you venture beyond in the Chapter 6 Prologue. Prepare yourself for the future of Mabinogi today. 

For all the details visit: http://fal.cn/ETl

notes.title: New DLC Available - Mabinogi - Spiritual Healing Package
notes.content:
The Spiritual Healing Package, all new content for Mabinogi is Now Available on Steam!

A perfect package for new players, the Spiritual Healing Package includes: Nao Soul Stones (5), Full Recovery Potion (5), Mass Holy Water of Lymilark (2), and Ice Bombs (3).

notes.title: New Free to Play - Mabinogi
notes.content:
Mabinogi is now available on Steam and is Free to Play!

Mabinogi offers a robust, online universe where people can experience all facets of fantasy life, from fighting monsters to harvesting fresh produce in the world of Erinn. It provides a new experience with a variety of gameplay, unique combat system, and orderly time element and age components.
